qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht ‘Kamp bereid tot harder optreden tegen dumpen van staal’

Teeven (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares concern that Chinese steel dumping threatens Dutch jobs, whether harder action is needed, and how higher duties would be pursued in Europe. Minister Kamp answered that the current lesser duty rule duties are effective, he sees no reason to abandon the rule or seek higher duties now, and he asked industry for evidence before considering additional measures.
At present the cabinet therefore sees no reason to abandon the lesser duty rule in favour of an alternative.
Op dit moment ziet het kabinet dus geen aanleiding om de lesser duty rule te laten varen voor een alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het CAO-overleg bij Defensie

Teeven (VVD) asked the Defence Minister whether CAO wage negotiations at Defence had stalled over long-term pension-related pay issues, what the sticking points are, and how talks will proceed. The minister confirmed the talks are stalled, explained that Rijksbrede pension developments are being assessed and will take time, and said the unions have suspended negotiations pending that assessment.
Defence considers reaching a working conditions agreement important and hopes negotiations can resume in the short term.
Defensie vindt het bereiken van een arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord belangrijk en hoopt dat de onderhandelingen op korte termijn kunnen worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het vrijhandelsverdrag tussen de EU en de VS (TTIP)

MP Teeven asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether she agreed that TTIP negotiations had effectively failed and how far they had progressed. The minister confirmed the German statement, described the reactions of several member states and the US, and said that conclusion in 2016 is unlikely without major US concessions, while providing a general status update.
On this, the cabinet will send your House a report as usual.
Daarover stuurt het kabinet uw Kamer zoals gebruikelijk een verslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht ‘Laat veteranen op 25 juni vrij reizen’

An MP asked whether post-active veterans may travel free by rail on Veterans Day, and whether this excludes actively serving veterans and their families. The government answered that post-active veterans get two free day-train cards per year via the Veterans Institute, with an extra card for a partner or companion when registered for the parade, while active-duty veterans claim travel costs through Defence.
Post-active veterans receive travel tickets via the Veterans Institute, because they cannot claim through the regular Defence channels.
Post-actieve veteranen krijgen vervoerbewijzen via het Veteraneninstituut, omdat zij niet via de reguliere Defensiekanalen kunnen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven inzake het bericht over gestolen data van Zwitserse speciale eenheden door Russische hackers

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked the Defence Minister about reports that Russian hackers stole data on Swiss special forces, the risks of such cyberattacks to the Dutch armed forces, and whether Dutch units' identities are adequately protected. The Minister replied that Switzerland is investigating the incident, that Defence faces a considerable and growing cyber espionage threat but has not lost sensitive information so far, and that the Swiss case does not require additional measures.
Defence repels attacks daily and there are so far no known cyberattacks in which sensitive information has been seized.
Defensie slaat dagelijks aanvallen af en er zijn vooralsnog geen cyberaanvallen bekend waarbij gevoelige informatie is buitgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over de fitheidstest bij de krijgsmacht

MP Teeven asked the Defence Minister about the large number of military personnel, especially senior officers in office jobs, who do not complete the mandatory annual fitness test, and whether the test should be abolished or enforced. The minister answered that the test is a useful instrument, will not be abolished, that obstacles such as facility access will be addressed with alternatives, and that commanders already have disciplinary tools to enforce it.
The individual reasons are not recorded.
De individuele redenen worden niet vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht "Defensiepersoneel vreest honderden ontslagen"

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether hundreds of jobs will disappear at DMO and JIVC due to an IT reorganisation, and about the effects on the investment quota and project timelines. The minister confirmed that JIVC and Operations are merging into one IT company, that the precise staffing effects are not yet clear, and that personnel will be consulted and redeployed where possible.
The precise consequences of these developments for the required size and composition of the future workforce are not yet clear.
De precieze gevolgen van deze ontwikkelingen voor de benodigde omvang en de samenstelling van het toekomstige personeelsbestand zijn nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het bericht "Openbaarmaking personeelsblad MIVD brengt werknemers in gevaar"

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked why the MIVD staff magazine Ingelicht was published online with unredacted staff names and photos, and what is being done about security risks. The Minister says the names should have been anonymised, that the MIVD advised honouring the access request, that no threats have been recorded, and that efforts to have the personal data removed have not yet succeeded.
In hindsight, however, it can be concluded that when the access request was granted, the names in the magazines should have been anonymised.
Achteraf kan echter geconcludeerd worden dat bij het honoreren van het inzageverzoek de namen in de bladen geanonimiseerd hadden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Teeven over de bewapening van politie en marechaussee

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence about heavier arming of police and Royal Marechaussee in light of the terror threat, and about staffing and training. The government replied that equipment and armament are set per situation based on threat assessment, that the Marechaussee can carry out its core tasks though capacity is tight, and that extra staff is being recruited.
Should it become apparent that the performance of the Marechaussee's core tasks is at risk, the desirability and possibility of new additional measures will of course be reassessed.

Mocht blijken dat de uitvoering van de kerntaken van de Kmar in het geding komt, dan zullen de wenselijkheid en de mogelijkheid van nieuwe aanvullende maatregelen vanzelfsprekend opnieuw worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Thales Nederland

Two MPs asked the defence and economic affairs ministers whether Thales Nederland's 200 job cuts relate to postponed naval investments, what this means for the domestic defence industry and armed forces' access to radar technology, and how investment planning accounts for industry knowledge. The minister replied that the cuts are a company reorganisation, that investment decisions are weighed against the budget, that access to SMART-L radar technology is secured through signed contracts, and that knowledge is maintained via the Gouden Driehoek cooperation and maintenance contracts.
The measure announced by Thales Nederland is of a business-economic nature and concerns an internal reorganisation.
De maatregel die Thales Nederland heeft bekendgemaakt is van bedrijfseconomische aard en betreft een interne reorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het onderzoek naar de export van omstreden goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of dual-use goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including licensing, the countries involved, and consequences for defence projects. The minister confirmed that customs is investigating after the ministry was alerted and that the remaining questions will be answered once the investigation, expected in about two months, is complete.
Questions 3 through 7 will be answered after the customs investigation has been completed.
De vragen 3 tot en met 7 worden beantwoord na afronding van het onderzoek van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over Dumpstaal uit China

An MP asked the trade and economic affairs ministers about alleged dumping of Chinese cold-rolled steel, its effects on climate goals and Tata Steel's Hisarna technology, and whether they would press the European Commission on anti-dumping timing and measures. The minister replied that an EU anti-dumping investigation is underway with preliminary findings due by 14 February 2016, that the Netherlands weighs environmental costs of duties case by case, and that the issue has been raised in EU Council meetings.
Yes. This issue was discussed during an extraordinary session of the Competitiveness Council on 9 November 2015 and at the regular Foreign Affairs Council (trade) on 27 November 2015.
Ja. Deze kwestie is besproken tijdens een ingelaste sessie van de Raad van Concurrentievermogen op 9 november 2015 en tijdens de reguliere Raad voor Buitenlandse Zaken handel op 27 november 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Fokker

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked whether Fokker's job cuts of 270 positions affect Dutch defence industry, the armed forces, F-35 technology access, and whether Thales cuts signal a wider trend. Minister Kamp answered that the cuts stem from the civil aircraft market, do not weaken Fokker's strategic partnership with Defence, are unrelated to Thales, and that future trends cannot be predicted.
Through the measures now announced, the strategic partnership in the form of industry cooperation with Defence is not affected.
Door de nu aangekondigde maatregelen wordt het strategische partnerschap in de vorm van samenwerking van de industrie met Defensie niet aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het personeelstekort bij Defensie

An MP asks the Defence Minister about the personnel shortage, including the fill rate of vacancies, hard-to-fill technical posts, the Techbase event, reinstating older staff, workload and innovative recruitment. The minister reports 94% filled military posts, an 86% recruitment target, a partly frozen right to extend service, and points to the personnel report for details.
The military organisation is 94 percent filled (reference date 1 July).
Antwoord 2 De militaire organisatie is voor 94 procent gevuld (peildatum 1 juli).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het opleggen van een anti-dumpingheffing aan ZEP BV Urk

An MP asks whether ZEP BV Urk, forced by minimum order volumes to buy solar roof tiles from Chinese producers, should be subject to anti-dumping duties up to 64%, and whether SMEs should be restricted by such duties. The minister explains that price undertakings with over 120 Chinese producers can avoid the duties, that duties apply regardless of firm size, and that solar roof tiles are supported through net metering and energy innovation policy.
When imposing anti-dumping and countervailing duties, no distinction is made between small and large importers.
Bij het opleggen van antidumping en compenserende rechten wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen kleine en grote importeurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over een tekort aan bommen boven Irak voor Nederlandse F-16’s

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the Defence Minister about a reported shortage of bombs for Dutch F-16s fighting ISIS over Iraq, including consequences, causes, reorders and allied supply. The minister replied there is no current shortage, but certain precision munitions may run out over time due to higher consumption and long delivery times, and that the government is pursuing deliveries, loans and prioritisation with allies and producers.
There is currently no shortage of bombs for the Dutch F-16s deployed in the fight against ISIS.
Er is op dit moment geen tekort aan bommen voor de Nederlandse F-16’s die worden ingezet in de strijd tegen ISIS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Teeven over de financiering van het verjaardagsfeestje van de VARA door het vfonds

MPs Bruins Slot and Teeven asked whether the vfonds, an independent foundation for veterans, funded the VARA's 90th anniversary party and a half-million-euro TV series on labour history, and whether this fits its mandate and was coordinated with Defence. The Minister replied that the vfonds is independent with its own spending authority, confirmed the subsidy, declined to judge the foundation's guidelines, and said she held no consultation because the subsidy does not affect veteran care funding.
The National Fund for Peace, Freedom and Veterans Care (vfonds) is an independent foundation with autonomous control over its expenditure.
Het Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg (vfonds) is een onafhankelijke stichting, met autonome zeggenschap over haar uitgaven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Van Bommel, Teeven en Taverne over het bericht dat zes Russische leden van de OVSE Parlementaire Assemblee vanwege de voor hen geldende EU-inreisverboden geen visum voor Finland h

MPs asked whether Finland's refusal of visas to six sanctioned Russian OSCE Parliamentary Assembly members, who were barred by EU travel bans, and the absence of a clear exemption for interparliamentary meetings was acceptable and whether the government would seek a formal exception. The minister answered that Finland only had to inform other member states, that the EU travel-ban rules contain only limited exceptions, and that the government values parliamentary dialogue in the OSCE but offered no commitment to seek a new formal exception.
The cabinet cannot comment on any reactions other member states may have given within the confidential Council framework.
Op (eventuele) reacties die overige lidstaten in vertrouwelijk Raadskader hebben gegeven, kan het kabinet niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Teeven over problemen bij de inschrijving voor de Marechaussee opleiding

MPs Straus and Teeven asked the State Secretary of Education and the Minister of Defence about raised entry requirements for a one-year mbo level 2 security course that feeds into the Royal Marechaussee training, which excluded vmbo basic-track pupils without prior communication. The minister acknowledged the requirement was not in line with law, said the ROCs failed to inform the KMar, promised the pupils would be admitted via the usual selection, and committed to requiring ROCs to restore the legal entry requirement and rename the course.
The ROCs concerned will have to bring the entry requirement back to the statutory entry requirement for vmbo-bb.
De betrokken ROC's zullen de instroomeis terug moeten brengen naar de wettelijke instroomeis vmbo-bb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Teeven over de berichten “Welzijn scharrelvarken niet beter dan gangbaar” en “Welzijn straalt uit naar buren”

MPs Lodders and Teeven (VVD) asked whether animal welfare standards in the EU and in Denmark and Germany are raising Dutch pig farming costs and weakening competitiveness, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that Dutch production costs are only modestly above EU peers, mostly due to environmental rules, and that the government will push for EU-level welfare standards and innovation without unilateral tightening.
I am in favour of tightening animal welfare requirements at European level because of the consequences for the competitiveness and future prospects of the Dutch pig sector.
Ik ben voorstander van het aanscherpen van dierwelzijnseisen op Europees niveau vanwege de gevolgen voor de concurrentiepositie en het toekomstperspectief van de Nederlandse varkenssector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk, Teeven en De Roon over het project Data Communicatie Mobiel Optreden Long Range Communications (DCMO-LRC)

MPs Vuijk, Teeven and De Roon asked the Defence Minister about the DCMO-LRC communications project, its status, purpose, reliability in worst-case scenarios and lessons learned. The minister answered that the project is in its realisation phase due for completion in 2015, that LRC extends communication beyond VHF radio range, and that Defence uses a mix of transmission means, with the business partner FoxIT developing the basic module.
LRC is in the realisation phase.
LRC bevindt zich in de realisatiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over familie van Nederlandse militairen die zouden kunnen worden bedreigd door IS-aanhangers

MP Teeven asked the Defence Minister whether relatives of Dutch soldiers are being threatened by IS sympathisers and whether soldiers' home numbers are being traced, and what precautions exist. The minister said the MIVD investigates reported incidents, has seen more reported approaches on social media, cannot disclose details on their origin, and that security information is shared with soldiers' families during briefings and contact is available 24 hours a day.
I cannot say what the MIVD precisely knows about the origin of these kinds of requests, to protect the level of knowledge and the working methods of the service.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over wat de MIVD precies weet over de herkomst van dit soort verzoeken, omwille van de bescherming van het kennisniveau en de werkwijze van de dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Jan Vos over het anti-dumping onderzoek naar de import van Transformatorstaal in de EU

MPs Teeven and Jan Vos asked whether EU anti-dumping duties on grain-oriented electrical steel (GOES) are justified and whether they threaten Dutch jobs, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the Commission found dumping and injury, that recent world price rises and quality issues need clarification, that Netherlands asked the Commission for clarity and will take a critical stance in the consultation, but that the government does not compensate firms for anti-dumping measures.
The Netherlands has asked the Commission to provide clarity on the basis for the anti-dumping duties.
Nederland heeft de Commissie verzocht duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de grondslag voor de antidumping heffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het artikel “Experts kritisch op wapenexportplan”

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the ministers about a press report criticising the arms export plan, including CDIU consultation, the timing and validity of export licences, and EU-level distortion of competition through state-owned shipyards. Minister Ploumen answered that licences are issued before delivery with a prior sounding procedure available, that licences usually run one year, and that the EU has long worked to reduce competition distortion in defence procurement.
A licence is issued prior to the actual delivery of the goods.
Een vergunning wordt verstrekt voorafgaand aan de daadwerkelijke levering van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht "TTIP-akkoord bedreigt de democratie"

An MP asked the trade minister whether the TTIP deal threatens democracy, whether talks at the Riga informal EU meeting exposed obstacles to a 2015 deal, and for a timeline. The minister said TTIP does not override EU laws, that Parliament will be involved in ratification, and that the EU aims to conclude talks by end 2015 while prioritising substance over speed.
As with every RBZ, I send a report of it to the House.
Zoals met elke RBZ stuur ik een verslag daarvan naar de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat de Staatsloterij kopers van staatsloten in de periode 2000-2008 zou hebben misleid

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government about a Supreme Court ruling that the State Lottery misled ticket buyers in 2000-2008, including revenue figures, possible misleading draw practices, the Kansspelautoriteit investigation, and liability. The government answered that the KSA found no reason to suspend draws, recommended measures the lottery will implement by Q2 2015, and that no assessment of damages can yet be made.
The KSA expects that the State Lottery will have implemented the final measures to carry out the recommendations by the end of the second quarter of 2015 at the latest.
De KSA verwacht dat de Staatsloterij uiterlijk aan het einde van het tweede kwartaal 2015 de laatste maatregelen ter uitvoering van de aanbevelingen heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de regels met betrekking tot de meldplicht van accountants

Two MPs asked whether an Accountantskamer ruling narrows accountants' confidentiality duty when they suspect large tax fraud, and whether it conflicts with earlier rulings and with the Wwft reporting duty. The minister answered that the ruling reflects existing rules, that no conflict exists, and that no new legislation is needed.
No. The existing laws and regulations offer sufficient starting points for the accountants' duty to report fraud.
Nee. De bestaande wet- en regelgeving biedt voldoende aanknopingspunten voor de meldplicht van accountants bij fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het gedogen van illegale gokbedrijven en de risico’s voor het betalingsverkeer

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Kansspelautoriteit's alleged issuing of 'comfort letters' to illegal online gambling operators, and about the reliability of payment service providers after a Buckaroo director was suspected in a gambling case. The State Secretary denied that comfort letters or tolerance policy exist, described warning letters sent under prioritisation criteria, and pointed to planned licensing rules and DNB supervision of payment institutions while declining to comment on individual cases.
I do not have these individual letters.
Ik beschik niet over deze individuele brieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Wet schuldsanering natuurlijke personen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the government about falling admissions to the debt rescheduling scheme (WSNP), rising use of guardianship (beschermingsbewind), and whether debt-assistance attempts should remain a precondition for admission. The state secretary answered that the decline reflects several factors, that a precondition of prior out-of-court effort will be kept, and that admission via guardianship is legally possible but subject to judicial assessment.
It is currently not known to what extent guardianship is imposed on people who do not qualify for debt assistance or are insufficiently helped by it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend in hoeverre beschermingsbewind wordt ingesteld voor mensen die niet in aanmerking komen voor schuldhulpverlening of er niet voldoende door geholpen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Haatimams naar Utrecht’

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned Utrecht event featuring a controversial preacher, his radical views, and whether visa refusal or withdrawal and organiser responsibility could be used. The government answered that the preacher did not appear, there was no public order risk, and it outlined visa powers under the Schengen framework, local mayoral powers, and that the CMO will inform mosque organisations.
The event in Utrecht took place on Sunday 1 March last.
Het evenement in Utrecht heeft op zondag 1 maart jongstleden plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het terugvorderen van uitgekeerde toeslagen vanwege het samenwonen met een vreemdeling zonder rechtmatig verblijf

Two MPs asked the State Secretaries whether a Council of State ruling means people in special circumstances no longer automatically lose benefits when a partner without lawful residence lives with them, and what the ruling's scope and practical consequences are. The government answered that the ruling is limited to the specific facts of that individual case, that it changes no policy or practice at the Tax Authority, and that it is consistent with earlier rulings.
The scope of this ruling is limited to this individual case, because it is based on the specific facts and circumstances of the case, from which no general conclusion can be drawn.

De reikwijdte van deze uitspraak is beperkt tot dit individuele geval omdat die gebaseerd is op de specifieke feiten en omstandigheden van het geval waaraan geen algemene conclusie kan worden verbonden.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Financiën over pinpasfraude (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

MP Teeven asks the Justice and Finance ministers about professionalising pinpas (debit card) fraud, its scale, victim numbers, whether losses are passed on to customers, and whether victims are compensated. The ministers answer that fraud is indeed growing in sophistication, damages were about 36 million euro in 2009, a joint public-private anti-skimming initiative exists, victims are fully compensated by banks, and fraud appears to be declining in 2010.

The Ministry of Justice holds periodic consultations with the Dutch Banking Association, Currence, Equens, the police and the Public Prosecution Service to exchange knowledge and experience on preventing and combating skimming.

Het ministerie van Justitie heeft periodiek overleg met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken, Currence, Equens, Politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om kennis en ervaring uit te wisselen met het oog op het voorkomen en bestrijden van skimmen.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de vrije verkrijgbaarheid van grondstoffen voor de partydrug GHB (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

Teeven (VVD) asked the Justice Minister whether free access to GHB precursors such as GBL should be restricted, whether online sellers and sales should be registered, and whether a public campaign is needed. The minister answered that GBL has large industrial uses, so a ban or licensing would be undesirable and costly, a sales registration would add burdens without clear benefit, and prevention should be targeted rather than a broad campaign.
A ban on this substance is undesirable for that reason alone.
Een verbod op deze stof is alleen al om die reden onwenselijk.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Justitie naar aanleiding van de antwoorden op de Kamervragen van 30 juni 2010 inzake internetfilters (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Teeven asked the Justice Minister how Netherlands pressures other countries to ratify cybercrime treaties and why it claims website blocking helps fight child abuse images, citing a 2008 study. The minister said Netherlands promotes ratification through international bodies and bilateral contacts, stressed prosecution and takedown as primary tools, and refused to list specific websites targeted, citing the risk of aiding offenders.

The request for a specific overview of websites Netherlands has tried to target, directly or via legal assistance channels, I cannot grant, because it would give third parties the opportunity to deliberately search for images of sexual abuse of children.

Het verzoek om een specifiek overzicht van websites die Nederland – al dan niet via rechtshulpkanalen – heeft proberen aan te pakken, kan ik niet inwilligen, omdat daardoor aan derden de mogelijkheid zou worden geboden om gericht op zoek te gaan naar afbeeldingen van seksueel misbruik van kinderen.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Justitie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het buiten functie stellen van een commissaris bij Europol (ingezonden 5 juli 2

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Teeven asked the Justice Minister about a crisis at Europol involving its deputy director, alleged leaking of internal recruitment information to Dutch National Crime Squad staff, and whether the official is seconded. The minister called it an internal Europol matter, said the DNR leadership knew of questions about it, and said the person is not seconded but was granted special leave as KLPD manager.
I regard the matter as an internal affair of Europol.
Ik beschouw de aangelegenheid als een interne zaak van Europol.

Vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het wegpesten van

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether a gay couple was driven out of Utrecht's Leidsche Rijn by harassment from young people, whether police and the mayor acted decisively, and whether camera surveillance would be pursued. The government said the couple chose to sell, that police are investigating but have not linked suspects to the incidents, and that choosing local crime-fighting instruments is a municipal responsibility.
It is a responsibility of the local authorities to weigh which instruments are deployed.
Het is een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteiten om af te wegen welke instrumenten worden ingezet.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gang van zaken rond de dood van Marianne Vaatstra (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

An MP asked whether the Cold Case team and other investigators are still active on the Marianne Vaatstra murder, and whether an asylum seeker's 1999 transfer from the Kollum reception centre and his alleged threats and prior case were withheld from parliament. The minister answered that the case remains active with the Noordelijke Recherche Eenheid, that the transfer was unrelated to the murder and the 1999 sexual-offence case was dismissed, and that earlier disclosure was not warranted.
The reason the information described was not previously brought to the attention of the House is that there was no earlier reason to do so.
De reden dat de aldaar weergegeven informatie niet eerder ter kennis is gebracht aan de Kamer is dat daarvoor eerder geen aanleiding bestond.

Vragen van de leden Teeven (VVD) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de contacten tussen een ambtenaar van Buitenlandse Zaken en de voortvluchtige C. (wapenhandelaar) (i

MPs Teeven and Van Haersma Buma asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about contacts between a Foreign Affairs official and a fugitive arms dealer wanted by Italy, including whether the official informed his employer. Minister Verhagen answered, but the substantive answers were submitted only for confidential inspection by MPs and not published.
The answer to these questions is available for confidential inspection, for Members only, deposited at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Het antwoord op deze vragen is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de Leden, gelegd bij net Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.

Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de gevolgen voor de politie- en justitiepraktijk van de uitleg van artikel 126nd, eerste lid, Sv door de Hoge Raad (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Supreme Court's 2010 reading of article 126nd/126nf Sv (requiring judicial authorisation for obtaining passport photos that may reveal ethnicity) would hamper police and prosecution practice, including use of camera footage and photos of suspects. The minister answered that the ruling has limited scope, that camera footage is not sensitive data, and saw no reason for legislative change.
At present I see no reason to amend the law as a result of this ruling.
Ik zie in deze uitspraak vooralsnog geen aanleiding tot wetswijziging.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht dat Benno L. geen tbs krijgt (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether psychologists and psychiatrists advised against a TBS (forced psychiatric treatment) order for Benno L., a former swimming teacher accused of abusing 57 pupils, and whether the prosecution agrees, and asks whether he will reoffend without treatment. The minister answers that the experts did advise against TBS, that their findings will be discussed at the hearing on 7 June, and that the prosecution will state its position afterwards, while declining to judge the likelihood of reoffending because that is for experts and the judge.
Given the independence of the judiciary, it is for experts to advise on this and for the judge to decide.
Ingevolge de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak is het aan deskundigen om hierover te adviseren en aan de rechter om hierover te oordelen.

Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de gang van zaken in Zierikzee met betrekking tot het informeren van de beide slachtoffers in deze zaak door het Openbaar Ministerie en politie (ingezonde

Teeven asks the Justice Minister whether the procedures for informing the two victims of a released violent suspect in Zierikzee were correctly followed, and why the Chamber was not fully informed. The minister admits the Public Prosecution Service failed to instruct police to inform the victims, that its victim-notification policy was not fully applied, and that he will provide information on the matter.
The OM deeply regrets that it did not make a request to the police to inform the mother and daughter.
Het OM betreurt ten zeerste dat het geen verzoek aan de politie heeft gedaan om moeder en dochter te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het steekincident door een 49-jarige tbs’er waarbij een 61-jarige inwoonster van Boekel gewond is geraakt (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP from the VVD asked the Justice Minister about a stabbing by a long-stay tbs patient, including whether leave had been granted, whether procedures were followed, what action would follow an internal inquiry, how the clinic consults neighbouring municipalities on leave, and whether the state should pay compensation to the victim. The minister answered that the inquiry findings must first be discussed with those involved, that the clinic consults the municipality regularly, and that leave is assessed by the Adviescollege Verloftoetsing tbs, referring to earlier answers on compensation and leave.
This question can be answered after the outcomes of the investigation into the circumstances have been discussed with all those involved.
Deze vraag kan worden beantwoord nadat de uitkomsten van het toedrachtsonderzoek zijn besproken met alle betrokkenen.
Vragen van de leden Gerkens (SP) en Teeven (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de verantwoordelijkheid voor de afwikkeling van schade door identiteitsfraude (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice why the state has not resolved a long-running identity-fraud compensation case for a victim, and why mediation failed and the matter was sent to court. The minister answered that the records were corrected, the state paid the mediator's recommended compensation, and the remaining claim must be substantiated before a response, while defending the position against the Ombudsman's guidance.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Van Toorenburg over de onttrekking van een TBS-er tijdens zijn verlofperiode in de Rooyse Wissel

MPs Knops and Van Toorenburg asked why no full signalement or dangerousness information was shared after a TBS patient absconded during escorted leave from the Rooyse Wissel clinic, and why the Kamer was informed only via media. The Staatssecretaris answered that a signalement was in fact issued via Burgernet, described the standard notification procedures and the leave-approval process, and declined to change the policy of not informing parliament about individual absconding incidents.
Measured against roughly 70,000 leave movements, the 38 unauthorised absences and no escapes from clinics in 2014 give no reason to change its position (on informing parliament about such incidents).

Naar aanleiding van de motie van de heer Oskam. Afgezet tegen het totale aantal van circa 70.000 gepraktiseerde verlofbewegingen, vormen de 38 ongeoorloofde afwezigheden en de afwezigheid van ontvluchtingen uit klinieken in 2014, geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over een sharia-scheiding aangevraagd door een Nederlander in de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten (VAE)

An MP asked the government whether a Dutch citizen's sharia divorce obtained in the UAE, pronounced by unilateral text message, is recognised in the Netherlands, and how women and children can be protected against such routes. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the Dutch rules on recognising foreign divorces (art. 10:57-10:59 BW), noted the low risk of abuse, and described the limited consular assistance available.
However, I cannot make statements about this individual case, because I do not have sufficient information about it.
Ik kan echter geen uitspraken doen over deze individuele zaak, omdat ik niet beschik over voldoende informatie dienaangaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li vos over het gedogen van het aanbieden van online kansspelen gericht op de Nederlandse markt

An MP asks whether the online gambling site Unibet, which targets the Dutch market while avoiding the enforcement criteria of the Kansspelautoriteit, is being enforced against, and whether its referrals to Dutch addiction services show it targets the Netherlands. The Secretary of State answers that enforcement is the independent regulator's responsibility, that the regulator prioritises sites that clearly target the Netherlands but may still act against others, and that a licence applicant that persists in targeting the Dutch market can be refused.
In order not to disrupt ongoing investigations, the gambling authority makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanvraag van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) tot omzetting van een opvanglocatie naar een asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) met een capaciteit voor 800 tot 1000 per

An MP asks the State Secretary how a COA request to expand an asylum centre in the tiny village of Oranje to 800-1,000 residents (against roughly 150 inhabitants) fits earlier assurances about proportionality, and whether alternatives and local support were considered. The State Secretary replies that the municipality decides on locations, that the municipality earlier agreed to 1,400 and later 1,000 residents, and that a regular consultation group with residents exists.
The final decision on establishing a location belongs to the municipality.
Het uiteindelijk besluit tot de vestiging van een locatie hoort toe aan de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over reclameactiviteiten van illegale aanbieders van kansspelen

MP Mei Li Vos asked the State Secretary about illegal online gambling providers advertising during the World Cup, whether they could later obtain licences, and what tools the Gambling Authority has. The State Secretary answered that providers who persisted in targeting the Dutch market after the 2011 motion may be refused a licence, that the Authority has enforcement tools but cross-border gambling limits their effectiveness, and that a forthcoming letter will explain how persistent providers will be excluded.
providers to whom the gambling authority imposed an administrative fine after the Bouwmeester motion in September 2011 will in any case not be eligible for a licence when the market opens.

aanbieders aan wie de kansspelautoriteit na het aannemen van de motie-Bouwmeester c.s. in september 2011 een bestuurlijke boete heeft opgelegd, bij opening van de markt in ieder geval niet in aanmerking komen voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei Li Vos over het artikel ‘Tegenslag in strijd tegen matchfixing’

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked about matchfixing risks in the planned legal online sports betting, including how the Kansspelautoriteit (KSA) and justice authorities would detect manipulated matches and obtain information. The State Secretary answered that operators must adopt integrity policies, report high-risk matches, join the national matchfixing platform, and provide information on request or voluntarily, with the KSA able to use existing investigative and licence-withdrawal powers.

Under the proposed Article 34k of the Wok, licence holders are additionally obliged to provide, on their own initiative, information relevant to supervising compliance with the relevant laws, regulations and licence conditions.

Op grond van het voorgestelde artikel 34k Wok worden vergunninghouders daarnaast verplicht eigener beweging informatie te verschaffen die relevant is voor het toezicht op de naleving van de relevante wet- en regelgeving en vergunningvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het innen van boetes door de Kansspelautoriteit

An MP asked the State Secretary about fines imposed by the Gambling Authority on online gambling operators, including whether they could be appealed, whether they had been collected, and how unpaid foreign fines could be enforced. The State Secretary answered that appeals are possible and pending in most cases, that three of five fines have been paid (totalling 530,000 euro), and explained the enforcement mechanism and that fined operators will not receive a licence.
In total, three of the five imposed fines have been paid at this time.
In totaal zijn op dit moment drie van de vijf opgelegde boetes voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Opnieuw kinderen zonder belangenafweging in bewaring’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to respond to a report that children were again detained without a documented balancing of their interests, contrary to earlier court rulings and commitments. The State Secretary denied acting against court rulings, said detention was lawful and the appeal was rejected, and promised renewed attention to written balancing of children's interests.
I have explicitly asked these parties to pay attention to a recognisable balancing of interests, especially for families with minor children.
Ik heb bij deze partijen expliciet aandacht gevraagd voor een kenbare belangenafweging in het bijzonder bij gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Oskam en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Eerste stap naar vergunning voor gokbedrijven’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the Kansspelautoriteit's survey of interest in online gambling licences was justified, whether it should be halted before the bill passed, how many applications were expected, and how advertising violations by gambling firms were monitored and sanctioned. The State Secretary answered that the survey was the regulator's own decision to prepare for licensing, that he hoped licensing would be swift for consumer protection, that expected applications rested on a 2011 study and contacts with regulators, and that individual enforcement cases could not be disclosed to protect ongoing investigations.
Offering this possibility to interested parties for a licence was an independent decision of the gambling authority.
Het bieden van deze mogelijkheid aan geïnteresseerden voor een vergunning is een zelfstandige beslissing van de kansspelautoriteit geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de handhaving van het verbod op illegale gokzuilen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about enforcing the ban on illegal gambling machines in cafes, including municipal powers, enforcement by the Gaming Authority and the Public Prosecution Service, and the Gaming Authority's capacity. The State Secretary answered that municipalities enforce primarily under administrative law, that cooperation with the Gaming Authority and prosecutors is ongoing, and that the Gaming Authority has sufficient capacity, while stating prosecutors keep no figures on their interventions.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have figures on the number of cases in which the OM intervenes.
Het OM beschikt niet over cijfers met betrekking tot het aantal gevallen waarin het OM optreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat gevangenisbewaarders onder druk staan

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a DJI staff satisfaction survey showing reduced feelings of safety, violence against staff, working-time law breaches, understaffing, sick leave, cell opening practice, management ratios and the 'stoplicht' promotion model. The State Secretary answered that the ISZW and staff survey reports would be responded to substantively in April, gave sick-leave and staffing figures and management ratios, and denied unrest about the stoplicht model.
At the General Consultation on the Prison Service of 22 January, the then State Secretary committed to giving Parliament a substantive response to both reports.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Gevangeniswezen van 22 januari jl. heeft de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie uw Kamer toegezegd een inhoudelijke reactie te geven op beide rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht “VN roepen op tot reddingsplan”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the EU should expand the Triton operation's mandate and resources to save more migrant lives in the Mediterranean, and whether the issue would be raised at the JBZ Council. The State Secretary answered that Triton is a border-control mission whose mandate should not be broadened, that rescue duties rest with states, and that the Netherlands favours an integrated EU approach.
In view of the above, I am not in favour of broadening the mandate of operation Triton.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik geen voorstander van een mandaatverruiming voor operatie Triton.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de intentieverklaring die is gesloten met België om de samenwerking op immigratiebeleid uit te breiden

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Netherlands-Belgium letter of intent on migration cooperation, including the Europe route for family migration, resettlement, and the EASO asylum pilot. The State Secretary answered that cooperation focuses on implementing agencies, that the government will raise the Europe route abuse with the Commission, and that the EASO pilot ran in Den Bosch.
The Netherlands wants to examine together with Belgium what options exist to make it harder to use the Europe route.
Nederland wil samen met België onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om het gebruik maken van de Europaroute moeilijker te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken en Maij over het bericht dat Griekenland 300.000 migranten zou willen laten doorreizen naar de rest van de EU

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether Greece would issue travel documents to 300,000 to 500,000 migrants, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The government said no such formal announcement had been made, called any such move unacceptable, reminded Greece of its EU obligations, and described EU support and Dutch contributions.
The cabinet considers the statements by this Greek official about opening the borders unacceptable.
De door deze Griekse bewindspersoon gedane uitspraken over het openstellen van de grenzen acht het kabinet onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat burgers kansloos zijn bij een geldruzie met een bedrijf

An MP asked whether citizens are powerless in money disputes with companies, citing claims that most consumers, employees and tenants go to court without a lawyer, and asked about the effect of legal aid cuts. The minister disputed the 'hopeless' conclusion, gave the no-lawyer percentages from Raad voor de Rechtspraak research, said the link to legal aid cuts is not direct, and noted that the competence threshold rise and a WODC evaluation are ongoing.
The choice whether or not to engage a lawyer or other legal aid provider rests with the citizen, who thereby also has more control over the costs of the procedure.
De keuze om al dan niet een advocaat of andere rechtshulpverlener in te schakelen berust bij de burger, die daardoor ook meer grip heeft op de kosten van de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat er kritiek is op de Europese grensbewaking naar aanleiding van een nieuwe ramp met een migrantenschip

An MP asked whether the government shares UNHCR criticism that the shift from Mare Nostrum to the narrower Frontex Triton mission contributed to a deadly migrant shipwreck, and whether it will push for more humane border policing and more rescue capacity. The Minister replied that Triton is a border-control mission rather than a rescue mission, that rescue duties remain with states under international law, that the EU Mediterranean Task Force is working on a joint approach, and that the Netherlands will deploy a coast guard aircraft to Triton in April 2015.
The death of the migrants in the Mediterranean is a horrific event.
Het overlijden van de migranten op de Middellandse Zee is een afschuwelijke gebeurtenis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat deurwaarders veel te hoge nota’s sturen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Staatssecretaris whether bailiffs were sending excessive invoices for evictions and whether the practice was widespread. The Staatssecretaris said the KBvG had filed a disciplinary complaint, that the four firms had adjusted their practice, that the KBvG was surveying members, and that overcharged tenants would be repaid through the bailiff and client.
I am following this case closely and will await the outcome of the procedure.
Ik volg deze zaak nauwlettend en wacht de uitkomst van de procedure af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat bijna twee derde van de gevangenen allochtoon is

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that nearly two-thirds of prisoners are of foreign origin, and why Moroccans and Antilleans are heavily overrepresented among suspects of violent property crime even after controlling for socioeconomic factors, including whether cultural factors play a role. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said research offers no consensus explanation and cites cultural factors among possible causes, pointing to the government's general approach with local authorities, and explained that CBS can now publish prisoner statistics by parental country of birth.
A large number of scientific publications are available on this phenomenon, but they do not give unambiguous explanations.
Over dit fenomeen is een groot aantal wetenschappelijke publicaties beschikbaar die geen eenduidige verklaringen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat een gedetineerde een drone heeft binnengesmokkeld en laat vliegen binnen de penitentiaire inrichting

An MP asked whether a video showing a drone flown inside a prison was filmed by a detainee in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting Vught, and how a detainee could order and fly a drone inside. The minister answered that the footage was not from Vught or any operational prison but from the former Blokhuispoort in Leeuwarden, now a business centre, so filming there is for its owner to decide.
These images were not recorded in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting in Vught.
Deze beelden zijn niet opgenomen in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting te Vught.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de intentieverklaring om misbruik van de Europa-route aan te kaarten bij de Europese Commissie

An MP asked whether the Dutch-Belgian intention declaration on the Europa-route abuse would be shared and whether the two-year-stay idea and six-month policy fit the Court of Justice ruling. The minister shared the declaration, argued the six-month rule is a reasonable policy rule consistent with case law, and said the Commission guidance does not set a minimum stay for the Europa-route.
If not, why not? Answer to 2 and 3: The cabinet is of the view that the Europa-route is an undesired and unintended outcome of the right to free movement of persons.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 2 en 3 Het kabinet is van mening dat de Europa-route een ongewenste en onbedoelde uitkomst is van het recht op vrij verkeer van personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat hij gemeenten toch financieel gaat compenseren voor het leveren van noodopvang aan dakloze asielzoekers

An MP from GroenLinks asked why the government reversed its earlier decision and will now financially compensate municipalities for emergency shelter for homeless asylum seekers, following a Central Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answers that the ruling obliges centre municipalities to provide basic shelter on request for a limited period, that compensation will be based on actual use and comparable costs, and that the funding source is not yet determined.

In a ruling of 17 December 2014, the Interim Judge of the Central Appeals Tribunal determined that centre municipalities must, on request, offer basic shelter to unlawfully residing foreign nationals.

In een uitspraak van 17 december 2014 heeft de Voorzieningenrechter van de Centrale Raad van Beroep bepaald dat centrumgemeenten desgevraagd sobere opvang moeten bieden aan niet-rechtmatig verblijvende vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over multilevel marketing bedrijven

An MP asks whether the Kingdom Business/Conligus MLM advertised on Marktplaats is a pyramid scheme, whether courts or the Kansspelautoriteit have acted on such schemes, and whether MLM firms should disclose income and earnings. The government declines to judge the specific company, says it has seen no relevant rulings or enforcement, and says participants must receive complete and accurate information under the Civil Code.
It does not befit me as State Secretary of Security and Justice to give a legal judgement on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij als Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie niet een juridisch oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de steeds hogere drempels bij het vragen van extra uren door rechtshulpverleners bij bewerkelijke zaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether approved extra-hours requests for complex legal aid cases are counted as fully approved even when only part of the hours requested are granted, and whether a new 2015 guideline makes it harder to obtain extra hours. The State Secretary replied that approval of the request and approval of the hours are distinct, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand registers both (77% of requests approved in 2013, with 75% of requested hours granted), and that the policy and practice on extra hours is unchanged, so there are no consequences for applicants.

I am of the opinion that this way of recording gives a good picture of both the granting and rejection of cases in which extra hours are allocated, as well as the number of extra hours that are actually granted.

Ik ben van mening dat deze wijze van registreren een goed beeld geeft van de toekenning en afwijzing van zowel zaken waarin extra uren worden toegekend, als ook het aantal extra uren dat daadwerkelijk wordt toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het niet langer opvangen van gezinnen met Nederlandse kinderen in gezinsopvang locaties

An MP asked whether families with Dutch children were being excluded from family reception locations and whether this was a policy change. The State Secretary answered that Dutch children may still be housed in such locations in individual cases, that no policy change has occurred, and that such housing is a choice of the parents.
No changes have taken place with respect to this policy.
Ten aanzien van dit beleid hebben geen wijzigingen plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de gedwongen terugkeer van een uitgeprocedeerde Afghaanse vreemdeling naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the State Secretary about the forced return of a rejected Afghan asylum seeker, including whether force was used on the flight, whether injuries occurred, and why the embassy did not verify reports of hospital treatment. The State Secretary answered that force use is documented by the Marechaussee but declined to specify the measures, stated no monitoring occurs after return, and refused to release the individual case documents.
I consider restraint important when it comes to providing information about individual cases.
Ik acht terughoudendheid van belang als het gaat om het verstrekken van informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Benefiet ter discussie'?

An MP from the VVD asks the Justice Minister about a planned charity gala in Rijswijk featuring foreign salafist preachers, including whether the government can refuse visas or act against them and what responsibility organisers and venue owners bear. The government answers that visas of three speakers were withdrawn for public order reasons, that Schengen rules allow refusal on threat grounds, that Dutch authorities can ask other member states to revoke visas, and that free speech is limited where hatred or threats to public order arise.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn in the interest of public order, against the background of social unrest, as set out in a letter from the NCTV.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust, zoals verwoord in een brief van de NCTV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de mogelijke overplaatsing van een Belgische lustmoordenaar en verkrachter naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the minister would block the proposed temporary transfer of a Belgian interned sex offender to a Dutch forensic psychiatric centre, and why he engages with a neighbouring minister on it. The minister confirmed the talks, said the transfer is not yet certain, ruled out leave and a permanent transfer, and declined to withdraw from the request.
I am pleased that the excellent performance of the Dutch forensic care sector is also noticed beyond our national borders.
Het verheugt mij dat de uitstekende prestaties van de forensische zorgsector in Nederland ook buiten onze landsgrenzen worden opgemerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de tot nu toe verstrekte informatie over de omvang en aard van (legale) identiteitswisselingen en mogelijke fraude met reisdocumenten

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Gesthuizen, Schouw) asked the Dutch State Secretary and Minister about the scope and nature of legal identity changes and possible passport/identity fraud, including why Parliament was not informed earlier of NVIK/police signals from 2011 and 2013 and of the April 2014 meetings. The government answered that the signals were operational, not quantified, that duplicate registrations were largely legal name changes or data-entry errors, and that several measures and studies are underway.
It is not customary to inform the Chamber while an investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om lopende een onderzoek de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over (ver)bouwplannen voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether local and regional firms could be given a chance in building and renovating asylum reception centres, and whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and COA could draft tenders allowing local participation. The state secretary replied that COA is responsible for works, that local involvement is encouraged within procurement rules (including a 10 percent regional sourcing requirement in framework contracts), and that mandatory local preference would breach tender rules.
Mandatory use of local or regional companies conflicts with procurement rules because it leads to distortion of competition.
Het verplicht gebruik maken van lokale of regionale bedrijven is strijdig met de aanbestedingsregels omdat dit leidt tot concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een politieke reactie op het privacybeleid van Facebook

MP Oosenbrug asked whether the minister would respond to Belgian counterpart Tommelein's reaction to Facebook's new privacy terms, share the view that political statements can support privacy regulators, call for European joint action, and organise a meeting with Facebook. The Staatssecretaris answered that the independent privacy regulator CBP should assess Facebook's terms, that Netherlands actively defends data protection in the EU and Council of Europe, and that he will await the CBP investigation rather than contact Facebook directly.
A judgement on Facebook's privacy terms I must therefore leave to the CBP.
Een oordeel over de privacyvoorwaarden van Facebook moet ik dan ook aan het CBP laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de affaire Demmink

Bontes asks about the status of the criminal investigation into former secretary-general Demmink, Turkey's non-cooperation with mutual legal assistance requests, the handling of intelligence reports and the Rolodex inquiry, the civil case against AD, and legal aid costs. Minister Opstelten answers that the investigation is ongoing with requests to Turkey still pending, declines comment on the witness statements because of the parallel investigation, reports legal aid costs of about 16,343 euro, and notes that no appeal is expected.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de helft van de sociale advocatuur verwacht te stoppen voor 2017

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he responds to a survey showing half of social-law advocates expect to stop before 2017 due to legal aid cuts, including effects on supply, client refusals, and quality. The State Secretary questions the survey's representativeness, denies a realistic supply shortage, points to rising advocate numbers, promises a commission to study the measures, and says quality is adequately safeguarded.

I have since informed your House and the Senate that I will suspend the procedure for the measures I intend to bring into force in 2016, pending the results of the commission's study that I will set up.

Inmiddels heb ik uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer geïnformeerd de procedure voor de maatregelen waarvan ik inwerkingtreding in 2016 beoog aan te houden, in afwachting van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de commissie die ik zal instellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de ARGOS-uitzending ‘Ik keer terug!’

An MP asked the government about problems Dutch nationals face returning from abroad with a foreign partner, loss of nationality, and the lack of a one-stop-shop for emigrants. The state secretary acknowledged some IND cases on the income-sustainability requirement, promised to report on talks with expats, refused to drop loss of nationality on voluntary acquisition of another nationality, and said no one-stop-shop exists but pointed to existing web information.
As I promised in the General Consultation with your House on 14 January, I will inform the House of the outcomes of the talks I intend to have with expats
Zoals ik in het Algemeen Overleg met uw Kamer op 14 januari jl. heb toegezegd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het gesprek dat ik voornemens ben te hebben met expats
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat Facebook korte metten maakt met beschermde foto's

MP Verhoeven asked the State Secretary about reports that Facebook blocked the Reclaim app and imposed new terms on photos and personal data, including whether Dutch users can give informed consent. The State Secretary said the app works again, that the CBP's investigation must be awaited before judging Dutch consent and possible measures, and that he will not contact Facebook to interfere with the CBP's approach.
As I already indicated in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions, I will await this investigation.
Zoals ik in de beantwoording op eerdere Kamervragen 2 reeds heb aangegeven, zal ik dit onderzoek afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke crimineel die vervroegd is vrijgelaten en ook nog een zak geld heeft gekregen

An MP asks why a violent offender, a Turkish national in the country illegally, was released early through sentence interruption with a bag of public money and an identity card, and whether the government will change the rules. The Secretary of State explains that sentence interruption is a return instrument, that the offender left with a large sentence remainder and an entry ban, that IOM support is in kind up to EUR 1,500, and that no change to conditional release is planned.
I want to emphasise that IOM is independent in carrying out its tasks.
Ik wil benadrukken dat IOM in haar taakuitvoering onafhankelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de ontsnapping van een gevangene

An MP asked the state secretary about a detainee who escaped while being transferred to a clinic and whether handcuffing should be standard during transport. The secretary said the escape was unexpected, the detainee surrendered voluntarily, standard use of restraints conflicts with rules, and search costs remain with the responsible organisations.
I stand fully by my earlier judgement that DJI staff are well able to make an adequate assessment per detainee of whether it is appropriate to apply restraints.

Ik sta onverkort achter mijn oordeel van destijds dat medewerkers van DJI goed in staat zijn om per gedetineerde een adequate afweging te maken in hoeverre het aangewezen is om vrijheidsbeperkende middelen toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over geweld in en om asielzoekerscentra

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about violence in and around asylum centres, including reports of ethnic and religious tensions and the sustainability of the current asylum intake. The Secretary of State reported 72 violent incidents registered by COA in 2014, described existing house rules and sanctions, and said the government would not cap the number of asylum seekers while stressing public support and local consultation.
In 2014 COA registered a total of 72 violent incidents.
Het COA heeft in 2014 in totaal 72 geweldsincidenten geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het artikel ‘Asielopvang tikkende tijdbom’

Voordewind asks whether tensions and threats against Christian asylum seekers at reception centres are rising, what measures and monitoring exist, and whether a new study or more reporting support is needed. Teeven replies that tensions stem from diverse residents rather than religion or ethnicity, describes COA house rules and police involvement, says the 2010 Gave recommendations were followed and no new study is needed, and reports 72 registered violent incidents in 2014.
The COA registered a total of 72 violent incidents in 2014.
Het COA heeft in 2014 in totaal 72 geweldsincidenten geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over suïcidepogingen in de gesloten gezinslocaties in Zeist

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary about reported suicide attempts at the Zeist closed family facility, how families and children are supported, separated transports of families, and whether causes were investigated. The State Secretary answered that no suicide attempts occurred per the incident protocol, only observations, a light self-injury and a food/fluid refusal, that families are kept together, and that medical and psychological care is available, without announcing an investigation or ending separated transports.
According to the incident protocol, this does not concern suicide attempts.
Het betreft volgens het incidentenprotocol geen suïcidepogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een steekpartij in het Asielzoekerscentrum in Dronten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a stabbing at an asylum centre in Dronten, whether it shares outrage at repeated violent incidents, what measures will stop them, how violent asylum seekers can be detained and denied residence, and whether regional reception should replace reception in the Netherlands. State Secretary Teeven answered that safety is a priority with COA house rules, supervision, police involvement and consequences for asylum procedures, and that reception in the region and Dutch international obligations remain the government's starting points, without capping numbers.
Safety and liveability inside and outside the asylum centre have the highest priority.
Veiligheid en leefbaarheid binnen en buiten het asielzoekerscentrum geniet hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat er veel minder asielzoekers binnen zijn gekomen dan werd verwacht

An MP asks why the asylum inflow forecast for 2014 was set at 65,000 when the actual figure was about 25,000, and whether the 2015 budget and any surplus accounted for that forecast. The minister says the 65,000 figure was a scenario rather than a forecast, that the 2014 budget used 30,000, that realised inflow was 30,020, and that a 375 million euro reserve for reception costs was added and will be reviewed.
That was therefore not an annual forecast.
Daarmee was geen sprake van een jaarprognose.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat huurwoningen schaarser zijn door de komst van vluchtelingen

An MP from the PVV asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister for Housing about reports that rental homes are scarcer due to refugees, whether priority allocation for asylum seekers is unfair, how many applicants are disadvantaged, and whether asylum inflow will be stopped. The government answers that refugees with residence permits get priority to support integration and reduce COA centre congestion, that a direct effect on waiting times cannot be given, and that it will not stop asylum intake because international obligations and individual assessment apply.
No, asylum seekers who have been granted a permit are housed with priority in order to promote outflow from COA centres and integration.
Nee, asielzoekers die een vergunning hebben gekregen worden met voorrang gehuisvest teneinde uitstroom vanuit de COA centra en de integratie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Schouw, Van Tongeren en Gesthuizen over de onwettigheid van de bewaarplicht van telecomgegevens van burgers

Four MPs asked whether the Dutch data retention law, which the Court of Justice had found incompatible with EU rights, should be suspended, and whether providers could claim damages or be shielded from client claims. The minister replied that the Dutch regime is more detailed than the annulled directive and is compliant, that there is no reason to suspend it, that providers may face damages claims left to the courts, and that no reliable investment estimate exists.
I see no reason to freeze the implementation of the current law until parliament has dealt with the proposed amendment.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de uitvoering van de huidige wet te bevriezen totdat het parlement de voorgestelde wetswijziging heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat Feda Amiri na 18 jaar in Nederland alsnog is uitgezet naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the deportation of Feda Amiri to Afghanistan after eighteen years in the Netherlands, including the use of article 1F of the Refugee Convention and reliance on a 2000 country report on the Afghan security services. The State Secretary answered that individual cases are not discussed, that persons excluded under article 1F are not refugees, that no policy change or new research on the security services is planned.
It is known to your House that I consider it undesirable to provide information about individual foreign nationals.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het onwenselijk acht informatie te verstrekken over individuele vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the Demmink affair, including a Turkish document on entry records, the handling of security reports, costs of legal aid for former secretary-general Demmink, and contacts between officials and MPs. The minister answered that the Turkish document was passed to the Public Prosecution Service and a letter rogatory was sent, declined to comment on the content of documents in an ongoing criminal investigation, provided cost tables, and said security dossiers are kept by the AIVD and that the department does not keep records of MP contacts.
I do not comment on the content of documents that form part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de inhoud van documenten die onderdeel zijn van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice to comment on testimony that former SG Demmink was under investigation in the Rolodex case, contrary to earlier denials, and on a former detective's statement that he was tasked to follow Demmink. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service found no information confirming the testimony, and that the statements are being considered in a separate prosecutorial investigation, so he declined to comment further.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak van de rechter die het AD in het gelijk heeft gesteld in de zaak Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Justice Ministry would pay the legal costs of former secretary-general Demmink after a court ruled the AD's publications lawful, and whether the ministry would further investigate the allegations. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other allegations, that he will not judge any investigation, and that he would reconsider reimbursement if Demmink appealed and sought costs.
Against that background, I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgement on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de problemen bij de uitvoering van de SBF-regelingen

An SP MP asked why the SSC sent wrong letters and wrong income data to former SBF-leave staff, whether 123 staff were paid the AOW-gap compensation too early, and who the contact points are. The minister acknowledges the errors, says all staff now have correct information, offers staff the choice to keep or repay the early payment, and reports new contact points and regular SSC-P Direkt coordination.
I deeply regret the course of events.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken zeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het opsluiten van terroristen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked about criteria for placing terrorism suspects in a dedicated prison wing, whether such concentration causes radicalisation, and whether resocialisation is tailored. The State Secretary said placement follows Regeling SPOG criteria with periodic review via a multidisciplinary consultation, that individual regimes allow tailored treatment, and that no concrete evidence of radicalisation through grouping is known, while refusing to give exact figures for security reasons.
I cannot provide further information for security reasons.
Verdere mededelingen kan ik om veiligheidsredenen niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Omtzigt over fraude door middel van legale naamwisselingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Omtzigt asked the ministers how the government responded to RTL reports on fraud through legal name changes, which signals from abroad and the police it received, whether the Matching Autoriteit was consulted, and whether databases should be cross-matched. The government answered that no overview of signals is kept, that operational services act on signals as needed, that no separate report was required on the police signal, and that after investigation no evidence of fraud through double registration was found, so no further cross-matching is planned.
No overview is kept of all signals exchanged in the course of regular operational work.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van alle signalen die in het kader van de reguliere taakuitvoering worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitlatingen van het Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA) over een suïcidale vreemdeling
