An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a BMA medical advisory report that suggested no post-deportation medical arrangements were needed for a suicidal foreign national, and whether the reasoning was acceptable. The State Secretary rejected the reading that the BMA had reasoned cynically, said the passage was misinterpreted out of context, and declined to order an investigation.
I am of the view that there is an incorrect interpretation of the relevant passage in the BMA report.
Ik ben van mening dat er sprake is van een onjuiste interpretatie van de betreffende passage in het BMA-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei Li Vos over het artikel ‘Tegenslag in strijd tegen matchfixing’

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that UEFA and online betting firms (ESSA) no longer share information on match-fixing and that betting firms may not pass on suspicious patterns. The Minister said he was unaware of the sharing breakdown, declined to judge UEFA's claims, and said the forthcoming remote gambling bill would require betting operators to share information on suspicious patterns, with the Gaming Authority supervising compliance.
In the lower regulations for remote gambling, licence conditions will also be included on sharing information necessary to strengthen the fight against match-fixing.

In de lagere regelgeving voor kansspelen op afstand zullen daarnaast vergunningsvoorwaarden worden opgenomen over het delen van informatie die noodzakelijk is voor versterking van de strijd tegen matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontbreken van een bed-bad-brood voorziening voor uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen in Nederland

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about UN rapporteurs' criticism that the Netherlands lacks a bed-bath-bread facility for rejected asylum seekers, and whether this causes health harm and international reputational damage. The State Secretary answered that no international obligation requires such a facility, pointed to Article 3 ECHR as a minimum, said shelter is available to those cooperating with return and medical care is always available, and referred to his letter of 18 December for the rest, declining to answer in time.
International legal obligations do not require the Netherlands to provide a bed-bath-bread facility for rejected asylum seekers.
Uit volkenrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt niet dat Nederland verplicht is een bed-bad-brood voorziening te treffen voor uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de gerechtelijke uitspraak dat de staatssecretaris zelf in opvang voor uitgeprocedeerden moet voorzien

An MP asked the State Secretary how the government will respond to a court ruling that the state must provide shelter, food and clothing to rejected asylum seekers under Article 8 ECHR, and whether it will act on the European Committee of Social Rights' position. The State Secretary answers that he will appeal the ruling, meanwhile offering affected persons places in Ter Apel without restrictive measures, and sees no reason to attach policy consequences yet.
I see reason to lodge an appeal against these rulings of the court.
Ik zie aanleiding om tegen deze uitspraken van de rechtbank hoger beroep in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nareis van meerderjarige kinderen van vluchtelingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the family reunification policy for adult unmarried children of refugees, including how the 'more than normal emotional dependency' test is applied and how many children have been unable to join their families. The State Secretary confirmed the policy is intentionally more generous than the EU directive requires, explained the individual IND assessment and a 2014 adjustment for children who lived with parents, but could not provide numbers because the IND system no longer separates these cases.
The answer to the above questions requires intensive and time-consuming individual file research.
Antwoord 5 Het antwoord op bovenstaande vragen vergt intensief en tijdrovend individueel dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Marokko dat asielzoekers gaat opvangen voor de EU

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the EU paying Morocco to host asylum seekers, whether reception in the region should be prioritised over resettlement in the Netherlands, and whether an immigration opt-out is the best solution. The State Secretary answered that the government supports regional reception, that Morocco is implementing its own asylum system, that the Dublin-based right to asylum cannot be guaranteed to be avoided, and that structural solutions lie in countries of origin.
Because of the diversity of the activities and because part of it concerns staff deployment, it is not possible to state which amounts are involved.
Vanwege de diversiteit van de activiteiten en omdat het voor een deel ook personele inzet betreft, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over resocialisatiepilots in het gevangeniswezen

MP Kooiman asked about the dyslexia pilot and the self-reliance (zelfredzaamheid) pilots in prisons, why funding was stopped, and whether ex-prisoner experts could be used more. The Secretary of State answered that the dyslexia pilot was evaluated and discontinued because the evidence did not justify it, that the self-reliance pilots are under WODC evaluation with a decision expected in spring 2015, and that volunteers are supported.
Based on this evaluation, I decided in September 2013 not to continue the pilot.
Ik heb op grond van deze evaluatie in september 2013 besloten geen vervolg aan de pilot te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Ypma over de gevaren van sociale media voor minder begaafde jongeren

MPs Rebel and Ypma asked about risks social media poses to young people with intellectual disabilities, including data on cyberbullying and abuse, available teaching materials, and whether a dedicated reporting point is needed. The government acknowledges the heightened vulnerability, says data on prevalence for this group cannot be provided, points to a Rutgers/CED project and ongoing talks on filling material gaps, and states that meldknop.nl is the place for reports for everyone.
However, we cannot give you insight into the extent of the problem.
Wij kunnen u echter geen inzicht geven in de omvang van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht “Alleen Duitsers straks nog baas op Facebook”

MPs asked the Minister whether Germans alone can sue Facebook over use of their name and photos, whether Facebook's European activities fall under Irish law, and whether the Netherlands will have its privacy watchdog examine Facebook's new terms. The Minister answered that the CBP (Dutch privacy regulator) is investigating the new terms, that it has jurisdiction over Facebook in the Netherlands, and that the CBP asked Facebook to delay the new policy pending the outcome.
The CBP is an independent supervisory body and itself determines what the investigation examines.
Het CBP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder en bepaalt zelf waarnaar het onderzoek doet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Den Haag, nevenzittingsplaats Groningen, inzake het tienjarenbeleid omtrent gezinsleden van vreemdelingen aan wie artikel 1F Vluchtelingenverdr

An SP MP asked the State Secretary how he will respond to a Hague District Court ruling that the ten-year residence rule in the Vreemdelingencirculaire still applies under the Kinderpardon scheme even where 1F exclusion is invoked against a parent, and whether he will apply it. The State Secretary says he disagrees with the ruling, will appeal to the Council of State, and will not change policy pending that appeal.
I cannot agree with the ruling and will lodge an appeal against it with the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Ik kan mij niet verenigen met de uitspraak en zal daartegen hoger beroep aantekenen bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Visser over benzinedieven

MPs Tellegen and Visser asked whether police fail to catch fuel thieves because paper reports are not entered in the national digital system, and what measures are being taken. The Minister of Security and Justice said paper reports are not automatically recorded, that pomphouders are encouraged to use the digital reporting facility, that camera footage upload will be possible by year-end, and that the database contains repeat offenders.
Therefore, before the end of this year, the digital reporting facility will offer the option to upload images that support the report and may help with the investigation.

Daarom wordt nog voor het einde van dit jaar binnen de digitale aangiftefaciliteit de mogelijkheid geboden om beelden te uploaden die de aangifte ondersteunen en die behulpzaam kunnen zijn bij de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over winterse illegalenopvang in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Amsterdam's winter night shelter for rejected asylum seekers rewards illegal residence, whether the state should cut the municipality's fund, and how the government will enforce return. The State Secretary answered that only rejected asylum seekers qualify for a basic night shelter, that the government will not compensate or cut municipal funds, and that it will stress return in dialogue with municipalities and use detention where removal is feasible.
In my discussions with the municipality of Amsterdam I will continue to emphasise the importance of return.
Ik zal in mijn gesprekken met de gemeente Amsterdam het belang van terugkeer blijven onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de inrichting van een adviesteam door de Raad voor de kinderbescherming

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about the Child Protection Board's new advisory team, its overlap with Veilig Thuis, privacy safeguards, medical expertise and the meldcode. The government answered that the advisory role supports municipalities without shifting responsibility, that the Board and Veilig Thuis are complementary, and that privacy and forensic medical procedures are regulated.
When a municipality consults the Board, responsibility for the report and therefore for the child's safety remains with the municipality.
Als een gemeente de Raad consulteert, blijft de verantwoordelijkheid voor de melding en dus voor de veiligheid van het kind bij de gemeente liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de rol van de gemeentelijk coördinator nazorg gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about how municipalities support children of imprisoned mothers, pointing to a Trouw article and a PvdA study, and to commitments made after the Bouwmeester initiative note. The State Secretary answered that a municipal aftercare coordinator should be in place, that most municipalities now share information, and that a factsheet and a new reintegration convenant will be sent to municipalities, with a letter promised before the January 2015 committee meeting.
I can inform the House that this factsheet will still be sent to all municipalities this year with a joint letter from me and my colleague at Health, Welfare and Sport.
Ik kan uw Kamer melden dat deze factsheet dit jaar nog met een gezamenlijke brief van mij en mijn ambtsgenoot van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aan alle gemeenten zal worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de erkenning van gerechtelijke uitspraken in andere Unie-lidstaten

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how Dutch child custody rulings, such as a contact ban on a father, are recognised in other EU member states, including whether foreign courts can penalise a mother for not presenting the children, and how this relates to the Hague Convention and Brussels IIbis. The State Secretary answered that recognition depends on the rules of Brussels IIbis and the concrete case, that courts must assess jurisdiction and prior rulings themselves, and that the Dutch Central Authority and a liaison judge network can assist citizens.
It is for the judge to decide whether a particular ruling is recognised. This depends on the concrete circumstances of the case.
Het is aan de rechter of een bepaalde uitspraak wordt erkend. Dit is afhankelijk van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over de gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de hoogte van de te betalen kinderalimentatie

Two MPs asked whether the government was aware that the Wet hervorming kindregelingen could trigger reassessment of existing child maintenance orders and how many reassessments were expected. The State Secretary confirmed the law's measures can affect the maintenance criteria, cited the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice that the number of reassessments cannot be reliably estimated, and said the effects on courts, legal aid and the LBIO are uncertain.
The Council indicates that it is not possible to make a concrete estimate of this.
De Raad geeft aan dat het niet goed mogelijk is om hiervan een concrete inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Smaling over Vluchtelingensituatie in Turkije

MPs Gesthuizen and Smaling asked the government to respond to Amnesty International's report on Syrian refugees in Turkey, including alleged shootings of refugees at the border and forced returns. The government denied structural forced returns, attributed the incidents to a period before the Kobani surge, and pointed to Dutch humanitarian funding of EUR 30 million and EUR 12 million for 2015 with a resettlement quota of 250 Syrians.
The cabinet does not believe there are structural problems regarding forced return of Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat er sprake is van structurele problemen met betrekking tot gedwongen terugkeer van Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Schouten over onoplosbare schulden

MPs Yücel and Schouten asked about the Jungmann report on unsolvable debt situations, including eligibility criteria for debt rescheduling, municipal barriers, behavioural factors and alternative help. The state secretary answered that the report's exclusion practices conflict with the Wgs, that municipal help should be client-oriented, and that a broader range of support exists beyond debt rescheduling, with a letter on the debt policy and the land debt register promised for December.
Excluding debtors does not solve the underlying problem.
Het uitsluiten van schuldenaren lost de eigenlijke problematiek niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over twee Britten die door Amsterdamse drugs zijn overleden

An MP asked the state secretaries about two British tourists who died after taking heroin sold as cocaine in Amsterdam, and about warning signs and prevention. The government answered that the deaths likely stem from misleading cocaine sales, that no incident data on misleading sales exists, that warning signs were posted for about three weeks without recorded incidents, and that prevention policy will be reviewed after a Trimbos study expected at year end.
I do not have figures on the scale of incidents involving misleading sales.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers met betrekking tot de omvang van incidenten door misleidende verkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Mensen met schulden zijn een melkkoe’

MPs Schouw and Van Nispen asked whether bailiff tariffs contain excess profit, whether the government exerts price pressure on bailiffs, and how the CAK tender requiring bailiffs to pay for contracts was handled. Minister Teeven answered that tariffs are cost-based and indexed annually, that the CAK withdrew the tender after being told it violated bailiff independence rules, and that a sample review of tariffs will be explored.

The bill also provides that where there is a serious suspicion of complaint-worthy conduct, the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, the Royal Professional Organisation of Bailiffs, or the Minister of Security and Justice can ask the disciplinary court to suspend the bailiff immediately.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet er tevens in dat bij een ernstig vermoeden van klachtwaardig handelen, het Bureau Financieel Toezicht, of de Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders of de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, de tuchtrechter kan vragen de betrokken gerechtsdeurwaarder direct te schorsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Schouw over Brandpunt uitzending "De lange arm van Kagame"

MPs Sjoerdsma and Schouw asked the government to respond to a Brandpunt broadcast alleging that a Rwandan whistleblower's asylum-related reports were manipulated and questioning Rwandan fair-trial guarantees. The government rejected the claims, said the matter was handled through the proper channel with the court, declined further investigation, and described Rwanda's judicial standards.
Because his statements concern individual asylum cases, the cabinet is bound by confidentiality and cannot go into concrete details.
Omdat zijn uitspraken individuele asielzaken betreffen is het kabinet gebonden aan vertrouwelijkheid en kan niet ingaan op concrete details.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Nispen (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Man Ingabire in oorlog met justitie» en soortgelijke berichten (ingezonden 5 no

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Nispen asked whether reports of unfair trials and misuse of genocide charges against Rwandan opposition figures are true, whether the Netherlands checks them, and whether extradition or deportation to Rwanda is safe. The government answered that it raises suspected unfair trials with Rwanda, that extradition has safeguards including court review and detention guarantees, and that it declines to discuss an individual case, while describing the IND's Article 1F procedure and its verification of intelligence reports.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht van jihadverdachten op terroristenafdelingen

An MP from the PVV asks whether jihadist suspects on terrorism wings can have contact with each other and whether security should match the EBI, the highest-security unit. The state secretary denies the reported mistreatment, defends individual regimes with risk-based contact limits, and says the terrorism wings are sufficiently secured, so the EBI level is not needed.
I therefore do not consider it necessary for the terrorism wings to have the same security level as the Extra Secure Facility.
Ik acht het daarom niet nodig dat op de terroristenafdelingen hetzelfde beveiligingsniveau geldt als die van de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Van Raak over het ontbreken van een geboortedatum op verblijfsdocumenten en in de basisregistratie personen

Four SP MPs asked why residence documents and the BRP carry placeholder birth dates such as 00-00 and whether a single fictitious date would be adopted. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Wet BRP article 2.17 now takes the fictitious date from the Justice Minister, and declined to retroactively assign dates to existing cases because of the consequences for acquired rights.
It was therefore decided, when article 2.17 of the Wet BRP was drafted, not to make such an arrangement for these existing cases.
Er is daarom bij de totstandkoming van artikel 2.17 Wet BRP besloten af te zien van het treffen van een dergelijke regeling voor deze bestaande gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het besluitmoratorium voor vluchtelingen uit Irak

MPs Voordewind and Kuiken asked whether the decision moratorium for Iraqi asylum applications leaves vulnerable minorities waiting up to 18 months, how family reunification is affected, how long the moratorium lasts, and what the IND can still decide individually. State Secretary Teeven answered that the moratorium only allows the IND to postpone decisions, that individual cases with clear risk can still be granted, that minority groups are assessed on their merits, and that the moratorium lasts six months with a possible single six-month extension.
The decision moratorium has been set for a period of six months. After this period I will consider whether there is reason to extend the moratorium once by six months.
Het besluitmoratorium is ingesteld voor de duur van zes maanden. Na afloop van deze termijn zal ik bezien of er aanleiding is het moratorium eenmalig met zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de afspraak om in het dorp Oranje honderden asielzoekers te plaatsen in recreatiewoningen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether an agreement to house hundreds of asylum seekers at a holiday park in Oranje, owned by a VVD councillor, conflicts with the zoning plan and lacked council approval, and whether there were close personal ties with the owner. The State Secretary answers that the COA may use the park, that the municipality was informed and discussed numbers with the council, and denies personal or financial contacts beyond the stated ones, declining to give details of commercial transactions.
Given the commercial interests of the entrepreneur involved and the COA, I do not provide specific information about business transactions that the COA conducts with individual entrepreneurs.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van de betrokken ondernemer en het COA geef ik geen specifieke informatie over zakelijke transacties die het COA met individuele ondernemers aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over de integratie van vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van de Integratiebarometer van Vluchtelingenwerk

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the poor labour-market and poverty outcomes of refugees shown in the Vluchtelingenwerk Integratiebarometer 2014, and whether current integration instruments and municipal support are adequate. The government acknowledges the weak outcomes, points to language, education and recognition gaps and to Somali refugees doing worst, and cites new labour-market orientation in civic integration from January 2015, but makes no concrete new commitments.
The civic integration policy was recently changed and needs time to prove itself.
Het inburgeringsbeleid is recent gewijzigd en heeft tijd nodig om zich te bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt over langdurige vreemdelingenbewaring zonder bijstand van een advocaat

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked the State Secretary about a detainee who spent 182 days in immigration detention without contact with a lawyer. The State Secretary said detainees are assigned a state-paid duty lawyer, courts review detention automatically at 28 days and six months, and the lawyer concerned was reprimanded by the disciplinary board while the new supervision regime is being strengthened.
This is laid down in the Vreemdelingenwet in line with the European Return Directive.
Dit is conform de Europese Terugkeerrichtlijn vastgelegd in de Vreemdelingenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de bezuinigingen op de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand die volgens strafrechtadvocaten tot klassenjustitie leiden

An MP asks whether cuts to state-funded legal aid for complex criminal cases, which criminal lawyers say will produce class justice, are acceptable and whether their effects will be studied. The State Secretary rejects the class-justice concern, says lawyers choose their own business models, defends the 4.5% cut to the per-point fee for complex criminal cases as a compensation measure, and declines to study the effects further.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Segers over draagmoederschap

Two MPs asked the government about surrogacy, including unregulated online matching, risks to children, enforcement under the Criminal Code, and the status of existing policy. The Secretary of State answered that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigates only when it learns of a possible surrogacy arrangement, that reporting and a new reporting structure are not needed, that enforcement is limited and largely left to the Public Prosecution Service, and that policy will await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, expected in 2016.
It is not inconceivable that single men also make contact with potential surrogate mothers.
Het is niet ondenkbaar dat ook alleenstaande mannen contact leggen met potentiële draagmoeders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Van der Staaij over illegaal draagmoederschap

MPs Arib and Van der Staaij asked about illegal surrogacy, including enforcement by the prosecution service, whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming can track children born through surrogacy, a reporting structure, and screening of surrogates and intended parents. The government answered that it sees no reason to tighten enforcement, a reporting structure or screening now, deferring these questions to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap due mid-2016.
On this basis I see no reason to ask the Public Prosecution Service to tighten the current enforcement policy on surrogacy or to give it more priority with the police.

Ik zie op basis hiervan geen aanleiding het Openbaar Ministerie te verzoeken het huidige handhavingsbeleid ten aanzien van draagmoederschap aan te scherpen of het meer prioriteit te geven bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de asielexplosie in het Drenthse Oranje

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether it is reasonable that a village of 140 residents is multiplied tenfold by an asylum centre, whether residents should be able to block such centres, and whether regional reception and an EU opt-out would be a structural solution. State Secretary Teeven acknowledged the impact on residents and said reception is necessary, referred back to earlier answers on the location, and rejected an opt-out as the only structural solution, saying solutions lie mainly in countries of origin.
I realise that this has an impact on the residents.
Ik realiseer mij dat dit impact heeft op de omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de rechters bij de Raad van State zelden de kant van de vluchteling kiezen

MP Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Council of State judges rarely side with asylum seekers, including criticism of deferential and marginal review and unmotivated rulings. The State Secretary rejected the portrayal, defended the scope of judicial review and the summary-decision power under Article 91(2) Vreemdelingenwet, and committed only to a forthcoming bill implementing the EU Procedures Directive's full ex nunc review.
I do not recognise the picture of the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division painted by Prof. Spijkerboer.
Het door prof. mr. Spijkerboer geschetste beeld van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kooiman over de vroegtijdige plaatsing van een veroordeelde mensenhandelaar in een zeer beperkt beveiligde inrichting (zbbi)

MPs Segers and Kooiman asked why a convicted human trafficker was placed in a zbbi before serving half his sentence, why victims were informed only after his first leave, and what safeguards exist during weekly leave. The minister answered that placement follows the regime, victims were informed in time, a no-contact condition applies, and victims are not consulted on leave decisions.
There is no question of victims advising on the granting of freedoms during detention.
Van advisering door slachtoffers bij het toekennen van vrijheden tijdens detentie is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat België niet langer cellen van de Penitentiaire Inrichting Tilburg wil huren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Belgium will stop renting cells in the Tilburg prison, whether staff were informed, and whether the prison should stay open given its low cost. The State Secretary answered that the treaty runs to end-2016 with a yearly notice date, that talks with Belgium are ongoing, and that the closure decision under the Masterplan DJI will not be reconsidered as there is no growth in demand.
The treaty between the Netherlands and Belgium on the use of the PI Tilburg is valid until 31 December 2016
Het verdrag tussen Nederland en België over het gebruik van de PI Tilburg heeft een geldigheid tot 31 december 2016
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over uitzettingen naar landen waar ebola heerst

Three MPs asked the State Secretary whether Belgium's suspension of forced returns to Ebola-affected countries (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was justified given the travel advice, and whether returns endanger migrants' health care access. The State Secretary answered that forced returns are temporarily suspended for staff safety, that individual risk assessments under Article 3 ECHR continue, and that returns of migrants needing medical care will be handled cautiously and case by case.

However worrying the situation in the affected countries is, I am of the view that at this moment not all foreigners who must return to the affected countries are automatically at risk of violating Article 3 ECHR.

Hoe zorgwekkend de situatie in de getroffen landen ook is, ben ik van oordeel dat op dit moment niet bij voorbaat alle vreemdelingen die naar de getroffen landen moeten terugkeren, risico op schending van artikel 3 EVRM lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een asielzoekerscentrum in Winschoten of Scheemda

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether residents of Winschoten and Scheemda were consulted about a possible asylum reception centre, and what measures would reduce asylum inflow. State Secretary Teeven answered that municipalities decide on reception centres and on whether to hold referendums, and that migration flows cannot be fully steered, while stating measures from an earlier letter remain in force.
It is up to the municipalities to decide whether, and if so in which cases and under which conditions, a public consultation takes place on matters that fall within municipal autonomy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen of en zo ja, in welke gevallen en onder welke voorwaarden, een bevolkingsraadpleging plaatsvindt over onderwerpen die tot de gemeentelijke autonomie behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Schouw over de opvang van Nederlandse kinderen in gezinsopvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Schouw asked why two Dutch children and their Guinean mother were held for twenty months in a restrictive family locations despite having Dutch nationality, and whether more such cases exist. The State Secretary acknowledged the children's Dutch nationality was insufficiently recognised, said about ten Dutch children currently stay in such locations on a voluntary basis, and committed to finding alternative accommodation.
In the case referred to in question 1, the court ruled that this measure was therefore wrongly imposed on the two children.
In de casus waarover het bericht van vraag 1 gaat, heeft de rechter bepaald dat deze maatregel derhalve ten onrechte aan de twee kinderen is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Of slapen er terroristen in Zwolle’

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of possible jihadist terrorists among asylum seekers, whether border closures and subsidy cuts were warranted. The minister answered that there are no concrete indications of planned abuse, that reintroducing internal border controls would be disproportionate, and that he will not close borders or cut subsidies, while pointing to a letter on measures and promising continued vigilance.
For operational reasons, I cannot make specific statements about any possible indications in this regard.
Vanwege operationele belangen kan ik geen specifieke mededelingen doen over eventuele aanwijzingen hieromtrent.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het terugtrekken van de Nationale Ombudsman uit het systeem ter preventie van de vernederende en onmenselijke behandeling van burgers die onder staatstoezicht van hun vrijheid z

An MP asked why the National Ombudsman withdrew from the National Preventive Mechanism against torture and ill-treatment, and whether the mechanism is functioning and sufficiently independent of the inspectorates and the minister. The state secretary regretted the withdrawal, argued the network functions adequately, and rejected concerns about ministerial influence over inspection priorities.
I therefore do not share the concerns of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de zorgen van de Nationale ombudsman dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de beperking van de persvrijheid door justitie

An MP asks why press access to detention facilities such as Schiphol is refused while other detention footage exists, and whether press freedom justifies access for photographer Robert Glas. The Secretary of State replies that access is granted when conditions are met, that press freedom is not unconditional access, and that DJI invited Glas to amend his request.
The principle of press freedom does not, however, yet carry an unconditional right of access to every place.
Het beginsel van persvrijheid brengt evenwel nog geen ongeclausuleerd recht op toegang tot elke plaats met zich.
Antwoord van het lid Gesthuizen over de gevolgen van de stroomlijning van de toelatingsprocedures

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the streamlining of admission procedures since 1 April 2014, under which the IND ex officio tests all possible humanitarian grounds and treats later applications on those grounds as subsequent applications with reduced legal aid fees, impairs access to a lawyer and an effective remedy. The State Secretary defended the policy as avoiding stacked procedures, stated that legal aid remains available, and refused to drop ex officio testing of regular residence grounds.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de steeds hogere drempels bij het vragen van extra uren door rechtshulpverleners bij bewerkelijke zaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that legal aid lawyers face ever-higher thresholds for extra hours on complex cases, and whether applications are routinely rejected. The State Secretary answered that the policy is unchanged since 2009, that rejection rates (around 39-46% in 2009-2013) are stable, and that lawyers can appeal rejections, while not explaining why lawyers perceive higher hurdles.
The policy for assessing a compensation claimed on the ground of case complexity is set out in the answer to question 1.
Het beleid voor beoordeling van een wegens bewerkelijkheid van de zaak aangevraagde vergoeding is in het antwoord op vraag 1 weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een paranoïde Pool alleen celstraf krijgt omdat geen kliniek hem wil behandelen

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a paranoid Polish offender convicted of manslaughter received only a prison sentence because no clinic would treat him, and how this fits the TBS guidance for foreign nationals and the handling of repatriation and leave for TBS patients. The State Secretary replied that the prosecution declined TBS with conditions because the offender had no health insurance or income, that prison psychiatric care is available, and that leave and repatriation rules were adjusted from April 2014.

Because enforcing a TBS with conditions would encounter practical obstacles, as the person has no own income and no individual health insurance, the Public Prosecution Service refrained from it and sought only a prison sentence.

Omdat de tenuitvoerlegging van een tbs met voorwaarden echter op praktische bezwaren zou stuiten, omdat betrokkene geen eigen inkomen heeft en ook geen individuele ziektekostenverzekering, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie daarvan afgezien en alleen een gevangenisstraf geëist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bezuinigingen op het reclasseringstoezicht

The MP asks whether the cut in reclassering supervision hours rests on a report by the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and Sexual Violence against Children, and whether the cut is representative given that it covers only a small share of advice. The state secretary answers that the cut is not based solely on that report, that merging supervision levels 1 and 2 with fewer hours allows more tailored supervision, that the high-impact-crime policy for robbers at level 3 will be maintained, and that the reclassering organisations were consulted in the 2015 framework letter.

The announced downward adjustment of the hours available within reclassering supervision is not based solely on the report of the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and Sexual Violence against Children.

De door mij aangekondigde neerwaartse bijstelling van het aantal uren dat beschikbaar is binnen het reclasseringstoezicht, is niet enkel gebaseerd op het rapport van de Nationaal Rapporteur Mensenhandel en Seksueel Geweld tegen Kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat Sociale Zaken mogelijk de privacywetgeving schond

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked who authorised linking personal data for fraud detection without a legal basis, whether the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) supervised this, and why a statutory basis was only created in 2013. Minister Asscher answers that the Wbp and the WWB/SUWI provided a basis for data linking, that the CBP was consulted and informed parliament via letters in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2011, and that the 2013 SUWI amendment (SyRI) was chosen for transparency rather than because the earlier practice was unlawful.

Although the bureau concludes that the Wbp provides a sufficient legal basis to work within a 'Black Box' environment, a separate statutory basis is chosen for reasons of transparency and a clear division of tasks and responsibilities.

Ofschoon het bureau concludeert dat de Wbp voldoende juridische basis heeft om binnen een «Black Box» omgeving te werken, wordt er om redenen van transparantie en heldere taak- en verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling voor gekozen een aparte wettelijke basis te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over beschermingsbewind en het toezicht daarop door de kantonrechter

An SP MP asked the government about the rising number of protective administration orders (beschermingsbewind), the strain on court supervision of professional administrators, the lack of a blacklist, bank account problems, and the funding of inspections. The Secretary of State answered that cases rose steadily, that the new quality rules are too recent to judge, that supervision workload is high but remains with the judge, and that no blacklist is planned for now while banks and sector bodies talk about account opening.
I see no reason to consider a black or white list.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een zwarte of witte lijst te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat er weer een tbs’er ontsnapt is tijdens verlof

An MP asks why a tbs detainee escaped during supervised leave, whether the risk assessment and tbs system are structurally flawed, why searches were not broadcast earlier, and whether escort staff should be armed. The State Secretary answers that the escape followed standard procedure, that the risk assessment was sound, that the detainee was arrested on 30 September, and that arming escorts is not warranted.
I do not share this view. In this case there were no signals that the tbs detainee would want to abscond.
Deze mening deel ik niet. In dit geval waren er geen signalen dat de betreffende tbs-gestelde zich zou willen onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de mogelijkheden om extra opvanglocaties voor asielzoekers te vinden

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how municipalities and residents could be encouraged to accept extra temporary asylum reception locations, and what the current figures are. The State Secretary answered that COA is using existing and new locations, that municipal cooperation is essential, and that a platform has been set up with VNG to speed up housing of permit holders.
COA responded to the unexpectedly higher inflow by making optimal use of existing spaces at existing locations.
Het COA heeft gereageerd op de onverwachte hogere instroom door op bestaande locaties optimaal gebruik te maken van de bestaande ruimten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de situatie in de IJsselhallen in Zwolle

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary about conditions for asylum seekers housed in the IJsselhallen in Zwolle, including length of stay, health care, privacy, and plans for structural reception capacity. The State Secretary answered that the IJsselhallen are a temporary emergency measure, that health care access is adequate, and that new locations are being sought, while acknowledging privacy shortcomings and that emergency-type reception may be needed again.
The reception provided in the IJsselhallen is a temporary emergency measure and therefore deviates from the reception normally provided.
De opvang die geboden wordt in de IJsselhallen is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel en wijkt daarmee af van de opvang die normaal gesproken geboden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over medische zorg voor gedetineerden

The MP asked whether the ECtHR Rudyak v. Ukraine judgment requires doctors to examine all arrestees on arrival at police stations, and whether current police health screening complies with Articles 2 and 3 ECHR. The Secretary of State replied that the judgment does not require a doctor examination for every arrestee, that detainees have access to a doctor and screening by trained staff is followed by a doctor when needed under a police-GGD protocol.
It therefore does not follow from the judgment that every arrestee must be examined by a doctor immediately on arrival at the police station.
Uit de uitspraak volgt dus niet dat iedere arrestant direct bij aankomst op het politiebureau dient te worden onderzocht door een arts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bijvoegen van een alimentatieberekening bij uitspraken over alimentatie

MP Van Nispen asked why alimony calculations are still not attached to court rulings on maintenance despite the minister's 2011 commitment, and whether this will change. The minister replies that the judiciary decided not to attach them routinely, that a well-reasoned ruling should allow recalculation without an attachment, and that no further legal provision is considered appropriate.
Given the response of the Council for the Judiciary and the advice of the Council of State on the Bontes private member's bill, I do not consider a further statutory provision appropriate.

Gelet op de reactie van de Raad voor de rechtspraak en het advies van de Raad van State over bovengenoemd initiatiefwetsvoorstel van het Lid Bontes acht ik een nadere wettelijke voorziening niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een kliniek een gevaarlijke veroordeelde liet lopen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a clinic released a dangerous, previously acquitted-on-grounds-of-insanity offender, and whether clinics may decide such releases on their own. The state secretary answered that the clinic granted conditional discharge under the bopz framework, that the psychiatric decision lies with the medical director, and that a pending forensic care bill would require ministerial consent for early termination.
Deprivation of liberty in connection with a disorder is only possible when the disorder and the danger arising from it justify it.
Vrijheidsontneming in verband met een stoornis is alleen mogelijk wanneer de stoornis en het gevaar dat daaruit voortvloeit dat rechtvaardigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over terugkeer naar en re-integratie in landen van herkomst voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the Safe Future method for discussing return to countries of origin with trafficking victims should become a standard task of shelters and be implemented nationally, and about falling reporting rates, identification of victims in asylum centres, and whether a study should be done. The government welcomed the method and said the project organisation is mapping rollout, announced a one-year pilot of interview studios in victim shelters, pointed to existing COA and IND training, and declined a dedicated study of victims in asylum centres.
In the autumn of 2014 a one-year pilot of interview studios in shelters for trafficking victims will therefore be started.
In het najaar van 2014 zal daarom voor de duur van een jaar een pilot verhoorstudio’s in opvanglocaties van slachtoffers mensenhandel worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat meer uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers een pardonvergunning krijgen

An MP asked why the government keeps granting residence permits to rejected asylum seekers, why this rewards ignoring departure orders, and whether it made deals with other parties to legalise such families. The Secretary of State said the long-term-resident children scheme is being implemented, that municipalities must house permit holders, and that return remains the starting point of policy, with the scheme not meant to change that.
The measures under the long-term resident children scheme are by no means intended as a change to this starting point.
De maatregelen in het kader van de regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen zijn geenszins bedoeld als een wijziging van dit uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Ypma over de implementatie van het familiegroepsplan door gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Ypma asked whether the VNG adequately informed municipalities about the legal obligation, from 1 January 2015, to enable use of the family group plan (familiegroepsplan) under the Jeugdwet, and whether municipalities have incorporated it into policy and budgets. The state secretary rejects that the VNG failed seriously, notes municipal policy gives little attention to the plan, and reports a VNG model regulation revision and a factsheet to raise awareness.
As promised in the general debate with your House of 24 September 2014, I have since held consultations with the VNG to examine how awareness of the family group plan can be increased.
Zoals toegezegd in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 24 september 2014 heb ik inmiddels met de VNG overleg gevoerd om te bezien hoe de bekendheid van het familiegroepsplan kan worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse illegalen-taxi's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Italian taxi drivers are smuggling illegal migrants into the Netherlands, how many were caught, and what measures are taken. The State Secretary said the number transported by taxi is unknown, about 150 smugglers were arrested (none Italian), and pointed to EU-level and bilateral measures against secondary migration.
It is not known how many illegal migrants have been transported by Italian taxi drivers.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel illegale migranten door Italiaanse taxichauffeurs zijn vervoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘Hulpdiensten mochten niet in vluchtgebouw’ en ‘Van der Laan wil opvang voor vluchtelingen’

MPs Voordewind and Dik-Faber asked about reports that ambulance staff were not allowed into an Amsterdam asylum shelter due to asbestos, causing delay in treating an injured asylum seeker, and about the mayor's call for a national bed-bath-bread scheme. The minister answered that protocol requires a safety clearance before entering asbestos-risk buildings, that the delay was 5-7 minutes for the patient and 10-15 minutes wait in the garage case, and referred the bed-bath-bread question to a separate answer.
The ambulance team was told when dispatched that rescue workers could not simply enter the building because of the presence of asbestos.
Het ambulanceteam kreeg bij de ritopdracht de vermelding mee dat hulpverleners het gebouw niet zomaar mochten betreden vanwege de aanwezigheid van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de brief ‘Beleidsreactie op het WODC rapport over de au-pairregeling’

An MP from the VVD asks why the au pair scheme is being tightened on the basis of a 2012/2014 WODC study, given that the 2013 Modern Migration Policy Act already tightened enforcement, and why the government wants to cut weekly hours, require a Dutch course and limit cultural exchange. The State Secretary and Minister reply that the study shows widespread overwork and heavy household tasks contrary to the scheme's cultural-exchange purpose, that intensified enforcement and a declaration of commitment will be used, that the Dutch course is encouraged rather than mandatory, and that the letter sent with the answers contains the decision.
Therefore we are intensifying enforcement with the aim of improving compliance with the rules and detecting more violations.
Daaarom intensiveren wij de handhaving met als doel de naleving van de regels te verbeteren en meer overtredingen op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een oplossing voor de massale toestroom van asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether the asylum system is inadequate given mass inflow, whether asylum seekers could be housed in other countries, and why the government will not push for a Dutch opt-out in EU migration policy. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the system is inadequate, rejected housing asylum seekers abroad as a general principle while allowing it in acute emergencies, and argued that migration must be tackled through joint European action.
The Cabinet stands for ensuring that persons who need protection actually receive that protection.
Het Kabinet staat er evenwel voor dat personen die bescherming nodig hebben, deze bescherming ook daadwerkelijk krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Reclassering in de knel door bezuinigingen’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about warnings from Reclassering Nederland over budget cuts, including longer waiting lists and reduced supervision hours. The State Secretary answered that the cuts reduce supervision and advice hours by about 8% but are expected to avoid further waiting-list growth without changing risk-based supervision levels, and that the review of the probation system, including the pending application of Info-Excellente, will be reported before the budget debate.
A definitive assessment of the application by Info-Excellente will take place in light of the outcomes of the review of the adult probation system currently being carried out.

Een definitieve beoordeling van de aanvraag van Info-Excellente zal plaatsvinden in het licht van de uitkomsten van de verkenning naar het stelsel van de volwassenenreclassering die op dit moment wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het beleid inzake gratieverzoeken en het negeren van gerechtelijke adviezen

Parliamentary questions from MP Schouw (D66) ask the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the pclemency policy for life-sentenced prisoners, including a court ruling that refused unaccompanied leave was an improper balancing, the weight given to victims and relatives, the role of judicial advice (Art. 122 Constitution) and the Vinter case law. The State Secretary Teeven answers that he respects the court ruling, will consider its consequences for clemency policy, has started resocialisation activities for the prisoner, and that judicial advice is in principle leading but he may deviate from it.
In light of the ruling, I am examining whether and what consequences this ruling has for the enforcement of life imprisonment and the clemency policy.
In het licht van de uitspraak bestudeer ik of en zo ja welke consequenties deze uitspraak voor de tenuitvoerlegging van de levenslange gevangenisstraf en het gratiebeleid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vrije advocaatkeuze

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how insurers are responding to the Supreme Court and EU Court of Justice rulings on the free choice of legal representative under legal expenses insurance, including scope, premiums, coverage limits and second-opinion procedures. The State Secretary answers that insurers have informed policyholders, adjusted work processes and some policy conditions, that premium effects are uncertain, that the scope of the rulings is limited to certain insurers, and that existing complaint and second-opinion routes remain available.
Furthermore, consultations have been held with the Ministry of Finance with a view to a desirable amendment of the Financial Supervision Act (Wft), which regulates legal expenses insurance.
Verder is met het Ministerie van Financiën overleg gevoerd met het oog op een wenselijke aanpassing van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft), waarin de rechtsbijstandverzekeringen zijn geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kweekschool voor criminelen’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a newspaper report calling youth detention centres a breeding ground for crime, and about sick-leave levels, staffing and reorganisations in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen. The State Secretary rejected the report as one-sided, gave sick-leave figures by institution, and said that staffing problems at De Hartelborgt were structurally resolved and that the closures had not reduced quality.
I find the article paints an unbalanced picture of what happens in the Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's).
Ik vind het artikel een onevenwichtig beeld schetsen van hetgeen in de Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's) gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Bajes bakermat van drugsbende’

An MP asked whether prisons allowed inmates to run an international drug network and whether DJI budget cuts endangered safety. The State Secretary denied any failure in supervision, stating cooperation with the prosecution and police led to conviction, and that staffing shortages were not the cause, while safety remained a precondition of the Masterplan DJI.
I dispute the claim that detainees could have started an international drug gang undetected during their detention.
Ik bestrijd de stelling dat gedetineerden onopgemerkt een internationale drugsbende hebben kunnen beginnen tijdens detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over euthanasie bij Belgische tbs'ers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Belgian forensic patient granted euthanasia due to inadequate care, and whether Dutch longstay tbs differs and whether Belgian detainees face legal barriers to transfer. The State Secretary answered that Dutch longstay tbs keeps resocialisation prospects through three-yearly reviews and biennial court hearings, that no transfer request was made, and that EU-level discussion is unwarranted as Belgium bears responsibility.
I see no reason to request such data.
Ik zie geen aanleiding dergelijke gegevens op te vragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66) over het bericht dat de Nederlandse zorgautoriteit (NZa) jarenlang medische gegevens, onbeveiligd en in strijd met privacy regels, heeft bewaard

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked how the NZa could keep sensitive patient records and bank card copies unsecured and unchecked for years, what safeguards exist for supervisors' data handling, whether the Dutch data protection authority will be involved, and when the Chamber will be informed. The government's answer is a referral to an earlier written consultation letter on the NZa, without substantive answers to the five questions.

The written questions from MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (both D66), question number 2014Z06807, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2014Z06807 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012» (Kamerstuk 25 268, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 130.000 vluchtelingen naar Turkije

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Turkey had closed border crossings to Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would press Turkey, offer more humanitarian aid, and resettle more refugees. The minister answered that Turkey reduced crossings to two rather than closing all, described Turkish reception and registration, pointed to 30 million euro in extra aid, and said resettlement would continue in 2015 with details to follow.
To prevent further chaos, two border crossings remain open so that Turkey and UNHCR can register the refugees in a controlled manner.
Om verdere chaos te voorkomen blijven vooralsnog twee grensovergangen open zodat Turkije en UNHCR gecontroleerd de vluchtelingen kunnen registreren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten van mogelijke fraude bij de Staatsloterij

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries of Justice and Security and of Finance about reports of possible fraud at the Staatsloterij, including when indications arose, whether the draw should be suspended, and the government's responsibility as sole shareholder and over the Kansspelautoriteit. The state secretaries answered that the Kansspelautoriteit is conducting its own investigation into compliance with licence conditions, that the ministries were only informed afterwards, that the Kansspelautoriteit has not seen grounds for measures, and that it is for the regulator to conclude the investigation and set its timeline.
The Kansspelautoriteit does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken doet de Kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over hoog ziekteverzuim en gebrek aan begeleiding van jonge criminelen in jeugdgevangenissen

MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that high staff sick leave in youth detention centres leaves young offenders with too little treatment, supervision and leave, and about related complaints, incidents and recidivism risk. Secretary Teeven rejected the claim that sick leave causes insufficient care, gave sick-leave and complaint figures, explained that leave cancellations have varied causes, and stated that community sanctions are preferred over detention.
I do not endorse the gist of the article that young people in a youth detention centre receive too little treatment or supervision because of high staff sick leave.

Ik onderschrijf niet de strekking van het artikel dat jeugdigen in een justitiële jeugdinrichting (JJI) te weinig behandeling of begeleiding zouden krijgen vanwege een hoog ziekteverzuim onder het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over de zelfmoord van een 17-jarige Afghaanse jongen op de campus voor alleenstaande minderjarigen in Oude Pekela

MPs asked the State Secretary about the suicide of a 17-year-old Afghan boy at the Oude Pekela campus for unaccompanied minors, including his psychological care, his residence permit, the delay in finding him, communication with relatives, and prevention measures. The State Secretary declined to address individual aspects of the case, said suicide is not always preventable, and reported that the Inspectorate for Youth Care received notification and decided not to start a further investigation.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over een foutief uitzetbericht van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary why a deportation notice for a man was wrongly sent, how the error occurred and how recurrence will be prevented. The State Secretary answered that a human error from an incomplete holiday handover caused a mistaken flight booking, that the flight was cancelled, and that safeguards exist, but said he cannot guarantee such errors will not recur.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to provide information from individual files.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht informatie te verstrekken uit individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het gebruik van de illegale filmdienst Popcorn Time in Nederland sterk groeit

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary whether the illegal streaming service Popcorn Time harms legal providers and creators, whether existing law can tackle foreign-based services, and what awareness measures exist abroad. The State Secretary agrees the service is harmful, explains that enforcement is largely private through Stichting Brein and that the legal framework is not yet in need of expansion, and points to thecontentmap.nl and a positive stance on voluntary rights-holder and provider awareness agreements.
Enforcement of copyright is in principle a private law matter.
De handhaving van het auteursrecht is in beginsel een privaatrechtelijke aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf ‘Extra bezuinigingen bij Justitie door tegenvallers’

An MP asks whether the Justice Ministry faces additional cuts after shortfalls, whether EU criminal law implementation could be dropped to save money, and whether the reclassering waiting list and merging the three reclassering organisations should be addressed. The minister rejects further cuts being ruled out, says EU directives must still be implemented, defends community sentences as effective, and says alternatives for reclassering are being explored with information to follow before the budget debate.
I will inform the House on this in more detail before the budget debate.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer hier vóór de begrotingsbehandeling nader over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht Christenen in Irak vluchten voor ISIS

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether ISIS targets Christians in Mosul and whether the Netherlands would follow France in admitting them as refugees, possibly via the UNHCR quota. Minister Teeven confirmed the persecution, said the Netherlands does not operate asylum-on-the-post policy, deferred any Iraq-specific asylum decision until a new country report, and said the resettlement quota for 2015 will follow UNHCR priorities while humanitarian aid is increased.
In the short term the Minister of Foreign Affairs will issue a general country report on Iraq.
Op korte termijn wordt door de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een algemeen ambtsbericht Irak uitgebracht.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat jonge criminelen in jeugdgevangenissen vaak niet worden behandeld (ingezonden 20 augustus 2014).

MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about press reports that young offenders in youth detention centres often receive no treatment, and about sick leave, daily programmes and the effects of closures and budget cuts. State Secretary Teeven rejects the one-sided picture, describes measures taken to improve care and states that daily programmes and quality have not changed materially despite cutbacks.
I find the article paints an unbalanced picture of what happens in the youth detention institutions (JJI's).
Ik vind het artikel een onevenwichtig beeld schetsen van hetgeen in de Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's) gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groep wetsondermijnende uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about an Amsterdam group of rejected asylum seekers ('We are here') that keeps squatting buildings, and whether national government should cut Amsterdam's municipal fund payments, detain or expel the group, and press Brussels for an immigration opt-out. Secretary Teeven confirmed the squatting, said Amsterdam's policy does not amount to structural undermining of the law, rejected a funding cut, and stated national policy gives no shelter to rejected asylum seekers while pledging EU-level efforts on returns.
I believe the approach of the municipality of Amsterdam described above cannot be characterised as structural undermining of the law through facilitating asylum seekers.
Ik meen dat het hiervoor beschreven uitgangspunt van de gemeente Amsterdam niet kan worden geduid als structurele ondermijning van de wet door het faciliteren van asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over asielzoekers en andere vreemdelingen die zonder recht op basisvoorzieningen en onderdak in Nederland leven

An MP asks when the European Committee of Social Rights' collective complaint decision on Netherlands will be published, what safety-net shelter exists for asylum seekers and other migrants without rights to basic provisions, how the motie-Spekman medical shelter rules work and how many use them, and how many such people there are. The Secretary of State says the ECSR findings will be published after the Committee of Ministers acts, likely November 2014, describes a broad system of shelter and exceptions while refusing to offer unconditional housing to those not complying with return obligations, and states the size of the illegal group cannot be known.
Once the Committee of Ministers has pronounced itself on the ECSR findings, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra het Comité van Ministers zich heeft uitgesproken over de bevindingen van het ECSR, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Discussie illegalen op scherp’

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether he would immediately ensure that rejected asylum seekers have access to bed, bath and bread after two such people died or were seriously injured in Amsterdam. The state secretary expressed regret but rejected any link to national policy, arguing that the reception system covers vulnerable groups and that those who fulfil their departure obligation need not be without shelter.
Providing shelter to people without prospect or conditions, without requiring work towards departure, would not only undermine the credibility and sustainability of the Dutch migration system.

Het zonder perspectief of voorwaarden bieden van onderdak aan personen zonder te verlangen dat wordt gewerkt aan vertrek, zou niet enkel afbreuk doen aan de geloofwaardigheid en houdbaarheid van het Nederlandse migratiestelsel.

Vragen van het lid Taverne (VVD) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat de heffing op hardware ten behoeve van de thuiskopieervergoeding, die lange tijd alleen gold voor

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Supreme Court ruling that the home-copying levy should also have covered digital audio and video players, and about the resulting damages and whether the AMvBs must be amended. The State Secretary answered that the State and NORMA settled the damages dispute for 10 million euros and that a new levy system, covering nearly all carriers, took effect in 2013.
The State pays an amount of 10 million euros to NORMA, which will benefit the artists and actors affiliated with NORMA who can claim that compensation.
De Staat betaalt een bedrag van 10 miljoen euro aan NORMA, dat ten goede zal komen aan de bij NORMA aangesloten artiesten en acteurs die aanspraak op die vergoeding kunnen maken.
Vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos (PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het toekomstig Nederlands kansspelbeleid en Belgische ervaringen daarmee (ingezonden 6 juni 2014).

MP Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary whether Belgian experience with online gambling should lead to a cap on licences in the planned Dutch online gambling law, and how minors and excessive gambling would be controlled. The state secretary replied that no cap is needed, that the bill relies on strict licensee requirements, age and identity checks, and stronger enforcement powers for the Kansspelautoriteit.
I have concluded that limiting the number of providers is not necessary to achieve the objectives of gambling policy.
Ik heb geconcludeerd dat een beperking van het aantal aanbieders niet nodig is om de doelstellingen van het kansspelbeleid te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten dat een TBS’er uit de Rooyse Wissel Oostrum is verdwenen

PVV MP Helder asked why the escape of a TBS patient from the Rooyse Wissel Oostrum clinic was not publicly announced with a description, whether this secrecy will change, how many TBS patients were unlawfully absent in 2014, and whether unsupervised leave should end. Minister Teeven replied that police and prosecutors decide case by case on using a description, that about 27 patients breached leave conditions in 2014 through August, and that leave is a carefully controlled part of treatment and no general description will be issued for every leave.
Police and prosecutors must be able to decide for themselves, based on their expertise and experience, case by case, whether to deploy certain investigative tools, including the timing.
Politie en OM moeten zelf, op basis van hun deskundigheid en ervaring, per casus kunnen beslissen over de wenselijkheid van de inzet van bepaalde opsporingsmiddelen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder

CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de zesvoudig moordenaar Cevdet Yilmaz die met onbegeleid verlof mag

An MP asked the State Secretary why a court allowed the life-sentenced prisoner Cevdet Yilmaz unaccompanied leave, how levenslanggestraften are treated and what it costs, and why life prisoners are placed in TBS clinics. The State Secretary answered that the court ruling is known, that the case is unique and rests on earlier policy, that leave will consider victims' residences, and gave cost figures and the placement criteria, without committing to new action.
I realise that this development is heavy and burdensome for victims and survivors.
Ik besef dat deze ontwikkeling voor slachtoffers en nabestaanden zwaar en ingrijpend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van de gemeente Zaanstad (ingezonden 23 juli 2014)

MP Leijten asked the state secretaries about a fire letter from Zaanstad and other Amsterdam-region municipalities warning that youth care providers' offers exceed the budgets in the May circular, and about possible shortfalls in The Hague and Haaglanden. The government answered that it expects regional investigations to reduce the gap, that municipalities are responsible for tariffs and contracting, and that it monitors the procurement process and will support municipalities where needed.
It is up to municipalities, in consultation with youth care providers, to make procurement agreements.
Het is verder aan gemeenten in overleg met jeugdhulpaanbieders om inkoopafspraken te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitzending ‘Opa en oma in de ban’

An MP (Oskam, CDA) asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about grandparents' difficulties keeping contact with grandchildren after divorce, the legal test for contact orders, and whether the law should be changed. The government answered that the scale of the problem cannot be measured, that courts apply a two-step test (close personal bond, then child's best interest), that Germany and France name grandparents in law but the Dutch route via the court is adequate, and that grandparents feature in the anti-conflict-divorce action plan.

I nevertheless consider the previously outlined possibility for grandparents to obtain a contact arrangement through the court adequate, and therefore see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik acht de eerder geschetste mogelijkheid voor grootouders om via de rechter tot een omgangsregeling te komen niettemin afdoende en zie daarom geen aanleiding hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.

Vragen van de leden Segers (ChristenUnie) en Siderius (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Jeugdklinieken in nood door overheveling

MPs Segers and Siderius asked about reports that youth clinics face financial distress from the transfer of youth care to municipalities, and about the motion on care for victims of trafficking and honour-related violence, municipal purchasing of specialist care, and whether children can still reach specialist facilities. The State Secretaries answered that the transition is ongoing, a VNG framework and a transition arrangement support specialist providers, bridge funding exists, municipalities remain responsible for their own purchasing, and the Youth Act guarantees access to appropriate care.
We follow the transition closely. We try to support municipalities as much as possible in the transition, and also address municipalities and/or regions where problems threaten to arise.
We proberen gemeenten zoveel mogelijk te ondersteunen bij de transitie, en spreken gemeenten en/of regio’s ook aan daar waar zich problemen dreigen voor te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over het bericht dat Frankrijk hulp en opvang gaat bieden aan christenen

Two CDA MPs asked whether France's offer of aid and shelter to Christians expelled by IS from Mosul would be matched by Dutch asylum options, and what support minorities and the EU provide. The minister answered that asylum cases from IS-controlled Iraqi areas are postponed until a new country report appears in early September, while the EU and Netherlands continue supporting minorities.

Once the new country report is available, the State Secretary for Security and Justice will consider whether the information in it should lead to an adjustment of the current asylum policy regarding Iraq.

Zodra het nieuwe ambtsbericht er is, zal de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien of de informatie in het ambtsbericht tot een aanpassing moet leiden in het huidige asielbeleid ten aanzien van Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over verboden gokreclames

An MP asked the State Secretary about online gambling advertising and illegal online gambling providers that continue to target the Netherlands despite warnings and a motion to exclude them from licences. The State Secretary answered that enforcement rests with the Gambling Authority, which investigates without disclosing individual cases, and that he intends to exclude persisting providers from licensing with details to follow in autumn.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Gambling Authority makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de ksa geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het proefschrift ‘Sexoffender Risk Assessment In The Netherlands – Towards a risk need responsivity oriented approach’

A Van der Steur (VVD) asks the State Secretary about Dr. W. Smid's dissertation on risk assessment and treatment allocation for sex offenders, including under- and over-treatment and whether standardised actuarial instruments should be mandatory. The State Secretary answers that the study concerns 1996-2002 cases, that RNR principles are already applied, that preferred instruments (HCR-20 V3, HKT-R) will be mandatory in clinical care from 2015, and that projects are underway to improve risk analysis.
I have also asked the sector this year to designate the preferred risk assessment instruments.
Aan de sector heb ik – eveneens dit jaar – gevraagd de preferente risicotaxatie-instrumenten aan te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over medische zorg voor gedetineerden

MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about medical care for detainees, including whether police should involve medically trained staff, how medical information is passed on at transfer, and whether acute cases can be admitted to the Justitieel Medisch Centrum. The State Secretary answered that a police-GGD protocol requires medical assessment, that new transfer forms and an expanded electronic patient file are being rolled out, and that the JCvSZ admits only non-urgent somatic cases as the IGZ confirmed.
