Several initiatives are underway to improve information exchange between the police and the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI).
Verschillende initiatieven zijn gaande om de informatie-uitwisseling tussen de politie en de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over afhandeling van incidenten door penitentiaire en tbs-inrichtingen

An MP asked how penitentiary and TBS institutions handle drug finds and suspected criminal incidents, including reporting to police and recording of reports. The State Secretary explained the aangifte rules, sanctions, police cooperation, and a national handbook, but said national counts of reports and processen-verbaal are not kept for penitentiary institutions.
The number of reports, and therefore also the number of official records drawn up, is not kept nationally for penitentiary institutions.
Het aantal aangiftes en dus ook het aantal opgemaakte processen-verbaal wordt niet landelijk voor de penitentiaire inrichtingen bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het toekomstig Nederlands kansspelbeleid en de Belgische ervaringen daarmee

An MP asked the State Secretary about Belgian experience with legal online gambling, including caps on licences, youth gambling and enforcement, and how Dutch gambling policy will respond. The State Secretary answered that Belgian, Danish and French experience informed the draft Remote Gambling Act, that no cap on licences is needed since a non-capped licensing system achieves channelling, and that strict licence conditions and enhanced enforcement powers for the gambling authority address youth and excessive gambling.
The bill provides for strict requirements for providers, both before and after the licence is granted.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in het stellen van strikte eisen aan aanbieders, zowel voorafgaand als na verlening van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over het bericht dat illegalen in Amsterdam de eigen bijdrage voor medicijnen terugkrijgen

Two PVV MPs asked why undocumented migrants in Amsterdam receive free medicines, whether the mayor breaches agreements, and how the government will ensure departure. The minister answered that undocumented migrants are responsible for care costs, that reimbursement via Zorginstituut is possible with a €5 correction, that the mayor's payment of that amount is a municipal matter, and that she was not consulted in advance.
To what extent municipalities bear these costs themselves and how they have organised this is not for me to assess.
In hoeverre gemeenten deze kosten voor eigen rekening nemen en hoe zij dit georganiseerd hebben, staat niet aan mij ter beoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht “Grensdetentie is niet langer houdbaar”

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report calling border detention of asylum seekers, including children, incompatible with human rights norms and EU law. The State Secretary answered that detention and refusal of entry are applied under EU and national rules with individual assessment, that about 77% of asylum seekers detained at the border in 2013 eventually gained access, and that new policy for families with minor children and an IND work instruction would be introduced.
Furthermore, refusing entry and imposing border detention must take place with care.
Voorts geldt dat het weigeren van toegang en het opleggen van grensdetentie zorgvuldig moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het hoogste aantal asielzoekers in 13 jaar

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the highest number of asylum seekers in 13 years, including concerns about integration, welfare, police and courts burden, and whether opt-outs on immigration should be pursued in the EU. The State Secretary answered that the surge requires extra effort across the migration chain, that opening reception locations is being accelerated with local information, that Eritrean and Syrian applicants are often granted protection, and that Netherlands will not seek an EU immigration opt-out but will pursue joint EU action on return.
I also want to push ahead with a joint, effective EU approach to return.
Ook wil ik graag doorpakken op een gezamenlijke, effectieve EU-aanpak voor terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over een tbs’er die 100 euro per dag vangt door getalm van de IND

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why the IND delayed declaring a Turkish tbs detainee undesirable, causing a daily penalty payment, and whether Turkey takes back such nationals. The state secretary replied that the objection was declared unfounded on 22 July 2014, removal preparations have started, the deadline overrun was due to case complexity, and the IND has issued work instructions to prevent recurrence.
Due to the complexity of this case, the IND regrettably exceeded the decision deadline for the objection, which led to a penalty payment as stated in the article.
Vanwege de complexiteit van deze zaak is tot mijn spijt de beslistermijn in bezwaar door de IND overschreden, wat heeft geleid tot een dwangsom zoals in het artikel staat vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de rapportage Vreemdelingenketen 2013

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about the 2013 Vreemdelingenketen report, including the number of children and families in asylum reception, how often families moved during the procedure, and exit figures from family locations. The State Secretary answered with the requested counts and tables, but declined to count all relocations during the asylum procedure because such moves are not registered separately.
No. As previously reported to your House, relocations that form part of the asylum procedure are not recorded separately.
Nee. Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld, worden verplaatsingen die onderdeel zijn van de asielprocedure niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Congolese getuigen van het Strafhof ondanks zorgen toch uitgezet zijn

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would act on reports that Congolese detainee witnesses for the International Criminal Court were returned to the DRC despite concerns about torture, unfair trial and the death penalty, and whether Netherlands would monitor them or contact Congolese authorities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Council of State and the ECHR found no obstacle to return, that the ICC bears responsibility for witness protection and monitoring under its own agreements with the DRC, and that Netherlands will not monitor individuals after return.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het aantal vreemdelingen in isoleercellen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how often foreign nationals in immigration detention were placed in isolation in 2011–2014, and for breakdowns by reason and duration. The State Secretary gave yearly counts (741 in 2012, 662 in 2013, 167 in Jan–Apr 2014), noting the registration system is not fully reliable, and gave shares by reason (disciplinary vs. protective order) and average durations.
The registration system consulted for this purpose, given its current automated processing, does not provide a fully reliable picture.
Het hiervoor geraadpleegde registratiesysteem voorziet wegens de huidige geautomatiseerde verwerking niet in een volkomen betrouwbaar beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opnieuw Straf brandstichter Winschoten”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a convicted arsonist could serve a prison sentence in a TBS clinic where he is already treated, and about the cost and frequency of such arrangements. The State Secretary answered that prison sentences are normally served in penitentiary facilities, that courts may advise on placement, that such placements in forensic psychiatric centres occur in a small number of cases, and that each case is weighed individually.
Prison sentences are in principle carried out in penitentiary institutions.
Gevangenisstraffen worden in beginsel in penitentiaire inrichtingen ten uitvoer gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Man rent geboeid weg uit politieauto”

An MP asked how a handcuffed arrestee escaped from a police car, whether figures on escapes and attempts could be provided, and whether the broekstok (leg restraint) should always be used during transport. The Secretary of State said the escape method is unknown, gave figures for attempts and one escape (no figures for arrestees are registered), and defended the current case-by-case restraint policy while declining to recover costs from the arrestee.
Figures on the number of escapes and attempts by arrestees are not available, because they are not registered as such.
Cijfers over het aantal ontvluchtingen en het aantal pogingen hiertoe van arrestanten zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat dit niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het versneld afdoen van zaken door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) op gespannen voet staat met een eerlijk proces

MPs Van Nispen asked whether the OM's fast-track ZSM approach to criminal cases undermines a fair trial, including access to counsel, information for lawyers, and judicial review. Minister Teeven answered that ZSM respects defendants' rights (Salduz consultation, legal aid, right to object to a penalty order and go to court), that information is documented in writing, and that a separate government reply on the human rights report would follow.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.
Vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar haar vader in de Verenigde Staten. (ingezonden 7 mei 2014).

MP Van Nispen asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the forced return of a 10-year-old girl to her father in the United States under the Hague Child Abduction Convention, including the manner of the return, the mother's lack of access to her lawyer, the restrictive Dutch application of the convention's exceptions, and possible solutions. The State Secretary's second supplementary answer refers back to earlier answers and to a confidential annex, indicating the substance is handled in a restricted briefing.
Placed for confidential inspection, for members only, at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd, alleen voor de leden, bij het Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over vluchtelingen met een vals paspoort die vrijuit gaan

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why asylum seekers carrying forged passports escape prosecution, whether this conflicts with the Refugee Convention, and what measures would be taken. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution is only possible after a final rejection of the asylum claim, that the Supreme Court ruling is binding, and that no new measures or treaty withdrawal are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het fiscaal mogelijk gemaakte (tot een bepaald bedrag vrijgesteld van vermogensrendementsheffing) banksparen ten behoeve van de kosten van een uitvaart

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why no bank offers the tax-favoured bank savings product for funeral costs created in 2010, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that banks find the amounts too small to justify the product, that the government will not oblige banks to offer it, and that it intends to abolish the facility in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015 unless the NVB shows such products will be offered.
I intend to abolish the facility in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015, unless the NVB makes it plausible that bank savings products for funeral costs will still be offered.
Ik heb het voornemen om de faciliteit af te schaffen in de Fiscale verzamelwet 2015, tenzij de NVB aannemelijk maakt dat bankspaarproducten voor uitvaartkosten alsnog aangeboden zullen gaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de doodsoorzaak van een gedetineerde die in 2011 is overleden

An MP asked the minister whether a forensic report showing police-violence injuries on a detainee who died in 2011 should prompt a new investigation into the cause of death. The minister answered that a complaint procedure under article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is pending, so no comment can be made while the case is before the court.
Since this case is before the court, no statements can be made about it.
Nu deze zaak onder de rechter is, kunnen er geen mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over gijzelingstrainingen in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether crisis training for prison staff (hostage-taking, riots, fire drills) would be cut, how often trainings and drills occur per prison, and how crisis team sizes change after budget cuts. The State Secretary answered that no cuts apply to drills or crisis teams, that a new hostage-training approach using in-house instructors and e-learning is being prepared, and that staff councils will be consulted.
No cuts are being made to crisis teams.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het niet vervolgen van vluchtelingen met valse papieren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Supreme Court ruling stops prosecution of refugees entering with false papers, its effect on asylum policy, the expected number affected and pull effect, and whether the government would denounce the Refugee Convention to reverse it. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution remains possible only after a final asylum refusal or after a residence permit is granted, the ruling does not directly affect admission policy, and denouncing the Convention is not an option.
The Supreme Court ruling concerns the criminal prosecution of foreigners for using false or forged travel documents.
Het arrest van de Hoge Raad ziet op de strafrechtelijke vervolging van vreemdelingen voor het gebruiken van valse of vervalste reisdocumenten.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Kooiman over de brief van de gemeente Alphen aan den Rijn over de fiscale consequenties van de inkoop van jeugdhulp

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the municipality of Alphen aan den Rijn's warning about VAT charges on regional youth care purchasing, possibly cutting budgets by 21%, was accurate, and what would be done about the budget uncertainty. The government replied that VAT exemptions for youth care apply, that clarifying standard cooperation forms with umbrella organisations is underway, and that municipalities received budget certainty on 30 May 2014.
We are therefore in consultation with a number of umbrella organisations to produce a description of the tax consequences of the most common forms of cooperation, as expected.
Wij zijn daarom in overleg met een aantal koepelorganisaties om te komen tot een beschrijving van de fiscale consequenties van de – naar verwachting – meest voorkomende samenwerkingsvormen.
Vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar haar vader in de Verenigde Staten. (ingezonden 7 mei 2014).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the forced return of a 10-year-old girl to her father in the United States, including the conduct of the arrest, the mother's access to counsel, the Hague Abduction Convention exception for children's objections, legal aid costs and criminal prosecution of returning parents. The State Secretary declined to answer the operational questions in public, citing a confidential document regime, and otherwise defended the existing Dutch practice and the Convention's strict interpretation without committing to changes.

The answers to these questions were already sent to your House on 18 June 2014 in accordance with the Regulation on confidential documents and deposited with your Clerk's office for confidential inspection.
De antwoorden op deze vragen zijn op 18 juni 2014 reeds aan uw Kamer gestuurd conform de Regeling vertrouwelijke stukken en bij uw Griffie ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Dijkhoff over ftp-servers die onvoldoende beveiligd zijn waardoor privégegevens van burgers te zien zijn

MPs Van Oosten and Dijkhoff asked whether privacy-sensitive data on insecure FTP servers could be misused, whether cases were known, what safeguards exist, and what the ministry and NCSC do to protect citizens and businesses. Minister Opstelten answered that information security is primarily the responsibility of citizens, businesses and government, that the Wbp applies, that no reported cases of misuse were received by the NCSC, and that awareness campaigns and the NCSS-2 strategy address the issue.
It should be borne in mind that information security is primarily the own responsibility of citizens, businesses and governments.
Hierbij dient te worden bedacht dat informatiebeveiliging primair een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van burgers, bedrijven en overheden is.

Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugsturen van minderjarige kinderen naar Italië op grond van de Dublin-verordening (ingezonden 5 juni 2014).

Ms Maij (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about returning minor children to Italy under the Dublin Regulation, following ECtHR interim measures against Denmark and the pending Tarakhel case. The State Secretary answered that transfers of families with children to Italy remain acceptable, that asylum seekers can seek interim relief in court, and that the government will await the Tarakhel judgment before considering any policy change.
In line with the situation in Denmark, I will not oppose the court granting an interim measure where the family includes a child under five.
In lijn met de situatie in Denemarken zal ik mij niet verzetten tegen een toewijzing van een voorlopige voorziening door de rechtbank, indien het gaat om een familie met een kind jonger dan vijf jaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat opvang van illegalen wordt verlengd

An MP asks why Amsterdam is extending shelter for rejected asylum seekers at the Vluchthaven and what the government will do to send them back. The Secretary of State says the initiative was closed on 1 June and replaced by six months of follow-up shelter for two defined groups, that two people have returned, and that return depends on the willingness of the person concerned.
The initiative was discontinued on 1 June.
Het initiatief is op 1 juni jl. stopgezet.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het tekort aan woningen voor ex-asielzoekers (ingezonden 11 juni 2014).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether ex-asylum seekers with residence status could move in with partners immediately, to ease the housing shortage, and whether he would consider changing the rules. The State Secretary answered that there are no obstacles to such a move and that he sees no solution to the housing shortage in the proposal.
In your proposal I therefore see no solution to the shortage of housing for the accommodation of permit holders mentioned in the article.
In uw voorstel zie ik dan ook geen oplossing voor de in het artikel vermelde tekort aan woningen voor de huisvesting van vergunninghouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Rebel over het bericht dat gemeenten niet weten hoe ze kindermishandeling moeten tegengaan

MPs Ypma and Rebel asked the state secretaries whether municipalities lack the knowledge and data to prevent child abuse, citing an Ombudsman for Children report. The government answered that most municipalities do hold data, that it will support municipalities with tools, a regulatory change and an updated action plan, while noting that prevention policy is primarily their own responsibility.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for shaping child abuse prevention policy and setting objectives.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om preventiebeleid voor kindermishandeling vorm te geven en doelstellingen te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat Van der G. zijn leven niet zeker

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked whether serious threats had been made against Van der G., whether a former AIVD agent's warnings were included in the security analysis, and whether the minister would inform the House in closed session. The minister said he was unaware of the former agent's role, that threat assessments are current and not disclosed publicly for security reasons, and that he saw no reason for a closed briefing.
No statements are made in public about the extent and nature of the threat and risk, or about security measures.
Over de mate en aard van dreiging en risico en over beveiligingsmaatregelen worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over mobiel grenstoezicht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about delays in amending the Aliens Decree to widen mobile border checks by the Marechaussee, whether Germany had expanded such checks, and whether the government would push for risk-based flexibility at EU level. The State Secretary confirmed the amendment is in progress after advice from the ACVZ and Raad van State, explained the planned extension of train-check limits and a temporary exceptional power, said Germany's expansion is not evidenced, and stated the government will keep pressing for room at EU level while noting the national power must respect EU law.
With this proposal to amend the Aliens Decree, the legal framework for MTV checks on trains is being extended.
Met dit voorstel tot wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit wordt het juridisch kader voor de MTV-controles op treinen uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de kosten van de vreemdelingenadvocatuur en subsidies voor aan vreemdelingenzaken gerelateerde organisaties

The MP asks about the cost of the immigration lawyers' legal aid (about 19.6 million euro paid in 2013 across 15,503 persons), how that compares with other countries like Denmark, and which migration-related organisations received subsidies in 2013 and how spending is accounted for. The Secretary of State gives figures, states that cross-country comparison data for subsidies are not available, reports subsidy recipients with accountability via the Auditdienst Rijk and the Court of Audit, and says measures against procedure-stacking are in place.
I do not have this data for other EU member states.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens van andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar haar vader in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the forced return of a 10-year-old girl to her father in the United States, questioning the facts, the Hague Abduction Convention practice, the enforcement protocol, the mother's denied access to counsel, and possible reforms. The government's reply is a bare notice that the answers were deposited for confidential inspection by members only, so the substance is withheld.
the answers to the written questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) on the return of a 10-year-old girl to the United States have been deposited for confidential inspection, for members only

de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) over de teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar de Verenigde Staten ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de leden, zijn gelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onmogelijkheid tot herinvoering van grenscontroles

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Eritrean influx justified reinstating internal border controls, what counts as a threat to public order, and whether EU asylum and migration directives harm the Netherlands and warrant an opt-out. Secretary Teeven answered that the influx is not a serious threat under EU law, that border checks mainly target illegal stay and cannot stop asylum applicants, that the directives harmonise law usefully, and that an opt-out would need a treaty change so it is not on the table.
Migration and crossing of external borders by a large number of third-country nationals may in principle not be regarded as a threat to public order or internal security.

Migratie en het overschrijden van buitengrenzen door een groot aantal onderdanen van derde landen mag in beginsel niet worden gezien als een bedreiging van de openbare orde of de binnenlandse veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over nareis van meerderjarige ongehuwde kinderen

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the family reunification of adult unmarried children, citing a case of a Syrian refugee's daughter too old to join her parent, and about the European Commission's guidance on the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary said Dutch law deliberately allows adult unmarried children to join asylum-holding parents subject to an individual 'more than normal emotional dependency' test, promised a general reply on the guidance after an expert meeting, and stated that the directive applies to these cases.
How many cases have a situation comparable to the individual case in question, I do not have insight into.
In hoeveel zaken zich een vergelijkbare situatie voordoet als in de betreffende individuele zaak, heb ik niet inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de EO-reportage 'De nachtmerrie na het misbruik'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an EO report on parents of sexually abused children lacking a strong victim position, the court ruling that parents cannot join criminal proceedings for their damages, and the limited compensation from the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven. The State Secretary acknowledged parents' limited victim rights, announced a bill allowing parents to join as injured parties for costs incurred for their child (aiming for early 2015), explained the Schadefonds' limits, and declined a personal meeting while using the letters as input for policy.
I intend to regulate by law that parents can join the criminal proceedings as an injured party for costs they have incurred on behalf of their child.
Ik ben voornemens wettelijk te regelen, dat ouders zich in het strafproces kunnen voegen als benadeelde partij voor kosten die zij ten behoeve van hun kind hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke Zwitserse jeugdcrimineel die in Nederland in een luxueus hotel is geplaatst

MP Helder asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why a dangerous Swiss young offender was housed in a luxury hotel in the Netherlands, how this squares with earlier answers, whether the Netherlands should decide on flight risk itself, and whether the hotel has training rooms for young offenders. The State Secretary answered that the stay was temporary housing within a resocialisation trajectory rather than treatment, agreed the Netherlands must judge risk itself, saw no need for action toward Switzerland, and denied that hotels have training rooms for offenders or that taxpayer money pays for this.
I trust that this will result in the Swiss authorities handling such a case differently in the future
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit tot gevolg heeft dat de Zwitserse autoriteiten een dergelijke zaak in de toekomst op een andere manier zullen behandelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Tongeren over de samenstelling van de staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Van Tongeren asked whether a member of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap should be reconsidered given his tweet that there should be no more than two legal parents or guardians, and whether the government would reconsider his appointment. The Secretary of State confirmed the tweet, said all members are chosen for expertise and may hold views, and saw no reason to reconsider the appointment.
The mere fact that Prof. Nuytinck, prior to his appointment to the state commission, took part in the public debate via a tweet does not mean he would be biased regarding the commission's outcomes.

Het enkele feit dat (bijvoorbeeld) prof. Nuytinck zich, voorafgaand aan zijn benoeming in de staatscommissie, door middel van een tweet heeft gemengd in het maatschappelijk debat, betekent niet dat hij vooringenomen zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de verwarring omtrent het publiceren van namen door gemeenten

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities may publish citizens' names and addresses in objection submissions, and whether privacy is adequately protected. The minister answered that municipalities must weigh privacy against publicity case by case, that the Groningen case involved only a list sent to parties rather than internet publication, and that an ombudsman investigation is ongoing.
The aforementioned investigation by the municipal ombudsman is partly aimed at establishing whether in this case the personal privacy of the submitters of objections was adequately safeguarded.
Het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van de gemeentelijke ombudsman is er mede op gericht vast te stellen of in dit geval de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de indieners van de zienswijzen goed is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de betekenis van de uitspraak van het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten (ECSR)

MPs asked the State Secretary how his refusal to take immediate measures after a European Committee of Social Rights ruling squares with a Amsterdam court ruling recognising a right to a dignified existence, and whether he will provide bed, bath and bread to rejected asylum seekers living on the street. The State Secretary replied that the court case concerned municipal welfare obligations rather than the ECSR letter, that the individual still had ongoing procedures, and that he sees no reason to change his position, judging the Dutch system balanced.
The ruling of the Amsterdam court therefore gives me no reason to revisit my position following the ECSR letter.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam vormt voor mij dan ook geen aanleiding om terug te komen op mijn standpunt naar aanleiding van de brief van het ECSR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Duitse agenten asielzoekers weigeren aan de grens

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether German police really turn asylum seekers back at the border and whether the Marechaussee should get the same powers. State Secretary Teeven answered that German authorities forward asylum requests to their federal migration office rather than returning people, that border handover under the Benelux-German treaty applies to illegal immigrants, and that he sees no reason to change Marechaussee powers.
Following the Telegraaf report, I immediately made inquiries with my German colleague.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf heb ik direct navraag gedaan bij mijn Duitse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de hoeveelheid kinderen die in Nederland om migratieredenen in bewaring wordt gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about EU comparisons of children detained for migration reasons, the number of children detained in 2011-2013, and alternatives to detention. The government answered that the comparative figures are unverifiable and it draws no conclusions, gave detention numbers, and said children are only detained exceptionally and that the new policy and a bill will address this.
These figures are not known to me.
Deze cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat criminele meisjes een andere aanpak nodig hebben

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether criminal girls need a different approach, including their share in youth detention, whether a new group of difficult girls exists, and whether multisystemic therapy is effective for them. The State Secretary answered that girls are about one in five suspects, are underrepresented in detention relative to offences, that no new group of difficult girls is evident, that girls receive specific facilities and interventions including MST, and that girls' recidivism (19.3%) is lower than boys' (39.2%).
This is reflected, among other things, in the fact that there are special departments for girls within the youth correctional sector.
Dat komt onder meer tot uiting in het gegeven dat er binnen de sector JJI speciale afdelingen voor meisjes zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over over de brandbrief van gemeenten in de regio Zuidoost-Utrecht over het tekort op het budget Jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretary how he views the Zuidoost-Utrecht municipalities' alarm over a 15 million euro youth-care budget shortfall and whether other municipalities face similar gaps. The state secretary says he is consulting the region, will run a difference analysis after the May circular, and sees no problem with the woonplaatsbeginsel allocation.
It is not exactly known to me which other municipalities expect to face financial shortfalls regarding the youth-care budget.
Het is mij niet exact bekend welke andere gemeenten verwachten te maken te krijgen met financiële tekorten met betrekking tot het budget voor de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Toorenburg over de onrust onder het gevangenispersoneel

MPs Kooiman and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about unrest among prison staff, including staffing shortages, intimidation, budget cuts and the pension gap for staff in substantially burdensome posts. The State Secretary disputed the staffing-shortage and intimidation claims, cited falling violent incidents, and deferred detailed answers on cuts and the Masterplan to a later letter.

In line with my earlier commitments during the General Consultation on the DJI Masterplan of 29 January and the General Consultation on prisons of 27 March, I will inform the House before the summer recess about progress on implementing the DJI Masterplan and the additional financial problems.

Conform mijn eerdere toezeggingen tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Masterplan DJI van 29 januari jl. en het Algemeen Overleg over het gevangeniswezen op 27 maart jl. zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van het Masterplan DJI en de aanvullende financiële problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de ontslaggolf in de jeugdzorg

The SP MP Kooiman asked the state secretaries about the reported loss of 140 jobs at Bureau Jeugdzorg Gelderland and an expected 5,100 to 8,700 job losses in youth care, asking how quality and continuity would be protected, whether dismissals and social plans could be reported by region, and what transition support exists. The government answered that job losses are plausible and depend on municipal contracting, that it is monitoring labour market effects, and that it has allocated funds for transition and retraining, but gave no regional dismissal figures because contracting is not yet complete.
Only once the contracting process between municipalities and providers has progressed further can it be stated to what extent, despite the efforts of these parties, forced dismissals occur and where.
Pas als het inkoopproces tussen gemeenten en aanbieders verder is gevorderd kan worden aangegeven in hoeverre er, ondanks de inspanningen van deze partijen, gedwongen ontslagen zijn en waar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over richtsnoeren voor de toepassing van de Richtlijn inzake het recht op gezinshereniging

An MP asks the State Secretary whether Dutch family reunification practice (age limit of 21, civic integration test abroad, income duration rules, and individual balancing) should be changed to match new European Commission guidelines on the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary largely rejects changes: he says the age limit is compliant, the integration test awaits a CJEU ruling, individual assessment is adequately secured, and the policy will not be adjusted immediately.
Until then, I see no reason to change the policy on this.
Tot die tijd zie ik geen aanleiding om het beleid hieromtrent te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de asielaanvraag van Somalische piraten

An MP asked whether Somali pirates serving prison sentences in the Netherlands had applied for asylum, and demanded guarantees of refusal and deportation, an end to the Refugee Convention's application, and that no more pirates be prosecuted here. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual asylum applications, said they would be refused under Article 1F or the 24-month rule, reported deportations under agreements with Somalia, and reaffirmed the Convention framework and regional prosecution policy.
The Dutch government does not make statements about asylum applications submitted by individual foreigners.
De Nederlandse regering doet geen mededelingen over asielaanvragen die door individuele vreemdelingen zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Vrijgelaten piraten willen asiel’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is acceptable that Somali pirates who shot at Dutch soldiers and were jailed could seek asylum in the Netherlands, and how asylum policy prevents such people from freely moving in the country. The Secretary declined to confirm individual asylum applications, explained that criminal records are weighed and that Article 1F or public-order grounds can lead to refusal, and stated that return of the roughly 25 Somali pirates is being pursued, with one already deported.
The Dutch government does not make statements about asylum applications submitted by individual foreigners.
De Nederlandse regering doet geen mededelingen over asielaanvragen die door individuele vreemdelingen zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het ten onrechte vrij laten van Somalische piraten

Two PVV MPs asked why Somali pirates were released early despite earlier assurances that this only happens on proven departure, and whether they will serve their full sentences and be deported afterwards. The State Secretary replied that the law wrongly allows early release for foreigners who file asylum claims, that he will propose amending the Criminal Code, that the court found lawful residence so release applies, and that deportation of pirates is being pursued through agreements with Somalia.
I will therefore submit a proposal as soon as possible to amend the Criminal Code on this point so that only foreigners with a stable form of lawful residence can be eligible for conditional release.

Ik zal daarom zo spoedig mogelijk een voorstel indienen om het Wetboek van Strafrecht op dit punt te wijzigen zodat alleen vreemdelingen met een bestendige vorm van rechtmatig verblijf voor voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling in aanmerking kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Werkstraf voor doodrijdster Jim (16)’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether a community service sentence for a 16-year-old who killed a cyclist is acceptable to the victim's family, and whether community service as a main penalty should be abolished. The State Secretary declined to comment on the court's ruling, said the prosecution's demand was carefully made, and stated the cabinet wants to keep community service but considers it unsuitable for serious sex and violent crimes.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on a judgment of the court.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over een oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht ‘Google gaat gebruikers volgen naar de echte winkel’

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about reports that Google would link online browsing to offline store purchases, including whether it happens in the Netherlands, how it fits Dutch cookie and data protection law, and whether extra safeguards are needed. The minister answered that the test is only in the United States, that cookies require informed consent under the Telecommunications Act and the Data Protection Act, and that a broader big-data letter and the forthcoming EU regulation will address the issue.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to assess whether this representation of events is correct.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie om te beoordelen of deze voorstelling van zaken correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over boetes die vluchtelingen krijgen omdat zij niet aan hun verzekeringsplicht voldoen

An MP asked the State Secretary about fines imposed on refugees for failing to take out health insurance after receiving residence permits, including retroactive premium claims and loss of care allowance. The government acknowledged the problems, says most refugees comply within the deadline and COA pays fines when they do not, but rejects exempting refugees from the insurance obligation and only commits to faster municipal housing and a pilot.
I find it undesirable to adjust the basic principles of the insurance obligation for a small number of cases.
Ik vind het onwenselijk om voor een klein aantal gevallen de uitgangspunten voor de verzekeringsplicht aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de komst van het Eritrees voetbalelftal naar Nederland

An MP from the PVV asks whether former Eritrean national football team members, resettled from Romania to the Netherlands, should be rejected under the Dublin rules and why the Netherlands helped bring them, and asks what is being done about rising Eritrean asylum inflow. The State Secretary answers that the group was referred by UNHCR for resettlement, that Dublin rejection is not warranted because they came from the Emergency Transit Centre, and that measures on the inflow will be sent separately.
I will inform the House separately about the measures I have taken and am taking regarding the increased inflow.
Ik bericht uw Kamer separaat over de maatregelen die ik heb getroffen en tref met betrekking tot de verhoogde instroom.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie dat je bij zaken als opvangcentra voor verkrachte vrouwen kan afvragen of dat een taak is voor de overheid

An MP asked whether the state secretary's remark that funding shelters for raped women may not be a government task, comparable to beekeeping in Malawi, reflected cabinet policy. The government replied that the remark was not meant to question state responsibility, that municipalities are responsible for victim shelter under the Wmo, and that no consultation with the health ministry had taken place.
Under the Social Support Act, municipalities are responsible for arranging shelter for victims of domestic violence who need it.
Op grond van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning hebben de gemeenten de verantwoordelijkheid om opvang te regelen voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld, die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het mogelijk verdwijnen van taaleisen bij gezinshereniging

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether EU rules undermine strict migrant admission, whether Dutch civic integration requirements abroad will remain, and whether the Netherlands can opt out of EU immigration and asylum rules. The State Secretary replied that a CJEU ruling on language requirements is expected within about eighteen months and the current policy stays unchanged until then, and that a Dutch opt-out is not realistic because it would require a treaty change.
Depending on the Court's ruling, the government will consider its position at that time.
Afhankelijk van de uitspraak van het Hof zal de regering zich op dat moment beraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Human Rights Watch concludeert dat Bulgarije asielzoekers mishandelt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would act on a Human Rights Watch report alleging Bulgarian border police push back and mistreat asylum seekers, and how this squares with EASO and Bulgarian government statements. The State Secretary replied that the government sees no reason for action beyond continued support to Bulgaria, citing Bulgarian denials, Red Cross and UNHCR reports, and announced a loosening of its earlier lenient Dublin policy on Bulgaria.
In view of the above, I see no reason to take action following the HRW report.
Gelet op het vorenstaande zie ik geen reden om naar aanleiding van het HRW-rapport acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Potters over de gevolgen van het hebben van schulden voor zzp’ers

Two VVD MPs asked whether self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts are effectively excluded from debt relief, since minnelijke trajecten are often unavailable and the Wsnp generally requires ending the business. The State Secretary answered that the Bbz scheme is the first route for viable businesses, that continuation under the Wsnp is possible with judicial permission but judges are cautious, and that municipalities decide how debt assistance is organised.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Bbz.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het Bbz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Zeker 28 illegalen op top 600-lijst’

MP Azmani (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports that at least 28 illegal immigrants with criminal records are on Amsterdam's Top 600 list, and how their return is managed, including handover from prison to immigration detention and supervision measures. The State Secretary answered that a special case-consultation with DT&V, police, OM and others is in place, that a new VRIS protocol took effect in January 2014, and that supervision measures such as reporting duties and sureties are used case by case, without committing to new steps.
Since mid-2013 there has been a special case-consultation for foreigners within Amsterdam's Top600.
Sinds medio 2013 is er een speciaal casusoverleg voor de vreemdelingen binnen de Amsterdamse Top600.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Burg over seksueel misbruik in jeugdzorginstellingen

An MP asked the state secretaries about sexual abuse in youth care institutions, including incident reporting figures, whether gender-separated housing exists, the appropriateness of mixed groups for vulnerable youths, the persistence of abuse after the Samson report, and whether inspectorates will be directed to check safety. The government answered with inspectorate figures, admitted lacking data on police reports and gender-separated places, defended individualised care, pointed to ongoing research and a Rouvoet quality framework, and said the Inspectorate is already conducting targeted supervision.
The IJZ supervision is aligned with the actions from the Rouvoet committee's quality framework for preventing sexual abuse.
Het toezicht van de IJZ sluit aan bij de acties uit het Kwaliteitskader voorkomen seksueel misbruik van de commissie Rouvoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vorig jaar twintig doden door eergerelateerd geweld’

PVV MPs asked the government about a report of twenty honour-related deaths in 2013, probing the role of Islam, shelter data, whether victims relocate for safety, and deportation or denaturalisation of perpetrators. The minister answered that the figures are being collected and the LEC EGG network continues, that culture rather than religion drives honour codes, that shelter nationality data is not kept, and that denaturalisation for common crimes is not permitted under the Dutch law and the European Nationality Convention.
Nationality and religious background are not recorded by the Federatie Opvang.
Nationaliteit en religieuze achtergrond worden niet bijgehouden door de Federatie Opvang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Voortman en Gesthuizen over de uitzending van Zembla van 30 april jl. en de schriftelijke verklaring van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie aangaande het uitzett

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Zembla broadcast and ministry statement on deporting people to Guinea, including whether Dutch authorities are responsible for checking the validity of travel documents issued by Guinean officials and whether deportations should be halted. The State Secretary answered that Guinea is responsible for the validity of its documents, that no concerns have been raised by the Guinean government, that monitoring deportees is not appropriate, and that the Commission Integraal Toezicht Terugkeer is reviewing the matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on whether certain (replacement) travel documents for return are valid or not.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid uitspraken te doen over of bepaalde (vervangende) reisdocumenten ten behoeve van terugkeer al dan niet rechtsgeldig zouden zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat de heffing op hardware ten behoeve van de thuiskopieervergoeding, die lange tijd alleen gold voor cd’s en dvd’s, ook op digitale audio- en vid

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the Supreme Court ruling that the private-copying levy on hardware should have covered digital audio and video players, exposing the State to millions in back compensation, and whether the implementing decree must be amended. The government declined to estimate damages because a damages procedure is pending, and said the decree will be amended following the Court of Justice ruling and talks on appropriate tariffs.
I therefore refrain from estimating the amount of damages the State must pay to Norma et al.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van het maken van een inschatting van de hoogte van de schadevergoeding die de Staat aan Norma c.s. moet betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskamp over het bericht dat torrentsites een omzet halen van 165 miljoen euro

The CDA MP Oskamp asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report that torrent sites earn 165 million euro, including whether Dutch torrent sites pay copyright fees and taxes, the financial damage to the sector, and whether advertisers on illegal sites can be addressed. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of the report, estimated about 70 Dutch torrent sites per year, stated that damage estimates vary and that rights holders must establish them, and described Brein's outreach to advertisers.
In the first instance it is up to the rightsholder to establish the extent of the damage.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de rechthebbende om de omvang van de schade vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de permanente detentie van migranten in Griekenland

MP Maij asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of indefinite detention of migrants in Greece, including an advisory opinion on detention beyond 18 months and the Return Directive. The government replied that it is not aware of a Greek decision, that the Commission is monitoring compliance and will question Greece, and that the Netherlands will show restraint given the Commission's role.
However, I am not aware of any decision-making by Greece.
Ik ben echter niet bekend met besluitvorming door Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Large increase to almost 435000 asylum applicants registered in the EU28 in 2013’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Eurostat report on a sharp rise in asylum applications in the EU in 2013, the reasons for the rise in Somali applicants, whether family reunification rules for Somalis differ, and whether intake of Somalis could be restricted given social problems. The State Secretary attributed the Somali increase largely to family reunification, said there is no specific Somali reunification policy, and argued that EU law leaves no room to restrict intake, while explaining Dutch recognition rates as partly a product of procedure and nationality mix.
Without commenting on the possible extent of social problems with Somalis, I therefore see no possibilities to limit the inflow of Somalis.
Zonder een uitspraak te doen over de eventuele omvang van maatschappelijke problemen met Somaliërs, zie ik dan ook geen mogelijkheden om de instroom van Somaliërs te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over het bericht dat voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel bij terugkeer in Guinee geen enkele opvang beschikbaar is

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about reports that Guinean trafficking victims returning from the Netherlands would find no shelter, and whether deportations should be suspended. State Secretary Teeven replied that the trafficking residence scheme and asylum rules offer adequate safeguards, that a general Guinea country report will address FGM and vulnerable women and minors, and that deportation will not be suspended since minors are not returned without adequate reception.
Yes, I am willing to examine the possibilities.
Ja, ik ben bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke Zwitserse jeugdcrimineel die in Nederland in een luxueus hotel is geplaatst

An MP asked whether a Swiss juvenile offender was relocated to a luxury Dutch hotel for training and whether he should be sent back. The Secretary of State answered that it was temporary supervised housing within a resocialisation plan, that Switzerland did not notify the Dutch authorities, and that he had already left the Netherlands, with no public cost.
This concerned temporary housing within the framework of his resocialisation trajectory and therefore not a transfer.
Dit betrof tijdelijke huisvesting in het kader van zijn resocialisatietraject en dus geen overplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de transparantie bij onderhandelingen over een Memorandum of Understanding met Somalië

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the status of negotiations on supplementary working arrangements to a 2010 Memorandum of Understanding with Somalia, and whether the Chamber would be informed and given the MoU's content. The State Secretary said no response has been received, the timing is unknown, and the MoU cannot be published without Somali consent, though agreements may be shared confidentially; no forced return flights are currently booked.
If Somalia agrees to publication of the working arrangements, I will send them to your Chamber.
Indien Somalië instemt met openbaarmaking van de werkafspraken, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen vann de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de voorwaarden voor het laten overkomen van gezinnen naar Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the criteria for exempting nationalities from the provisional residence permit requirement, and about the availability and telephone-based administration of the Dutch language test abroad. The government answered that exemptions rest on old agreements (South Korea added for economic reasons in 2007), that the test is available at more locations than claimed, that it will not be offered at all posts, and that candidates get a free retake if the phone connection fails.
With the exception of South Korea, this exemption is based on agreements or treaties concluded with these countries in the (distant) past.
Met uitzondering van Zuid-Korea is deze vrijstelling gebaseerd op afspraken of overeenkomsten die in het (verre) verleden met deze landen zijn gemaakt of afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Schouw en Voortman over schade die kinderen oplopen tijdens het verblijf in asielzoekerscentra

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether children suffer developmental harm while living in asylum reception centres, citing a court ruling, and asked about oversight, relocation of children and the state's duty under the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary rejected the claim that children face harm merely from reception centre stay, pointed to existing oversight by the COA Supervisory Board and inspectorates, and committed to no new independent oversight body or relocation study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Recourt over meer vechtscheidingen door het verplichte ouderschapsplan

MPs Ypma and Recourt asked whether the mandatory parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces and what support children in such divorces receive. The government says no study shows the parenting plan causes more conflict, describes existing child support and planned early-signalling pilots, and points to parents' and their networks' responsibility.
I am not aware of any research on the basis of which it can be concluded that the parenting plan causes more high-conflict divorces.
Mij is geen onderzoek bekend op basis waarvan de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het ouderschapsplan voor meer vechtscheidingen zorgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Keijzer over het ouderschapsplan

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked the government about reports that children in high-conflict divorces are in a difficult position, the effectiveness of the parenting plan, and whether relationship counselling is covered by basic insurance. The government answered that it has sent an implementation plan to parliament, that a WODC evaluation is preliminary, that basic insurance does not cover relationship problems without a psychiatric diagnosis, and that municipalities may buy such help from 2015.
To this end, we sent an implementation plan to your House by letter of 31 March 2014.
Daartoe hebben wij bij brief van 31 maart 2014 een uitvoeringsplan naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht “ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag”

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked the government about reports that ING wanted to commercialise customers' payment data, and whether this is lawful under the Dutch data protection act and the sector code. The State Secretary answered that such use for third-party marketing is not explicitly covered by the code, that consent must be free, specific and informed, and that the Cbp and supervisors are critical, while leaving the question of ING's plans to ING and the supervisors.
A careless approach and poor communication could damage consumer trust in the banking sector.
Een onzorgvuldige aanpak en slechte communicatie kan het vertrouwen van de consument in de bancaire sector schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Oosten over het bericht "ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customers' payment behaviour and whether it fits privacy rules and the Dutch banks' data code. The minister answered that consent and purpose-limitation rules apply, that the plan's scope is unclear and banks must demonstrate compliance, and that the privacy regulator may investigate but no ruling was given.
It is not for me, nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice, to rule on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Raak over het bericht dat staatsraden nevenfuncties hebben bij loterijen

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked whether two Council of State councillors holding side positions at lottery organisations, and councillors with close ties to lottery bodies in the advising section, create a conflict of interest and undermine the Council's advisory authority. Minister Plasterk answered that the side positions are public, no councillors with lottery ties sit in the section handling the online gambling bill, and that appointments are vetted under the Council of State Act and recusal rules.
In the section of the Advisory Division currently handling the bill amending the Betting and Gaming Act, there are no councillors with side positions at lottery organisations.

In de sectie van de Afdeling advisering die momenteel het voorstel van wet tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen ... in behandeling heeft, zitten geen staatsraden met nevenfuncties in loterijorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jongeren nog steeds geen passende zorg krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about reports that young adults with autism and severe behavioural problems, such as Jabko, still lack suitable care after turning 18, and why a year later no good follow-up places exist. The state secretary expressed understanding, said providers bear responsibility for suitable care, is consulting providers and the CCE on tailored care and its financing, and says the number of such cases is about 40 per year, with no concrete new preventive measures beyond the planned municipal role in youth care.
The CCE has indicated that it sees nationally around 40 (very) hard-to-place young people and (young) adults with autism spectrum disorder and severe behavioural problems each year.
Het CCE heeft aangegeven landelijk jaarlijks circa 40 (zeer) moeilijk plaatsbare jongeren en (jong)volwassenen met een autisme spectrum stoornis en ernstig probleemgedrag te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een slachtoffer dat niet wist van het verlof van haar verkrachter

An MP asks why a rape victim was not informed about her offender's leave, and whether registration at the Informatiepunt Detentieverloop should extend to offenders who were not held in pre-trial detention in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answers that the OM followed its policy, which requires prior pre-trial detention for registration, acknowledges the consequences, and promises a revised policy by summer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over mogelijke contacten van Kamerleden met de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over individuele gevallen binnen het vreemdelingenbeleid

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the State Secretary and officials hold informal contacts with individual MPs about individual immigration cases outside formal debates, how often this happens, and whether it is open to scrutiny. Teeven answered that such factual briefings have existed for years, are available to all MPs equally to verify facts, cannot themselves lead to intervention, and that no overview of frequency or outcomes is kept.
There is no overview on the basis of which it can be stated how often these contacts take place.
Er bestaat geen overzicht op basis waarvan kan worden aangegeven hoe vaak genoemde contacten plaats hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de forse stijging van Syrische asielzoekers in Nederland

An MP from the PVV asks the Secretary of State for Security and Justice why Syrian asylum arrivals rose sharply in early 2014, whether his earlier pledge to admit nearly all Syrians played a role, why regional protection is not used more, and what will ensure rejected Syrians leave. The Secretary answers that the rise reflects the situation in Syria, refers to earlier letters on regional reception, and states that most Syrians receive asylum with Dublin transfers as the main exception and no deportations to Syria.
It is not likely that Syrian asylum seekers flee their country because of Dutch asylum policy or my statements about it.
Het is niet waarschijnlijk dat Syrische asielzoekers hun land ontvluchten vanwege het Nederlandse asielbeleid of mijn uitspraken daarover.
Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung (ingezonden 21 januari 2014).

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Samsung smart TVs may track viewing behaviour under accepted terms, whether consumers are clearly informed and whether Samsung acts unlawfully, after a Dutch DPA ruling against smart TV data collection. The state secretary's follow-up answer says Samsung removed a packaging warning from mid-2013, and that Samsung now informs the public about data-dependent functions via ads and websites, without addressing whether the practice is lawful.
Samsung has informed me that it now informs the public about the functions of the receiver, including the feature that some functions require personal data to be processed.

Samsung heeft mij meegedeeld dat zij het publiek nu informeert over de functies van de ontvanger, met inbegrip van de eigenschap dat voor de benutting van enkele functies persoonsgegevens moeten worden verwerkt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules. The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.

I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat Utrechtse raamexploitanten niet ingrepen ondanks berichten over mensenhandel

An MP asked whether Utrecht brothel operators ignored signs of human trafficking, how many victims were suspected, whether closing the windows reduced trafficking and whether trafficking displaced to other municipalities, and what role the Justice department played. The minister replied that licences were withdrawn on the basis of police reports showing trafficking indications, poor supervision and disturbance of public order, that the municipality believes closure reduced trafficking, that some sex workers reportedly moved to other municipalities though figures are unknown, and that several suspects were prosecuted in an integrated approach.
The precise number of possible victims is not known.
Het precieze aantal van mogelijke slachtoffers is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat uitbreken in de bajes kinderspel is

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether it is acceptable that prisoners can escape from their cells with a simple screwdriver, and whether he will take immediate measures. The State Secretary acknowledged the incident, said an investigation is ongoing, noted that the cell had double escape protection, and said the bolts securing the bars are being replaced, though he sees no need for further measures.
An investigation into how the incident was able to occur is currently under way.
Momenteel loopt een onderzoek naar de wijze waarop het incident zich heeft kunnen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het nieuwe regime in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of unrest and criticism of the new prison promotion-and-demotion regime, including whether its introduction ahead of the pending penitentiary law amendment was justified, its treatment of life-sentence prisoners, its compatibility with European rules on restricting freedoms, and whether it is a cost-cutting measure. The State Secretary answered that no security incidents are known, that the regime is carefully monitored, that it does not depend on the pending legislation, that about two-thirds of prisoners qualify for the plus programme, and that the regime is not in itself a cost measure though the basic programme saves costs.
I have therefore asked the director-general of DJI to monitor the implementation carefully and adjust where necessary.
Ik heb de hoofddirecteur van DJI dan ook verzocht de implementatie zorgvuldig te monitoren en bij te sturen waar dit noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een zware crimineel die vrijkomt door een tikfout

An MP asked why a serious criminal was released early due to a clerical error by the Utrecht court (6 years entered as 6 months), why prison staff and a second check did not catch it, and what will prevent recurrence. The government acknowledged the administrative error, said the court tightened its work processes and the issue will be discussed nationally, and stated that an extra prison-level check would add no value and that the suspect is being actively sought.
The court has in the meantime tightened its own work processes in this area, after consulting with the Public Prosecution Service about it.
De rechtbank heeft ondertussen de eigen werkprocessen op dit gebied aangescherpt, na hierover met het OM contact te hebben gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Gangster vrij na tikfout’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how a convicted gangster was wrongly released after a clerical error recorded six months instead of six years, why no one caught it, and what is being done. The minister answered that the error passed two-person checks, was discovered via a journalist, that the rechtbank has tightened procedures, and that the suspect is being actively sought.
I therefore consider it of great importance that, following this incident, the judiciary takes and will take steps to tighten its working methods to prevent recurrence.
Ik acht het dan ook van groot belang dat naar aanleiding van dit incident door de rechtspraak stappen zijn en worden ondernomen om de werkwijze aan te scherpen om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de moordenaar van Melanie Sijbers wapens maakte tijdens zijn vluchtpoging en het bericht “Foutenfestival rond Peter H. onderzocht”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether reports that the murderer of Melanie Sijbers made weapons during an escape attempt and that a 'festival of errors' surrounded his placement were accurate, and how such tools and placements would be prevented in future. The State Secretary denied the weapons claim, said tools are kept locked away, stated that the placement procedure was correctly followed, and announced a review and a change to the procedure for placing extreme-profile detainees.
An extensive security investigation is currently under way into the fact that Peter H. was nevertheless able to leave his cell.
Naar het feit dat Peter H. wel zijn cel heeft weten te verlaten vindt momenteel een uitgebreid veiligheidsonderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over het bericht dat een ernstig zieke vader is uitgezet naar Guinee

Four MPs (SP, ChristenUnie, D66, GroenLinks) asked State Secretary Teeven why a seriously ill Guinean father was deported despite pending Article 8 ECHR proceedings, medical concerns, questions about travel documents, and Utrecht's offer of care. The State Secretary defended the deportation as the outcome of careful individual assessments, said medication was confirmed available in Guinea, and declined to discuss the individual case beyond what was necessary.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to enter into individual cases in public debate.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht in het publieke debat in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de ophef die is ontstaan sinds het nieuws dat de veroordeelde pedoseksueel Benno L. in Leiden huisvesting heeft gekregen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior and Justice about public outcry over housing a convicted sex offender in Leiden, including whether mayors and councils should be informed and whether citizens should have more say. The minister acknowledged residents' concerns, said mayors decide case by case with partners and need not inform the council beforehand, and announced a joint VNG/OM/reclassering meeting in March 2014 without committing to new structural powers.
Based on the risk analysis, the mayor will decide how and with whom to communicate in order to safeguard the neighbourhood's safety, the victim and the returning sex offender.

Op basis van de risicoanalyse zal de burgemeester beslissen op welke manier en met wie gecommuniceerd dient te worden om de veiligheid van de wijk, het slachtoffer en de terugkerende zedendelinquent te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht dat een gevangene is beschoten met een spijkerpistool

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a reported shooting of a prisoner with a nail gun at the Alphen aan den Rijn detention facility, the status of the investigation, occupancy, and whether security was under pressure after G4S guards left. The State Secretary answered that a police investigation is ongoing so the circumstances cannot yet be disclosed, occupancy was above 95%, the security concerns are not shared, and that the department monitors security and incidents internally.
The police investigation is ongoing. As long as the police investigation has not been concluded, no conclusive statement can yet be given about the circumstances of the incident.
Het politieonderzoek is gaande. Over de toedracht van het incident kan, zolang het politieonderzoek nog niet is afgerond, vooralsnog geen uitsluitsel worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug over het afwijzen van een geboorteakte van het geadopteerde kind van een homostel
