MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked about a Florida birth certificate for an adopted child of a same-sex couple that omitted the biological mother, which the civil registry office Landelijke Taken did not register. State Secretary Teeven answered that there is no flaw in the law since the mother is the legal parent, that no formal application or refusal was made so no court appeal arose, and that the registry checks for conflict with Dutch public order.
In my view there is no flaw in the law.
Er is in mijn optiek geen sprake van een weeffout in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “NPO vanaf dinsdag ‘uitgekleed’ in Belgische tijdschriften”

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a reported sharp rise in the fees Belgian magazines must pay the NPO for Dutch broadcast programme data, and whether this matches the intent of the Mediawet. The government answered that the statutory tariffs were never meant to apply to foreign users, that this will be clarified in the next amendment to the Mediawet, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media will report before the summer recess.
Because this currently does not sufficiently appear from the Mediawet 2008, this will be corrected in the next bill amending the Mediawet 2008.
Omdat dit momenteel onvoldoende uit de Mediawet 2008 blijkt, zal dit worden hersteld in het eerstvolgende wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Mediawet 2008.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de zorg voor kinderen in gevaar is

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretaries whether the transfer of youth care to municipalities threatens continuity of care for children, citing gaps in contracts, budgets, frictional costs and regional cooperation ahead of 2015. The government replied only by referring to its letter on preparing the Youth Act (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351), without answering the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Kooiman (SP), question number 2014Z04148, have been answered by means of the letter on 'preparing the introduction of the Youth Act on 1 January 2015' (Kamerstuk 31 839, no. 351).
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP), vraagnummer 2014Z04148 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief over «voorbereiding invoering Jeugdwet op 1 januari 2015» (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het stopzetten van de procedure naar het opsporen van doodsoorzaken van minderjarigen per 1 januari 2014

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about ending the NODO procedure for investigating causes of death of minors from 1 January 2014, including parents' rights, the loss of knowledge infrastructure and whether the procedure was effective against child abuse. The government replied that legal duties for doctors and coroners remain unchanged, the sector will handle unexplained child deaths through joint working arrangements, and that talks with the field will start on 17 March with parliament to be informed of the outcome.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over problemen in het gevangenisziekenhuis

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about a new death and continuing complaints at the prison hospital (JCvSZ), including harsh regime and isolation, and whether earlier claims that problems were resolved still hold. The State Secretary answers that the police investigation is closed with no need for further inquiry, a calamity commission is investigating, the Inspectorate has ended intensive supervision and judges care to be in order, and he will send the inspectorate's final report but does not commit to a new investigation of the complaints.
The police investigation into the death of the detainee in question has recently been concluded.
Het politieonderzoek naar het overlijden van de betreffende gedetineerde is recent afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het loonbeslag bij het vaststellen van het recht op gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asks why wage garnishment is ignored when assessing entitlement to state-funded legal aid, even though it can push income below the threshold, and whether creditors' garnishment or bailiffs' conduct should affect the outcome. The State Secretary defends the current income test, saying actual spending is not decisive, that garnishment does not fit the system, and that debt-relief and insolvency safety nets exist.

The Royal Professional Organisation of Bailiffs will examine whether bailiffs' working methods in this context can be further improved and will present an advisory report with recommendations on simplifying the calculation of the protected minimum income in mid-2014.

De Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders zal bezien of de werkwijze van gerechtsdeurwaarders in dit kader verder verbeterd kan worden en zal medio 2014 een preadvies met aanbevelingen over vereenvoudiging van de berekening van de beslagvrije voet presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het eerder sluiten van penitentiaire inrichtingen

An SP MP asked whether several prisons, including De Kruisberg, Haarlem and Wolvenplein, would close earlier than planned in the Masterplan DJI, and about staff impact and funding for reintegration. The Secretary of State answered that no facilities close earlier than the Masterplan dates, that vacancies are concentrated in several locations, and that staff are being supported through the Van Werk Naar Werk scheme with a reserved budget.
This means that no departments or institutions will be closed earlier than planned in the Masterplan DJI.
Dit betekent dat er geen afdelingen of inrichtingen eerder dan in het Masterplan DJI gepland worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat honderden mensen Mogadishu ontvluchten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether reports of Al-Shabaab attacks and people fleeing Mogadishu would change asylum, foreign-nationals and return policy for Somalia, and whether forced returns of rejected asylum seekers should stop. The State Secretary said the situation is worrying, that targeted violence has become more concentrated, that certain groups were designated as at-risk and the admission policy adapted, but saw no reason to change policy on arbitrary violence and promised a new country report in autumn.
Regarding the reports of recent arbitrary violence in Mogadishu, I see no reason for now to change my policy.
Voor wat betreft de berichtgeving over recent willekeurig geweld in Mogadishu zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om mijn beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Situatie in de Vluchtgarage dreigt uit de hand te lopen’

MP Azmani asks why a squat housing rejected asylum seekers in Amsterdam's Vluchtgarage is tolerated, why it is not cleared, and why violent incidents led to no detention. The state secretary replies that the squat is not a municipal shelter, that Amsterdam's policy avoids clearing vacant buildings, that police act where needed, and that the return service is available to talk to residents.
I am and remain of course in discussion with the mayor of Amsterdam about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ben en blijf uiteraard in gesprek met de burgemeester van Amsterdam over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over topinkomens bij goede doelen loterijen

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked about top incomes at lottery operators for good causes, whether lottery revenue flows to founders, whether licensing imposes pay conditions, and the enforcement against an unlicensed British lottery and illegal operators. The Secretary of State answered that the statutory 50% pay-out to good causes is met, that the regulator sets no pay conditions yet, that the British site could not be verified, and that persistent illegal operators will be excluded from licences.
The gambling authority has informed me that, when granting licences, it currently sets no requirements regarding the remuneration policy of lotteries that finance good causes.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten bij het verlenen van vergunningen momenteel geen eisen te stellen ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid van loterijen die goede doelen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over de aanscherping van het toevoegbeleid bij gijzeling als dwangmiddel

MPs De Wit and Kooiman asked why legal aid (toevoeging) for imprisonment as a coercive measure (gijzeling) was tightened at a time of rising complaints about CJIB enforcement, and whether this would be reversed. The State Secretary defended the policy change as aligned with existing practice, promised to refine aid criteria with attention to hardship cases, and announced a letter on a more targeted approach for people who cannot pay, with further plans due in Q2 2014.
In view of the foregoing, there is no reason to reverse the policy set out above.
In het licht van het vorenstaande is geen aanleiding om het hiervoor uiteengezette beleid terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Klever over medische zorg voor vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked how many asylum seekers use medical care during their procedure, what it costs, whether they pay co-payments, and how many rejected applicants receive care. The government answered that care is provided under the Rva and RZA, costs were 72 million euro in 2012, asylum seekers pay no co-payments or deductibles, and it cannot track several requested figures due to medical confidentiality and lack of registration.
Which medical care an asylum seeker has received falls under medical professional confidentiality and is therefore not visible to the non-medical staff of the immigration chain.
Welke medische zorg een asielzoeker heeft ontvangen valt onder het medische beroepsgeheim en is daarom niet inzichtelijk voor het niet-medische personeel van de vreemdelingenketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het wederom afwijzen door de rechter van een door de burgemeester van Veenendaal opgelegd gebiedsverbod aan een delinquent

An MP asked the state secretary about a court ruling that again annulled a area ban imposed by the Veenendaal mayor on an offender, and whether burgomasters should have stronger powers or advisory roles in reintegration decisions. The state secretary answered that the ruling does not change his view, that mayors can act where concrete public order disturbance is shown, and that he sees no reason to strengthen mayoral powers.
No. The aforementioned rulings give me no reason to strengthen the powers mayors have to maintain public order.
Nee. Bovengenoemde uitspraken geven mij geen aanleiding de mogelijkheden die burgemeesters hebben om de openbare orde te handhaven, te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht 'Amsterdam: 1,7 miljoen euro extra voor illegalen' en de brief van burgemeester Van der Laan van 30 januari jl.

The VVD MP Azmani asked whether the proposed structural 1.7 million euro for shelter for undocumented migrants in Amsterdam conflicts with the 2007 bestuursakkoord and whether the minister will act against municipalities offering structural shelter. Minister Teeven answered that the 2007 agreement still stands, that the Amsterdam plan is compatible with it as crisis shelter, and that the government will engage with municipalities that do not respect these limits.
With municipalities that do not respect these principles, I will enter into discussion.
Met gemeenten die deze uitgangspunten niet respecteren, ga ik in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam meer geld, opvang en hulp wil bieden aan  illegalen

The MP Fritsma (PVV) asked whether Amsterdam's plan to offer shelter, a 3,000 euro yearly housing allowance and other help to undocumented migrants breaches the 2007 bestuursakkoord and undermines return policy. The State Secretary replied that the plan was not discussed with the mayor beforehand, that the 2007 agreement still stands, that the shelter is short-term crisis accommodation linked to a return-oriented approach, and that he will evaluate the six-month pilot before judging its value.
After this six-month period the balance will be drawn up and it will be assessed whether this initiative by the municipality of Amsterdam has added value.
Na deze periode van zes maanden zal de balans worden opgemaakt en worden bezien of dit initiatief van de gemeente Amsterdam een meerwaarde heeft gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet verlenen van toestemming aan bandleden van Pussy Riot om een Nederlandse gevangenis te bezoeken

Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why two Pussy Riot band members were denied permission to visit a Dutch prison and whether this was justified. Teeven answered that visits are weighed against order, security and detainee privacy, and that a director-level meeting and a video were arranged instead of a prison visit.
As long as the visit serves no functional purpose and is not initiated by a detainee, these interests prevail over the interest of visits by interested parties.
Zolang het bezoek geen functioneel doel dient of is geïnitieerd door een ingeslotene prevaleren deze belangen boven het belang van bezoek van belangstellenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Nederlandse homostellen niet langer Russische kinderen kunnen adopteren

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Russia's 2014 decree blocking adoptions by same-sex married couples and unmarried persons from countries allowing same-sex marriage affects Dutch applicants, and whether the Netherlands would support them before the European Court of Human Rights. The government answered that Russia-Netherlands adoption cooperation has never existed so effects are limited, and that intervention in ECHR cases would be assessed case by case and only in exceptional situations.
Whether the Netherlands will support any Dutch couples will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
Of Nederland eventuele Nederlandse stellen zal bijstaan zal per zaak worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de tenuitvoerlegging van de levenslange gevangenisstraf

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about life imprisonment in the Netherlands, following a Sint Maarten Constitutional Court ruling, ECtHR case law (Vinter, Murray), gratia practice, resocialisation and victims' positions. The State Secretary answers that the Sint Maarten ruling is not binding and gives no reason to change the gratia system, that the ECtHR case law does not require a statutory conditional release or periodic review in the Netherlands, and that gratia remains the mechanism for reassessing life sentences.
I therefore see no reason in these judgments to include in the Criminal Code a provision allowing conditional release of life-sentenced prisoners.

Ik zie dan ook in deze arresten geen aanleiding om een bepaling in het Wetboek van Strafrecht op te nemen die voorziet in de mogelijkheid tot voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling van levenslanggestraften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Schouw over diens uitspraken tijdens het debat van de Volkskrant over het asielbeleid op zondag 9 februari 2014

MPs Voordewind and Schouw asked State Secretary Teeven to explain his remarks at a Volkskrant debate comparing the child pardon (sour) with criminalising illegal residence (sweet), and whether these remarks fit a humane asylum policy. Teeven said he was describing coalition party positions, did not regret implementing the child pardon, intended no signal to children granted status, and did not mean to depart from humane asylum policy.
I did not want to give a signal.
Ik heb geen signaal willen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het tegengaan van online kansspelen gericht op de Nederlandse markt

An MP asked the State Secretary whether several foreign online gambling websites aimed at the Dutch market comply with the Betting and Gaming Act, whether referral sites are lawful, and how the Gambling Authority sets enforcement priorities and recovers fines from foreign operators. The State Secretary said the Gambling Authority is responsible for enforcement and does not comment on individual cases, that referral may be prohibited, and that new bills would add enforcement powers.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Ksa makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de ksa geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat Britse wedkantoren azen op de Nederlandse onlinegokmarkt

MP Mei Li Vos asked whether the government helped set up the gambling industry body Speel Verantwoord, how the Kansspelautoriteit engages with prospective online licence applicants, and whether illegal Dutch online casinos taken over by firms could escape the exclusion policy. Staatssecretaris Teeven denied government involvement in founding the body, said consultation with stakeholders is normal, and stated that persistent illegal providers will be excluded from licences, while declining to comment on individual enforcement cases and noting that takeovers do not affect the integrity assessment.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the gambling authority does not make statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het gedoogbeleid ten aanzien van online casino’s

MP Mei Li Vos asked the State Secretary about lobbying by a former state secretary, alleged agreements with illegal online gambling operators, and the Gambling Authority's enforcement priorities, which she framed as tolerance policy. The State Secretary denied any agreements or lobbying influence, said the Gambling Authority prioritises enforcement against operators targeting the Dutch market, and reported several fines with more investigations ongoing.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the Gambling Authority does not make announcements about individual cases or operators.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over zijn aanwezigheid bij de doop van een reddingsboot

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether his attendance at the christening of a lifeboat sponsored by Oranje Casino signals legitimacy for an online gambling operator and whether online gambling is still prohibited in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answers that online gambling without a licence remains prohibited under current law, that enforcement belongs to the Kansspelautoriteit, that his attendance signals nothing, and that any future licence would be assessed independently by that authority.
To avoid disrupting ongoing investigations, the gambling authority makes no statements about individual cases or providers.
Om lopende onderzoeken niet te verstoren, doet de kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen over individuele zaken of aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat er asielzoekerscentra (AZC's) worden geopend in voormalige gevangenissen en detentiecentra

MPs Voordewind and Voortman asked whether the COA is seeking to open asylum centres in former prisons and detention centres, how many asylum seekers lack regular reception places, and whether such unsuitable sites will be dropped in favour of alternatives. The State Secretary answered that COA searches broadly for reception sites (not only prisons), that about 1,700 places have been opened or reopened at former sites in Bellingwolde, Geeuwenbrug, Sweikhuizen, Uithuizen and Wassenaar, that every eligible asylum seeker currently has a place, and declined to discuss specific planned locations, citing municipal agreements.
Because of municipal and administrative agreements when acquiring locations, I do not consider it desirable to discuss locations intended for COA reception.
Vanwege gemeentelijke/bestuurlijke afspraken bij het verwerven van locaties vind ik het niet wenselijk om in te gaan op locaties die beoogd zijn voor de opvang door het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over documentaires over detentiecentra

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether he agrees that the public should be able to learn about daily life in Dutch immigration detention centres, and whether a documentary maker could be granted access, as Switzerland and Italy have allowed. The State Secretary agreed, pointed to the recent documentary 'Borders' and said he is in talks with broadcaster HUMAN about a documentary on Detentiecentrum Rotterdam.
Requests for such documentaries will therefore always be carefully considered by me.
Aanvragen voor dergelijke documentaires zal ik dan ook altijd zorgvuldig bekijken.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de stand van zaken rond de noodzakelijke uitzetting van een Iraakse eermoordenaar (ingezonden 5 december 2012).

An MP asks the State Secretary for the status of the removal of an Iraqi man convicted of honour killing, why he runs a law office registered with the Chamber of Commerce, and why parliament was not kept informed despite a prior commitment. The State Secretary answers that the man has returned to Iraq, that an appeal procedure is still pending, and that parliament will be informed of new developments.
Currently an appeal procedure is still open in this case.
Momenteel staat er nog een beroepsprocedure open in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat België meer EU-burgers uitzet

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Belgium expelling more EU citizens, requesting 2013 figures on residence revocations and departures and the reasons and nationalities involved, and asked whether the Netherlands would quadruple expulsions. The State Secretary reported 650 terminations of lawful residence in 2013 (360 for public order, 60 for unreasonable reliance on welfare, others for nuisance or failing conditions), explained differences in Belgian data practices, and said the existing tightened policy would be continued and a welfare pilot extended.
In 2013 the lawful residence of 650 EU citizens was terminated.
In 2013 is van 650 EU-burgers het rechtmatig verblijf beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de problemen waar ongedocumenteerde hiv-patiënten in Nederland tegenaan lopen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how undocumented HIV patients risk losing medication, whether the IND tests real access to care in the country of origin, and how the new 5-euro medicine co-payment affects them. The State Secretary rejects the Aids Fonds conclusions, states that the IND assesses availability (not actual accessibility) through BMA advice, places responsibility for access on the patient and treating doctors, and declines to change the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
I do not share the conclusions of the Aids Fund.
Ik deel de conclusies van het Aids Fonds niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Maij over de gevolgen van het beperken van de rechtsbijstand voor de rechtsbescherming in vreemdelingenzaken

MPs Recourt and Maij asked State Secretary Teeven how the reduced legal aid fees for manifestly unfounded (kennelijke) decisions in immigration cases affect legal protection, and whether he will reverse them. Teeven answered that he will revisit the measure across the legal aid system and will restore the pre-October 2013 fee structure, while providing caseload figures for the Council of State and IND.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1 and 5, I intend to revise the measure under which a lower fee is awarded to legal aid providers in cases ending in a manifestly unfounded ruling.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vragen 1 en 5 heb aangegeven ben ik voornemens om de maatregel waarbij een lagere vergoeding aan de rechtsbijstandverlener wordt toegekend in zaken die met een kennelijke uitspraak eindigen te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat asielaanvragen van homoseksuele asielzoekers zorgvuldiger moeten worden beoordeeld

MP Voortman asked whether the government will act on the Raad van State ruling that gay asylum seekers should not be expected to behave discreetly on return, and whether the government will investigate criminalisation of homosexuality in countries with general country reports. Secretary Teeven answered that asylum policy on discretion will be adjusted and that terms of reference for country reports will be reviewed.
This means that from an asylum seeker whose LHBT status is considered credible, it will not be expected that they behave discreetly in the country of origin when expressing their sexual orientation.

Dit betekent dat van een asielzoeker waarvan geloofwaardig wordt geacht dat hij LHBT is, niet verwacht zal worden dat hij zich in het land van herkomst terughoudend opstelt bij het uiting geven aan zijn seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat medische problemen dreigen voor illegale vreemdelingen

An MP asked the government whether a new €5 co-payment per prescription line for uninsured foreigners would block access to medical care, and why a means test was not used instead. The health minister replied that the rule reflects the principle that uninsured foreigners pay their own care costs, that weekly dispensing is exempt, and that means-testing is impractical.
In view of this, I am of the opinion that an amount of (at least) €5 does not impede access to medically necessary care.
Gelet hierop ben ik van mening dat een bedrag van (minimaal) € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg niet belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de 5 euro die onverzekerbare vreemdelingen moeten betalen voor medicijnen

MPs Maij and Bouwmeester asked why undocumented migrants must pay EUR 5 for medicines, how it was communicated, and what safeguards exist for those unable to pay. Minister Schippers answered that the charge restores the principle that the patient pays, that pharmacies and GPs were informed, that access is not blocked in urgent cases, and that the CVZ will monitor effects in its annual report rather than in a two-month inventory.
I have asked the CVZ to address the five-euro measure in this monitor where possible, and I will include it in the annual VWS Insured Monitor I send to your House.
Ik heb het CVZ gevraagd in deze monitor zo mogelijk in te gaan op de vijf-euromaatregel en zal dit meenemen in de VWS-Verzekerdenmonitor die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer zend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het budget voor transgenderzorg bij lange na niet toereikend is

MP Leijten asked the Health Minister whether the VUmc's funding shortfall for transgender care, reported in the press, would leave about 600 patients untreated and whether insurers could refuse care. The minister said she could not confirm the reported figures, expressed trust that insurers and the VUmc would meet their duty of care, and noted the regulator NZa is examining the matter.
The NZa has indicated that it is already examining this case, is alert to the issue, and will keep me informed of developments.
De NZa heeft laten weten deze casus al te onderzoeken, alert op deze kwestie te zijn en mij geïnformeerd te houden over de ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het VUmc stopt met nieuwe behandelingen van transgenders en patiënten met genderdysforie

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister about VUmc reportedly halting new gender treatments due to lack of funds, and about the right to care, financing, capacity and the 2014 gender-declaration requirement. The minister said insurers and VUmc must resolve financing, pointed to the insurers' duty of care and the NZa's oversight, and said the declaration process is separate from medical treatment.
It is therefore up to insurers to agree with VUmc how much funding is needed for care for transgender people.
Het is dus aan verzekeraars om in overleg met het VUmc af te spreken hoeveel middelen nodig zijn voor de zorg voor transgenders.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Vuijk over het zelden vooraf bekend maken van dronevluchten

Two VVD MPs asked why only 9 percent of drone flights were announced in advance in 2013 compared with 87 percent in 2011, and why flights were announced afterwards rather than beforehand, including how this relates to privacy rules. The minister explained the drop by a 2012 decision removing the separate airspace application for training flights, said civil authorities decide on pre- or post-flight publication, and stated the camera footage does not show identifiable persons.
With a view to the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights in advance.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk om vluchten van te voren aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de intrekking van verblijfsvergunningen vanwege het verplaatsen van het hoofdverblijf voor studie

An MP asked the State Secretary why residence permits of sixteen Angolan and Nigerian youths were revoked after they moved their main residence to Portugal for study, and whether they could be offered an alternative. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, restated the general policy that long stays abroad can lead to revocation, with an exception for circumstances beyond one's control, and did not address the other questions.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases when answering questions from your House.
Zoals u bekend is, ga ik in de beantwoording van vragen van uw Kamer niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het loonbeslag bij het vaststellen van het recht op gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

An MP asked why wage garnishment is not deducted from current income when determining entitlement to state-funded legal aid, and whether this should be reconsidered. The State Secretary defended the fiscal-income approach on administrative grounds, said garnishment challenges belong with the bailiff and Juridisch Loket, and declined to consult the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
I endorse the principle that legal seekers must be able to challenge a wage garnishment if they believe it was wrongly imposed.
Ik onderschrijf het uitgangspunt dat rechtzoekenden een loonbeslag moeten kunnen aanvechten indien dit naar hun mening ten onrechte is gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Dijkhoff, Elias en Litjens over het artikel ‘Onderzoek naar corruptie KLM werd vroegtijdig gestaakt’

MPs from the VVD asked whether a Caribbean corruption investigation into KLM-linked bribery was stopped early after a judge-commissioner imposed a four-month time limit, and why. The minister answered that the time limit was set under the reasonable-time rules, the prosecution prioritised two of eight files, the Oil Trading Bonaire file was dropped, and a later court complaint was only partly upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service on Bonaire has informed me that neither the Oil Trading Bonaire file nor other investigation has shown any free business-class flights.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Bonaire heeft mij bericht dat noch uit het dossier «Oil Trading Bonaire», noch uit overig onderzoek, is gebleken over gratis businessclassvluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het negeren van waarschuwingen over het binnensmokkelen van verboden goederen in een Penitentiaire Inrichting

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why warnings about smuggling of prohibited goods into PI De Schie were ignored, what measures exist to keep such goods out, what risks were taken, and whether the prison management has been consulted. The State Secretary answered that DJI's Bureau Integriteit en Veiligheid launched its own investigation in February, leading to dismissal of two staff, that the media makers' footage yielded no new insights, and that cell inspections and mobile-phone detection are standard practice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over geestelijk verzorgers bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI)

Parliamentarian Marcouch asked the State Secretary about chaplains at the Dutch prison service DJI, including dismissals under the Masterplan, religious backgrounds, the use of temporary staffing, and whether recent graduates are disadvantaged. The State Secretary answered that no dismissals have yet occurred, 32 humanist and 44 Islamic chaplains are candidates for voluntary redeployment pending assessment of surplus staffing, and that flexible temporary staffing and language requirements are justified.
At this moment there is no question of dismissals.
Op dit moment is geen sprake van ontslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over gokbedrijven die vooruitlopend op niet bestaande wetgeving investeren in Nederland

An MP asked whether foreign gambling firms signing contracts with Dutch partners ahead of uncertain online gambling legislation bear entrepreneurial risk, and about Holland Casino buying online casino software. The government answered that firms may prepare for market opening at their own risk, that licence conditions on addiction prevention will apply, and that Holland Casino's procurement is responsible given planned regulation and privatisation.
Gambling operators, including current licence holders, are free to prepare for a possible opening of the Dutch online gambling market.
Het staat kansspelaanbieders, waaronder ook de huidige vergunninghouders, vrij zich voor te bereiden op een eventuele opening van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de veiligheidssituatie in Somalië en de terugkeer van Somalische asielzoekers naar Somalië

Labour MP Maij asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the security situation in Somalia after a deported Somali was injured in a bombing, the latest situation and whether the country report is current, the number of returns, the number of rejected Somali asylum seekers awaiting removal, NGO positions, and policies of neighbouring countries. The State Secretary answered that the government considers the situation concerning but does not classify Mogadishu or other areas under Article 15c; forced returns were briefly resumed but are now paused pending supplementary agreements with the Somali government, and he noted the differing positions of Amnesty, Vluchtelingenwerk and UNHCR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een man 1000 xtc-pillen naar detentiecentrum Zeist heeft meegenomen zonder dat het personeel dat in de gaten had

An MP asked the State Secretary whether staff at detention centre Zeist should have recognised 1,000 ecstasy pills smuggled in by a detainee, and whether the man should be tracked down and deported to serve his sentence abroad. The State Secretary confirmed staff did seize and recognise the pills but failed to report them promptly, led an internal investigation with staff reprimanded, and said the case concerns a remand prisoner whose conviction is not yet final, so enforcement is not yet possible.
It was wrongly neglected to report the discovered contraband immediately.
Ten onrechte is verzuimd dadelijk aangifte te doen van de aangetroffen contrabande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Gesjoemel bij reclassering”

The MP Marcouch asked the State Secretary about press reports of misconduct at the probation service, including community-service offenders making furniture for themselves, and whether independent investigations were adequate and whether criminal investigation was warranted. The State Secretary replied that the internal and external Hoffmann investigations found no proof of the alleged misconduct, that the supervisory board judged the investigation adequate, and that no further criminal inquiry was needed.
Neither on the basis of this investigation, nor on the basis of the follow-up investigation that subsequently took place, could it be established that the reported misconduct had actually occurred.

Noch op basis van dit onderzoek, noch op basis van het vervolgonderzoek dat aansluitend hierop heeft plaatsgevonden, kon worden vastgesteld dat de gemelde misstanden ook daadwerkelijk hadden plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een Nederlandse schrijver na een bezoek aan de gevangenis een geheimhoudingsverklaring moest tekenen en niet over ‘misstanden’ mocht rapporteren

MP Van der Steur asked whether writer Arnon Grunberg was required to sign a confidentiality declaration barring him from reporting 'misstanden' after a prison visit, and whether he will be allowed a stay in a prison in 2015. The Secretary of State replied that the declaration covers only confidential prison and detainee-privacy information, that visitors may report alleged misstanden if confidentiality is protected, and that no action on the policy is planned.
As long as the confidentiality of the data and the privacy of detainees is guaranteed, visitors to penal institutions must be able to report alleged misstanden.
Zolang de vertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens en de privacy van gedetineerden wordt gewaarborgd, moeten bezoekers van penitentiaire inrichtingen melding kunnen maken van vermeende misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over een nieuwe speler op de reclasseringsmarkt: ‘Info-Excellente’

An MP asked whether the new organisation Info-Excellente, which seeks recognition as a reclassering provider, counts as a new player and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The minister answered that it is not yet a recognised reclassering institution, that the three existing organisations remain responsible, and that the request and alternatives to the current system will be examined and reported after summer 2014.

Regarding the precise meaning and nature of this application, I have over the past period been in discussion with Info-Excellente itself, the three existing reclassering organisations and the Public Prosecution Service.

Over de precieze betekenis en het karakter van deze aanvraag ben ik de afgelopen periode in gesprek geweest met Info-Excellente zelf en met bestaande drie reclasseringsorganisaties en het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Bureau Buitenland over foute regimes die Interpol misbruiken

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government about a Bureau Buitenland broadcast alleging that Interpol notices are misused to arrest recognised refugees and human rights activists in Europe, and how Dutch checks on such notices work. Minister Opstelten answered that Interpol itself makes no arrests, that Dutch notices are screened against refugee status and persecution grounds before any extradition, that data on arrests from notices cannot be retrieved from police systems, and that Interpol removes notices that breach its constitution.
It cannot be derived from police systems how many or which arrests have taken place following an Interpol notice.
Uit de systemen van de politie kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel of welke aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden naar aanleiding van een Interpolsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het smokkelen van mobiele telefoons en cocaïne door een gevangenismedewerker in De Schie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary about a prison staff member at De Schie smuggling phones and cocaine, alleging delay after a journalist's report. The government answered that two staff were dismissed after an internal investigation, that the journalist was approached in time, and that cell inspections, phone detection and a market survey on blocking phones are underway.
Pending the investigation, one employee was placed on non-active duty.
Hangende het onderzoek is één medewerker op non-actief gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht “Politie en Justitie tappen te veel af”

MP Recourt asked the minister whether Dutch police and prosecutors tap too often and whether this harms privacy and investigative quality. The minister answered that the tap is a valuable tool subject to strict legal safeguards, that the legal framework is adequate, and that he will report to parliament in a year on restrained use.
During the budget debate in November this year I committed to informing your House in a year about using the tap as an investigative tool as restrainedly as possible.
Tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van november dit jaar heb ik toegezegd 3 uw Kamer over een jaar te berichten over het zo terughoudend mogelijk inzetten van de tap als opsporingsmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een verkrachter met tbs weer de straat op mag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a sex offender under TBS (detention under a hospital order) being released on conditional termination was acceptable, and whether the leave scheme should change. The minister answered that conditional termination is allowed only when the risk is sufficiently reduced, that reclassering supervision and conditions apply, and that the leave scheme needs no change for this case, though a separate revision is planned.
The court extended the TBS order by one year and conditionally ended the state-ordered detention.
De rechtbank heeft de terbeschikkingstelling met een termijn van een jaar verlengd, en de verpleging van overheidswege voorwaardelijk beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de invoering van een pro-deotaks

MP Recourt asked whether all lawyers should be obliged to take legal aid (pro deo) cases or pay a levy, given the Bar's mission to serve everyone seeking justice. Minister Teeven answered that the Bar as a whole fulfils its duty, that 44% of lawyers did legal aid cases in 2012, that legal aid supply and demand are in balance, and that voluntary contributions by non-legal-aid lawyers would be welcome, with no levy planned.
It is primarily for the Dutch Bar Association to determine what practical form the mission statement quoted in question 2 requires in the current era.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten om te bepalen welke praktische invulling de in vraag 2 genoemde zinsnede uit de missie in de huidige tijd behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rondetafelgesprek van het NJCM van 29 november 2013 inzake Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA)

MP Schouw asks the State Secretary about the NJCM roundtable criticism of the Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA), including doctors' independence under IND protocols, perceived partiality as an IND body, anonymous consulting doctors abroad, and treatment of sick asylum seekers after removal. The State Secretary rejects the independence critique, refers to earlier letters, explains the medical emergency rules and DT&V support for three months of treatment, and declines to publish the report on recommendation 4.
No, in the aforementioned letter I explain why not (page 5).
Nee, in voornoemde brief leg ik uit waarom niet (pagina 5).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over DNA-afname bij jongeren

An MP asked whether a Rotterdam court ruling on taking DNA from a 15-year-old in a criminal case was accepted, how often DNA was or was not taken in 2012 and how many juveniles are in the databank, and whether the exceptions had been widened. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said no exceptions were widened and the sample was destroyed, and explained that the government does not yet record the number of refused cases but expects to by March 2014.

At present the number of cases in which it was decided not to take DNA material is not yet recorded, but once the GPS and GPS-DNA systems are linked, expected in March 2014, these figures will become available.

Op dit moment vindt nog geen registratie plaats van het aantal zaken waarin is besloten geen DNA-materiaal af te nemen, maar na koppeling van de systemen GPS en GPS-DNA, die naar verwachting in maart 2014 zal worden gerealiseerd, zullen deze cijfers wel beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports country-by-country tax reporting for multinationals, as proposed by the European Parliament development committee, and whether it will push for mandatory per-country tax disclosure in annual reports. The government replied that it supports transparency initiatives on tax payments but stresses coordination with existing rules, the economic risks of public disclosure, and the need for clear EU proposals with assessed effects.
The Netherlands has consistently indicated that alignment with existing transparency obligations, such as the obligation already included in the capital requirements directive, is important.
Nederland heeft steeds aangegeven dat afstemming met bestaande transparantieverplichtingen, zoals de verplichting die reeds is opgenomen in de richtlijn voor kapitaalvereisten, van belang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over ondertitelen van films als inbreuk op auteursrecht

An MP asked whether fan-made subtitling of films and the sites hosting it infringe copyright, and whether copyright law should be changed to favour such innovation. The State Secretary answered that translating dialogue into subtitles and making them public requires rightsholder consent, that sites facilitating infringement can be liable, and that he favours simplifying licensing and opposes illegal offerings, while committing to send a response to the European Commission consultation.
I am concerned that the legal market for music, films and e-books is being strongly hindered by large-scale, free offerings of illegal files.
Ik ben er beducht voor dat de legale markt voor muziek, films en e-boeken sterk wordt gehinderd door grootschalig en kosteloos aanbod van illegale bestanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat homostellen hun kind niet kunnen erkennen

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether married gay men can be prevented from recognising an unborn child they fathered with an unmarried woman, given differing municipal practice under Article 1:204(1)(e) of the Civil Code. The State Secretary agreed there is no good reason for unequal treatment, explained that a 2013 amendment removes the provision (planned for 1 April 2014), and said municipalities apply the law individually.
From the standpoint of equal treatment, however, there is no good reason to continue giving the man married to a woman other than the mother a different position from a man married to a man.

Er is vanuit het oogpunt van gelijke behandeling evenwel geen goede reden om de met een andere vrouw dan de moeder gehuwde man een andere positie te blijven laten innemen dan de met een man gehuwde man.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over integriteitsonderzoeken onder gevangenispersoneel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about annual dismissals of prison staff for integrity violations, the differences between institutions, the independence of the Bureau Veiligheid & Integriteit, and whistleblower protection in prisons. The State Secretary answered that DJI addresses violations directly under a renewed code of conduct, that the Bureau is an internal body whose investigations meet due care standards, that the national whistleblower scheme is applied, and denied that whistleblowers are transferred or dismissed without the problem being solved.
The investigations meet the set requirements of due care, such as applying the principle of hearing both sides.
De onderzoeken voldoen aan de gestelde eisen van zorgvuldigheid, zoals het toepassen van hoor en wederhoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het verscherpt toezicht van de kansspelautoriteit op Holland Casino

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the Gambling Authority's decision to place Holland Casino under heightened supervision, including its prevention policy and whether its priorities are right given illegal online gambling. The state secretary answered that the rules are set out in law and that it is for the Gambling Authority, not the minister, to judge compliance and set enforcement priorities.
It is not for me to judge the extent to which individual license holders comply with the rules set, nor how the Gambling Authority supervises those rules.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de mate waarin individuele vergunninghouders voldoen aan de gestelde regels, noch over de wijze waarop de kansspelautoriteit op die regels toeziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Armeense man na 14 jaar rechtmatig verblijf alsnog moet terugkeren

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why a long-resident Armenian man was facing return after 14 years, whether his asylum account was properly examined given a different name had been given, and whether removal would breach EU procedural rules and Article 8 ECHR. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, explained revocation and appeal rules in general terms, and said the answers to the MP's questions and the mayor's letter would come before any removal.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over medicijnkosten voor vreemdelingen

SP MPs asked whether the 2014 requirement that undocumented migrants pay EUR 5 per prescription line at pharmacies, and must pay in full where a pharmacy lacks a CVZ contract, undermines access to necessary care and whether hospital access and reimbursement problems will be addressed. The minister defended the EUR 5 charge as a means to reduce non-payment, denied conflict with the law, said hospital access is sufficient and refused to commission further research.
I therefore do not share the view that an amount of EUR 5 hinders access to medically necessary care.
Ik deel dus niet de mening dat een bedrag van € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vos over de inzet van de kansspelautoriteit tegen gokverslaving

An MP asked the State Secretary whether enforcement against illegal foreign online gambling operators and the Gambling Authority's preventive capacity effectively reduce gambling addiction. The State Secretary answered that licensed operators face strict prevention conditions, that the Authority has about 15 FTE on supervision and enforcement, and that a bill on remote gambling is planned to strengthen enforcement powers, including against foreign operators who refuse to pay fines.
In developing the remote gambling bill, I am therefore examining which additional powers could further strengthen the effectiveness of the Authority's enforcement.
Bij de ontwikkeling van het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand bekijk ik dan ook welke aanvullende bevoegdheden de effectiviteit van de handhaving van de ksa verder kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Recourt over malafide incassobureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about allegedly fraudulent debt collection agencies, including over-charging of consumers and a possible fraud case, and whether a legal quality mark is needed. The State Secretary answered that the sector's voluntary membership suffices for now, that a dialogue with the sector and a letter on enforcement of the Wet incassokosten would follow before Christmas, that legal aid is available only where gedupeerden fall under the Wet op de rechtsbijstand, and that no specific government body supervises compliance, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt possibly acting in some cases.
No government body is specifically charged with supervising compliance with this law.
Er is geen overheidsinstantie specifiek met het toezicht op de naleving van deze wet belast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en De Wit over het bericht dat incassobureaus zich nog steeds niet aan de regels houden

MPs Siderius and De Wit asked whether collection agencies still charge excessive collection costs and whether the Wet normering buitengerechtelijke incassokosten should carry a sanction for non-compliance. The State Secretary said it is too early to judge the law's effect, that civil-law remedies exist for consumers, and that he will send a letter on enforcement before the Christmas recess.
As promised during the General Consultation of 3 July 2013 on civil law matters, I will send your House a letter before the Christmas recess on enforcement of the debt collection costs act.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 3 juli 2013 inzake civielrechtelijke onderwerpen zal ik uw Kamer – voor het Kerstreces – een brief sturen over de handhaving van de wet incassokosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de vrijheid voor internetdienstverleners om geaggregeerde informatie over gegevensvorderingen openbaar te maken

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether internet providers may publish aggregated information about government data requests, and why an earlier civil-rights letter went unanswered. The State Secretary admitted the letter was mishandled, said providers need not report request numbers, and urged providers not to publish aggregated data because the Public Prosecution Service considers it harmful to investigations.
While respecting providers' own responsibility, the government can do nothing other than make an urgent appeal to providers not to disclose this kind of information.
Met inachtneming van de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de aanbieders kan de overheid niet anders dan een dringend appèl op de aanbieders doen om dit soort informatie niet te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over cijfers van de ‘span of control’ bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen en de Dienst Vervoer & Ondersteuning in het bijzonder

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about average span of control (number of staff per manager) at the Rijksoverheid, DJI and DV&O, and whether DV&O's 54 managers for 1,100 fte was justified amid budget cuts. The State Secretary answered with per-unit figures (DV&O has 63 managers for 1,055 fte, after a reorganisation added managers) and defended the ratios as efficient given DV&O's nationally deployed tasks.
No, DV&O has a total of 63 managers on a staff of 1,055 fte.
Nee, de DV&O heeft in totaal 63 leidinggevenden op een personeelsbestand van 1.055 fte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de praktijk van draagmoederschap een ethische grens bereikt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Health about reports that surrogacy reaches an ethical limit, including a Dutch surrogate's birth to a child from anonymous Spanish donors and the Child Protection Board's decision to let the child go home with the intended parents. The government answered that Dutch law protects children's right to know their origins, that cross-border surrogacy is undesirable but not fully preventable, and that it will set up a State Commission on surrogacy and multi-parent families and follow Hague Conference work on an international instrument.
I intend to establish such a State Commission in the field of surrogacy and multi-parent families.
ben ik voornemens een dergelijke Staatscommissie in te stellen op het terrein van draagmoederschap en meeroudergezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de wijze waarop Bulgarije omgaat met asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Bulgarian bill to detain asylum seekers on arrival, reports of Bulgaria sharing data on Syrian asylum seekers with the Syrian embassy, and whether Dublin transfers to Bulgaria are safe. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria's parliament must judge the bill, that the Commission is responsible for checking EU directive implementation, that the Bulgarian ministry said the data concerned voluntary returnees, and that the situation is being monitored.
It is for the Bulgarian parliament to assess these bills and to approve or amend them through national processes.
Het is aan het Bulgaarse parlement om deze wetsvoorstellen te beoordelen en goed te keuren of te amenderen volgens de nationale processen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de gevolgen van het legaliseren van de online kansspelen

An MP asked whether legalising online gambling would substantially reduce payouts to good-cause lotteries and how good causes could benefit from online regulation. The minister rejected the fear of substitution, citing research and growth figures, but admitted no guarantee exists, and said the bill allows mandatory contributions while primary aims remain player protection.
The purpose of regulating gambling is to protect players against the risks of addiction, deception and crime.
Het doel van de regulering van kansspelen is om spelers te beschermen tegen de risico's op verslaving, misleiding en criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de mogelijkheid voor getraumatiseerde asielzoekers om in de verkorte asielprocedure hun asielrelaas volledig naar voren te brengen

An MP asked whether traumatised asylum seekers can fully present their claims in the accelerated asylum procedure, and what safeguards exist, given that later-raised traumatic experiences matter for repeat claims. The State Secretary said the reported signals cannot establish a problem's extent, pointed to MediFirst medical advice, correction rights, the expanded ex nunc review in appeal, and an evaluation due around summer 2014.
Naturally, the House will be informed about this.
Vanzelfsprekend wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Azmani en Van der Linde over signalen dat Sint Maarten zich bij het verlenen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit niet houdt aan de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs Bosman, Azmani and Van der Linde asked whether signals exist that Sint Maarten grants Dutch nationality in breach of the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap, and whether the Sint Maarten Justice Minister wants to ease passport grants for immigrants, along with related questions. The state secretary answered that such signals are unknown, that the Sint Maarten minister disavowed the newspaper report and said only the Kingdom government may grant nationality, and that the rules should remain uniform across the Kingdom.
Signals as referred to in the first question are not known to us.
Signalen als bedoeld in de eerste vraag zijn ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitzetting van een Eritreese vrouw

Labour MP Gesthuizen asked the state secretary whether an Eritrean woman facing expulsion could be prevented from being passed between authorities and whether she should receive a residence permit on discretionary grounds. The state secretary declined to address the individual case, saying it is not appropriate to request discretionary permit grants through parliamentary questions.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal adviesbureaus inhuren voor hulp bij decentralisaties

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked whether it is desirable that municipalities spend large sums on consultancy firms to prepare for the decentralisations and whether this should be stopped. The state secretary answered that municipalities bear their own responsibility and may hire commercial advisers, noted a non-commercial national transition bureau, and declined to commission a study of how much has been spent.

Given the municipalities' own responsibility for the decentralisation and my answers to the previous questions, I do not consider a study into the hiring of consultancy firms by municipalities necessary.
Gegeven de gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid bij de decentralisatie en mijn antwoorden op de vorige vragen acht ik een onderzoek naar de inhuur van adviesbureaus door gemeenten niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de “immediate measure” die het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten ten aanzien van Nederland heeft getroffen over het bieden van basale bestaansvoorzieningen aan burgers zonder r

The MP Maij asked the State Secretary about the European Committee of Social Rights' immediate measure on basic subsistence for migrants without lawful residence, and whether the Raad van State should be consulted on its legal effect. Teeven answered that the Raad van State's advisory division had been asked for advice, that the Charter's personal scope excludes unlawfully resident migrants, and compared other states' arrangements, while not stating a concrete change to Dutch policy.

Following your question, I have asked the Council of State's advisory division for advice on the scope of the immediate measure, its degree of legal binding, and its consequences for review by national courts.

In navolging van uw vraag heb ik de afdeling advisering van de Raad van State om voorlichting gevraagd over de reikwijdte van de «immediate measure», de mate van juridische binding en de gevolgen voor de toetsing door nationale rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de opvang van 600 asielzoekers in vakantiepark Duinrell

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why 600 asylum seekers were being housed in holiday park Duinrell, questioning the choice given Syrian refugees and the regional-aid policy. The State Secretary confirmed temporary housing there until end March 2014 due to rising asylum inflow, said the COA is seeking other sites, and defended regional refugee support and the efficiency of the asylum procedure.
It is correct that asylum seekers are being housed in cottages in Duinrell, where the first asylum seekers arrived from 15 November.
Het is correct dat er asielzoekers worden opgevangen in huisjes in Duinrell waar vanaf 15 november de eerste asielzoekers zijn ingestroomd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei li Vos over het bericht dat SBS een “gokzender” wil beginnen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether plans for a TV gambling channel and online gambling licences conflict with preventing gambling addiction, and whether licences should be limited or TV advertising banned. The State Secretary answered that TV gambling is not ruled out in principle, depends on the design, that current TV advertising rules apply, and that the number of licences will not be capped in advance.
The bill on remote gambling in principle leaves room for offering games of chance via television.
Het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand geeft in beginsel ruimte voor de mogelijkheid kansspelen aan te bieden via televisie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het vertonen van kansspelen op televisie door SBS

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that broadcaster SBS plans a gambling channel, whether this is desirable, and about the risks of addiction and youth access. The state secretary said television gambling is not yet permitted, that a future regulation will set conditions based on risks, that current advertising rules apply, and that he has not met SBS because the Kansspelautoriteit handles licensing and oversight.
The law currently offers no possibility to allow participation in gambling via television.
De wet biedt op dit moment geen mogelijkheid voor het gelegenheid geven tot deelname aan kansspelen via televisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over overdrachten van vreemdelingen op grond van de Dublin-verordening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criteria for applying the humanitarian clause of the Dublin Regulation, including for elderly or dependent family members, and about detention of vulnerable migrants who are not cooperating with return. The State Secretary replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the Dublin humanitarian clause and relevant CJEU case law, and said detention is a last resort with attention to vulnerable persons.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over een psychisch zieke vreemdeling die is geïsoleerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a mentally ill Guinean asylum-seeker held for six months and repeatedly isolated with no prospect of return, and about who bears responsibility for care after release. The State Secretary answered that detention is subject to judicial review, that isolation is used sparingly and reviewed, that medical care is guaranteed even for unlawfully resident persons, and promised a new detention bill in spring 2014.
There must then be a real risk of absconding and actual prospect of removal. This is reviewed by the judge.
Er dient dan een reëel risico op onttrekking en daadwerkelijk zicht op uitzetting te zijn. Dit wordt getoetst door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Leijten over het financieel misbruik van ouderen

MPs De Wit and Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about financial abuse of elderly people, including whether notaries can report such abuse given their professional secrecy and whether it should be narrowed. The government answered that it had noted the broadcast and referred to earlier answers on notaries' duty of confidentiality and the KNB's step-by-step plan.
I refer to my answer to questions 2 and 3 from members Van Oosten and Van Veen.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen over een uitzending waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan het beoordelen van de wilsbekwaamheid door een notaris bij dementie

MPs Van Oosten and Van Veen asked about a broadcast on notaries assessing testamentary capacity in dementia cases, and whether notaries should be released from absolute professional secrecy to report suspected abuse. The government answered that notaries already have a duty to investigate such suspicions under professional rules and case law, can use a KNB reporting protocol, and that pilots on preventing financial exploitation of the elderly run until end 2014.
It is the notary's natural task to provide legal protection to his clients regarding the content and legal consequences of an intended legal act.
Het is de natuurlijke taak van de notaris om aan zijn cliënten rechtsbescherming te bieden ten aanzien van de inhoud en de rechtsgevolgen van een voorgenomen rechtshandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over notarissen die uitbuiting van hun cliënten moeten melden

MP Recourt asked whether notaries should be obliged to report exploitation or financial abuse of clients despite professional secrecy, and about disciplinary action and anonymous reporting. The government answered that notaries must refuse services in cases of suspected illegality and have reporting duties under the WWFT, that a voluntary meldcode and pilots are being used, and that anonymous reporting is not permitted.
I consider it important that notaries practise their profession in accordance with their professional code and legal obligations.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat notarissen conform hun beroepscode en wettelijke verplichtingen hun beroep uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over bezuinigingen op grensbewaking

MP Oskam asks whether cuts to the PARDEX border management system undermine the need for better insight into travel movements of persons posing a threat, given the raised threat level, and what budgets and alternative financing exist. The Minister acknowledges insufficient insight into jihadist travel, states a reduced PARDEX scope is retained, and promises a letter by end November on national use of travel data financed through EU funds.
At the end of November I will send the House a letter with the planned measures on travel data.
Eind november stuur ik de Kamer een brief met de voorgenomen plannen rond reisgegevens.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de Staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het validatiestelsel voor ANBI's en het aflopende convenant «ruimte voor geven» (inge

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Security and Justice about the delayed validation system for charities (ANBI) and the expiring 'Ruimte voor geven' covenant, including who is responsible for the system, the evaluation of covenant commitments, the SBF's representativeness, and the status of the governance and pay code. The government answered that the SBF develops the validation system with the ministries jointly responsible, that the covenant was evaluated in September 2013 with mixed results, that a new covenant is under negotiation, and that it is awaiting the De Jong committee's advice before informing parliament further.
The validation system for philanthropy will be adopted jointly by the covenant parties.
Het validatiestelsel filantropie wordt gezamenlijk door de convenantspartijen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Gevangene ontsnapt in Groningen’ en ‘Tbs’er ontsnapt tijdens proefverlof’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of a prisoner escaping in Groningen and a tbs patient absconding during supervised leave, and whether the leave system should be tightened (two guards, police alerts) and the costs recovered. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, explained the leave was approved after a positive advisory opinion and had gone without incident, said his position on tightening rules is unchanged, and declined to recover search costs since police core tasks are not charged.
After the Advisory Committee on tbs leave review (AVt) gave a positive recommendation, supervised leave was granted from 13 April 2012.
Nadat het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing tbs (AVt) positief heeft geadviseerd is er per 13 april 2012 begeleid verlof verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over het toepassen van het dwangmiddel gijzeling

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about a Bergen op Zoom judge's sharp criticism of the CJIB's automated practice of routinely seeking detention (gijzeling) for unpaid traffic fines, even where payment arrangements existed, and what would be done about it. The state secretary said detention is a last resort decided case by case by a judge, that over 40% of ordered detentions end in payment, and that the CJIB will broaden bundling of cases and earlier recognition of special circumstances, with the OM improving its use of detention.
The CJIB has set itself the goal of applying this bundled approach to cases more broadly in the future.
Het CJIB heeft zich ten doel gesteld deze gebundelde aanpak van zaken in de toekomst breder toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over het Nederlandse asielbeleid voor Russische LHBT-ers

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman and Schouw asked whether Russia's anti-gay propaganda law endangers LGBT people, what the Netherlands is doing about it, whether visa liberalisation should be suspended, and whether Russian LGBT asylum claims will be processed faster. The minister replied that the Netherlands raises LGBT rights through dialogue with Russia, the EU and the Council of Europe, that visa liberalisation is only at an exploratory stage with human rights weighed in future steps, and that LGBT asylum claims are assessed case by case under existing criteria without priority processing.

The Netherlands continues to focus primarily, both bilaterally and multilaterally, on broad international attention and dialogue on the human rights situation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia, rather than hardening positions.

Nederland blijft zowel op het bilaterale als multilaterale spoor primair inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de mensenrechtensituatie en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland, in plaats van het verharden van standpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de brief «de aantallen opgelegde boetes aan luchtvervoerders die de Vreemdelingenwet overtreden»

An MP asks why undocumented passengers still exit aircraft despite carrier copy and care duties, and how carriers are fined and prosecuted under the Aliens Act. The State Secretary explains the copy duty applies to 27 departure airports, cabins are searched when suspicion arises, and fines and prosecutions were inconsistent before 2013 due to MOU arrangements and a legal gap, with stronger cost recovery planned as the main lever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de naturalisatie van vreemdelingen die een verblijfsvergunning hebben op grond van het generaal pardon

An MP asked the state secretary about naturalisation applications from foreigners who received residence permits under the 2007 general pardon (RANOV), including how many were granted, refused for missing identity documents, and how often documentary evidence was waived. The state secretary reported 6,790 applications, 4,220 granted and 410 refused, said refusal reasons cannot yet be produced automatically, and noted a petition against the document requirement without committing to change it.
It is currently not yet possible to produce automated figures on the reason for refusal.
Het is nu nog niet mogelijk om geautomatiseerd cijfers over de reden van afwijzing te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over naar Nederland gevluchte Noord-Koreanen die terug moeten keren naar Zuid-Korea

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether North Korean asylum seekers in the Netherlands face danger if returned to South Korea and whether South Korea cooperates with returns. The government answered that South Korea admits all voluntary North Korean defectors who automatically gain citizenship, that no returns have yet occurred, and that the risk to asylum seekers and their families is weighed case by case.
All relevant circumstances raised by the foreign national are taken into account when assessing an asylum application.
Alle door de vreemdeling aangevoerde relevante omstandigheden worden meegewogen bij de beoordeling van een asielaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de kosten uitzetting Guineese hongerstakers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the costs of deporting two Guinean hunger strikers, including the breakdown of flight and delegation costs, frequency of special deportation flights, joint EU flights with Frontex support, and the status of the CITT investigation into Guinea taskforces. The state secretary answered in detail on costs and frequency, said future flight costs cannot be predicted, and said he awaits the CITT's findings in its 2013 annual report without suspending the taskforces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Sluitingsdatum Willem II gevangenis in Tilburg staat nog steeds niet vast” en de Rijksbegroting 2014 Veiligheid en Justitie

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Tilburg prison (PI Tilburg), leased to Belgium, will stay open after 2016, and whether earlier statements on this were misleading given the budget text. The State Secretary reaffirmed his statements, said Belgium's cabinet has agreed to extend use in 2014 and formal steps are underway, but only the extension to 31 December 2016 is currently on the table.
I will inform your House and the staff of PI Tilburg when the decision-making is definitively concluded.
Ik zal uw Kamer en de medewerkers van de PI Tilburg berichten wanneer de besluitvorming definitief is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over een dreigende ernstige verslechtering van de positie van Iraanse lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele en transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra asked whether the abolition of the national c-ground in the asylum bill would worsen protection for Iranian LGBT asylum seekers, given continuing severe persecution, and whether the government would keep the protection level promised by a previous minister. The state secretary answered that a current country report on Iran will be assessed before the new law takes effect to decide whether equivalent protection under the a- or b-ground is needed, and that the group's protection is not automatically worsened.

However, this means that before the bill takes effect, based on current information on the situation of LGBT persons in Iran, it will be assessed whether there is reason to offer them a comparable level of protection under the a- or b-ground.

Wel brengt dit mee dat, voorafgaand aan de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel, op basis van de actuele informatie over de situatie van LHBT's in Iran, zal worden beoordeeld of er aanleiding bestaat om hen een vergelijkbaar beschermingsniveau te bieden in het kader van de a- of de b-grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Twee jonge criminelen lopen weg uit behandelcentrum ‘

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about two young offenders who escaped from a youth detention centre by getting into a car, and asked about Burgernet alerts, cost recovery and preventing future escapes. The state secretary confirmed the escape, said an internal investigation is pending, defended the discretion over Burgernet and the policy against recovering police costs, and promised to review measures after the investigation.
I am awaiting the investigation being carried out by the Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit of the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) into this incident.
Ik ben in afwachting van het onderzoek dat door het Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) wordt uitgevoerd naar dit incident.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het in land van herkomst fysiek overdragen van uitgezette zieke vreemdelingen

The SP member Gesthuizen asked how the government applies the condition that seriously ill foreigners may only be expelled if physical handover to a medical provider in the country of origin takes place, and whether that handover always succeeds. State Secretary Teeven answered that the BMA can set such conditions, DT&V arranges and verifies them with receiving clinics, no registration is kept of failed handovers, and if handover proves impossible the person is brought back to the Netherlands.
No registration is kept of physical handovers that are not possible in the country of origin.
