Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van fysieke overdrachten die niet mogelijk zijn in het land van herkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rapport van de UNHCR en Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland “Pas nu weet ik: vrijheid is het hoogste goed”

Mr Schouw (D66) asked the state secretary whether the closed extended asylum procedure lacks legal legitimacy, whether Dublin claimants are detained without substantive asylum review, and what alternatives to detention were examined. The state secretary rejected the claim of insufficient legal basis, pointing to independent judicial review of each detention, and said the Dublin procedure will be reviewed when the revised Dublin Regulation is implemented; he committed to informing the House on alternatives to detention.
Every placement in the closed extended asylum procedure can be brought by the asylum seeker, including the Dublin claimant, before the (independent) judge.
Elke plaatsing in de gesloten verlengde asielprocedure kan door de asielzoeker, ook de Dublinclaimant, worden voorgelegd aan de (onafhankelijke) rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de medische opvang van twee uitgezette hongerstakers

An MP asks the state secretary about the medical care of two hunger strikers deported to Guinea in August 2013, including whether promised treatment was actually arranged and why a delegation was sent. The government says the clinic was ready to treat them, that they left against medical advice, and that it will not cover the costs of the alternative clinic.
Both before the deportation and afterwards, the Dutch government did everything possible to fulfil the commitments regarding the medical transfer and support of the individuals concerned.

Zowel voorafgaand aan de uitzetting als daarna, is door de Nederlandse overheid al het mogelijke gedaan om de toezeggingen ten aanzien van de medische overdracht en begeleiding van betrokkenen na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sociaal beleid en de personele gevolgen van het sluiten van gevangenissen

An SP MP asked about social policy and staff consequences of prison closures under the DJI Masterplan, including unclear communication, uncertainty over the 'van-werk-naar-werk' scheme, early closures, placement numbers, the timing of plans and the SBF scheme. The government answered that closures follow planned dates, consultation with unions is ongoing, staff are being placed elsewhere, and a new offer on the SBF scheme is under discussion without details.
The content of that cannot be communicated while the consultation is ongoing.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan lopende het overleg geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Moordenaar niet teruggekeerd van verlof”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a convicted murderer who failed to return from prison leave in July 2013 and whether the public was informed, and asked about abolishing leave and charging prisoners for their resocialisation. The State Secretary answered that the prisoner was arrested in Austria in August 2013, that leave is part of resocialisation and recidivism reduction, that the government plans to abolish the current detention phasing and introduce electronic detention, and that the public is informed mainly through investigation appeals.
In view of this incident, the Public Prosecution Service has requested the court that the conditional early release of prisoner N. be further withheld.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft gezien dit voorval bij de rechtbank gevorderd dat de voorwaardelijke invrijheidstelling van gedetineerde N. verder achterwege blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘EU plan to suspend visa-free travel’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the European Commission may take legal action over the EU mechanism to suspend visa-free travel, and what this means for the Netherlands. The government said the Commission's concerns concern the reciprocity mechanism, that the emergency brake was a Dutch initiative, and that it expects the legislation to be finalised quickly.
The European Commission's concerns relate to the reciprocity mechanism.
De bedenkingen van de Europese Commissie liggen op het terrein van het reciprociteitsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over persoonsgegevens bij digitale televisie en Netflix

An MP asked the state secretaries about personal data handling by Netflix and digital TV providers, including whether Dutch privacy law applies to Netflix operating from Luxembourg and whether viewing data can reveal sensitive information. The government answered that the Dutch Wbp does not apply to Netflix, which falls under Luxembourg law implementing the same EU directive, and described Ziggo's opt-in rules for sharing viewing data.
The Wbp does not apply because Netflix has no establishment in the Netherlands.
De Wbp is niet van toepassing aangezien Netflix geen vestiging in Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische asielzoekers door Bulgarije

MPs Maij, Gesthuizen and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reception conditions for Syrian asylum seekers in Bulgaria, including access to procedures, shelter, child provisions, EU minimum standards and other affected countries. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria faces overcrowded centres and UNHCR criticism, that an EU/Frontex/EASO mission was planned, that the Commission monitors EU law compliance, and that Greece and Cyprus would also be visited.
It is not for me, but precisely for the European Commission, to monitor the correct application of EU law.
Het is niet aan mij, maar juist de taak van de Europese Commissie om over correcte toepassing van het EU-recht te waken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Angolese asielzoeker

MPs from ChristenUnie, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government would reconsider the age cutoff of the Kinderpardon scheme, which excludes a 22-year-old Angolan asylum seeker who arrived at age ten, and whether he could await his objection procedure in the Netherlands and why he remains in detention. The State Secretary refused to revisit the upper age limit, allowed the man to await his objection procedure in the Netherlands, and defended detention given his earlier evasion of lighter measures.
I have now decided that the person concerned may await his objection procedure in the Netherlands.
Inmiddels heb ik besloten dat betrokkene zijn bezwaarprocedure in Nederland mag afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de nieuwe PI Zaanstad geschikt is voor vreemdelingenbewaring

An SP MP asked whether the new Zaanstad prison, reported as suitable for immigration detention, signals a reversal of the plan to cut immigration detention capacity, and how this fits the planned shift to alternatives. The state secretary answered that the building is designed as a multifunctional facility that will be used by the prison sector, while immigration detainees will stay in Rotterdam, Schiphol and Zeist, and that the capacity cut and shift to supervision measures are unaffected.
Foreigners placed in custody will be housed in the three detention centres Rotterdam, Schiphol and Zeist.
Vreemdelingen die in bewaring worden gesteld, zullen worden ondergebracht in de drie detentiecentra Rotterdam, Schiphol en Zeist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over verzekeraars die werkgevers chanteren om medische gegevens van werknemers door te spelen

An MP asked whether insurers pressuring employers to obtain employees' medical data violate privacy, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges that privacy rules are not always respected in sickness-absence management, calls the practice undesirable, and says the insurers' association will be asked to adjust practices and report on progress, while the CBP is responsible for supervision.
I will ask the VvV to keep me informed of the progress of this, so that such practices are prevented in the future.
Ik zal het VvV vragen mij op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang hiervan, zodat dergelijke uitvoeringspraktijken in de toekomst worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van homoparen bij interlandelijke adoptie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch intercountry adoption practice through Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions tolerates discrimination against same-sex and non-Christian couples in South Africa, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary replied that the South African discrimination investigation is ongoing, that Abba Adoptions has removed discriminatory criteria, that the Central Authority acted adequately, and that the government is open to a second intermediary and to a possible European working group, without committing to a new discrimination-free alternative.
As I have already shared with your House, there are no longer any discriminatory conditions in the cooperation between Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions.
Antwoord 5 Zoals ik al eerder met uw Kamer heb gedeeld 3 , zijn er geen discriminerende voorwaarden meer in de samenwerking tussen Wereldkinderen en Abba adoptions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over de trage uitbetaling van rechthebbenden bij Buma/Stemra

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked about artist dissatisfaction with Buma/Stemra's royalty distribution, complaint numbers, reports of Spotify royalties being held too long, and the distribution norms. The Secretary of State answered that only one formal complaint was filed in 24 months, that the legal three-year distribution deadline is met, and that no further action with the oversight college is warranted.
Given that the payouts take place within the statutory deadline, I see no reason to bring the handling of distribution at Buma/Stemra to the attention of the Supervisory Board for Copyright.

Gelet op het feit dat de uitkeringen binnen de gestelde wettelijke termijn plaatsvinden, zie ik geen aanleiding de gang van zaken bij Buma/Stemra met betrekking tot de repartitie onder de aandacht te brengen van het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Wit over het verhalen van bijstand door gemeenten op vermeende verwekkers van kinderen

An MP asked whether municipalities may recover welfare costs from alleged fathers who have no legal paternity established, and how to prevent wrongful claims. The government answered that municipalities have statutory recovery powers under the WWB and that individual cases fall to municipal autonomy, so it will not intervene.
In assessing the facts of an individual case, neither the State Secretary for Social Affairs and Employment nor I can intervene.
In de beoordeling van de feiten van een individuele zaak kunnen noch de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, noch ik, treden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Weyenberg over het achterhalen van vaders van niet-erkende kinderen

D66 MPs asked whether municipalities may pursue biological fathers of non-recognised children for benefit recovery, how paternity is established, how this relates to privacy, and whether mothers can lose benefits for refusing cooperation. The state secretary explained the municipal procedure, the court route under the Civil Code, the mother's duty to cooperate with possible suspension of benefits, and that sperm donors are generally not liable for maintenance.
Those who carry out work under the WWB are subject to a duty of confidentiality (article 65 WWB), which adequately safeguards the privacy of those involved in municipal benefit recovery.

Voor degenen die werkzaamheden verrichten in het kader van de uitvoering van de WWB geldt een geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 65 WWB) waarmee de privacy van de betrokkenen bij gemeentelijk bijstandsverhaal afdoende is gewaarborgd.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) inzake levenslang (ingezonden 15 juli 2013).

Recourt (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the 2013 ECtHR ruling against the UK on life sentences affects Dutch practice, including whether clemency gives lifers a real prospect of release, how often clemency was granted, and whether victims' interests are weighed. Teeven answered that Dutch law offers a real prospect of release through clemency, that clemency is effective (147 unconditional and 51 conditional grants in January–August 2013, one lifer's request granted in ten years), and that victims' interests are part of the assessment.
Life-sentenced prisoners can after all also be eligible for clemency.
Levenslanggestraften kunnen immers ook in aanmerking komen voor gratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tbs’er op verlof aangehouden voor belagen 13-jarig meisje’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether a tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient on leave, arrested for stalking a 13-year-old girl, should be disclosed, and whether the leave regime should be tightened, including armed escorts and police profiles. The State Secretary confirmed the facts, described the transmural leave approval process and the revocation rules, and declined to change the regime, citing the recidivism figures and that the risk cannot be fully excluded.
For the person concerned, FPC de Rooyse Wissel requested an authorization for transmural leave on 24 May 2013.
Voor betrokkene is door FPC de Rooyse Wissel op 24 mei 2013 een machtiging aangevraagd voor transmuraal verlof.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over herrie van politiehelicopters(ingezonden 5 juli 2013).

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the legal rules for deploying police helicopters and whether night-time and urban use causing noise nuisance should be restricted to acute safety risks, quieter equipment, or flight instructions. The government replied that legal rules exist under the Police Act and aviation law, that deployments are tested for proportionality, subsidiarity and priority including nuisance, and that deployment is limited to lifesaving, complex arrests and high-impact crime, without committing to new restrictions.
Deployments are tested against the requirements of proportionality, subsidiarity and priority.
De inzetten worden getoetst aan de eisen van proportionaliteit, subsidiariteit en prioriteit.

Vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos(beiden PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe publicatieregeling voor freelance journaliste

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked about Sanoma Media's new exclusive licensing and resale terms for freelance journalists, the 30% fee share, possible abuse of market power, the Mededingingswet, and whether the Auteurscontractenrecht bill should apply retroactively. The state secretary answered that contract disputes are for civil courts, that the ACM handles abuse-of-dominance complaints, and that the bill's fair-remuneration rule will not apply retroactively to existing contracts.
It is also not for us to pronounce on a provision in a specific private-law relationship.
Het is ook niet aan ons om ons uit te spreken over een bepaling in een specifieke privaatrechtelijke rechtsverhouding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Ontsnapte boefjes gepakt’ en ‘Drie ontsnapte jongeren uit Hartelborgt aangehouden’

An MP asked the State Secretary about press reports of three youths escaping from the Hartelborgt juvenile institution, whether the escape was easy, whether the investigation would be shared with parliament, and whether measures would prevent future escapes. The State Secretary said investigations by DJI and the inspectorates are underway, the inspectorate will publish its findings, the DJI security investigation stays confidential, and further measures depend on the outcomes.
The security investigation, carried out by the DJI Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit, is confidential in nature and will not be presented publicly.
Het veiligheidsonderzoek, uitgevoerd door Bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI), is vertrouwelijk van aard en wordt niet publiekelijk gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Helder over het bericht: 'Seks, drugs en telefoons in jeugdgevangenis'

MP Helder (PVV) asked the state secretary about press reports of drugs, phones, sex and freedom of movement in a youth detention centre (Teylingereind), including whether the convicted killer of a referee had access to a key, and whether detention is punitive enough and whether searches should be standard. The state secretary denied the key claim, said an internal inquiry found no evidence of sexual contact with staff, admitted contraband can never be fully excluded, rejected longer maximum detention and standard full searches, and said existing rules and controls will be kept.
Following the PowNews broadcast, the management of Teylingereind immediately launched an internal investigation into the truth of this claim.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending van PowNews heeft de directie van Teylingereind direct een intern onderzoek ingesteld naar het waarheidsgehalte van deze bewering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Van der Burg en Van Toorenburg van uw Kamer over verboden voorwerpen in de cel van de veroordeelde voor het doodschoppen van Richard Nieuwenhuizen

MPs Van der Steur, Van der Burg and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about a PowNews broadcast showing contraband (a phone or camera, soft drugs, a key-fob and possible sexual contact) in the cell of a convicted youth at the Teylingereind youth institution. The State Secretary acknowledged the phone was unacceptable, described existing controls and a sector-wide review, said no sexual contact was found, and saw no reason for further action or concern about the institution's management.
I have instructed the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen to survey across the sector how the illegal import and use of mobile phones can be further curbed.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen de opdracht gegeven om sectorbreed te inventariseren hoe de illegale invoer en het gebruik van mobiele telefoons nog verder kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanwezigheid van mobiele telefoons en drugs in een justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

The MP Kooiman asks the state secretary about a PowNews broadcast showing a youth in a juvenile detention facility with a mobile phone, hashish and a guard's key, and about sanctions and further controls. The state secretary acknowledges the possession as very serious, explains the key-access system, reports sanctions imposed on the youths, and says existing controls are sufficient with no extra measures needed, though the sector will look into additional systems.

I have expressly asked the sector management of the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) to remain alert to this and have instructed them to survey the sector as a whole on how the illegal import and use of mobile phones can be further curbed.

Ik heb de sectordirectie JJI van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) nadrukkelijk verzocht hier blijvend alert op te zijn en hen de opdracht gegeven om sectorbreed te inventariseren hoe de illegale invoer en het gebruik van mobiele telefoons nog verder kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Crimineel Martha op vrije voeten’ en ‘Topcrimineel vrijgelaten door Hof van Amsterdam’

An MP asked whether a high-profile criminal released pending appeal by the Amsterdam appeals court should have been freed, and what measures the government would take to prevent such releases and to implement immediate execution of sentences after first-instance conviction. The minister said it cannot comment on the court's release decisions, that the prosecution had argued for continued detention and has no appeal remedy, that appeal alone is not grounds for suspending detention, and that a bill on immediate execution will be put to consultation this month.
I cannot comment on the assessments by the district court and the appeals court in connection with the suspensions in the criminal cases mentioned in answer 1.
Ik kan niet treden in de beoordelingen door de rechtbank en het gerechtshof in verband met de schorsingen in de in antwoord 1 genoemde strafzaken.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het aantal ontvluchtpogingen van gedetineerden en het gebruik van vrijheidsbeperkende middelen bij het vervoer van gedetineerden (in

An MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice for the number of escape attempts by detainees during transport since May 2012 and the total number transported, and questioned the policy of not applying restraints by default after an ombudsman ruling. The secretary disclosed 14 attempts (2 successful) out of about 44,000 persons and 138,000 transport movements, denied that the policy invites escapes, and said the current rules are adequate.
Yes. In the period May 2012 through June 2013, there were 14 attempts to escape from transport.
Ja. In de periode mei 2012 tot en met juni 2013 hebben zich 14 pogingen tot onttrekking aan transport voorgedaan.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Oskam (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kansspelen op het internet (ingezonden 31 juli 2013).

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary why online gambling by unlicensed operators remains easy despite the ban, whether the enforcement criteria are too lax, how the parliamentary motion excluding illegal operators from licences and cutting off banks and payment providers is being implemented, and whether a fast-lane for compliant firms is possible. The government answered that it prioritises enforcement against operators clearly targeting the Dutch market, will add stronger enforcement powers including binding instructions to payment and internet service providers, will exclude persisting operators from licences, is studying a fast-lane but sees limited scope, and is working with banks on a blacklist.
I intend to include in the online gambling bill several additional enforcement instruments to further strengthen the gambling authority's enforcement powers against illegal online gambling.

Bovendien ben ik voornemens in het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand enkele aanvullende handhavingsinstrumenten op te nemen om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de kansspelautoriteit om illegale online kansspelen aan te pakken verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het belang van de ondersteunende rol die NGO’s kunnen hebben voor het aannemelijk maken van het asielrelaas door asielzoekers

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether NGO support can help asylum seekers substantiate their claims, whether documents from the NGO CLAAS should be treated as reliable given Dutch funding, and why IND document research cannot always give a verdict on authenticity. The state secretary acknowledged the role of NGOs, said CLAAS funding concerns a different activity and does not determine evidentiary status, and stated that the IND assesses each document individually and considers its content acceptable.
I consider this approach careful and adequate.
Ik acht deze werkwijze zorgvuldig en toereikend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de behandeling van asielzoekers op Schiphol

An MP asked the State Secretary about hunger-striking asylum seekers in border detention at Schiphol, the legal basis for detaining air arrivals but not land arrivals, duration of detention, and whether border detention should be abolished. The State Secretary replied that border detention is a necessary measure balancing legal protection against Schengen border obligations, that each case is assessed individually, and that alternatives are being explored, while referring the UNHCR/Vluchtelingenwerk critique to a separate letter.
That is also why it is assessed individually whether there is reason to lift the border detention.
Dat is ook de reden dat individueel wordt bekeken of er aanleiding is de grensdetentie op te heffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het plaatsen van hongerstakers in een isoleercel

MP Schouw (D66) asked the state secretary whether hunger strikers are still placed in bare isolation cells at Schiphol detention centre, whether the ombudsman was promised an end to this, and about camera monitoring and policy implications following a complaints committee ruling. The state secretary answered that the ombudsman's recommendation on facilities for hunger strikers is being implemented, that isolation is used sparingly, and that cells at Schiphol were upgraded by May 2013 without committing to new measures.

The National Ombudsman recommended in a 2010 report that directors of justice institutions be told that when hunger strikers are placed in an observation cell, as many facilities as possible must be provided there, as in a regular cell.

De Nationale ombudsman heeft in 2010 in een rapport de aanbeveling gedaan om bij de directeuren van de justitiële inrichtingen onder de aandacht te brengen dat wanneer hongerstakers in een observatiecel worden geplaatst, in deze cel zoveel mogelijk faciliteiten moeten worden geboden
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat Samir A. begin september vrijkomt

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government will overturn the court decision releasing terrorist Samir A. on conditional release, and what measures will prevent such releases in future. The minister replied that the prosecution had sought to block the release and that the court rejected this, leaving no legal remedy, but strict conditions (reporting duty, location and contact bans, media ban, exit ban, passport seized, strictest reclassering supervision) now apply, and that life sentences are the appropriate tool for such cases.
The court however decided otherwise, and I have no legal remedies available against that.
De rechtbank heeft evenwel anders beslist en daartegen staan mij geen rechtsmiddelen open.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de effecten van de wijziging van het landgebonden asielbeleid Somalië

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how returns of Somalis were established, whether readmission agreements guarantee acceptance, why answers differ from court submissions, and whether detention and expulsions to South-Central Somalia remain justified amid Artsen zonder Grenzen's withdrawal and ECHR interim measures. The State Secretary defends the policy, says detention lacks no prospect of removal, cites an upcoming Council of State ruling, and refers to earlier answers on interim measures.
Of course I will follow this ruling if the Division concludes that there is insufficient prospect of removal to Somalia.
Uiteraard zal ik gevolg geven aan deze uitspraak indien de Afdeling oordeelt dat er onvoldoende zicht is op uitzetting naar Somalië.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Irakees gezin met kinderen die onder toezicht zijn gesteld en uit huis zijn geplaatst

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked about the planned deportation of an Iraqi family whose children were under supervision and placed out of home, questioning the state's conduct in detaining the children and whether their rights were protected. The state secretary declined to discuss the individual case, but said the children's detention was lifted, the family was placed in a family location, and a plan is being worked out with Nidos and the family.
As you know, when answering parliamentary questions I do not go into specific aspects of individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik bij de beantwoording van kamervragen niet in op specifieke aspecten van individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat een  in afwachting van hoger beroep zijnde veroordeelde zedendelinquent een baan in de gehandicaptenzorg kon krijgen

MPs asked why a convicted sex offender awaiting appeal could take a job in disability care, and how the government will prevent similar cases, including VOG requirements, IGZ reporting of sexual misconduct complaints, and supervision of offenders pending appeal. The state secretary said the pending Wkkgz bill would require providers to vet staff and allow a VOG requirement by decree, IGZ transparency is limited by confidentiality, and immediate enforceability of probation conditions now exists though no figures are kept, with evaluation planned after three years.

With every request for information, a judgement is made about which information can be disclosed without harming those involved, breaching medical confidentiality, or disrupting the treatment process.

Bij elk verzoek om informatie wordt de afweging gemaakt welke informatie naar buiten kan worden gebracht zonder de betrokkenen te beschadigen, het medisch beroepsgeheim te schenden, of het behandelproces te verstoren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de tegemoetkoming in de kosten van adoptie

An SGP MP asked why the Agentschap SZW changed the wording of the adoption-cost allowance criteria, which led to rejections of some applications, and whether the old criteria would be applied. The minister says the change was a clarification, that 35 wrongly rejected cases were reassessed and the website amended, and that the earlier criteria will be applied to the affected applications.
It was then decided to reassess these 35 cases and to amend the website, so that the lack of clarity has been removed.
Daarop is besloten deze 35 gevallen opnieuw te beoordelen en de website aan te passen, zodat de onduidelijkheid is weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over becherming van persoonsgegevens in digitale patientendossiers

MPs Oosenbrug and Kuzu asked the health and justice ministers about privacy protection in digital patient records after the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found that none of the examined care institutions complied with the Wbp. The minister answered that institutions must improve access controls, that CBP will enforce if breaches continue, that NEN security norms will be made binding via an AMvB, and that IGZ is considering intensifying its supervision.
If the CBP finds that the institutions do not end the violations, the CBP will take enforcement action.
Als het CBP constateert dat de instellingen de overtredingen niet beëindigen, zal het CBP handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Maij over het besluit van Artsen zonder Grenzen om Somalië te verlaten

Two MPs (Van Laar and Maij, PvdA) asked the ministers how the government views Artsen zonder Grenzen' withdrawal from Somalia over security concerns, its consequences for humanitarian aid, attacks on aid workers and how the Somali authorities respond, and whether the Netherlands will raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that the government regrets the decision, that other organisations continue aid, that the Somali government has pledged to protect aid workers and that the security situation remains fragile without changing asylum policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a robust dialogue by the international community with the SFG on this subject.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op een stevige dialoog van de internationale gemeenschap met de SFG over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht ‘Egypt’s Christians face backlash for Morsi ouster’

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Coptic Christians face backlash after Morsi's ouster, including how many have been attacked, whether the interim government protects minorities, and whether Copts should be treated as a risk group in asylum policy. The minister answered that sectarian violence has increased, the security forces and local authorities have not sufficiently prevented it, but no new country report or asylum risk-group designation is deemed necessary.
There is currently no unambiguous and reliable information available on the number of victims and the number of churches destroyed.
Er is op dit moment geen eenduidige en betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar over aantallen slachtoffers en over aantallen kerken die vernield zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Steekincident hing in de lucht'

Two MPs from the CDA asked the state secretary about a press report on a fatal stabbing in the Nieuwegein prison, including whether the deceased inmate had complained about overcrowding, the occupancy rate, staffing, transfers after the incident, and whether discrimination played a role. The minister answered that no complaint about overcrowding is known, the occupancy was 82%, staffing was sufficient, five inmates were transferred to restore order, and details of the incident cannot be disclosed because of an ongoing criminal investigation.
The circumstances of this stabbing incident are the subject of an ongoing criminal investigation into the suspect and therefore I cannot make any statements about it.
De toedracht van dit steekincident is onderwerp van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de verdachte en derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen hierover doen.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een 10-jarig meisje is aangerand door een illegaal in Nederland verblijvende Somalische bewoner v

PVV MPs asked the state secretary how a suspect with a record of sexual aggression, residing illegally in the Netherlands, could move freely and whether such persons should be detained, and asked for a guarantee he would not be released and how many criminal illegal residents exist. The state secretary replied that the suspect was arrested and detained pending trial, that his removal was blocked by lack of treatment options in his country of origin, that the court decides on the measure, and that the government is improving data on criminal illegal residents.
It is for the judge to decide which measure is appropriate, taking into account all circumstances of the case and the perpetrator's personal situation.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen welke maatregel passend is, alle omstandigheden van het geval en de persoon van de dader meewegend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de voortdurende wantoestanden rondom de “vluchtflat” in Amsterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary about recurring incidents (assault, fights, drug use) at the 'vluchtflat' in Amsterdam housing rejected asylum seekers, whether illegal residents commit crimes repeatedly, who facilitates the building, and whether detention and eviction should follow. The State Secretary denies evidence of repeated crimes, says the building is provided temporarily by a housing corporation with conduct rules, that detention is not a criminal-law tool, and that the mayor is responsible for public order and action against the building, while he continues consulting the municipality.
No. Immigration detention is an instrument the government can use as a last resort to actually realise the departure of a foreign national.
Nee. Vreemdelingenbewaring is een instrument dat de overheid als uiterst middel kan inzetten om daadwerkelijk vertrek van een vreemdeling te realiseren.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de effecten van de wijziging van het landgebonden asielbeleid Somalië

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about the effects of the revised Somalia asylum policy on forced returns, voluntary returns, detention, cooperation arrangements and European Court interim measures. The State Secretary answered each question, noting that few forced returns had occurred, that interim measures do not change policy, and that he rejects Amnesty International's view that returns to south and central Somalia breach international law.
The government is not informed when a complainant asks the Court for an interim measure and the request is rejected, so I cannot provide figures on rejected requests.
De regering wordt niet op de hoogte gesteld als een klager het Hof heeft verzocht om oplegging van een voorlopige maatregel, maar dit verzoek is afgewezen.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum over het onthouden van medische zorg aan de 7-jarige Renate tijdens haar verblijf in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why a seven-year-old asylum seeker, Renata, allegedly was denied medical care in the Netherlands and whether the transfer to Poland was medically justified. The State Secretary answers that the child received medical care, details the contact moments and procedural history, declines fuller disclosure citing medical confidentiality, and states that inspectorates will investigate the medical handling.

The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) have announced they will launch an investigation, in particular into the medical handling and medical information transfer in the chain.

De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) hebben inmiddels gemeld een onderzoek in te zullen stellen, in het bijzonder naar het medisch handelen en de medische informatieoverdracht in de keten.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de uitzetting van een zesjarig meisje met acute leukemie

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary about the transfer to Poland of a six-year-old asylum seeker with acute leukaemia, how her medical situation was taken into account, and whether an investigation would be started. The state secretary answered that medical confidentiality and an announced IGZ/IVenJ investigation prevent substantive comment on the medical handling, explained the BMA and fit-to-fly procedures in general terms, and said the inspectorates will investigate the medical handling and information transfer in the chain.

Because of the medical confidentiality that applies to medical files and because of the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot currently make statements on the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medische beroepsgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen Maij over de uitzetting van een asielgezin met een ernstig ziek kind naar Polen

MP Maij asks the State Secretary about the deportation of an asylum family with a seriously ill child to Poland under the Dublin procedure, requesting a factual account of the child's medical complaints and how they were handled, whether the handling was adequate, and whether a family with an acutely ill child may be deported. The State Secretary refers to earlier answers, cites medical confidentiality and an inspectorate investigation to decline substantive medical detail, states the family had access to care, and says acute treatment would be given in the Netherlands although a transfer may still occur depending on the treatment needed.

Because of the medical confidentiality that applies to medical records and because of the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate of Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot at this time make statements about the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medisch beroepgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de uitzetting van een zieke asielzoeker

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the deportation of a seriously ill six-year-old asylum seeker, her medical treatment timeline, and what the government meant by the 'human scale' in policy. The State Secretary referred to earlier answers, said he cannot discuss the substance of medical care due to medical confidentiality and pending inspection investigations, and clarified the 'human scale' concept without changing restrictive policy.

Due to the medical confidentiality that applies to medical records and the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot currently make statements about the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medisch beroepsgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de niet-nakoming van controles op de correcte uitvoering van de Wet Politiegegevens (ingezonden 25 juni 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police did not carry out the mandatory self-checks under the Police Data Act on time, and whether this undermines public trust and justifies widening police powers. The state secretary answered that the 2013 re-check was completed in April 2013 and published, the police is compliant with its reporting duties to the CBP, and the next external privacy audit is planned for late 2014, while declining to commit to more frequent audits pending an evaluation.
The CBP receives, in line with the legal framework, the results of the four-yearly external privacy audit and, on request, the results of the interim internal checks.
Het CPB ontvangt, conform de wettelijke kaders, de resultaten van de vierjaarlijke externe privacy- audit en, op verzoek, de resultaten van de tussentijdse interne controles.
Vragen van het lid De Wit (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat e-Court voor rechtbank speelt (ingezonden 27 juni 2013).

MP De Wit (SP) asks the Minister of Security and Justice about e-Court, a private arbitration body, including whether parties explicitly consent, the continued use of notarial binding-advice procedures for cases filed before 1 February 2013, the exclusion of court review, the one-month deadline for opting out, arbiter appointment, and whether judges should serve as arbiters. The State Secretary answers that arbitration requires party consent, that e-Court's terminology and procedural rules will be reviewed with it, that parties keep access to court review under the law, and that judges' side functions are handled by the judiciary's guidelines.
Regarding e-Court procedures based on binding advice (article 7:900 et seq. Civil Code), I am not aware how many cases have been handled this way by e-Court.
Ten aanzien van procedures van e-Court op basis van bindend advies (artikel 7:900 e.v. BW) is mij niet bekend hoeveel zaken op deze manier door e-Court zijn behandeld.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de prostitutie in Utrecht aan banden is gelegd (ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the closure of window prostitution in Utrecht, the consequences for sex workers, rental prices and police powers. The state secretary answered that the municipality revoked the permits for 115 workspaces for reasons including trafficking signals, that aid remains available, and that police powers are set by law while the APV is a local matter.
This concerns a local matter. I trust that the municipal authorities made a sound weighing of the various options before reaching this decision.
Het betreft een lokale aangelegenheid. Ik vertrouw erop dat het gemeentebestuur een goede afweging heeft gemaakt tussen de verschillende handelingsopties voordat het tot dit besluit is gekomen.
Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over ongedocumenteerde alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (ingezonden 5 juli 2013).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether undocumented unaccompanied minor asylum seekers should receive an identity document, how many there are, how they are protected against exploitation, and how other EU states handle this. The State Secretary declines to issue ID documents to unlawfully resident minors, states no statistics on undocumented minors are kept, and points to protective shelter, guardianship and return efforts.
No figures are kept on undocumented unaccompanied minors.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden over ongedocumenteerde amv’s.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (I

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel ask about two Chinese interpreters removed from the IND interpreter file, their training requirements, integrity checks, use in Uyghur asylum cases and risks to family members in China. The state secretary answers that the IND sets no general training requirements for its interpreters, that the two interpreters were removed, and that Uyghurs' cases and family risks are weighed case by case without informing Chinese authorities.
The IND does not set general further-training requirements for interpreters, partly because training courses for the foreign languages these interpreters speak often do not exist.
De IND stelt geen algemene bijscholingseisen aan tolken, mede daar er op het gebied van de door die tolken gesproken vreemde talen vaak geen tolkenopleidingen bestaan.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Winkeldieven kunnen slag slaan» (ingezonden 12 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether police do little with camera footage supplied by shopkeepers, how footage from shop theft is handled and whether it is seized, whether national sharing of footage and media warnings about mobile gangs are possible, and whether winkeldiefstal is a police priority. The state secretary replies that footage is used in investigations and sometimes handed over voluntarily, that an integrated action plan with 21 measures and a new information organisation is under way, and that shop theft is still a shared public-private responsibility with overvallen given priority.
I am fully aware that mobile gangs pose a major problem for shopkeepers.
Ik ben me er terdege van bewust dat mobiele bendes een groot probleem vormen voor winkeliers.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over klachten over het regime in vreemdelingendetentie (ingezonden 21 juni 2013).

MP Schouw asked the State Secretary about a TV report on complaints in immigration detention, how detainees can file complaints, and how many were filed and upheld over five years. The State Secretary explained the two-step complaint procedure (Commission of Supervision monthly commissioner, then complaints committee with appeal to the Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing) and reported falling complaint numbers and upheld complaints, while saying the new law will address complaints procedures.
Against the ruling of the complaints committee, the detainee who complains under the Pbw can lodge an appeal with the Council for Criminal Justice and Juvenile Protection.
Tegen de uitspraak van de beklagcommissie kan de ingeslotene die klaagt op grond van de Pbw beroep instellen bij de Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing en Jeugdbescherming.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over «family tracing» (ingezonden 25 juni 2013).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about how the IND and DT&V trace families of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in their country of origin, including timing, consent, safety and verification. The State Secretary answered that tracing starts only after a final decision, that minors are informed and may involve their guardian, and that family refusal to take a child back does not automatically grant a residence permit.
It is therefore not correct that tracing already starts before a decision has been made on the asylum application.
Het is dus niet juist dat tracing al start als er nog geen beslissing is genomen op de asielaanvraag.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over asielvergunningen aan alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how many asylum permits were granted in 2012 and the first half of 2013 to unaccompanied minor asylum seekers across procedure types, and how the best interests of the child are taken into account in their procedures. The State Secretary said the figures cannot yet be provided because INDiGO management information is being restored in phases, expected from Q1 2014, and described existing child-specific safeguards such as specialised interviewers, a child-friendly interview room and tailored reception.
It is not yet possible to provide detailed information, which means the questions about unaccompanied minors cannot yet be answered.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om gedetailleerde informatie te leveren, wat betekent dat de gestelde vragen over amv’s nog niet kunnen worden beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma over het bericht dat Irak nog altijd niet meewerkt aan het terugnemen van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the state secretary had pressed Iraq over its refusal to take back rejected asylum seekers, whether a EUR 5.5 million aid commitment had been paid out, and what aid Iraq receives and whether it would be suspended. Teeven answered that he raised Iraq's obligations, that the money remains unpaid because no returns have occurred, and that aid is not being suspended since it supports minorities, demining and business diplomacy.
It was agreed to set up a working group with Iraq to develop concrete solutions to the return problem.
Afgesproken is samen met Irak een werkgroep in te stellen om concrete oplossingen voor de terugkeerproblematiek uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de veiligheidssituatie in Irak

Three MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the deteriorating security situation in Iraq, especially Baghdad and central Iraq, including civilian casualty figures compared with 2011-2012 and when a departure moratorium would be needed. The state secretary reported a rise in violence in April-June 2013 but argued the situation does not amount to a breach of Article 3 ECHR, and said a departure moratorium is not the appropriate instrument, with a general country report due in autumn.
In my view, however, the available information does not show that the situation in Iraq is so serious that return to that country would amount to a violation of Article 3 ECHR.
Naar mijn opvatting kan echter uit de beschikbare informatie niet worden opgemaakt dat de situatie in Irak zo ernstig is dat terugkeer naar dat land een schending van artikel 3 EVRM oplevert.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Haagse jihadisten vrijuit» (ingezonden 26 juni 2013).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch jihadists fighting with Jabhat al-Nusra in Syria are committing terrorist offences, whether the Hague mayor was wrong to say they cannot be prosecuted, and how society will be protected. The state secretary answered that participation is a terrorist offence and prosecution is legally possible though difficult, and pointed to intensified intelligence, enforcement and personal-approach measures referenced in an earlier policy letter.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitvoering van de kinderasielregeling (ingezonden 28 juni 2013).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the IND sends intent-to-impose-entry-ban letters to applicants under the children's asylum scheme while their applications are pending, and how the promised individual review of borderline cases is applied. The State Secretary answers that such letters are sent to preserve the right to be heard before a decision, that the wording will be clarified to avoid confusion, and that borderline cases are reviewed individually and submitted to him.
To prevent confusion, I will have the letter adjusted so that its purpose becomes clearer and it is also clear that the letter does not anticipate the decision on the residence application.

Om verwarring te voorkomen, zal ik de brief laten aanpassen, zodat de bedoeling van de brief duidelijker wordt en tevens helder is dat de brief niet vooruitloopt op de beslissing op de verblijfsaanvraag.
Vragen van het lid De Wit (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het ontijdig uitstellen van rechtszittingen (ingezonden 4 juli 2013).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether court hearings are sometimes postponed on the day itself due to ICT failures that prevent parties from timely inspecting case files, and asked about causes, case numbers and costs. The state secretary answered that such postponements are not registered by the prosecution service or judiciary, so no overview or cost estimate can be given, though there are no indications the situation is more than incidental.
Such cases are not registered as such by the public prosecution service and the judiciary, so it is not feasible to produce an overview of them.
Dergelijke zaken worden door het OM en de rechtspraak niet als zodanig geregistreerd, waardoor het niet goed doenlijk is om hiervan een overzicht te maken.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het CJIB, Marnix State te Leeuwarden (ingezonden 20 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the CJIB office renovation in Leeuwarden, including the cost of furnishings and whether it fits budget cuts. The state secretary answers that the cost of about 1.7 million euro fits Rijk-wide norms, that the published photos show another building, and that the reorganisation aims at more efficient use of office space.
What matters to me is that the costs fit within the norms in force across the central government.
Wat voor mij van belang is dat de kosten passen binnen de (rijksbreed) geldende normen.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Geld voor gedupeerde TBS-patiënten» (ingezonden 26 juni 2013).

An MP asks the state secretary whether TBS patients forced to transfer when a clinic closes could claim compensation, how much that might cost, and whether this should be ruled out. The state secretary replies that only courts can award damages, that a lawful transfer creates no unlawful situation, and that the transfers will be carefully managed to avoid treatment delays.
Only the judge rules on awarding compensation in the case a TBS patient claims it.
Alleen de rechter oordeelt over toekenning van een schadevergoeding in het geval een tbs-gestelde dat eist.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de recordopbrengst aan boetes (ingezonden 13 juni 2013).

MP Kooiman asks the minister whether the expected rise in traffic fine revenue will be invested in police, prosecution and prisons, whether automated fines lack educational effect, whether fines arrive too slowly, whether 130 km/h enforcement increased, and whether some fine amounts are disproportionate. The state secretary denies a 30% rise (EUR 912m forecast vs EUR 898m in 2012), promises to decide allocation in the budget cycle, defends automated enforcement and the Tarievenhuis fine framework, and declines to revise the fine system.
I therefore do not intend to revise the fine system or the current traffic fines.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens het boetestelsel of de huidige verkeersboetes te herzien.

Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het in rekening brengen van administratiekosten bij verkeersboetes dat tot ergernis en tot verwarring leidt (ingezonden 21 juni 2013)

An MP asks the state secretary whether administrative costs added to traffic fines cause annoyance and confusion, and whether he agrees with a district court ruling that collection measures were disproportionate in a small case. The state secretary says the fine notice clearly shows the amount, cites appeals court rulings that the charges are lawful, and refuses to include them in the planned evaluation of the fine system.
It does not befit me as Minister of Security and Justice to have a judgment on the ruling of a district court judge in an individual case.
Het past mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie niet om een oordeel te hebben over de uitspraak van een kantonrechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de moord op Mostafa Talaie

An MP asked about the murder of Mostafa Talaie, a convert from Islam to Christianity, and about threats against converts in and outside asylum centres. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the broadcast, said COA has taken measures for Christian asylum seekers and that reporting and complaint rates should be raised, and reported 18 recorded incidents in 2012 across thirteen centres.
The number of reports of violence and threats against Christian asylum seekers amounted to eighteen in 2012, spread over thirteen different asylum centres.
Het aantal meldingen van geweld en bedreiging tegen christelijke asielzoekers bedroeg in het jaar 2012 achttien, verspreid over dertien verschillende azc's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Amsterdam afspraken heeft gemaakt met de illegale vreemdelingen in de gekraakte kantorenflat in Amsterdam

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that the Amsterdam mayor made arrangements with rejected asylum seekers occupying a squatted office block, and whether detention and departure would be pursued. The state secretary answered that the mayor did not make agreements himself; the parties involved drew up house rules, the municipality is not a party, and detention is not appropriate for most residents who do not cooperate with return.
Regarding placing the persons concerned in immigration detention, I note that this is only relevant for the purpose of removal, when there is concrete prospect of removal.
Over het in vreemdelingendetentie plaatsen van de betrokken vreemdelingen merk ik op dat dit alleen aan de orde is ter fine van uitzetting, wanneer er concreet zicht is op uitzetting.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het nieuwsbericht over het debat Masterplan DJI op de intranetsite van Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI), Dienst vervoer en Onder

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether an internal DJI intranet news item on the Masterplan DJI debate was incomplete for omitting the PVV, and whether it amounted to censorship that should be corrected. The State Secretary answered that the item was not deliberately incomplete, that it only summarised some of the 17 motions (the PVV motion being referenced via another intranet item), and that no correction would be made.
I do not believe the news item is deliberately incomplete.
Ik ben niet van mening dat het nieuwsbericht bewust incompleet is.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit door de Nationale Politie (ingezonden 19 juni 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice how the Nationale Politie will tackle transport crime after the Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is folded into the Landelijke Eenheid, and whether industry concerns about lower priority are justified. The state secretary replies that the successful approach is preserved within the national police, that transport crime is now handled by the DINFRA unit with a focus on it, and that industry worries are not shared.
Transport crime will be tackled programmatically from the National Unit (LE), in cooperation with the regional units and the (chain) partners.
Transportcriminaliteit zal vanuit de Landelijke Eenheid (LE) programmatisch worden aangepakt, in samenwerking met de regionale eenheden en de (keten)partners.

Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichten «Heb ik recht op een uitkering als ik naar een gevangenis ga?» en «Utrecht weigerde ten onrechte bijstand tbs’er» (ingezonden 2

An MP asked the minister whether the limited list of benefits that stop during imprisonment also applies to tbs detainees, and whether convicted offenders should be barred from benefits and allowances while detained. The state secretary confirmed the rule applies to tbs patients with an exception for those discharged from prosecution, explained that detained persons have no right to assistance under the Wet werk en bijstand, and listed the limited set of situations in which benefits may continue.
The Wet socialezekerheidsrechten gedetineerden provides that a person deprived of liberty under law has no entitlement to a benefit.
In de Wet socialezekerheidsrechten gedetineerden is geregeld dat indien een persoon rechtens zijn vrijheid is ontnomen, deze geen recht heeft op een uitkering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Strafhof krijgt eigen cellen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Hague-based International Criminal Court's new holding cells, and the omission of them from the DJI Masterplan debates, were concealed, and whether the plans should be scrapped. The state secretary answered that the cells are only waiting rooms on court days, outside the Masterplan, so no prisons need closing, and declined to reconsider or relocate the court.
In view of the above, there was no reason to inform your House within the framework of the DJI Masterplan about these holding cells being built by the International Criminal Court.
Gelet op het bovenstaande was er geen aanleiding om uw Kamer in het kader van het Masterplan DJI te informeren over deze nieuw door het Internationaal Strafhof te bouwen bewaarcellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de publiek-private aanbesteding van een nieuw te bouwen penitentiaire inrichting te Zaanstad

Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rijksgebouwendienst will award the PPS prison project in Zaanstad to consortium Pi2, when the PPS trajectory started relative to the DJI Masterplan, what risks the state bears, and whether the award should be suspended pending consultation with parliament. Minister Plasterk answered that the award is planned for 22 July 2013, that the project followed existing ministerial policy and was reported in annual progress reports, that risks are allocated to the party best able to control them, and that suspending the award would cost about 30 million euro.
Do you think it would have been more logical to start such a trajectory only after consulting the House of Representatives?
Bent u van mening dat het meer voor de hand had gelegen om pas met een dergelijk traject te beginnen nadat met de Tweede Kamer was overlegd?

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vraag waarom rechters geen grondig feitenonderzoek zouden mogen plegen in asielzaken (ingezonden 11 juni 2013).

An MP asked the state secretary whether courts should be allowed to conduct a thorough fact review of asylum refusals, citing a doctoral study that marginal judicial review of asylum credibility conflicts with international and European law. The state secretary answered that credibility assessment rightly lies with the executive, that the courts' legality review is adequate, that no legislative change is currently needed, and that the implications of the new Procedures Directive will be examined later.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gebruik van DigiD door bewindvoerders ten gu

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked whether professional guardians (bewindvoerders) routinely request clients' DigiD login credentials, whether this is desirable, and whether fraud is possible. The state secretary answered that DigiD is personal and should not be shared, that DigiD Machtigen is not yet connected to most agencies, that a review and consultation with the professional associations are underway, and that no evidence of fraud is known.
Because DigiD is a personal means of identification, it is not desirable for guardians to appeal to beneficiaries to hand over their login details.
Omdat DigiD een persoonsgebonden middel is, is het niet wenselijk dat bewindvoerders een appèl doen op rechthebbenden om hun inloggegevens te verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat justitie door uitzetting een moeder van haar kinderen wil scheiden

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek plans to deport a Moroccan mother whose minor children hold Dutch nationality, and asks for an answer before the summer recess since she is in immigration detention. The State Secretary confirms the earlier questions were noted and says the questions were answered as quickly as possible.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de basisschool op asielzoekerscentrum Gilze dreigt te worden gesloten

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether closing the primary school at the Gilze asylum centre, which lacks extra funding for effective education of rejected asylum children, breaches children's right to education under the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government answered that schools can claim additional funding, that the threatened closure has been averted after talks, and that per-pupil funding for these groups will rise from the 2013–2014 school year.
That is why I recently decided to earmark €45,500 for the Prinsenbosschool to relieve the school's distress in the short term.
Daarom heb ik onlangs besloten de Prinsenbosschool een bedrag van € 45.500,00 in het vooruitzicht te stellen, om de nood op de school op korte termijn te lenigen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over uitspraken van de directeur van de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) inzake toepassing van de discretionaire bevoegdheid in de zaak van een dorststaker uit Kameroen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the IND director's statement that discretionary power was applied in a Cameroonian hunger striker's case, based on newly known facts, could be explained in a confidential letter to parliament. The state secretary declined, citing the principle of not discussing individual cases, while offering general information on policy implementation.
As I have already indicated in my earlier reply to your House, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.

Antwoord 2 Zoals ik reeds eerder heb aangegeven in mijn beantwoording aan uw Kamer ( 2013Z08916 ) vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het rapport inzake de luchtkwaliteit in celruimten in huizen van bewaring en gevangenissen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a report on air quality in prison cells, whether cell ventilation will meet standards quickly, the impact on the Masterplan DJI, the costs, and whether multi-person cell use is possible. The State Secretary answered that only ventilation capacity was measured, that the report has no consequences for the Masterplan, that ventilation cleaning protocols will be tested at selected locations with further measures if needed, that costs are unknown, and that multi-person cell use will only occur in suitable cells.
If the test with cleaning protocols does not achieve the desired results and other measures prove necessary, measures will be taken depending on the planned closure date.

Mocht de test met reinigingsprotocollen niet tot de gewenste resultaten leiden en mochten daardoor andere maatregelen noodzakelijk blijken, dan zullen afhankelijk van het tijdstip van voorgenomen sluiting maatregelen genomen worden.
Antwoord vragen Helder, Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht: ‘Discriminatie in cellen’

Three PVV MPs asked whether non-Muslim prisoners are being discriminated against by Muslim prisoners, whether Muslim prisoners gain undue influence, what measures will be taken, and how many prisoners hold dual nationality. The state secretary answered that no cases of structural discrimination or complaints to supervisory committees are known, that directors can sanction such conduct and file complaints, and that no further measures are needed.
I am not aware of any cases of (structural) discrimination of non-Islamic detainees by detainees with an Islamic background.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend van (structurele) discriminatie van niet-islamitische gedetineerden door gedetineerden met een islamitische achtergrond.

Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie over het terugsturen van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen naar een

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the CJEU ruling on transferring unaccompanied minors under the Dublin Regulation, including its consequences for Dutch policy and timing. The State Secretary said the ruling was still being studied, promised to inform parliament as soon as possible, and instructed IND not to claim unaccompanied minors back to other states except where a lawfully present family member exists and transfer is in the child's interest.
After I have carefully analysed the judgment, also taking into account the analyses of other Member States, I will inform your House about this as soon as possible.
Nadat ik het arrest zorgvuldig heb geanalyseerd, waarbij ik ook de analyses van de andere lidstaten wil betrekken, zal ik uw Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat justitie door uitzetting een moeder van haar kinderen wil scheiden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether it is in a child's interest to deport a Moroccan mother of Dutch-national children when the father cannot care for them, and how the best interests of the child are weighed. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that having Dutch children is not in itself a ground for a residence permit, and explained that the child's interests and the family-life test under Article 8 ECHR are weighed in the application process, while the decision to reject an application also implies a duty to leave.
As you know, in answer to written questions I do not provide information from individual case files.
Zoals u bekend is, verstrek ik in antwoord op schriftelijke vragen geen informatie uit individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking Uyghur interpreters suspected of leaking confidential information to Chinese authorities, whether they face prosecution, how they passed vetting, and what is being done for affected asylum seekers. The state secretary answered that a criminal complaint was filed, the interpreters were excluded from further use, all asylum cases were re-assessed with almost all granted asylum, and no Uyghurs were returned to China.
The IND has filed a criminal complaint against the interpreters concerned.
Er is door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) aangifte gedaan tegen de betreffende tolken.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een bericht over een “wraakactie” van cipiers tegen een verdachte

An MP asked the state secretary whether prison guards who posted threatening remarks about a detainee on Facebook had acted improperly and whether the matter warranted investigation. The government answered that the guards admitted the posts, were reprimanded, and that Bureau Integriteit judged further investigation unnecessary; it added that the case stands on its own.
Bureau Integriteit ultimately decided, in consultation with the directorate, that further investigation was not necessary in this case.
Bureau Integriteit heeft uiteindelijk in goed overleg met de directie besloten dat nader onderzoek in dit geval niet nodig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over schending van de gezinsherenigingsrichtlijnen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether he met Commissioner Reding in May 2013 about the EU family reunification directive, whether correspondence on a possible infringement procedure can be shared, and whether implementation will be revised after Commission and Children's Ombudsman criticism. The government confirms the meeting as routine preparation, denies discussing the directive, agrees to confidential access to the correspondence, and defers the substantive policy response to a separate letter.
Yes. As long as the correspondence does not enter the public domain, the Commission has no objection to (confidential) inspection.
Ja. Zolang de correspondentie niet in het publieke domein komt heeft de Commissie geen bezwaar tegen (vertrouwelijke) inzage.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de verslechtering van de veiligheidssituatie in bepaalde gebieden in Irak

MPs asked the state secretary about the worsening security situation in central Iraq and whether a new country report, a departure moratorium for asylum seekers, and asylum policy changes were warranted. The state secretary said an updated report on Iraq, including security by region and the position of ethnic and religious groups, is expected in autumn, and that a departure moratorium is not necessary at present while developments are monitored.
I have already asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs for an updated country report on the general situation in Iraq.
Ik heb reeds aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een geactualiseerd ambtsbericht gevraagd over algehele situatie in Irak.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch, Heijnen en Monasch over de toekomst van het Oranjehotel Scheveningen nu het kabinet van plan is de Scheveningse gevangenis te sluiten

MPs Marcouch, Heijnen and Monasch asked whether the government still supports keeping the Oranjehotel monument (Dodencel, Poortje, Gedenkplaat) after the planned closure of the Scheveningen prison, and how its future will be secured. The state secretary confirmed the monument should be preserved, said a future design is being developed with the Stichting Oranjehotel and that the detailed plan will follow once the DJI masterplan decision is taken.

Once the decision-making on the DJI Masterplan is completed, and it is therefore clear whether the PI Scheveningen will continue to exist, the Foundation, in consultation with the state, will further develop the preliminary design of a Oranjehotel Monument.

Zodra de besluitvorming over het Masterplan DJI is afgerond en daarmee ook duidelijk is of de PI Scheveningen blijft bestaan, zal de Stichting in samenspraak met het rijk het voorlopige ontwerp van een Monument Oranjehotel verder uitwerken.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het toepassen van het mvv-vereiste in gezinsmigratiezaken waar kinderen bij betrokken zijn

An MP asks whether the government will waive the mvv (provisional residence permit) requirement for a Dutch child's Nigerian mother in a family-migration case, citing ECHR and CRC principles. The state secretary declines to discuss the individual case, defends the mvv requirement as a pre-entry check, and says exemptions or the hardship clause may apply on the merits.
As is known, I cannot provide information about an individual case.
Zoals bekend kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over een individuele zaak.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over een nadere onderbouwing van de gemaakte keuzes met betrekking tot de bezuinigingen in de tbs-sector en een reactie op verzoek van het lid Van Toorenburg om een brief over het voor

MP Kooiman questioned the government's justification for closing FPC Veldzicht and FPC Oldenkotte, including unclear resocialisation figures, how building friction costs were calculated, the regional labour market impact, and the effect of transfers on treatment duration. Secretary Teeven defended the criteria and calculations, said the closures had been justified in writing, and stated that transfer delays would be minimised and measured.

In a letter of 11 June 2013 to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, I provided an explanation of the underlying information, including the weighting of the criteria for closing FPCs in forensic care.

Bij brief van 11 juni 2013 aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer heb ik een toelichting gegeven op de achterliggende informatie ten aanzien van onder meer de weging van de criteria voor de sluiting van FPC's in de forensische zorg.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Duitsers boos om asielbeleid Italië» (ingezonden 3 juni 2013).
