Azmani (VVD) asks the state secretary whether Italy's granting of temporary residence and travel documents to African refugees affects the Netherlands and what can be done about it. Teeven answers that few such persons have been found in the Netherlands, that he will support EU colleagues in asking Italy for clarification, and that persons without sufficient means can be ordered to return to Italy.
However, I will support my colleagues in Europe who do experience major consequences from the Italian approach and are now asking the Italian authorities for clarification.
Wel zal ik in Europees verband mijn collega's steunen die wel grote gevolgen ondervinden van de Italiaanse handelwijze en nu bij de Italiaanse autoriteiten om opheldering vragen.
Vragen van het lid De Wit (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat twee directieleden van Bureau Financieel Toezicht zijn opgestapt (ingezonden 4 juni 2013).

MP De Wit asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that two directors of the Bureau Financieel Toezicht resigned over a disagreement on the bureau's direction after its supervisory remit was expanded to integral supervision of notaries. The state secretary answered that the directors disagreed on the new working method and single-director structure, that the bureau's statutory supervisory tasks are unchanged, and that an interim director was appointed with the former directors acting as advisers.
The Bureau performs the following statutory supervisory tasks: integral supervision of notaries and financial supervision of bailiffs.
Het Bureau vervult de volgende wettelijke toezichtstaken: het integrale toezicht op notarissen en het financiële toezicht op gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het bericht dat een rechtsbijstandverzekeraar een belang heeft in een deurwaarderskantoor

MP De Wit (SP) asked the state secretary whether the revised Verordening Onafhankelijkheid for bailiffs (gerechtsdeurwaarders) safeguards their independence and how he views legal insurer DAS taking a 49% stake in bailiff firm Sensus Groep. The state secretary answered that he withheld approval of the revised regulation as contrary to the public interest, because it widens the circle of participants in bailiff firms, and that he will consider including independence in a forthcoming bill amending the Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet.
I am considering including the core value of independence – and where possible the safeguards for it – in a bill amending the Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet to be submitted to your House in the short term.

Ik overweeg de kernwaarde onafhankelijkheid – en zo mogelijk de waarborgen daarvoor – in een op korte termijn bij uw Kamer in te dienen wetsvoorstel ter wijziging van de Gerechtsdeurwaarderswet op te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Banken verkopen pingedrag klanten’

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the state secretary about reports that banks and Equens planned to sell customers' PIN-transaction data, and whether this violates the Dutch data protection act (Wbp). The government answered that Equens has suspended the plans, that whether the data are personal data and whether the Wbp is breached is for the independent data protection authority (CBP) to judge, and that the CBP sees no reason to open an investigation for now.
It is not for us to pronounce on whether the data concern personal data and whether this is compatible with the Wbp.
Het past ons niet een uitspraak te doen over de vragen of de gegevens persoonsgegevens betreffen en of sprake is van verenigbaarheid met de Wbp.
Antwoord vragen Aukje de Vries en Van der Steur over het bericht ‘Plan voor verkoop pingegevens winkels in ijskast na golf van kritiek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Justice State Secretary about Equens' plan to sell ping (debit card) payment data to shops, which was shelved after public criticism. The minister confirmed banks adhere to the data-processing code, that Equens acts as a processor bound by it, that the CBP supervises compliance, and that Equens has halted activities pending broad societal support.
Equens has indicated that the way it makes analyses and planned reports from the data it uses as processor amounts to processing data that are not, or no longer, personal data.

Equens heeft aangegeven dat de wijze waarop zij analyses en voorgenomen rapportages maakt van de door haar als bewerker gebruikte gegevens neerkomt op het verwerken van gegevens die niet of niet langer zijn aan te merken als persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over de behandeling van homoseksuele asielzoekers

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that gay asylum seekers are poorly treated and whether the asylum procedure and reception centres can be made safer for LGBT people. The State Secretary replied that a COC-agreed action plan based on an independent Deloitte study is in place, that the IND trains staff and has received no complaints about questioning on sexual orientation, and that about 90 possible discrimination cases in 2012 were handled under the regular protocol.
All recommendations from the report have either been adopted or adjusted in consultation with the COC.
Alle aanbevelingen uit het rapport zijn of overgenomen of in overleg met het COC aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over  ‘de additionele dekking van 69 miljoen bedoeld om wijzigingen in het masterplan Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen mee op te vangen’

An MP (D66) asked the State Secretary how the 69 million euro structural cover for revisions to the DJI masterplan is built from unpaid wage and price adjustments, which budget items are affected, and whether prisons will close. The State Secretary explained the wage/price adjustment mechanism, the reallocation schedule rising to 69 million by 2018, and that fewer prison closures and lower real-estate costs are expected, while stating that other items must absorb cost increases through efficiency measures.
Yes. X Footnote 1 DJI 2013–2018, Parliamentary paper 24 587, no. 490
Ja. X Noot 1 DJI 2013–2018, Kamerstuk 24 587, nr. 490
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over intimidatie en beïnvloedingspraktijken van buitenlandse overheden bij asielzoekers en migranten

An MP asked whether the AIVD has signs that Russia, like Iran and China, intimidates migrants and asylum seekers in the Netherlands, how the immigration chain handles such reports, whether asylum centres are approached by foreign intelligence services, whether staff are screened, how many people are intimidated and how their safety is ensured, and whether the Dolmatov case was investigated. The minister answered that there are no such signs at present, described the referral procedure to the AIVD and MIVD, said there are no concrete indications of foreign services approaching asylum centre residents, explained screening via VOG and security investigations, declined to give numbers publicly, and said the Dolmatov case was examined without leading to measures, while refusing further detail on current knowledge.
I cannot make any public statements about numbers.
Over aantallen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman over het op straat zetten van voormalige tentenkampbewoners

An MP asked whether former tent-camp residents at Ter Apel were told they would be made homeless from 17 June, and why, and asked the government to await the advisory report on a broader buitenschuld (no-fault) criterion. The state secretary denied a fixed cut-off date, said continued shelter depends on effort toward return, and said he would not anticipate the forthcoming advice.
In the short term the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will issue advice on the no-fault policy.
Op korte termijn komt de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) met een advies over het buitenschuldbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Schouw over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the state secretary whether Guinean laissez-passers for deportations were issued despite the Guinean ambassador's claim that he signed none, and why Guinea did not take part in taskforces. The state secretary answered that about 20 laissez-passers were obtained in 2013 from the Brussels mission, signed by the consul, that two deportations have taken place, and that there is no reason to suspend deportations to Guinea.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitspraken van een internist over het medisch beroepsgeheim en vreemdelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether an internist's claims that detained foreign nationals are accompanied by guards or police during medical consultations, and that this breaches medical confidentiality, are accurate, and whether the government will change its policy. The State Secretary replied that detainees receive necessary care, that supervision during hospital visits is justified on security grounds with confidentiality balanced case by case, and that he sees no need to revise the policy, while complaints can follow the usual route.

All in all, I am of the view that for reasons of security it may be justified, after careful weighing against the respect owed to the doctor's professional secrecy, to infringe on the doctor-patient confidentiality.

Al met al ben ik van mening dat het uit oogpunt van veiligheid gerechtvaardigd kan zijn om – na zorgvuldige weging het te respecteren beroepsgeheim van de arts – een inbreuk te maken op de arts-patiënt vertrouwelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how acquitted ICC suspect Ngudjolo could be released on Dutch soil, whether the ICC met its host-state duties, and how witnesses or acquitted suspects excluded from asylum under Article 1F would be handled. The government answered that the ICC must arrange transfer after acquittal, Dutch authorities facilitate it, structural arrangements with the ICC registry are being developed, and detained witnesses' cases are discussed in that context without individual details.
Regarding the status of the procedure, I maintain the principle that I do not comment on individual cases.
Wat betreft de stand van de procedure hanteer ik het uitgangspunt dat ik niet inga op individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over de veiligheid van homoseksuele asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the State Secretary about safety of LGBT asylum seekers in reception centres, incidents, discrimination reports, the Deloitte and COC reports, and the COC's recommendations. The State Secretary replied that COA, IND and DT&V have taken measures, about 90 possible discrimination cases were recorded in 2012 at reception locations, the IND reported no incidents, and he committed to continued dialogue with the COC while rejecting some COC demands such as blanket asylum for LGBT nationals of countries criminalising homosexuality.
Without further information, such as file numbers, it is not feasible to establish what exactly happened in these cases.
Het is, zonder nadere informatie, zoals bijvoorbeeld dossiernummers, niet haalbaar om na te gaan wat er in deze zaken exact gespeeld heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat het aantal toegewezen asielaanvragen in Nederland veel hoger ligt dan in de rest van de EU

An MP asked why the Netherlands grants asylum at a higher rate than other EU states, whether this stems from differing rules, and whether the state should cap admissions at 1,000 people. The state secretary attributed the gap to differences in countries of origin, implementation and procedure design, and rejected a cap because Dutch obligations under international norms require protection for those entitled to it.
The difference in grant rates between member states cannot be unambiguously explained.
Het verschil in de inwilligingspercentages tussen de lidstaten kan niet eenduidig worden verklaard.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over het verband tussen het verstrekken van vergunningen voor online kansspelen en gokverslaving

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked whether licensing online gambling would increase gambling addiction and what safeguards and measurement exist. The government answered that it does not expect an explosive rise, citing strict licence conditions (warnings, limits, a national exclusion register, a duty of care), monitoring every five years, and enforcement powers of the Kansspelautoriteit.
I do not have data on the private addiction care sector.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens van de «particuliere» verslavingszorgsector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de AT5 uitzending “Voortvluchtige A.A. werd steeds crimineler"

Labour MP Recourt asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about an AT5 broadcast on a fugitive who cut his ankle monitor, asking whether this occurred, what procedure applies, what actions followed, and how often offenders do this. The state secretary confirmed the bracelet was cut, described the notification procedure and the registration in the search register, acknowledged that monitoring cannot prevent all incidents, and said such cases occur only two to three times a year.
In the present case, the procedure was followed in full.
In de onderhavige casus is volledig conform genoemde procedure gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het Nederlandse visitatiebeleid in vreemdelingendetentie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about body search practices in immigration detention, including whether they comply with ECHR case law (Valasinas) and whether the policy should be revised before a new detention law. The State Secretary explained the legal basis and restrictive internal criteria for body searches, said the courts can review individual cases, and declined to revise the policy ahead of the forthcoming bill.
Whether body searches in individual cases were lawfully applied can be reviewed by the judge on the basis of the concrete circumstances of the case.
Of het onderzoek aan het lichaam in individuele gevallen rechtmatig is toegepast kan door de rechter worden getoetst aan de hand van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het uitbreiden van gokhallen en kansspelmogelijkheden

An SP MP asked the state secretary about plans by hospitality firms such as Van der Valk and Hof van Putte to open gambling halls, which municipalities license, and how casino gaming and oversight are organised. The state secretary replied that the halls are slot-machine halls licensed locally, that the Kansspelautoriteit holds a complete sector overview through annual reporting, and that municipalities alone decide on locations and no 'wildgroei' exists.
It is up to individual municipalities to decide whether and for which location they want to grant presence permits for slot-machine halls.
Het is aan individuele gemeenten om te bepalen of en voor welke locatie zij aanwezigheidsvergunningen voor speelautomatenhallen willen verlenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over toezicht op advocaten

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the supervision of lawyers after a Haarlem court case involving two advocates and a possible criminal plot, and how a dean can act on complaints or concerns. The state secretary answered that the dean is responsible for investigating the lawyers' conduct, that anyone may report concerns to the dean, and that the roles of both lawyers are currently under investigation, while also referring to a bill proposing a supervisory college for the legal profession.
It is not for me but for the dean to carry out such an investigation.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de deken om een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Schouw en Voordewind over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked about cooperation between the Guinean embassy in Brussels and the Guinean taskforce in the Netherlands on deportations, why a May 2013 taskforce was postponed, and whether there is a dispute between them. The state secretary answered that presentations are coordinated with both channels, that the postponement was due to unspecified Guinean reasons, that he knows of no dispute, and that about 100 travel documents were issued in 2012 with roughly a third of those returned, with no reason to suspend deportations.
I am not aware of any disagreement between the Guinean taskforce and the Guinean government.
Van onenigheid tussen de Guineese taskforce en de Guineese overheid is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het rapport ‘DNA-onderzoek bij veroordeelde minderjarigen’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Children's Ombudsman's report on DNA collection from convicted minors, which argues it breaches children's rights under the IVRK, was sound and whether the government would act on its recommendations. The state secretary rejected the recommendations, arguing the DNA Act applies equally to minors and adults, is limited to serious offences, and is consistent with ECHR case law.
For the reasons set out in the answers to questions 4 through 6, I do not adopt any of the Children's Ombudsman's recommendations.
Ik neem om de redenen zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 4 tot en met 6 geen van de aanbevelingen van de Kinderombudsman over.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de fiscale regeling voor hypotheekrenteaftrek

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether homeowners who already enjoyed mortgage interest deduction on a previous home can only get deduction on a new loan if its term is shortened, and how the rules work in such cases. The State Secretary explained the transitional and new rules, said the shortened-term outcome is undesirable, and announced a policy decision allowing a 360-month repayment period with the deduction period shortened by the earlier period.
Pending legislation, I will shortly approve in a policy decision that in cases like this one, the new home loan may be repaid over 360 months.
Vooruitlopend op wetgeving zal ik op korte termijn in een beleidsbesluit goedkeuren dat in gevallen als het onderhavige, de nieuwe eigenwoningschuld in 360 maanden mag worden afgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Schouw van Uw Kamer over de medische behandeling van vreemdelingen

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Schouw asked the state secretary about the medical treatment of a hunger-striking asylum seeker at a Rotterdam detention centre, including allegations of mistreatment by a physician and restricted access for the trusted doctor. The state secretary defended the use of force by an internal assistance team, said the detainee refused a medical examination, referred the assault complaint to a police investigation, and stated that access and care procedures were followed.
If the outcomes give reason to do so, I will inform your House confidentially about this individual case.
Indien de uitkomsten daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik uw Kamer vertrouwelijk over deze individuele casus informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlanders op talibanscholen

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether they knew of Dutch nationals studying at Taliban-linked schools in Pakistan, which nationalities they hold, how many Dutch nationals attend Islamic institutions abroad, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled on return. The minister confirmed awareness, said travel is unregistered so the numbers cannot be tracked, and explained that denaturalisation is possible only after a terrorism conviction and only where the person holds another nationality.
It is therefore not possible to keep track of who travels to Pakistan, or abroad in general, nor which educational institutions they attend.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk bij te houden wie er naar Pakistan, of het buitenland in het algemeen, reist noch wie welke onderwijsinstellingen bezoekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat 20 procent van de illegalen medische zorg wordt geweigerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a report that one in five undocumented migrants was refused medical care in 2012, and whether the Gesthuizen motion had been implemented. The State Secretary replied that a letter on care for undocumented migrants would be sent shortly by the health minister, which would also report on implementing the motion.
The minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform the House about the implementation of the aforementioned motion in the earlier-mentioned letter.
Bij eerder genoemde brief van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport wordt uw Kamer bericht over de uitvoering van voornoemde motie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht op grond van de Wet op het financieel toezicht op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether banks demanding AFM licences from court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) to open accounts can be stopped, given the minister's promised exemption. The minister confirmed the promise, said he asked the banks' association to inform members, and aims to publish the exemption by 1 July 2013, retroactive to 26 February.
I have therefore asked the NVB to point its members to my commitment and my intention with it.
Ik heb de NVB daarom gevraagd haar leden te wijzen op mijn toezegging en mijn bedoeling daarmee.
Antwoord vragen Oskam over de berichten ‘Gokbranche wil lagere belasting’ en ‘Het Nederlandse model voor gokken op internet komt eraan’

Oskam (CDA) asked whether the government should accept online gambling firms' demands for a much lower gambling tax rate, and how it would prevent evasion from tax havens like Malta. The government confirms it is considering a lower 20 percent rate for remote gambling, arguing a high rate drives players to illegal operators, and says a strong regulated regime and enforcement will address evasion.
A lower rate for legal remote gambling is indeed being considered.
Een lager tarief voor legale kansspelen op afstand wordt inderdaad overwogen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het onzorgvuldig handelen van de overheid waar het gaat om het verzamelen en aan elkaar koppelen van persoonsgegevens

An MP asks the State Secretary and Interior Minister about government data linking and purpose limitation, citing the Dutch privacy regulator's warning of growing overreach and declining citizen transparency. The government answers that data linking is a deliberate choice within existing law, supports purpose limitation and the 'select before you collect' principle, points to MijnOverheid and access rights as transparency tools, and declines to give a substantive response to the regulator's annual report.
The cabinet therefore endorses the 'select before you collect' principle advised by the Advisory Committee on Security and Personal Privacy to avoid creating a 'digital haystack'.

Het kabinet onderschrijft dan ook het door de Adviescommissie veiligheid en persoonlijke levenssfeer gehanteerde uitgangspunt van «select before you collect» om te vermijden dat een «digitale hooiberg» ontstaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Gesthuizen over een humaan asielbeleid

MPs Schouw (D66) and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about a more humane asylum policy, covering the wider policy direction, the return policy and the ground-for-no-fault criterion, criminalisation of illegal stay and aid to illegal migrants, the illegals quota for police, and conditions and numbers in immigration detention. The state secretary answered that the current policy leaves room for humane treatment, pointed to planned reviews, the forthcoming bill on criminalising illegal stay, and reduced detention capacity plans, while declining to discuss an illegals quota.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreigners often switch an existing residence permit to 'knowledge migrant' status and whether the 30% tax ruling for expats should be denied to those already living in the Netherlands. The government answered that 1,130 (2010) and 1,260 (2011) such changes occurred, and that people already resident on another basis are excluded from the 30% ruling unless they are students, interns or PhD candidates.
Employees who already reside in the Netherlands on another residence basis are not eligible for the 30% ruling, unless they reside in the Netherlands as a student, intern or PhD candidate.

Werknemers die reeds op grond van een ander verblijfsdoel in Nederland verblijven, komen niet in aanmerking voor de 30%-regeling, tenzij zij in Nederland als student, stagiair of promovendus verblijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de zorgelijke toename van het aantal herhaalde asielaanvragen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why repeat asylum applications have risen sharply, whether the eight-day procedure is to blame, which policy changes cause them, what share end in approval, and whether the rise will be studied. The State Secretary attributes repeat applications to varied motives and policy developments, says the approval share cannot be given due to the IND system transition, and states that the rise will be addressed through existing measures and the PIVA evaluation later in 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Criminele Roma-families zetten eigen kinderen in’

MPs Azmani and Dijkhoff asked about reports that criminal Roma families use their own children in crime, including whether children are freed after arrest, whether birth registration and GBA deregistration hinder oversight, and what measures will be taken. The minister confirms a Police Academy study showing children involved in property crime, says there is no insight into amounts stolen, refers to earlier answers on prosecuting parents and GBA rules, and promises a joint programme to implement the study's recommendations.
In a joint programme with my colleague of Social Affairs and Employment, we will translate these recommendations into measures.
In een gezamenlijk programma met mijn collega van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gaan wij deze aanbevelingen omzetten in maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over zelfmoordpogingen in grensdetentie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about two suicide attempts in border detention and how psychiatric care, lawyer notification, isolation and Dublin cases are handled. The State Secretary answered that standard medical intake and crisis procedures were followed, that lawyers are not automatically informed, and that he will send a future vision on alternatives to detention before the summer recess.
An attempted suicide in border detention on 14 March 2013 is not known to me.
Een poging tot suïcide in grensdetentie op 14 maart 2013 is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een ernstig zieke vreemdeling

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why a seriously ill Togolese former unaccompanied minor, resident over eleven years, faces deportation, why the state appealed a court ruling in his favour, and whether the discretionary power should be used. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, restated the medical-stay procedure and the general policy framework, and said rootedness is not an objective criterion.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma het bericht dat een dorststaker een verblijfsvergunning heeft gekregen

Fritsma (PVV) asks the state secretary whether a Cameroonian asylum seeker on hunger/thirst strike was granted a residence permit, on what basis, and whether this undermines admission criteria and signals to others that protest works. Teeven declines to discuss the individual case, states that a hunger or thirst strike is not a ground for residence, but that individual dossier indications must still be considered.
As the House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Ypma over een illegale verstandelijk gehandicapte jongen die in een schoolbus is opgepakt en een week in vreemdelingenbewaring heeft verbleven

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Ypma asked the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice about a mentally disabled undocumented youth stopped in a car and held in immigration detention for about a week, asking why he was detained, whether his vulnerability was considered, and whether a 48-hour judicial review should be introduced. The state secretary answered that the vulnerability was unknown to police and not reported, detention was justified by the risk of absconding, compensation was offered, and a future policy vision would follow, while declining to examine the case further beyond answering the questions.
Personal information about the person concerned and his immigration status has been limited as much as possible in these answers, given his privacy.
Persoonlijke informatie over betrokkene en zijn vreemdelingrechtelijke status is zo veel als mogelijk beperkt in deze antwoorden, gelet op zijn privacy.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Verstandelijk beperkte jongen week vast in Amsterdamse cel

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report that a young man with an intellectual disability was held in an Amsterdam cell for five days after a police stop, asking whether this was proper, whether he was denied family contact and food, and whether aftercare will be provided. The State Secretary answers that the stop and detention followed procedure, that the youth's disability was not reported and gave no reason for care, that no aftercare will be arranged, but that detention was not the most suitable measure, so a damages offer was made to the lawyer.
In view of the information about the person that became known afterwards, detention was not the most appropriate measure.
Gelet op de informatie over de persoon van betrokkene die achteraf bekend is geworden, was inbewaringstelling niet het meest geëigende middel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat Mediamarkt zonder toestemming personeelsleden heeft gefilmd

An MP asked whether a report that Media Markt secretly filmed staff was accurate, whether privacy law was breached, what the Data Protection Authority (CBP) was doing and whether the apology was sufficient. The minister said the CBP is responsible for deciding whether the law was breached and any sanctions, declined to comment on ongoing investigations, and noted planned extension of CBP fining powers.
The CBP in principle makes no statements about possible or ongoing investigations.
Het CBP doet in beginsel geen uitspraken over mogelijke of lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Syrische familie wordt uitgezet naar Polen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a Syrian family would be deported to Poland, citing reported poor reception conditions and possible violations of the Return Directive, and asked whether the Dublin transfer would be reconsidered. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, stated that Dublin transfers are barred where Article 3 ECHR or Article 4 of the EU Charter would be breached, and said the government is not responsible for checking other member states' compliance with EU law.

As I indicated in my answers to the questions of MP Maij, a transfer to a member state may not take place if the foreign national would be subjected to inhuman or degrading treatment within the meaning of Article 3 ECHR or Article 4 of the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Maij heb aangegeven, mag een overdracht naar een lidstaat niet plaatsvinden indien de vreemdeling in die lidstaat onmenselijk of vernederend wordt behandeld in de zin van artikel 3 EVRM of artikel 4 van het Handvest van de Grondrechten van de EU.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over slechte opvangomstandigheden van asielzoekers in Polen

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported poor reception conditions and inaccessible asylum procedures for asylum seekers in Poland, including a critical NGO report on guarded centres. The minister answered that Poland has announced reforms, that the government cannot judge the Polish system, that the Commission oversees EU law, and that Dutch Dublin transfers are checked against article 3 ECHR and article 4 of the EU Charter.
Of course I am willing to ask my Polish colleague on the margins of the Council about relevant developments.
Uiteraard ben ik wel bereid om mijn Poolse collega en marge van de Raad te vragen naar relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de kaalslag in de forensische zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether a 120 million euro cut to forensic care would reduce treatment, leave, recidivism outcomes and staff conditions. The State Secretary answered that the budget falls from 725 to 602 million euro by 2017, that a convenant with sector bodies sets a shorter average tbs treatment duration and protects quality, and that the cuts are unavoidable though he will try to soften staff impacts.
The cuts at DJI, and therefore also those on the forensic care budget, are unavoidable.
De bezuinigingen op DJI, en dus ook die op het budget voor forensische zorg, zijn onvermijdelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de prejudiciële vragen die de Raad van State heeft gesteld over de beoordeling van de homoseksualiteit van vreemdelingen

MP Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the Council of State's preliminary questions to the EU Court on how to assess the claimed homosexuality of asylum seekers, including effects on pending cases, assessment standards, and reports of observation in psychiatric facilities in Poland, Bulgaria and Romania. The State Secretary replied that the questions do not change IND policy, that the IND's approach is careful and respects personal integrity, that the courts decide on suspension, and that Poland and Romania denied the practice while Bulgaria's information is still awaited.
It is up to the judge whether appeal procedures will be suspended.
Het is aan de rechter of procedures in (hoger) beroep zullen worden aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tbs’er in kliniek gepakt met kinderporno’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a tbs patient and an accomplice caught viewing child pornography on a smartphone smuggled into a forensic clinic, asking how contraband reached the ward, whether the public's trust is damaged, whether the patient had prior similar convictions, and what measures will prevent smuggling. The State Secretary confirmed the arrests, said a incident report was requested from the clinic, withheld individual offence details on privacy grounds, defended the tbs system with recidivism figures, and promised access control via the Forensische Zorg bill and a later letter on re-imposing tbs.
For privacy reasons, offence details of individual tbs patients are not made public.
Uit privacyoverwegingen worden (delict-)gegevens van individuele tbs-gestelden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Azmani over de uitvoering van de “koudweerregeling” die regelt dat uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen niet uit de opvang worden geplaatst als het vriest

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how the informal 'cold weather arrangement' (vorstcoulance) for rejected asylum seekers is applied, including criteria, whether COA evicted people during recent cold periods, how it handles forecast frost, and whether it will consult municipalities. The State Secretary answered that it is an informal COA practice, denied evictions during frost periods, said forecast-frost cases are weighed case by case, and saw no reason for consultation now, though the topic could be raised in regular VNG meetings.
COA ensures that during the frost period foreigners are not put out on the street by COA.
Het COA draagt er zorg voor dat vreemdelingen tijdens de vorstperiode niet door het COA op straat gezet worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het ontbreken van Nederlandse immigratie- en asielgegevens in de rapportages van Eurostat

An MP asked why Dutch asylum and immigration data are missing from Eurostat overviews and whether they can be supplied, and about return figures. The State Secretary answered that data for 2012 could not be delivered due to the conversion from INDIS to INDiGO, to be supplied retroactively after completion, and that no return figures from countries of origin are held.
Once the conversion of the active 2012 files is completed, the data will be made available retroactively.
Nadat de conversie van de actieve dossiers 2012 is voltooid, zullen de gegevens met terugwerkende kracht beschikbaar worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de sluiting van de basisschool op het asielzoekerscentrum in Gilze wegens geldgebrek

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the primary school at the Gilze asylum centre would close for lack of funds, why money was not spent, and whether children's right to education would be guaranteed. The government said the school board decides on closure, housing was resolved via COA funds, the financial problem is being examined with the board, and that a solution aims to prevent closure.
The decision whether or not to keep a school open rests with the school board concerned.
Het besluit om een school wel of niet open te houden is aan het betreffende schoolbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Terbeschikkingstelling (TBS) - klinieken verdienen goud geld aan TBS-ers, andere patiënten creperen?

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the state secretary about a report alleging TBS clinics profit from TBS patients while neglecting others, with thin therapy and lax leave rules. Teeven denied the description, cited evidence-based treatment programmes, a no-drugs policy and low recidivism figures, and rejected the claim of widespread demotivation.
I do not recognise the description of this alleged employee.
De beschrijving van deze vermeende medewerker herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen De Wit en Karabulut over de toetredingsvoorwaarden van de Wet Schuldsanering Natuurlijke Personen

MPs De Wit and Karabulut asked why the ten-year bar on re-entering the Wsnp debt-restructuring scheme exists, how often the exceptions are used, and whether the government will introduce a shorter term or a general hardship clause after a Supreme Court ruling and Advocate-General conclusion criticising the rule. The state secretary answered that the rule was deliberately made mandatory in 2008, that at least 237 people were re-admitted within ten years, and that he sees no reason to shorten the term or generalise the hardship clause.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hamer over het bericht “Vraag geen verlof aan voor staking DJI!

MPs Marcouch and Hamer asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security's circular on union actions wrongly required staff to request leave for strike participation, and whether those staff should have leave reversed. The state secretary acknowledged the wording wrongly suggested leave was required, clarified that pay is withheld only when working time is used without leave, and issued a corrected letter with a special arrangement for the 25 April action.
With this wording, the suggestion was unintentionally created that action may only be taken if leave has been taken.
Met deze formulering is onbedoeld de suggestie gewekt dat alleen actie mag worden gevoerd als verlof is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het categorisch weigeren van mediacontacten van personen werkzaam in het gevangeniswezen

MP Kooiman asked whether prison-service staff are categorically barred from speaking to national media and how many requests were refused, and asked about the rationale given. The state secretary replied that twelve requests were forwarded to the Directorate of Communications since the last answers and all were granted, and that restraint before parliamentary hearings is considered appropriate with contact allowed afterwards.
Since the answering of the previous parliamentary questions, a total of twelve requests have been submitted to the Ministry's Directorate of Communications. All of these have been granted.
Sinds de beantwoording van de vorige Kamervragen zijn in totaal twaalf verzoeken voorgelegd aan de Directie Voorlichting van het Ministerie. Deze zijn alle gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hilkens, Oosenbrug en Ypma over de bescherming en de bewustwording van jongeren op internet

MPs Hilkens, Oosenbrug and Ypma asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about youth protection and awareness on the internet, including the Digibewust finding that two-thirds of 12-16 year olds had a bad online experience, parental awareness, consent for minors' online profiles, the handling of grooming and the Meldknop website. The government disputed the two-thirds figure citing SCP research, pointed to existing criminal law, Mediawijzer.net, CBP guidance and EU strategy, and largely answered on substance without committing to new concrete steps.
I cannot confirm this conclusion from the YoungWorks research commissioned by Digibewust on the basis of my own data.
Deze conclusie uit het onderzoek van YoungWorks in opdracht van Digibewust kan ik niet op basis van eigen gegevens bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de plannen van Holland Casino om online gokken aan te bieden

An MP asked the state secretary whether Holland Casino's plans to offer online gambling, including a tender for an online platform, mean it will obtain a licence and whether insider knowledge risks are being avoided. The government answered that a European tender is underway, that no licence is guaranteed, that the licensing rules will be set out in a draft bill for internet consultation, and that Holland Casino has been consulted on regulation.
I aim to put this draft bill into internet consultation at the end of April, so that everyone is informed about it at the same time.
Ik streef ernaar dit concept-wetsvoorstel eind april in internetconsultatie te brengen, zodat een ieder daarover tegelijk wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Misdaad levert een huurwoning op”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that criminals receive priority for rental housing while ordinary citizens wait years, and whether such priority can be ruled out. The minister replied that the Amsterdam 'Pak je kans' project offers temporary housing only to former offenders who work or study, on a strict protocol, in former municipal service dwellings not part of the regular stock, and that there is no priority for regular rental housing.
There is no question of priority for the named group in obtaining a regular rental home.
Er is voor de genoemde groep geen sprake van voorrang voor het krijgen van een regulier huurhuis.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het rapport ‘Verloren tijd’

PVV MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government agrees that asylum seekers should not receive day-care, education or recreation while cuts hit care for the elderly and disabled, and asked for the ACVZ report 'Verloren tijd' to be destroyed. State Secretary Teeven confirmed receipt of the advice and said a full government response will follow within three months, without taking a position on the substance yet.
As is customary, a government response to the report of the Advisory Committee on Migration Affairs (ACVZ) will be sent to the House of Representatives within three months of publication.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk wordt binnen drie maanden na verschijning van een rapport van de Adviescommissie voor Vreemdelingenzaken (ACVZ) een kabinetsreactie aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht “Veel Zuid-Europeanen naar Nederland”.

MPs Madlener and Fritsma asked the government about a news report on rising numbers of Southern European nationals in the Netherlands and what would be done to control this immigration. The government responded that EU free movement rights apply, that the numbers differ from CBS figures, and that it will keep enforcing income requirements and tackling exploitation while continuing existing initiatives.

As long as citizens from another member state meet the conditions for free movement of persons and thus do not place an unreasonable burden on social provisions in our country, we see no reason to oppose their arrival in the Netherlands and participation in Dutch society.

Zolang burgers uit een andere lidstaat voldoen aan de voorwaarden die gesteld worden aan het vrij verkeer van personen en daarmee dus geen onredelijke belasting vormen voor sociale voorzieningen in ons land, zien wij geen reden om afwijzend te staan tegen hun komst naar Nederland en deelname aan de Nederlandse samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind  en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘IJsland wil porno blokkeren’

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about Iceland's plan to block internet pornography and about what is known of its effects on Dutch children, including exposure, help-seeking and research. The government answered that Iceland's plans are only under study, that the evidence on harm is mostly correlational, and that no further research is considered necessary beyond the ongoing NHL study.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport and I do not consider initiating additional research necessary.
Het entameren van aanvullend onderzoek achten de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over interlandelijke adoptie uit Ethiopië

Member Recourt (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about intercountry adoptions from Ethiopia, following a Brandpunt broadcast alleging fraud and irregular procedures, and asked whether Vereniging Wereldkinderen should be suspended and how adoption safeguards are controlled. The State Secretary Teeven answered that no fraud was found but procedural irregularities occurred, extra safeguards were introduced in 2010, no new adoptions via Wereldkinderen occurred after 2010, and he sees no reason to suspend procedures.
There was no fraud in adoptions from Ethiopia.
Er is niet gefraudeerd met adopties vanuit Ethiopië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over interlandelijke adoptie uit Ethiopië

MP De Wit (SP) asked the state secretary for Security and Justice how he responds to broadcasts alleging irregularities in intercountry adoptions from Ethiopia, whether adoptions should be halted, what safeguards exist, and whether the licensed agency Wereldkinderen should be investigated and past cases re-examined. The state secretary answered that the irregularities date from 2009 and earlier, that additional safeguards were introduced, that no investigation of Wereldkinderen or of past adoptions is planned, and that adoptive families will be informed where biological parents come forward.
I see no reason to launch an investigation into the role of the association Wereldkinderen.
Ik zie geen aanleiding onderzoek in te stellen naar de rol van vereniging Wereldkinderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het bericht dat het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie slecht samenwerkt met de Nationale ombudsman

SP MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to respond to press reports that the ministry cooperates poorly with the National Ombudsman, whose criticism described it as immune to criticism and hard to work with. Minister Opstelten answered that he takes the criticism note of, responds to all requests, follows most recommendations, holds consultations where he does not adopt one, and will consult the ombudsman more often and improve deadline monitoring.
I answer all requests from the ombudsman.
Ik geef op alle verzoeken van de ombudsman antwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Oosten over interlandelijke adopties uit Ethiopië

Two VVD MPs asked whether Wereldkinderen, which receives MFS-II development funds, financed intercountry adoptions in Ethiopia exposed by Brandpunt, and what the government will do about adoption procedures and the legal status of adoptions obtained irregularly. The state secretary answered that the adoptions predate MFS-II funding, that adoption agencies receive no government money, and that existing safeguards suffice, with no new action planned.
In view of these measures, it is not necessary to take action now.
Gelet op deze maatregelen is het niet noodzakelijk om nu actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Ypma over het geadopteerde Chinese meisje dat na drie weken bij een pleeggezin is ondergebracht

MPs Recourt and Ypma asked the state secretaries about a Chinese adopted girl placed with a foster family after three weeks, the Inspectorate's findings, whether the Central Authority was informed, adoption-matching failures and aftercare. The government answered that the adoptive parents did not inform the intermediary or Central Authority, that the Central Authority of China was informed afterwards, that the Inspectorate's recommendations will feed into an evaluation of the quality framework, and that VWS will report on aftercare in the first half of 2013.
The quality framework for intercountry adoption intermediaries is currently being evaluated.
Momenteel wordt het kwaliteitskader voor de vergunninghouders interlandelijke adoptie geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de toename van het aantal vluchtelingen vanuit Syrië

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked about the rising number of Syrian refugees, EU strategy, family reunification and visa policy for Syrians. The state secretary replied that the EU has seen asylum applications from Syrians rise sharply, that EASO and emergency funds exist for member states, that the Temporary Protection Directive is not yet triggered, that Netherlands issues no visas on protection grounds, and that EU and member states have committed substantial humanitarian funding.
The Netherlands does not issue visas for reasons of international protection.
Nederland verstrekt geen visa om redenen van internationale bescherming.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over het bericht dat circa 100 huizen van Pakistaanse christenen zijn verbrand vanwege vermeende belediging van Mohammed

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether the Pakistani government adequately protects Christian minorities after about 100 homes were burned over an alleged blasphemy case, and why Christians are not classed as a risk group for asylum purposes. The state secretary answered that Pakistani authorities often fail to protect and prosecute perpetrators, that no reliable data on 2012 incidents exists, and that after considering the Lahore incident he still does not consider Pakistani Christians a risk group.
No, there is no reliable information available on this.
Nee, er is hierover geen betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over fraude bij Holland Casino

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Holland Casino staff suspected of fraud were given time to self-report in exchange for job guarantees, and about whether crimes should be reported to police, the number of criminal complaints filed since 2012, existing government supervision, and the plans to privatise the casino. The government answered that Holland Casino handles integrity matters through internal procedures, that seven complaints were filed since 2012, that several oversight bodies supervise the casino, and that privatisation plans are being prepared with a letter to parliament promised before summer.
The company has both confidential advisers and a whistleblower scheme.
Het bedrijf kent zowel vertrouwenspersonen als een klokkenluidersregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two SP MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking interpreters suspected of leaking information to Chinese authorities about Uyghurs in the Netherlands, how interpreters are screened, and what the consequences are. The government answered that an AIVD warning concerned these individuals only, that screening rules apply, that about 1,000 case files used these interpreters with 75 percent granted asylum, and that the Minister of Foreign Affairs asked China for clarification.
In about 75 percent of these files asylum protection was granted.
In ongeveer 75 procent van deze dossiers is asielbescherming toegekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het spreekverbod voor gevangenisdirecteuren en gevangenispersoneel en de verhouding tot de vrijheid van meningsuiting

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether prison directors and staff may speak publicly about the Masterplan DJI 2013-2018 and whether a gag order exists, questioning its compatibility with freedom of expression. The State Secretary answered that staff may speak to local and regional media, that contacts with national press must be coordinated with the ministry's communications directorate, that no gag order was imposed, and that the existing policy will not be changed.
There has been no question of a gag order.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een spreekverbod.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en De Wit over verplichte omgang tussen ouder en kind na levensdelicten

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether contact between a child and a parent who killed the child's other parent should be allowed, whether the law gives enough grounds to refuse it, and whether the law should change. The state secretary agreed the child's interest must come first, announced a WODC study, said the law already allows refusal if contact is not in the child's interest, and stated he intends to amend the law so that the initiative for contact lies with the child rather than the parent.
I intend to amend the law.
Ik ben voornemens de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over leges

An MP asks the state secretary whether leges for residence permits must be reduced following the CJEU and Raad van State rulings, whether the cost-recovery principle still applies, and why leges for replacing a foreigner's document are much higher than for Dutch or EU identity documents. The state secretary answers that leges for study and research were lowered, medical-ground permits are unaffected since they are national, cost recovery remains the principle subject to EU law, and higher fees for foreigners' documents reflect the extra checks the IND must perform.
I therefore see no reason to adjust these fees downward.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om deze leges naar beneden bij te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de achterstanden bij de tenuitvoerlegging van gevangenisstraffen, de vakantieplannen en het vaststellen van de identiteit van veroordeelden

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the state secretary about long delays before prison sentences are enforced, whether offenders' holiday plans should be accommodated, and whether sentences should be suspended for those lacking identity documents. The state secretary disputed the RTL figures as indicative only, promised a norm for starting enforcement, said a booked holiday will no longer be grounds for postponement, and said the letter will be amended on the identity document point.
That is why I am working with partners in the enforcement chain to formulate a standard for starting the enforcement of prison sentences.
Daarom werk ik samen met de partners in de executieketen aan het formuleren van een norm voor het starten van de tenuitvoerlegging van gevangenisstraffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de moord op een christelijke asielzoeker

The MP asks the State Secretary whether a Christian asylum seeker murdered after converting was threatened, whether COA knew, and what protections exist for converted Christians in asylum centres. The State Secretary answers that COA was aware of his faith, received no threat reports, and that existing measures and interest groups provide adequate protection, while rejecting an independent confidential contact person.
I do not share the view that an independent confidential contact person should be set up through which asylum seekers can, if needed anonymously, first report violence and intimidation.
De mening dat er een onafhankelijke vertrouwenspersoon moet worden ingesteld waarbij asielzoekers, zonodig anoniem, een eerste melding kunnen doen van geweld en intimidatie, deel ik niet.

Vragen van het lid Arib(PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vaak niet melden van de dood van een minderjarige (ingezonden 6 maart 2013).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice and the Minister of Health about the low rate of reporting of deaths of minors to municipal coroners, the new NODO procedure, and whether obduction without suspicion of abuse complies with Article 8 ECHR. The government answers that reporting is improving, attributes low 2010 rates to physician unfamiliarity, states that case numbers are about fifty per year, and justifies compulsory obduction as proportionate.
In consultation with professional associations and the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG), awareness of the reporting obligation will be increased.
In overleg met beroepsverenigingen en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) zal de bekendheid van de meldplicht worden vergroot.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een Afghaanse vreemdeling die in Nederland een 1F-status heeft toch een vergunning krijgt in België

MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary about reports that an Afghan person suspected of war crimes under article 1F received a residence permit in Belgium after years of failed proceedings in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch 1F policy should be revised. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case in detail, explained that Belgium granted a residence card on EU family-link grounds outside Dutch responsibility, rejected the call to revise the policy, and gave statistics on 1F investigations and rejections.
The issuing of residence cards by Belgium does not fall under my responsibility.
De afgifte van verblijfskaarten door België valt niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht dat loverboyslachtoffers hun veiligste haven verliezen

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether no closed youth care facility for girls remains in the Netherlands after the merger of two institutions, and how safe care for loverboy victims is ensured. The State Secretary answered that capacity exists in open and closed youth care across regions, that some girls-only categorical groups exist, that professionals choose between mixed and girls-only groups case by case, and that a categorical pilot is only in an exploratory phase.
With the merger of the institutions De Lindenhorst and Almata, there are no youth care plus institutions where only girls reside.
Met het samengaan van de instellingen De Lindenhorst en Almata zijn er in de jeugdzorg plus geen instellingen waar uitsluitend meisjes verblijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Jasper van Dijk over kinderen die noodgedwongen bij hun ouders moeten aankloppen ondanks een ontbrekende band of voogdij

SP MPs asked whether students who cannot ask a parent without custody or a parent who is absent or refuses to pay can qualify for the supplementary grant, and how many are affected. The minister explained the existing 'weigerachtige of onvindbare ouders' rule, saw no need for further research or a new solution, and noted the rule will be abolished under the coalition agreement, with a hardship clause under study.
It is not registered how many students with parents who have been removed or deprived of parental authority do not receive a supplementary grant based on parental income.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel studenten met ouders die uit het gezag zijn ontheven of ontzet op basis van het inkomen van de ouders geen aanvullende beurs krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Nader Onderzoek Doods Oorzaak (NODO) meldplicht (ingezonden 1 maart 2013).

An MP asks the Interior Minister about research showing that only about 51.4% of deaths of minors were reported to municipal coroners under the NODO reporting duty in 2010, and what will be done to raise compliance. The state secretary replies that the low rate reflects early unfamiliarity and reluctance among doctors, that reporting is not tracked centrally, and that awareness campaigns and communication to civil registry officials will be stepped up.
In consultation with professional associations and the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG), awareness of the reporting duty will be increased.
In overleg met beroepsverenigingen en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) zal de bekendheid van de meldplicht worden vergroot.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

An MP asked whether a baby house with an anonymous foundling hatch in Dordrecht conflicts with children's right to know their parents and with better care for pregnant women in need. The government answered that such a hatch breaches children's rights, pointed to a confidential-birth protocol and planned reforms of women's shelter care, and said babyhouse carers are not screened as foster parents under youth-care law.
The babyhouse therefore does not fall under the regular supervision of the inspectorate.
Het babyhuis valt daardoor niet onder het reguliere toezicht van de inspectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over reclame voor kansspelen

An MP asks the state secretary whether gambling advertisements comply with the statistical-odds and responsible-gambling warning requirements of article 4a of the Gambling Act, and whether the Gambling Authority has imposed sanctions. The state secretary answers that the Gambling Authority is responsible for supervision, is examining some advertisements, has not yet imposed sanctions, and that an investigation is ongoing and could lead to a sanction.
The Gambling Authority informs me upon request that it is examining some advertisements.
De Ksa laat mij desgevraagd weten dat zij enkele reclame-uitingen onderzoekt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Oosten en Tellegen over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a baby house with a foundling chamber in Dordrecht, including whether leaving a newborn there is punishable, whether the initiator could be prosecuted for incitement, quality and supervision criteria, and comparisons with other countries. The government answered that leaving a newborn in such a chamber is punishable, that the baby house conflicts with the Criminal Code and children's rights, and that existing confidential-birth and temporary-care options remain the proper route.
Answering the question about quality criteria and supervision for such a baby house is therefore not relevant.
Beantwoording van de vraag naar kwaliteitscriteria en toezicht voor een dergelijk babyhuis is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jongeren geen jeugdzorg meer krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked about reports that young people lose youth care at age 18, with the case of Jabko, an autistic young man with no follow-up placement. The state secretary acknowledged such gaps occur, said he would investigate how often, rejected raising the age limit to 21 for now, and described efforts to develop follow-up care and a working group.
I am willing to investigate how often this happens and to inform the House about it.
Ik ben bereid uit te zoeken hoe vaak dit gebeurt en daarover de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP asked the state secretaries about a critical report on the progress of the youth care decentralisation, and whether the government shares its concerns. The government says the findings match its agenda, commits to reporting deadlines and a transition plan to parliament, and describes the consultation arrangements with field organisations.
Yes, we commit to that. These points will be included in the transition plan.
Ja, dat zeggen we toe. In het transitieplan zullen deze punten terugkomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Kritisch rapport over voortgang jeugdzorg’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries for Health and for Justice about concrete activities and results in preparing the youth care transition, before and after November 2012. The government listed the parliamentary letters, debates and the 28 February 2013 letter, and said a transition plan will be sent to parliament after April consultations with VNG and IPO.
The Transition Plan will address the process planning, programme structure, method of steering and allocation of responsibilities.
In het Transitieplan zal worden ingegaan op de procesplanning, de programmastructuur, de wijze van sturing en de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het aantal ondertoezichtstellingen en voogdijmaatregelen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the rise in child protection supervision orders (ondertoezichtstellingen) and guardianship placements, the causes of the rise, how municipalities will prevent such measures after decentralisation of youth care, and related budget and caseload questions. The government answered that the rise is likely due to greater attention to child abuse, that numbers have fallen since 2009, that municipalities will be responsible for integrated youth policy and quality requirements under the new law, and that some data (spending by municipalities, caseload averages) cannot be provided or are not planned for research.
Deze vraag is niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Irak niets doet voor teruggekeerde landgenoten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Iraq does nothing for returnees, whether voluntary return is therefore not an option, what became of the offer of 5.5 million euro for reintegration, and whether talks were under way after reports that the Netherlands would refuse 15,000 Iraqis. The State Secretary disputed the characterisation, described the reintegration support available to returnees and the still-open 5.5 million euro offer, and said the reports misrepresented a meeting in Baghdad and the number of voluntary returns.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over een incident met een inwoner van detentiecentrum Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an incident at the Rotterdam detention centre in which a detainee lost a finger in a cell door, whether guards had closed the door on his hand, whether detainees were placed in isolation afterwards, and whether the Inspectorate was notified. The State Secretary answered that the detainee had behaved aggressively, that a supervisor and the detainee both pulled the door so the hand was caught, that all residents were temporarily locked in with three disciplined for refusing, and that the Inspectorate saw no reason to investigate.
The inspectorate reported that it sees no reason to launch an investigation.
De inspectie heeft gemeld dat zij geen aanleiding ziet om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het samenplaatsen van (levens)langgestraften

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the status of plans to place life-sentenced and very long-sentenced prisoners together in dedicated wards, including why it was delayed, and whether the inventory and expert advice could be published. The State Secretary said the plan was delayed because not all prisoners cooperated with the required risk assessment, expected it to be realised by 1 July, and declined to publish the inventory and advice citing privacy.
The inventory and the expert advice are not made public for privacy reasons.
De inventarisatie en het deskundigenadvies worden niet openbaar gemaakt vanwege privacy redenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Kamerleden nacht in ‘Vluchtkerk’”

MP Azmani asked the state secretary about a municipality (Smallingerland) funding temporary emergency shelter for ex-asylum seekers and whether this breaches the 2007 agreement, and what the government can do about it, plus alleged delays by India and Pakistan in issuing return documents. The state secretary answered that structural emergency shelter is unnecessary and undesirable, pointed to existing 12-week shelter for those cooperating with return, will engage in dialogue with the VNG and municipalities, and stated no countries are known to structurally refuse returns.
I note that the intended target group of the shelter in Smallingerland includes foreigners who cooperate in their return.
Ik stel vast dat de beoogde doelgroep van de opvang in Smallingerland onder meer vreemdelingen zijn die meewerken aan hun terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de aanpak van illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op internet

An MP asks the State Secretary about enforcement against illegal online gambling operators targeting the Dutch market, including banks facilitating payments and whether licensing should wait until illegal operators are gone. The State Secretary says the Gaming Authority has warned about 40 operators, more than half complied, enforcement against non-compliers is ongoing, no fines or orders have yet been imposed, and bank blacklisting awaits a legal basis.
During the investigation the Gaming Authority cannot address the specific cases.
Gedurende het onderzoek kan de ksa niet op de concrete zaken ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over ondertoezichtstellingen die vele jaren worden verlengd

An MP asked whether repeated extensions of child supervision orders (OTS) lasting many years should be capped by law, and whether financial incentives for youth-protection organisations discourage foster guardianship. The government declined a statutory maximum, pointing to case-by-case judicial review, the pending bill with a prospect-based test and Raad voor de Kinderbescherming advice, and said it knows of no such financial practice.
Ultimately, it is the children's judge who, after carefully weighing all interests, judges whether the measure should continue.
Uiteindelijk is het de kinderrechter die na zorgvuldige afweging van alle belangen een oordeel geeft over de noodzaak om de maatregel al dan niet te laten voortduren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de aanpak van illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op internet

An MP asked the state secretary about enforcement against illegal online gambling operators, including advertising by 7Red.com and Royaalcasino.com and the Gaming Authority's ability to detect illegal ads and collect fines from foreign operators. The state secretary said the Gaming Authority is responsible for enforcement, that it monitors ads and receives reports, and that foreign fines are hard to collect administratively, while promising to examine additional powers in the forthcoming online gambling bill.
In developing the online gambling bill, I am examining which additional powers could further strengthen the effectiveness of the Gaming Authority's enforcement.
Bij de ontwikkeling van het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand bekijk ik welke aanvullende bevoegdheden de effectiviteit van de handhaving van de ksa verder kunnen versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about a Congolese person acquitted by the International Criminal Court who was detained by Dutch authorities for removal, questioning whether this ignored the court's ruling and whether the ICC assessed his safety. The State Secretary answered that acquittal does not confer a right to remain, that the host state must facilitate transfer to a third state under the seat agreement, that his asylum/protection request is pending, and that structural arrangements with the ICC are being discussed.
The Netherlands deprived the person of his liberty within the framework of the aforementioned immigration law procedure.
Nederland heeft betrokkene zijn vrijheid ontnomen in het kader van genoemde vreemdelingrechtelijke procedure.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de zelfmoord van een Russische activist

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary whether reports of a Russian activist's suicide in a Rotterdam detention centre are accurate, including claims about his past work, asylum grounds and why he was transferred to detention while his appeal was pending, and asked about policy on political refugees from Russia. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual's account, said an Inspectorate investigation into the handling of the detention was awaited, and stated that Russian asylum claims are assessed individually without special policy.
Following this incident I have asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) to start an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van dit incident heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de zelfmoord van een Russische vreemdeling in het uitzetcentrum in Rotterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the suicide of a Russian asylum seeker in the Rotterdam detention centre, whether he was wrongly detained, his psychiatric condition, and the reasons for rejection. The State Secretary confirms shock, has asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice to investigate, explains detention rules, and declines to discuss the individual asylum account or to say whether the rejection is linked to the suicide.
Following this event, I have asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ) to start an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van deze gebeurtenis heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) gevraagd een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de klacht van de kerken tegen Nederland over het vreemdelingenbeleid

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary whether the government would respond to a complaint by churches to the European Committee of Social Rights that the Netherlands treats undocumented migrants in breach of the European Social Charter, and whether it would act before the Committee's ruling. The State Secretary answered that the complaint had only been received for information, that the Committee would decide in March whether to request a government response, and that he would not comment on the merits or anticipate the Committee's decision.
In view of this, I do not consider it appropriate at this stage to go into the merits of the complaint or to anticipate a decision of the Committee.
Gelet daarop acht ik het niet juist in dit stadium in te gaan op de merites van de klacht of om op een beslissing van het Comité vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Nederland zet weer Somalische asielzoekers uit'

Green Left MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about reports that the Netherlands was resuming forced returns of Somali asylum seekers to Mogadishu, and about safety, monitoring and the views of UNHCR, Amnesty and VluchtelingenWerk. Teeven answered that the February 2013 removal was halted by a court, that returns to all of Somalia are again possible, and that individual assessment and the CITT oversight provide adequate safeguards, while not sharing the safety concerns.
It is expected that this will not involve more than a few removals per month.
Naar verwachting zal het niet om meer dan enkele uitzettingen per maand gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de komst van de winnaar van de verkiezingen op Curaçao die Nederlanders bodybags in het vooruitzicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked whether Curaçao election winner Wiels, who reportedly said body bags were ready for Dutch nationals, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The minister replied that the government values Wiels's constructive relations with the Netherlands and that the Kingdom has no power to bar Dutch nationals from entry.
In the Kingdom there is no possibility of 'denying access' to persons with Dutch nationality.
In het Koninkrijk bestaat geen mogelijkheid tot «ontzeggen van toegang» aan personen met een Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘sociaal economische gevolgen van echtscheiding’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretaries and minister about a report on the socio-economic costs of divorce, including its effects on health, well-being, public finances, poverty risk and family policy. The government answered that the report does not directly establish effects on public finances and that a further cost study would not isolate causal links, pointed to work participation and social safety nets against poverty, and described the handreiking and planned evaluations on relationship support and family policy.
In view of the above, further research into the total societal costs of divorce will be insufficient to demonstrate causal relationships.
