Gezien het voorgaande zal nader onderzoek naar de omvang van de totale maatschappelijke kosten van echtscheiding onvoldoende oorzakelijke verbanden kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Schouw over het bericht dat rechtszaken te duur worden voor lage inkomens door bezuinigingen op de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

MPs De Wit and Schouw asked the State Secretary whether budget cuts to subsidised legal aid, including a draft decree on contributions and lawyer fees, make court access nearly impossible for low-income citizens, and whether a full study of the effects would be done. The State Secretary said access for low-income groups remains guaranteed, that a quick scan was completed but a deeper study of cumulative effects is not feasible in the short term, and that the decree's effects will be reported in spring 2013.
I aim to inform the House in spring 2013 about how the renewal of the system will be further developed.
Ik streef ernaar in het voorjaar van 2013 uw Kamer te informeren over de wijze waarop de stelselvernieuwing verder wordt uitgewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vergunningplicht Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) op het gebied van onder andere curatele en bewindvoering

An MP asked whether court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) need an AFM licence to open bank accounts for clients, and whether that conflicts with the Civil Code duty to open such accounts. The minister answered that opening accounts is brokering requiring a licence in principle, but because the administrator is already legally obliged and supervised by the court, a licence exemption will be created with the AFM, also for curators, and that other categories will be discussed with the AFM.
I will therefore create an exemption in consultation with the AFM.
Ik zal dan ook in samenspraak met de AFM een vrijstelling vormgeven.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Van Vliet over het bericht dat België Europese bijstandsfraudeurs uitzet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of Belgium expelling EU welfare fraudsters, how many EU nationals were removed from the Netherlands for benefit fraud or failing the income requirement, and how EU nationals can receive benefits despite the income requirement. The minister answered that 70 residence rights were ended in 2012 (10 forced returns), that benefit receipt does not automatically end residence, and that experiments with the municipalities of Vaals and Rotterdam aim to speed up information exchange, with results promised before summer.
The minister of Social Affairs and Employment promised in the General Consultation on Labour Migration of 17 January 2013 to inform the House before the summer about the results of the experiments.

De minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid heeft in het Algemeen Overleg Arbeidsmigratie van 17 januari 2013 toegezegd om de Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de resultaten van de experimenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Neppérus over de inkomensafhankelijke bijdrage voor de Zorgverzekeringswet

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether directors-major shareholders with several BVs are charged income-dependent Zvw contributions exceeding the normal amount, and what solutions exist. The state secretary confirmed the problem, explained the refund and advance-payment mechanism and the wage-payment arrangement under the Wet op de loonbelasting.
These messages have also reached me.
Deze berichten hebben mij ook bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Arib over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Oeigoerse asielzoeker naar China

MPs Van Ojik and Arib asked whether a planned deportation of a Uyghur asylum seeker to China, halted by the Council of State, would be cancelled, whether his risks were re-examined, and whether Dutch policy on deporting Uyghurs to China would be reviewed in light of NGO warnings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the country report on China is under review and that the government will inform parliament shortly.
Given the privacy interest of the foreign national concerned and the fact that his case is before the court, I will not go further into this individual case.
Met het oog op het belang van de privacy van de betrokken vreemdeling en gezien het feit dat zijn zaak onder de rechter is, ga ik niet verder in op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over aantallen kinderen die niet onder de regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen vallen

MP Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how many children fall outside the long-term resident children scheme, including by contra-indication, by absence of an asylum application, and whether families who evaded state supervision but stayed known to municipalities are excluded. The State Secretary said no reliable estimate can be given, excluded children who evaded supervision, and promised to assess cases reported by the VNG under the scheme's conditions.
It is not possible to give an estimate of the number of children who fall outside the scheme because of a contra-indication or for not submitting an asylum application.
Het is niet mogelijk om een schatting te geven van het aantal kinderen dat niet onder de regeling valt vanwege een contra-indicatie of het niet indienen van een asielverzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bestrijden van recidive en het aan het werk zetten van ex-gedetineerden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the state secretary how to reduce recidivism by helping ex-prisoners find work, including concerns that the Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) blocks ex-offenders from jobs. The state secretary answered that work is important for reintegration but public safety weighs too; VOG refusals are based on case-by-case assessment, the look-back period for adolescents has been shortened, and prison labour is being reorganised.
I consider it important that people have a paid job as soon as possible after their detention, because having work is one of the important conditions for not reoffending.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat mensen zo snel mogelijk na hun detentie weer een betaalde baan hebben omdat het hebben van werk één van de belangrijke voorwaarden is, om niet te recidiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de moeilijkheden voor een in Nederland geboren kind dat afkomstig is uit Kosovo om een verblijfsvergunning te krijgen wegens het ontbreken van een paspoort

MP Arib asked the state secretary why a Dutch-born child of Kosovar parents must meet the passport requirement for a residence permit, and whether this is unreasonable when no Kosovar passport can be obtained locally. The state secretary answered that the passport requirement applies, exemption is only granted when the foreign authorities cannot issue a passport, and the child can register at the Kosovar embassy in The Hague and apply for a passport in Brussels, so no return trip is needed.
It is not possible to apply for a passport for a child born in the Netherlands at the Embassy of Kosovo in The Hague.
Het is niet mogelijk om voor een in Nederland geboren kind een paspoort aan te vragen bij de ambassade van Kosovo in Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de oproep van Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland om te stoppen met de grensdetentie van vluchtelingen

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Vluchtelingenwerk's call to end border detention of asylum seekers arriving by air, including numbers detained, detention durations, minors, and whether alternatives exist. The State Secretary defended border detention as required by the Schengen Borders Code, reported 620 detained asylum seekers and 50 in the closed extended procedure in 2012, and said he would report on alternatives before the summer recess.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover voor het zomerreces te kunnen berichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Rel rond illegale Marokkanen’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary about the ambassador's claim that illegal Marokkanen stay because of Moroccan obstruction, and what consequences this should have for relations with Morocco. The State Secretary said Morocco's cooperation on nationality checks and travel documents can improve, that the EU holds the readmission negotiating mandate, and that bilateral contacts and linkage to other dossiers are being pursued.
The Netherlands wants requests for nationality determination and issuance of replacement travel documents to be processed more quickly.
Nederland wil graag dat verzoeken tot nationaliteitsvaststelling en afgifte van vervangende reisdocumenten sneller worden afgehandeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Marokko niet meewerkt aan de terugname van illegalen vanuit Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Morocco is refusing cooperation on returning Moroccan illegal migrants, including the scale of failed returns, whether Moroccan authorities still refuse charter flights, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement in Moroccan cooperation, reported that many detention orders were lifted because identification took too long, said charter flights are not needed since scheduled flights work, and noted the EU holds the mandate for a readmission agreement and that the government will pursue the file bilaterally and within a broader country strategy.
As promised, I will inform the House further about the strategic country approach.
Zoals toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer over de strategische landenbenadering nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen lid Arib over het verhuizen van asielkinderen.

An MP from the Labour Party asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report on asylum children being relocated repeatedly between reception locations, and whether this should be reduced. The State Secretary replied that moves are largely on the family's own request or necessary parts of the procedure, that the COA tries to minimise and schedule them during school holidays, and that small-scale commercial family housing is not preferred, while noting moves can burden children.
I do not share the conclusion that the number of relocations is exorbitantly high.
De conclusie dat het aantal verhuizingen exorbitant hoog is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de publicatie ‘Ontheemd: de verhuizingen van asielzoekerskinderen in Nederland’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report on asylum-seeker children moving frequently between reception centres, whether a COA study was too narrow, and whether the situation conflicts with the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The state secretary acknowledged that such children move more often, said the COA's registration is not comparable to the report's sample, cited protocols and policies to reduce moves, and referred to an earlier letter for the substantive response.
Retroactive registration was not reliably possible based on the COA systems because those systems were not set up for it.
Registratie met terugwerkende kracht was op basis van de COA-systemen niet op een betrouwbare wijze mogelijk omdat de systemen daar niet op waren ingericht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de ervaringen met Nader Onderzoek DoodsOorzaak minderjarigen (NODO-procedure)

An MP asked about the NODO procedure for unexplained deaths of minors, prompted by a case involving a severely disabled child, including whether obduction is needed when a medical file exists, procedure duration, the two NODO centres, and training of forensic doctors. The government answered that the procedure is standard for unexplained deaths, explained its steps and criteria, noted a startup evaluation until October 2013, and stated the procedure is neutral and non-judicial, while declining to discuss the individual case.
In answering these and the following questions I cannot go into the individual case.
Bij de beantwoording van deze en volgende vragen kan ik niet ingaan op de casuïstiek

Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de brief van Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie van 27 november 2012 waaruit blijkt dat bij gedetineerdentransport geen vrijheid beperkend

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary of Security and Justice why restraints are used during detainee transport only when expressly ordered, and why transport guards must decide individually, arguing this is dangerous. The state secretary replies that the Penitentiary Principles Acts allow restraints when motivated, that the Public Prosecution Service and the institution share the risk assessment, and that he sees no reason to make restraints the default.
When using restraints, the necessity requirement comes first.
Bij de aanwending van vrijheidsbeperkende middelen staat het noodzakelijkheidsvereiste voorop.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Syrië voor de mogelijkheden van Nederlandse statushouders om te naturaliseren en voor de gezinsleden van vluchtelingen om naar Nederland na te reizen

An MP asked about the consequences of the Syrian war for Syrian status holders' naturalisation eligibility and for family reunification, including document requirements and processing times. The state secretary answered that most naturalisation requirements still apply, that document evidence of hardship is assessed case by case, and that family reunification processing averages 22 weeks with no commitment to fast-track or early entry.
This information is not available. The IND does not record this data.
Deze informatie is niet beschikbaar. De IND legt deze gegevens niet vast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Hardenberg woest om taakstraf na geweld”

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why a 25-year-old who seriously injured a young man (broken jaw, skull fracture) received a community service sentence, and whether community service should be excluded for such violent offences. The State Secretary declined to comment on the judge's ruling, noted that the Public Prosecution Service has appealed on the ground that the 2012 restriction on community service was wrongly applied, and defended the existing statutory balance between legislator and judge without committing to abolish community service.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on the judge's assessment.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over het oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland overweegt haar steun aan de EU-privacyvoorstellen in te trekken

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would withdraw support for EU data privacy proposals by joining a blocking minority, and which points and member states might form one. The minister denied concrete indications of any blocking minority, said the Netherlands takes positions like all member states and will keep the Chamber informed, and agreed to answer before the JBZ Council debate.
I have no concrete indications of the existence or form of a blocking minority in the negotiations on the proposals mentioned.
Ik heb geen concrete aanwijzingen van het bestaan of vormen van een blokkerende minderheid bij de onderhandelingen over de genoemde voorstellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink over het militair strafproces

MP Eijsink asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence whether officer-counsels (officier-raadsman) in military criminal proceedings can be justified given their limited legal training, and whether this compromises fair trial rights under Salduz and the ECHR. The government answered that officers receive about one week of military criminal law training, that the modality functions satisfactorily, and that suspects may waive the right to a lawyer, so no unfair trial arises.
I have no indication that the training in practice fails to lead to adequate qualification.
Mij is niet gebleken dat het onderricht in de praktijk niet leidt tot een afdoende kwalificatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over oppakken van vreemdelingen op basis van huidkleur

MP Arib asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about police stopping foreigners based on skin colour, the legal consequences of Council of State rulings, cooperation between Connexxion and the aliens police, and the abandonment of a vulnerable woman after detention. The state secretary referred to earlier answers on questions 1-4, said no formal cooperation existed with Connexxion, and described detention-release procedures and the 2012 change allowing medical staff to be present in the evening, without addressing the individual case due to privacy.
Due to privacy, I cannot go into this individual case, which took place in 2011.
In verband met de privacy kan ik niet ingaan op dit individuele geval, dat speelde in 2011.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de vermoedelijke eerwraak op een 16-jarig meisje

PVV MPs asked whether an apparent honour killing of a 16-year-old in IJsselstein was honour-motivated, how many honour killings occurred in ten years, whether immigration from Islamic countries is linked to them, and whether perpetrators with dual nationality should be deported. The state secretary declined to comment on the motive during the ongoing investigation, provided registration figures, rejected the links to religion and immigration, and explained the sliding-scale deportation rules without addressing individual cases.
The investigation into the death of the 16-year-old schoolgirl from IJsselstein is still in full swing.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de 16-jarige scholiere uit IJsselstein is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de onmogelijkheid om te slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen

Yücel (PvdA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast showing a candidate repeatedly failing the civic integration exam over a pronunciation error, and asked about failure rates, feedback to candidates, and a hardship clause. Minister Asscher answered with figures on repeat test-takers, announced feedback letters and preparation tips, noted an existing exemption route for candidates showing demonstrable effort, and said he will examine whether human assessors could re-review repeat candidates' spoken test results.

That is why I will examine whether and how the results of a candidate who has failed the Dutch Spoken Language Test several times can also, even when the speech computer directly assessed the answers, still be assessed by human assessors.

Daarom zal ik onderzoeken of en hoe de resultaten van een kandidaat die meerdere malen voor de Toets Gesproken Nederlands is gezakt in Nederland, óók als de spraakcomputer de antwoorden van een kandidaat direct heeft kunnen beoordelen, alsnog door menselijke beoordelaars beoordeeld kunnen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat gezochte criminelen makkelijk aan een paspoort kunnen komen

MP Schouw asked why wanted offenders can obtain passports, given that only 217 of 1566 fugitive convicts are flagged and only 16 passports withdrawn, and how the passport-alert register can be made more complete. The Secretary of State explained the strict legal conditions for listing (Dutch nationality plus a well-founded suspicion of flight abroad), pointed to OM procedures, and said the Paspoortwet will be amended to widen passport alerts.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and I have agreed to amend the Passport Act as soon as possible regarding the conditions for passport alerts.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en ik zijn overeengekomen de Paspoortwet op zo kort mogelijke termijn aan te passen wat betreft de voorwaarden voor paspoortsignalering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Terrorist Jason W. mag met bewaking op verlof’

An MP asks the state secretary whether the leave granted to terrorist detainee Jason W. (Hofstad group) should be reversed, given the risk to public safety and the apparent reversal of the earlier refusal. The state secretary answers that after a Council ruling he re-sought advice from police and prosecutors, who convinced him leave was now possible under supervision, and he sees no reason to change the decision.
The RSJ instructed me to take a new decision, taking into account the ruling of the appeals committee.
De RSJ heeft mij daarbij opgedragen een nieuwe beslissing te nemen, met inachtneming van de uitspraak van de beroepscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending betreffende de situatie in de justitiële jeugdinrichtingen en het bericht “Lak aan regels in Teylingereind”

PVV MP Helder asked the state secretary about a broadcast alleging drugs, weapons and phones are present and treatment is lacking at youth detention centre Teylingereind, and whether escapes during leave can be stopped. The state secretary disputed most of the broadcast's claims, said escapes are unacceptable and leave policy will be tightened with a report before summer 2013, but rejected mandatory use of restraints and additional measures on contraband.
I am therefore in consultation with the youth detention sector to tighten the leave policy.
Ik ben derhalve met de sector JJI in overleg om het beleid met betrekking tot verlof aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over signalen van misstanden in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reported misconduct and contraband in two youth detention centres (Amsterbaken and Teylingereind), including treatment of PIJ detainees, staff assaults and smuggled drugs and phones. The State Secretary answered that investigations found no structural shortcomings, described treatment programmes and incidents handled, and promised heightened vigilance and tighter controls.
I have asked the youth detention sector to monitor this closely.
Ik heb de sector JJI gevraagd hierop scherp toe te zien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pechtold over het belang van een onafhankelijke Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the independence of the Dutch Safety Board, including its placement under his ministry, its budget, the appointment of members, and the vacancies and planned reduction in members. The minister answered that statutory safeguards ensure independence, that the 2008 evaluation found the framework adequate, and that a new evaluation commission will review effectiveness, while the vacancies are held open pending that evaluation.
All these safeguards together ensure that, even if services under my responsibility were the subject of investigation, the Board could carry out that investigation in full independence.
Al deze waarborgen tezamen stellen zeker dat ook indien diensten, ressorterend onder mij, onderwerp van onderzoek zouden worden, de raad dat onderzoek in volledige onafhankelijkheid kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het Onderzoeksrapport Taskforce TBS 2012 en zijn brief d.d. 30 januari 2013 ‘Onderzoek Taskforce TBS naar (mogelijke) gemaximeerde TBS’

Member Helder (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether citizens have a right to know how many dangerous TBS patients are now at large following the ECtHR Van der Velden ruling, and whether all cases affected by the ruling, including those before 26 November 2012, should be investigated and the figures published. The State Secretary answered that the Council for the Judiciary examined the affected cases, that the Supreme Court later narrowed the reading of the ruling, and that the Council's report with figures has been sent to Parliament and is public.
I have asked the Council for the Judiciary to investigate which cases of TBS detainees require attention in light of the ECtHR ruling.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr) verzocht te onderzoeken welke zaken van tbs-gestelden aandacht vragen in het licht van de uitspraak van het EHRM
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Mei Li Vos over onduidelijkheid bij het terug verkrijgen van het CBF keurmerk voor goede doelen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the unclear withdrawal and later reinstatement of the CBF quality mark for a cancer research charity without public explanation, and about progress on a convenant with the charity sector for more transparency. The State Secretary said the CBF is independent and he does not judge individual decisions, but that a public explanation would help transparency, and he described the ongoing work on a validation system due by Q4 2013.
I do not intervene in individual assessments by the CBF.
Ik treed niet in individuele beoordelingen van het CBF.
Antwoord vragen Recourt en Marcouch over het afluisteren van telefoongesprekken van gedetineerden

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked about the recording of detainees' phone calls, including with lawyers, after an RSJ ruling that standard recording must end. Minister Teeven answered that the current rules already allow standard recording, that a number-recognition system with the NOvA is planned for 2013, and that interim alternative phones will be arranged for calls with lawyers.
I point out that the amendments to the Penitentiary Principles Act and underlying regulations in force since 1 January 2011 already provide a basis for standard recording.
Ik wijs er op dat met de sinds 1 januari 2011 inwerking getreden wijzigingen in de Pbw en onderliggende regelgeving al is voorzien in een grondslag voor het standaard opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over misleidende reclame voor kansspelen

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Vriendenloterij scratch-card advertisement complies with the new gambling-advertising rules in Article 4a of the Gambling Act, and whether the regulator has fined any operator. The secretary answered that the regulator is monitoring compliance, has no signals of violations, has not fined anyone, and that the implementing decree is planned for 1 July 2013.
When asked, the gambling authority informs me that it will not comment on individual cases, except where there is, for example, a public sanction decision.
Desgevraagd laat de kansspelautoriteit mij weten geen mededeling te doen over individuele zaken, behalve wanneer bijvoorbeeld sprake is van een openbaar sanctiebesluit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Psycho’s op vrije voeten”

An MP asked about reports that long-stay TBS patients, including psychopaths, are being moved to regular wards where they may gain leave and work toward reintegration, and questioned the role of libido-suppressing medication and recidivism trends. The state secretary answered that transfers occur only when new treatment prospects exist, that treatment is tailored and risk management is prioritised, and that the long-stay policy is under evaluation with results due later in the year.
In these cases, those concerned are transferred back to regular TBS wards so that the treatment ordered by the judge can be resumed.
In deze gevallen worden betrokkenen teruggeplaatst naar de reguliere tbs-afdelingen zodat de door de rechter opgelegde behandeling hervat kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over de barrières bij de gezinshereniging van vluchtelingen

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the Defence for Children and Vluchtelingenwerk report on barriers to family reunification for refugees, and about high refusal rates. The state secretary defends the procedure as careful and anti-fraud, rejects the report's characterisation, says he will respond more fully in spring 2013, and states that refusals do not necessarily indicate fraud.
A refusal does not by definition mean that there is fraud.
Een afwijzing betekent niet per definitie dat er sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de jacht op schoonmaaksters

MP Karabulut asks about a Zembla broadcast alleging that the Kennemerland aliens police stop cleaners based on skin colour, whether this is ethnic profiling, whether the police ignore Supreme Court rulings on the bus project, and what will improve domestic workers' position. The state secretary denies that skin colour alone triggers checks, says the police complied with the Council of State ruling, promises a general vision on aliens supervision, and points to a forthcoming advisory commission on domestic workers.
After the Council of State ruled that there were insufficient grounds for a reasonable suspicion of illegal residence in the case concerned, the police adjusted their approach on this point.

Nadat de Raad van State heeft geoordeeld dat er in de betreffende zaak onvoldoende gronden waren voor een redelijk vermoeden van illegaal verblijf, heeft de politie haar handelwijze op dit punt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat de Haarlemse vreemdelingenpolitie een Ghanese tuinman, enkel op grond van zijn huidskleur, heeft opgepakt

MP Arib asked whether the Haarlem aliens police detained a Ghanaian gardener solely on the basis of his skin colour, and whether guidelines should change. The state secretary replied that the newspaper report is incorrect, that the official record and court ruling show no ethnic basis for the check, that skin colour alone cannot establish a reasonable suspicion, and that he sees no reason to amend the guidelines.
Skin colour alone does not give rise to a reasonable suspicion of unlawful residence measured by objective standards.
Huidskleur alleen levert geen naar objectieve maatstaven gemeten redelijk vermoeden van illegaal verblijf op.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over het bericht minder kinderen in jeugdinstellingen in Zeeland

MPs Ypma and De Vries asked about a report that fewer children in Zeeland are placed in youth institutions thanks to the wraparound care model, and whether this model should guide the transition of youth care to municipalities. The state secretary answered that the Zeeland method is a good example for the transition, though it has not yet reduced placements, and pointed to existing models, shared learning platforms and funding for pilots.
I will further examine how we can make these good examples more visible.
Ik ga nader bezien hoe wij deze goede voorbeelden meer zichtbaar kunnen maken.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht Tbs'er ontsnapt tijdens begeleid verlof

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about a report that a tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patient escaped during supervised leave, asking whether escort security should be tightened, whether police should receive a description in advance, and whether escapes are unacceptable. The state secretary replied that supervised leave is a necessary, phased part of resocialisation, that unauthorised absences are under 1 per mille of leave movements, that police need no advance description since cooperation works in practice, and that the leave advisory body reviews every request.
The Advisory Committee on Leave Assessment for tbs (AVt) advises on all leave applications, on whether leave should be granted or not.
Het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing tbs (AVt) adviseert bij alle verlofaanvragen, over het al dan niet toekennen van het verlof.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘megabezuiniging van 100 miljoen euro op het gevangeniswezen’

An MP asks the minister why electronic detention at home is being introduced amid a 100 million euro prison budget cut, whether it contradicts the tough-on-crime stance, and whether it endangers staff and public safety. The minister replies that electronic detention is an acceptable alternative for short sentences if applied selectively, that a bill is being prepared, and that a masterplan on prison capacity is being drawn up.
As I indicated during the debate on the 2013 budget of the Ministry of Security and Justice, I am preparing a bill that will make the use of electronic detention possible.

Zoals ik tijdens de behandeling van de begroting 2013 van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie heb aangegeven, bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor dat de toepassing van elektronische detentie mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord vragen Wilders, Helder en Agema over het bericht Aanrander bejaarden vrij

PVV MPs Wilders, Helder and Agema asked the Justice minister about reports that a 15-year-old suspect of sexually assaulting elderly women was released, and how victims and nearby residents would be protected. The minister confirmed the reports, explained that the court lifted the pre-trial detention suspension, said further investigation and neighbourhood police contact are underway, and noted that vulnerability can be weighed in sentencing.
During this period neighbourhood police officers remain in contact with those involved.
Gedurende deze periode houden wijkagenten contact met de betrokkenen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de slechte situatie voor asielzoekers in Griekenland

An MP from the PvdA asks the state secretary of Security and Justice about the poor conditions for asylum seekers in Greece, including the reported detention and street-exposure of unaccompanied minors, and whether Dublin transfers to Greece can resume. The state secretary says he is concerned, awaits Greece's official response, notes Greece's revised action plan due in January 2013, and says Netherlands will press for EU support but gives no firm timeline for resuming Dublin returns.
I only want to go into the substance of the report after this reaction.
Ik wil inhoudelijk pas ingaan op het rapport na deze reactie.

Vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de stand van zaken rond de noodzakelijke uitzetting van een Iraakse eermoordenaar (ingezonden 5 december 2012).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the status of the residence procedures and planned removal of an Iraqi honour-killing perpetrator, and why the Chamber was not kept informed and whether the man can run a law firm. The State Secretary declines to give details while the appeal is pending, explains that the man may work under his permit-related labour rights during the procedure, and promises to inform the Chamber of new developments.
Since the appeal procedure concerning the extension of the person's residence permit has not yet been concluded, I cannot provide any information about it.
Aangezien de procedure in hoger beroep inzake de verlenging van de verblijfsvergunning van betrokkene nog niet is afgerond, kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked whether US authorities could access biometric data held by Morpho in the Netherlands under the Patriot Act, and whether the agreed solution with Morpho prevents this. The minister answered that the US law remains in force and has extraterritorial reach, but that Morpho reports no data requests and the agreements are a proportionate safeguard, while refusing to guarantee that foreign authorities will never use extraterritorial powers to access personal data.
I cannot make any statements about requests from US authorities to other companies.
Over vragen van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten bij andere bedrijven kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

Two PVV MPs asked why the government refused to answer questions about individual criminal foreigners tied to recent news cases, when earlier individual cases had been answered, and whether it is inconsistent to withhold information on criminals while disclosing information on people to be deported. State Secretary Teeven replied that he declines to discuss individual cases to protect the privacy of those involved, since the data are special personal data under the Dutch data protection law, and that privacy will generally weigh heavily.
I refrained from going into the individual cases because, for the protection of the privacy of those involved, I do not consider it desirable to go further into them.
Ik heb afgezien om in te gaan op de individuele zaken omdat ik het uit oogpunt van bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen niet gewenst acht hierop verder in te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraken van de Raad van State inzake christelijke vluchtelingen van Iraanse afkomst

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether he would change asylum policy for Iranian Christians following two Council of State rulings, and whether he would halt planned deportations to Iran. The state secretary answered that the rulings follow the EU Court of Justice's framework on religious freedom, that the IND already applies this framework, and that no further measures are warranted.
The clarity you requested has existed since 2 November, and I therefore see no reason to take the measures you propose.
De door u gevraagde duidelijkheid is er al sinds 2 november jl. en ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de door u voorgestelde maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de toegang tot de schuldhulpverlening en de schuldsanering

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether stricter selection criteria for debt rescheduling and debt relief have reduced access, and about differences between municipalities. The government replied that municipalities now carry debt assistance responsibility, that no national data on excluded people exist, that Wsnp applications rose from 16,643 to 21,114 between 2010 and 2011, and that debt assistance tends to pay for itself.
The national government does not keep records of the number of people with problematic debts who do not qualify for debt assistance.
Door het Rijk worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over het aantal mensen met problematische schulden dat niet in aanmerking komt voor schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over de uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers die tot voor kort in het tentenkamp in Amsterdam Osdorp verbleven

An MP from the PVV asked why rejected asylum seekers removed from a Amsterdam Osdorp tent camp were released rather than detained, and whether the government would act against the left-wing groups supporting them. The state secretary answered that detention requires individual grounds and prospect of removal, that eight were detained, and that organisations acting humanely within the law give no cause for action.
For the other foreigners there was insufficient basis, for example because there is no or insufficient prospect of removal, to justify a detention measure.
Bij de overige vreemdelingen was er onvoldoende grondslag, bijvoorbeeld omdat er geen of onvoldoende zicht is op uitzetting, om een maatregel van bewaring te rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Agema over het bericht dat de gemeente Smallingerland opvang voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers wil betalen met geld dat bedoeld is voor mensen met een beperking

MPs Fritsma and Agema asked whether the government will stop the municipality of Smallingerland from providing shelter to rejected asylum seekers using funds meant for people with disabilities, and how it will ensure return policy is not undermined. The state secretary said the municipality's plans were not yet clear, that municipalities have discretion over their own funds, and that the government will keep pursuing active return policy, without committing to any new concrete step against the municipality.
It is not yet clear whether and how the municipality will actually provide (emergency) shelter to these people and how this will be financed.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of en hoe de gemeente daadwerkelijk (nood)opvang gaat bieden aan deze mensen en op welke wijze een en ander gefinancierd gaat worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Potters en Van Oosten over het te laag vaststellen van de beslagvrije voet door onder andere deurwaarders

MPs Potters and Van Oosten asked the state secretary for Justice and Security about the National Ombudsman's view that bailiffs and government bodies set the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) too low, and what measures would be taken. The secretary acknowledged the ombudsman's report, placed the duty to supply information mainly on debtors, and said talks with the ministry of Social Affairs and the bailiffs' association on a debt-register feasibility study would be reported early next year.
The outcomes of this consultation will presumably be reported to your House early next year as part of the cabinet response to the aforementioned report.
Over de uitkomsten van dit overleg zal uw Kamer naar verwachting begin volgend jaar worden bericht in het kader van de kabinetsreactie op het genoemde rapport.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over een innovatieplatform ten behoeve van de transitie jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretaries whether differences in municipal readiness for the youth care transition, the value of innovative pilot projects, and the need for an innovation platform should be addressed. The government answers that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that existing support and knowledge-sharing are in place, and that it will consult the field on whether a platform is needed.
In consultation with the field I want to discuss and test whether there is a need for a platform and how the exchange of innovative projects can be improved.
In overleg met het veld wil ik bespreken en toetsen of er behoefte is aan een platform en hoe de uitwisseling van innovatieve projecten kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de moord op een door Nederland afgewezen Servische asielzoeker na terugkeer in het land van herkomst

An MP asks the state secretary of Security and Justice about the murder in Serbia of a Serbian asylum seeker rejected by the Netherlands, including whether his asylum refusal was justified and whether an independent investigation will be held. The state secretary answers that the IND decision was reviewed by the courts and confirmed, that further investigation would not bear on the decision's care, that the time lapse makes any causal link speculative, and that he will consider additional procedural safeguards for coordination with witness-protection programmes.

I am willing to include additional procedural safeguards in the asylum procedure for contact between government bodies responsible for the asylum procedure and witness protection programmes at international tribunals.

Ik ben bereid om voor contact tussen overheidsinstanties verantwoordelijk voor de asielprocedure en beschermingsprogramma's voor getuigen bij internationale tribunalen, aanvullende procedurele waarborgen op te nemen bij de asielprocedure.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

Two D66 MPs asked the government about a proposed Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill carrying the death penalty, its likely passage, diplomatic steps, and whether deportations of Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers should be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns, that the EU ambassadors raised them with Uganda's prime minister, that further steps are premature, and that asylum seekers are assessed individually rather than as a group.
A careful individual assessment is therefore carried out, taking into account the worrying situation of homosexuals in Uganda.
Er vindt derhalve een zorgvuldige individuele toets plaats met inachtneming van de zorgelijke situatie van homoseksuelen in Oeganda.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over schutterijen die aanlopen tegen knelpunten in de wapenwet- en regelgeving

MPs Oskam and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether shooting clubs (schutterijen) would get their own weapons rules, and about practical problems under the Cwm and Wwm, including carrying deactivated weapons, replica weapons, sponsor shooting with children, and the KNSA licence requirement. The State Secretary answered that the club input was considered in the evaluation, that some problems (carrying during drill, sponsor shooting) will be examined and may lead to rule changes, but rejected the idea that clubs could issue their own licences and KNSA membership could lapse.
I will examine whether the laws and regulations need to be adjusted on this point.
Ik zal bezien of de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over namaak goede doelen in de zorg

An MP asked whether fake charities in healthcare should be stopped by stricter rules, such as extra demands on the 'Ruimte voor geven' covenant and limits on ANBI tax status. The government answered that it opposes misleading charities, points to the transparency and supervision vision already sent to parliament, and says adding new covenant demands now would be premature, while agreeing that only compliant charities should get ANBI status.
The cabinet finds it undesirable that people are misled and that incorrect medical information is provided, whether via sites of fake charities or otherwise.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat mensen worden misleid en dat foutieve medische informatie wordt verstrekt, of dit nu via sites van namaak goede doelen gebeurt of anderszins.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘cipier ernstig gewond na gevangenisgeweld’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that a female prison guard at PI Hoogeveen was seriously assaulted by an inmate, and how such an incident could happen, what measures would prevent recurrence, whether charges were filed, and whether fellow inmates who applauded would be sanctioned. The State Secretary confirmed the assault and injuries, described the response time, announced an internal calamity investigation by the DJI with outside members, reported that charges were filed, and declined action against applauding inmates.
I await the findings and recommendations of this investigation and will take appropriate measures where necessary.
Ik wacht de bevindingen en aanbevelingen van dit onderzoek af en onderneem zo nodig passende maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over adoptie in afrikaanse landen

An MP asked the state secretary about adoption practices from African countries, including professionalism of adoption organisations, the suppressed Fruits of Ethiopia report, and Ethiopia and Uganda adoptions. The state secretary answered that the system is sound but needs stronger controls, that the report was withheld for privacy reasons and unverified findings, and that no evidence of abuses exists in other African countries.
The reason the report was not published is the privacy sensitivity of the information and the inaccuracies found in the report.
De reden dat het rapport niet naar buiten is gebracht is vanwege de privacygevoeligheid van de informatie en de geconstateerde onjuistheden die in het rapport stonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over de NODO-procedure in de praktijk

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked why the Child Death Review was dropped, why only two instead of five NODO centres were set up, and whether forensic doctor knowledge gaps affect NODO referrals. The state secretary answered that the CDR could not be funded given budget limits, that two centres were chosen for expertise and cost reasons with a startfase evaluation until October 2013, and that enough qualified forensic doctors are now available.
The available budget has been used to introduce the NODO procedure.
Het beschikbare budget is ingezet om de NODO-procedure in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over baby Donna

An MP asks the State Secretary about the baby Donna case, whether a similar case is still possible, how often surrogacy has led to problems, and whether EU or national rules are needed. The State Secretary says existing criminal law and cooperation agreements reduce such risks but cannot exclude recurrence, and that surrogacy is being raised internationally with a new Hague process while practical measures are pursued.
Given the complexity of cases like this, however, I can never rule out that such a case will occur again.
Gezien de complexiteit van zaken zoals deze, kan ik echter nooit uitsluiten dat een dergelijke zaak zich nogmaals zal voordoen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het onderzoek ‘Erven zonder financiële zorgen’

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the government about a study proposing three routes to protect heirs from unintended acceptance of an estate's debts, about the number of households with negative home equity, and about delays in CAK and Toeslagen decisions affecting inheritances. The government said it has no exact count of negative-equity households (estimated around 700,000), announced mortgage-debt measures and a temporary tax deduction for residual debt, and promised a reply on the study's preferred route by year-end.
The cabinet does not have information that gives insight into the exact number of households with negative home equity.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die inzicht geeft in het exacte aantal huishoudens met een negatieve overwaarde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked how various suspects and convicted criminals obtained residence rights in the Netherlands, and what measures would remove them after serving their sentences, and whether residence permits could require a criminal-record statement from origin countries. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described the sliding-scale test for ending lawful residence after conviction and his plan to tighten it, and said he would inform parliament this year about using antecedent declarations.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Dijksma en Grashoff over het bericht dat de fouten bij de bouw van een detentiecentrum ruim 13 miljoen euro hebben gekost

MPs Gesthuizen, Dijksma and Grashoff asked the state secretary about reports that construction faults at the Alphen aan den Rijn detention centre cost taxpayers 13.1 million euro, and whether the government knew of leaks and fire-safety problems from 2009 and misinformed parliament. The minister replies that the actual cost to the state was 8.8 million euro with the rest used for upgrades, that the fire-safety study found the cells compliant, that the closure was due to electrical defects and inspections rather than an unsafe situation, and that the building cost stayed within budget.
The repair did not cost the state 13.1 million euro but 8.8 million euro (2/3 of 13.1 million euro).
Het herstel heeft het Rijk geen € 13,1 miljoen gekost maar € 8,8 miljoen (2/3 van € 13,1 miljoen).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht 'Justitie laat verdachte van zware mishandeling vrij’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how a suspect of serious assault was released by mistake and whether release checks should include DNA, and what measures will prevent recurrence. The State Secretary explained the release procedure with cross-checks and biometric verification, said DNA adds no value, noted the error was corrected within two days, and said measures will await an independent internal investigation.
I will await the outcome of the investigation before deciding whether to take measures.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek af alvorens een beslissing te nemen over het treffen van maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht dat bureau Jeugdzorg Haaglanden/Zuid-Holland onder verscherpt toezicht is gesteld

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretaries why the youth care bureau Haaglanden/Zuid-Holland had scored poorly on the quality of its child protection advice for nearly three years, what had been done to improve it, and what this means for the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's advice to the juvenile judge. The government replied that the Inspectorate had placed both bureaus under intensified supervision after repeated failures to improve, that the Raad conducts its own independent investigation so court measures are not directly based on bureau advice, and that the enforcement role will move to a national supervisor under the new youth care system.
From this, the inspectorate concludes that quality monitoring at the youth care bureau has been lacking.
Hieruit constateert de inspectie dat het aan kwaliteitsbewaking van bureau jeugdzorg heeft ontbroken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Marokkaanse gevangenen naar eigen land’

PVV MPs asked whether a large share of prisoners are Moroccan nationals, whether transferring them to Morocco to serve sentences would save costs, and whether an agreement with Morocco should be concluded. The state secretary answered that about 5% of intake is Moroccan nationals, that transfer is only possible under WOTS or WETS with consent and the receiving country's agreement, and that the ministry will explore a supplementary bilateral agreement with Morocco.
The Ministry of Security and Justice will look into whether there are possibilities to conclude a bilateral (supplementary) agreement between the Netherlands and Morocco.
Vanuit het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie zal worden geïnformeerd of er in hoeverre er mogelijkheden zijn om een bilaterale (aanvullende) overeenkomst te sluiten tussen Nederland en Marokko.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de huis-aan-huis-verkooppraktijken voor ‘goede doelen’

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether companies selling door-to-door cards for supposed charities must disclose recipients and the share actually donated, whether municipalities check and regulate these sellers, and whether the government will act against Care Promotions. The state secretary answered that disclosure is not mandatory, that municipalities license such sellers with CBF advice and conditions, that consumers rely on signals and public licence lists, and that the Consumer Authority may act under unfair trading rules.
Municipalities can, under the local general bylaws (APV), require a permit for anyone who collects money or goods door-to-door.
Gemeenten kunnen op basis van de (plaatselijke) APV een vergunning verplicht stellen voor iedereen die huis-aan-huis geld of goederen inzamelt
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Ruim 200 gram hasj in cel drugsveroordeelde”

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary whether drugs could be smuggled into a prison cell holding a convicted drug offender, why urine checks did not catch them, and whether staff were involved. The state secretary confirmed the report, explained the standard drug-control regime and urine testing, said a staff member is suspected and was arrested and reported, and that the criminal investigation is closed while the court has not yet ruled.
The staff member concerned was arrested at the institution, and his access to DJI buildings was revoked.
Het desbetreffende personeelslid is in de inrichting aangehouden, waarbij hem de toegang tot de gebouwen van DJI is ontzegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de reclassering de huisvesting van een zwervende pedofiel zou blokkeren

The MP asks whether the probation service (reclassering) leaked the address of a released sex offender, causing him to lose housing, and what will be done now that he is wandering without housing. The state secretary denies that the reclassering disclosed the address, says the Openbaar Ministerie shared information with the mayor in line with its duty, and states the offender has found temporary housing while remaining under supervision.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Serieverkrachter (18) loopt dagen vrij rond”

An MP asked why justice did not publicly raise alarm when a dangerous youth sex offender absconded for days, and whether a supervised medical outing was safe. The minister defended not issuing a public appeal to protect victims and society, said the outing followed the rules, will be evaluated internally, and rejected abolishing the PIJ measure.
However, the incident will be evaluated internally to learn lessons for similar cases in the future.
Wel zal het incident intern worden geëvalueerd om hieruit lering te trekken voor soortgelijke zaken in de toekomst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over een ontsnapte serieverkrachter

Marcouch asked the state secretary how a juvenile detainee (described in the press as a serial rapist and tbs'er) escaped while under escort for a medical visit, whether staff were warned of recidivism risk, and why the escape was not publicized. The state secretary explained the escape, the escort arrangements and the risk assessment, and said media publication was withheld after a case-by-case balancing of investigation interests against victim and public safety.
In this case, after a carefully considered assessment, it was decided that media reports would not serve the investigation interest.
In de onderhavige zaak is, na een weloverwogen inschatting, besloten dat mediaberichten niet in het opsporingsbelang zouden dienen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de tegemoetkoming van adoptiekosten

An MP asked whether the state's adoption-cost tegemoetkoming (allowance), which runs from 2009 to 1 January 2013, would be continued after that date, and under what conditions, including income-dependence. The State Secretary answered that given the economic situation and budget cuts he does not consider it responsible to offer an alternative for the period after 1 January 2013.
Given the current economic situation and the associated budget-cut task, I do not consider it responsible to come up with an alternative for adoptive parents for the period after 1 January 2013.
Gezien de huidige economische situatie en de daarbij behorende bezuinigingsopdracht, vind ik het niet verantwoord om met een alternatief te komen voor adoptieouders voor de periode na 1 januari 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht "Gekonkel op luchtplaats gevangenis"

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that a shortage of exercise yards at the Geerhorst prison in Sittard could cause criminal cases in Limburg to go wrong, and that detainees under contact bans could communicate with co-suspects, asking whether the law allowing detainees to feel the rain should be changed and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service sees no indication that cases are harmed, that contact bans are enforced by separating detainees during exercise, and that temporary organisational measures are in place, so no additional measures are deemed necessary.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it has no indications that ongoing criminal cases have suffered or threaten to suffer harm.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten geen aanwijzingen te hebben dat lopende strafzaken schade hebben opgelopen dan wel schade dreigen op te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over ondeugdelijke politiecellen

An MP asked the government why a newly built Apeldoorn police custody complex and the Netherlands' police cells fall short of European standards, and what safeguards exist, and asked about child immigration detention and handcuffing of detainees. The minister answered that the cells meet guidelines via daylight openings, that regional custody commissions and the Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie provide oversight, that children are only rarely detained, and that handcuffing has been restricted to a not-by-default principle.
In addition, a Custody Supervisory Commission has been established in every region, in accordance with the Decree on the management of regional police forces.
Daarnaast is in elke regio een Commissie van Toezicht Politiecellen ingesteld, conform het Besluit beheer regionale politiekorpsen.

Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over uitlatingen van de staatssecretaris over de dood van een verdachte van inbraak (ingezonden 27 september 2012).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether his public remarks about the death of a burglary suspect in Diessen judged the case and risked undermining judicial independence and possibly incited crime. The State Secretary refers to his earlier answers to MP Kooiman, says citizens should take preventive measures, and rejects the suggestion that citizens are left to fend for themselves.
I refer to the answer to question 2 from MP Kooiman.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Kooiman
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over zijn uitspraken over de dood van een inbreker (ingezonden 27 september 2012)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to explain his remarks that the death of a burglar in Diessen was a risk the intruder took, and whether these remarks encourage vigilantism and a spiral of violence. The State Secretary answered that he sympathised with homeowners defending themselves within the legal limits of self-defence, that he gave no judgment on the specific incident which is for the courts, and refused to retract his remarks.
That judgment is also not for me, but for the judge.
Dat oordeel is ook niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de slachtoffer-dadergesprekken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the low uptake of victim-offender conversations, the sharing of personal data by police and the Public Prosecution Service with the organisation Slachtoffer in Beeld, and whether the government would act on a motion. The State Secretary replied that case numbers are rising, that prisons and probation are being engaged, and that data-sharing with police is still under review, with results expected in October 2012.
I am currently having it investigated whether there are legal obstacles.
Ik laat op dit moment uitzoeken of er juridische belemmeringen zijn.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afluisteren van advocaten (ingezonden 7 september 2012).

MP Recourt asks the state secretary whether lawyer-client conversations were recorded or listened to in real time despite rules, how that happened, and whether confidentiality can be guaranteed. The state secretary admits real-time listening occurred in about 0.1% of taps because the automatic number-recognition system did not cover it, says the gap is being fixed, and orders an external audit with the Dutch Bar.
The KLPD has taken action to ensure that, in a very short time, real-time privileged lawyer-client conversations are also blocked.
Het KLPD heeft actie genomen om ervoor te zorgen dat op zeer korte termijn ook «real time» geheimhoudergesprekken worden geblokkeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over een ontsnapte ter beschikking gestelde en de aan een burgemeester opgelegde zwijgplicht

An MP asked the state secretary about a tbs patient who escaped during escorted leave from FPC Oldenkotte, his prior offences, the role of the advisory board in granting leave, comparative escape figures, and whether a mayor was ordered by the prosecution to stay silent. The state secretary answered that the patient was arrested and suspected of attempted murder and rape, the advisory board advised leave and he followed that advice, escape figures show no clinic anomaly, and the prosecution asked the mayor not to publicise the case for investigative reasons, though he did not impose a formal gag.
The prosecution then urgently asked him, in view of the investigative interest, not to make any public statements about the case.
Daarop heeft het OM hem in verband met het opsporingsbelang dringend verzocht geen mededelingen over de zaak in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: “Slachtoffer vaak genegeerd”

An MP asked the state secretary whether victims and relatives of serious crimes are often not informed about offenders' leave and releases, and what measures will reduce this. The secretary said the Information Point reaches over 96% of victims, that the 20% figure was a wrongly reported OM statement now corrected, and that the OM is working with partners to reach 100% and to tailor contact to victims.
Every victim who wishes to be informed must be informed.
Elk slachtoffer dat geïnformeerd wenst te worden, moet geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat 15.000 veroordeelden vrij rondlopen

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that 15,000 convicted persons remain at large and whether this is acceptable, and whether extra prisons and measures would be taken. The state secretary said the enforcement of sentences is a priority, pointed to existing and expanded measures such as tracing teams, withholding social security and passport measures, and a new administrative centre, but rejected detaining all convicts pending sentence.
That is why active efforts are being made to trace persons who still have to serve their sentence.
Daarom wordt actief ingezet op het alsnog opsporen van personen die hun straf nog moeten ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de al maar weer terugkerende berichten dat er vele veroordeelde criminelen nog steeds vrij rond lopen

Labour MP Marcouch asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about reports that around 15,000 convicted criminals remain at large, and what the government is doing about it. The state secretary confirmed roughly 15,000 people must still serve custodial sentences, described enforcement measures and the USB programme, and said the figures differ from earlier answers only because they are snapshots taken at different dates.
Question 6: Can you now indicate how many of the criminals at large have committed new criminal offences during their freedom?
Vraag 6 Kunt u inmiddels wel aangeven hoeveel van de vrij rondlopende criminelen tijdens hun vrijheid opnieuw strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat de belastingbetaler moet opdraaien voor de schade die criminelen veroorzaken

MP Recourt asked the state secretary whether the taxpayer is left paying for damages criminals owe to victims of violent and sexual offences, and how the state recovers them. The state secretary explained that advance payment schemes are recovering only part of the money, that the CJIB has enforcement tools including substitute detention, and that most sentenced offenders pay in full.
Perpetrators must bear the cost of the damage they cause.
Daders moeten opdraaien voor de schade die zij aanrichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de gezondheidszorg in penitentiaire inrichting Nieuwegein

An MP asked the state secretary and health minister about alleged inadequate medical care at PI Nieuwegein, including a former detainee's case and calls for IGZ, Ombudsman and inspection investigations. The government replied that care was adequate, cited an IGZ 2011 follow-up finding that care met standards, noted the RSJ rejected the complaint, and declined further investigation or emergency measures.
In view of the above, and my answer to question 2, I do not consider further investigation or emergency measures necessary.
Gelet op het voorgaande, en mijn antwoord op vraag 2, acht ik nader onderzoek en het treffen van noodvoorzieningen niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht dat homoseksuele en niet-christelijke paren nog steeds geen kinderen uit Zuid-Afrika mogen adopteren

An MP asked the State Secretary whether same-sex and non-Christian couples can adopt children from South Africa despite a 2010 law banning such exclusions, and what steps will be taken. The State Secretary answered that ABBA Adoptions applies no exclusionary conditions and that same-sex and non-Christian couples can already adopt through the Vereniging Wereldkinderen and ABBA cooperation, recently confirmed by a cooperation arrangement between the central authorities.
As I indicated in my earlier answer to parliamentary questions, ABBA Adoptions does not apply any exclusionary conditions.
Zoals ik in mijn eerdere beantwoording van Kamervragen heb aangegeven worden er door ABBA Adoptions geen uitsluitende voorwaarden gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Van der Steur over misbruik door NS van gegevens van de OV -chipkaart

MPs Elias and Van der Steur asked the ministers whether NS misused OV-chipkaart travel data for marketing, as the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found, whether this breached 2008 agreements, and what would ensure the misuse has stopped. The minister accepts the CBP's findings, notes NS has already destroyed the data and changed its practice, and states that monitoring and enforcement lie with the CBP rather than with the government.
The CBP is charged with supervising compliance with and enforcement of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het CBP is belast met toezicht op de naleving en handhaving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over het bericht dat ACTA terug is als CETA

An MP asked whether parts of the rejected ACTA text reappear in the EU-Canada trade agreement CETA, whether parliament will be informed of such recurrences, and whether similar treaties are planned. The minister replied that some ACTA-derived wording was in an earlier CETA draft but the Commission will respect the European Parliament's vote, that provisions will be reviewed or removed, and that parliament is involved in the usual way while negotiations stay confidential.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester over de ontsnapping van twee jeugdige gedetineerden

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked about a police report on two girls who escaped from Het Poortje youth institution during a theme park outing, and whether the outing and supervision were appropriate. The state secretary answered that the girls were not detainees but were in closed youth care, that the outing followed a planned, individually assessed reintegration step with parental consent, and that the institution acknowledges the individual risk assessment should have outweighed the group interest.
The institution acknowledges that in this case the individual risk assessment of the girls should have weighed more heavily than the group interest.
De instelling erkent dat in dit geval de individuele risicotaxatie van de meisjes zwaarder had moeten wegen dan het groepsbelang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman concludeert dat de vreemdelingenbewaring inhumaan is

MP Dibi asked the ministers whether they accept the Ombudsman's conclusion that immigration detention is inhumane, whether detention should be a last resort with alternatives preferred, and how the government responds to detention conditions. The minister replied that detention is a last resort, pilots with alternatives run until a 2013 evaluation, minors are largely no longer detained, and the government rejects that detention conditions are inhuman while promising incremental improvements.
Unlike the National Ombudsman, we are of the view that there is no question of inhuman detention conditions in detention centres.
Anders dan de Nationale ombudsman zijn wij van mening dat er geen sprake is van mensonwaardige detentieomstandigheden in detentiecentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Facebook de activiteiten van zijn gebruikers scant op mogelijke criminele activiteiten

An MP asked the Dutch ministers of Security and Justice whether they knew of reports that Facebook scans user activity for possible criminal activity, how this fits EU and Dutch data protection law, whether detection of criminals should be solely a government task, whether other firms do this, and whether Dutch authorities systematically use such information. The minister answered that he lacks details, that privacy supervisors (Ireland and the Article 29 group) are examining the matter, that Article 22 of the Dutch data protection act allows private parties to process criminal data in their own interest under conditions, that crime detection is a government task, and that Dutch authorities do not systematically use such information.

The Dutch Data Protection Authority informed me that the Irish privacy supervisor, where Facebook's European office is located, is investigating Facebook on behalf of the privacy supervisors of the other 26 EU member states.

Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft mij in dit verband meegedeeld dat de privacytoezichthouder in Ierland, waar het Europese kantoor van Facebook is gevestigd, mede namens de privacytoezichthouders van de 26 overige EU-lidstaten onderzoek doet naar Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over transparantie en publicatieplicht

MP Omtzigt asked whether a transparency bill for charities (ANBI register and publication duty) was pending before cabinet, whether consultation partners saw it, and when a joint transparency vision and bill would be ready. The state secretary refused to disclose cabinet deliberations, said consultation is standard and more time is needed for sector support, and confirmed the bill and full implementation of the motion will proceed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het gebruik van Yammer door Nederlandse overheidsinstanties en de onbeperkte toegang van Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot die gegevens

MP El Fassed asked whether US authorities have unrestricted access to Dutch government data via Yammer, why it is used, whether risks were assessed, and what measures will close the alleged leak. Minister Spies replied that there is no unrestricted access, that interdepartmental guidelines apply, that confidential information may not be shared, and that no leak is seen so no additional measures are planned.
There is no unrestricted and uncontrolled access for the American authorities.
Er is geen sprake van een onbeperkte en ongecontroleerde toegang voor de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de aanpak van kindersekstoerisme

An MP asked whether child sex tourism cases should be registered separately and whether a separate criminal offence should be created, given concerns about weak insight into its scale. The state secretary replied that child sex tourism is not a specific offence but is already punishable under Dutch law when committed abroad, that separate registration would not add effectiveness, and that the real problem is weak investigation abroad.
A separate registration of child sex tourism by the police and the Public Prosecution Service does not strengthen the effectiveness of the Dutch approach.
Een afzonderlijke registratie van kindersekstoerisme bij politie en OM versterkt de effectiviteit van de Nederlandse aanpak niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over toezicht op de veroordeelde pedoseksueel

An MP asks the state secretary about a convicted sex offender who reportedly found housing without reclassering involvement, and whether mayors are always informed about released sex offenders. The state secretary denies the housing report, notes the court ruling on reclassering information-sharing, and says the BIJ information project is ongoing with an evaluation due end 2012, while rejecting the need for new legislation.
I therefore see no need to make changes to laws and regulations in addition to what I have already done.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak om aanvullend op hetgeen ik reeds heb gedaan wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving door te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de RET die gesprekken zou opnemen of afluisteren (ingezonden 11 mei 2012).

MP Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether RET tram and bus operators record or listen in on passengers' conversations, when recording began, how long recordings are kept, whether the privacy regulator knows, and whether there is a legal basis.
