The state secretary answered that there is no link between radios and recording equipment, that cameras with audio have been in use since 2008 and in new trams since mid-2011, that the recordings were recently reported to the privacy regulator, and referred to earlier answers for retention and legal basis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht dat Bureaus Jeugdzorg en rechtbanken afspraken hebben gemaakt over automatisch verlengen van indicatiebesluiten

MP Van der Burg asked whether courts in the Arnhem district and provinces agreed to automatically extend youth care indication decisions without new decisions, and about the implications under Article 8 ECHR. The state secretary said courts accepted indications without valid duration pending a bill removing the duration requirement, that no national agreements exist, that the Arnhem appeal court rulings are for courts to judge, and that talks with the IPO on a pragmatic solution will be held.
It is not for me to intervene in a judgment of the court.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in een uitspraak van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur inzake het bericht ‘Pieter Baan Centrum gaat dicht’

Van der Steur asked whether the Pieter Baan Centre is closing, what the move to three locations means for report quality and staff, and whether the research can stay objective. The minister replied that it is relocating to Almere plus smaller sites in Eindhoven and Amsterdam, that quality and objectivity are safeguarded by central reporting and separate units, and that staff face relocation or possible surplus positions with support offered.
The Pieter Baan Centre is not closing but relocating.
Het Pieter Baan Centrum gaat niet sluiten maar verhuizen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg Gesthuizen en Bouwmeester inzake de opsplitsting cq. verplaatsing van het Pieter Baan Centrum

MPs Van Toorenburg, Gesthuizen and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would fully inform parliament about plans to split up or relocate the Pieter Baan Centrum, a forensic psychiatric observation institute, after press reports and without debate on the matter. Minister Opstelten answered that the building is outdated and the funds for renovation are lacking, so a relocation to Almere is planned for 2013 with decentralised observation places, and that the move was not discussed in the June debate because there were no new developments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
As I also indicated in answering questions from MP Van der Steur (VVD), the Netherlands Institute for Forensic Psychiatry and Psychology (NIFP) is continuously working to improve quality.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de beantwoording van de vragen ( 2012Z14241 ) van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) werkt het Nederlands Instituut voor Forensische Psychiatrie en Psychologie (NIFP) voortdurend aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over interlandelijke adoptie uit Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked whether non-Christian and same-sex couples can now adopt from South Africa through Wereldkinderen and the local partner ABBA Adoptions, and whether a second bilateral agreement can be pressed for. The minister answers that non-Christian and same-sex applicants are now accepted and actively mediated, that the South African authority sees no room for a second Dutch licence-holder, and that he sees no reason to press for a second agreement.
Vereniging Wereldkinderen accepts requests for mediation from non-Christian prospective adoptive parents and same-sex prospective adoptive couples.
Vereniging Wereldkinderen neemt verzoeken om bemiddeling in behandeling van niet-christelijke aspirant-adoptiefouders en aspirant-adoptiefparen van gelijk geslacht.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie het rijbewijs van dronken fietsers inneemt (ingezonden 10 juli 2012).

An MP asked the minister whether police were confiscating driving licences from drunk cyclists, which the Wegenverkeerswet does not allow, and how this squares with the law. The state secretary said police are not competent to seize licences from cyclists, that this is not police policy, that measures were taken to prevent wrongful seizures, and that affected cyclists can claim damages under article 164(9).
Measures have now been taken to prevent wrongful seizure of driving licences from drunk cyclists.
Er zijn inmiddels maatregelen genomen om onterechte invordering van het rijbewijs van dronken fietsers te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de veiligheid van paspoortgegevens

An MP asked the State Secretary about the security of passport data, including the spread of requests for passport copies, CBP guidance, and the possibility of a fining power for the privacy regulator. The State Secretary said the CBP is independent and enforces the ban on copying identity documents, that the website was updated in consultation with the CBP, and that the fining power motion would be answered separately.
The CBP is independent and sets its own supervisory, enforcement and information priorities, and is accountable for them.
Het CBP is onafhankelijk en stelt zelf zijn toezichts-, handhavings- en voorlichtingsprioriteiten vast, en legt daarover verantwoording af.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de behandeling van slachtoffers van zedenmisdrijven (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MP Berndsen asks the state secretary about a press report and a lawyers' blacklist showing problems in how sex-crime victims are treated, what will be done about it, and whether justice has enough capacity given budget cuts. The state secretary acknowledges the LANZS list as a serious signal, reports that OM and Rvdr have analysed the points and that a follow-up evaluation with stakeholders is planned, and says victim attention need not add costs.
Next autumn a follow-up consultation will take place at my ministry with the parties involved to evaluate the results of the chosen solutions.
Komend najaar vindt op mijn ministerie vervolgoverleg plaats met de betrokken partijen om het resultaat van de gekozen oplossingen te evalueren.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

An MP asked the ministers whether withholding requested data on online privacy under the 'state interest' clause (art. 68 Grondwet) was justified, and whether police phone-tapping and social media data requests are subject to equal controls. The state secretary declined to disclose cabinet deliberations, maintained that investigation interests justify withholding the requested figures, and said the Limburg-Zuid police should not have released social media request data.
As is well known, deliberations in the Council of Ministers are confidential and no statements are made about them.
Zoals bekend zijn de beraadslagingen in de Ministerraad vertrouwelijk en worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over toezicht op ongeboren kinderen

An MP asks the ministers about court supervision orders (ondertoezichtstelling) for unborn children, including how many were requested and how often parents lose custody of later children. The government answers that requests rose from 132 in 2009 to 251 in 2011, that rejected requests are unknown, and that post-partum removals and repeat custody losses are not centrally registered.
It is unknown in how many cases the judge has irrevocably rejected the request.
Het is onbekend in hoeveel zaken de rechter het verzoek onherroelijk heeft afgewezen.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het vervroegde verlof van Volkert van der Graaf

An MP asked whether Volkert van der Graaf, convicted of murdering Pim Fortuyn, could receive early prison leave 18 months before his conditional release date, and whether the new regime could block it, given his stated lack of remorse. The state secretary replied that detention phasing is decided case by case by the DJI selection officer using advice from probation and the prosecution, that recidivism risk and the offender's views will be weighed, and that the rules will be tightened (window cut to 12 months, new system from summer 2013).
I want to place the prisoner's own responsibility at the centre and let his behaviour and motivation determine whether detention phasing is granted.
Daarom wil ik de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gedetineerde centraal stellen en zijn gedrag en motivatie bepalend laten zijn voor het toekennen van detentiefasering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de communicatiemogelijkheden van gedetineerde vreemdelingen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked about the limited internet access, and the lack of email and social media access, for foreign nationals in immigration detention, and whether the UK and Australia are models. The state secretary answered that a pilot in two detention centres allowed restricted access to a whitelist of approved sites, that the pilot was positively evaluated, and that internet facilities will be further developed with a decision on continuation to follow.
Following the positive outcomes of the pilot evaluation, the internet facility for detainees will be further developed, after which a decision on continuation will be taken.

Naar aanleiding van de positieve uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de pilot zal de internetfaciliteit voor ingeslotenen verder ontwikkeld worden, waarna besluitvorming over voortzetting plaats zal vinden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Advocaat opgepakt om miljoenenfraude» (ingezonden 8 juni 2012).

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the arrest of a lawyer suspected of multi-million euro fraude with client funds and how police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Bar handled it. Teeven declined substantive detail because the criminal case is ongoing, described the cooperation as smooth, and said current supervision of lawyers is insufficient, announcing a thorough revision via an amendment to the Advocatenwet.
The current regulations on the supervision of lawyers are in my view insufficient to achieve effective, independent and uniform supervision that is also proactive in nature.
De huidige regelgeving over het toezicht op advocaten acht ik onvoldoende om tot een effectief, onafhankelijk en uniform toezicht te komen, dat ook proactief van aard is.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het risico dat er binnen vrijwillersorganisaties en sportclubs ontucht met kinderen kan worden gepleegd

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice how volunteer organisations and sports clubs can prevent people who previously committed child sexual abuse from working with children again, and whether a mandatory certificate of conduct (VOG) should be required. The state secretary answered that such abuse is unacceptable, pointed to a disciplinary college and reference list being set up and linked to sports registries by 2014, and said there is no legal basis to make the VOG mandatory, since responsibility primarily lies with the clubs.
If not, why not? Answer 5: For the situation described in the article, the sports club can ask the prospective volunteer to submit a VOG.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 5 Voor de geschetste situatie in het artikel geldt dat de sportclub de beoogde vrijwilliger kan vragen een VOG te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Schouw over controles op EK-voetbalpoules in café's en kroegen

MPs Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit will actively check cafés and pubs running EK football pools, whether fines can reach 780,000 euro, and what criteria distinguish open from closed pools. The State Secretary answered that the regulator sets its own priorities, will focus on large-scale commercial gambling rather than small café pools, may impose fines up to 780,000 euro or 10% of turnover, and will consider whether a venue is open to the public.
In principle the gambling authority itself decides how it carries out those tasks and which priorities it sets.
In beginsel bepaalt de kansspelautoriteit zelf hoe zij die taken uitvoert en welke prioriteiten zij daarbij stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “NMa heeft andere prioriteiten dan muziekauteurs”

MP Peters asked ministers whether the NMa's refusal, on priority grounds, to investigate a complaint by Stichting Platform Makers about NPO conduct was acceptable, whether the minister would talk with the NMa, whether competition law is applied evenhandedly in culture, and when a copyright contracts bill would be submitted. The minister answered that the NMa is an independent body setting its own priorities, that appeal remedies exist, that competition law applies to creators, and that the bill would be submitted shortly.
It is therefore up to the NMa to set its own priorities.
Het is dan ook aan de NMa om haar prioriteiten vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het (niet) aankondigen van inspectiebezoeken aan jeugdgevangenissen

An SP MP asked whether youth prison inspections are announced in advance and whether staff are coached on what to say to inspectors, after a handout of do's and don'ts was reported. The state secretary said youth prison doorlichtingen are always announced, distanced himself from the handout and ordered it withdrawn, and maintained that inspectors can still obtain a truthful picture.
I have distanced myself from the list of do's and don'ts attached to the pre-inspection protocol.
Ik heb afstand genomen van de lijst met do's en don'ts die als bijlage bij het protocol pre-inspectie is gevoegd.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about online privacy, including whether police monitoring of social media should face the same controls as wiretapping and whether the government will disclose how far social media are monitored. The State Secretary says disclosing monitoring would harm investigations, that wiretap statistics are published annually, and that disclosure of social media monitoring would conflict with the state interest under Article 68 of the Constitution.
In my judgement this is the case here.
Hiervan is naar mijn oordeel in dit geval sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Coke-advocaat vrij door tijdgebrek”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a Rotterdam court suspended pre-trial detention of cocaine suspects because trial could only be scheduled in autumn, and demanded faster trial scheduling, evening or weekend sittings and an assessment of structural capacity problems. The State Secretary confirmed the suspension was based on the unusually long detention and no date being set, declined to judge an individual case out of respect for judicial independence, and said court capacity is one of several factors with no count of cases, pointing to ongoing efficiency programmes.
Out of respect for judicial independence, I refrain from judging such a decision in an individual criminal case.
In verband met de rechterlijke onafhankelijkheid past mij terughoudendheid bij het geven van een oordeel over een dergelijke beslissing in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het forensisch psychiatrisch centrum De Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Bouwmeester asked about reports of a fear culture at De Oostvaarderskliniek, including the alarm system, whether staff can safely report incidents, and whether clients and staff have been surveyed. Secretary Teeven denied a faulty alarm system, described existing internal reporting channels and evaluation procedures, and saw no reason for further research into incident reporting.
I see no reason for further research into the reporting of incidents.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar het melden van incidenten.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over belastingvrije donaties aan sekten.

Berndsen (D66) asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Security and Justice whether sects can qualify as ANBI charities, whether Scientology is benefiting via a side route after a court ruling, and whether ANBI fraud or money laundering occurs. State Secretary Weekers answered that a sect has no clear legal meaning, that improper use of ANBI status is unacceptable and can lead to retroactive revocation after an Tax Authority investigation, and that no ANBI fraud cases are currently under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
The statutory duty of confidentiality does not allow me to address facts or assumptions concerning individual institutions.
De wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht staat mij niet toe in te gaan op feiten of veronderstellingen ten aanzien van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over DNA-afgename bij jongeren

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the NFI annual report showing a rise in juveniles in the DNA database and whether DNA sampling of minors is disproportionate due to pedagogical sentences. The government said the study is not yet finished, with the Chamber to be informed before the summer recess, and that the rise reflects stable proportions tied to the 2010 expansion of the DNA Act.
The House of Representatives will be further informed about this before the summer recess.
De Tweede Kamer zal hierover voor het zomerreces nader geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes inzake de ontvoering van een negenjarig meisje

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the reported abduction of a nine-year-old girl, asking whether the Dutch Central Authority acted to return the child, whether criminal measures were taken against the mother, and whether conflicting Dutch and Austrian rulings should be clarified with Austrian authorities. The government replied that the answers are confidential and sent them by post only to the House, without giving the substance in the public text.
Due to the confidential content of the answers, this letter is sent to the House only by post.
In verband met de vertrouwelijke inhoud van de beantwoording, wordt de onderhavige brief alleen per post aan uw Kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about law-enforcement requests for social media user data, including counts of requests, whether Google's publication of request numbers harms investigations, and compliance with the notification duty under article 126bb Sv. The State Secretary declined to publish the counts, said notification compliance is not centrally tracked, and pointed to new guidance for the prosecution offices.
It is not in the interest of investigation to provide this insight, among other things because there is a risk that persons will adjust their behaviour to this information.
Het is niet in het belang van de opsporing om dit inzicht te verschaffen, ondermeer omdat het risico bestaat dat personen hun gedrag op deze informatie gaan afstemmen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over een ontsnapte ter beschikking gestelde

An MP asked the state secretary about a tbs detainee who escaped from FPC De Kijvelanden while on supervised leave, the role of the advisory board AVt, and whether this clinic is under closer supervision or has more absences than others. The state secretary answered that the escape followed procedure, the AVt advised negatively on unsupervised leave, inspections found no structural problems, and absences have fallen since 2005.
Since a negative advice from the AVt is binding for me, I did not grant the extension.
Aangezien een negatief advies van het AVt voor mij bindend is, heb ik de uitbreiding niet toegestaan.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het opleggen van veel te lage straffen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice whether it is acceptable that a driver who caused a fatal accident under the influence of drugs received a fully suspended sentence and a 240-hour community service order, and whether a community service sentence of 120 hours for assaulting a police officer is adequate, and when the community service sentence will be abolished. The State Secretary responds that the courts set sentences independently, declines to comment on individual judgments, and states that community service is retained though it is unsuitable for serious violent offences, which has been restricted by law since early this year.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on the judgment of the court in an individual case.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over het oordeel van de rechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de berichtgeving over de NOvA en het toezicht op de advocatuur

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of a looming conflict with the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) over reform of supervision of the legal profession, including whether he rejected a joint solution and demanded irreversible steps be avoided. Secretary Teeven answered that a draft amendment is pending before the Council of State, that NOvA's objections were considered, that he asked the NOvA not to pursue irreversible situations before parliamentary decision-making, and that he will consider further consultation after the Council of State's advice.
This amendment note regulates, among other things, the revision of supervision of the legal profession.
Deze nota van wijziging regelt onder meer de herziening van het toezicht op de advocatuur.

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the state secretaries about a Gezondheidsraad recommendation on multidisciplinary child-abuse diagnostics, a national network of Kinder- en Jeugd Traumacentra, the motion on forensic expertise, and professional training on signalling and reporting child abuse. The state secretary answered that regional multidisciplinary initiatives will be tested, a forensic-expertise report and working group are underway, and training is the responsibility of employing organisations and education institutions.
In June you will receive a response from the cabinet to that report.
In juni ontvangt u een reactie van het kabinet op dat rapport.

Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over zelfmoord in detentie en reactie verzoek commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie inzake meer informatie over de suïcide die in de nacht van 7 op 8 april plaatsvond in de Penitentiaire Inric

An MP asks the Minister about a suicide in detention at PI Vught, the number of deaths in detention, and whether the frequent incidents at PI Vught will be analysed. The Minister answers that investigations (calamity commission, IGZ, OM) are ongoing, that all deaths are reported to the IGZ and examined, and that the Vught prison functions well overall with an incident analysis planned.
Only once the IGZ and calamity investigations are completed can statements be made about the cause.
Pas als de onderzoeken van de IGZ en het calamiteitenonderzoek zijn afgerond kunnen uitspraken over de toedracht worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders gevaar loopt

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether allowing non-bailiff participation of up to 49% in bailiff practices threatens the independence of bailiffs, who exercise delegated public authority, and whether a ban on third-party participation (a 'nuloptie') should be adopted. The state secretary answered that the 49% participation option already exists, that the proposed extension need not impair independence depending on safeguards in the amended regulation, that the KBvG lacks sufficient support for a ban, and that he will assess any safeguards when the regulation is submitted for approval.

For this reason, the Independence Regulation already stipulates that all decisions on, among other things, the execution of assignments are taken solely by or under the direct responsibility of a bailiff.

Daarom is in de Verordening Onafhankelijkheid reeds vastgelegd dat alle beslissingen over ondermeer de uitvoering van opdrachten uitsluitend worden genomen door of onder directe verantwoordelijkheid van een gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de verkoop van Holland Casino

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Justice about the possible privatisation of Holland Casino, whether it could become an entertainment company, and reports of foreign interest. The government answered that no concrete privatisation proposal exists yet, that any sale will be considered within the broader reform of the gambling market, and that it cannot yet give meaningful answers on sale methods or buyers.
There is therefore currently no concrete proposal for privatisation.
Een concreet voorstel tot privatisering is er nu derhalve niet.
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg over de uitzending van De Vijfde Dag over het huldigen van een tbs'er

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a broadcast on a tbs detainee's escape and early release, including the handling of the 1997 escape, the role of the Advisory Committee on Leave Assessment, drug use under supervision, and the status of the case. The State Secretary answered that the 1997 investigations gave no reason for prosecution, that the minister may depart from positive AVT advice, that controlled soft drug use was permitted by the probation service with prosecutorial consent, and that the tbs measure remains in force pending appeal.
To ensure the tbs measure is never ended without any form of preparation for return to society, I have submitted a legislative amendment.
Om te zorgen dat de tbs-maatregel nooit zonder enige vorm van voorbereiding op de terugkeer in de samenleving wordt beëindigd heb ik een wetswijziging ingediend

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ondertoezichtstelling van ongeboren kinderen (ingezonden 23 februari 20

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health state secretaries why a Dordrecht court refused a supervision order for a 17-week unborn child, whether such orders require 24 weeks of pregnancy, and whether earlier protection is possible. The state secretary answered that no earlier case is known, that the judge did not reach the substance of the request, and that it is for the courts to judge both Article 1:2 BW and whether a situation warrants a supervision order, including before 24 weeks.
It is for the judge to assess whether a situation warrants a supervision order.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een situatie ots-waardig is.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat een rechter geen ondertoezichtstelling heeft uitgesproken van een foetus van 17 weken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the court's refusal to place a 17-week foetus under supervision was acceptable, what safety measures were taken for the 18-year-old mother, and whether supervision could be extended or lowered in age limits. The State Secretary said the judiciary decides on supervision, a safety plan was in place (details withheld for privacy and security), a new interim supervision was granted at 24 weeks, and a general age change was neither desirable nor possible.
It is for the judge to assess whether a situation warrants supervision (ots).
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een situatie ots-waardig is.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over geweldpleging Mohammed B. in de gevangenis

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported fight in which Mohammed B. attacked a fellow inmate, whether it was true that a fellow inmate intervened instead of staff, and whether he had access to boxing training. The State Secretary answered that the OM dropped prosecution because the prisoner was already disciplined, that staff intervened adequately, that no boxing lessons were given though a punching bag is available, and that no martial arts instruction is provided.
It is correct that on 27 May 2011 a fight between two inmates took place in the exercise yard of the Extra Secure Facility (EBI), in which a fellow inmate intervened.

Het is juist dat op 27 mei 2011 een vechtpartij tussen twee gedetineerden heeft plaatsgevonden op de luchtplaats van de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI), waarbij een medegedetineerde tussenbeide is gekomen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de toerusting en verantwoordelijkheden van gezinsvoogden

MPs Kooiman (SP) asked seven questions about the power and training of child protection guardians (gezinsvoogden), following a Vara Ombudsman broadcast, including the timing of disciplinary law for youth care, mandatory continuing training, caseload and mentoring for new guardians, parents' right to respond to the plan of action, judges' time per case, and complaints handling. The state secretary answered that professionalisation via registration and disciplinary law is being prepared, that parents may already add their views and the bureaus will be reminded of this, and that complaints handling will be unified through provincial policy frameworks, while leaving caseloads and judges' time largely to the sector and the judiciary.
Parents also have the right to add their own opinion to a report or petition.
Ouders hebben ook het recht om hun eigen mening aan een rapport of verzoekschrift toe te voegen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet melden van een niet-n

An MP asked ministers why the Public Prosecution Service believes doctors wrongly sign natural-death certificates and why reporting of non-natural deaths is low, and whether the NODO procedure for child deaths will be introduced. The government answered that the prosecution service relies on a Nivel/EMGO estimate of about 1,960 avoidable care-related deaths yearly against only 96 reports, plans a knowledge campaign before approaching institutions, and promises a letter on the NODO procedure's status.
To establish whether a wrongly issued natural-death certificate has occurred, the prosecution service depends on other parties.
Om vast te stellen of sprake is geweest van een ten onrechte afgegeven verklaring van natuurlijk overlijden is het OM afhankelijk van andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het verschoningsrecht van bedrijfsjuristen

An MP asked the state secretary about legal privilege for in-house lawyers after a Groningen court ruled they lack it, citing EU case law. The state secretary said the ruling is under appeal, declined to take a position or commit to legislation yet, and said he would consult stakeholders on the scope of the privilege.
Pending a final judicial ruling, I will consult with the parties concerned to further explore the scope of the legal privilege.
In afwachting van een definitief rechterlijk oordeel zal ik in overleg met betrokken partijen mij nader oriënteren op (de reikwijdte van) het verschoningsrecht.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het aantal sterfgevallen in detentie

MP Bouwmeester asked about deaths in detention, including discrepancies between DJI and IGZ figures and reported deaths of detainees in late 2011. The state secretary explained the differences in counting and reporting, acknowledged that some deaths outside prisons were not reported to the IGZ, and promised intensified cooperation and a policy response after the Nationale Ombudsman study.

I consider it important that such deaths are also reported, so that there is a complete overview of all deceased persons under the responsibility of DJI, and I have therefore asked the penitentiary institutions to comply.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook dergelijke sterfgevallen gemeld worden, zodat er een totaaloverzicht is van alle overledenen onder verantwoordelijkheid van DJI, en heb de pi's dan ook gevraagd hier gehoor aan te geven.
Antwoord vragen Straus over het geweld tegen hulpverleners in de psychiatrie dat vaak onbestraft blijft

An MP asked the government about violence against psychiatric staff that often goes unpunished, including low reporting rates, weak prosecution, and differences between institutions and patient groups. The minister answered that the government is taking the issue seriously, points to the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg, the ELA agreements and the new Politie-GGZ convenant, and reports no evidence of differences in prioritisation or treatment.
In it we have included measures aimed at the care sector to improve the legal approach to the perpetrator, including an increase in willingness to report.
Daarin hebben wij op de zorgsector gerichte maatregelen opgenomen om de juridische aanpak van de veroorzaker te verbeteren, inclusief een verhoging van de aangiftebereidheid.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Peters over de ontslagvergoeding van een directielid van Buma/Stemra

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether the very high severance pay of a former Buma/Stemra legal director, paid from funds meant for artists, was acceptable, and whether the College van Toezicht or the minister could claw it back. Minister Teeven answered that the payment predates the supervision law and the salary norm, that there is no legal basis for clawback in this case, and that the forthcoming WNT and wetsvoorstel 31 766 will allow future recovery and salary caps.
This concerns an employment contract concluded some time ago, long before the Supervision of Collective Management Organisations Act came into force.
Het betreft hier een arbeidscontract dat geruime tijd geleden tot stand is gekomen, lang voordat de Wet toezicht collectieve beheersorganisaties in werking was getreden
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de verklaring van erfrecht

MP Recourt asks whether bank declarations replacing the certificate of inheritance give the same safeguards, whether heirs understand them, and whether banks must warn heirs that signing accepts the estate. The state secretary answers that the NVB form is not an equivalent safeguard, that banks will advise or refer heirs to a notary, and that the NVB will revise the form to flag pure acceptance of the estate.
The NVB has promised to look at how the NVB form can be adjusted on this point in the short term.
Zij heeft toegezegd op korte termijn te bekijken hoe het NVB-formulier op dit punt kan worden aangepast.

Antwoord vragen Arib en Groot over het bericht dat de fiscus belasting heft over smartengeld van slachtoffers uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog en mogelijk ook over vergoedingen voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen de

MPs Arib and Groot asked whether tax is levied on compensation paid to Second World War victims and to victims of abuse in the Catholic Church, and how such payments affect benefit entitlements. The government answered that periodic Artikel 2 Fonds payments are taxable income, that lump-sum church compensation is not income for tax purposes but counts as assets, and that municipalities decide on benefit means-testing, with a planned exemption under review.
I have decided together with the relevant fellow ministers to take measures so that the one-off payments from the Roman Catholic Church at issue are included in this regulation.

Ik heb met de betrokken collega-bewindslieden besloten om maatregelen te treffen waardoor de hier aan de orde zijnde eenmalige uitkeringen van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk in deze regeling worden opgenomen.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet melden van een niet-n

An MP asks ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service's concern that doctors sign death certificates too quickly is well founded, how many notifications of unnatural deaths were received, what the NODO procedure's status is, and why it has been delayed. The document is a holding notice: the government announces that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has yet been received.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Werkstraffen voor geweld op voetbalveld”

An MP asked the state secretary whether a 40-hour community sentence for two footballers who kicked an opponent into hospital is acceptable, and how to prevent such sentences. The secretary answered that courts act independently, that the sentence reflected the defendants' lack of prior record and tuchtcommissie appearances, and that the new legal limits on community sentences for serious violence will be evaluated.
As State Secretary of Security and Justice, I cannot interfere with the independent judgment of a judge.
Als Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie kan ik niet treden in het onafhankelijke oordeel van een rechter.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het krantenartikel “Veilig, veiliger, veiligst”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a newspaper report on tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patients being granted escorted leave earlier, the 18-month rule, escort composition, escape reporting to police and a central emergency number. The State Secretary explains the fpc guideline timeframes, the individual risk-based leave assessment reviewed by the independent Avt, the phased escort system, and that escapes must be reported immediately to police, with fpcs asked to adjust service instructions; no central number is needed.
In practice the KLPD escape team in Leusden is also often informed and brought in after consultation with the public prosecution service.
In de praktijk wordt vaak ook het team ontrekkingen van het KLPD te Leusden geïnformeerd en ingeschakeld na overleg met het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over het tekort aan capaciteit bij de College bescherming persoonsgegevens

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked the state secretary about the Dutch data protection authority's (CBP) shortage of capacity, reports that over half its cases remain unhandled, whether companies should self-report data breaches, and whether CBP fines could fund its staffing. The state secretary answered that enforcement must fit available resources, expects around 66,000 breach notifications a year under the planned duty, and said fine revenue cannot be directly used by the CBP under budget rules, while studying a broader administrative fine regime.
As stated in the attached draft explanatory memorandum, the notification duty is estimated to lead to 66 thousand notifications per year.
Zoals in het daarbij gevoegde concept van de Memorie van Toelichting wordt vermeld zal de meldplicht naar schatting leiden tot 66 duizend meldingen per jaar.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het oprukken van ‘Ndrangheta in de Nederlandse samenleving’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Ndrangheta poses a serious threat in the Netherlands, whether intelligence and investigative capacity are fragmented, and whether it may infiltrate government. The minister acknowledges some involvement in drug trafficking and money laundering, says existing structures (National Recherche, Public Prosecution Service, National Threat Picture) are adequate, sees no signs of government infiltration, declines to set up a dedicated team, and promises a working group review.
It is important that the matter in question is looked at again carefully.
Wel is van belang dat de desbetreffende problematiek nog eens goed tegen het licht wordt gehouden.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Dwing OM tot hoger beroep’

An MP asks whether victims should be able to force the Public Prosecution Service to appeal a judgment, as a citizens' committee proposed. The state secretary answers that victims' interests are weighed but the prosecution keeps sole discretion over appeals, and giving victims a say would amount to a disguised appeal they are not party to, which he rejects.
I consider that undesirable, apart from the consequences for the duration of criminal proceedings and for the capacity of the judiciary.
Ik acht dat onwenselijk, nog los van de gevolgen voor de doorlooptijd van een strafproces en voor de capaciteit van de rechterlijke macht.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het boek Rien ne va plus van een ex medewerker van Holland Casino

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a book by a former Holland Casino employee alleging weak addiction prevention and money-laundering risks, and why a lifetime entry ban is refused. The government answers that Holland Casino's prevention and anti-money-laundering conduct meets the rules (per an Audit Office report), disputes several factual claims, and says a lifetime ban is unrealistic and Holland Casino may refuse it.
Holland Casino has told me it will investigate the factual basis of the incidents described in the book.
Holland Casino heeft mij aangegeven onderzoek te doen naar het feitelijke gehalte van de in het boek beschreven incidenten.

An MP asked whether Dutch law protects children against threatened international abduction, whether attempts are punishable, and how many abduction cases occur; the state secretary replied that article 279 Sr together with the general attempt and preparation provisions (arts. 45-46 Sr) gives police and the Marechaussee sufficient powers to intervene, that the Hague Convention is generally well observed, and that a checklist (Baliekaart) for police and prosecutors exists and is being updated. The answers are substantive and largely committal on existing powers, without a new commitment to legislative change.
In my view, the police and the Royal Marechaussee have sufficient legal tools to act against an abducting parent in the case of a planned international child abduction.

Naar mijn oordeel beschikken politie en de Koninklijke Marechaussee over voldoende juridische handvatten om bij een voorgenomen internationale kinderontvoering op te treden tegen de ontvoerende ouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het digitaal rechercheren

An MP asked whether current legislation is still suitable for digital investigation, after the head of the National Police Investigation Service reportedly said it was not, and whether the minister had been contacted about these concerns. The minister acknowledged the reports, said new legislation on cybercrime is being prepared with proposals expected by summer 2012, and said there was no direct contact with the National Investigation head but extensive contact with police and prosecution services.
Before the summer of 2012 I will inform your House further on this.
Voor de zomer van 2012 zal ik uw Kamer hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kooiman over de financiering van Multi Systeem Therapie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why Multi Systemic Therapy for youths is mostly funded through health insurance rather than justice, and whether budget cuts and a limited number of justice-ordered treatments threaten its availability, including in Overijssel. The State Secretary said MST is promoted where suited to a youth's risk profile, that most MST is funded via health insurance by agreement with the provinces, that the justice-funded GBM placements are limited, and that capacity matters are for the youth probation services, GGZ providers and insurers, with a promised official-level consultation and later update.
I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of this consultation.
Ik zal u binnenkort over de uitkomsten van dit overleg informeren.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over ongeldige vonnissen van e-Court

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary whether e-Court's arbitral judgments, found invalid by a court, mislead contract partners and whether government will act, and about the use of binding advice and the Intrum Justitia deal. The state secretary replied that e-Court is a private body and must adapt its procedure itself, that the information given was correct, that arbitration rules are public, and that government will not intervene in private agreements.
Since this concerns a private dispute resolution body, it is not for me to take action.
Aangezien het om een private geschilbeslechtingsinstantie gaat is het niet aan mij om actie te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voorlopige hechtenis van dhr. R (ingezonden 28 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a suspect held in pre-trial detention for over five years, questioning the presumption of innocence, the limits on detention length, judicial independence, and the adequacy of legal remedies. The state secretary replied that the statutory 90-day limit and judicial review at each extension protect the suspect, that no absolute maximum is needed given the gravity of such offences, and that no new motivation rules or remedies are required.
I do not consider it desirable to include an absolute maximum in the law for this, precisely because of the seriousness of the offences and the risk to public safety if such suspects were released.

Ik acht het niet wenselijk om hiervoor een absoluut maximum in de wet op te nemen, juist vanwege de ernst van de strafbare feiten en het risico voor de maatschappelijke veiligheid als dergelijke verdachten op vrije voeten komen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opkomsttijden in Petten e.o (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

MP Kooiman asked whether NRG's company fire brigade stopping service outside its site from 1 January 2012 would lengthen response times in Petten to 15-17 minutes, and whether the safety region's compliance with statutory norms and the free smoke detectors were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the safety region's board imposed the staffing requirements, that response times would rise to 15-17 minutes, that the board will assess Petten against the norm in a review programme, and that he sees no reason to doubt fire safety.

The general board of the Noord-Holland Noord Safety Region will ultimately decide, through the cost-benefit assessment mentioned earlier, whether to take structural improvement measures or to deviate from the statutory norm with reasons.

Het algemeen bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Noord-Holland Noord zal uiteindelijk door middel van de eerder genoemde kosten-batenafweging besluiten tot het nemen van structurele verbetermaatregelen of het gemotiveerd afwijken van de wettelijke norm.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over gedetineerden uit Saba en St. Eustatius in Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked the Dutch government about prisoners from Saba and St. Eustatius being held and tried on Bonaire, covering defence-lawyer access, video-link problems, prison conditions, juvenile offenders, reintegration, family visits and the facility location. Minister Opstelten largely rejected the critiques, said conditions are equal to other prisons and improving, and promised a new prison on St. Eustatius by 2014 and an examination of weekly video contact for families.

Since 10 October 2010 a slightly different situation has arisen, namely that suspects detained longer than 18 days are now transferred to Bonaire instead of St. Maarten, but the suspect's detention rights have remained unchanged.

Sinds 10 oktober 2010 is weliswaar een iets andere situatie ontstaan dan daarvoor, namelijk dat verdachten die langer dan 18 dagen gedetineerd zijn nu naar Bonaire worden overgebracht in plaats van naar St. Maarten, maar de rechten van de verdachte in het kader van detentie zijn onveranderd gebleven.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het “Cocaïnefeestje in de gevangenis”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that a man smuggled cocaine into the Schutterswei prison by swallowing cocaine pellets, and why standard checks did not catch it. The secretary answered that the drugs were found after intelligence from another inmate, that standard checks found nothing, that no extra pellet check is planned for now, and that the drug-deterrence policy is being revised with a letter to parliament in spring.
Therefore the department-wide drug deterrence policy will be tightened on certain points, partly in light of the evaluation outcomes.
Daarom zal het GW-brede drugsontmoedigingsbeleid mede naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van dit beleid op bepaalde punten worden aangescherpt.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over online privacy (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

MP El Fassed asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a US court ruling allowing Twitter data in the WikiLeaks probe, how Dutch police obtain social media data and what legal protection targets have, how often such data were requested in 2009-2011, and whether Dutch privacy law should be tightened compared with Iceland. The State Secretary answers that the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure provides notification duties, complaint rights under article 552a and judicial review, that the statistics cannot be broken down by provider or suspect status for investigative reasons, and that no fundamental revision is needed.

I believe that Dutch legislation, including the Code of Criminal Procedure, is a balanced system in which the necessary intrusions on private life are surrounded by adequate safeguards and that judicial oversight is properly exercised.

Ik meen dat de Nederlandse wetgeving, waaronder begrepen het Wetboek van strafvordering, een evenwichtig stelsel is, waarin de noodzakelijke inbreuken op de persoonlijke levenssfeer met adequate waarborgen zijn omkleed en dat daarop goed toezicht wordt gehouden door de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Bontes, Elissen en Van Bemmel van uw Kamer over het censureren van internet

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether court-ordered blocking of websites by internet providers (following the Brein case) is censorship, what steps will prevent it, whether compensation applies if the ruling is reversed, and why funds for internet freedom abroad are not used domestically. The state secretary declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to existing compensation law, noted that Dutch policy opposes censorship while funds are spent abroad, and said he is still considering a response to a related motion.
By letter I informed the House about the ruling of the Hague District Court of 11 January 2012 and indicated that I refrain from commenting on this case, because it is before the court.

Bij brief heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag van 11 januari 2012 en heb ik aangegeven dat ik mij onthoud van commentaar op deze zaak, omdat deze onder de rechter is.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het laten werken van gedetineerden na detentie en de rol van het Uitvoeringsorgaan wer

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Justice and Social Affairs about job placement for prisoners before release, the UWV role, the effect of new four-week job-search waiting periods for under-27s, and budget cuts. The government answered that the UWV service continues but is moving to a digital format, that the waiting period applies to all young people registering with the UWV, and that prisoners themselves must take responsibility for their reintegration.
The state secretary of Justice and Security will inform you about work in detention no later than 1 May 2012.
Over arbeid in detentie wordt u uiterlijk 1 mei 2012 door de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie geïnformeerd.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de disproportionele kosten die non-profit organisaties moeten betalen aan de Buma en SENA (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Peters asks the state secretary why a carnival association was charged disproportionate fees by Buma and SENA, whether the error was handled too slowly, and whether other non-profit organisations are wrongly invoiced. The state secretary says the fees were corrected after complaint, the error stemmed partly from the association's own information, and he sees insufficient reason for a broader investigation of non-profit invoicing.
I see insufficient reason in the above for further investigation into incorrect invoicing of not-for-profit organisations
Ik zie in het voorgaande onvoldoende aanleiding voor een nader onderzoek naar onjuiste facturering van not-for-profit organisaties
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het op non-actief stellen van een klokkenluider binnen het gevangeniswezen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An MP asks why a department head at PI Zwolle prison was placed on leave, whether media disclosure played a role, who is responsible for the disclosure of his identity, and whether he qualifies as a whistleblower entitled to protection. The state secretary says the leave was an administrative measure with pay due to service interests, apologises for the internal disclosure of his name, and states that the whistleblower procedure under the Regeling was followed, with an investigation finding no misconduct.

In doing so, the reporter was promised legal protection in accordance with the Regulation, and was also told that he would not suffer any adverse consequences in the performance of his duties in any other way.
Daarbij is de melder, conform de Regeling, rechtsbescherming toegezegd en toegevoegd dat hij ook niet op een andere wijze bij de uitoefening van zijn functie nadelige gevolgen zou ondervinden.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Politie zoekt vermiste sekteleden» (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

MP Berndsen asked the minister about reports that members of the Efraim Genootschap, including minors, had disappeared, and why authorities did not intervene earlier. The state secretary answered that the prosecutor found no grounds for criminal investigation since the father had known of the plans and raised no concern, the sons have returned, a victims' reporting point is being considered, and no new sect policy is planned.
On the basis of these facts and circumstances, the public prosecutor decided not to start a criminal investigation and asked the police to withdraw the alert on the woman.
Op grond van deze feiten en omstandigheden heeft de officier van justitie besloten geen opsporingsonderzoek te starten en de politie gevraagd om de signalering van de vrouw in te trekken.
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de conferentie van OWASP (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister why no Govcert representative attended the OWASP Benelux security conference, whether the government would use OWASP's material, how the cost of that conference compared with the Govcert symposium, and whether it would engage more with the volunteer security community. The state secretary replied that Govcert is well connected to OWASP, already uses its material in the Raamwerk Beveiliging Webapplicaties, collaborates on a publication, and engages external experts within legal limits.
Govcert.nl is well connected to the initiatives arising from OWASP.
Govcert.nl is goed aangesloten op de initiatieven die voortvloeien uit OWASP.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een onderzoek naar het functioneren van het politiekorps Limburg-Zuid (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a visitation report finding that police force Limburg-Zuid was intellectually limited, including the chief's remarks about citizen dissatisfaction, its neighbourhood policing, internal accountability culture, and how visitations are used. The State Secretary answered that the chief's remarks were unfortunate but not meant as stated, that neighbourhood policing is adequate, that improvement initiatives are underway, and that visitation reports are routinely received.
I always receive the reports of the external visitation committee, together with the results of the force investigation and the police board's view on the visitation report.
Ik krijg de rapporten van de externe visitatiecommissie, samen met de resultaten van het korpsonderzoek en de visie van de korpsbeheerder op het visitatierapport altijd aangeboden.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het rapport politiekorps Limburg-Zuid (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

SP MP Kooiman asked the minister about a critical visitation report on police force Limburg-Zuid, including whether the report would be shared, the chief's priorities, the force's culture, and her suitability as regional transition manager. The state secretary sent the public report, referred to earlier answers on substance, said the quality of police work is sufficient, noted the appointment procedure for transition managers, and summarised the less critical Limburg-Noord visitation.
The visitation committee's report and the underlying documents are public, in line with the explanatory memorandum to the 24 June 1999 police quality-assurance decree.
Het rapport van de visitatiecommissie en de daaraan ten grondslag liggende documenten zijn – conform de MvT van het besluit kwaliteitszorg politie 24 juni 1999 – openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over het tekort in de ouderenpot bij de politie (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

Kooiman (SP) asked ministers why a 700 million euro shortfall arose in the police early-retirement scheme, who is responsible, and whether officers will bear the cost. The state secretary attributed the shortfall to incorrect population assumptions, said the scheme is being revised in ongoing CAO negotiations, and declined to set a firm timeline beyond an intention to reach agreement in spring.
The parties have expressed the intention to reach an agreement this spring.
Partijen hebben de intentie uitgesproken om dit voorjaar tot een akkoord te komen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over interlandelijke adoptie uit de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands still upholds the subsidiarity principle in intercountry adoption under the Hague Convention, and how a US practice allowing birth parents to choose adoptive families fits with it, including whether domestic placement must still be shown. The State Secretary answered yes, relying on US counseling, court review and Dutch Central Authority checks, arguing the US procedure satisfies the convention's 'due consideration' requirement.

I am of the view that if the American adoption agency has drawn up a careful adoption plan and the judge reviews whether the subsidiarity principle has been sufficiently satisfied, the Netherlands can agree with that.

Ik ben van mening dat als door het Amerikaanse adoptiebureau een zorgvuldig adoptieplan is gemaakt en de rechter toetst of er in voldoende mate is voldaan aan het subsidiariteitsbeginsel, Nederland daarmee kan instemmen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld en agressie in de gevangenis (ingezonden 28 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether he is shocked that the Labour Inspectorate found safety not guaranteed in 79% of prisons, whether the machismo culture will be tackled, and whether he will focus on violence and recidivism rather than privatisation. The state secretary replies that a WODC survey shows measures have worked, that the inspectorate's findings call for more attention to embedding measures, and that a cabinet position on privatisation will follow.
The findings of the Labour Inspectorate mean that more efforts are needed in some areas, particularly in embedding the measures taken.
De bevindingen van de Inspectie SZW leiden ertoe dat er op onderdelen meer inspanningen nodig zijn, met name op het gebied van de borging van de getroffen maatregelen.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overlijden van een gedetineerde in het penitentiair psychiatrisch centrum (PPC) (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a detainee's death in a penitentiary psychiatric centre, including IGZ findings on care quality, isolation use, staff training, workload links, and rising deaths in detention. The State Secretary answers that investigations are ongoing, outlines the reporting and inquiry steps, describes staff training and efforts to reduce coercion, and provides 2010 death statistics with commitments to a patient file and to await the Ombudsman and DJI studies.
Currently, fact-finding into this incident is being carried out through the appropriate channels.
Momenteel wordt via de geëigende kanalen toedrachtsonderzoek gedaan naar dit incident.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van de Veiligheid en Justitie over afluisteren van advocaten en cliënten (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether recording equipment in prison visiting rooms, which may be used to record lawyer-client conversations, threatens the confidentiality of lawyer-client contact and the right to a fair trial, and whether the Dutch bar's planned summary proceedings against the state are welcome. The secretary answers that recording equipment may be present for order and security, that the prison service has committed to giving lawyers rooms without it or to disclosing and switching off any equipment, that equipment remains in some institutions housing high-risk detainees for capacity and security reasons, and declines to assess the chances of the court case.
It is not the presence of recording equipment in a visiting room but the recording of a conversation that would infringe a detainee's right to a confidential conversation with his lawyer.

Niet het aanwezig zijn van opnameapparatuur in een spreekkamer, maar het opnemen van een gesprek zou een inbreuk betekenen op het recht van een gedetineerde op een vertrouwelijk gesprek met zijn advocaat.
Vragen van het lid Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Sharia4Belgium (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about disruption of debates by Sharia4Belgium/Sharia4Holland activists, past similar incidents, and whether the football-violence law, unwelcome declaration, and firearms-licence rules could prevent recurrence. The state secretary answered that the law could be applied to known disturbers facing serious fear of future disruption, that unwelcome declaration of EU citizens is a very far-reaching measure requiring proportionality, and that firearms licences would be refused where signals of misuse exist, but he had no direct contact with Belgian authorities on this incident.
Declaring an EU citizen unwelcome is a very far-reaching measure that must be proportionate and may be based solely on the foreigner's conduct.

Het ongewenst verklaren van een EU-burger is een zeer vergaande maatregel, die in overeenstemming moet zijn met het evenredigheidsbeginsel en uitsluitend gebaseerd mag zijn op het gedrag van de vreemdeling.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overlijden van een gedetineerde in het penitentiair psychiatrisch centrum (PPC) (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the death of a detainee in a penitentiary psychiatric centre, whether care and dossiers met standards, whether staff are trained in restraint, and whether deaths in detention are rising. The government's answer is only a holding notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received.
cannot be answered within the usual period, since not all the required information has yet been received
niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de disproportionele kosten die non-profit organisaties moeten betalen aan de Buma en SENA (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

MP Peters asks the state secretary why a carnival association was charged disproportionate and inconsistent Buma/SENA copyright fees over three years, whether it was an administrative error, and whether other non-profit organisations are affected. The reply in this item is only an interim notice stating that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet.
since not all the required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld en agressie in de gevangenis (ingezonden 28 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Security and Justice about violence and aggression in prisons, citing an Arbeidsinspectie finding that safety is still not guaranteed in 79% of inspected institutions, and asks whether his earlier claims of improved safety were based on reality, whether he will send the report, and how he will tackle the problem. The state secretary replies only with a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received, and promises an answer as soon as possible.
since not all the required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over Google en het ongevraagd gebruik maken van gebruikersdata voo

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked whether Google, Apple and others collect Wi-Fi location data from consumers' phones without consent and whether a ban is needed. The State Secretary answered that the Data Protection Act gives the regulator enough room to impose a ban if needed, and that consent is the basis for collecting movement data while Wi-Fi router data may be collected under legitimate interest with safeguards.
Such a specific ban is not necessary.
Een dergelijk specifiek verbod is niet nodig.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het op non-actief stellen van een klokkenluider binnen het gevangeniswezen (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Security and Justice whether a department head at the Zwolle prison was suspended, why, whether making the case public played a role, what the ministry's responsibility is for disclosing the official's identity, and whether this official should be treated as a whistleblower with protection. The document is a ministerial notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet, with a promise to answer as soon as possible.
since not all the required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de financiering van Multi Systeem Therapie (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why Multi Systemic Therapy, an evidence-based youth programme, is funded by justice only in certain criminal-law frameworks, whether this reflects budget cuts, and how the government will promote it. The State Secretary answers that MST is funded via the WMO and Zvw, that justice temporarily funds it for one framework pending evaluation, and that a demand-oriented approach applies, so no single programme will be promoted.
Because this is a severe target group with a high recidivism risk, it was decided at the time to temporarily fund the use of programmes within this measure, including MST, through Justice.
Omdat hier sprake is van een zware doelgroep met een hoog recidiverisico, is destijds besloten de inzet van programma's binnen deze maatregel, waaronder MST, tijdelijk door Justitie te financieren.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over interlandelijke adoptie uit de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

MP Kooiman (SP) asks the state secretary whether the subsidiarity principle in the Hague Adoption Convention still holds for intercountry adoption from the United States, given that US birth parents may choose who adopts their child, and whether that is a correct legal reading. The state secretary replies only with a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period and that an answer will follow as soon as possible.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe werkwijze van het Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en de overeenkomsten met gerechtsdeurwaarders (ingezonden 7 decembe

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether the CJIB is reopening its contracts with bailiffs and moving to no-cure-no-pay, and about risks, justification and savings. The state secretary replied that the CJIB is exploring more cost-efficient options with bailiffs, that no-cure-no-pay is one option but the form is not settled, and that the KBvG will be involved in developing the new approach.
The precise working method still has to be further developed. The KBvG will also be involved in this.
De precieze werkwijze moet nog nader worden ontwikkeld. Daarbij zal ook de KBvG worden betrokken.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van de Veiligheid en Justitie over afluisteren van advocaten en cliënten (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about recording equipment in prison consultation rooms that may allow lawyer-client conversations to be overheard, and whether this threatens the right to a fair trial, including the bar's objection to the prison service's proposal and a planned summary proceeding. The answer is only a holding notice saying the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de financiering van Multi Systeem Therapie (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the funding of Multi Systemic Therapy for juveniles, including why justice funding is restricted to measures and whether use will be stopped on 1 January 2012 for lack of funds. The text is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has been received.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Elissen (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het registreren van routers (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Dutch privacy law allows an opt-out instead of opt-in for collecting router (MAC and location) data, whether such collection could harm privacy, and whether companies like Microsoft, Apple, Blackberry and Skyhook are in violation and should be investigated. The State Secretary answered that Article 8(f) Wbp provides a basis for the processing, that the DPA (CBP) is the independent supervisor responsible for enforcement, that no criminal action is warranted, and that the government will address the opt-in/opt-out question in a forthcoming letter to parliament.
Whether the companies named in the article are in violation is a matter for the CBP.
Het oordeel of de in het artikel genoemde bedrijven in overtreding zijn is aan het CBP.

Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake kinderalimentatie bij schuldsanering (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

MPs Recourt and Van der Steur asked whether kinderalimentatie (child maintenance) should be a preferential claim in bankruptcy and debt rescheduling after a Supreme Court ruling that it is not automatically preferential. The state secretary answered that preference must rest on statute, that preference would bring little practical benefit in insolvency, and that the government would decide after receiving LBIO figures whether a statutory change is warranted.
Yes. In the letter of 15 January 2010 the previous Minister of Justice promised to further examine granting preference to the child maintenance claim.
Ja. In de brief van 15 januari 2010 heeft de vorige Minister van Justitie toegezegd het bevoorrechten van de vordering tot kinderalimentatie nader te onderzoeken
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opmerking dat een gevangenis geen hotel is (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

MP Gesthuizen asks the state secretary whether the prison is now a hotel, what hotel-like elements exist, and whether he misrepresented research on sentencing preferences by selectively quoting it. The state secretary says 'a prison is not a hotel' meant privileges should be earned via promotion and demotion, and denies misrepresenting the research, citing findings that support recidivist minimum-sentence policy.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overplaatsen van een gevangenisdirecteur en beschuldigingen aan zijn adres (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

An MP asks whether allegations against the dismissed Tilburg prison director were dropped, whether a 'cover-up' took place, and how the internal investigation, hidden camera use and his transfer were handled. The state secretary replies that the BI&V investigation found conflicting witness accounts, the director withdrew from his post and was reassigned, and that covert camera surveillance was ended once the works council objected.
In no way is there therefore any question of a cover-up affair.
Op geen enkele wijze is dan ook sprake van een doofpotaffaire.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over intimidatie door de ex-directeur van PI te Tilburg (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the former director of the Tilburg prison intimidated staff and secretly installed cameras, and whether the ministry buried complaints. The state secretary answered that an independent BI&V investigation found conflicting witness accounts, no sexual intimidation complaint was filed, and the director stopped camera monitoring after the works council refused consent.
No criminal complaint of sexual intimidation was filed.
Er is geen aangifte gedaan van seksuele intimidatie.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Spaarcenten demente oudere vergokt» (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretaries whether a dementia patient's savings were gambled away by a suspect who was not investigated despite a filed complaint and video footage, and asks for a faster police response and a higher penalty for elder abuse. The government replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet.

I hereby inform you, on behalf of the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport, that the written questions from MP Agema about the report 'Dementia patient's savings gambled away' cannot be answered within the usual deadline, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Mededeling Hierbij bericht ik u, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) over het bericht «Spaarcenten demente oudere vergokt» (ingezonden 17 november 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over intimidatie door de ex-directeur van PI te Tilburg (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reported intimidation and offensive conduct by the former director of the Tilburg prison, including secret cameras, and whether the ministry ignored the works council's complaints. The document is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received yet.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Bouwmeester (PvdA) to the State Secretary for Security and Justice about intimidation by the former director of PI Tilburg (submitted 17 November 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) van uw Kamer aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over intimidatie door de ex-directeur van PI te Tilburg (ingezonden 17 november 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over wapenhandel in Nederland (ingezonden 21 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice seven questions about a broadcast exposing an arms dealer who was a shooting club member and whose apparently legal arms trade hid illegal dealings, covering police investigative capacity and EU coordination. The government's reply is only a holding notice saying the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, with answers promised as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from Member Berndsen (D66) to the State Secretary for Security and Justice on arms trade in the Netherlands (submitted 21 November 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen (D66) van uw Kamer aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over wapenhandel in Nederland (ingezonden 21 november 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over mogelijke corruptie van een bestuurslid van Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 2 december 2011).
