An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a Buma/Stemra board member allegedly tied mediation over about 1 million euro in withheld royalties owed to a composer to receiving one third of that sum, and whether Buma/Stemra wrongly withheld royalties while using the work in its own advertising. The state secretary called the report disturbing, said the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten was asked to investigate with priority, that the board member has resigned, and that the supervisor's powers over Stemra will be strengthened by a pending bill.
Following the broadcast, I contacted the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten with the request to investigate the matter with priority.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending heb ik contact opgenomen met het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten met het verzoek de zaak met voorrang te onderzoeken.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overplaatsen van een gevangenisdirecteur en beschuldigingen aan zijn adres (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether allegations against a prison director in Tilburg, who resigned, are not being further investigated and whether this amounts to a cover-up, how an investigation into alleged intimidation and sexual remarks was conducted, why a hidden camera was not acted upon, what links exist between staff complaints, an integrity investigation, his dismissal and transfer, and whether staff should report complaints to the director himself. The government's reply is only a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all necessary information has been received, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.
since not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een dominee die kindermishandeling vergoelijkt (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

MP Arib asked the state secretaries whether a Katwijk pastor's newsletter, which said children may be physically punished, amounts to inciting child abuse and whether it is criminal. The government replied that it condemns any violence against children, that the Public Prosecution Service judged the statements a non-criminal exhortation to read a book, and that the pastor distanced himself from any call to corporal punishment.
The Public Prosecution Service examined the statements and regards them mainly as a non-criminal exhortation to the members of his congregation to read a book the pastor finds worthwhile.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft de uitingen van betrokkene bekeken en ziet deze vooral als een – niet strafbare – aansporing aan de leden van zijn gemeente om een boek te lezen dat betrokkene lezenswaardig vindt.
Vragen van de leden Helder en de Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht: «werkstraffen voor hooligans» (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice whether the community sentence (taakstraf) should be removed as a main penalty for lack of public support, and whether group liability in article 141 of the Penal Code should be strengthened for public violence by rioters. The government answered that research shows public support for community service and lower recidivism than prison, so it will keep it, and that a consultation on article 141 is ongoing with a report promised for January 2012.
The cabinet considers it important to retain the community sentence in the sanctions system.
Het kabinet acht het behoud van de taakstraf in het sanctiestelsel van belang.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opmerking dat een gevangenis geen hotel is (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether a prison is now a hotel, why he said a prison is not a hotel while announcing a leave-policy change, and whether he regrets selectively quoting research on public sentencing preferences and will be more honest in future. The government's answer is only a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, and that it aims to answer as soon as possible.
because not all the necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een tbs’er afgelopen zaterdag in zijn woning de minderjarige dochter van zijn vriendin heeft verkracht (inge

An MP asks the state secretary how a tbs (forensic psychiatric) detainee who had been judged dangerous and suicidal came to be released on conditional terms and allowed to live independently, and why the reclassering and police did not inform the mayor of Doesburg after he allegedly raped a minor. The secretary expresses shock, explains the risk assessment and intensive supervision, admits the municipality was not part of the information pilot, and promises evaluation and nationwide rollout of mayoral information sharing.
Early 2012 the pilot will be evaluated. If the evaluation is positive, nationwide rollout can then begin.
Begin 2012 wordt de pilot geëvalueerd. Bij positieve uitkomst van de evaluatie kan daarna gestart worden met de landelijke uitrol.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wijze waarop Nederland invulling geeft aan de levenslange gevangenisstraf (ingezond

An MP (D66) asked the Justice ministers about the life sentence in the Netherlands, including the Forum Levenslang proposal for conditional release after twenty years with judicial review. The state secretary replied that the 32 life-sentenced prisoners remain eligible for pardon, that the Forum proposal does not change policy, and that a periodic risk-assessment procedure is considered unnecessary.
I share the Forum's view that life-sentenced prisoners should not be denied every prospect of release.
Ik deel de mening van het Forum dat levenslanggestraften niet ieder perspectief op vrijlating mag worden ontnomen.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over marktwerking in het notariaat (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

Rep. Recourt asked the state secretary whether restricting the number of notary offices limits market competition, and how many notaries were refused a post, in light of a Commissie van Deskundigen Notariaat recommendation. The state secretary answered that formal entry requirements are by definition a market restriction justified by public interests, that the three-year viability test protects clients rather than incumbents, and that he is content with the current regulation of the notarial market.
The requirement that a new office must be able to operate cost-covering after three years serves to protect the (potential) clients of that office.
De eis dat een nieuw kantoor na drie jaren kostendekkend moet kunnen draaien dient ter bescherming van de (potentiële) klanten van dat kantoor
Vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «ING hackt telefoons van klanten» (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

MPs Van Bemmel and Elissen asked whether ING and Dutch telecom providers exchanged customer data to detect SIM swaps, and whether the regulator OPTA had investigated. The minister responded that the exchange aims to prevent identity fraud, that legality is for the data protection authority CBP, that OPTA did not investigate, and that the CBP does not comment on ongoing investigations.
Whether this data exchange is permitted is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Of deze gegevensuitwisseling geoorloofd is, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een veroordeelde pedofiel niet onder toezicht van de reclassering zou staan (ingezonden 2 september 20

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the probation service can no longer supervise a convicted paedophile, as reported in the press, and why this would be the case. The answers were given in a letter of 29 November 2011 to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62), which the item refers to without reproducing its content.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 29 November 2011 (Parliamentary paper 29 270, no. 62).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 29 november 2011 (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62 ).
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de pedoseksueel Sytze van der V. (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a convicted paedophile, Sytze van der V., was being supervised by probation services, whether the reclassering had tried to house him in Eindhoven, and whether the municipality was informed of his possible return. The answer was given by the state secretary by letter of 29 November 2011, which the item references as answering questions 1 to 5.
These questions were answered in a letter of 29 November 2011 (Parliamentary paper 29 270, no. 62).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 29 november 2011 (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62 ).
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over commercieel draagmoederschap in Nederland (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about commercial surrogacy in the Netherlands, including the outcome of an expert meeting, legal ambiguity on parentage, the distinction between altruistic and commercial surrogacy, data collection and enforcement. The state secretary answered that the questions are substantive, that he is consulting with two other ministers, and promised a letter to parliament before the Christmas recess.
On the subject of (commercial) surrogacy I am in consultation with the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and the Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Over het onderwerp (commer cieel) draagmoederschap ben ik in overleg met de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over notarissen die uit het ambt ontzet zijn en het toezicht op het notariaat (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about two notaries struck off by the Amsterdam appeals court for having deeds passed without their presence and without proper client information, whether this reflects a wider problem, and about the oversight of the notariat. The State Secretary called the practice unlawful and laakbaar, denied signals it is widespread, pointed to new Bureau Financieel Toezicht powers from 1 July 2012 to examine legal errors, and provided sanction statistics from 2005 to 2010.
In the Act of 29 September 2011 amending the Notaries Act, the tasks of the Bureau Financieel Toezicht have been expanded.
In de Wet van 29 september 2011 tot wijziging van de Wet op het notarisambt, zijn de taken van het Bureau Financieel Toezicht uitgebreid.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de disproportionele kosten die non-profit organisaties moeten betalen aan de Buma en SENA (ingezonden 2 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether non-profit organisations such as carnival clubs pay disproportionate copyright fees to Buma and SENA for music, citing an example of a club paying 520 euro a year, and whether the government would seek a solution. The state secretary replied that the figure was an administrative error and the actual amount is 48.05 euro, which he does not consider disproportionate, and saw no reason to intervene.
It has since become clear that there was an administrative error and the amount for music during carnival is not 520 euro but 48 euro and 5 cents.
Inmiddels is gebleken dat er sprake is van een administratieve fout en het bedrag voor muziek tijdens het carnaval geen 520 euro, maar 48 euro en 5 cent bedraagt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkelingen rond het bijstaan van slachtoffers in een strafproces (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether stricter application of rules for granting legal aid (toevoeging) to aggrieved parties in criminal proceedings weakens victims' position, notably for those with moderate injuries and domestic violence victims. The state secretary replied that the rules have not changed, that Slachtofferhulp Nederland is the primary support route with exceptions for complex cases, and that victims' position has been strengthened by recent legislation.
The policy on granting the legal aid allowance has been harmonised for all regional offices.
Het beleid omtrent het verstrekken van de toevoeging is voor alle regiokantoren geharmoniseerd.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over gevangene die in Breda wordt vergeten na een ziekenhuisbezoek (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice why a prisoner was left behind at a hospital in Breda after an operation, whether the blame for escape was unjust, and how often escapes during hospital visits occur. The state secretary answered that the prisoner left the hospital on his own without waiting for escort, was placed in isolation for two weeks, that two escapes during hospital visits occurred in 2011 so far, and that such incidents are discussed nationally to learn lessons.
If incidents like this still occur, I consider it important that lessons are drawn across the sector.
Indien zich toch incidenten zoals deze voordoen vind ik het belangrijk dat hier sectorbreed lering uit wordt getrokken.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over levenslang entreeverbod Holland Casino (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about Holland Casino's refusal to impose a lifetime entry ban on a gambling-addicted visitor who requested one, and about the casino's lobbying versus prevention priorities. The state secretary replied that the casino must in principle admit visitors, that temporary bans of six months to one year are the rules, and that the current system needs no change, citing the Court of Audit's positive view of Holland Casino's prevention policy.
In my view, the current system of visitor restrictions and entry bans does not need to be amended.
Het huidige stelsel van bezoekbeperkingen en entreeverboden behoeft in mijn ogen geen aanpassing.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de inkoop van forensische zorg bij zorginstellingen die topsalarissen uitker

Mr Gesthuizen (SP) asked why the Ministry of Justice and Security buys forensic care from mental health institutions that pay top executive salaries, and whether it will stop doing so. State Secretary Teeven answered that salary levels are not a procurement criterion, that the Wet Normering Topinkomens will apply to these institutions once in force, and that no interim measures are planned.
The height of the salary of the managers of care institutions is not a criterion in the procurement of forensic care.
De hoogte van het salaris van de bestuurders van zorginstellingen is geen criterium bij de inkoop van forensische zorg.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over notarissen die uit het ambt ontzet zijn en het toezicht op het notariaat (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about two notaries struck off by the Amsterdam notarial court for having deeds passed without proper legal oversight, the chamber's view that commercial interests outweighed their duties, how common such practices are, the scope of a WODC study that mainly checked form errors, and sanctions imposed on notaries since 2005. The State Secretary only sent an interim notice that the answers were not yet ready, so no substantive answer was given.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «PVV verzamelt privégegevens journalisten» (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether the PVV collected citizens' BSN numbers at the request of the Dutch royal protection service before admitting visitors to party events and press conferences, and whether this breached the data protection law. The state secretary confirmed the screening for Wilders' security, argued the Wbp does not apply to police duties, and said BSN collection via the PVV will stop, with a more transparent procedure to follow.
I have now decided that Burgerservicenummers will no longer be requested via the PVV, and I will work with the DKDB to set up a more transparent procedure.
Inmiddels heb ik er voor gekozen dat er voortaan geen Burgerservicenummers meer via de PVV worden opgevraagd, maar zal ik samen met de DKDB een meer transparante werkwijze opstellen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld binnen TBS-instellingen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about violent incidents at TBS clinics (Vught and Rooyse Wissel), whether staff shortages are structural, recent violence statistics, and an Abvakabo survey on aggression against prison staff. The state secretary answers that internal research found no structural link or staff shortage, provides 2010 incident figures, states the Abvakabo survey has serious methodological flaws, and describes ongoing WODC research and DJI prevention measures.
Internal research has not shown that the incidents are connected to each other or stem from structural problems.
Uit intern onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de incidenten met elkaar in verband staan of voortkomen uit structurele problemen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over onwettig gebruik van DPI (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011)

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks why the Central Information Point for Victims closed its inquiry into alleged unlawful use of Deep Packet Inspection by telecom providers, why police sent a one-day letter citing insufficient leads, and whether the OM's inquiry into KPN and OPTA's findings warrant further action. The state secretary answers that information points cannot close investigations, that the OM concluded on 28 July 2011 that further criminal investigation is not warranted because KPN's encryption prevented staff from viewing content, and that OPTA's preliminary scan found no grounds for enforcement while the CBP investigates data protection.
On 28 July 2011 the National Public Prosecution Service Office concluded that further criminal investigation is not warranted.
Op 28 juli 2011 heeft het Landelijk Parket van het Openbaar Ministerie geconcludeerd dat een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek niet in de rede ligt.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geld voor misbruik slachtoffers kerk (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether state-placed child abuse victims deserve compensation like the Catholic Church's scheme, and whether an independent compensation commission should be set up. The state secretary declined to commit, deferring to the Samson commission's final report due in 2012, while noting the existing Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven support and referral to victim aid.
I can only assess the question of financial compensation for victims of sexual abuse once I have all the information needed and sufficient insight into all relevant facts.
Het vraagstuk van financiële compensatie voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik kan ik pas beoordelen als ik over alle hiervoor benodigde informatie beschik
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedrijven die de privacy schenden (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the state secretary about reports that companies ignore data access (inzage) requests under privacy law, and what the government and the CBP will do about it, including fines and mediation powers. The state secretary said he could not confirm widespread non-compliance, that the CBP chooses its enforcement priorities independently, and that the cabinet intends to give the CBP administrative fining powers.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opkomsttijd van de brandweer in de Veiligheidsregio Brabant Zuid-Oost (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister why the Brabant Zuid-Oost safety region wants to raise fire brigade response times from eight to ten minutes and how this fits the Besluit veiligheidsregio's rules, and whether the region should be reminded of the decree. The state secretary answered that deviations are allowed only for specific, motivated locations with compensating measures, that no generic increase is permitted, and that an Inspectorate investigation into response times across all regions is underway.
With the deviation power in the Besluit veiligheidsregio's it is not possible for response times to be generically raised upward for the whole safety region.
Met de afwijkingsbevoegdheid uit het Besluit veiligheidsregio's is het niet mogelijk dat de opkomsttijden generiek en voor de hele veiligheidsregio naar boven worden bijgesteld.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de pilot voor forensisch onderzoek (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister about a pilot letting private firms perform forensic investigations alongside the NFI, its evaluation timing, whether it will become permanent market policy, and pros and cons of market competition. The state secretary said the evaluation report is expected in early 2012, a decision on structural private involvement will follow by summer 2012, a temporary EUR 500,000 arrangement is set for the first half of 2012, and the pros and cons will be addressed in that later position.
I will inform you before summer 2012 about the possible structural involvement of private providers of forensic investigation.
Ik zal u voor de zomer van 2012 informeren over de eventuele structurele inschakeling van particuliere aanbieders voor forensisch onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat kinderen die ernstig worden bedreigd in hun ontwikkeling te weinig hulp krijgen (ingezonden 12 augustus 2011).

Deputy MP Kooiman asks the state secretary about reports that children seriously threatened in their development receive too little help at Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam, including whether children placed in a management team (beheerteam) with heavy caseloads is acceptable. The state secretary replies that a beheerteam is undesirable but may be temporary, that children must get care and supervision, that the Deltamethode caseload of 1:15 should be kept, and that a financial audit of Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam will follow, while declining to fund a study of the effects of beheerteams.
Children subject to a child protection measure must immediately receive the necessary care and supervision.
Kinderen waarover een kinderbeschermingsmaatregel is uitgesproken moeten direct de noodzakelijke zorg en toezicht krijgen.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanhouding van een fotograaf op Utrecht CS (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police detaining a freelance photographer at Utrecht Central station, and demanding a columnist delete a photo, were justified and proportionate. The state secretary answered that taking photos alone is not grounds for intervention, that the arrest was based on an alleged violation of the Wet personenvervoer 2000 and refusal to identify, that the KLPD evaluation found no provable nuisance, that excuses were given, and that no further investigation is needed.
Taking photographs in itself does not give rise to police intervention.
Het maken van foto's op zichzelf vormt geen aanleiding tot politieoptreden.

Vragen van het lid Van Bochove (CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het toepassen van de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MP Van Bochove asks how the squatting and vacancy law (Wet kraken en leegstand) is applied, including why many Gelderland municipalities have not adopted a vacancy ordinance, whether police may address squatters, and whether the absence of an ordinance blocks prosecutorial eviction. The government answers that municipalities choose their own instruments, that police may address squatters but criminal eviction requires an order from the public prosecutor, and that the Openbaar Ministerie does not depend on a municipal ordinance.
The Public Prosecution Service does not depend on a vacancy ordinance nor on notifications from a municipality to act against squatting.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is niet afhankelijk van een leegstandsverordening noch van meldingen van een gemeente om op te treden tegen kraken.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gegeven dat Nederland de mensenrechten van transgenders schendt (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands violates transgender rights by requiring sterilisation for legal gender recognition under article 28 of the Civil Code, and whether article 28 will be amended. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the HRW report and said the sterilisation requirement will be removed, with a draft bill out for consultation and simplified changes to diploma gender markers planned.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over levenslang entreeverbod Holland Casino (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Security and Justice whether Holland Casino, a state-owned company, can and should impose a lifetime entry ban on gambling-addicted visitors who request one, and whether it prioritises expansion over prevention. The government replies only that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all necessary information has been received.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over teruglopen van het aantal rechters (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the number of judges in training has fallen sharply due to budget cuts and what this means for judge numbers and court backlogs. The state secretary confirmed the cut in training places from 60 to 25 per year and the shortening of the training, and said the judiciary expects no undercapacity or longer case times because of the expected drop in case inflow from court fees, while acknowledging uncertainty.
These are expectations and estimates, which are inevitably subject to a certain degree of uncertainty.
Het betreffen verwachtingen en schattingen, die onvermijdelijk met een bepaalde mate van onzekerheid zijn omgeven.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Zesvoudig moordenaar eist verlof» (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asks whether the state secretary knew of a decision not to grant leave to a six-times convicted life-sentence prisoner in a forensic psychiatric centre, and whether he will intervene if a court grants the prisoner's kort geding request. The state secretary confirms awareness of the report, explains the leave policy tightening for life-sentence prisoners and the RSJ ruling that gave him a right to supervised leave, and notes that the court rejected his claim for unsupervised leave on 9 September.
On 9 September the Hague District Court gave its ruling.
Op 9 september jl. heeft de Rechtbank te Den Haag uitspraak gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over teruglopen van het aantal rechters (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

MP Recourt (PvdA) asks the state secretary of Security and Justice whether budget cuts reduce the number of judicial training places, how that affects the judiciary, court delays and the planned court fee increase, and whether this harms citizens seeking justice. The government reply is a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all required information has been received, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Recourt (PvdA) on the decline in the number of judges (submitted 8 September 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, since not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) over teruglopen van het aantal rechters (ingezonden 8 september 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkelingen rond het bijstaan van slachtoffers in een strafproces (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

SP MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman ask the Minister of Security and Justice whether stricter application of rules for granting legal aid (toevoeging) to injured parties in criminal proceedings weakens victims' position, citing cases where victims with injuries such as a broken nose or lost teeth lose entitlement, and whether this contradicts the coalition agreement's promise to strengthen victims. The government's answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received yet, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.
cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all the necessary information has yet been received
niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een pedoseksueel als vrijwilliger heeft gewerkt op een kinderkamp (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice why a convicted child sex offender could work as a volunteer at a children's camp just after facing trial, and whether a legal requirement for volunteers to present a certificate of conduct (VOG) should be introduced. The state secretary says the organisation never requested a VOG, which would have been refused, rejects a statutory VOG obligation as shifting responsibility to government, and promises a disciplinary college and reference list for the volunteer sector.
I find it absolutely undesirable that convicted paedophiles work with children in a situation of dependence.
Ik vind het absoluut onwenselijk dat veroordeelde pedoseksuelen met kinderen in een afhankelijkheidssituatie werken.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kritiek op het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked the state secretary about press reports that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) barely protects privacy, its limited powers and budget, and whether individual complaints are handled poorly. The state secretary rejected the picture, said the CBP has successes and adequate staff and budget relative to other EU states, and noted planned powers to impose administrative fines.
I cannot confirm that the CBP is relatively underfunded compared with supervisory authorities in other EU countries.
Ik kan niet bevestigen dat het CBP relatief onderbedeeld is in vergelijking met toezichthouders in andere EU-landen.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de procedures rondom erkenning en gezag over kinderen geboren buiten het huwelijk (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked why the mother automatically holds custody of a child born outside marriage while the recognising father must go through recognition plus a court custody application, and whether this differentiation should be abolished. The State Secretary defended the current system as serving the child's interest, said the procedure is not more burdensome than in neighbouring countries, and agreed to answer before the committee debate.
Having two legal parents where possible is, in my view, in the child's interest.
Het waar mogelijk hebben van twee juridische ouders, acht ik in het belang van het kind.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbreuk op de privacy door LinkedIn (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

Labour MPs Van Dam and Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about privacy intrusions by LinkedIn, including the Dutch Data Protection Authority's (CBP) guidelines for social networking sites, whether commercial use of personal data without prior consent is objectionable, and whether the CBP should be instructed to change account settings. The State Secretary answered that the CBP applies privacy-friendly default settings and strict consent standards, that consent must be unambiguous under the Wbp, and that the government has no power to instruct the independent CBP on individual supervisory matters.
In view of this, I do not have the powers to instruct the CBP on how to act in individual supervisory cases.
Gelet hierop beschik ik niet over bevoegdheden om het Cbp voor te schrijven hoe zich te gedragen in individuele toezichtszaken.

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether the victim information centre closed its investigation into unlawful use of Deep Packet Inspection, whether police dismissed complaints within a day, how this squares with KPN and OPTA findings, what the Public Prosecution Service's preliminary inquiry found, and whether the response honours a motion. An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a sit-in by asylum detainees at the Rotterdam detention centre, alleged use of force, placement in isolation cells, the number of detainees and the justification and alternatives to immigration detention. The government answered that the detainees refused to return to their cells, that force was limited to the internal assistance team, that four detainees received 14-day isolation for incitement and intimidation, and that it sees no reason for further investigation while alternatives to detention are being studied.
The course of events is for me no reason for further investigation.
De gang van zaken vormt voor mij geen aanleiding voor een nader onderzoek.

On behalf of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, I inform you that it is not possible to answer these questions within the set deadline.
Mede namens de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties deel ik u mee dat het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden.

I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbreuk op de privacy door LinkedIn (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MPs Recourt and Van Dam asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether LinkedIn changed account settings so members' names and photos could be used in advertisements without consent, and whether the Dutch data protection law was breached. The state secretary answered that the settings have reportedly been changed, that the Wbp requires unambiguous consent, and that the Cbp supervises compliance, so complaints should go to the Cbp, without judging the individual case.
It is not for me to judge whether, in an individual case, the requirements of the Wbp are met.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de vraag of in een individueel geval aan de vereisten van de Wbp wordt voldaan.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Van Toorenburg (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het SBF-verlof voor gev

MPs Gesthuizen, Van Toorenburg and Bouwmeester asked why the SBF leave scheme for prison staff left DJI personnel inadequately and late informed about lower net income, why P-Direkt information was deficient, and whether the scheme should be changed or allow continued working. State Secretary Teeven answered that the lower net leave benefit was known from the start, that information was slow but not incorrect, that continued working is decided case by case on service interests, and that the scheme is a safety net not meant to encourage longer working.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over lesbisch ouderschap (ingezonden 25 juli 2011).

An MP asks the ministers why the Lesbian Parenthood bill has been delayed repeatedly and whether it will be submitted this summer, and how this fits earlier commitments. The state secretary replies that the Council of State has advised, a further report is being prepared, and submission is expected mid-September, in line with the summer commitment, while citing the complexity of the report as the reason for delay.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de regering van Curaçao gevangenen met een enkeltje na

MPs Lucassen and Helder asked ministers about reports that Curaçao wants to send prisoners back to the Netherlands one-way, and how Dutch authorities would prevent this. The state secretary replied that 22 prisoners convicted under Netherlands Antillean law will be transferred to the Netherlands in phases or to Bonaire after new prison construction, with the Netherlands paying Curaçao up to NAf 720,000 for interim housing, and that 7.2% of detained persons in the Netherlands come from the former Netherlands Antilles.

Vragen van het lid Bosman (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «Curaçao wil gevangenen uit Bonaire terugsturen» (ingezonden 24 augustus 2011).

The MP asks how many prisoners from Bonaire are held in Curaçao, why they have not been moved to Bonaire, and whether transfer arrangements existed around the 2010 constitutional change. The state secretary answers that 22 Bonaire detainees are held in Curaçao on temporary arrangements, with five moved to the Netherlands and the rest to be transferred to Bonaire, citing security and the new prison due around 2015.
Once the new prison on Bonaire is completed (2015) and the necessary security measures are guaranteed, these detainees will be transferred to Bonaire.
Zodra de nieuwbouw van de gevangenis op Bonaire gereed is (2015) en daarmee de noodzakelijke veiligheidsmaatregelen gegarandeerd zijn, zullen deze gedetineerden naar Bonaire worden overgebracht.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kritiek op het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Groningse advocaten zouden frauderen met overheidsgeld (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Recourt and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether Groningen lawyers defrauded legal aid funds, how it happened, and what action followed. The secretary confirmed two lawyers circumvented the 250-unit cap, roughly 450 files were affected, a criminal complaint and disciplinary complaint were filed, and recovery of an estimated 300,000 to 400,000 euros is underway.
The Council will reclaim the wrongly granted allowances from both lawyers.
De Raad zal de ten onrechte verstrekte vergoedingen terugvorderen van beide advocaten.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de liquidatie van Stanley H (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about communication failures during the operation that led to the killing of Stanley H, and whether police policy had been tightened. The state secretary answered that separate teams lacked a shared channel, so switching to an arrest was not possible, and that preparation, debriefing and joint exercises are being improved.
Investigation is now underway into how the communications can continue to adequately support the operation even when it takes an unexpected turn.
Thans wordt onderzocht op welke wijze de verbindingen de operatie adequaat kunnen blijven ondersteunen, ook al neemt deze een onverwachte wending.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a convicted rapist and robber who absconded during prison leave, and whether the prison and Justice had erred, what measures would prevent recurrence, and whether a one-year leave ban should be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged a miscommunication delaying notice to the victim, said existing disciplinary and parole-postponement tools already allow leave to be withheld after an absconding, and reported active tracing of the fugitive.
Due to a miscommunication between the CJIB and the Public Prosecution Service, the victim was not directly informed of the absconding.
Door een miscommunicatie tussen het CJIB en het Openbaar Ministerie is het slachtoffer niet direct over de onttrekking geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dood van een Turkse man na zijn aanhouding door de politie (ingezonden 12 juli 2011).

MP Dibi asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the results of the investigation into the death of a Turkish man after his police arrest in Beverwijk would be sent to parliament. The state secretary replied that the Rijksrecherche and NFI parts are finished and their findings were already made public via the Public Prosecution Service, while the medical-care investigation is still ongoing and the OM will publish its conclusions once complete.
Once the investigation has been completed and assessed, the OM will make its conclusions public.
Als het onderzoek is afgerond en beoordeeld, zal het OM zijn conclusies openbaar maken.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over klokkenluiders bij de politie (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

The state secretary replied that the 2009 whistleblower decree was agreed with police unions, that no grounds existed for disciplinary or criminal investigation, that the disclosure of the whistleblower's identity was regretted, and that anonymous reporting would not be introduced, with an evaluation after five years.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to carry out research into whether officers can report misconduct anonymously.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet nodig om onderzoek te verrichten om te bezien of agenten anoniem misstanden kunnen melden.
Vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over privacy-schending op internet door slachtoffers van ernstige delicten (ingezonden 3 augustus 2011).

An MP asks whether the government plans to give the Dutch data protection authority power to fine privacy violations online by victims of serious crimes, questioning the proportionality of such fines and asking about current civil damages. The state secretary answers that a bill sanctioning Wbp violations with administrative fines is being prepared without final decisions yet, that proportionality principles apply, that civil damages awards are relatively rare, and points to an upcoming outline letter and debate.
Every imposition of an administrative fine must meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Elke oplegging van een bestuurlijke boete moet voldoen aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanbesteding van de tolken- en vertaaldiensten bij de politie (ingezonden 28 juni 201

MP Gesthuizen asked why police tolk and translation services were tendered, how quality and sworn interpreters are ensured, and why turnover requirements exclude small firms. The state secretary answered that EU rules allow discretion for these services, that police purchasing policy requires EU tendering above a threshold, that the contract obliges use of sworn interpreters, and that a guidance note on proportionality for SMEs is being finalised and will be consulted on.
A turnover requirement is imposed to prevent a contract from being too large and the contracting authority running the risk that the bidder cannot perform the contract after award.
Een omzeteis wordt gesteld om te voorkomen dat een opdracht te omvangrijk is en de opdrachtgever het risico loopt dat de inschrijver na gunning de opdracht niet kan uitvoeren.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV), Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de liquidatie van Stanley H (ingezonden 14 juni 2011).

MPs Brinkman, Hennis-Plasschaert and Çörüz asked why an armed KLPD officer did not intervene during the liquidation of Stanley H., why the daders escaped despite surveillance, and how the observation team was alerted. The state secretary answered that the officer could not physically intervene, that the two buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren were not police officers and were concealed in a trailer, that the operation was not assessed as risky and communication channels were fragmented, and that the observation team learned of the attack only about ten minutes later.
As a result, it was not possible after the attack to adequately switch to a high-risk arrest.
Daardoor was het niet mogelijk om na de aanslag adequaat om te schakelen naar een risicovolle aanhouding.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over hulp en ondersteuning aan een persoon die na langdurige detentie is vrijgesproken (ingez

MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how a person released after long detention, later acquitted, was helped, and why answers on informing his home municipality seemed contradictory. The State Secretary said the prison social worker helped with housing, identity documents and debt freezing, that the municipality was informed though the person had not yet registered there, and that no extra measures are needed, while discussions with insurers found no broad refusal problem.
From the consultation with the Verbond van Verzekeraars it appeared that the problems in insuring ex-detainees, for example taking out contents insurance, are not recognised.

Uit het overleg dat heeft plaatsgevonden met het Verbond van Verzekeraars is gebleken dat de problemen met het verzekeren van ex-gedetineerden, bijvoorbeeld het afsluiten van een inboedelverzekering, niet worden herkend.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opnameapparatuur in gespreksruimtes (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether microphones or cameras can be present in rooms where lawyers confidentially meet clients, in prisons and police stations, and whether clients and lawyers are told beforehand. Daarom is aan de Orde voorgesteld om in het vervolg altijd duidelijk aan de advocaat te maken of er opnameapparatuur in een spreekkamer aanwezig is.

The state secretary answers that a licensing regime for online gambling will be set up with transparent criteria, that Pokerstars was the largest illegal provider in NL, and that a new gambling authority and enforcement measures are planned.
That is why I intend to regulate online gambling through a licensing system.
Daarom ben ik voornemens de kansspelen via internet te reguleren door middel van een vergunningstelsel.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verrichten van arbeid door gedetineerde 65-plussers (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice whether detained people aged 65 and over, who no longer receive AOW pensions in detention and are not obliged to work, should receive the wage-replacement allowance, and whether that allowance should not depend on a medical examination. The state secretary answered that 90 such detainees were held, that they will now be able to choose to work and receive a set allowance if they do not work, and that the arbeidsloon regulation will be amended.
I will amend the Regulation on prisoner labour wages for this purpose.
Ik zal hiervoor de Regeling arbeidsloon gedetineerden aanpassen.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat kinderen die ernstig worden bedreigd in hun ontwikkeling op de wachtlijst komen te staan (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Bureau Jeugdzorg Amsterdam and Rotterdam creating waiting lists or caseload-management teams for children seriously threatened in their development, including caseload levels, waiting times and budget shortfalls. The secretary called waiting lists undesirable but said the child's safety stays paramount, that municipalities and regions must supervise waiting lists, and that a research into youth-protection tariffs was commissioned, while providing limited current data.
Setting up a waiting list or management team is something I find undesirable.
Het instellen van een wachtlijst of beheerteam vind ik onwenselijk.
Vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de topsalarissen bij Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about top salaries at Buma/Stemra (over 200,000 euro for several board members), whether they should be capped, whether members have democratic means to act, and whether a spokesperson gag and oversight investigation are justified. The state secretary said the salary decision lies with the board and members, pointed to planned transparency and salary-normalisation rules in the pending Wet toezicht amendment, and said the College van Toezicht saw no reason to investigate for now.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat instanties geen signalen of dossiers hadden over zedendelinquent die voogdij kreeg ov

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary how a man convicted of incest could obtain sole custody of his daughters and whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming checks parents' criminal records and keeps child files long enough. The state secretary answered that criminal records are not checked by default in custody cases, that a framework to address repeat-offence risk is being developed with field partners, and that child files will be kept longer, with periodic updates to parliament.
I consider it important that a seamless approach be established for cases where the risk of repetition of a serious offence, and thus a threat to the child, is high.
Ik vind het van belang dat er een sluitende aanpak komt voor die zaken waarin het risico op herhaling van een ernstig misdrijf en daarmee een bedreiging voor het kind groot is.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over naburige rechten medewerkers en makers van film en tvproducties (ingezonden 11 mei 2

An MP asked why the amended Article 45d of the Dutch Neighbouring Rights Act considers only the producer's position, not the makers' such as directors and actors, and about low fees and weak bargaining positions of makers in film and TV, including comparison with Germany. The government answered that the rules seek a balance between producers and makers, that makers are structurally weaker in negotiations, that disputes over fees are for courts, and that a copyright contract law bill to strengthen makers' position will go to the Council of Ministers in summer 2011.
Strengthening the contractual position of the author and performing artist vis-à-vis their exploiter I have designated as one of the priorities of my policy.
Het versterken van de contractuele positie van de auteur en uitvoerende kunstenaar in de verhouding tot zijn exploitant heb ik als een van de speerpunten van mijn beleid aangemerkt.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over (transport)criminaliteit, en gestolen mobiele telefoons in het bijzonder (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about stolen mobile phones, after police found many phones from a 3000-phone robbery active on Dutch networks, and why Dutch providers do not block IMEI numbers as Belgium and the UK do. The state secretary answers that a bureau report is pending and will be considered with Economic Affairs, that Dutch providers stopped structural IMEI blocking due to non-unique IMEI numbers and easy spoofing, and that blocking has serious drawbacks.

Once I have received the final version of the administrative file from the Bovenregionale Recherche Midden Nederland, I will, in consultation with my colleague of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, examine whether it is possible and necessary to take measures.

Als ik de definitieve versie van het bestuurlijk dossier van de Bovenregionale Recherche Midden Nederland heb ontvangen, zal ik in afstemming met mijn ambtgenoot van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie bezien of het mogelijk en nodig is maatregelen te nemen

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opleggen van sancties aan gedetineerden en tbs’ers die spreken met journalisten (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether a prison director was right to sanction a detainee for speaking to journalists, whether the grounds for refusing media contact in the Penitentiary Principles Act are too broad, and whether directors will be told to apply them narrowly. since not all required information has yet been received

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister about a Dutch man extradited to Poland under a European Arrest Warrant, alleging no food or water during transport, lack of medical care, video recording of privileged lawyer-client talks, prison overcrowding, and a Polish judge threatening a new warrant for charges excluded from the surrender. The government's answer is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from Member Gesthuizen (SP) about developments in a European Arrest Warrant case cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijk gestelde vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP-fractie) over de verwikkelingen in een zaak van het Europees Arrestatiebevel [ingezonden 7 juni 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van verdachten van een overval op een Amsterdamse juwelier (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

Two PvdA MPs ask the Justice Minister why suspects in a jeweller robbery in Amsterdam were released by a judge, and how the Public Prosecution Service informs victims, neighbourhood and public. The item is a notice from State Secretary Teeven that the answers cannot be provided within the usual deadline because not all required information has been received yet.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) van uw Kamer aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wachtlijst van het PBC (ingezonden 9 juni 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de mishandeling van meisjes op een verjaardagsfeest (ingezonden 28

Two PVV MPs asked about a violent attack on girls at a birthday party, including release of suspects, prosecution, damages, sentencing, and the multicultural society and denaturalisation law. The government answered that suspects remain under investigation, the case is too complex for snelrecht, victims can claim damages as injured parties, and the denaturalisation question awaits a decision by autumn.
Soon the Public Prosecution Service will take a prosecution decision.
Binnenkort neemt het Openbaar Ministerie een vervolgingsbeslissing.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de handhaving van wapenverloven voor sportschutters (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about enforcement of firearm permits for sport shooters, following a Zembla broadcast, including police compliance with the firearms circular, verification of applicants' mental health and a proposed KNSA reporting point. The State Secretary responds that the OVV is investigating the legal firearm control system and that he will inform parliament once its findings are available, without answering the substantive questions now.

The letter further indicated that, on the basis of the research findings, it will be considered which conclusions should be drawn regarding the policy on legal firearm possession and the supervision thereof.

In de brief is verder aangegeven dat op basis van de onderzoeksuitkomsten zal worden bezien welke conclusies zouden moeten worden getrokken ten aanzien van het beleid met betrekking tot legaal wapenbezit en het toezicht daarop.
Vragen van de leden Cörüz en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Utrecht zet plan voor legale wietteelt toch door» (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

CDA MPs Cörüz and Uitslag asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he was aware of reports that Utrecht was pressing ahead with a legal cannabis cultivation plan despite his stated opposition, and what concrete action he would take. The state secretary confirmed awareness, restated his opposition, said he had already informed the Utrecht mayor and chief prosecutor, and assumed the local tripartite would act in line with his position without committing to a specific step.
I also earlier informed the mayor of Utrecht and the chief public prosecutor of this position, as announced during the oral question hour of 15 March.
Ook stelde ik eerder, zoals aangekondigd tijdens het mondeling vragenuur van 15 maart jl., de burgemeester van Utrecht en de hoofdofficier van justitie van dit standpunt op de hoogte.

Vragen aan de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het feit dat de vader van een ontvoerde minderjarige I.A. niet op de opsporingslijst staat (ingezonden 27

Two CDA MPs asked why the father of an abducted child, convicted of murdering her mother and believed to be in Libya, is not on the national wanted list, and whether it would be placed there. The state secretary answered that the Public Prosecution Service judged listing ineffective because he is unlikely to return to the Netherlands, though he is signalled nationally and internationally, and that the case would be revisited if Libya's situation changes.
Since it is known that the person is staying in Libya, the Public Prosecution Service did not consider involving the public through listing on the National Wanted List to be effective.
Aangezien bekend is dat betrokkene in Libië verblijft werd het inschakelen van het publiek door een vermelding op de Nationale Opsporingslijst door het OM niet effectief geacht.

Vragen aan de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het feit dat de vader van een ontvoerde minderjarige I.A. niet op de opsporingslijst staat (ingezonden 27

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice why the father of an abducted minor, convicted of murdering the child's mother and allegedly taking her to Libya, is not on the wanted list, whether the Korps landelijke politiediensten's view that listing him adds value will be acted on, and whether the case will be raised with new Libyan authorities. The state secretary replied only that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has yet been received, and promised an answer as soon as possible.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen over hulp en ondersteuning aan een persoon die na langdurige detentie is vri

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Recourt (PvdA) ask the state secretary of Security and Justice why, after an acquitted man was released from long detention, the prison did not inform his municipality of return in advance despite claims that much was done, which municipality received information, why he was not informed, what measures will prevent recurrence, and when the outcome of talks with the insurers' association about refusing ex-detainees will be reported. The state secretary's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed because not all necessary information has been received, with no substantive answer yet.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and Recourt (PvdA) to the State Secretary of Security and Justice on answers to earlier parliamentary questions about help and support for a person acquitted after long detention (submitted 31 May 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, since not all the necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Recourt (PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over antwoorden op eerdere Kamervragen over hulp en ondersteuning aan een persoon die na langdurige detentie is vrijgesproken (ingezonden 31 mei 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verrichten van arbeid door gedetineerde 65-plussers (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about detained over-65s: how many there are, why they receive no AOW pension and no replacement income when they are not required to work, whether they should get that allowance even if they do not want to work, and whether the medical-examination condition should be dropped. The reply is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received.
because not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.

Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ondertoezichtstelling (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why a three-year-old was placed with a family where the mother's partner had prior violent convictions, why the court refused a supervision order against Bureau Jeugdzorg's advice, and what would prevent such cases. The answer declined to comment on the judge's decision, pointed to an ongoing Inspectorate and prosecution investigation, and gave the number of pending supervision requests (about 3000 covering about 5300 children).
I do not comment on the judgment of a children's judge.
Ik treed niet in het oordeel van een kinderrechter.

Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het factureren door Buma/Stemra van websites die een radiostream op hun site embedden (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

MP Peters (GroenLinks) asked whether Buma/Stemra charging websites for embedding radio streams is justified, whether embedding is a new communication to the public or reproduction, and whether the law should be amended, plus how this compares to the 2010 YouTube controversy. State Secretary Teeven answered that the parties should resolve it through negotiation or the courts, that legal clarity is lacking, and that he sees no reason to amend the Copyright Act now.
I believe it is up to the parties involved to reach an arrangement through consultation.
Ik vind het aan de betrokken partijen om in overleg tot een regeling te komen.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over de verkoop van persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Economic Affairs about police use of speed profiles derived from TomTom location data, including payment, privacy, consumer disclosure and whether similar data sales occur. The State Secretary answered that the data is anonymised, that the Cbp is the competent body to judge re-identification, that consumer information duties lie with producers under existing law, and that police navigation systems are not synchronised so no location data is shared.
The Cbp is independent and itself determines in which cases it conducts an investigation.
Het Cbp is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf in welke gevallen het een onderzoek instelt.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gevolgen van het SBF-verlof voor gevangenispersoneel (ingezonden

An MP asked why the SBF leave benefit leaves prison staff born after 1949 with substantially less net income than the former FLO/FPU scheme, and why no compensation is offered. The state secretary answered that the lower net amount follows from general tax and premium rules, that a second-career arrangement is available, and that he does not consider the effect unduly harsh.
The lower net SBF leave benefit is not intended, but is the outcome of deductions on the benefit under generally applicable statutory rules on taxes and premiums.
De lagere netto SBF-verlofuitkering is niet beoogd, maar is de uitkomst van inhoudingen op de uitkering volgens algemeen wettelijke voorschriften ten aanzien van belastingen en premies.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het EHRM over een paranoïde gedetineerde die geen behandeling kreeg (ingezonden 14 april 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the state secretary about an ECHR ruling finding a violation of article 5 due to a 13-month wait for psychiatric treatment (TBS) for a detainee with schizophrenia, and about whether rules must change and how long waits are. The state secretary acknowledges the violation, says the four-month transit limit is now generally respected with only incidental exceedances, and reports average waits of 135 days in 2010 with a longest wait of 26 months, without committing to new measures.
Yes, in this case the ECHR finds a violation of article 5(1) ECHR due to an overly long TBS transit period (in this case just over 13 months).
Ja, in de zaak constateert het EHRM een schending van artikel 5, eerste lid, EVRM als gevolg van een te lange TBS-passantentermijn (in casu ruim 13 maanden).

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Van Bemmel (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Deep Packet Inspection door telecomproviders en de aantasting van privacy (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about telecom providers' use of deep packet inspection, its privacy implications and possible criminal offences, and whether consequences, investigations or new consumer-information rules would follow. The government answered that DPI is lawful in principle but depends on the case, that the Public Prosecution Service and OPTA are investigating, and that existing privacy law already obliges providers to inform customers, so no new measures are planned.
Pending these investigations, I cannot say whether there may have been corporate espionage, interception of government communications, or deception of consumers.
Hangende deze onderzoeken kan ik niet zeggen of er sprake kan zijn geweest van (bedrijfs)spionage, het onderscheppen van overheidscommunicatie, of het misleiden van consumenten.

The government's reply is a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, and that answers will follow as soon as possible.
because not all of the necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het CBP besluit over verzamelen van privégegevens door Google (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

MP Van der Steur asks the minister whether he agrees with the Dutch data protection authority's (CBP) order that Google must destroy accidentally collected private payload data, and whether collecting public Wi-Fi location data has value and is personal data. The state secretary declines to comment on the individual CBP decision, stating that the courts decide on appeal, and answers the other questions by referring back to the CBP's reasoning and to a European Article 29 Working Party opinion.
It is not appropriate for me to make statements about a CBP decision in an individual case.
Het past mij niet om uitspraken te doen over een besluit van het Cbp in een individuele casus.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de gevolgen voor het uitgaansleven van gewijzigde BUMA regels (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66), Heijnen (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een grote hoeveelheid gegevens ov

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how telecom companies store and link citizens' mobile phone data, who may access it, how long it is kept, and how citizens can object or inspect it, after a German press report on location tracking. Telecombedrijven zijn verplicht om gegevens van hun klanten beschikbaar te stellen aan de overheid bij bevragingen in het kader van de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het zwartboek met kritiek van jeugdreclasseerders op het VOG-systeem (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

I will discuss with Jeugdzorg Nederland where the needs lie regarding information about the VOG system.
Ik zal met Jeugdzorg Nederland bezien waar de behoeften liggen met betrekking tot voorlichting over de systematiek van de VOG.
