Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Mishandelde bejaarde moet zelf achter daders aan» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a 97-year-old assault victim must herself pursue the damages awarded against her attackers, and whether a damages claim lapses if the convicted person serves substitute detention. The state secretary answered that the CJIB is still collecting the EUR 15,000 award, that the victim may use civil routes for any remainder, and that the advance scheme's limited access lasts five years, while not committing to a new mechanism.
The CJIB has taken several steps to arrive at collection.
Het CJIB heeft verschillende stappen ondernomen om te komen tot een incasso.
Vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Vrouw (97) moet achter rovers aan» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a 97-year-old victim of a violent robbery is being left to pursue the damages owed by her attackers, and whether this undermines trust in justice, and asks about a planned bill on seizure and CJIB collection. The state secretary answers that the claim is incorrect, refers to earlier answers, says the bill is being prepared for early 2012, and states that the CJIB is already working on collecting the damages.
This bill is currently being prepared at the official level.
Dit wetsvoorstel wordt op dit moment op ambtelijk niveau voorbereid.

Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verkoop van gegevens aan de politie door Vodafone en TomTom (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that Vodafone and TomTom sold location data to the police, including whether the College bescherming persoonsgegevens was consulted, what the data show and whether individual locations can be derived, and which other parties could buy it. The government's reply is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the normal period because not all necessary information has been received, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Van der Steur and Hennis-Plasschaert (both VVD) on the sale of data to the police by Vodafone and TomTom (submitted 3 May 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) over de verkoop van gegevens aan de politie door Vodafone en Tom Tom (ingezonden 3 mei 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van het bericht «Privacywaakhond CBP schendt privacy» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether it was scandalous that the data protection authority CBP published privacy-sensitive address data in a report on Google, and whether he would hold it to account or investigate its working methods. The State Secretary answered that the CBP had anonymised the report immediately, apologised to the affected persons, and that he considered this an adequate response, with the CBP able to draw its own lessons.
I consider that an adequate response, and I regard the CBP as sufficiently capable of drawing the right lessons from this incident itself to prevent a repetition.
Ik vind dat een adequate reactie en acht het CBP voldoende in staat uit dit incident zelf de juiste lessen te trekken om herhaling te voorkomen.

Vragen van de leden Rik Janssen (SP) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Nederland de Verenigde Staten nauwgezet op de hoogte houdt van lopende terreuronderzoeken (

MPs Janssen and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether the Netherlands has agreements with the United States on removing information about people later found wrongly suspected of terrorism, and whether it receives confirmation of such removal. The state secretary answered that no specific agreements exist, that the trust principle applies, and that Dutch police share exonerating information with foreign counterparts under the Police Data Act criteria.
No specific agreements have been made on how the US handles information about persons later found to have been wrongly identified as suspects.
Over de wijze waarop de VS omgaan met informatie over personen die later blijken ten onrechte als verdachte te zijn aangemerkt, zijn geen specifieke afspraken gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (van de PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het invoeren van de wietpas (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the minister about municipalities refusing to introduce the weed pass, citing fears of rising illegal sales, lack of enforcement capacity, and the residence criterion, and asks whether extra police capacity will be provided. The state secretary defers much to an upcoming drug policy letter and a pending Council of State ruling, says illegal sales will be tackled by local authorities, police and prosecutors, and says he will keep listening to municipalities.
For applying this, the outcome of the legal case before the Council of State between the municipality of Maastricht and a coffeeshop owner is important.
Voor het toepassen hiervan is de uitkomst van de rechtszaak bij de Raad van State tussen de gemeente Maastricht en een coffeeshophouder van belang.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van diverse nieuwsberichten over het schietincident in Alphen aan de Rijn (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

The MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about firearms oversight after a shooting in Alphen aan den Rijn, including home checks of licence holders, the duration of the OvV investigation, age limits, sports shooters storing weapons at home, and KNSA youth recruitment. The state secretary Teeven said the OvV expects to publish in September 2011, that the government will review licensing and oversight policy after the investigations, and that the OvV's scope is its own to determine.
I therefore cannot say which aspects of the shooting incident in Alphen aan den Rijn will be examined by the OvV.
Ik kan derhalve geen uitspraken doen over welke aspecten van het schietincident in Alphen aan den Rijn door de OvV zullen worden onderzocht.
Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) aan minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de executie van een schadevergoedingsmaatregel (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

MP Recourt asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a court ruling on enforcement of a damages measure, the CJIB's discretion under the hardship clause in the enforcement guideline, and whether a single-parent welfare recipient with no capacity to pay should qualify as a hardship case. The state secretary confirms awareness of the ruling and guideline, says the CJIB has never yet granted a hardship claim, and explains that lack of means alone is insufficient, noting the court upheld the CJIB's rejection of a payment plan running to the enforcement limitation period.
The mere fact that the convicted person has insufficient capacity to pay is not sufficient to qualify as a hardship situation.
Het enkele feit dat veroordeelde onvoldoende draagkracht heeft, is niet voldoende om als schrijnende situatie gekwalificeerd te worden.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over taakstraf in de buurt (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the state secretary about community service (taakstraf) carried out in the offender's neighbourhood, failure rates, arrests and speed of enforcement. The state secretary answered that work in the neighbourhood will be explored with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, that enforcement timelines and protocols are being reviewed, and that the pilot evaluation results will feed into quality improvements.
I will explore with the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming the possibilities to further expand carrying out community service in the neighbourhood.
Ik ga met de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming de mogelijkheden verkennen om het uitvoeren van werkstraffen in de buurt verder uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het regelen van spreekrecht voor ouders in strafzaken (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

MP Rik Janssen asks why victims' parents in the Amsterdam child pornography case cannot use the right to speak in court, and why a 2009 motion to extend this right to legal representatives has not been implemented. The state secretary replies that the court will discuss the matter at a pro forma hearing, parents can submit written statements, and a bill extending the speaking right, including representation for very young victims, is being prepared for consultation and submission later this year.
I give high priority to strengthening the position of victims in the criminal process.
Ik geef hoge prioriteit aan het versterken van de positie van slachtoffers in het strafproces.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het CBP besluit over verzamelen van privégegevens door Google (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the CBP ruling ordering Google to destroy private 'payload data' collected via Street View cars, and whether such Wi-Fi location data is personal data and should remain collectable. The reply is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all necessary information has been received yet.

The written questions from MP Van der Steur of the VVD faction about the CBP decision on Google's collection of private data (submitted 20 April 2011) cannot be answered within the usual deadline, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

de schriftelijk gestelde vragen van het lid Van der Steur van de VVD-fractie van uw Kamer over het CBP besluit over verzamelen van privégegevens door Google (ingezonden 20 april 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van de Doggershoek (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman and Bouwmeester asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about closing the Doggershoek youth institution in Den Helder, alternatives, staff consultation, redeployment and remaining regional capacity. The State Secretary confirmed the closure as of 1 March 2011 for capacity reasons, said talks on reuse for LVB youths with Lijn 5 are ongoing with results promised by June 2011, and described staff mobility and redeployment measures.
As promised, I will inform you of the outcomes of that research in June 2011, or sooner if possible.
Zoals toegezegd zal ik u in juni 2011, of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, informeren over de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het detentieregime van een moeder die vervangende hechtenis ondergaat (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the detention regime for a mother serving substitute detention for an unpaid victim compensation order, who has a six-year-old child. The State Secretary replied that substitute detention is a measure applied to compel payment, that the regular regime applies with extra child visits, and that detention phasing is not offered because the end date is not fixed.
Substitute detention is not a custodial sentence but a measure, imposed only when the person fails to comply with the compensation measure imposed by the court.
Vervangende hechtenis is geen vrijheidsstraf maar een maatregel, die pas wordt opgelegd als de betrokkene niet voldoet aan de door de rechtbank opgelegde schadevergoedingsmaatregel.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afblazen van een voorgenomen proef met verbeterd spreekrecht (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that a planned pilot of separate sentencing hearings with enhanced victim speaking rights had been called off, and whether victims and bereaved relatives had been consulted. The State Secretary said no formal pilot exists, a preliminary study by the Amsterdam court is underway, and he is positive about expanding speaking rights and aims for a draft bill, while doubting separate sentencing hearings would reduce victims' emotional burden.
I aim to come up with a draft bill before the summer, on which the aforementioned organisations can also express their views.
Ik streef er naar voor de zomer met een conceptwetsvoorstel te komen waarover de genoemde organisaties zich ook kunnen uitlaten.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rechtsbijstand aan minderjarigen in strafzaken (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

Recourt (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about delays before minors suspected of crimes can consult a lawyer and are first questioned, including whether a standing duty lawyer at police stations would help and whether such waits should be capped at three hours. Teeven answered that the two-hour maximum wait is currently not always met, that the frequency is unknown pending the Salduz evaluation, that a broad impact analysis on on-site lawyers is underway with results expected before summer 2011, and that he cannot anticipate those outcomes; police record waiting times only locally with no national overview.
I am aware that in practice the lawyer does not always arrive within the two hours during which his arrival must be awaited after a detained minor suspect requests consultation assistance.
Ik ben ermee bekend dat in de praktijk de raadsman niet altijd arriveert binnen de twee uren, gedurende welke zijn komst moet worden afgewacht

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66)aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het zwartboek met kritiek van jeugdreclasseerders op het VOG-systeem (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman, Recourt and Berndsen asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how he would respond to youth probation workers' criticism of the VOG (certificate of conduct) system, which they say unfairly blocks young offenders from work, and whether COVOG could better distinguish circumstances and development and consult probation workers. The government only announced that the questions could not be answered within the usual deadline because not all necessary information had been received, promising a reply as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Kooiman, Recourt and Berndsen on the VOG system criticism by youth probation workers cannot be answered within the usual deadline, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij informeer ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) van uw Kamer aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het zwartboek met kritiek van jeugdreclasseerders op het VOG-systeem (ingezonden 31 maart 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rechtsbijstand aan minderjarigen in strafzaken (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

MP Recourt asks the state secretary about delays before minors' first police interrogation while awaiting a lawyer, including next-day interrogations, detention length in police cells, a standby duty lawyer model, a three-hour maximum wait, and differences between legal-aid and privately paid lawyers. The government reply is a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het weigeren van de toegang aan de Consumentenbond en Bits of Freedom tot de persconferentie van staatssecretaris Teeven over auteurs

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Consumentenbond and Bits of Freedom were refused access to his press conference on copyright and the download ban, and whether Bits of Freedom was specifically excluded. The secretary confirmed they were not invited because they are not journalists and said it is their own responsibility to reach the press.
Representatives of the Consumentenbond and Bits of Freedom were not invited to that because they are not journalists.
Vertegenwoordigers van de Consumentenbond en Bits of Freedom waren daarvoor niet uitgenodigd omdat zij geen journalisten zijn.
Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een ongelijk speelveld op de incassomarkt (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Schouw and Van der Steur ask whether the bailiff monopoly and the Verordening Onafhankelijkheid give bailiffs an unfair advantage in the debt-collection market, as the NMa suggests, and whether the government will curb bailiffs' commercial collection work. The minister denies an uneven playing field, defends the approval of the regulation as necessary for bailiffs' independence, and rules out banning bailiffs from non-official collection work.
I am not considering any measures to prohibit bailiffs from performing, alongside their official duties, non-official work such as debt collection.
Ik overweeg geen maatregelen om gerechtsdeurwaarders te verbieden naast de aan hen toebedeelde ambtelijke werkzaamheden ook niet-ambtelijke werkzaamheden, zoals incasso, te verrichten.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Financiën en over de kosten van het verwerpen van erfenissen en de omvang van de consignatiekas (ingezonden 28 maart 2

MP Kooiman asked whether it is fair that a woman who was abused by her father must pay court and notary costs to reject an inherited debt, and asked for the size of the consignment fund. The state secretary said rejecting an inheritance can be done at the court registry without a notary, and that a fee exemption exists for low incomes, so he sees no need to pay such costs from the consignment fund; the fund currently holds EUR 24.9 million, of which EUR 4.6 million relates to estates.
No, I see no need for that, because a provision has already been made for those with less financial means.
Nee, daartoe zie ik geen noodzaak, omdat voor minder draagkrachtigen al een voorziening is getroffen.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van drank, drugs en telefoons in Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI’s) (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary how alcohol, drugs and phones can reach youths in juvenile detention centres (JJI's) despite announced tightening, and about drug-dog use, spot checks, education participation and staffing. The state secretary says full control cannot be guaranteed, points to drug dogs, a saliva/breath-test pilot, spot checks and inter-facility best-practice exchange, and reports a staff surplus rather than shortage.
Despite these efforts, I cannot guarantee that the institutions can be kept 100% free of these substances.
Ondanks deze inspanningen kan ik u niet garanderen dat de inrichtingen 100% vrij van deze middelen kunnen worden gehouden.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van bestaande en het openen van nieuwe gevangenissen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether plans announced in Limburg for a new prison conflict with closures elsewhere, and questions the evidence for extra cell capacity from fast-track justice and other measures. The state secretary answers that capacity pressure is expected from other coalition measures, that a decision on a Limburg prison will come later in the year with a WODC study on private prisons, that the planned closures will be kept, and that Doggershoek will close with an alternative use under study.

I committed in the General Consultation of 9 December to inform you by June 2011 at the latest about the implementation of the Capacity Plan, including the possibilities for alternative use of JJI staff and locations.

Ik heb in het Algemeen Overleg van 9 december toegezegd u uiterlijk in juni 2011 te informeren over de uitvoering van het Capaciteitsplan, inclusief de mogelijkheden voor alternatieve inzet van JJI-personeel en -locaties.
Vragen van het lid Bontes (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Slachtoffer met letsel in de kou» (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a newspaper report that insurers refuse quick compensation to injured victims is accurate, and whether a non-binding code of conduct for handling personal injury claims should be anchored in law, tied to the Keurmerk Letselschade, and complemented by a complaints committee for victims. The government replies only that the answers cannot be given within the usual term because not all necessary information has been received, and promises to answer as soon as possible.
because not all necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het detentieregime van een moeder die vervangende hechtenis ondergaat (ingezonden 17 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the detention regime for a mother serving substitute detention for an unpaid victim compensation order, including whether her child-care needs can be reflected in the regime. The reply is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all required information has been received yet.
since not all the required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie inzake het onbestraft blijven van het downloaden van kinderporno (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

Member Van der Steur (VVD) asks the state secretary for Security and Justice whether downloading child pornography is likely to go unpunished, whether a lack of evidence blocks house searches of users of Boylovers.net, whether Article 97 jo 67 Sv bars such searches, and whether the Public Prosecution Service faces other legal limits. The government's answer is a holding notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from member Van der Steur (VVD) on the impunity of downloading child pornography (submitted 18 March 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) inzake het onbestraft blijven van het downloaden van kinderporno (ingezonden 18 maart 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het afblazen van een voorgenomen proef met verbeterd spreekrecht (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why a planned pilot with separate sentencing hearings to improve victims' right to speak was called off, whether the court and stakeholders were consulted, and whether he will support a renewed pilot. The government's reply is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all information has been received yet.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het regelen van spreekrecht voor ouders in strafzaken (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether parents in the Amsterdam child pornography case may not speak in court, why a 2009 motion to extend victim speaking rights to legal representatives has not been implemented, and whether implementation will be promised. The reply is a mere notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over «De Tbs-paradox» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about the tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) system, including alleged political interference in a release decision, a reported decline in unaccompanied leave, a psychiatrist's report being blocked, lengthy leave applications, and a patient placed in isolation. The state secretary largely rejected the allegations, stated that the release refusal was based on public safety, acknowledged the drop and later rise in unaccompanied leave, and promised a policy letter on improving the system.
I do not recognise the described sequence of events.
Ik herken mij niet in de beschreven gang van zaken.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about the composition of the Buma/Stemra board, whether music publishers dominate it, the powers of the College van Toezicht, independent investigation, the monopoly position, and reporting detail. The State Secretary replies that the board split is not unbalanced, that the College will get new powers and publishing duties, and that further steps will follow in a forthcoming copyright letter.

The bill also provides a legal basis for a general administrative order on the organisation and governance of a CBO and on the level and form of remuneration of directors, the supervisory board and those who handle day-to-day management.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet daarnaast in een grondslag voor het opstellen van een algemene maatregel van bestuur inzake de inrichting en het bestuur van een cbo en over de hoogte en de vorm van de bezoldiging van bestuurders, de raad van toezicht en degene die zich met de dagelijkse leiding bezig houden.
Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de componist die zijn eigen zak spekt dankzij Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a composer allegedly receiving over 2 million euros from Buma/Stemra under a false name, the lack of published KPMG research, inadequate remedial measures, slow complaint handling and transparency for composers. The state secretary replied that the royalty distribution followed the applicable rules, that the Supervisory Board found no unlawfulness, that pseudonyms are common, and that transparency and complaint handling are primarily the responsibility of Buma/Stemra, with the Supervisory Board monitoring.
It is the responsibility of Buma/Stemra to decide whether to make the research commissioned by it public or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van Buma/Stemra om de in haar opdracht gedane onderzoeken al dan niet openbaar te maken.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een reclamecampagne van de VriendenLoterij (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether a VriendenLoterij SMS campaign telling recipients they had won a prize misled consumers, and whether this breached the gambling advertising code. The state secretary confirmed the SMS was sent, said the website has been adjusted, and said the Reclame Code Commissie is primarily responsible for judging the advertising, while declining to use his power to issue a directive for now.
It is therefore primarily up to the RCC to assess whether this campaign falls under article II.3 of the gambling advertising code.
Het is dan ook primair aan de RCC om te beoordelen of deze campagne onder artikel II.3 van de reclamecode kansspelen valt.

Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers die hulp moeten ontberen vanwege een falend computersysteem bij de politie (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police IT failures left about 15,000 crime victims without referral to Slachtofferhulp Nederland. The state secretary denied a system fault, acknowledged that officers often do not tick the referral box, and said he asked police leadership to make referral automatic and to ensure correct entry in all forces.
I have therefore asked the police to introduce such a 100% referral in the system as soon as possible.
Ik heb daarom aan de politie gevraagd om op zo kort mogelijke termijn een dergelijke 100%-doorverwijzing in het systeem in te voeren.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over slachtoffers die hulp mislopen (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice why about 15,000 crime victims miss psychological, legal and practical help, what measures will ensure all victims get help, how affected victims can still access Slachtofferhulp, and what fault in the computer system causes referral failures and why the House was not informed. The State Secretary answered that questions 1, 4 and 5 are answered in a previous reply, and that analyses show no system fault: victim data is passed on automatically when the police officer ticks that data may be forwarded.
The analyses that have been made show no indication that there is a fault in the system.
Uit de analyses die zijn gemaakt blijkt niet dat er sprake is van een fout in het systeem.

Vragen van de leden Helder en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Slachtoffers in de kou» (ingezonden 11

PVV MPs asked whether victims of crime miss out on Slachtofferhulp aid because the police BVH system malfunctions and the consent question defaults to 'no'. The state secretary denied a system fault, said consent is not defaulted to 'no', and committed to have victim data forwarded automatically to Slachtofferhulp, with police asked to implement this quickly.
To ensure that victims consistently receive victim support offers from now on, it is necessary that victims' data are by default forwarded to Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat slachtoffers voortaan consequent slachtofferhulp krijgen aangeboden is het nodig dat standaard de gegevens van slachtoffers naar Slachtofferhulp Nederland worden doorgestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het onderzoek naar de onrust in de Koepelgevangenis in Breda (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether four suicides in one prison year (PI Breda, 2010) warranted a joint investigation by the Health Care Inspectorate and the Sanctions Inspectorate, and why suicides in prisons rose from 10 to 18. The secretary replied that the Health Care Inspectorate reviewed the calamity-commission reports and saw no link between the deaths, so a joint investigation was unnecessary, and offered a general study of suicide determinants without seeing a structural increase.
I can agree with the position of the IGZ and the ISt.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt van de IGZ en de ISt.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over taakstraf in de buurt (ingezonden 4 maart 2011).

Labour MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice ten questions about community service (taakstraf) in the neighbourhood, including the speed of enforcement, failure reports, and substitute detention. The State Secretary's reply is only an interim notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all required information has been received.
since not all required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van drank, drugs en telefoons in Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI’s) (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary how alcohol, drugs and phones keep reaching youths in closed juvenile institutions (JJI's), whether full control is possible, whether tightened measures and shakedowns are used, and whether there is staff shortage affecting treatment. The reply is a procedural notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all required information has been received yet.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over radiobazen die betaald krijgen voor liedjes die ze nooit geschreven hebben (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked whether radio station directors who register as composers of songs they did not write, and whether publishers pressure composers into co-registration, indicate abuse of market power and whether copyright contract law will protect composers. The government answered that the works are jingles and tunes made by employees under the work-for-hire rule, that the matter is referred to the copyright supervisory college, that market-power investigations are for market parties to request, and that a copyright contract law bill with bestseller and non-use provisions is being consulted on.
I will ask the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten to pay attention to this matter.
Ik zal het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten verzoeken aandacht aan deze kwestie te besteden.

Vragen van de leden Taverne en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat radiobazen betaald krijgen voor lied

MPs Taverne and Schaart asked whether radio station directors registered with Buma/Stemra as composers, receiving royalties for songs they did not write, and whether this constitutes abuse or should be criminalised. The government answered that these are private contracts, that Buma membership rules are for Buma to decide, that it will ask the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten to look at the issue, and that a copyright contract law proposal is pending.
I will ask the College van Toezicht Auteursrechten to pay attention to the matter.
Ik zal het College van Toezicht Auteursrechten verzoeken aandacht aan de kwestie te besteden.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van elektronisch huisarrest (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice whether he would scrap electronic house arrest (thuisdetentie) for convicted offenders, and about its preventive value, recidivism, costs and the cell shortage. The state secretary confirmed the plan, arguing that converting a prison sentence into home detention undermines the judicial sentence and retribution, that the government will instead pursue conditional sentences, and that the cell shortage no longer applies while electronic detention cost EUR 43 per day versus EUR 231 for a prison place.
This cabinet considers it fundamentally wrong that the administration decides that a prison sentence is carried out in a different way than in a prison.
Dit kabinet acht het principieel onjuist dat de administratie beslist dat een gevangenisstraf op andere wijze ten uitvoer wordt gelegd dan in een gevangenis.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het kansspelbeleid (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks whether internet gambling licences will be auctioned soon, when Holland Casino's sale will be clarified, whether talks were held with an online gaming lobby group, what happened to criminal complaints against illegal gambling sites, and whether banks including ABN AMRO and iDEAL have stopped facilitating illegal online gambling. The state secretary answers that a licensing bill will go to the Raad van State this autumn, a market study of casinos is planned, officials spoke with stakeholders including the lobby group, prosecution of illegal operators is hampered by foreign jurisdiction, and the banks association will send banks a blacklist of illegal operators.
Talks on ending the facilitation of illegal online gambling are not conducted with individual banks but with the Dutch Banking Association (NVB).
Het overleg over het beëindigen van het faciliteren van illegale kansspelen via internet wordt niet met individuele banken maar met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NVB) gevoerd.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne en Van der Steur (allen VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbeslagname servers door Stichting Brein (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Stichting Brein seized servers without a court order, accessed private data, and invoked Article 28 of the Copyright Act, and whether this amounts to vigilantism. The state secretary answered that the servers were handed over by the provider under Article 28, that a court later allowed judicial custody and seizure, that the parties dispute the legality and access issues and must resolve them or go to court, and that existing remedies suffice.
In the first instance it is up to the parties to resolve this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen om hier uit te komen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Justitie over inbeslagnames door de stichting BREIN (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice whether BREIN's seizure of pirates' servers was unlawful and whether copyright enforcement should be handed to a government body instead. The State Secretary declined substantive comment while the parties are in talks and a court case may follow, and rejected transferring enforcement to a public authority, pointing to civil and criminal remedies.
I therefore refrain from a substantive response.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een inhoudelijke reactie.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de plannen voor privatisering van het gevangeniswezen en het bericht «kleinere cel is beter» (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

SP MP Gesthuizen asked the state secretary about privatising prisons, smaller cells, cost breakdowns, cuts and staff safety. The state secretary said there are no concrete plans to shrink cells, gave the average day rate of 231 euros, and said a WODC study on privatisation would report in summer before any decision.
I expect the outcomes of the study this summer, after which I will inform your House further after the summer recess.
Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek deze zomer, waarna ik uw Kamer na het zomerreces nader zal informeren.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris kleinere cellen beter vindt (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that he favours smaller cells and privatising prisons, questioning recidivism, cost savings, safety and staff pay. The State Secretary answers that a WODC study on privatisation will be commissioned, that cell sizes and staffing are described, and that reintegration support will be curtailed for unmotivated or repeat offenders.
The WODC will carry out a study into the advantages and disadvantages of privatisation.
Het WODC zal een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de voor- en nadelen van privatisering.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toegenomen naleving van leeftijdsgrenzen voor games en films (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

GreenLeft MP Dibi asked the Justice Minister about improved compliance with age limits for games and films and whether a criminal ban on extremely violent games should be prepared or dropped. The state secretary answered that voluntary industry measures and intensified enforcement are working, that a ban would be of limited effectiveness, and that no preparations for such legislation have been made since 2010.
I note that the policy of improving and intensifying compliance with the age limits is bearing fruit.
Ik constateer dat het beleid van verbetering en intensivering van de naleving van de leeftijdsgrenzen zijn vruchten afwerpt.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat geprivatiseerde gevangenissen niet goedkoper zijn (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether privatised prisons are really cheaper, citing evidence that contract monitoring costs and wage pressures undermine savings, and asked about wages and capacity. The state secretary answered that the WODC will study the pros and cons of privatisation, including contract and monitoring issues and cost evidence abroad, while stating that current wages follow CAO-Rijk and no overcapacity exists.
The WODC has been asked to conduct a study into the pros and cons of privatising tasks relevant to the prison system.
Aan het WODC is gevraagd een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de voor- en nadelen van privatisering van voor het gevangeniswezen relevante taken.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Van Toorenburg (CDA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de hulp en ondersteuning aan mensen die na langdurige detentie worden vrijge

MPs asked the state secretary about help and support for people acquitted on appeal after long pre-trial detention, including a case of 28 months and housing, insurance and debt problems. The state secretary said reintegration support was offered during detention, gave acquittal figures for 2005-2010, explained when apologies are offered, and said he would discuss insurer refusals with the Verbond van Verzekeraars.
I will discuss this problem with the Verbond van Verzekeraars.
Ik ga deze problematiek bespreken met het Verbond van Verzekeraars.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van bestaande en het openen van nieuwe gevangenissen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Security and Justice why a new prison in Limburg is being announced, what evidence supports the need for extra cell capacity (from faster justice and abolishing community sentences), and how closing prisons such as Doggershoek in Den Helder fits with that plan. The document is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has been received yet.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een proef met spreekrecht in aparte strafmaatzittingen (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a reported trial of victim speaking rights in separate sentencing hearings at the Amsterdam court, and whether the government would support it and separate facts from emotions. The State Secretary replied that the Council for the Judiciary reported no trial or concrete plan, that speaking rights are part of the victim-position reforms, that separating facts from emotions is not a goal in itself, and that a bill to extend speaking rights is being prepared.
The Council for the Judiciary has informed me that at present there is no trial, nor any concrete intention to conduct one.
De Raad voor de Rechtspraak heeft mij laten weten dat op dit moment geen sprake is van een proef, noch van een concreet voornemen daartoe.

Vragen van de leden Recourt (PvdA) en Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpassing van de opleiding voor Rechterlijk ambtenaren in opleiding (Raio) (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

MPs Recourt and Rik Janssen asked the state secretary whether the Raio judicial training is being cut, reducing intake from 60 to 25 places, and whether this will cause a shortage of judges as many retire. The state secretary confirmed the cut follows the coalition agreement and budget savings, but said no judge shortage is expected and that a new training system will replace Raio and Rio.
The reduction in training places from 60 to 25 is indeed the result of budget cuts.
Het terugschroeven van het aantal opleidingsplaatsen van 60 naar 25 is inderdaad het gevolg van bezuiniging.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van een niet uitbehandelde ter beschikking gestelde (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the release of an ex-TBS patient whose treatment was not completed, a court ending TBS against the advice of treaters, the frequency of such rulings, and whether budget cuts affect treatment quality. The government's answer is a procedural notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received yet.
cannot be answered within the usual period, since not all necessary information has yet been received
niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van elektronisch huisarrest (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt (PvdA) ask the state secretary of Security and Justice ten questions about his plan to abolish electronic house arrest for convicted offenders, probing its preventive effect, recidivism, and costs compared with prison. The document is only an interim notice saying the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all information has yet been received.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt (both PvdA) to the state secretary of Security and Justice on abolishing electronic house arrest (submitted 21 February 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all the necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van elektronisch huisarrest (ingezonden 21 februari 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over commercieel draagmoederschap in India (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MP Arib asks the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about commercial surrogacy in India, whether Dutch criminal provisions on surrogacy and illegal adoption should be extended extraterritorially, the status of research and preventive measures, and whether policy should change. The state secretary responds that a report has been sent to parliament, an expert meeting is planned, and the Dutch consulate in Mumbai was ordered by a court to issue an emergency travel document in one case, without a ruling on the child's descent.
I indicated that an expert meeting on this subject will be held at the end of March/beginning of April.
Ik heb aangegeven dat eind maart/begin april een expertmeeting hierover zal worden gehouden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het plaatsen van acht gedetineerden op een cel en de onrust in de penitentiaire inrichting Tilburg (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about tensions at the Tilburg prison, the placement of up to eight Belgian detainees per cell, staffing levels, training and staff safety. The state secretary answered that staffing was expanded by over 100 fte, staff were trained by a Belgian institute, cells are opened by at least two officers, and staff safety is a key starting point.
All current instructions for staff are aimed at this or will be adjusted where necessary.
Alle vigerende instructies voor het personeel zijn hier op gericht of worden zo nodig aangepast.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne en Van der Steur (allen VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbeslagname servers door Stichting Brein (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Stichting Brein seized servers without a court order, gained access to owners' private data, and claimed release under the Copyright Act, and whether this amounts to vigilantism and privacy violation. The reply is only a holding notice: the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, and answers will follow as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from Members Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne, Van der Steur and Gesthuizen of your House, on the seizure of servers by Stichting BREIN submitted on 23 and 24 February 2011, cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijk gestelde vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne, Van der Steur en Gesthuizen van uw Kamer, over de inbeslagname van servers door Stichting BREIN ingezonden op 23 en 24 februari 2011, niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een reclamecampagne van de VriendenLoterij (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the VriendenLoterij's text-message campaign telling recipients they won a prize misleads consumers and encourages gambling, and what enforcement options exist under the gambling advertising code. The government's answer is only a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Bouwmeester (PvdA) to the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an advertising campaign by the VriendenLoterij (submitted 23 February 2011) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) van uw Kamer aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een reclamecampagne van de Vriendenloterij (ingezonden 23 februari 2011) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Justitie over inbeslagnames door de stichting BREIN (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Justice about a report that the copyright enforcement foundation BREIN seized pirate servers unlawfully, and whether such private enforcement should instead be entrusted to a government body. The government replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received yet, and promises an answer as soon as possible.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Aso’s isoleren in Tuigdorpen» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper proposal to isolate repeat offenders in 'tuigdorpen' (tent or container villages), asking whether it would help and whether the government would implement it. The state secretary rejected the proposal, citing existing remand facilities, the Inrichting voor Stelselmatige Daders (ISD) measure, and the experience of earlier Skaeve Huse-type projects that struggled with locations.
When it comes to providing a facility pending a criminal case, I do not consider an open facility appropriate.
Als het gaat om het bieden van een voorziening in afwachting van een strafzaak vind ik een open voorziening niet passend.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MP Braakhuis (GroenLinks) asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about alleged dominance of music publishers over the board of collective rights organisation Buma/Stemra, the powers of the supervisory College, a possible independent investigation, ending the statutory monopoly, and more financial reporting. The government's answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all required information has been received.
since not all the required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Smeets (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de componist die zijn eigen zak spekt dankzij Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that a composer received over 2 million euros from Buma/Stemra under a false name, including why the KPMG investigation was not published and whether oversight of collective rights organisations should be tightened. The government reply is only an announcement that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because not all information has yet been received.
since not all the required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het mogelijk maken van internationale kinderontvoering door bijschrijving van een kind in e

An MP asks whether a Dutch multilingual birth extract can be obtained without the other parent's consent, allowing a foreign father to register a child in his passport and risking international child abduction. The state secretary confirms that Algerian law allows this without the mother's consent, that Algeria's rules are for Algeria to decide, and refuses to require both parents' consent for the extract, citing the Vienna convention.

No. The current Dutch arrangement for issuing a multilingual birth register extract follows from the Vienna Convention on the issue of multilingual extracts from civil status records, to which the Netherlands is a party.
Nee. De huidige in Nederland geldende regeling van de verstrekking van een meertalig uittreksel uit het geboorteregister vloeit voort uit de Overeenkomst van Wenen
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Den Haag schrijft tbs-kliniek pillen voor» (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether ministry officials dictate treatment and medication in TBS clinics, whether a former minister demanded full medical files, whether ex-directors are gagged, and about post-TBS recidivism. The state secretary denied officials dictate treatment, said full files are consulted only when the Chamber requests a reconstruction, and said free speech of clinic directors is not restricted by rules, though prior consultation is expected.
Qualified doctors are required for medical treatments.
Voor geneeskundige behandelingen zijn gekwalificeerde artsen vereist.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet goed uitvoeren van onderzoe

An MP asks several ministers why the NODO procedure for investigating sudden unexplained deaths of minors is not yet in force and whether this leaves children's deaths unexamined. The government replies that the procedure is not yet mandatory, that since 2010 doctors must consult the municipal coroner, and that alternatives such as rapid-response teams are being studied to reach a decision soon.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures on the number of investigations ordered by the public prosecutor
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen cijfers over het aantal onderzoeken dat door de officier van justitie wordt gelast
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de teruggeleiding van een meisje naar Guatemala (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary how a 9-year-old girl was returned to Guatemala under the Hague Child Abduction Convention, why her whereabouts were unclear, and what safeguards and cooperation with Guatemalan authorities existed. The state secretary answered that courts, not the Central Authority, decided on return, that Dana is now staying with her father pending Guatemalan child protection review, and that Dutch authorities arranged protective measures and cooperation was good.
It is the judge who, on the basis of the criteria in this convention, decides whether a child must be returned to the country from which it was unlawfully removed.
Het is de rechter die aan de hand van de criteria genoemd in dit verdrag, beslist of een kind moet worden teruggeleid naar het land waar vanuit het ongeoorloofd is meegenomen.

Vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Gevangenis huurt meer imams in en minder pastors en humanisten» (ingezonden 28 januari

PVV MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about a report that prisons were hiring more imams and fewer pastors and humanist counsellors, and whether this threatened integration. The government answered that the increase follows a preference survey of prisoners, denied any integration effect, and refused to introduce an imam stop, citing the legal duty to match religious care to inmates' beliefs.
I therefore see no reason whatsoever to introduce an imam stop (as spiritual caregiver) at DJI.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele aanleiding om een imamstop (als geestelijk verzorger) in te voeren bij DJI.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over eventuele prijsverhogingen naar aanleiding van surfgedrag op internet (ingezonden 11 feb

An SP MP asked ministers whether online browsing behaviour could lead to price discrimination and profiling, and whether research into device fingerprinting and behavioural targeting should be commissioned. The minister replied that no complaints of price increases on repeat visits are known, that research into security effects is not warranted, that profiling falls under the privacy watchdog's agenda, and that a cookie study by OPTA/IVIR-TNO will be published.
No complaints are known about price increases following a repeat visit to the same webshop.
Er zijn geen klachten bekend over prijsverhogingen naar aanleiding van een herhaald bezoek aan dezelfde webwinkel.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over verklaringen omtrent gedrag voor criminele jongeren (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice minister why so few conditional certificates of conduct (VOG) were issued to young offenders under the Rotterdam pilot, and whether rigid application of the rules hinders resocialisation. The state secretary answered that only three conditional VOGs were issued, the pilot runs until October 2011 without extension, and the VOG is a preventive administrative tool rather than a punishment.
Because of the limited demand for a conditional VOG, a conditional VOG was also issued in only a limited number of cases.
Vanwege de beperkte vraag naar een VOG onder voorwaarden, is ook slechts in een beperkt aantal gevallen een VOG onder voorwaarden verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen over «Verklaringen omtrent Gedrag» (VOG’s) voor jongeren en werk (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Rep. Van der Ham (D66) asked the minister about the problem that refusals of Certificates of Conduct (VOG) can block young people's internships and jobs, and how to balance this against their chances after minor offences. The state secretary answered that refusals are rare (under 1% of applications by under-25s in 2010), that each case is weighed individually, and that employers may still hire a refused applicant unless a VOG is legally required.
Only in cases where, given the risk to society, it is necessary is the issuing of the VOG refused.
Slechts in de gevallen waarin het, gelet op het risico voor de samenleving, noodzakelijk is wordt de afgifte van de VOG geweigerd.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat geprivatiseerde gevangenissen niet goedkoper zijn (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether privatised prisons are really cheaper, whether wage cuts and oversight costs undermine savings, and whether privatisation should be ruled out given evidence from abroad. The reply is only an interim notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because not all necessary information has yet been received, with an aim to answer as soon as possible.
because not all of the necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Rik Janssen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een proef met spreekrecht in aparte strafmaatzittingen (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a proposed trial of victim speaking rights in separate sentencing hearings at the Amsterdam district court, including whether the government supports it, whether it reduces overlap between guilt and victim impact, whether it improves court efficiency, and whether the Public Prosecution Service will cooperate and report results. The government answered that the framework decision lets the CJIB collect final fines from other EU states for offenders living in the Netherlands, that transfer is not mandatory, and that it does not regulate how offences are sanctioned or whether fine amounts are excessive; it saw no need to contact the Commissioners.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over handmatige acties en controles bij tap- of referentieverzoeken (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) over handmatige acties en controles bij tap- of referentieverzoeken (ingezonden 22 december 2010) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bonnenquotum in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Utrecht are still judged on the number of traffic tickets issued, despite the abolition of ticket quotas, and what the government will do about it. State Secretary Teeven answered that quotas are undesirable, that he phoned the Utrecht mayor and police leadership who committed to dropping quotas, and that no critical signals from other forces had been received.
It is undesirable for the police to work with ticket quotas or to let the suggestion of steering through them hang over the market.
Het is ongewenst dat de politie met bonnenquota werkt of de suggestie van sturing daarmee boven de markt laat hangen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het handhaven van de openbare orde tijdens de komende jaarwisseling (ingezonden 29 december 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice how public order will be maintained during the coming New Year's Eve, including preparations, use of preventive fines against nuisance-makers, recidivism and available legal instruments. As in previous years, your Chamber will receive a letter in February addressing the preparations made and the measures taken.
Uw Kamer zal, evenals in voorgaande jaren, in februari een brief ontvangen waarin wordt ingegaan op de getroffen voorbereidingen en de genomen maatregelen.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over twee recente gerechtelijke uitspraken over de thuiskopieheffing en do

Since the court still has to rule in both cases, I cannot at this time go into the substance of these cases.
Aangezien de rechter zich in beide zaken nog dient uit te spreken, kan ik op dit moment niet inhoudelijk op deze zaken ingaan.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Holland Casino als staatsdeelneming (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Bouwmeester (PvdA) asked whether Holland Casino, as a state-owned monopolist, can be justified given public goals and EU competition rules, and whether the state can stress those goals when appointing supervisory board members. Teeven answered that the monopoly is legally justified, that Holland Casino faces only limited competition, and that appointment profiles require the company to operate within public gambling policy goals.
I will shortly send the House a letter on my policy intentions regarding gambling policy.
Ik zal de Kamer overigens binnenkort een brief sturen over mijn beleidsvoornemens met betrekking tot het kansspelbeleid.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de inperking van het advocatengeheim (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether talks with the Dutch Bar on limiting lawyers' confidentiality, including powers for the BFT to inspect client files, breach due process and ECHR rights, and what evidence supports claims that lawyers facilitate financial crime. The state secretary replies that the aim is a new supervision regime rather than limiting confidentiality, that BFT is an independent body not part of the ministry or prosecution, that no definitive decisions have been taken, and that FIU data show few suspicious transactions reported by lawyers.
The aim of the talks with the Dutch Bar Association is not to limit the duty of confidentiality, but to arrive at a supervisory system for lawyers that meets present-day requirements.

Het doel van de gesprekken met de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (hierna: de Orde) is niet de inperking van de geheimhoudingsplicht, maar het komen tot een, aan de eisen van de huidige tijd beantwoordend stelsel van toezicht op advocaten

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toegankelijkheid van privacygevoelige informatie voor derden, waaronder particuliere recherchebureaus (ingezonden 2 n

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how easily private investigators and others can obtain privacy-sensitive information, and whether government agencies commission such methods. The state secretary replied that government officials using such methods would commit crimes, that private actors face criminal and data-protection rules rather than the Code of Criminal Procedure, and that the Data Protection Authority provides guidance and awareness-raising.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen die de rechtspraak frustreren (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

An SP MP asked whether budget cuts at the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen caused a suspect in the Almelo hostage case to arrive late at court, and how often late transport happens and what will be done. State Secretary Teeven answered that the delay resulted from a combination of circumstances, not budget cuts, that late arrivals are rare and unregistered, and that no measures are needed.
No, due to a combination of circumstances the suspect arrived late at the court.
Nee, door een samenloop van omstandigheden is de verdachte te laat bij het hof gearriveerd.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Opstelten sluit DNA verdrag met VS» (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the signing of the PCSC treaty with the United States on exchanging DNA and fingerprint data, its reciprocity, relation to the Visa Waiver Programme and Prüm, EU data protection compliance, and ratification timing. The government confirmed signing, asserted full reciprocity and adequate data-protection safeguards, said it had not pursued the treaty at EU level, and expected the ratification bill before summer 2011 with consultation of the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
My expectation is that the bill approving the treaty, together with the necessary implementing legislation still to be drafted, can be submitted to the Council of Ministers before summer 2011.

Mijn verwachting is dat het wetsvoorstel tot goedkeuring van het verdrag, tezamen met de nog op te stellen noodzakelijke uitvoeringswetgeving, voor de zomer van 2011 aan de Ministerraad kan worden voorgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het DNA-verdrag tussen Nederland en de Verenigde Staten (VS) (ingezonden 25 november 2010)

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about the Dutch-US DNA and fingerprint data exchange treaty, covering reciprocity, the purpose of serious-crime solving, privacy safeguards, the link to US Visa Waiver requirements, comparable treaties with other EU states, and EU coordination. The government answered that access is granted case by case through national contact points, that privacy is protected because reference data are not traceable to individuals, that the treaty was driven by slow manual matching rather than specific cases, and that EU coordination was informal.
As for reciprocity, I refer to my answer to question 3 from MP Schouw of your House.
Wat betreft de wederkerigheid verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op vraag 3 van het lid Schouw van uw Kamer

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens van Europese consumenten in de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 1 december 2010).

An MP asked the government whether the US Safe Harbor certification adequately protects Europeans' personal data, citing claims of fraud, weak US enforcement, and calls for a binding US-EU data protection treaty. The Secretary of State answered that Safe Harbor is important but not the only legal basis, that the claims about the Australian research are not endorsed, that enforcement is largely by the FTC on complaint, and that the Commission, not the Dutch government, must address enforcement and evaluate the scheme, while offering to approach the Commission.
Enforcement of the Safe Harbor decision, however, is a matter that can only be addressed at European level by the Commission.
De handhaving van de «Safe Harbor»-beschikking is echter een zaak die uitsluitend op Europees niveau door de Commissie kan worden aangepakt.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over de problemen rondom de AIS-transponders (ingezonden 21 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister about privacy concerns over AIS transponders, a 2006 convenant with inland shipping, cost and purpose creep, mandatory use, the public MarineTraffic website, and Rijkswaterstaat's dual role. The reply says the privacy regime is adequate, the College bescherming persoonsgegevens will not disclose its enforcement plans in advance, and the Public Prosecution Service sees no violation of article 441 Sr.
The College informed me upon request that it is not customary for it to give advance insight into and account for the enforcement strategy to be followed.
Het College heeft mij desverzocht laten weten dat het niet te doen gebruikelijk is dat hij op voorhand inzicht geeft in en verantwoording aflegt over de te volgen handhavingsstrategie
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over achterlating in Pakistan (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice how authorities handled warning signs that a Pakistani girl, N., in Rotterdam would be abandoned in Pakistan and forced into marriage, and what the government will do to tackle abandonment and forced marriage. The state secretary answers that authorities acted promptly and that the case confirms the value of warm handover and early cooperation, that the case has been shared confidentially with parliament, and that the government will strengthen its approach and criminalise forced marriage, while rejecting a national Forced Marriage Unit and saying no representative estimate of prevalence is feasible.

Based on the overview of facts that the mayor of Rotterdam provided to me, which I am sending separately and confidentially to your House, I am of the view that the authorities involved were not lacking in readiness to act and that signals were picked up quickly.

Op basis van het overzicht van de feiten dat de burgemeester van Rotterdam mij heeft verschaft en dat ik separaat en vertrouwelijk aan uw Kamer toestuur, ben ik van mening dat het bij de betrokken autoriteiten niet heeft ontbroken aan actiebereidheid en dat signalen snel zijn opgepakt.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een alternatief voor de traditionele rechtspraak (stichting E-Court) en de rol van de deurwaarder (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether private dispute body Stichting E-Court, which issues enforceable notarial deeds, requires bailiff involvement that the minister should recognise as official acts under the Gerechtsdeurwaarders law. The state secretary replies that E-Court is comparable to binding advice, that a court-referred test case is pending, and that the ministry awaits its outcome and the KNB's view before informing parliament in early 2011.
Therefore I am awaiting the outcome of said procedure and the further determination of the KNB's position.
Daarom wacht ik de uitkomstvan genoemde procedure en nadere standpuntbepaling van de KNB af.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verhuren van celcapaciteit voor jeugdigen aan België (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

MP Kooiman (SP) asks the state secretary whether youth detention capacity could be temporarily rented to Belgium, citing Belgium's cell shortage and whether this could avoid forced layoffs in Dutch youth facilities. because not all necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether staff had warned management of the Schiphol cell complex about leadership gaps and inexperienced colleagues before the 2005 fire, and what became of the staff survey. The Rijksrecherche and the Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid have received all relevant documents relating to the Schiphol fire file, including the staff survey.
De Rijksrecherche en de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid hebben alle relevante stukken ontvangen die betrekking hebben op het dossier Schipholbrand, ook de personeelsenquête.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Veiligheid en Justitie over het onervaren personeel bij de Schipholbrand en de brandveiligheidsmaatregelen in justitiële inrichtingen (ingezonden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about inexperienced staff and fire-safety measures at the Schiphol detention centre before and after the 2005 Schiphol fire, including staff surveys, maintenance complaints, training, outsourcing and spending. Unfortunately this has not proven possible, but of course this matter can also receive attention in the general consultation with your House on 8 December.
Tot mijn spijt is dit niet mogelijk gebleken, maar uiteraard kan ook in het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 8 december aanstaande aandacht worden besteed aan deze materie.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het plaatsen van containercellen op Bonaire (ingezonde

I will however inform myself about the situation within a reasonable time.
Ik ga me wel zelf op de hoogte stellen binnen afzienbare tijd.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State betreffende adoptie (ingezonden 18 november 2010).
