since not all required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de opstartproblemen van het Nederlands Register Gerechtelijk Deskundigen (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP asked the minister about criticism that admission standards for the Dutch Register of Forensic Experts are too low, how many experts have registered, and how appointment via the examining magistrate is working. The state secretary rejected the criticism as premature, reported small registration numbers so far, and said the College monitors progress and government will give impulses where needed, without committing to new measures.
The number of expert appointments is not registered centrally.
Het aantal deskundigenbenoemingen wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het plaatsen van containercellen op Bonaire (ingezonde

An MP asks the state secretary of Security and Justice and the minister of Interior about planned container cells on Bonaire, raising concerns about visibility, communication with outsiders, ventilation, pests and humane detention, and asks whether the government will visit and reconsider. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen die de rechtspraak frustreren (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Gesthuizen (SP) to the State Secretary for Security and Justice on the budget cuts at the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen that frustrate the judiciary (submitted 4 November 2010) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) van uw Kamer aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bezuinigingen bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen die de rechtspraak frustreren (ingezonden 4 november 2010) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een alternatief voor de traditionele rechtspraak (stichting E-Court) en de rol van de deurwaarder (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de aanwezigheid van een advocaat bij het verhoor (ingezonden 4 novembe

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the European Court of Human Rights ruling in Brusco v. France implies a right for a lawyer to be present during police interrogation, and whether evidence could be excluded where no lawyer was present. The state secretary answered that the ruling does not require a lawyer's presence during questioning in general, that Dutch practice complies with Article 6 ECHR, and that the court decides on consequences under article 359a Sv.
This ruling does not lead to the conclusion that, apart from the context of French legislation, the lawyer must in general also be able to be present during the interrogation.
Deze uitspraak leidt niet tot de conclusie dat los van de context van de Franse wetgeving de raadsman in het algemeen ook tijdens het verhoor aanwezig moet kunnen zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verlof van een veroordeelde die agressie pleegde tegen politieagenten (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a Polish man convicted of attempted murder of police officers was released on leave pending appeal, whether he was still required to serve a Latvian sentence, and how he is being sought after absconding. The state secretary admitted leave was wrongly granted because the extradition information was overlooked, announced internal measures and a review, and declined to exclude such suspects from leave in principle.
It appeared that the penitentiary institution did have the extradition information, but it was wrongly not considered when weighing whether to grant the person leave.

Gebleken is dat in de penitentiaire inrichting de informatie met betrekking tot de uitlevering wel aanwezig was, maar ten onrechte niet aan de orde is geweest bij de afweging om betrokkene al dan niet verlof te verlenen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het melden en meten van agressie en geweldsincidenten in penitentiaire inrichtingen (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a fight between inmates and prison staff at PI Rotterdam Hoogvliet, how violence in prisons is recorded, and staffing and safety measures. The state secretary confirmed the incident, reported falling violence figures since 2006, and said staffing norms are unchanged while describing safety measures.
However, I take the staff's feelings seriously and will consult with them to examine what causes the divergent perception.
Ik neem de gevoelens van het personeel evenwel serieus en zal in overleg met hen bekijken wat de afwijkende perceptie veroorzaakt.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over regulering van kansspelen (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

Labour MP Bouwmeester asks the Justice Minister about the Dutch gambling regime after EU Court rulings, including the BankGiroLoterij's mailings and whether Holland Casino advertising fits restriction policy, and asks whether the policy hampers fair market competition. State Secretary Teeven answers that he largely agrees with the legal analysis, defends the government's position in the pending De Lotto/Ladbrokes and Betfair proceedings, says advertising has been reduced and the conduct code will be revised, declines to judge the BankGiro mailings given pending litigation, and says a review of licensing procedures is under way.
Since this question is now directly before the national court, I consider it undesirable to take a position on it in light of the mentioned advertising campaign.
Nu deze vraag concreet voorligt bij de nationale rechter, acht ik het ongewenst hierover, in het licht van genoemde reclameactie, een standpunt in te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over de proef arbeidstoeleiding vanuit detentie (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice about a pilot linking detention to job placement (UWV, prison and municipalities), its expansion to six locations, the number of prisoners placed in work, and whether the pilot will be adopted nationwide. The State Secretary answered that the pilot expanded in 2010, only 10 of 60 registered prisoners were placed in work in the first phase, a nationwide toolkit is due in January 2011, and agreements with the prison service on structural adoption will follow in early 2011.

Based on the outcomes of the pilot evaluation, I will make agreements with the prison service in early 2011 on introducing the job placement approach as part of the regular reintegration activities offered to detainees.

Op basis van de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de pilots zal ik begin 2011 met het gevangeniswezen afspraken maken over de invoering van de werkwijze arbeidstoeleiding als onderdeel van het regulier aanbod aan terugkeer activiteiten voor gedetineerden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een promotioneel kansspel: «Heel Nederland pint en wint» (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An SP MP asks whether it is desirable that anyone making a card payment during 1-7 November 2010 is automatically entered into the promotional game 'Heel Nederland pint en wint', how account holders were informed, whether data use complies with the data protection law, and how realistic the winning chances are. The government reply is only a notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all information has been received.
because not all required information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over inadequaat handelen door de Centrale Autoriteit bij een kinderontvoeringszaak (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked why authorities failed to stop a mother who abducted her 11-year-old son to Portugal, why the Dutch Central Authority took over a week to send documents, and whether there is a backlog of 96 cases. The state secretary answered that the CA acted promptly, transmitted documents to Portugal within days, and denied any waiting list, while citing privacy limits on individual case details and committing to do everything possible to locate the child.
I cannot fully inform your House about individual cases for privacy reasons.
Ik kan uw Kamer om privacyredenen niet volledig informeren over individuele zaken.
Vragen van het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over binnenlandse adoptie door lesbische ouderparen (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about costs and leave rights for lesbian parent couples in domestic adoption, and whether the legal treatment is unequal. The state secretary replied that a draft bill would establish legal parenthood for the co-mother by operation of law, that adoption costs are comparable to other parentage procedures, and that the sex of the partner is irrelevant to adoption and birth leave entitlements.
The sex of the partner is not relevant here.
Het geslacht van de partner is hierbij niet van belang.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Teeven (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het visa waiver program (VWP) (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Teeven asked whether the US requested a Dutch data-sharing arrangement like Austria's, whether direct access to police data is acceptable, and whether the European Commission should intervene. As was the case with the PCSC agreement described in the letters mentioned, your House will be informed further about this request once the Dutch government's assessment of the American request is completed.

Net als bij de in de genoemde brieven beschreven Prevention and Combating of Serious Crime Agreement (PCSC-overeenkomst) het geval was, zal uw Kamer nader worden geïnformeerd over dit verzoek op het moment dat de beoordeling van het Amerikaanse verzoek door de Nederlandse regering is afgerond.

MP Dibi (GroenLinks) asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he proposed letting the departmental Bureau Financieel Toezicht inspect lawyers' files of clients suspected of money laundering or fraud, and questions the compatibility with the ECHR right to confidential lawyer-client contact and the evidence for lawyers' involvement in crime. I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Dibi (GroenLinks) on the restriction of lawyer confidentiality (submitted 22 October 2010) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all required information has yet been received.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen het lid Dibi (GroenLinks) over de inperking van het advocatengeheim (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie ontvangen is.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over achterlating in Pakistan (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice, after a Nieuwsuur report, how schools and child-protection agencies handled signals that a Pakistani girl was at risk of being abandoned in Pakistan and forced into marriage, whether the case can be investigated and the girl brought back, what has happened to a parliamentary motion on criminalising forced marriage, and whether a national unit like the UK Forced Marriage Unit should be set up. The government's answer is only a notice that the questions cannot yet be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received.
I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minster van Justitie over de huis-aan-huis-verkoop van kaarten voor goede doelen (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

The MP asks the Minister of Justice whether companies selling cards door-to-door for charities must disclose which charities benefit and what share of proceeds they receive, and what action will be taken against misleading sellers. The minister replies that municipalities regulate door-to-door sales through permits and transparency conditions, that charities are responsible for their partnerships, that existing filing and tax controls apply, and that no criminal investigation is currently warranted.

Imposing a reporting obligation on what share of proceeds goes to which charity is reserved for the municipality, which must grant a permit for door-to-door sales under the General Local Regulation (APV).

Het opleggen van een meldingsplicht over welk deel van de opbrengst naar welk goed doel gaat, is voorbehouden aan de gemeente die op grond van de Algemene Plaatselijke Verordening (APV) vergunning moet verlenen voor huis-aan-huisverkoop.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het aan het werk zetten van gedetineerden (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Justice Minister whether the UK plan to put prisoners to work 40 hours a week, with proceeds partly going to victims, is worth studying, and whether work in prison aids structure and reduces recidivism. State Secretary Teeven replied that the UK situation is not directly comparable, that work in Dutch prisons is offered for 20 hours and cannot be expanded to 40 hours within the current daily programme, and that prison labour is not cost-covering.
Within the current daily programme it is not possible to offer 40 hours of work, because prisoners are also entitled to other activities such as exercise, recreation and visits.
Binnen het huidige dagprogramma is het niet mogelijk om arbeid voor 40 uur aanbieden, omdat gedetineerden tevens recht hebben op andere activiteiten, zoals luchten, recreatie en bezoek.

Vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister van Justitie over het plaatsen van containercellen op Bonaire (ingezonden 24 september

An MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about the placement of container cells for detainees on Bonaire, including the tropical climate, cooling, compliance with detention norms, permit requirements, humane detention, and whether the government would halt the practice. The government answered that the open-sided cells use wind for cooling, meet international detention standards, were permitted by local authorities, and that it declined to stop the practice, while the DJI will continue improving conditions.
No. This method of detention was deliberately chosen.
Neen. Er is bewust gekozen voor deze wijze van detineren.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van een informatiseringproject van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichti

MPs Heijnen and Bouwmeester asked ministers about the halting of the DJI information system Cajis, its costs, project governance, and the information given to parliament. The government answered that the project was stopped after a June 2010 review found its design outdated and costs would exceed 20 million euro, that parliament was not informed because the project did not meet the large-ICT threshold, and that existing systems continue to be used.
The Tweede Kamer was not informed about the planning and progress of the Cajis project, because this is not usual for projects that do not meet the criterion for designation as a 'large ICT project'.

De Tweede Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de planning en voortgang van de ontwikkeling van het Cajis-project, omdat dit niet gebruikelijk is voor projecten die niet voldoen aan het criterium voor aanwijzing tot «groot ICT project».
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Justitie over de intimidatie van gevangenispersoneel door een gevangenisdirecteur (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

MPs Gesthuizen and Schouw asked the Minister of Justice about alleged intimidation of prison staff by a prison director, staff overwork, understaffing and unsafe conditions at PI Rotterdam, location Hoogvliet, following a broadcast. The State Secretary denied the signals, reported that issues were being addressed through meetings and a training programme, cited an external security audit, and declined to start an investigation for now.
Information relating to the security of an institution is not made public.
Informatie die betrekking heeft op de beveiliging van een inrichting wordt niet naar buiten gebracht.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het verstrekken van voedsel aan gedetineerden in gevangenissen (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice whether prisons have reduced food rations for detainees (half a loaf for two days, one piece of fruit daily), whether this stems from budget cuts, and whether national minimum quantities apply. The state secretary confirmed the reduced quantities follow from a recent European tender, say the package matches Voedingscentrum advice, acknowledge one facility wrongly gave only one piece of fruit, and state that detainees requesting more bread will be accommodated.
In cases where only one piece of fruit was wrongly provided in certain penitentiary institutions, the supplier has since been held to account.
In het geval dat in bepaalde penitentiaire inrichtingen ten onrechte slechts 1 stuks fruit is verstrekt, is de leverancier daar inmiddels op aangesproken.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de procedure op grond van Wet overdracht en tenuitvoerlegging van strafvonnissen (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers why Dutch enforcement of transferred foreign sentences under the WOTS can mean longer or harsher detention than the sentence imposed abroad, citing a Norwegian case and a Supreme Court ruling. The State Secretary replied that the transfer treaty bars any aggravation, that the Norwegian release date is binding, that no measures are needed, that the Supreme Court ruling reflects existing practice, and that prisoners receive information on early release options.
In this case there is no aggravation of the convicted person's criminal legal position.
Er is in deze casus geen sprake van een verzwaring van de strafrechtelijke positie van betrokkene.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het aan het werk zetten van gedetineerden (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

The reply is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all information has yet been received.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from Member Gesthuizen (SP) to the Minister of Justice on putting detainees to work (submitted 8 October 2010) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) van uw Kamer aan de minister van Justitie over het aan het werk zetten van gedetineerden (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over een iftarmaaltijd in Slotervaart (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

I inform you that it is not possible to answer these questions within the prescribed period.
deel ik u mee dat het niet mogelijk is deze vragen binnen de gestelde termijn te beantwoorden
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over de onafhankelijkheid van de advocaat in loondienst (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

Rep. Recourt (PvdA) asked the Justice Minister whether the Akzo ECJ ruling, which denies legal professional privilege to in-house lawyers in Commission competition inspections, means in-house lawyers can no longer be considered independent, and what practical consequences follow. State Secretary Teeven answered that the ruling means in-house lawyers cannot invoke confidentiality in Commission verification procedures, that its full scope is not yet clear, and that he will consult the NOvA, the insurers' association and the corporate counsel association and report back.
This ruling calls for reflection on the independence and legal professional privilege of lawyers in employment.
Deze uitspraak dwingt tot een bezinning over de onafhankelijkheid en het verschoningsrecht van advocaten in dienstbetrekking.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Justitie over de intimidatie van gevangenispersoneel door een gevangenisdirecteur (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

since not all necessary information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.

since not all the required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de olifant Buba

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the circus elephant Buba, arguing she should be allowed to stay with her circus family and that precedent should not block this. The minister replied that an exemption under conditions was granted on 25 March 2021 for an indefinite period, while noting that the keeper was responsible for her residence and that earlier relocation efforts had been supported.
At the request of Mr Freiwald, I granted an exemption on 25 March 2021.
Ik heb op verzoek van de heer Freiwald op 25 maart 2021 een ontheffing afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de verkoop van Nederlandse MP5’s in een Maltese wapenhandel

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Defence about the sale of 2,084 surplus Dutch firearms (Glock pistols, m2.50 and MP5 submachine guns) to a Dutch dealer apparently destined for a Maltese arms shop, questioning the sale method, export implications and EU compliance. The government answered that the sale was lawful under EU and Dutch rules, that policy is being tightened to exclude sales of firearms to private parties, and that it bought back only the unsold weapons, arguing it lacks a legal basis to recover the rest.

That is why I have instructed that a new assessment framework be drawn up for disposing of surplus Defence materiel, tightening policy by excluding sales of firearms to private parties other than the manufacturer or a manufacturer's licence holder.

Daarom heb ik ook opdracht gegeven om een nieuw afwegingskader op te stellen voor het afstoten van overtollig Defensiematerieel, waarin het beleid wordt aangescherpt door de verkoop van handvuurwapens aan private partijen, niet zijnde de fabrikant of een licentiehouder van de fabrikant, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Chinese surveillanceapparatuur

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Huawei tested facial recognition software targeting Uyghurs, whether this breaches international human rights law, whether Dutch and EU bodies use Hikvision surveillance equipment, and whether the government will act against Chinese firms and push for tougher EU measures. The minister answered that the government cannot confirm the reports, that ethnically targeted facial recognition would likely breach non-discrimination treaties, that it will raise concerns with Huawei and China but rejects calls for a blacklist or a dedicated investigation, and that it has no overview of surveillance equipment used by public or private bodies.
There is no complete overview of the surveillance equipment used across all government institutions.
Er bestaat geen compleet overzicht van de gebruikte surveillanceapparatuur binnen alle overheidsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Palland over het bericht 'Gaat de Nederlandse industrie aan boord van Nederlandse onderzeeboten?'

MPs Van Helvert and Palland (CDA) asked about concerns that Dutch industry may not be included in the new submarines given the three-yard competition, the cost burden on SMEs, and knock-out criteria for industrial participation. The government replied that essential security interests and strategic autonomy will be secured through primary and secondary requirements in the procurement, that a parallel industrial cooperation agreement led by EZK will pursue broader Dutch involvement, and that no fixed participation percentage is imposed in advance.
Defence will, after testing in the dialogue, set requirements in the D-phase to safeguard essential national security interests and strategic autonomy.
Defensie zal daarbij, na toetsing in de dialoog, in de D-fase eisen stellen ter borging van het wezenlijk nationaal veiligheidsbelang en de strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Graaf, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Same Faith, Different Persecution' van Open Doors

MPs from four Christian parties asked the government about an Open Doors report on gender-specific religious persecution of women and girls, and what came of earlier commitments to raise it with UN envoys. The minister said the Special Envoy's talks with UN officials led to closer cooperation on religion and gender, that the government recognises the problem, and that it will be addressed through existing human rights channels and funding without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet recognises that women and girls from religious minorities are subjected to forced marriage and human trafficking.
Het kabinet herkent dat vrouwen en meisjes uit religieuze minderheden onderworpen worden aan gedwongen huwelijken en mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de situatie in Tigray

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the situation in Tigray, including reported mass killings, sexual violence, famine risk, the fate of Eritrean refugees, humanitarian access, UN peacekeeping and evidence preservation. The minister answered in detail, describing ongoing conflict, EHRC and OHCHR investigations, Dutch diplomatic initiatives, and the Ethiopian government's commitments on access, while declining to commit to a UN mission for now.
Given the limited access for humanitarian organisations and journalists, and the ongoing fighting in the region, it is not possible to give an exact picture of the fate of these refugees.
Gezien de beperkte toegang voor humanitaire organisaties en journalisten, en de voortdurende strijd in de regio is het niet mogelijk een exact beeld te geven van het lot van deze vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Helvert over de ongeregeldheden bij Marokkaanse consulaten

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about protests and intimidation at Moroccan consulates in the Netherlands, including the desecration of the Moroccan flag in Utrecht. The ministers condemned the incidents, said police and the Public Prosecution Service act on criminal offences, and described contacts and extra security alertness, while stating that demonstrations are a local matter for mayors.
As your House knows, we cannot make statements about the nature of the measures.
Over de aard van de maatregelen kunnen wij, zoals uw Kamer weet, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht dat studenten in Nederland China vrezen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked whether the Groningen Confucius Institute chair contract, which bars damaging China's image, threatens academic freedom, and what measures the government will take. The minister said the RUG must safeguard academic freedom, the Inspectorate may investigate, the chair agreement will lapse this year, and further measures are under review.
The Inspectorate of Education can itself decide, based on signals including media reports, to launch an investigation.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs kan zelf op basis van signalen, waaronder berichten in de media, besluiten een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de precaire situatie in Noord-Irak

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish military operations in northern Iraq since June 2020, their effect on minorities, and what Dutch diplomacy can do to protect them. The minister described the Turkish operations, said there were no current signs of a new offensive, and answered most questions by pointing to Iraqi responsibility and continued bilateral dialogue without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet does not wish to speculate about a possible future Turkish operation.
Het kabinet wil niet speculeren over een eventuele toekomstige Turkse operatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over overlast door nieuwe SMART-L radar in Wier

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Defence about nighttime noise and other complaints from residents near the new SMART-L radar in Wier, and about the plan for the second radar at Herwijnen and a motion to find another site. The State Secretary answered that the radar is switched off at night, that Defence will work with Thales to meet noise norms, that the permit was granted in 2020, and that the second radar's permit is pending, though the answers on Herwijnen and the motion were partly deferred or evasive.
At all times Defence must comply with the applicable noise standards laid down in the environmental permit, including at night.
Te allen tijde moet Defensie voldoen aan de geldende geluidsnormen, zoals opgenomen in de omgevingsvergunning, ook ‘s nachts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over hulp aan Kroatië na aardbeving

MP Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about the earthquakes in Croatia, the ongoing hardship of displaced families, and Dutch aid offers. The minister replied that Croatia declined Dutch in-kind and engineering support, that Croatia is eligible for EU Solidarity Fund aid, and that the Netherlands stands ready should needs arise.
In a letter to my counterpart I indicated that the Netherlands stands ready to consider new options should Croatia develop further humanitarian needs in the future.
In een brief aan mijn ambtgenoot heb ik aangegeven dat Nederland klaarstaat om nieuwe mogelijkheden te bezien, mocht er in de toekomst nog een Kroatische hulpbehoefte ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over de betrokkenheid van Defensie bij de bestrijding van de pandemie

CDA MPs asked the Defence Minister about Defence's role in the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccination programme, including why only 150 of 1,000 standby soldiers were deployed, how 2009 differed, and whether Defence should host innovation offers. The minister answered that civil authorities lead vaccination, Defence supports planning and standby personnel as requested, and innovation offers are routed to the responsible ministries.
The civil authorities are responsible for the vaccination programme.
De civiele autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het vaccinactieprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked whether the government would make a humanitarian request for transfer of Mr Singh's sentence to the Netherlands, given his health and the failure of earlier clemency requests, and why it rejects the WOTS transfer procedure and continuing enforcement. The minister replied that transfer is not a humanitarian instrument, that the government is diplomatically supporting a clemency request instead, and that it sees no room for a WOTS request because of the lack of remaining sentence and binding to the Netherlands.

In my letter to the House of 21 September 2020, responding to the motion by Van Nispen et al., I indicated why I see no room for a request to the American authorities to transfer enforcement of his sentence to the Netherlands.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer d.d. 21 september 2020, in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s., heb ik aangegeven waarom ik geen ruimte zie voor een verzoek aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot overdracht van de tenuitvoerlegging van zijn straf aan Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Verhoeven, Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat er tientallen communistische partijcomités binnen Nederlandse bedrijven in China bestaan

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government whether it knew of Chinese Communist Party committees in Dutch companies in China, what economic or strategic effects this has, whether the government has agreements with these firms, and whether intellectual property is being stolen. The minister answers that the government is aware of such committees and offers general advice to firms, cites an EU Chamber survey suggesting limited influence, says precise numbers of party-linked board members are not held, and declines to comment on intelligence investigations.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on specific investigations by the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over specifieke onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de berichtgeving van de Veteranenombudsman over de behandelingsduur van de schadevergoeding voor invalide veteranen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Defence about the Veterans Ombudsman's findings that compensation for disabled veterans is handled too slowly, and about proposed fixes such as digitising medical files, a single medical assessment and a care coordinator. The minister acknowledged the delays, said Defence aims to settle claims within two years, is positive about the proposals and is working on a reform of the benefits system, though she declined to commit to a firm date for digitisation.
Defence aims, together with the parties involved, to settle the compensation within two years.
Defensie streeft er naar – samen met betrokken partijen – de schadevergoeding binnen twee jaar af te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2021 van Open Doors

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert) asked the foreign minister about the Open Doors 2021 Christian persecution ranking, covering FoRB envoy vacancy, persecution in Nigeria, China, India and Turkey, COVID aid, and export controls. The minister answered at length, mostly restating policy and concerns, while declining to commit to specific new initiatives beyond existing diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitvoering van de motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het organiseren van een wereldconferentie van democratieën in Den Haag

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the motion to host a world conference of democracies in The Hague is being implemented, including whether contact has been made with the incoming Biden administration. The minister supports the planned Summit for Democracy, agrees The Hague is a suitable location, and says no policy contact was possible before the inauguration but contact will be sought afterwards.
After the inauguration, contact will be sought with the administration, including via the Dutch embassy, to learn more about this initiative.
Na de inauguratie zal er contact gezocht worden met de administratie, o.a. via de Nederlandse ambassade, om meer te weten te komen over dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Ahrar-al-Sham

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether Ahrar al-Sham is a terrorist organisation, whether it benefited from Dutch non-lethal assistance, and whether it poses a threat in the Netherlands, among related questions. The minister answered that intelligence services do not see the group as a direct national security threat, that no non-lethal assistance reached it, and that it does not meet the conditions for national listing, while declining to comment publicly on other armed groups.
The cabinet does not make public statements about moderate armed groups that have or have not received NLA.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over gematigde gewapende groepen die al-dan-niet NLA hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de Verenigde Naties datacentra in China gaat neerzetten

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister whether UN data centres in China, a systemic rival, risk giving China broad knowledge of global activity and whether the Netherlands should object or refuse to share data. The minister answers that the centres involve technical cooperation using freely available or no Dutch personal data, that the government sees no grounds to block them and will monitor developments.
The cabinet of course continues to closely monitor the developments.
Het kabinet blijft de ontwikkelingen uiteraard nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Nederlands subsidiegeld aan voormalig Syrische kopstuk

MP Van Helvert asks whether Dutch subsidy money flowed via the European Institute of Peace to a former Ahrar al-Sham figure, Labib al-Nahhas, and questions the government's refusal to list Ahrar al-Sham as terrorist. The ministers answer that Al-Nahhas withdrew from the project, that the ministry was not informed beforehand, and that Ahrar al-Sham is not on the national sanctions list because there are no Dutch links, promising only to examine screening procedures.
Information about the salary of Mr. Labib al-Nahhas is confidential personnel information and cannot be shared.
Informatie over het salaris van Dhr. Labib al-Nahhas is personeelsvertrouwlijk en kan niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over samenwerking Nederlandse universiteiten met China.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Dutch universities' cooperation with China, including whether contracts are tracked centrally, whether guidelines exist, and whether China-specific rules are needed. The government answered that institutions are autonomous and not obliged to register partnerships centrally, that RVO found faculty-level MoUs sometimes escape university board view, and that landen-neutral knowledge-security guidelines are being drafted for the second quarter of 2021.
I will, together with my colleagues, discuss this with the knowledge sector to explore what (administrative) agreements can be made on this.
Ik ga, samen met mijn collega's, hierover in gesprek met de kennissector om te onderzoeken op welke manier we hier (bestuurlijke) afspraken over kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het onderzoek naar de Nederlandse steun aan Syrische rebellen

An MP asks whether the Prime Minister tried to block a motion for an independent inquiry into the Dutch non-lethal aid (NLA) programme to Syrian rebels, and why the government opposes such a probe on grounds of confidentiality, allied relations and risk to rebel groups. The minister responds that the motion was implemented via advisory bodies, that a case-by-case fact-finding inquiry conflicts with confidentiality obligations, that a toetsingskader will be shared in spring 2021, and that no additional inquiry is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Paternotte over het bericht ’Internationale steun voor Einstein Telescope groeit; 'Toponderzoeksproject met een wereldwijde impact'

Three MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about international support for the Einstein Telescope, including Italian and German funding, the Recovery Fund, and whether the project can be submitted to the National Growth Fund. The minister confirmed a meeting with North Rhine-Westphalia, declined to comment on Italian budget financing, said the bid process and criteria are still being designed, and that no project announcements will be made before the Growth Fund review.
I am aware that funds are being made available in both locations, in Italy and the Euregio, for research into the suitability of the site.
Het is mij bekend dat op beide locaties, zowel in Italië als de Euregio, middelen ter beschikking worden gesteld voor het onderzoek naar de geschiktheid van de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two CDA MPs asked why noise-barrier construction along the A79 at Valkenburg cannot be combined with planned road maintenance, and when residents will get clarity. The minister answered that barriers await the final noise-remediation plan (draft mid-2021, final early 2022, possible appeal), that maintenance cannot be delayed, and that barriers should be complete by 2027.

Only once the noise remediation plan Zuid-Nederland phase 2 (MJPG) is definitively adopted and irrevocable is there certainty about the noise barriers and other measures along the A79 at Goudenrood and Vroenhof.

Pas op het moment dat het geluidsaneringsplan Zuid-Nederland fase 2 (MJPG) definitief is vastgesteld en onherroepelijk is, is er zekerheid over de te realiseren geluidsschermen en andere maatregelen langs de A79 bij Goudenrood en Vroenhof.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de geheime Europese Uniemissie (EU) naar Venezuela en het bericht dat de EU Ambassadeur in Venezuela een propagandarapport in ontvangst heeft genomen uit handen van dhr. Ta

Van Helvert (CDA) asks the Foreign Minister whether the EU ambassador in Venezuela erred by receiving a propaganda report on human rights from Tarek William Saab, whether Dutch ambassadors may meet sanctioned persons, and whether the EU will condemn the report. Minister Blok answers that the ambassador did not know in advance of the handover, the Netherlands does not recognise Maduro, the report was not endorsed, and the EU's sanctions and human rights statements stand, while declining to ask the High Representative to act.
The EU ambassador in Venezuela has contact with all relevant actors to contribute to a solution to the political crisis, including representatives of the Maduro regime.
De EU-ambassadeur in Venezuela heeft contact met alle relevante actoren om bij te dragen aan een oplossing voor de politieke crisis, waaronder vertegenwoordigers van het Maduro-bewind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Slootweg over het bericht 'Militairen betaalden te veel voor pensioen’

MPs Van Helvert and Slootweg asked whether seven former military personnel who sued over pension premiums charged from 2004 to 2018 were overcharged, and whether Defence should compensate them. The State Secretary answered that the correct premiums were charged under annual agreements with the unions, rejected compensation, and promised to inform the House of the court outcome.
Defence takes the position that the correct pension premium was always charged, as agreed annually with the unions.
Defensie stelt zich op het standpunt dat altijd de juiste pensioenpremie in rekening is gebracht, zoals die (jaarlijks) is overeengekomen met de vakbonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Helvert over de Hagia Sophia, die door Turkije tegen de regels van de Organisatie der Verenigde Naties voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (UNESCO) in, i

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's conversion of the Hagia Sophia and Chora Museum into mosques, both UNESCO World Heritage sites, breaches UNESCO rules and whether the Netherlands will raise it at the Executive Board. The minister confirmed awareness of the conversions and covered frescoes, said the matter is for the World Heritage Committee to judge under the Outstanding Universal Value standard, and noted the Executive Board meeting was postponed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Is er nog leven voor VDL Nedcar na 2023 nu BMW afhaakt’

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked the government whether it had contacts with VDL Nedcar, BMW or the German government about BMW ending its contract, which ministries are involved in finding a solution, and whether an integral action plan for the region will be made. Minister Wiebes answered that contacts with VDL Nedcar and BMW took place at high level, no contact with the German government occurred on the contract, several ministries and NFIA help find new clients, and a regional development package with funding and road projects is being pursued.
The cabinet is generally reticent about publishing information on the content of specific contacts with businesses.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het publiceren van informatie over de inhoud van specifieke contacten met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het beoogd VN-datacentrum in China.

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN plans a geospatial and big-data centre in China, how the government assesses the reports, who funds it, and whether the UN was contacted. Minister Blok confirmed UN preparations for a Global Geospatial Knowledge and Innovation Centre in Deqing and a regional hub in Hangzhou, said the government supports careful data use but sees risks in concentrating global data flows in one country and wants clear, verifiable data agreements, and described the intergovernmental governance of the initiative.
For this reason, the cabinet considers it important that clear and verifiable agreements come about regarding the availability, integrity and confidentiality of data.
Daarom acht het kabinet het van belang dat er duidelijke en controleerbare afspraken komen over de beschikbaarheid, integriteit en vertrouwelijkheid van gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over Nagorno-Karabach

MPs from ChristenUnie, CDA, SGP and SP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged deployment of Syrian fighters in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, Azerbaijan's ceasefire violations, possible sanctions, arms embargoes, war crimes allegations and recognition of Karabakh's independence. The minister answered that the government now knows of Turkish involvement, condemned the use of Syrian fighters, said no sanctions are currently under consideration, reaffirmed the OSCE arms embargo with no Dutch exports, and rejected recognition of independence.
Sanctions are not on the agenda at this moment.
Sancties zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Van der Staaij over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MPs Van Helvert, Geurts and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on white farmers, land expropriation without compensation in South Africa's Expropriation Bill, and Brexit implications for trade. The minister said the government has raised land reform concerns bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, that the bill sets limited no-compensation scenarios subject to court or arbitrator review, and that Dutch influence is limited to continued dialogue.
The new bill, the Expropriation Bill, provides for this.
Het nieuwe wetsvoorstel, de «Expropriation Bill», voorziet daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de Circulaire wapens en munitie

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Circulaire Wapens en Munitie 2019, including the omission of traditional-shooting calibres from Annex C8, the minimum age of 18 for introducees, and difficulties the KNTS faces in getting its concerns addressed. The Minister acknowledged the calibre omission and promised correction at the next revision, said the age threshold is in line with the majority age and is being explored for revision with stakeholders without a commitment to change it, and offered a possible site visit when conditions allow.
This will be corrected at the next revision of the Circulaire wapens en munitie.
Dit zal bij een eerstvolgende herziening van de Circulaire wapens en munitie gecorrigeerd worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de geheime Europese Uniemissie (EU) naar Venezuela en het bericht dat de EU Ambassadeur in Venezuela een propagandarapport in ontvangst heeft genomen uit handen

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an EU delegation's late-September 2020 visit to Venezuela and the EU ambassador's receipt of a pro-government propaganda report from Tarek William Saab, a sanctioned official. The minister answered all 18 questions, denying that the mission or the report legitimised the Maduro government, stating that a mission cannot be held to conditions it has not set, and promising to keep the dialogue and human rights pressure going.
No. Both during and after the EU mission it was conveyed that Venezuela does not meet the conditions for holding free and fair elections.
Nee. Zowel tijdens als na de EU-missie is uitgedragen dat Venezuela niet voldoet aan de voorwaarden voor het houden van vrije en eerlijke verkiezingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de inzet van Syrische rebellen door Turkije in de oorlog om Nagorno-Karabach

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey deployed Syrian rebel fighters to support Azerbaijan in the Nagorno-Karabakh war, whether Dutch-supplied non-lethal assistance reached such groups, and what the government would do about it. The minister confirmed Turkish military involvement and condemned external interference, called for an OSCE investigation and EU statements, but declined to say whether Dutch-supported groups were involved, citing traceability, and said recovery of supplied equipment was no longer possible after monitoring ended.
Because of the traceability to the moderate armed groups supported by the Netherlands, publicly it cannot be addressed whether previously Dutch-supported moderate armed groups were involved.

In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen, kan er in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op eventuele betrokkenheid van voorheen door Nederland gesteunde gematigde gewapende groepen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Helvert over het bericht 'emoties lopen hoog op bij huisuitzetting: meerdere politiepatrouilles rukken uit'

MPs Peters and Van Helvert asked about a reported eviction in Geleen over rent arrears, in which several police patrols were deployed, and whether evictions for debt could be prevented. The government confirmed the case, declined to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons, and described measures such as early warning of rent arrears, the amended Municipal Debt Assistance Act from 1 January 2021, and the plan 'Een (t)huis, een toekomst' to prevent evictions.
To protect the privacy of those involved, I cannot go into individual cases.
Om de privacy van de betrokkenen te beschermen, kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht dat China wereldwijd 2,4 miljoen sleutelfiguren volgt

CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that China's Zhenhua Data tracks 2.4 million key figures worldwide, including whether Dutch people are in the database and whether the government will act. The government confirmed it was informed, said Dutch persons with special roles in the democratic order were notified, saw no indications of Chinese security service orders or a link to a social credit system, and pointed to existing resilience measures and telecom security rules.
I have been informed about the database.
Ik ben geïnformeerd over de databank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘VS zet hoofdaanklager Internationaal Strafhof op zwarte lijst’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions placing the ICC chief prosecutor and Court staff on a blacklist, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in the EU to prevent or respond to them. The minister answered that the government repeatedly urged the US not to escalate, is pursuing EU options such as the Anti-Boycott Regulation, and is working with banks to limit the impact on the Court, while stressing the Court must keep functioning.
Over recent months close contact has been maintained with the Court, various banks and our European partners.
Afgelopen maanden is nauw contact onderhouden met het Strafhof, verschillende banken en onze Europese partners.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya Hemani, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about the 2016 abduction of Dutch toddler Insiya Hemani to India, the enforcement of Dutch court rulings on her return, and what is being done to bring her back. The ministers confirmed awareness of the case and court rulings, said the Indian authorities are being pressed via diplomatic notes but that enforcement in India cannot be compelled by the Netherlands and that India's child-custody and immigration matters are for Indian law.
In this case, Dutch court rulings are being presented to the Indian authorities through diplomatic channels so that they can take note of them.
Nederlandse gerechtelijke uitspraken worden in deze zaak langs diplomatieke weg aangeboden aan de Indiase autoriteiten om daar kennis van te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht over de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Legal Protection what steps had been taken after a motion to bring Jaitsen Singh, detained in a US prison for 36 years, to the Netherlands, including whether a transfer request existed, whether the discretionary power should be used to start a transfer procedure, and whether diplomatic pressure for clemency would be pursued. The minister replied that no formal transfer request exists, that the US review is ongoing, that no transfer procedure will be initiated by the Netherlands, and that diplomatic support for a clemency request by Singh himself will be provided if no societal risks are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over dat kermisexploitanten boos zijn over het annuleren van Park Hilaria

CDA MPs asked the minister why municipalities are not granting fair permits after COVID rules allowed small fairs from 1 July 2020, and whether the government will talk with the VNG and fix delayed SBI business-code changes for fairground operators. The state secretary answered that municipalities cite short notice, location safety, financial feasibility and enforcement, that the SBI-code reassessment process for TOGS/TVL has been handled, and that the VNG was already urged to support the sector, without committing to a new meeting.
It falls under the statutory authority of municipalities to grant permits for events, including fairs.
Het valt onder de wettelijke bevoegdheid van de gemeenten om vergunningen voor evenementen, waaronder kermissen, te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de naamswijziging van het Confucius instituut en het samenwerkingscontract Stichting Confucius Instituut Groningen

CDA MPs asked whether the renaming of the Confucius Institute headquarters signals stronger Chinese state control, and whether Dutch Confucius contracts, including that of Groningen, should be made more transparent and reviewed. The minister answered that the renaming appears to be a response to backlash and creates distance from Hanban, that Dutch institutions are autonomous and their contracts non-confidential by default, and that no extra measures are needed now, with a fuller update promised this autumn.
As indicated in the cover letter to this report, I will further inform your House this autumn about the position of the Netherlands vis-à-vis China in the field of education and science.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit rapport, zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de positie van Nederland ten opzichte van China op het terrein van onderwijs en wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Viecurie vreest voor zelfstandigheid'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the cancelled merger between VieCuri and Laurentius hospitals and its consequences for regional acute care, emergency departments, obstetrics, and decision-making. The minister answered that the government leaves the matter to hospitals and insurers, that quality of care must be safeguarded, and described the regional data, stakeholder views and involvement in the decision.
It is for the health insurers to talk with the hospitals to secure continuity and quality of care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om met de ziekenhuizen in gesprek te gaan om de continuïteit en kwaliteit te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Nederland moet ondernemers in het buitenland mogelijk toch TOZO-uitkering geven"

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's view that the Tozo is a special non-contributory benefit requires exporting it to cross-border entrepreneurs, and whether Tozo 2's partner test should be treated differently. The State Secretary answered that the Tozo is a social assistance benefit outside the scope of the coordination regulation, so it cannot be exported, and that cross-border entrepreneurs can use other support measures instead.
The Tozo is a social assistance benefit and cannot be regarded as a special non-contributory benefit.
De Tozo is een bijstandsuitkering en kan niet gezien worden als een bijzondere non-contributieve uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert, Van Dam inzake het bericht ‘Activist Zarza neergestoken in Leeuwarden, familie vermoedt politiek motief’

Three CDA MPs asked whether the stabbing of Iranian activist Sadegh Zarza in Leeuwarden had a political motive, whether Iranian academics should face broader screening, and what steps the government had taken regarding Iranian involvement in liquidations in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service leads the investigation and no substantive statements can be made yet, that screening is limited to sensitive technical research areas under sanctions rules, and that no further action is currently planned.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to lead the criminal investigation into the offence and any possible motive.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om leiding te geven aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar het strafbare feit en het eventuele motief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over de verkoop van Nederlandse MP5’s in een Maltese wapenhandel

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked about Dutch MP5 submachine guns reportedly sold by a Maltese arms dealer, whether the sale involved a batch of 850 ministry weapons, what rules apply to resale, and oversight of onward sales. The state secretary answered that no weapons were sold to that firm, that 850 surplus MP5s went to the Dutch defence supplier TBM, and that Defence has no sight of further resale by the manufacturer or its partners.
Defence does not keep track of further (onward) sales by the manufacturer or an authorised trading partner of the manufacturer.
Defensie houdt geen zicht op de verdere (door-)verkoop door de fabrikant of erkende (handels)partner van de fabrikant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Kuik over de arrestatie en gevangenneming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Niger

MPs Van Helvert and Kuik asked the ministers about the detention of human rights defenders in Niger, including two trade union leaders, and whether Dutch aid to youth employment programmes is hindered as a result. The ministers said they raised the case with Nigerien authorities through several diplomatic channels, will keep following it while respecting judicial independence, and that the detentions are hindering one part of the programme but the Dutch youth employment efforts continue.
The Netherlands will continue to follow this matter closely, with respect for the independent judicial process in Niger.
Nederland blijft deze kwestie nauwlettend volgen, met respect voor de onafhankelijke rechtsgang in Niger.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de betrokkenheid van door Nederland betaalde UAWC-medewerkers bij de terreurorganisatie PFLP en het feit dat zij verdacht worden van een terreuraanslag, waarbij

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the foreign and development ministers what the government knew about Dutch-funded UAWC staff allegedly linked to the PFLP and a 2019 bombing, and about the funding involved. The ministers answered that the staff were paid partly from Dutch project funds, that payments were suspended, that audits were not yet shared due to data protection, and that an external investigation has been commissioned.
Our intention is to share these documents with you as soon as possible.
Onze intentie is om deze documenten zo spoedig mogelijk met u te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiering van UAWC met Nederlands belastinggeld en de overeenkomst tussen Nederland en de UAWC nadat bekend geworden was dat twee hooggeplaatste medewerke

Two CDA MPs asked why Dutch funding to UAWC continued after two former staff were suspected of a terrorist bombing, and about the subsidy agreement's reporting and sanction clauses. The ministers answered that funding was suspended, that no irregularities were formally reported under article 6, that UAWC is not listed as terrorist by the EU, UN or Netherlands, and that an external investigation will be commissioned.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it necessary to commission further external research into UAWC in light of the recent developments.
Het kabinet acht het niettemin noodzakelijk nader extern onderzoek naar UAWC te laten doen op grond van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over foltering en honger in vrouwenkampen in Noord-Korea na gedwongen terugkeer vanuit China

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about torture, starvation and sexual violence against North Korean women repatriated from China, and the UN's 2020 report on this, asking whether it amounts to crimes against humanity and what Netherlands is doing about it, including whether military intervention could be justified without a Security Council mandate. The minister confirmed awareness of the UN report and agreed that crimes against humanity are occurring, noted diplomatic and UN-level efforts, and stated that human rights violations alone do not provide a legal basis for military intervention without Security Council authorisation.

Human rights violations, even if they may be qualified as crimes against humanity, do not under existing international law constitute a legal basis for military intervention without authorisation from the UN Security Council.

Het plegen van mensenrechtenschendingen, ook wanneer deze kunnen worden gekwalificeerd als misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid, vormen onder het bestaande internationaal recht geen rechtsgrond voor militaire interventie zonder autorisatie van de VN-Veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Dam en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Erdogan wil weer bidden in de Hagia Sophia’

CDA MPs asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that Turkey may convert the Hagia Sophia from museum to mosque, what steps it would take, and whether it will lobby UNESCO. The government replied that the building's function is an internal Turkish matter, that the Netherlands with EU partners has urged respect for its symbolic role and free access, and that UNESCO's assessment focuses on preserving universal value rather than the building's function.
The precise function of the Hagia Sophia is an internal matter for Turkey.
De precieze functie van de Hagia Sophia is een interne aangelegenheid van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vuurgevechten en vijandelijkheden aan de Azerbeidzjaans-Armeense grens vanaf 12 juli jl.

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the July 2020 clashes on the Azerbaijan-Armenia border, including whether Armenia's warnings were ignored, what the Netherlands has done to prevent war, and whether it will push for a ceasefire and new talks. The minister answers that the Netherlands monitors the situation through embassies, the OSCE and the EU, backed an EU statement calling for an immediate halt to hostilities, and says the OSCE Minsk Group remains the primary negotiating format.
The cabinet closely monitors developments in the region.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in de regio nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Gommers ziet geen verschil tussen Efteling en kermis: 'Virus niet verspreiden''

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether the NVIC chair's view that fairground visits should be possible under good plans is considered, whether fairground operators' continuity and field labs were addressed, and when clarity would be given. The minister replied that the relaxations announced on 24 June give perspective, that 1.5 metre distancing applies with no maximum headcount including fairs, that the sector will run a field lab and results will be reported to parliament, and that the June relaxations give clarity.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het sluiten van het consulaat in Nador

CDA MPs asked why the Netherlands is moving visa application services from Nador to Tanger, and whether the Nador honorary consulate is closing. The minister answered that the honorary consulate stays open and only the external visa service provider's office moves, to speed up and improve visa processing, a decision already final though paused by COVID-19.
The honorary consulate remains open and the current tasks of the consulate do not change.
Het honorair consulaat in Nador blijft geopend en de huidige taken van het consulaat veranderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over inzake de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked about delays in the entry into force of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij against piracy, the date, consultation with the maritime sector, a task force, the 48-hour response period for the Coast Guard, and including the Gulf of Guinea. Minister Grapperhaus replied that entry into force is now expected by 1 January 2022 at the latest, that existing coordination is sufficient without a new task force, and that the Gulf of Guinea could be explored while noting that naval protection under the VPD-first principle would be needed.

Based on current insights and taking into account the fixed dates for entry into force of legislation (1 January or 1 July), the cabinet assumes that the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij will enter into force by 1 January 2022 at the latest.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten en rekening houdend met de vaste data van inwerkingtreding van wet- en regelgeving (1 januari, dan wel 1 juli), gaat het kabinet er vanuit dat inwerkingtreding van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij uiterlijk per 1 januari 2022 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeente verleent vergunning voor Frans Klooster/Walram Site’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Sittard-Geleen's permit for a Confucius Institute annex, and concerns about Chinese influence, warranted stricter policy. The minister answered that the municipality decides autonomously, that government is monitoring Chinese influence via a knowledge network and ongoing research, and that it would discuss arrangements with institutions if the research shows a need.
That is the responsibility and free choice of the municipality.
Dat is de verantwoordelijkheid en de vrije keuze van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Situation Analysis on Children and Adolescents on Sint Maarten 2020'

MPs Van Dam and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about the 2020 UNICEF situation analysis on children's rights on Sint Maarten, including early childhood care, foster care, and responsibility for child rights. The State Secretary answered that Sint Maarten is autonomous and primarily responsible, describing the shortfalls, joint Kingdom task force work, and a UNICEF-led project funded from a trust fund.
As an autonomous country, the government of Sint Maarten is responsible for the welfare of the population, including children and young people.
Als autonoom land is de regering van Sint Maarten verantwoordelijk voor het welzijn van de bevolking, inclusief kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pandemie zal opmars China niet stuiten, maar juist versnellen’

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Van Helvert asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the COVID-19 crisis would accelerate China's geopolitical expansion in Europe and the Netherlands, and what measures the government would take, including on investment screening and a possible revision of the China strategy. The government replied that it sees no concrete indications of China acting differently than normal, pointed to the FDI screening regulation and planned investment-screening legislation (including a retroactive reference date of 2 June 2020), and said the China strategy's basic approach still holds.
The development of the legislation follows a critical timeline. Introducing the law on an accelerated basis is not desirable.
De totstandkoming van de wet- en regelgeving volgt een kritiek tijdspad. De wet versneld invoeren is niet wenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Digitalisering aan de grens; Cybersecurity van het grenstoezicht door de Koninklijke Marechaussee op Schiphol'

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the Court of Audit report on cybersecurity of border control systems at Schiphol run by the Royal Marechaussee, including data ownership, transfer of the self-service system to Schiphol N.V., security approval, testing frequency and monitoring. The government answered in detail, acknowledging delays in approval and resource limits, while withholding some test results as classified and promising further measures on protecting vital infrastructure.
The research results of the counter system are classified and therefore cannot be shared.
De onderzoeksresultaten van het baliesysteem zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen daarom niet gedeeld worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en van Helvert over de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea n.a.v. de excommunicatie van patriarch Antonios van de Eritrees-Orthodoxe Tewahedo-Kerk en de gedwongen s

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Eritrea, including the detention of Patriarch Antonios and other religious figures, the forced closure of Catholic clinics, and interference by Eritrean authorities in religious life among the diaspora in the Netherlands.
