The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, has taken diplomatic steps against interference, but that Eritrea shows little sensitivity to pressure and the available instruments are limited.

The Netherlands consistently speaks out about the worrying human rights situation in Eritrea and calls on the country to respect human rights and cooperate with the Special Rapporteur on the human rights situation in Eritrea.

Nederland spreekt zich voortdurend uit over de zorgwekkende mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea en roept het land op om de mensenrechten te respecteren en om samen te werken met de Speciaal Rapporteur voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over de leefbaarheid rondom AWACS-basis Geilenkirchen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about noise nuisance from AWACS flights at Geilenkirchen, including the promised livability fund, flight timing, flight statistics and quieter engines. The State Secretary answered that noise is declining and flight counts have halved since 2004, that a livability fund is still under discussion with the region and will be revisited after COVID-19 measures are lifted, and that engine replacement is not pursued because the business case has weakened.
I will also send these to you.
Ik zal u deze ook doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vernieling van graven van christenen in Turkije

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the desecration of Christian graves in Turkey, whether this reflects a rising trend of pressure on Christians, who spreads hate speech, whether Turkish school books label missionary activity a national threat, and whether Turkey effectively prosecutes grave desecration. The minister answered that Turkish authorities prosecute such acts, that the cemetery is being restored and guarded, that reports show no clear increase in pressure on Christians, and that the Dutch government raises minority concerns with its Turkish counterpart.
I also do that in my conversations with my Turkish counterpart.
Ook ik doe dat in mijn gesprekken met mijn Turkse ambtsgenoot.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de Beleidsregels exploitatievergunning speelautomatenhallen Heerlen 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why Heerlen allocates speelautomatenhal licences by lottery rather than by merit on player protection and crime prevention. The minister replied that municipalities may choose any allocation method that respects formal equality, that Heerlen's lottery is followed by a substantive assessment of each drawn application, and that it is for the municipality to decide.
Within the limits of laws and regulations, municipalities are free to determine how they shape the granting of licences.
Binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving zijn gemeenten vrij om te bepalen hoe zij de verlening van vergunningen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over de uitzending ‘WNL op Zaterdag‘ d.d. 7 maart 2020

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert (CDA) asked whether the government is doing enough to collect testimony from Yazidi women and others who suffered under ISIS, so it can be used as evidence in prosecutions. The government answered that it supports NGOs and UN and IIIM mechanisms that collect evidence, stresses victim choice and careful interviewing, and says it is funding Yazda, UNITAD and other programmes, without committing to a new concrete step.
The Netherlands is concretely committed to actively reaching the Yazidi community through, among other things, the support mentioned above for Yazda, UNITAD and the IIIM.
Nederland zet concreet in op het actief benaderen van de Jezidi-gemeenschap door onder meer bovengenoemde steun aan Yazda, UNITAD en het IIIM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het Coronafonds van de Europese Commissie en over het Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)-initiatief van de G20

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the EU coronavirus investment initiative (CRII) allocations per member state, why Poland and Hungary receive large sums while the Netherlands receives very little, and about EU vaccine production and CEPI participation. The ministers answered that the CRII redistributes remaining cohesion funds based mainly on economic prosperity and implementation progress, not on COVID-19 impact, and that the government views CEPI positively and will consider a contribution, with information to follow in the weekly Corona letter.
The size of the available CRII budget per member state is therefore independent of the scale of the COVID-19 crisis in that member state.
De omvang van het beschikbare CRII-budget per lidstaat staat dus los van de omvang van de COVID-19-crisis in de betreffende lidstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bezoek van de minister aan Zuid-Afrika

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister about his February 2020 visit to South Africa, including human rights, the planned expropriation of land without compensation, the cancelled bilateral investment treaty, and the Afrikaans language. The minister answers that he pressed for fair compensation and a clear reform timeline, that no new investment treaty is currently possible, and that language policy is a matter for South Africa with support channelled via the Dutch Language Union.
I used this visit to discuss this broad cooperation agenda with my counterpart.
Ik heb dit bezoek gebruikt om over deze brede samenwerkingsagenda te overleggen met mijn counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Turkije Syrische rebellen inzet in de strijd in Libië

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey deployed Syrian rebels, including former ISIS and Al Qaeda fighters, to Libya, and about alleged war crimes by Turkish-backed groups, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and address it in the EU and NATO. The minister answered that it is unclear which groups are involved, that the Netherlands condemns foreign interference and urges full implementation of the Berlin agreements and the arms embargo, and that the Non-lethal assistance programme ended in 2018 so the status of delivered goods is hard to trace.
It is currently unclear which fighters or groups are involved, what their background is, and how or by whom they would have been recruited and deployed.
Het is op dit moment onduidelijk om welke strijders of groepen het gaat, wat hun achtergrond is en op welke wijze of door wie zij geworven en ingezet zouden worden.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitbraak van het coronavirus.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the coronavirus outbreak, including its infectiousness during incubation, passenger tracing from the Westerdam, EU coordination, travel restrictions and travel advice. The minister answered that transmission during incubation plays a very limited role per RIVM, that EU coordination runs through ECDC and the HSC, and that WHO and ECDC advise against trade or travel restrictions.
Based on the scientific knowledge of the RIVM, we assume that the new coronavirus is transmitted through coughing and sneezing.
Op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis van het RIVM nemen wij aan dat het nieuwe coronavirus wordt overgedragen door hoesten en niezen.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de passagiers op het schip Westerdam

MPs Kuik, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about passengers stranded on the cruise ship Westerdam in Cambodia, their information, repatriation, passenger lists, and the RIVM's earlier claim that people are only contagious once symptomatic. The minister answered that most questions were addressed in an earlier letter, that about 30 Dutch nationals have returned, that returnees are monitored by the GGD, and that current RIVM knowledge supports the incubation and transmission figures, while acknowledging the contagiousness statement as based on current evidence.
Answer 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 These questions I have already answered in the letter to the House of 17 February.
Antwoord 2, 3, 4, 5 en 7 Deze vragen heb ik reeds beantwoord in de Kamerbrief van 17 februari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about noise nuisance from the A79 at Valkenburg aan de Geul, including responsibility of Rijkswaterstaat, delays in the resurfacing and MJPG noise measures, and consultation with residents. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible, that resurfacing is planned for 2021 with no further delay expected, and that noise measures remain in MJPG phase two, though some questions were answered only partly or in general terms.
I do not expect any further delay for these works.
Ik verwacht geen verder uitstel voor deze werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Aantal ontvoeringen in West-Afrikaanse Golf van Guinee groeit hard’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about rising kidnappings and piracy in the Gulf of Guinea and why the Merchant Shipping Protection Act, passed in 2019, has not yet entered into force. The minister explained the delay (implementing regulations, consultation, and a small statutory amendment needed) and said he aims for entry into force in 2021.
I aim for the act (including the amending act) and the underlying subordinate regulations to enter into force as soon as possible in 2021.
Ik streef naar inwerkingtreding van de wet (inclusief de Wijzigingswet) en de onderliggende lagere regelgeving zo spoedig mogelijk in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over De veroordeling van de Chinese voorganger Wang Yi

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the criminal convictions of Chinese church leaders Wang Yi and Qin Defu, the implications of China's 2018 religion law, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed Dutch concern, described an embassy statement and EU-level advocacy, and promised to raise Qin Defu's case through regular dialogues and to pass on concerns about the religion law.
The cabinet is also willing to raise the case of Qin Defu with the Chinese government through the regular dialogues with the Chinese authorities.
Het kabinet is tevens bereid om de zaak van Qin Defu aan te kaarten bij de Chinese overheid via de reguliere dialogen met de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Voordewind over het bijwonen van de herdenking in  Armenië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister which minister would attend the April 2020 Armenian genocide commemoration in line with a motion, whether he would visit the Tsitsernakaperd monument and lay a wreath, and how he would raise the genocide with Armenia. The minister confirmed he visited Yerevan and laid a wreath, but said the attending minister for April would be announced later.

That is still being discussed. As also mentioned during the 2019 foreign affairs budget debate, the House will be informed in advance of the commemoration about who will attend on behalf of the Netherlands.

Daarover wordt nog gesproken. Zoals ook gemeld tijdens de BZ Begrotingsbehandeling voor 2019, zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan de herdenking worden geïnformeerd wie namens Nederland aanwezig zal zijn bij deze herdenking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat een Chinese geneticus van het Erasmus MC werkt voor de Chinese politie

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about reports that a Chinese geneticist at Erasmus MC worked for the Chinese police, and what the government had done in response, including contacts with China, funding, screening of Chinese researchers and university awareness. The minister answered that the disputed face-shape research was separate from the Rotterdam height study, was not funded by Erasmus MC or the EU, that the Chinese embassy was warned about misuse of knowledge, and that the cabinet is examining broader knowledge-security measures.

I cannot give detailed statements on what information is or is not known to the intelligence and security services, because this would reveal the current knowledge level, modus operandi and/or sources of the services.

Ik kan geen gedetailleerde uitspraken doen over welke informatie al dan niet bekend is bij de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten omdat dit inzicht geeft in het actuele kennisniveau, de modus operandi en/of bronnen van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het zorginnovatieproject ‘Meer tijd voor de patiënt’ in Afferden

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care why insurer VGZ is not expanding the successful 'More time for the patient' pilot in Afferden, its cost savings, and whether the NZa monitors shifting care to Maasziekenhuis Pantein in Boxmeer. The Minister says VGZ will continue the pilot in four practices in 2020 with possible expansion later, that savings are not yet realised, and that regional data and NZa monitoring results are not yet available.
I do not yet have insight into the outcomes of the NZa monitor.
Ik heb nog geen zicht op de uitkomsten van de monitor van de NZa.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Helvert over de kranslegging op het oorlogskerkhof te Margaten

MPs Krol and Van Helvert asked why wreaths of balsam fir from the United States may stay on war graves in Margraten only 72 hours, and whether this could be changed given the tradition's importance to families. The Minister answered that the short period reflects EU plant health rules and pest risks, that the permit was granted exceptionally, and that a new risk analysis would be needed for any future request, while offering talks on alternatives.
If desired, I am happy to discuss with the initiators how we can meet the wishes regarding American wreath-laying traditions in an alternative way.
Desgewenst ga ik graag in gesprek met de initiatiefnemers hoe we op alternatieve wijze aan de wensen rond Amerikaanse kransleggingstradities tegemoet kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de OPCW Douma-documenten op Wikileaks

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether leaked OPCW Douma documents were authentic, whether the final Douma report was sound, and whether an inquiry into its preparation was warranted. The minister replied that the OPCW has launched an independent investigation into the leaks, that he sees no reason to doubt the report's process or conclusions, and that no separate inquiry is needed.
No. As I indicated above, I find the OPCW's explanation convincing and appreciate the organisation's own handling of this matter.
Nee. Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, vind ik de uitleg van de OPCW overtuigend en apprecieer ik de aanpak van deze kwestie door de organisatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de Zembla-uitzending ‘Doelwit Volkel’

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapons at Volkel, whether the Dutch pilots must follow a US order, and whether the government will confirm the presence of nuclear weapons. The ministers answered that NATO decisions require unanimity and Dutch consent, but that numbers, locations and procedures cannot be disclosed for security and binding alliance reasons, and that efforts to increase transparency have gained no support.

On the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht 'Weer gedoe bij kleding defensie’

An MP asks the state secretary for Defence about reported shortages of winter jackets, uniforms and other clothing and equipment, soldiers buying items themselves, and whether budgets were exceeded. The government acknowledges shortages and delivery problems, describes ongoing projects and interim measures, but gives no guarantee and no firm timeline.
To ensure timely delivery, measures are being taken to make better use of framework contracts, apply existing emergency procedures in time, and improve planning and management of demand and supply.

Om te zorgen voor een tijdige levering zijn en worden er maatregelen genomen om beter gebruik te maken van raamcontracten, bestaande noodprocedures tijdig toe te passen en de planning en het beheer van vraag en aanbod te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht 'België houdt grens dicht voor directeur Confucius-instituut'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government was informed that Chinese professor Xinning Song was barred from Belgium and the Schengen area, and about screening, Chinese intelligence obligations and Confucius Institutes in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Belgium did not actively inform the Netherlands, that no security screening applies to Confucius Institute staff, that Chinese law cannot be ruled out as requiring cooperation with intelligence services, and that knowledge-security measures and a broader study are underway.
When relevant developments arise on this, I will inform the House further.
Bij relevante ontwikkelingen hieromtrent zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de Iraakse weigering om IS-strijders uit Syrië te berechten

MP Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about Iraq's reluctance to try European IS fighters and the status of a proposed tribunal. The minister answered that Iraq now only wants to prosecute crimes against Iraqi interests, that talks with Iraq and European partners continue, and that evidence-securing mechanisms are supported.
The Netherlands will continue to advocate for trials in the region according to international standards for crimes committed by all parties to the conflict.
Nederland blijft zich sterk maken voor berechting in de regio naar internationale standaarden van misdrijven gepleegd door alle partijen bij het conflict.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de zaak van klokkenluider Victor van Wulfen en een arts van Defensie die een consult en ziektebeeld verzon, opschreef in zijn medische dossier en daarvoor beris

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why a Defence doctor who recorded a non-existent consultation and diagnosis in a whistleblower's file was only publicly reprimanded, and whether the Inspectorate's findings and document access were adequate. The State Secretary answered that the disciplinary ruling is noted, declined to comment further while appeal was possible, rejected independent re-investigation and found no evidence of fraud, but gave limited reasons for withholding some documents from the complainant.
I do not consider it opportune to go further into the ruling of the Regional Disciplinary Board, partly because the period for appeal is still running.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om nader in te gaan op uitspraak van het Regionaal Tuchtcollege, mede omdat de termijn om daartegen beroep in te stellen nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over de vertraging van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Frisokazerne in Assen

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked why the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen is delayed by a year, despite earlier promises of operation in summer, and what is being done about food safety and meal quality. The state secretary acknowledges the one-year delay, explains it by a switch to a new interim kitchen location after the old building proved unfit, and states the kitchen is expected in the second half of 2020 while meals are supplied from elsewhere.
Is it correct that the placement of the emergency kitchen at the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen has been delayed by one year?
Klopt het dat de plaatsing van de noodkeuken op de Johan Willem Friso kazerne in Assen met een jaar vertraagd is?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het intrekken van paspoorten Syriëgangers en beleid Buitenlandse Zaken inzake ‘gematigde’ rebellen

Three CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about passport and citizenship revocations for Syria fighters and the government's stance on 'moderate' rebel groups supported under the Dutch Non-Lethal Assistance programme, including why Ahrar al-Sham is not on Dutch terrorism lists. The ministers answered largely by referring to legal frameworks, declining to comment on individual cases, and explaining that the listing criteria for the national-security list and the national sanctions list were not met.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Van Helvert (CDA) over de in Amerika opgepakte Nederlandse Youtubers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether contact had been made with US authorities and the detained Dutch YouTubers, what steps would be taken to bring them home quickly, and for an update. The minister confirmed contact with US police and family and the detainees, said the Netherlands cannot interfere in foreign legal proceedings, and reported that the men were released on bail and returned to the Netherlands.
As you know, the Netherlands cannot interfere in the legal proceedings of another country.
Nederland kan zich zoals u bekend niet mengen in de rechtsgang van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het uitvoeren van de motie Van Helvert c.s. inzake het bijeen roepen van de NAVO-raad

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister why he would not convene the NATO Council under Article 4 over the release of ISIS detainees in northeast Syria after the Turkish invasion, and what the Netherlands was doing to contain the threat. The minister answered that Article 4 is only appropriate if a NATO member is directly threatened, that the issue would be raised at the NATO North Atlantic Council on 15 October and in the anti-ISIS coalition, and that the Netherlands would condemn the Turkish operation and call for its halt.
Invoking Article 4 of the NATO treaty is only opportune if the territorial integrity, political independence or security of one of the NATO member states is directly threatened.
Inroeping van artikel 4 van het NAVO-verdrag is pas opportuun indien de territoriale integriteit, politieke onafhankelijkheid of de veiligheid van een van de NAVO-lidstaten direct wordt bedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'We’re Indians too' van organisatie Open Doors inzake geweld, uitsluiting en geloofsvervolging van christelijke en moslimminderhe

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on violence and exclusion of Christian and Muslim minorities in India, including whether the government would raise anti-conversion laws, Dalit classification, and religious freedom with India at bilateral, EU and UN level. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom in human rights dialogues and UN forums, and plans to ask the new Special Envoy for freedom of religion to visit India, while declining to speculate on post-election developments.

I also intend to ask the recently appointed Special Envoy for freedom of religion and belief to travel to India to speak with the government and civil society organisations about freedom of religion and belief.

Ook ben ik voornemens om de onlangs aangestelde Speciaal Gezant religie en levensovertuiging te vragen naar India te gaan om daar met overheid en maatschappelijke organisaties te spreken over vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het economische deel van het Israëlisch-Palestijnse vredesplan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a US-organised economic conference in Bahrain on the economic part of the Israeli-Palestinian peace plan, its participants, Dutch and EU contributions, and barriers to Palestinian economic growth. The government answered that it attended at senior civil-servant level, outlined EU and Dutch aid and World Bank growth estimates, and called for a two-state solution and donor involvement, while noting the US plan lacked attention to occupation's effects.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this and keep seeking dialogue in other forums such as the Ad Hoc Liaison Committee.
Nederland zal daar op aan blijven dringen en de dialoog blijven zoeken in andere fora zoals de Ad Hoc Liaison Committee
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs from CDA, D66 and SP asked whether Dutch detainees abroad can receive legal aid from the Netherlands, how subsidies for detainee support were distributed, and whether DutchAdvocates refuses or redirects cases and pressures former PrisonLAW clients. The minister replied that legal aid is primarily the detainee's own responsibility with local lawyers, that subsidy was transferred to DutchAdvocates from 2019 with PrisonLAW's agreement, that clients are free to choose their lawyer, and that no misconduct exists.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘RIVM scherpt vaccinatieadvies mazelen aan’

MPs Raemakers, Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked about RIVM's measles vaccination advice for infants travelling to high-risk countries and whether the Foreign Ministry should adjust its travel advice accordingly. The minister answered that the advice is updated annually based on WHO data, and that the Foreign Ministry defers health information to the national travel health centre (LCR) by linking to it rather than copying the measles guidance, while examining automatic integration.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is examining whether it is possible to automatically load the LCR information into the BZ Travel App.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken onderzoekt wel of het mogelijk is om de informatie van de LCR automatisch in de BZ Reisapp in te laden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een Brits rapport inzake geloofsvervolging waarin grote zorgen worden geuit over de wereldwijde christenvervolging

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about a British interim report on Christian persecution that said persecution in some regions approaches the UN definition of genocide, and asked what Dutch action would follow. The minister responded that the Netherlands shares concern, cites its existing human rights commitments, the planned Special Envoy and an international conference in November 2019, and that sanctions and genocide-prevention obligations are available instruments without committing to new specific measures.
The cabinet is committed, and will remain committed, to upholding the Universal Declaration, including article 18.
Nederland zet zich in, en zal zich blijven inzetten, voor naleving van de Universele Verklaring, met inbegrip van artikel 18.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van Helvert over het statement gemaakt door de (werkgroep Legal Affairs en Human Rights van de) Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Council of Europe PACE working group statement on prosecutions facing Laura Codruța Kövesi, a candidate for European Public Prosecutor, and whether the government would seek clarification from Romania and condemn it. The minister replied that the government greatly values her anti-corruption work and wants all candidates treated fairly, that it is closely following the case, and that the Romanian courts must first rule on the cases.
However, it is first and foremost for the Romanian judge to rule on the cases brought against Ms Kövesi.
Het is nu echter allereerst aan de Roemeense rechter om zich uit te spreken over de zaken die zijn aangespannen tegen mevrouw Kövesi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over rijnvarenden, die grote persoonlijke naheffingen ontvingen van de Nederlandse belastingdienst voor sociale premies, die zij ook al in Luxemburg betaald hebben

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked why Rhine boatmen face large Dutch social premium back-assessments already paid in Luxembourg, and what steps the authorities took to recover the debt from former employers and ensure only one country collects premiums. The government answered that the tax authority cannot pursue employers for individual income-tax debts, that refund claims lie with Luxembourg authorities under its law, that it will raise the issue with Luxembourg, and that payment arrangements are available, but gave no clear timeline for resolving the double premium problem.

Although the Netherlands is not a party to these requests, I will, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, actively and promptly raise the signals with the Luxembourg authorities.

Hoewel Nederland geen partij is bij deze verzoeken, zal ik met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, die verantwoordelijk is voor de vaststelling van de verzekeringsplicht, de signalen hierover actief en op korte termijn bij de Luxemburgse autoriteiten onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bombardementen van Turkije op christenen in Irak

MPs Van Helvert, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about reported Turkish airstrikes forcing Christian villagers in northern Iraq to flee, and about civilian casualties and compliance with international humanitarian law. The minister said the reports could not be verified, attributed the strikes to Turkey's campaign against the PKK, denied any targeting of religious minorities, and called on Turkey to exercise restraint and proportionality.
The cabinet has no precise information about the exact times and precise locations of these bombings.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de exacte tijd en precieze locaties van deze bombardementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over verschillende reisadviezen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether EU member states issue differing travel advice for the same countries, whether a single European travel advice is desirable, and what Netherlands has done to harmonise. The minister agrees a single European advice is desirable and says the main obstacles are national competence, differing formats and procedures, and timing, while describing consular cooperation efforts and promising continued advocacy.
I am willing to keep emphasising the importance of unified travel advice within the EU.
Ik ben bereid het belang van eensgezinde reisadviezen verder te blijven benadrukken binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over het bericht dat de VS Turkije uit F-35 programma dreigen te gooien om Russische raketten

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked whether the US halting F-35 equipment deliveries to Turkey over its planned purchase of Russian S-400 air defence systems is accurate, whether Nederland agrees with the US reasoning, and whether Dutch industry could take over Turkish F-35 work. The government confirmed the US decision, shared US concerns, said it has raised them bilaterally and in NATO, and declined to speculate on further steps while Turkey remains a partner.
At this stage it is undesirable to speculate openly about possible follow-up steps in the programme.
Het is onwenselijk om in dit stadium openlijk te speculeren over mogelijke vervolgstappen in het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de militaire oefening van Turkije en Rusland op de Zwarte Zee

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a Turkish and Russian naval exercise in the Black Sea and whether it was an alliance-worthy act given NATO tensions with Russia, the S-400 dispute and the Kerch Strait incident. The minister said Turkey held a national exercise, that two Turkish ships made a port visit to Novorossiysk without confirmed joint drills, that the Kabinet is open to raising the matter with Turkey and deepening NATO Black Sea cooperation, but did not condemn Turkey's rapprochement with Russia.
The cabinet is willing to make inquiries with Turkey about this.
Het kabinet is bereid hierover bij Turkije navraag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over de berechting van Syriëgangers

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked why the Ministry of Foreign Affairs classifies some Syrian armed groups as moderate while the public prosecutor treats some as terrorist, and whether the government would align its classifications and share information to prevent lenient sentences. The minister answered that prosecutors make their own assessments, that the ministry relies on EU and UN terrorist listings, that NLA support does not rule out prosecution, and that information will be shared case by case on request.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will where possible share information with the Public Prosecution Service to promote the course of justice.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal waar mogelijk informatie delen met het Openbaar Ministerie om de rechtsgang te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de belemmerde vervolging van Syriëgangers

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether Dutch jihadist fighters in Syria could cite Dutch non-lethal assistance (NLA) to armed groups in their defence, and whether the Public Prosecution Service had been informed about which groups received NLA. The minister replied that such use is not known, that information on two specific groups was shared with the prosecutor only for a pending case, and that prosecution decisions are independent of NLA support.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no general statements about fighting groups.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen algemene uitspraken over strijdende groeperingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de advocaat van de Asia Bibi, de heer Saif ul-Malook, nu hij teruggekeerd is naar Pakistan om haar zaak te verdedigen

MPs asked whether the Minister would nominate lawyer Saif ul-Malook for the Human Rights Tulip, offer him protection when threats recur, confirm the validity of his Schengen visa, and say how the Netherlands could help his safety in Pakistan. The Minister said the Tulip nomination process is independent, declined to pre-empt any new protection request, would not confirm visa validity, and noted Pakistani authorities are responsible for his safety.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the validity of individuals' Schengen visas, partly because it is not authorised to share this personal data.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de geldigheid van het Schengenvisum van individuen, mede omdat het kabinet niet gemachtigd is deze persoonsgegevens te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de minderjarige Nederlandse jongen Charly die in Spanje gedetineerd is en prisonlaw

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch detainees are not actively told about PrisonLAW, whether a minor is held unsafely in Spain, and why Kaderbesluit 829 was raised late, and about the pressure on PrisonLAW and the ministry's contacts with it. The minister answered that PrisonLAW is mentioned in a brochure but not actively offered, that the Spanish facility is judged safe, that KB 829 was raised from September 2018 and formally in December, and declined to give case details or precise contact counts citing privacy and ongoing proceedings.
For reasons of personal data protection and because the legal proceedings are still ongoing, I cannot provide the House with further judicial details about this individual case in this public letter.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming en omdat de rechtsgang nog loopt, kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen nadere justitiële gegevens over deze individuele zaak verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse jongen die in Spanje gedetineerd is

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Dutch youth Charly T. in Spain, including whether consular procedures were followed, why no trust lawyer was appointed, and whether the ministry pressed Spanish authorities. The minister answered that the ministry uses consular and subsidised legal-advice instruments, is actively following the case without ordering a trust-lawyer review yet, did not steer the family to another legal aid provider, and will continue its efforts.

Because the legal proceedings are still in the initial phase and the public prosecutor, the defence and the judge still have to play their roles to a significant extent, there is currently no reason or scope to use the instrument of examining the proceedings through a trust lawyer.

Omdat de rechtsgang zich nog in de initiële fase bevindt en de Officier van Justitie, de verdediging en de rechter hun rollen in de rechtsgang nog in belangrijke mate moeten vervullen, is er thans geen aanleiding en ruimte voor het inzetten van het instrument van onderzoek naar de gevolgde rechtsgang door een vertrouwensadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het gebruik van pepperspray in het Turkse consulaat in Rotterdam en het feit dat niemand daarvoor vervolgd wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why no one was prosecuted after a Turkish consulate staff member used pepperspray in Rotterdam, and about the immunity and diplomatic-prosecution arrangements involved. The minister answered that the person had functional immunity, that Turkey withdrew him, that no prosecution of others was possible because no other offences were known, and described the prosecution working arrangements and the planned notification system.

When requesting a lifting of immunity, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs immediately makes clear to the country concerned that no answer or a refusal to lift immunity will very likely lead to a request for the person's withdrawal.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt bij een eventueel verzoek om opheffing van immuniteit meteen duidelijk aan het land in kwestie dat geen antwoord of een weigering om de immuniteit op te heffen zeer waarschijnlijk zal leiden tot een verzoek om terugtrekking van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de ranglijst christenvervolging 2019 uitgebracht door 'Open Doors'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2019 Open Doors ranking of Christian persecution, its trend, and Dutch responses in Iraq, China, India and Algeria, plus the Asia Bibi case and the planned special envoy for freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concern about rising persecution, described ongoing bilateral and EU diplomacy, and said the special envoy would start work as soon as possible.
The Netherlands continues to work for freedom of religion and belief bilaterally and through various multilateral fora and will intensify this effort in the coming years.
Nederland blijft zich zowel bilateraal als via de diverse multilaterale fora inzetten voor de vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging en zal deze inzet in de komende jaren intensiveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Voordewind over mogelijke staatsgeheimen die gepubliceerd zijn in WOB-stukken over Non Lethal Assistance aan Syrische ‘rebellen’

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked whether state secrets were published in FOIA documents on Non Lethal Assistance to Syrian rebel groups, and what the penalties and actions are. The minister admits some names were wrongly left unredacted, says the government will not publicly name supported groups for security and alliance reasons, reports a data-leak investigation, and offers Parliament renewed confidential access to the documents.
The cabinet nevertheless maintains the principle that no public statements are made about groups that received support under the Non Lethal Assistance (NLA) programme.
Het kabinet blijft evenwel bij het uitgangspunt dat er geen openbare uitspraken gedaan worden over groepen die steun ontvingen in het kader van het Non Lethal Assistance (NLA)-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de 17-jarige Charly T. die al meer dan 4 maanden in voorarrest in Spanje zit

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about a 17-year-old Dutch national held on remand in Spain for over four months, including consular visits, support, and possible transfer to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the embassy has visited and supports him, has contacted Spanish authorities about alternative measures, and that the Dutch prosecutor is willing to cooperate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Helvert over de ontwikkeling dat Zuid-Afrika in sneltreinvaart aankoerst op landonteigening

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that South Africa is rushing towards land expropriation without compensation, and about the constitutional amendment, Namibia, the EU summit and the risks to Dutch farmers. The minister answered that the government raises concerns bilaterally and in the EU, notes that the constitution already permits such expropriation under review, and says it will wait for South Africa's measures and does not consider an external legal advisor necessary.
It is therefore practically impossible to carry out such an investigation.
Het is daardoor praktisch onmogelijk om een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bedreiging, onderdrukking en roof van christenen in Irak

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of militia intimidation of Christians in Iraq, illegal seizure of their homes, the Shia militias' status, and whether Dutch pressure and UN investigation were planned. The minister said the Bartella incident was a wedding celebration rather than religious restriction, acknowledged property seizures, and said the government raises minority rights with Iraqi authorities but sees no reason for a separate UN inquiry.
The cabinet sees no reason to additionally start a UN investigation into the alleged oppression, threats and persecution of vulnerable minorities in Iraq.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om hiernaast nog een VN onderzoek te starten naar de vermeende onderdrukking, bedreiging en vervolging van kwetsbare minderheden in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeerplaatsen bij het belastingkantoor in Maastricht

CDA MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked why the Tax Office in Maastricht does not open its car park to the public outside office hours and whether they would seek a solution with stakeholders. State Secretary Knops answered that security, safety and vandalism concerns, plus a higher FIOD security regime, mean the Tax Office will not admit third parties, while the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and Tax Office will study shared use of space at other sites.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Tax Office will jointly examine the possibility of multiple use of space and map what is feasible at locations where the Tax Office is the user.

Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf en de Belastingdienst zullen samen de mogelijkheid tot meervoudig ruimtegebruik onderzoeken en in beeld brengen wat er mogelijk is bij locaties waar de Belastingdienst de gebruiker is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over internet langs de grens in Schinveld

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked why residents of Schinveld lost internet access despite permits, and whether a cross-border solution would be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the government did not cut any existing connection, explained the wiretap and 112 conditions for a new network, and said talks with Agentschap Telecom and residents are ongoing with a progress update promised.
However, there has been no question of the government cutting the existing internet connection, nor any intention to do so.
Van het verbreken van de (bestaande) verbinding met internet door de Nederlandse overheid is echter geen sprake geweest, evenmin van een intentie daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Sjoerdsma over het akkoord met Venezuela

MPs Van Helvert and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands' border agreement with Venezuela, signed with Vice-President El Aissami despite planned EU sanctions against him, was properly prepared and justified given alleged human rights abuses. The minister answered that the agreement was in the Kingdom's interest, that Venezuela's signatory was Vice-President Soteldo, that the EU sanctions process was separate, and declined to link the agreement to the sanctions or to human rights concerns.
The agreement was in the interest of the Kingdom.
Het akkoord was in het belang van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat PrisonLaw breekt met Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked the Foreign Minister about PrisonLaw's decision to end its subsidy relationship, alleged pressure on the organisation over publicity, and consular assistance shortcomings for detainees abroad. The minister denied the portrayal, said the ministry and PrisonLaw are negotiating an orderly early termination, and largely referred to earlier letters while declining to share the internal integrity investigation in detail.
Because of the legal requirements on personal data protection, the investigation and handling of the complaint are confidential.
Vanwege de wettelijke eisen die worden gesteld aan persoonsgegevensbescherming zijn het onderzoek en de afhandeling van de klacht vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Koopmans over de situatie van Asia Bibi nu zij is vrijgesproken van godslastering door het Pakistaanse Hof

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Asia Bibi after her acquittal by Pakistan's Supreme Court, including efforts to secure her release, safe exit for her and her family, and protection for Christians in Pakistan. The minister answered that a review petition is pending under Pakistani procedure, that the Netherlands is pursuing quiet diplomacy with allies, offered the lawyer and family a place in the Shelter City programme, and will raise minority protection at the Foreign Affairs Council.
To the lawyer of Asia Bibi, as well as his wife and child, the cabinet has offered a place in the Shelter City programme.
Aan de advocaat van Asia Bibi, alsmede zijn echtgenote en kind, heeft het kabinet een plek in het Shelter City-programma aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de sluiting van Aramese scholen door de Koerdische YPG in Noordoost-Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that the YPG had closed Christian schools in north-east Syria, how he assessed this, what contacts the government has with the YPG, and what steps it would take on the risk of ethnic cleansing and a ceasefire. Minister Blok answered that the government finds the reports worrying, will raise them informally with the Benelux representation of the PYD/YPG, and that contacts are sporadic; on ceasefire efforts he described support for initiatives in Idlib without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over militair optreden in Syrië

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether he remembers partially publishing internal international-law advice on possible military action in Syria after a Wob request, to list the internal legal advice given on Syria since late 2014, and to publish it or explain why not. The minister confirmed a summary part was released, said advice covered the NLA programme, the mandate for operations over Syria and the response to chemical weapons use, and declined to publish it, citing the need for candid internal advice, though it gave confidential access to decision memoranda on the NLA programme.
The cabinet attaches great importance to civil servants being able to advise impartially and in confidence, and therefore as a rule does not provide internal advice.
Het kabinet hecht er zeer aan dat ambtenaren onbevangen en in vertrouwen kunnen adviseren en verstrekt interne adviezen dan ook in de regel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan de Syrische rebellen en de vele geheime onderzoeken die daarnaar gedaan worden

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about Dutch support to Syrian rebels, the ending of the NLA programme, and the secrecy and multiple reviews surrounding it. Minister Blok answers that the programme ended, that delivery documents are classified for security reasons, that reports will be shared confidentially before the debate, and that some detailed information cannot be disclosed.
Prior to the debate on the NLA programme, the cabinet will send the full research report to the House on a confidential basis.
Voorafgaand aan het debat over het NLA-programma zal kabinet het volledige onderzoeksrapport op vertrouwelijk basis aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over intern volkenrechtelijk advies over de steun aan de rebellen in Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether internal international-law advice on arms-type aid to Syrian rebels is public, whether the government deliberately avoided external advice, and asked for all such advice to be sent to parliament before a debate. The minister said internal advice is not state secret but falls under personal policy views and is not released by default, and offered confidential inspection of the decision memoranda for the NLA programme.
In this exceptional case, the cabinet is prepared, exceptionally, to give the House confidential access to the decision memoranda on the NLA programme if desired.
In dit bijzondere geval is het kabinet bij uitzondering bereid de Kamer desgewenst vertrouwelijk inzage te geven in de besluitvormingsmemoranda over het NLA-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het beëindigen van vluchten naar Teheran door KLM en de gevolgen van Amerikaanse secundaire sancties

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked whether KLM's halt of Tehran flights and the US secondary sanctions on Iran are related, and what the sanctions mean for Dutch firms. The ministers answered that KLM's decision was commercial, that Dutch firms face reputational, financial and legal risks from extraterritorial US sanctions, and that the Netherlands opposes such extraterritoriality while the EU has adopted countermeasures.
The Dutch government is not involved in internal considerations and motives regarding the business operations of Dutch companies.
De Nederlandse overheid is niet betrokken bij interne overwegingen en beweegredenen t.a.v. bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de toekenning van de speciale editie van de mensenrechtentulp aan de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein en de rol van de commissaris i

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked how the special Human Rights Tulip was awarded to outgoing UN High Commissioner Zeid Ra'ad Al Hussein, given his role in the treatment of whistleblower Anders Kompass, and whether he should apologise and help child victims of abuse by peacekeepers. The minister explains the award procedure and the decision by the minister, says the independent panel found no abuse of power by the High Commissioner, notes that a UN tribunal case is pending, and declines to request an apology, while pointing to UN and UNICEF measures for victims and whistleblower protection.
The cabinet will strive to answer your questions before the Human Rights Tulip ceremony.
Het kabinet zal streven naar beantwoording van uw vragen voor de uitreiking van de Mensenrechtentulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created. The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de toenemende onzekerheid van eigendom en investeringen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about declining property and investment security in South Africa, including the Financial Times reporting, the EFF leader's rhetoric, proposed land expropriation without compensation, BBBEE policy, and the effect on Dutch investors and the bilateral investment treaty. The government answered that it is cautiously optimistic about President Ramaphosa's reforms, that it will monitor expropriation and raise investor concerns in dialogue and at the upcoming EU-South Africa summit, but it gave no concrete commitments beyond continued contact.
The cabinet continues to closely monitor developments, including by maintaining close contacts with the South African authorities through the Embassy in Pretoria.
Het kabinet blijft ontwikkelingen op de voet volgen, onder andere door het onderhouden van nauwe contacten met de Zuid-Afrikaanse autoriteiten door de Ambassade in Pretoria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de niet nagekomen beloftes van de regering van Malta

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the Foreign Minister about Malta's Valletta 2018 director's comments on murdered journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia, Leeuwarden's suspension of official exchanges, the stalled murder investigation, and Dutch forensic assistance. The minister answered that the Dutch forensic institute helped Maltese police, that responsibility for the investigation lies with Malta, and that the issue has been raised bilaterally and in the EU and Council of Europe.
