The Maltese authorities are responsible for the investigation into the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia and for tracking down and prosecuting the perpetrators.
De Maltese autoriteiten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het onderzoek naar de moord op journaliste Daphne Caruana Galizia en het opsporen en berechten van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de steun van de Nederlandse regering aan de rebellen in Zuid-Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch non-lethal assistance to Syrian rebels in the south, including reports of US withdrawal, other donors, results, and whether support continues. Minister Blok answered that the NLA programme in the south has ended, the north programme was also stopped, and that the government's objectives were stability on the Jordanian and Israeli borders and a foothold for the opposition.
Besides the Netherlands, the US also publicly states that it supported the moderate armed opposition in southern Syria in 2018.
Naast Nederland stelt ook de VS publiekelijk dat het de gematigde gewapende oppositie in Zuid-Syrië in 2018 heeft gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de agressieve retoriek en manoeuvres van Turkije richting Griekenland en Cyprus

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's aggressive rhetoric and maneuvers toward Greece and Cyprus, including ramming incidents, airspace violations, and maritime disputes over Cypriot gas exploration. The government condemned violations of sovereignty and territorial integrity in general terms, referenced EU Council conclusions, said it lacked facts on specific incidents, and declined to take an active bilateral role, saying the issue should be resolved between the parties.
It is therefore not obvious that the Netherlands should play an active role in this matter at this time.
Het ligt dan ook niet voor de hand dat Nederland in deze kwestie op dit moment een actieve rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het steunprogramma aan de Syrische gewapende oppositie

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch support programme for the Syrian armed opposition, including the external evaluation, the number of groups supported, vehicle deliveries, end-use and goal achievement. The minister answered most questions with confidentiality and security reasons, declined to share the evaluation or transfer documents, and pointed to an IOB review and an Auditdienst Rijk audit still underway.
Information about this project, as stated in the external evaluation, is state secret.
Informatie over dit project, zoals vermeld in de externe evaluatie zijn staatsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de stijgende christenvervolging in China onder Xi Jinping

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Catholic bishop Guo Xijin, new Chinese restrictions on unregistered religious activity, and what the government will do about religious freedom in China. The minister said the Netherlands is seriously concerned, raised religious freedom in bilateral and multilateral talks, and will use the UN Universal Periodic Review, but made no commitment on the bishop's appointment, which he called a matter between China and the Vatican.
The cabinet makes no statement on the official appointment and approval of bishops; this is a matter between China and the Vatican.
Over de officiële benoeming en goedkeuring van bisschoppen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken – dit is een kwestie die speelt tussen China en het Vaticaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Israël Nederlandse projecten op de Westelijke Jordaanoever sloopt

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Helvert asked whether Israel demolished Dutch-funded water systems on the West Bank, whether Israel was consulted, and what steps the government took, including on compensation and EU-funded project demolitions. The minister confirms the demolitions, says Nederland was not consulted, protested at official level and sought compensation (refused by Israel), and reports about 326 EU-assisted structures and roughly 38,600 euro of Dutch damage demolished since 2015, while condemning demolitions under occupation law.
The Netherlands and the EU consistently and at various levels make clear objections to the Israeli authorities against demolition of Palestinian property.
Nederland en de EU maken consequent en op verschillende niveaus de bezwaren duidelijk bij de Israëlische autoriteiten tegen sloop van Palestijnse bezittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over mensenrechtenschendingen in Ethiopië

An MP from the CDA asked the government about human rights violations in Ethiopia, including repression of protesters, detention and torture, the Maekelawi and Kaliti prisons, Dutch aid and dialogue, and an outdated country report used in asylum decisions. The government acknowledged serious past abuses, noted recent reforms under the new prime minister, described its diplomatic engagement, and said the updated country report would be delayed until summer 2018.
The government regrets that the country report could not be delivered on time.
De regering betreurt het dat het ambtsbericht niet tijdig kon worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de mogelijke strafbaarheid van het vechten voor Turkije in Syrië

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether Turkish dual nationals could be mobilised for the Afrin offensive, whether Dutch citizens fighting for the Free Syrian Army or serving in Turkish forces are criminally liable, and whether the Turkish offensive is lawful. The ministers answered that no general mobilisation orders are known, that fighting in Syria is in principle punishable for Dutch nationals except for state-authorised action against IS, that serving in foreign armed forces is not in itself criminal, and that the government takes no active role in advising those called up; several questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or deferred.
Active participation other than on government orders in the fight against IS in Iraq and Syria is in principle punishable.
Actieve deelname anders dan in opdracht van de overheid aan de strijd tegen IS in Irak en Syrië is in beginsel strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Drie mishandelaars Praag veroordeeld en Tsjechië uitgezet’

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that three Dutch men were convicted in Prague for assault and expelled, including questions on reputational harm, prosecution in the Netherlands, police-officer involvement and compensation for the victim. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the case is individual, the Czech authorities handle it, the Netherlands will not investigate under Article 68 Sr, a Dutch police investigation has started, and compensation is not for the Dutch government.
I do not make statements about the individuals involved.
Over de betrokken individuen doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam en Omtzigt over de aangenomen resolutie van de parlementaire assemblee van de Raad van Europa “Prosecuting and punishing the crimes against humanity or even possible g

MPs Van Helvert, Van Dam and Omtzigt asked whether the government will act on a Council of Europe resolution calling ISIS crimes genocide, including whether to appoint a specialised prosecutor and enable handover of evidence. The government confirmed its support for the resolution, described existing investigative cooperation, and promised to study the specialised prosecutor proposal and report back.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Over de resultaten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het massaproces en de doodstraf voor een persfotograaf in Egypte

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the death sentence sought against photojournalist Shawkan in a mass trial in Egypt, the detention of rights defenders, and the NGO law. The minister shares concern about the death penalty, unfair trial procedures, and the NGO law, and says the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and supports civil society, though implementing rules are not yet published.
I have taken note of the reports and remain deeply concerned about the application of the death penalty in Egypt.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de berichtgeving en maak mij onverminderd zorgen over de toepassing van de doodstraf in Egypte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Becker en Van Helvert over verhoging van het budget voor betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Becker and Van Helvert asked the government about reports that the Palestinian Authority's 2018 budget raises payments to prisoners and their families by $56 million, and what the Netherlands is doing to change the system. The ministers answered that the increase is about $900,000 compared with 2017, that the Netherlands opposes linking payments to length of detention, and that it keeps raising this bilaterally, multilaterally and within the EU.
The cabinet continues to press on this, including in multilateral settings.
Het kabinet blijft hierop aandringen, ook in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan het Vrije Syrische Leger

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Dutch non-lethal support to Free Syrian Army groups had reached groups now fighting alongside Turkey in Afrin, and requested transfer documents and a fuller answer. The government declined to publish transfer documents or group names for security reasons, said support was stopped in northern Syria in March 2018, and referred the specific questions to a confidential letter.
For security reasons the cabinet does not make public information from which it can be inferred which groups Netherlands supports or supported or where they are located.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen maakt het kabinet geen informatie openbaar waaruit kan worden afgeleid welke groepen door Nederland worden of werden gesteund of waar ze zich precies bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de discriminatie van, onteigeningen van en moordpartijen op blanke boeren in Zuid-Afrika

CDA MPs Van Helvert and Geurts asked the Foreign Minister about reports of discrimination, land expropriation and murders of white farmers in South Africa, and whether the government takes South Africa's security responsibility seriously. The minister answered that violence is a broad problem, that the government sees no reason to doubt South Africa's responsibility, and that the proposed constitutional change on expropriation without compensation is a domestic process being monitored through diplomatic contacts.
The cabinet continues to urge South Africa to keep the farming community well informed about developments and to communicate clearly and unambiguously about the conditions and consequences.
Het kabinet blijft Zuid-Afrika oproepen de boerengemeenschap goed op de hoogte te houden van de ontwikkelingen en eenduidig en helder te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Helvert over de berichten dat oude diesels niet meer welkom zijn in Arnhem en Maastricht

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about Arnhem and Maastricht introducing municipal low-emission zones that exclude old diesels, and whether this fits the coalition agreement and risks a patchwork of local zones. The state secretary replied that she will agree nationwide harmonisation with municipalities and the VNG before summer, that municipalities keep the power to set zones, and committed to improving collection of foreign fines.
It remains the municipality's competence to decide whether and where a low-emission zone is introduced and to what extent it is proportionate as a measure to improve air quality.
Het blijft de bevoegdheid van de gemeente om te bepalen of en waar een milieuzone wordt ingevoerd en in hoeverre deze proportioneel is als maatregel om luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de sloop van klaslokalen in Abu a-Nawar door Israël

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Israel's demolition of classrooms in Abu a-Nawar serving 26 Palestinian children, whether the Netherlands funded them, and what action it would take, including on compensation and on Area C demolitions in the EU. The government answered that it condemns the demolition, that the classrooms were funded by the EU and other member states rather than the Netherlands, that it will support joint EU steps including compensation if asked, and that it will keep raising Area C demolitions within the EU.
The cabinet condemns the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, regardless of whether it was financed by the EU or not.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de sloop en confiscatie van Palestijnse bezittingen, ongeacht of deze door de EU zijn gefinancierd of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over berichten dat Belgische en Duitse defensiehelikopters met grote problemen kampen

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Helvert asked the Defence Minister about reports that Belgian and German defence helicopters have serious availability problems, and what this means for Dutch operations in Mali. The government answered that the Belgian NFH-90 retrofit affects the Belgian contribution to MINUSMA only marginally, that the Dutch NH-90 upgrade is planned around operations, that Germany's helicopter fleet is a German matter, and that no change to Dutch operations is needed, while promising to inform parliament about helicopter capacity for the second half of 2018.
As soon as more is known about the deployment of helicopter capacity in the second half of 2018, you will be informed, as I promised you during the committee debate of 4 December 2017.
Zodra meer bekend is over de inzet van helikoptercapaciteit in de tweede helft van 2018 wordt u hierover geïnformeerd, zoals ik u tijdens het algemeen overleg van 4 december 2017 heb toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Pedofielen delen massaal Nederlandse kinderfoto’s op openbare Russische site’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked whether the government would investigate a Russian website hosting child photos, including Dutch children, and whether Dutch police cooperate with Belgian investigators. The government answered that no joint investigation or Dutch-specific investigation is underway because no punishable images of Dutch children have been found, that the OM would open an investigation if such material is found, and that it will ask Russian authorities about action against the site.
At this moment there is no joint investigation with the Belgian authorities underway regarding the named Russian website, nor any investigation into images of Dutch children.
Op dit moment is er ten aanzien van de genoemde Russische website geen gezamenlijk onderzoek met de Belgische autoriteiten gaande of onderzoek gedaan naar afbeeldingen van Nederlandse kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2018

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 Open Doors persecution ranking, including religious freedom in Pakistan, North Korea, India and other countries, and whether religious freedom should be a priority in asylum policy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, describes bilateral, EU and Human Rights Fund activities, and sees no reason to make Christian asylum seekers a separate priority in asylum policy.
The government cannot independently confirm the exact number of North Korean Christians in prison camps.
Het kabinet kan het exacte aantal Noord-Koreaanse christenen in strafkampen niet eigenstandig bevestigen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over mogelijke mijnbouwactiviteiten aan de grens met België bij Zuid-Limburg voor de winning van onder andere zink en mogelijke effecten voor de Nederlandse bie

CDA MPs asked whether Belgian mining exploration for zinc near the Dutch border, and the Einstein Telescope bid in South Limburg, threaten each other. The minister answered that the Belgian authorities did not notify the Netherlands, that a transboundary environmental assessment would be required, and that the Belgian mining could affect the telescope's noise environment, but that it is too early to judge and the matter will be investigated with the province and the Belgian authorities.
I was not informed by the Belgian authorities.
Ik ben door de Belgische autoriteiten niet op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Helvert over het stemgedrag van Nederland in de Verenigde Naties

MPs Voordewind and Van Helvert asked how Dutch voting positions on UN resolutions are determined, how parliament exercises democratic control over them, and whether the government is bound by an alleged EU principle that all member states vote the same. The minister answered that positions are set by the minister after substantive review and EU coordination, that parliament controls this through regular debates, questions and motions, and that no EU principle requires identical voting, though member states must coordinate under Article 34 TEU.
There is no principle agreement within the EU that all member states vote the same.
Er is geen principe-afspraak binnen de EU dat alle lidstaten hetzelfde stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over Nederlandse steun en internationale steun aan de Syrische oppositie

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Dutch and international support for the Syrian opposition, including the AJACS police programme in Idlib, monitoring of aid, NLA to the SDF, the White Helmets, and arms origins. The ministers answered most questions on substance, defending the AJACS programme's resumption after investigations and declining to share detailed monitoring reports and recipient locations for security reasons.
For security reasons the cabinet does not share information showing at which locations and to which communities the AJACS programme provides support.
Het kabinet deelt om veiligheidsredenen geen informatie waaruit kan blijken op welke locaties en aan welke gemeenschappen het AJACS-programma ondersteuning verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Niemand vertelt ons wat’

MPs Van Helvert and Van Dam asked how the government supports relatives of Dutch citizens who die abroad, how it supports the Malaysian police investigation into Ivana Smit's death, and why there is no dedicated contact person for such relatives. The minister replied that the ministry provides consular assistance on request, keeps contact with relatives and local authorities, and that Slachtofferhulp Nederland can offer support after return, while noting that the Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign police investigation.
The Netherlands cannot interfere in a police investigation by foreign authorities into a case that took place abroad.
Nederland kan zich niet mengen in een politieonderzoek door buitenlandse autoriteiten naar een zaak die zich in het buitenland heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de omstandigheden in Noord-Koreaanse politieke gevangenissen

MPs from CDA, VVD, PVV and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that North Korean political prisons resemble Nazi camps, including detention numbers, alleged crimes against humanity, UN and ICC action, and protection for Christians. The minister answered that the UN commission reports are authoritative, that Netherlands raises the issue at the UN and supports referral to the ICC though this requires Security Council agreement, and that it supports documentation projects and religious freedom.
The Netherlands, together with the EU, regularly raises the human rights situation in North Korea, including abuses in (political) prisons.
Nederland stelt de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea, inclusief misstanden in (politieke) gevangenissen, mede in EU-verband regelmatig aan de orde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland in de VN meestemt met anti-Israëlische resoluties als gevolg van EU-beleid

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch voting on anti-Israel UN resolutions is determined by EU policy and whether this conflicts with a parliamentary motion, and whether the government will change its voting. The minister answered that each proposal is assessed on its merits, that EU unity is pursued for influence, and that the motion is seen as encouragement to continue the current approach, without committing to a change in voting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de op Saoedi-Arabië afgevuurde raketten ‘Made in Iran’

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iran supplied missiles fired by Houthi rebels at Saudi Arabia, and whether Iran violated UN Resolution 2216, and asked whether the government would raise it with Iran and allies. The minister said the UN Panel of Experts found the missile had Iranian characteristics but made no finding on who supplied it, that no evidence yet shows Iran breached the embargo, and that the EU conducts critical dialogue with Iran on its regional role and missile programme without new sanctions planned.
The Panel makes no statements in this report about when, by whom and how the missile would have been supplied to the Houthi rebels.
Het Panel doet in dit rapport geen uitspraken over wanneer, door wie en hoe de raket aan de Houthi-rebellen geleverd zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Ten Broeke over de implementatie van het vredesakkoord in Colombia

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Helvert and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the slow and uneven implementation of the Colombia peace agreement, including rising violence and rights abuses, and what the Netherlands is doing and will do about it. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mixed progress, listed Dutch funding and diplomatic initiatives, and said the government will press Colombia on faster implementation.
The cabinet will therefore seize every opportunity to press for the most effective and swift possible implementation of the peace agreement.
Het kabinet zal dan ook elke gelegenheid aangrijpen om aan te dringen op een zo effectief en spoedig mogelijke uitvoering van het vredesakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat christenen in Noord-Irak bedreigd worden door sjiitische milities

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Shia militias in northern Iraq are preventing and persecuting Christians who fled the offensive against the Kurdish region, and about possible ethnic cleansing and Iranian influence. The minister answered that the UN cannot confirm systematic persecution or ethnic cleansing, that the government monitors the situation and raises minority rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities, and that the matter is discussed in EU channels.
The government closely follows the situation, in cooperation with the Iraqi government and our international partners.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie nauwgezet, in samenwerking met de Iraakse overheid en onze internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omzigt en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘UK foreign aid money 'diverted to extremists' in Syria’

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government was aware of BBC allegations that AJACS-funded police in Syria paid extremists and worked with courts imposing executions, and asked about Dutch funding and whether it would suspend aid. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch funding of EUR 2.2 million was held pending investigation, committed to joint inquiry with the UK, and listed conditions for resuming aid.
In response to these serious allegations, the financiers involved took immediate action.
Naar aanleiding van deze ernstige aantijgingen hebben de betrokken financiers direct actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over brandstofzwendel

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the government about possible fuel fraud in shipping, including whether a 'black list' of prohibited substances in marine fuel is delayed and whether enforcement is adequate. The government denies a major poisoning scandal is evident, describes ongoing ILT and prosecution investigations, and says an international black list is being pursued via IMO, with results expected in late 2018.
The Chamber can be expected to be informed about the results of this investigation in the first half of 2018.
Naar verwachting kan de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2018 over de resultaten van dit onderzoek worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van Helvert over uitstel van verbreding van de ‘dodenweg’ N50 bij Kampen

MPs Bruins and Van Helvert asked the minister why widening the N50 near Kampen may be delayed to 2023 despite safety and congestion concerns, and whether the start decision and the motion on the N50 are being implemented. The minister answered that the N50 is not a bottleneck in the national market and capacity analysis, that personnel capacity is reserved for the existing MIRT programme, that EUR 5 million has been reserved and a start decision is expected soon.
The N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid does not emerge as a bottleneck in the NMCA (National Market and Capacity Analysis).
De N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid komt niet als knelpunt naar voren in de NMCA
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen, Visser, Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over paspoortcontroles door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs from VVD and CDA asked whether airlines must check passengers' identity on intra-Schengen flights, how responsibilities are divided, and how the EU PNR directive would help detect terrorists. The minister explained that border checks are a KMar task only at external borders, that airlines may but need not perform conformity checks, and that PNR implementation (deadline 25 May 2018) and a feasibility study on mandatory conformity checks are the planned responses.
Figures on how many airlines check the identity of their passengers are not kept.
Cijfers over hoeveel luchtvaartmaatschappijen de identiteit van hun passagiers controleren worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de overtocht naar één van de Waddeneilanden 21% duurder wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked about reports that ferry tickets to a Wadden island would become 21% more expensive, and about VAT, the concession and fare rises. The government answered that the reports are inaccurate, that the Tax Plan 2018 removes the zero VAT rate for ships used on the Wadden Sea, and that the concession transfer to the province will be studied in 2018.

When long-term solutions take more shape, the State Secretary intends to commission, together with the Province of Friesland, an independent study in 2018 into the consequences of transferring concession management and award.

Wanneer de lange termijn oplossingen meer vorm krijgen, is de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu voornemens om samen met de Provincie Friesland in 2018 een onafhankelijk onderzoek uit te laten voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht 'Vliegen op één rij kost fortuin'

MP Van Helvert asked whether hidden extra charges for choosing seats on airline tickets break the law, what rules ensure full price transparency, whether the ACM has fined airlines for this, and whether airlines may charge for seats keeping families together. The government answered that total prices must be shown upfront, optional seat fees must be disclosed early and opt-in, the ACM enforces this and has fined providers, and airlines may charge for specific seats with no legal cap on fees.
Booking specific seats is increasingly an optional choice.
Het boeken van specifieke zitplaatsen is steeds vaker een facultatieve optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over containercongestie bij de binnenvaart

An MP asked the minister about container congestion slowing inland waterway shipping at Rotterdam, its causes, the economic risk of modal shift back to trucks, and concrete remedies. The minister acknowledged the congestion, cited multiple causes, said the port authority will invest 3 million euros and hold follow-up talks, and offered to assist if needed.
At the meeting the port authority HbR announced it will make 3 million euros available to develop plans to counter delays in container transshipment to inland vessels.
HbR heeft in het overleg aangekondigd € 3 miljoen beschikbaar te stellen om plannen uit te werken om vertragingen bij de containeroverslag op binnenvaartschepen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het afbreken van een mast van de tweemastklipper Amicitia

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about the mast collapse of the sailing ship Amicitia, the state of certification and inspection of the 'brown fleet', and inspection staffing compared with Germany and Denmark. The minister acknowledged the OVV findings, described inspection intensification and staffing, and promised a fuller response to the OVV recommendations by January 2018.
The accident with the Amicitia has been the reason for me to intensify the existing supervision of the inspection bodies.
Het ongeluk met de Amicitia is voor mij aanleiding geweest om het bestaande toezicht op de keuringsinstanties te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de informatie beschikbaar bij de Nederlandse overheid en regering over het onveilige luchtruim boven Oost Oekraïne in de eerste helft van 2014, dus vóór het nee

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked what information the Dutch government held about unsafe airspace over eastern Ukraine before MH17 was downed, including an April 2014 NCTV threat-analysis request, the Kiev memorandum, OVSE and ECAC warnings, NOTAMs, Eccairs reports and airline warning arrangements. The government answered that the April 2014 request was a routine terrorism-alert request on Dutch airports, that the relevant warnings concerned Crimea and the Black Sea rather than eastern Ukraine, and it offered some documents for confidential inspection by the House until the 2017 Christmas recess while withholding others from public disclosure.
To give your House a complete picture I will make all the requests mentioned above available for confidential inspection, only to members of your House, until the 2017 Christmas recess.
Om uw Kamer een compleet beeld te geven zal ik alle hierboven genoemde aanvragen ter vertrouwelijke inzage ter beschikking stellen, alleen aan de leden van uw Kamer, tot het kerstreces 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Von Martels, Nijkerken-de Haan en Middendorp over het behoud van het station Valkenburg door de Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary about the ILT's refusal to let the Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij run over the main line to Valkenburg station without machinist licences, and whether the rules are stricter than EU requirements. The State Secretary answered that no regulatory change occurred, the ILT had no legal basis for an exemption, and ZLSM is expected to obtain a new safety certificate by early 2018 with a study into training for its machinists.
The ILT's decision arose from a request by the ZLSM.
Het besluit van de ILT komt voort uit een verzoek van de ZLSM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Helvert over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about the maintenance state of the Ghent-Terneuzen canal near Sluiskil, sheet-pile rust, water nuisance for residents, water-level agreements with Belgium and legal responsibility. The minister answered that renovation is underway, a joint study into the water nuisance is planned, water-level agreements were respected, and responsibility is divided among Rijkswaterstaat and Zeeland Seaports.
Rijkswaterstaat, as manager of the canal, is responsible for the water level.
Rijkswaterstaat is als beheerder van het kanaal verantwoordelijk voor het waterpeil.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het onderzoek van Helios naar de vliegroutes van Lelystad

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the Helios second opinion on Lelystad airport flight routes, whether the B+ routeset is fixed, the London airspace comparison, military airspace in other countries, and LVNL's role. The state secretary maintained that the B+ routes and design principles are given, confirmed Helios would review the proposed routes within those principles, and provided the Helios assignment.

Helios is therefore, partly at my request, carrying out a second opinion next month on the currently proposed connecting routes and the consequences for the airspace, guided by the principles advised by the Alderstafel Lelystad and adopted by the cabinet.

Helios voert dan ook, mede op mijn verzoek, komende maand een second opinion uit op de nu voorliggende ontwerp aansluitroutes en de gevolgen voor het luchtruim, met als leidraad de door de Alderstafel Lelystad geadviseerde en door het kabinet overgenomen uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops over de confiscatie van 50 kerken, kloosters en begraafplaatsen door Turkije

MPs Van Helvert and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported confiscation of 50 churches, monasteries and cemeteries in Mardin, the Aya Sofia Koran reading and alleged Islamist-driven Christian persecution. The minister answered that the transfers stem from lawful administrative reorganisation, that the embassy is monitoring the Aramean community, and that Aya Sofia should not become a site of provocation, while declining to characterise Turkey as systematically persecuting Christians.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de situatie voor chauffeurs in Calais

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about dangers for truck drivers at Calais after a Polish driver died when migrants blocked the road, including coordination with France, Benelux, and damage estimates. The minister said France is responding alertly, is increasing police numbers and lighting on the A16, that no Benelux role is needed for now, and that Dutch damage figures are not known.
I therefore see no role for the Benelux Union or the Benelux Parliament at this moment.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen rol voor de Beneluxunie of het Beneluxparlement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over de verbreding van de A2 tussen Weert en Eindhoven

Two CDA MPs asked why the government chose not to widen the A2 between Weert and Eindhoven despite daily congestion, and about the rules for paying drivers to avoid peak hours. The minister answered that the MIRT study was taken into account, that peak-avoidance payments would be capped at three months and follow Parliament's conditions, and that the region-led programme chose no-regret measures instead of a widening study because other bottlenecks had greater economic losses.
The Programme Council SmartwayZ.nl therefore weighed not having the state start an exploration for a further package of measures on the A2.
In de Programmaraad SmartwayZ.nl is daarom afgewogen nu geen verkenning door het rijk te laten starten voor een verdergaand maatregelenpakket op de A2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Visser en Jetten over het vliegveld Teuge

MPs asked whether the province of Gelderland pushed for a new flight route over the Teuge airport, whether provinces were consulted and informed about the planned airspace connections for Lelystad Airport, and what alternatives exist. The state secretary denied that Gelderland pushed for a route over Teuge, said the provinces were involved and informed, that a consultation procedure starts in September, and that she is exploring with Teuge and the parachute centre how to limit the effects.
There is no question of the province of Gelderland having pushed for a flight route over Teuge.
Er is geen sprake van dat de provincie Gelderland op een vliegroute boven Teuge zou hebben aangestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de slechte staat van onderhoud van bruggen rond Rotterdam

An MP asked the minister about reports that bridges around Rotterdam are poorly maintained and risk a traffic collapse, and about a Sweco study and filing-cost estimates. The minister rejected the claim that the bridges are poorly maintained, said they are adequately maintained though vulnerable due to heavier traffic and age, and pointed to a renovation programme and new road links.
This report is not correct. The bridges around Rotterdam, managed by the national government, are adequately maintained.
Dit bericht klopt niet. De bruggen om Rotterdam, in beheer bij het Rijk, worden adequaat onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over een politieteam in Indonesië tegen LHBT'ers (Lesbiënnes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) moet opsporen

MPs Van Helvert, Ten Broeke and Voordewind asked about a planned West Java police unit to hunt LHBT people, alleged threats of harsh punishment, Dutch aid to Indonesia, and whether the Netherlands will act via EU dialogue. The government says the unit has not been formally established, confirms the Netherlands raised LHBTI concerns bilaterally and via the EU, lists aid being phased out by 2020 while support to civil society continues, and commits to raising the issue in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over parkeren van vrachtwagens langs rijkswegen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the shortage of truck parking along motorways, long-term parking misuse, differing rest-time enforcement in neighbouring countries, and a possible Benelux role. The minister said parking capacity is sufficient network-wide but overcrowded on busy corridors, that enforcement of long-term parking is not possible without a legal time limit, and that Dutch policy aims for a Europe-wide level playing field, with the Benelux role limited to intelligent transport systems.
I have no data on how the situation in Belgium and Luxembourg is regarding the long-term parking of vehicles or parts thereof at rest areas along the main road network.
Ik heb geen gegevens over hoe de situatie in België en Luxemburg is ten aanzien van het langdurig stallen van voertuigen of onderdelen daarvan op een verzorgingsplaats langs het hoofdwegennet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over mensenrechten in de Republiek Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about heavy-handed police action against protesters in Suriname, alleged rights violations, the handling of the December murders trial, and whether the Netherlands should raise human rights with Suriname. The minister acknowledged excessive police force and promised agreements to prevent recurrence, but largely defended the Surinamese state's rights record and said the Netherlands will continue raising human rights bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands will continue to call attention to the human rights situation in Suriname, both bilaterally and multilaterally.
Nederland blijft aandacht vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Suriname, zowel bilateraal als multilateraal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Van Helvert en Jetten over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de situatie op Schiphol

MPs Visser, Van Helvert and Jetten asked the state secretary about long queues at Schiphol airport, including slot allocation, KMar staffing, selectiveness policy and Lelystad. The government replied that Schiphol committed to fully staffing security lanes over summer, extra KMar capacity is planned, and most questions were answered with policy restatements and referrals to other bodies.
Soon I want to discuss in a follow-up meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN which actions these parties can take to work towards a more structural solution in the medium term.
Binnenkort wil ik in een vervolggesprek met Schiphol, KLM en BARIN bespreken welke acties deze partijen kunnen nemen om op middellange termijn naar een meer structurele oplossing toe te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over een inschattingsfout van Rijkswaterstaat bij de A58

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat misjudged traffic on the A58 when scheduling roadworks on 6 June 2017, and how holiday traffic is factored into planning. The minister answers that the Pentecost traffic pattern differed from past years, that holiday peaks are considered in planning, and that no further commitment beyond taking the experience into account is made.
This experience will of course be taken into account in the future planning of works.
Deze ervaring zal uiteraard wel worden meegenomen bij de toekomstige planning van werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Duitsland het cabinekamperen verbiedt

Rep. Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the Netherlands should ban truck cabin camping after Germany did, and whether parking nuisance and uneven enforcement across Europe are a concern. The minister answered that a level playing field is needed, that the issue should be handled at EU level in the Mobility Package, that Rijkswaterstaat will monitor parking pressure, and that the Netherlands will not ban cabin rest for now.
I will have Rijkswaterstaat monitor whether parking pressure along motorways to and from Germany increases.
Ik zal Rijkswaterstaat laten monitoren of de parkeerdruk langs autosnelwegen van en naar Duitsland een toename kent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over nieuwe bruggen in de Afsluitdijk

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked whether the Afsluitdijk bridges would not be replaced until after 2050, causing repeated breakdowns, and asked about the delay, cost and temperature causes. The minister denied any delay, said replacement of the superstructure is planned for 2023-2025 with a repair in 2020, and gave no estimate of future breakdowns or their costs, citing lack of registration.
Incidentally, between mid-July 2016 and end April 2017 no breakdowns with consequences for (waterborne) road traffic occurred at either bridge.
Overigens hebben zich in de periode van midden juli 2016 tot eind april 2017 aan beide bruggen geen storingen met gevolgen voor het (vaar)wegverkeer voorgedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de berichtgeving over Schiphol

Visser (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about reports of queues, baggage, gate and runway capacity problems at Schiphol, KLM's concerns, the selectivity policy and the ongoing growth debate. The State Secretary answered that a meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN led to agreed opening of security lanes in summer 2017, that the government is coordinating border-control measures, and that the selectivity policy and the MER/safety analysis on growth beyond 2020 are in progress.
On 8 May I held a meeting with the CEO of Schiphol, the CEO of KLM and the chair of BARIN about the situation that has arisen.

Ik heb 8 mei jl. een gesprek gevoerd met de president-directeur van Schiphol, de president-directeur van KLM en de voorzitter van de Board of Airline Representatives In the Netherlands (BARIN) over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat treinen vaker stilvallen

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising train breakdowns on NS are caused by more trains, and about economic damage, NS's performance and new Flirt trains. The state secretary answered that the share of cancelled trains rose on the main rail network but fell on the HSL, attributed the increase largely to the new Den Haag-Breda service and Flirt introduction problems, and said an improvement programme with ProRail is underway.
No research is available on the economic damage of trains that stop running.
Er is geen onderzoek beschikbaar naar economische schade van stilvallende treinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over rolstoeltoegankelijkheid van treinen

Mr Van Helvert (CDA) asked the state secretaries about the wheelchair accessibility of trains after a TV report, including the number of stations without assistance, the risk of worsening access before 2024/2030, and whether timelines can be shortened. The state secretary rejected the report's conclusion as too one-sided, cited planned extra assistance stations and new accessible trains, and said the timelines are already near what is feasible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Hoge NS bazen kregen half miljoen oprotpremie’

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether the government approved and knew the reasons for severance payments of about EUR 600,000 to two NS managers, and whether these were linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The minister answered that NS restructured its top structure, that the board needs no approval for non-board severance, that the departures are unrelated to Limburg, and declined to share supervisory board minutes.
I do not have access to the minutes of the meetings of the supervisory board.
Ik heb geen beschikking over de verslagen van de vergaderingen van de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het niet afnemen van files na de opening van de Velsertunnel

An MP from CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why, after the reopening of the Velsertunnel, rush-hour congestion on the A9 toward Haarlem-Alkmaar had not eased and whether the renovation had solved any bottleneck. The minister answered that the renovation was a 60-year maintenance and safety upgrade, not a capacity expansion, that no structural bottleneck exists on the A22, and that the A9 congestion lies near Zijkanaal C and Velsen, with monitoring and a MIRT study promised.
The goal of the Velsertunnel renovation project was a complete renovation of the 60-year-old tunnel.
Het doel van het project Renovatie Velsertunnel was een volledige renovatie van de 60 jaar oude tunnel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de voorgenomen zeer lage aanvliegroutes met veel geluidsoverlast in Overijssel naar vliegveld Lelystad

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about very low approach routes over Overijssel to Lelystad airport causing noise nuisance, including route maps, the scope of the environmental impact assessment, and provincial representation at the Alderstafel. The State Secretary answered that the routes follow the agreed 6,000 ft and 3,000 ft heights, that low flying is limited to exceptional cases, that no new MER is needed, and that she will explore optimisations with LVNL and CLSK.
For the south-eastern approach route over Overijssel, this means traffic to Lelystad enters Dutch airspace well above 6,000 feet over Twente.
Voor de zuidoostelijke naderingsroute over Overijssel betekent dit, dat verkeer naar Lelystad boven Twente aanzienlijk hoger dan 6.000 voet het Nederlandse luchtruim binnenkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Helvert over ongevallen op A73

MPs Ronnes and Van Helvert asked whether accidents on the A73 are increasing and what causes them, and whether further research will be done. The minister confirms registered accidents have risen, partly due to better registration, attributes the rise to economic recovery and mobility, and says Rijkswaterstaat will analyse the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch where accident risk is above average.
Therefore I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this road section in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure minister about provincial co-financing of national motorway projects, noting that Overijssel and Gelderland pay far more than other provinces. The minister answered that the figures are distorted by timing of payments, that provinces have varying motives and financial capacity, and provided a table of co-financing shares, but the answer largely explains the differences by project phase and does not commit to new action.
This reasoning cannot be linked to the cited figures; see my answer to question 3.
Deze redenering kunt u niet aan de aangehaalde cijfers verbinden, zie hiervoor mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CBR (driving licence authority), including criticism of its communication, the handling of medical re-examinations and code 100 restrictions, and whether it has enough legal instruments. The minister answered that communication has improved, that the Gezondheidsraad advises on fitness criteria with new advice coming, that medical specialists play a role, and that the CBR has sufficient legal instruments.
Following the Omroep Max broadcast, the CBR has adjusted the instructions for the experts who conduct driving tests.
Het CBR heeft naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Omroep Max de instructies aangepast voor de deskundigen die rijtesten afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over schadevergoeding door de kapotte stuw bij Grave

Three CDA MPs asked the minister whether the state bears responsibility, through the lack of a calamity plan and slow repairs, for damages from the broken Grave weir, and whether the damage should be compensated. The minister answered that the damage was caused by the ship collision rather than a government act, so no nadeelcompensatie applies; the investigation is ongoing and the shipowner's liability-limitation request is pending in court.
However, this damage is not the result of a government decision or action, but the direct consequence of the collision.
Deze schade is echter niet het gevolg van een besluit of handeling van de overheid, maar het directe gevolg van de aanvaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over Alternatieve Sjöterie Sint Christina Stank Stief Sjaelberg

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a Justis department letter refusing a cannon exemption to a Limburg association after a phone call seemed to suggest approval, and about handling errors and whether the decision should be revised. The minister confirmed the call was only a discussion, that the cannon was self-built without the required license, admitted the handling was unfortunate, but refused to revise the decision pending a possible objection procedure and declined a meeting.
I acknowledge that the course of events is unfortunate.
Ik erken dat de gang van zaken ongelukkig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de uitval van spitstreinen

CDA MP Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about the high cancellation rate of extra peak trains and the number of passengers affected, and whether NS and ProRail measure punctuality consistently. The State Secretary answered that extra peak trains are cancelled more often because they are the first to be dropped during disruptions, that 6.5% were cancelled in 2016 versus 1.8% overall, and that punctuality thresholds have been aligned from 2017 while she awaits NS's formal accountability report before judging performance.
I am awaiting this formal accountability with final figures before forming a judgement on performance on the main rail network.
Ik wacht deze formele verantwoording met definitieve cijfers af voordat ik mij een oordeel vorm over de prestaties op het hoofdrailnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the reported sharp drop in drink-driving checks, and the reduced role of Veilig Verkeer Nederland volunteers, is accurate and what explains it. The minister confirmed the declining trend, attributed it to social media warnings making large checks less effective and to police shifting toward individual checks that are not always registered, and said police are in talks with VVN.
Registering individual checks, which also test for alcohol use, is not mandatory.
Het registreren van individuele controles, waarbij ook getest wordt op het gebruik van alcohol, is niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Ronnes over de stuw bij Grave

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the damaged weir at Grave, its causes, impacts on inland shipping, residents of houseboats, dikes and other businesses, and why municipalities in Gelderland were informed later than those in Brabant. The minister answered that the cause cannot yet be determined pending a police investigation, described temporary and permanent repair measures, said the damage is not fully quantified, and promised an independent evaluation of the incident expected in spring 2017.
I cannot assess that at present. An independent evaluation will be carried out into the incident with the ship at the Grave weir.
Ik kan dat momenteel niet beoordelen. Er zal een onafhankelijke evaluatie worden uitgevoerd naar het incident met het schip bij de stuw Grave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Ronnes over de rol die de Raad van Commissarissen van NS gespeeld heeft bij de fraude bij de aanbesteding in Limburg

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the role of NS's supervisory board in the Limburg tender fraud, including when he learned of it, access to board minutes, discharge granted for 2014 and 2015, and damage claims. The minister answered that he was informed in April 2015 by the supervisory board, denied knowledge of board incitement to crimes, refused to release board and shareholder meeting minutes, and pointed to ongoing court and regulatory proceedings.
It is also not usual for such reports to be shared with the general meeting of shareholders.
Het is ook niet gebruikelijk dat dergelijke verslagen met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Vliegveld Lelystad wordt Lelystad-Zwolle Airport”

An MP asks whether the Secretary of State will engage Schiphol Group and regional authorities to strengthen Lelystad Airport's support for the Zwolle region and examine long-term infrastructure improvements. The government answers that regional consultation tables already exist, that the A6 and public transport upgrades have been agreed, and that the choice of the airport's regional role rests with regional authorities.
Where possible, I will support this process in the future.
Waar mogelijk zal ik dit proces in de toekomst ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het niet voorwaardelijk kunnen opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why the Wet OM-afdoening does not allow conditional fines in prosecutorial penal orders, and whether the Public Prosecution Service sees a need for conditional sanctions and what a law change would require. The Minister explained the design choice (penal orders use instructions rather than conditions, with a court fallback), said prosecutors weigh cases individually, and noted the Public Prosecution Service wants conditional sentences, which would need legislation; the question has been passed to the ongoing WODC evaluation.
This would require a legislative amendment, which would have to provide, among other things, for additional procedural safeguards.
Dit zou wetswijziging vergen, waarbij onder meer zou moeten worden voorzien in extra procedurele voorzieningen
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Andere zorgen over kerncentrale Tihange’

MPs from the CDA asked whether it is alarming that safety plans of the Tihange nuclear plant were publicly accessible online, whether the minister will raise this with Belgium, and what cyber-security rules apply. The minister agreed it is alarming, said the ANVS has discussed it with Belgium's FANC and will raise it with his Belgian counterpart, and described existing nuclear cyber-security rules and reporting obligations.
I will also do so when I am in contact with my Belgian colleague Jambon.
Ik zal dit ook doen als ik contact heb met mijn Belgische collega Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Geurts over de aansluiting A30/A1

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about regional co-financing for the A30/A1 junction, after local authorities and the province offered funds. The minister confirms awareness of the offers, says she is willing to agree co-financing but only if there is a national bottleneck, and will wait for the 2017 NMCA results before talking with the region.
I am willing to make agreements with the region on co-financing the reconstruction of the A1/A30 junction.
Ik ben bereid met de regio afspraken te maken over cofinanciering bij de reconstructie van de aansluiting A1/A30.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeers (on)veiligheid op de N36

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister about road safety on the N36, including fatality figures over ten years and how it compares with other N-roads. The minister answered that the N36 has 18 fatalities in the period, lists completed and planned Meer Veilig measures, and says a behaviour-change approach is being prepared, but declined to commit to a plan matching the average N-road.
In addition, I constantly monitor the safety of the N36 and all other national roads and take measures where necessary to improve safety.
Daarnaast houd ik de veiligheid van de N36 en alle andere Rijkswegen constant in de gaten en neem ik waar nodig maatregelen om de veiligheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord op van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Duitse tolheffing

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the planned German road toll for passenger cars, its compatibility with EU law, its cross-border effects and possible Dutch complaints. The minister answered that the Commission and Germany are still negotiating, that the plan was already softened for border regions, and that no concrete figures or border-effect study exist yet.
I will study the outcome as soon as it is known, and will consider further steps.
Ik zal de uitkomst zodra deze bekend is bestuderen, en zal mij beraden op vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asked whether the CBR's self-declaration approach to driver fitness is adequate, whether drivers' self-interest was examined, and whether the CBR should get more powers over psychological fitness for practical exams. The minister defends the current system, citing a 2012 study, driver responsibility and proportionality, and rejects additional CBR powers.
Therefore I do not consider it desirable to introduce additional powers and control mechanisms before the practical exam.
Daarom acht ik het niet wenselijk om extra bevoegdheden en controlemechanismen te introduceren vooraf aan het praktijkexamen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes, Rog en Van Helvert over de huisvesting van studenten in hotels

MPs from the CDA asked the minister whether The Student Hotel's rentals to students, often longer than six months, breach tenancy protection, whether the rents are acceptable, and whether such hotel rooms count toward student housing goals. The minister replied that the short-stay exception may apply, that tenants must go to the rent commission or court themselves, that the Rijk has no enforcement role, and that municipalities decide on hotel-based housing.
The central government has no enforcement role on this point.
Het Rijk heeft op dit punt geen handhavende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the CBR's plan to reduce driving-test locations from 53 to 30, including whether the plan was discussed with staff and industry and how it affects users with extra travel costs. The minister replies that the 30 locations offer longer opening hours and better facilities, that job losses are avoided, and that the change was discussed with staff and trade organisations.
The number of locations where practical examinations are held remains 53.
Het aantal locaties waar praktijkexamens worden afgenomen blijft 53.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Schiphol dreigt veel eerder ‘vol’ te raken dan voorzien’

MPs Monasch and Van Helvert asked the state secretary about reports that Schiphol may reach its capacity limit sooner than expected, the number of night flights, and whether Schiphol is breaching the Alders agreement. The state secretary confirmed that the 500,000-movement limit is coming into view sooner, that night flights are expected to reach about 31,600, and that the Omgevingsraad talks are ongoing, with a plan of action due by 1 December 2016 and a new noise calculation planned.
I have now called on the ORS to come up with a plan of action for the entire advice request by 1 December 2016.
Ik heb inmiddels de ORS opgeroepen om uiterlijk 1 december 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen voor de gehele adviesaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de gevolgen van het sluiten van de Merwedebrug A27 voor vrachtverkeer

MPs Visser and Van Helvert asked the Minister about the closure of the Merwede bridge on the A27 to heavy traffic, its causes, traffic diversions, compensation for transport firms and repair timing. The Minister explained that fatigue in the steel main girders led to a ban on vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, that repairs were planned to allow heavier traffic again around late November or early December, that diversions and compensation procedures were in place, and that the situation was not expected to affect the broader A27 planning.
The decision not to allow traffic heavier than 3.5 tonnes was taken to safeguard the safety of (waterway) road users.
Het besluit om geen verkeer zwaarder dan 3,5 ton toe te staan is genomen om de veiligheid van (vaar)weggebruikers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over de snelle trein van Breda naar België

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why NS cannot promise fast trains from Breda to Belgium by April 2017 and whether earlier commitments still hold. The state secretary answered that delays at Bombardier in the signalling software mean the service will likely start only after timetable 2018, that NS is having the planning checked externally, and that the government will press Bombardier.
Together with NS I will engage in discussion with Bombardier to underline the Dutch interest in a rapid solution.
Samen met NS ga ik het gesprek aan met Bombardier om het Nederlandse belang van een snelle oplossing te onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «Eijsden-Margraten dient klacht in over vliegtuiglawaai»

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary about aircraft noise over Eijsden and Mesch from Liège airport traffic after the municipality filed a complaint, and whether the 2013 airspace change should be revisited. The state secretary agrees the change caused unwanted noise, reports on meetings with the municipality and Belgian authorities, and says measures so far are insufficient and not yet structural, but argues the airspace change was needed for safety and that a new Environment Cell is working to reduce the noise.
I agree with the municipality that the airspace change has led to unwanted noise effects above Eijsden-Margraten.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente dat de luchtruimwijziging heeft geleid tot ongewenste geluidseffecten boven Eijsden-Margraten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over een overvolle sprinter in Almere

MP Van Helvert asked the State Secretary whether an overcrowded NS train at Almere Poort, where doors stayed closed, was dangerous and why, and how such situations are handled. The State Secretary answered that the conductor kept doors closed for safety on a shortened train, that NS has no fixed protocol for such exceptional cases and will review the incident with ProRail.
NS regrets the incident and is discussing it with ProRail in relation to the work at the shunting yard in order to learn from it.
NS betreurt het voorval en bespreekt dit in relatie tot de werkzaamheden op het opstelterrein samen met ProRail om van te leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Veldhoven, Van Helvert en Madlener over het bericht dat Rover vindt dat het Ministerie de verkeerde prioriteiten stelt

MPs from ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and PVV asked the State Secretary about ROVER's claim that the ministry sets the wrong priorities in its ProRail repositioning, including concerns about rushed decisions, missing baselines, and the handling of parliamentary motions. The State Secretary answered that a public-law form for ProRail is already chosen, that an analysis with stakeholder input will be sent to Parliament before year-end, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before debate.
Until I have discussed this analysis with your House, no irreversible steps will be taken regarding the positioning of ProRail.
Totdat ik deze analyse met uw Kamer heb besproken, zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen ten aanzien van de positionering van ProRail worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Flessenhals A4 levensgevaarlijk’

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about rising accidents on the A4 near Leiden and the claim that a narrowing at the aqueduct was a wrong choice. The minister attributed the rise to growing traffic and congestion, said planned measures and a third-lane study are underway with results expected in 2017, and rejected the claim that the narrowing alone caused the accidents.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht OV-chipkaart blijft bron van ergernis

An MP asked the state secretary about complaints over the OV-chipkaart, including card replacement fees, the cost of new cards, and single check-in across operators.
