The government answered that complaints are reported quarterly, that alternative pricing is being studied within the NOVB, and that operational improvements and a single check-in pilot are underway.
I have previously indicated that it is desirable to explore alternatives to the current purchase price of the OV-chipkaart and the service costs.
Ik heb eerder al aangegeven dat het wenselijk is om alternatieven te onderzoeken voor de huidige aanschafprijs van de OV chipkaart en de servicekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan eigen weg’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about unclear road signs and markings set by municipalities, and about complaints handled by road authorities. The minister said road layout is the road authority's responsibility, guidelines are not mandatory, legal rules still apply, and only aggregate complaint numbers are available, with a VVN report due in 2017.
I do not have an overview of how these reports have been handled by the various road authorities.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de afhandeling van deze meldingen door de diverse wegbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over normoverschrijding bij vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about reports that hazardous goods trains in Brabant might be replaced by barges, whether registration of dangerous substances on trains is up to date, how registration quality is checked, and when water transport could start. The state secretary answered that a sample shows about 95% accurate registration on running trains, that registration at marshalling yards is insufficiently compliant, that the inspectorate will expand enforcement and report again at end 2016, and that the promised letter on the water-transport motion will follow in autumn.
The ILT will report to me again at the end of 2016 on the results of its supervision of information on dangerous substances at railway yards.
De ILT zal mij eind 2016 opnieuw rapporteren over de resultaten betreffende het toezicht op de informatie over gevaarlijke stoffen op spooremplacementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de Belgische kernreactor Tihange 2

MPs Mulder and Van Helvert asked the minister about the safety of Belgian reactor Tihange 2 after reports of irregularities in forged reactor components. The minister replied that the Belgian regulator FANC found no safety risk, that the dossier was incomplete, that no link to the reactor vessel cracks exists, and that the ANVS will keep monitoring the case and a communication plan is being developed.

I have, however, asked the ANVS to continue following the matter surrounding the irregularities at the Creusot forge and to inform me when new developments arise that are important for the safety of Dutch citizens.
Wel heb ik aan de ANVS gevraagd om de zaak rondom de onregelmatigheden bij de Creusot smederij te blijven volgen en mij te informeren wanneer er zich nieuwe ontwikkelingen voordoen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Controle werktijden en bemanningsterkte op binnenvaartcontainerschepen’

An MP asked the minister whether the inspectorate had been told to enforce anticipatorily on inland shipping crew and working-time rules, and how that squared with announced checks. The minister replied that anticipatory enforcement is not yet applicable because the rules are still being modernised with social partners, so current rules are enforced and checks are announced in advance.
However, anticipatory enforcement can only apply when legislation is about to be amended.
Van «anticiperend handhaven» kan echter alleen sprake zijn indien wetgeving op het punt staat om gewijzigd te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Smaling over ‘gevaarlijke stoffen op het spoor’

MPs Van Helvert and Smaling asked why reports showing that risk ceilings for hazardous goods on the rail network will be exceeded were not sent to parliament sooner, and about registration failures and the enforcement response. The state secretary answered that the quarterly reports were delivered in April and used for policy reflection, that the exceedances are being analysed with results expected in July, and that stricter enforcement by the ILT is being expanded, while declining to publish a list of offenders due to ongoing criminal prosecution.
Criminal prosecution is ongoing against the offenders of the statutory obligation to register hazardous substances, and public disclosure of such a list is not among the options.
Tegen de overtreders van de wettelijke verplichting tot registratie van gevaarlijke stoffen loopt een strafrechtelijke vervolging waarbij dergelijke openbaarmaking niet tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fransen kapen KLM’ en ‘Stakingsdreiging Air France: wat zijn de consequenties voor KLM'

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about reports that Air France might shift KLM flights from Amsterdam to Paris amid strike threats, and about the strain on the KLM-Air France relationship. The State Secretary replied that Air France KLM denies such a plan, that cost-cutting is needed at both airlines, that the government opposes shifting capacity at KLM's expense, and that it will keep defending the public interests tied to KLM and Schiphol, promising a letter to the House.
We continue to commit to safeguarding the public interests involved with KLM and the main-port function of Schiphol.
We blijven ons inzetten voor de borging van de publieke belangen die met KLM en de mainportfunctie van Schiphol zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over onderhoud van de A59

Two CDA MPs asked why a stretch of the A59 near Rosmalen will receive single-layer ZOAB in 2017 while other roads get double-layer, and whether the maintenance contract is deficient. The minister says single-layer is in line with the contract and the applicable rules, that no noise ceiling breach is foreseen, and that double-layer would be beyond legal requirements, so it will not be applied there.
In those consultations Rijkswaterstaat indicated that laying double-layer ZOAB goes beyond legal requirements and that it adheres to the applicable laws and regulations.
In die overleggen heeft Rijkswaterstaat aangegeven dat het aanleggen van tweelaags ZOAB bovenwettelijk is en zich te houden aan de geldende wet-en-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert over de onnodige regeldruk voor vrijwilligers die voortvloeit uit de Regeling verkeersregelaars 2009

Two MPs asked about excessive regulatory burden on volunteer traffic marshals under the 2009 traffic marshals regulation, following Actal advice, and about sports bodies' exclusion from consultation and proposed reforms such as a national database and removal of individual appointments. The minister replied that a working group has a draft amendment ready for internet consultation, that the national e-learning database will replace separate appointment passes, and that motorcycle marshals remain barred from giving signals from vehicles for safety reasons.
It is expected that this draft proposal will be put to internet consultation by the Ministry of IenM this spring.
Naar verwachting zal dit conceptvoorstel dit voorjaar door het Ministerie van IenM in internetconsultatie kunnen worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over de aanpak van verkeershufters

MPs Van Helvert and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why fines for road offences such as overtaking on the right and tailgating have fallen and how this fits the 2020 road-casualty target. The minister attributes the drop mainly to police CAO actions in 2015, vacancies and shifting priorities, announces a 2016-2018 enforcement plan, and declines to reinstate the alcohol-lock programme as not opportune.
An important reason for the decline in the number of fines imposed is the police CAO actions in 2015.
Een belangrijke reden voor de daling van het aantal opgelegde boetes zijn de CAO-acties van de politie in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert inzake ongevallen op de A2

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about accidents on the A2 motorway, including trucks, the causes analysed, and five years of accident data. The Minister reports 1,918 accidents on the Leenderheide–Kerensheide stretch in 2010–2014, 44 involving trucks, notes causes are often unknown, and states that police records do not capture distraction or driving-hour violations.
Aspects such as distraction from calling or texting, failure to observe driving hours, and whether the driver is licensed to drive a truck are not routinely recorded in the accident registration.

Aspecten zoals afleiding door bellen of appen, het niet naleven van rijtijden en of de chauffeur gerechtigd is om met een vrachtwagen te rijden worden niet standaard in de ongevallenregistratie vastgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het gebruik van sluiproutes na de invoering van de Belgische kilometerheffing voor vrachtvoertuigen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether trucks were using Dutch side routes to avoid the new Belgian road charge, and whether she would consult her Belgian counterpart and address cross-border fuel purchases. The Minister said early counts show only route optimisation during a transition period with no clear evidence of lasting rat-running, that the matter would be raised with her Flemish colleague, and that the transport sector weighs costs when choosing routes.
In my next meeting with my Flemish colleague, Mr Weyts, I will certainly raise the road charge instrument.
Ik zal in mijn eerstvolgende gesprek met mijn Vlaamse collega, dhr. Weyts, zeker het instrument kilometerheffing aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert en Visser over het besluit om het alcoholslot op te heffen

MPs Van Helvert (CDA) and Visser (VVD) asked why the government abolished the alcohol interlock programme (ASP) after court rulings, questioning its cost, recidivism effects and whether alternatives were examined. The minister defended the abolition on cost and legal grounds, saying the programme could not be kept in administrative law and would add little in criminal law, while pointing to other measures and pending WODC research.

Weighing everything, we conclude that placing the ASP in criminal law offers too little added value beside existing instruments to tackle drink-driving, and that it is therefore not expedient to maintain the ASP.

Alles afwegende komen wij tot de conclusie dat het onderbrengen van het ASP in het strafrecht te weinig meerwaarde biedt naast het bestaande instrumentarium om rijden onder invloed aan te pakken en dat het derhalve niet opportuun is om het ASP in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch en Geurts over ontheffing lengte samenstel van landbouwtrekkers en aanhangwagen(s)

MPs from the CDA asked why the RDW cannot grant exemptions for tractor-trailer combinations longer than 18.75 metres, whether enforcement is underway, and whether the RDW's mandate should be widened. The minister confirmed the 18.75 m limit (aligned with EU Directive 96/53/EG), said there is no national enforcement campaign though regional checks occurred, and declined to widen the RDW's mandate because exemptions fall to provincial or municipal road authorities.
The authority to grant an incidental exemption, for example for an indivisible load, lies with the provincial or municipal road authority.
De bevoegdheid om een incidentele ontheffing verlenen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om een ondeelbare lading, ligt bij de provinciale of gemeentelijke wegbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Helvert inzake afwikkeling verkeer rond Utrecht

Two CDA MPs asked the infrastructure minister about traffic congestion risks on national and provincial roads around Utrecht from the city's draft mobility plan, including doubts about the modelling and the business impact. The minister said the effects cannot yet be determined, that Rijkswaterstaat has concerns and submitted an objection, and that the plan is a municipal matter, with follow-up agreements and talks with the municipality promised.
Rijkswaterstaat does have concerns about traffic flow on the main road network and the access roads in the city, and therefore about the city's accessibility.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft wel zorgen over de doorstroming op het hoofdwegennet en de toeleidende wegen in de stad en daarmee over de bereikbaarheid van de stad.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Helvert over tol voor personenauto’s op Belgische wegen

An MP from the CDA asks the Dutch Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether she knows of and will challenge Flemish plans for a per-kilometre road charge on passenger cars in Belgium, and whether she will raise the matter with the European Commission. The minister answers that no concrete Flemish plans or timetable exist yet, that she will ask the Flemish minister to stay informed as agreed under Benelux arrangements, and that she opposes new road pricing but sees no basis for Dutch action absent EU-law conflict.
In my discussions with my Flemish colleague I will certainly ask to be kept informed of plans and intentions, as also agreed within the Benelux framework.
In mijn gesprekken met mijn Vlaamse collega zal ik zeker vragen om geïnformeerd te blijven over plannen en intenties, zoals dit ook afgesproken is in Benelux-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over drones bij Schiphol

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary whether stricter drone rules are needed after a drone flew close to landing aircraft at Schiphol, and how public awareness and enforcement can be improved. The government answers that existing rules already prohibit flying in controlled airspace without permission, plans to intensify public communication and talks with manufacturers on geofencing, and says the police and Marechaussee are alert to incidents and have arrested two drone operators.
In addition, I will soon consult with the largest producers of recreational drones about the possibilities of voluntarily applying technology to make flying near airports impossible.

Daarnaast overleg ik binnenkort met de grootste producenten van recreatieve drones om met hen te spreken over de mogelijkheden van vrijwillige toepassing van technologie om vliegen in de buurt van luchthavens onmogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat vliegreizen stilletjes duurder worden

An MP asked whether surcharges for hold baggage on flight tickets mislead consumers and should be stopped, and what role the market authority ACM should play. The minister answered that such fees are avoidable options that must be shown transparently, that ACM monitors compliance, and that he sees no reason to consult airlines on the matter.
It is up to the ACM to monitor this.
Het is aan de ACM om hier controle op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de Belgische kilometerheffing

An MP from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister about Belgium's truck road-charging system, which had technical problems and too few onboard units, and asked whether the minister had pressed Belgium for postponement and leniency in enforcement. The minister answered that contacts with Belgian authorities and the Flemish minister had taken place, that Belgium would show leniency if drivers could prove the device was faulty without fault of their own, and that the operator was being held to its obligations.
I have requested that the problems be resolved urgently and asked for leniency regarding enforcement while the introduction problems remain unresolved.
Ik heb verzocht de problemen met spoed op te lossen en om coulance gevraagd ten aanzien van de handhaving zolang de invoeringsproblemen niet zijn opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Rog over studenten in verzet tegen NS

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares unions' view that NS blames overcrowded trains on education and whether students are being consulted about off-peak travel plans. The government rejects the blame framing, says NS is responsible for capacity, that no negotiations exist but exploratory talks are ongoing, and that students will be involved in follow-up talks.
NS cannot and will not unilaterally refuse students in the peak hours.
NS kan niet en zal niet eenzijdig studenten weigeren in de spits.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de onderzoeken naar de vliegramp bij Faro en de mogelijke heropening van dat onderzoek door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV)

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether new facts justify asking the OVV to reopen the Faro air disaster investigation, and why the Netherlands seeks reopening of the Portuguese report, with questions on confidentiality, expert access to documents, and maintenance responsibility. The State Secretary answered that the OVV was asked to assess new relevant facts, that the Portuguese authority alone can reopen the investigation, that ICAO rules restrict disclosure of records, and that the aircraft was found airworthy and maintenance-deferral records remain unverified.
I have not asked the OVV to reopen the Portuguese investigation.
Ik heb de OVV niet gevraagd het Portugese onderzoek te heropenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why NS settled employment contracts with executives involved in the Limburg concession tender irregularities despite the minister's earlier promise of no severance payments, and about the amounts, timeline and whether the state approved them. The minister answered that the NS board handled the settlements under employment law, that the state as shareholder has no role in ordinary employee dismissals, that he does not know the individual amounts, and that the settlements avoided costly litigation.
It is not for the shareholder to make this information public. That is for the company itself.
Het is niet aan de aandeelhouder om deze informatie publiek te maken. Dat is aan de onderneming zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Hoogland, Smaling en Van Helvert over het sluiten van overwegen door ProRail

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about ProRail's closure of level crossings, including the Laantje van Alverna private crossing, the status of a QuickScan on 100 unsupervised crossings, and how recreational interests are weighed. The State Secretary answered that ProRail follows the agreed procedure with the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking, that recreational interests are weighed in the Omgevingswet process, and that clarification on definitions will follow in spring 2016.
Nevertheless, I note that there is uncertainty between ProRail and the other members of the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking about some definitions in the procedure.
Niettemin constateer ik dat er tussen ProRail en de overige leden van de Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking over sommige definities uit de procedure onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over een kapotte brug op de Afsluitdijk

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a broken bridge on the Afsluitdijk, its repeated breakdowns, communication to motorists, and contingency plans. The minister answered that breakdowns are linked to the age of control systems being replaced in 2016, that information to drivers could have been better and signposts are being added, and that maintenance and extra staffing are underway.
The information provided to motorists could, in hindsight, have been better.
De informatievoorziening naar automobilisten had achteraf bezien beter gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over carnavalswagens over de snelweg A76 in Limburg

A CDA MP asked the Infrastructure minister whether carnival floats could be escorted over a two-kilometre stretch of the A76 motorway in Limburg, as the province proposed, and whether such slow special transport has occurred elsewhere. The minister confirmed the province's position but refused to allow the floats on the motorway, citing unmet Wegenverkeerswet 1994 requirements, costs and police advice, and pointing to alternative routes.
Since the preconditions of the Wegenverkeerswet are not met and road safety cannot therefore be guaranteed, I am and remain of the view that these carnival floats may not use the motorway.

Nu niet aan de randvoorwaarden van de Wegenverkeerswet wordt voldaan en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid niet kan worden geborgd, ben en blijf ik van mening dat deze carnavalswagens geen gebruik mogen maken van de autosnelweg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de filedruk op de A76 explosief groeit

An MP asked the minister about reports that congestion on the A76 motorway grew sharply in 2015, and whether this was linked to traffic patterns and German tolls. The minister answered that congestion rose 44% but the road is not a national bottleneck under current norms, that the 2013 analysis showed no bottleneck, and that a new analysis will start at the end of 2016.
Of course I will continue to monitor traffic developments on the A76.
Uiteraard blijf ik de ontwikkelingen van het verkeer op de A76 volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Knops over aanhoudende incidenten bij Belgische kerncentrales

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about recent incidents at Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including Dutch involvement in extended operation, follow-up of IAEA recommendations, closure scenarios, communication with Dutch authorities, and joint inspections. The Minister answered that nuclear safety is a national Belgian matter, that she supports better involvement of Dutch authorities and has asked Belgium to explore it, that closure decisions rest with the Belgian regulator FANC, and that joint inspections with Belgium have started and more are planned.
The FANC will take a decision on that, if the FANC sees reason to do so.
Het FANC zal daarover, indien het FANC daar aanleiding toe ziet, een besluit nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de voornemens voor een nieuwe helikopterhaven in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a proposed helicopter port at Eemshaven next to the Wadden Sea, questioning its environmental impact, the need for a permit, its long-term viability, and its effect on Den Helder airfield. The minister answered that the environmental impact report is not finished, that an exemption from the Wadden Sea no-new-airfields rule would be needed and cannot yet be assessed, and that permit applications are expected in early 2016.

This environmental impact report is not yet fully completed, so at this stage it is not possible to assess whether the effects (disturbance) on nature and the environment from the helicopter flights will be acceptable.

Deze milieueffectrapportage is nog niet helemaal afgerond, waardoor het in dit stadium niet mogelijk is te beoordelen of de effecten (verstoring) op natuur en omgeving als gevolg van de helikoptervluchten aanvaardbaar zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van treinen van IC-direct

An MP asked whether IC-direct trains with refurbished ICR carriages pose a safety risk, including overbuffering, wheelset and axle wear, a stranded train with a hot axle box, and a smoke incident. The Secretary of State answered that the Inspectorate found no violations and no grounds to ban the rolling stock, that NS sees the overbuffering risk as near zero and reports no failures from added weight, and that the inspectorate is investigating further.
The ILT has found no violations of the applicable laws and regulations and has since informed the Maatschappij Voor Beter OV of this.
ILT heeft geen overtredingen van de vigerende wet- en regelgeving vastgesteld en de Maatschappij Voor Beter OV hierover inmiddels geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de subsidieregeling van OP Zuid

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister why the OP Zuid subsidy scheme's conditions were changed after the application deadline to exclude projects already started, and how many applications were affected. The Minister replied that the change followed EU state-aid rules on incentive effect, that the managing authority had earlier interpreted the rules too loosely, and that he sees no way to reverse the change.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Geurts over de decharge die de aandeelhouder van de NS verleende op 4 maart 2015 tijdens de ALV, ondanks het feit dat toen al duidelijk was dat NS in 2014 de Spoorw

MPs Omtzigt, Van Helvert and Geurts asked why the shareholder granted discharge to NS management on 4 March 2015 although an ACM finding of a Railway Act breach was already foreseeable, and about the handling of the Veolia tender case, remuneration reports and bonuses. The minister answers that ministries were informed step by step, that NS did not yet know the ACM decision date on 4 March, that discharge covers only facts known at that time, and that remuneration information is publicly available in the annual reports.

Moreover, the shareholder grants discharge to the directors only for what the shareholder knew at that moment, and it does not amount to approval of the conduct for which the legal entity remains responsible.

Overigens geeft de aandeelhouder alleen decharge aan de bestuurders voor wat de aandeelhouder op dat moment (moment decharge) bekend is en betreft het hier geen goedkeuring van de gedragingen waarvoor de rechtspersoon verantwoordelijk is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Nieuwe druk op KLM”

An MP from the CDA asks ministers whether Air France-KLM plans to absorb Transavia and whether this breaches earlier commitments on KLM's position. The government answers that talks are ongoing, that earlier agreements were reaffirmed and are expected to be honoured, and that a transfer of Transavia France is not harmful to Schiphol network quality.
No conclusion can yet be given on changes to the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «Trajectcontrole A2 levert 48 miljoen aan boetes op»

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why 31% of fines on the A2 trajectory-control stretch are collected, whether fines still have a corrective effect, and whether the speed limit will be raised or changed. The minister answered that only about 2% of vehicles speed there, that high traffic volume and fewer active systems in 2014 explain the number of fines, and that a decision on raising the limit awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House this year about the options available on the A2.
Ik informeer uw Kamer dit jaar over de mogelijkheden die er zijn op de A2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de herijking van de spoorbudgetten

Mr Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about the rail budget reassessment (herijking), including which regional projects were funded, selection criteria, the PHS project's share of funds, and ProRail's cost norms and uncertainty margins. The State Secretary answered that the final package was decided after MIRT consultations, that remaining regional wishes will be pursued later, and gave detailed but largely indicative responses on costs and criteria.
Therefore, after the Nota Overleg MIRT, I will work together with the parties involved to seek financial room to take the desired additional steps.
Daarom zal ik ná het Nota Overleg MIRT samen met de betrokken partijen zoeken naar financiële ruimte om de geambieerde extra stappen te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de toepassing van het innovatieve concept ‘whisstone’

An MP asked the minister about the 'Whisstone' noise diffractor, whether it should be added to the Reken- en meetvoorschriften 2012 before wider use, and about regulatory barriers to innovation. The minister said pilots are already possible, that more evidence from further pilots is needed before the calculation rules can be changed, and that RIVM will be asked for an opinion once enough information exists.
Therefore Rijkswaterstaat will carry out additional pilots in 2015/2016 at 2 locations along the main road network, with extensive noise measurements.
Daarom gaat Rijkswaterstaat in 2015/2016 aanvullende pilots uitvoeren op 2 locaties langs het hoofdwegennet waarbij uitgebreide geluidsmetingen zullen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt, Bashir, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de afschaffing van de oldtimervrijstelling

MPs from CDA, SP, PVV and Van Vliet asked the Finance State Secretary about the revenue estimates for abolishing the classic-car tax exemption, the number of diesel and LPG cars affected, and the cost of extending transitional rules to them. The State Secretary defended revised revenue estimates of roughly 60 to 70 million euros, gave a table of affected vehicles, and rejected extending transitional rules to diesel and LPG cars because of budget and air-quality concerns.

In my letter on the classic car measure I only intended to indicate that, to reach the estimated revenue of 137 million euros, the second part of the revenue, the replacement cars, would need to yield 82 million euros in motor vehicle tax.

Ik heb in mijn brief over de oldtimermaatregel slechts willen aangegeven dat, om de geraamde opbrengst van € 137 miljoen te halen, het tweede deel van de opbrengst, de vervangende auto's, € 82 miljoen aan MRB zou moeten opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht «Voormalig NS-topman Huges spant kort geding aan om vergoeding»

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that former NS chief Huges sued for a large severance payment, whether his 2014 variable pay was reclaimed, and how NS governance and disclosure of the settlement work. The minister answered that the matter was settled out of court, the variable pay was repaid as part of the settlement, the shareholder discharge was granted, and the settlement will appear in the 2015 annual report, with the settlement document made available for confidential inspection.
I have made the settlement agreement itself available for confidential inspection.
De vaststellingsovereenkomst zelf heb ik ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht van een nieuwe financiële strop bij Utrecht Centraal Station

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a reported new cost overrun of 53 million euros at Utrecht Centraal Station, including whether the figure was validated, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, the relation to the DSSU project, and the timing of ProRail's notifications. The State Secretary answers that the overrun was confirmed after a 2014 external review and an agreement on risk allocation with Utrecht municipality in July 2015, that the Chamber was informed during the committee meeting, and that an overview of other station projects will follow.
Incidentally, on Thursday 10 September during the ProRail committee meeting I informed your Chamber that a budget adjustment for this project was at issue.
Ik heb overigens donderdag 10 september tijdens het AO ProRail uw Kamer geïnformeerd over dat er een budgetaanpassing bij dit project aan de orde is.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Helvert inzake het vliegen over conflictgebieden

An MP from the CDA asked the government about airlines, notably KLM, flying over conflict zones, whether the government can prevent this, and what contacts and information-sharing exist. The ministers answered that airlines are responsible for their own risk assessment, that the law gives no clear power to ban flights over foreign airspace, and that an ICAO information system is being developed.
However, this law contains no explicit provision that makes it possible to impose a ban on Dutch companies for flying in foreign airspace.
Deze wet bevat echter geen expliciete bepaling die het mogelijk maakt een verbod aan Nederlandse maatschappijen op te leggen voor het vliegen in buitenlands luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het nieuws dat de NS bezwaar maakt tegen Overijsselse lijnen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether NS's formal objection to a Syntus regional rail concession could delay the 2017 start, why NS would object to lines it also bid for, and how high-frequency service on Enschede-Almelo would be achieved. The State Secretary answered that the province is responsible for the regional concession, that all parties should seek a swift solution, that the high-frequency programme does not cover Enschede-Almelo, and that she would intervene if no agreement is reached.
If no agreement is reached, they can turn to me. If necessary I will ensure that a decision is made.
Indien geen overeenstemming wordt bereikt, dan kunnen zij zich tot mij wenden. Als het nodig is zal ik ervoor zorgen dat er een besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de miljoenenstrop die dreigt rond de verbouwing van station Utrecht

An MP asked the state secretary about a projected cost overrun of about EUR 29.5 million on the Utrecht station rebuild, why the ministry did not act earlier after ProRail's 2014 warning, and who would pay. The state secretary answered that the overrun is covered from the Infrastructure Fund, that an external investigation started in April 2015 and will report this autumn, and that the ministry's oversight was adequate.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of this investigation once it is completed.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer na afronding ervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Terrorist sprak in moskee’

Members Oskam and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a convicted terrorist and a controversial preacher spoke at the Al Houda mosque in Geleen and what authorities knew and did. The minister answered that police found no evidence that the man in the footage is Ouaboer or of any criminal offence, so no investigation was opened, and that the government considers preaching of intolerant or anti-democratic messages unacceptable, while declining to detail information sharing between agencies.
However, I will not go into further detail on the extent and manner in which information was shared between the authorities involved.
Ik zal echter niet nader ingaan op de mate en wijze waarop informatie is gedeeld tussen betrokken instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops inzake het bericht ‘Wintelre is overlast Eindhoven Airport zat’

MPs Van Helvert and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether route optimisation 1B has increased noise and fine-particle nuisance in Wintelre, and about noise monitoring, route evaluation, and compensation for Eindhoven Airport. The government acknowledges increased complaints, reports no rise in fine particles, promises extra noise monitoring before 1 October 2015, an evaluation after one year, and a decision on a compensation fund in September.
I am aware that route optimisation 1B has led residents of Wintelre to report more nuisance from air traffic.
Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat de routeoptimalisatie 1B ertoe heeft geleid dat de inwoners van Wintelre aangeven meer overlast te ervaren van het vliegverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «NS haalt huisadvocaat De Brauw van ontslagzaken»

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether NS shareholders were consulted when NS removed law firm De Brauw from the disciplinary (ontslag) cases and whether De Brauw should continue its investigation into misconduct at NS. The minister said consultation with the shareholder took place, defended De Brauw's use as normal, and pointed to a second opinion by Brenninkmeijer and an Orde van Advocaten review as safeguards.
Although I see no reason to question the integrity and critical attitude of De Brauw, I have announced that a second opinion on De Brauw's investigation will be carried out by Mr Alex Brenninkmeijer.

Hoewel ik geen aanleiding zie om de integriteit en de kritische houding van De Brauw in twijfel te trekken, heb ik aangekondigd een second opinion op het onderzoek van De Brauw uit te laten voeren door de heer Alex Brenninkmeijer.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over de onduidelijkheid over toeslagen op vliegtickets

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about unclear surcharges on airline tickets, including whether charges are controlled and how they are spent. The State Secretary answered that airlines set their own fares, that only Dutch government levies and the PRM levy are audited, and that existing EU transparency rules and ACM oversight are sufficient, declining to pursue new EU agreements or ACM advice.
It is not for the Netherlands to judge the desirability of another country's national levies.
Het is niet aan Nederland om een oordeel te geven over de wenselijkheid van de nationale heffingen van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over een nieuw benoemde executive vice president bij de holding Air France KLM

An MP asked whether the appointment of a new executive vice president at the Air France KLM holding in Paris conflicts with the minister's March 2015 assurance that KLM activities would not be further centralised there, and whether the minister would act against this 'salami tactics'. The minister replied that the appointment was agreed before March 2015, that no further centralisation is planned, that no action is needed, and that the agreements were documented in a signed conversation report placed before the House.
The agreements from the meeting with Mr De Juniac are recorded in a conversation report signed by the presidents-directors of Air France KLM and KLM and by myself.
De afspraken uit het overleg met de heer De Juniac zijn vastgelegd in een gespreksverslag dat is ondertekend door de president-directeuren van Air France KLM en KLM en door mijzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Helvert over onjuiste informatie over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Hoogland and Van Helvert asked the Infrastructure and Environment state secretary about inaccurate information on trains carrying dangerous goods, including inspection powers, ProRail's role, unregistered cargo and ghost/orphan wagons. The state secretary answered that the ILT's powers and resources are adequate, that ProRail is not a supervisor, that a legal duty to register non-dangerous goods is not currently warranted, and that improvement will be pursued with the sector.
The powers and enforcement options the ILT has at its disposal I consider sufficient, as are the resources available for them.
De bevoegdheden en handhavingmogelijkheden die de ILT voorhanden heeft, acht ik voldoende, evenals de daarvoor beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over het bericht dat bij de A4 bij Steenbergen geluidsschermen staan bij onbewoonde en gesloopte huizen

MPs Van Helvert and Ronnes asked why noise barriers were built along the A4 at Steenbergen next to homes that were bought and demolished, and whether this wasteful situation can be prevented, and whether residents without barriers will get relief. The minister explained the barriers serve as noise protection for remaining homes and the building plots, that all measures follow the Tracébesluit and noise law, and that no money is wasted.
All barriers along the route have a function in dampening noise.
Alle schermen langs het tracé hebben een functie in het dempen van geluid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Helvert over jeugdzorg voor gezinnen die in het buitenland wonen, maar werken en/of schoolgaan in Nederland

MPs Keijzer and Van Helvert asked how youth care applies to families living abroad but working or schooling in the Netherlands, and whether the Jeugdwet decentralisation removed their access to youth mental health care. The state secretary answered that the residence principle of the Jeugdwet excludes these children, that EU social security coordination covers only insured care, and that a transitional arrangement runs for a maximum of one year.
I will check with the VNG whether there are specific bottlenecks in implementing the transitional arrangement.
Ik zal met de VNG wel nagaan of er bij de uitvoering van het overgangsrecht specifieke knelpunten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het boetebeleid dat gemeenten hanteren middels de buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren en over het overnemen van een parkeerkaartje

MPs Oskam and Van Helvert asked about inconsistent municipal fining policy by enforcement officers (boa's), whether boa's should take on more police fining powers, and the legality of transferring a parking ticket. The government replied that local enforcement differences are a municipal matter, it opposes extending boa fining powers into police territory, and it will not change the fiscal parking rules, while noting that no administrative fine but a tax assessment is imposed for ticket transfer.
Given local circumstances and differences in the nature and extent of nuisance, there is no need for national uniformity in government action against local nuisance.
Gelet op de lokale omstandigheden en verschillen in de aard en omvang van overlast is er geen noodzaak tot (landelijke) eenheid in overheidsoptreden bij de aanpak van lokale overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over ZZP-piloten

An MP asked the state secretary how it can be concluded that freelance (ZZP) pilot contracts are not widely used by Dutch airlines when no exact data exist, and whether EASA should be asked to act on the safety and working-condition concerns. The state secretary said the conclusion rests on informal contacts with airlines and the pilots' association, that obtaining data would require weighing the burden on firms, that EASA has examined the risks and found no safety problem with ongoing monitoring, and that the ministry will discuss pilots' labour position with the social affairs ministry.
I do not have this data.
Over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat Brussel registratie van rij- en rusttijden van bestelauto’s wil

An MP asked the minister whether the EU plans to require tachograph recording of driving and rest times for delivery vans, and what the consequences would be for the Netherlands. The minister replied that the Commission is not considering extending the tachograph obligation to vans, that the 2014 regulation does not require digital tachographs in vans, and that no lobbying against the measure is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over het dreigende gat in de begroting door de snel stijgende verkoop van o.a. de Volvo XC90

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal risk from rising sales of plug-in hybrids such as the Volvo XC90 T8, the low company-car tax base, the Algemene Rekenkamer's recommendations on tax incentives for efficient cars, and whether the bijtelling increase should be accelerated. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures on lost tax revenue and referred the test-method and actual-consumption questions to other sources, but declined to accelerate the measure, citing lack of support and practical objections, and deferred the rest to the Autobrief 2.0.
In autumn 2014 I informed the House of the need to include additional measures for 2016 in the car taxes.
Ik heb in het najaar van 2014 de Kamer geïnformeerd over de noodzaak om aanvullende maatregelen voor het jaar 2016 voor de autobelastingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht over het bericht “Zorgen om zzp-piloten”

Parliamentary member Van Helvert asks whether the government considers it desirable that pilots in pay-to-fly and self-employed (zzp) arrangements carry responsibility in aircraft, and whether national measures should be taken. The state secretary replies that licensing ensures competence, EASA's analysis finds no proven urgent safety problem, Dutch use of such contracts is not known to be widespread, and no national intervention is currently deemed necessary, though EASA's management board will be pressed to act.
There is no exact data available on how many of these work at Dutch airlines.
Er zijn geen exacte gegevens beschikbaar hoeveel hiervan bij Nederlandse maatschappijen werkzaam zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Franse staat vergroot zeggenschap bij Air France-KLM”

An MP from the CDA asked whether the Dutch state should increase its stake in Air France-KLM after France raised its holding, and whether commitments by Air France-KLM's chief on KLM jobs and guarantees should be laid down in a new memorandum of understanding, along with questions on airport security cost models and Gulf carriers at Schiphol. The government replied that the French stake increase is not fundamental, that the Netherlands will not take a larger stake, that the 2010 MoU guarantees are already fixed while other commitments are being examined for formal recording, and that Gulf carriers are not being banned from Schiphol.
KLM and Air France KLM are currently considering whether and how these agreements can be recorded.
KLM en Air France KLM bezien thans of en hoe deze afspraken zijn vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma, Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de nadelige gevolgen voor kloosterlingen, indien de kostendelersnorm ook voor AOW wordt ingevoerd

MPs Heerma, Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether the household-sharing norm for the AOW pension would harm monastic residents and when the study on its effects on informal care would be ready. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted the exemption for commercial arrangements, said implementation was postponed to 1 July 2016 and promised the decision-making would be sent to Parliament before summer 2015.
My aim is to send the decision-making on the household-sharing norm in the AOW, in relation to effects on informal care, to both Chambers of the States General before summer 2015.
Mijn inzet is om de besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in de AOW in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg voor de zomer van 2015 naar beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het krantenartikel ‘Regeltjes nekken bloemencorso’

An MP asked the ministers about newspaper reports that rules were hampering a flower parade (bloemencorso), whether stricter rules were justified, and about Rijkswaterstaat's role in transporting carnival floats on the A76. The minister answered that local events fall under municipal permits, the state sets no explicit rules for them, and float transport on motorways cannot be permitted under the current traffic law.
The national government is not a party to the organisation of local events.
Het rijk is geen partij bij de organisatie van lokale evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Limburgse gemeenten in de fout met bewaren agenda’s

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked the minister about reports that most Limburg municipalities delete wethouders' digital agendas when they leave office, contrary to the seven-year Archiefwet term. The minister did not dispute the findings, said there is no systematic oversight of municipal compliance, and pointed to digital archiving programmes and a letter sent to the VNG.
The ministry keeps no systematic records of how sub-national governments carry out their tasks, and therefore also not of how municipalities comply with the Archives Act requirements.
Het ministerie houdt geen systematische administratie bij van de naleving van taken door medeoverheden en derhalve ook niet van de wijze waarop gemeenten de voorschriften van de Archiefwet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig”

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a motorist who took over a transferred parking ticket that was still valid was fined, and whether the rules should allow such tickets to be passed on. The minister answered that these are two separately taxable facts, that there is no refund or transfer of remaining parking time, and that changing the regulation is not necessary based on this single case.
Changing the substantive basis of the relevant regulations as a foundation is not necessary in my view based on this single case.
Wijziging van de inhoudelijke grondslag als fundament voor de terzake doende regelgeving acht ik niet noodzakelijk op basis van deze ene casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de inpassing van A13 en A16 bij Lansingerland

The MP asks whether the government took note of a residents' proposal to lower the N471 crossing near Lansingerland and why Rijkswaterstaat dropped it from the participation table, and how this fits the Participation Code. The minister answers that the variant fell outside the scope of the Standpunt, was examined anyway, costs about 36 million euro more, and was not pursued in the draft route decision, though it may play a role in regional measures.
The proposed variant for lowering the crossing with the N471 does not fit within the scope of the Standpunt, which is in principle reason not to consider this variant further.
De ingebrachte variant voor verlaging van de kruising met de N471 past niet binnen de scope van het Standpunt en dat is in principe reden om deze variant niet nader in beschouwing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de gevolgen van in Nederland begane verkeersovertredingen met auto’s met een buitenlands kenteken

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of traffic fines against foreign-plated vehicles, including data exchange under the Cross Border Enforcement directive, collection rates, and a 2013 Wob request by RTL. The minister answered that the new directive was adopted in March 2015, that enforcement of French plates began in December 2014 and Polish plates was still being prepared, that collection rates are partial, and that the RTL request was partly granted after court proceedings, with some information unavailable.
RTL did not receive data overviews because there were no overviews or other documents within my ministry containing such data.
RTL heeft geen data-overzichten ontvangen, omdat er zich geen overzichten of andere documenten binnen mijn ministerie bevonden waarin dergelijke data zijn opgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de aanvraag van carnavalsverenigingen in Limburg om in het kader van halfvasten carnavalswagens via de A76 over de Maas naar België te vervoeren, op 8 en 22 maart, zoals da

An MP asked why Rijkswaterstaat refused permission for Limburg carnival floats to cross the A76 motorway into Belgium during half-Lent, when Belgian authorities permit it with police escort. The minister answered that the request was new, that the floats would travel too slowly and endanger safety under the Road Traffic Act, and that police deployment is not the ministry's responsibility.
In the case of this carnival procession, the mandatory requirements set by the Road Traffic Act 1994 are not met.
In het geval van deze carnavalsoptocht wordt niet voldaan aan de dwingende eisen die de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid op het spoor

MP Van Helvert asked the state secretary about rail safety after a passenger and freight train collided at Tilburg, including progress on safer routing of hazardous goods, use of the EUR 3 million noise budget, Betuweroute diversions, the absence of a buffer wagon, and a noise screen in Breda. The state secretary answered that the Basisnet law took effect on 1 April 2015 with risk ceilings, that EUR 15 million was allocated to Dordrecht, Zwijndrecht and Tilburg, that the noise budget is fully spent, and that the Breda screen question is the responsibility of the project developer; it also said hazardous-goods volumes through Brabant cannot be predicted.
How much hazardous material will ultimately be transported through the Brabant cities cannot be predicted.
Hoeveel gevaarlijke stoffen uiteindelijk door de Brabantse steden vervoerd zullen worden, laat zich niet voorspellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether delays threaten several lock projects, what the economic effects would be, which consultations were held, and how regional builders can be involved. The minister denied that delays are expected, said the schedules are stable, and gave a project timetable with planned start years.
Because I do not intend to delay these projects, no economic consequences are expected.
Omdat ik niet voornemens ben om deze projecten te vertragen, zijn hier geen economische consequenties van te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van spoortunnels

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the state secretary about a press report that safety rules for rail tunnels might be relaxed, the causes of false fire alarms, which bodies shape tunnel safety policy, and whether tunnels meet safety requirements and training obligations. The state secretary answered that rules are not being loosened, that the update of the Derde Kadernota Railveiligheid is ongoing with a report to parliament by end 2015, and that tunnels meet requirements with minor shortcomings already fixed.
The outcomes of all discussions will be taken into account in the update of the Third Railway Safety Framework Memorandum, on which I will inform your House in more detail at the end of 2015.
De uitkomsten van alle gesprekken worden betrokken bij de actualisatie van de Derde Kadernota Railveiligheid waarover ik uw Kamer eind 2015 nader zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over KLM en Air France

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether contracts and agreements between the state and Air France KLM and KLM since the merger should be sent to parliament, and whether a January 2015 press release showed that KLM's cash management had been centralised under the Air France KLM holding. The state secretary replied that no new agreements or contracts had been concluded since 2004 beyond a 2010 memorandum on state guarantees, and that the holding's president had confirmed KLM keeps autonomous financial management in Amstelveen.

Since the merger in 2004, no new agreements have been recorded or contracts concluded, apart from the memorandum of understanding of 25 May 2010 on extending part of the state guarantees, which was sent with the letter of 3 March.

Sinds de fusie in 2004 zijn er geen nieuwe afspraken vastgelegd of contracten gesloten, naast het met de genoemde brief van 3 maart jl. meegestuurde memorandum of understanding van 25 mei 2010 inzake verlenging van een deel van de staatsgaranties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about road safety on the N36 after a site visit and about the timing of planned improvement measures. The minister said some measures will be realised in 2015-2016 by folding them into existing contracts, while the rest will follow in 2017-2018 with no possibility of acceleration, and offered to discuss a grade-separated junction with the region if it takes the initiative and funds it.
Acceleration of these schedules is not among the possibilities.
Versnelling van deze planningen behoort niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over sluiting van tunnels in de A73

Member Van Helvert (CDA) asked the minister about the roughly 600 closures of the A73 tunnels at Roermond and Swalmen in 2014, the applicable availability norms, how to reduce unplanned closures, and freight rail versus road safety data for hazardous substances. The minister disputed that closures were excessive (98.8% availability), noted a 98% national availability standard and a uniform tunnel standard, planned to reduce scheduled closures from 11 to 9, and declined to express a general modal preference.
RWS consults with the industry to inform transport companies about the permitted height and about heeding warnings for an overly high truck.
RWS voert overleg met de branche om transportbedrijven te informeren over de toegestane hoogte en het opvolgen van waarschuwingen bij een te hoge vrachtwagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van tunnels

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about safety defects in Dutch national tunnels (Schiphol, Wijker, Zeeburger and Coen tunnels) reported by EenVandaag, and whether the tunnels meet Rijkswaterstaat's own safety standards. The minister answered that all tunnels comply with the tunnel law, that identified defects were remedied on schedule, that inspection findings are programming tools rather than signs of immediate danger, and rejected the claim that the cause is backlog maintenance or removal of independent oversight.
No, the tunnels are adequately maintained by Rijkswaterstaat to keep the tunnel safe and therefore available for traffic.
Nee, de tunnels worden door Rijkswaterstaat adequaat onderhouden om de tunnel veilig en daarmee beschikbaar voor het verkeer te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het strooibeleid bij gladheid

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about delayed gritting of the A2 in Limburg on 24 January 2015 and how winter road treatment timing is decided and coordinated, and whether accident data by road section can be shared. The minister answered that the Limburg response was not longer than usual because the snow moved from west to east, that gritting is coordinated with decentralised authorities, and that Rijkswaterstaat has only an incomplete incident overview for that day that cannot show which accidents were caused by slippery roads.
Rijkswaterstaat does not keep an exhaustive record of all accidents caused by slipperiness.
Rijkswaterstaat houdt niet uitputtend alle ongelukken bij die veroorzaakt zijn door gladheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het grote aantal ongevallen met dodelijke afloop op de rijksweg N36 tussen Almelo en Ommen

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the minister for an overview of fatal and serious accidents on the N36 between Almelo and Ommen, its casualty rates against comparable national roads, and the timing of promised safety measures. The minister supplied accident counts, fatality figures, a risk comparison showing the N36 slightly above average, and said the measures will be built between 2015 and 2018 with a further safety decision pending.
The number of seriously injured in this period is not yet known.
Het aantal zwaargewonden in deze periode is nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de bevriezing van de A50 en de A59

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why the A50 and A59 were left frozen overnight and whether preventive closures or an evaluation would be appropriate. The minister replied that warnings were issued and Rijkswaterstaat gritted preventively and curatively, that preventive closures would cause more inconvenience, and that a separate evaluation was not currently considered necessary, though Rijkswaterstaat is reviewing the situation.
Rijkswaterstaat is reviewing how the situation on the A50/A59 unfolded and whether there are points for improvement.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt hoe de situatie op de A50/A59 is verlopen en of er verbeterpunten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het station in Eijsden

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment why station Eijsden remains on the main rail network served by NS, why it was not transferred to the regional authority, and what barriers prevent another operator from serving it. The State Secretary answered that NS already serves the station via a cross-border Maastricht-Luik service, that transfer of the station is not legally possible, that technical and economic barriers exist but are solvable, and that dialogue with the province can continue through existing channels.
There is no reason to enter into consultation about transferring the train service to Eijsden to the decentralised authority.
Er is geen aanleiding om in overleg te treden over een overdracht van de treindienst naar Eijsden aan de decentrale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Helvert en Oskam over het grondwaterproblemen in de Vliettunnel Leidschendam

MPs Van Helvert and Oskam (CDA) asked the minister about recurring groundwater problems in the Vliettunnel in Leidschendam that forced closures, and whether lowering the groundwater level could be explored with the province and water board. The minister confirmed the problems and said a study on a structural solution, including groundwater lowering and other options, is underway with completion expected in summer 2015.
That is why I am now having research carried out into a structural solution.
Daarom laat ik nu onderzoek doen naar een structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Opnieuw ongeval met vrachtwagens op A73”

An MP asked the minister whether the A73 stretch has a disproportionate accident rate, whether a truck tank carrying hydrochloric acid could split open given safety rules, and what the response would be. The minister answered that the stretch is not more accident-prone than comparable roads, that the tank complied with all rules, and that the rupture was an unforeseen accident.
The risk of an accident on the stretches you mention is also not greater than the average risk of an accident on a comparable road (2x2 motorway) elsewhere in the Netherlands.
Het risico op een ongeval op de door u genoemde weggedeelten is ook niet groter dan het gemiddelde risico op een ongeval op een vergelijkbare weg (2x2 autosnelweg) elders in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over ongevallen op de A73 en de A2

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the answers on accidents on the A73 should also cover the A2, especially the junction at Maasbracht. The minister referred to the answers to questions 2 and 3 and to earlier questions on the A73.
See my answers to questions 2 and 3
Zie mijn antwoorden op vragen 2 en 3

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de voor 3 februari geplande vliegshow met onbemande commerciële systemen (drones) op vliegveld Valkenburg niet door dreigt te gaan

MPs Van Helvert and Agnes Mulder asked whether the planned drone show at Valkenburg airfield, part of the TUSExpo 2015 event, is threatened by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf starting demolition of the runway, whether consultation took place, and why demolition begins now. The minister answers that the demolition follows a Masterplan and a contract signed in December 2013 that was widely known, that the organisers only contacted the agency on 26 January, that the agency offered alternative venues which were declined, and that the sloop proceeds under that contract.
The demolition has therefore been known for some time and has received media attention.
De sloop is hierdoor geruime tijd bekend en heeft media-aandacht genoten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de kaspositie van KLM

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether KLM's roughly 1 billion euro cash position will stay under KLM's own management, whether KLM keeps control of its financial management, and whether the SAK foundations and MoU remain in force. State Secretary Mansveld answered that Air France KLM reported no plans to transfer KLM's surplus cash to the holding, that KLM will retain autonomy over its cash, banking and hedging, and that the foundations and MoU are maintained, though no final decision on financial management had yet been taken.

This means that KLM as an independent airline can continue to invest (such as in fleet financing) and remains responsible for its own cash flows, bank relations, management of its financial cash position and execution of its own hedging.

Dit betekent namelijk dat KLM als zelfstandige luchtvaartmaatschappij kan blijven investeren (zoals ten aanzien van vlootfinanciering) en verantwoordelijk blijft voor haar eigen kasstromen, bankrelaties, beheer van de financiële kaspositie en uitvoering van haar eigen «hedging».

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de bereidheid van de provincie Overijssel en de gemeente Raalte om zelf (mede) te investeren in de aanpak van het knelpunt in de N35 bij Raalte (kruispunt-Bos N35/N348)

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister whether the province of Overijssel and the municipality of Raalte are willing to co-invest in fixing the N35/N348 junction, and whether national funds can be used for a level crossing there. The Minister confirmed the local willingness, pointed to the signed 15 million euro package (10 million provincial, 5 million national) that includes this junction, declined extra national money, and said the level-crossing budgets cannot fund it while the municipality has not yet responded on the project scope.
I see no reason to make additional funds available for the N35 Wijthmen-Nijverdal beyond the funds already provided.
Ik zie geen reden om naast de reeds beschikbaar gestelde middelen, additionele middelen beschikbaar te stellen voor de N35 Wijthmen-Nijverdal.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de plannen om het financiële beheer van KLM van Nederland naar Frankrijk over te hevelen en daarmee KLM een groot deel van haar resterende autonomie te laten ve

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Air France KLM plans to move KLM's financial management to Paris, whether the Memorandum of Understanding and other agreements are respected, and related questions on the state's shareholding and KLM's profits. The State Secretary answered that concrete plans are not yet known, that the state's influence as shareholder is limited, that the 2010 MoU safeguards KLM's Dutch base and hub network, and offered confidential inspection of the MoU.
I am willing to make this Memorandum of Understanding and the agreements with the State available for confidential inspection.
Ik ben bereid om dit Memorandum of Understanding en de afspraken met de Staat vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over storingen bij ProRail en de personeelsactie op 2 december 2014 bij NS

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about rail disruptions on 2 December 2014 caused by a morning staff meeting at NS in The Hague, and about the causes of reported disruptions, staff grievances, and steps to make the network more robust. The state secretary answered that the meeting was effectively a work stoppage, that NS estimates about 40,000 passengers were delayed, that the government has no formal role in employer-employee contacts, and that infrastructure disruption counts show no increase in recent years.
I have no formal role or involvement in the contacts between employers and employees, including at NS.
Ik heb geen formele rol of betrokkenheid bij de contacten tussen werkgevers en werknemers, ook niet bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat de techniek faalt in de zogenaamde combi-tunnel in Nijverdal

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether she was aware of reports that technology fails in the Nijverdal combi-tunnel, what actions have been taken, the cause and timing of fixes, and whether similar ICT is used elsewhere. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that data communication between tunnel systems is not yet working, that the cause is still under investigation with no firm reopening date, and that other tunnels use comparable systems with measures to be taken once the problem is understood.
Until it is clear which adjustments exactly need to be made, it is not known when the tunnel can be fully reopened.
Totdat duidelijk is welke aanpassingen precies moeten worden gedaan, is niet bekend wanneer de tunnel volledig kan worden opengesteld.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Geen Q-koortsvergoeding voor een op de vijf slachtoffers'

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about roughly 600 rejected Q-fever compensation applications (about 20%) and whether applicants were wrongly excluded. The minister replied that rejected applicants did not meet the eligibility criteria, that the scheme was broadened after consultation with parliament, and that appeal procedures and an independent medical commission already reviewed the refusals.
For the rejected applications, objection and appeal procedures were available.
Voor de afgewezen aanvragen heeft er bezwaar en beroep opengestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht 'Faillissement van BOPEC kost overheid Bonaire € 300.000'

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about the bankruptcy of oil company BOPEC on Bonaire, its skeleton crew for safety risks, union involvement, responsibility for safety, the role of government policy, and the Bonaire public body's bridging credit. The government answered that the curator and regulators (ILT, RWS) selected the skeleton crew after a union-agreed list became unworkable, that safety responsibility lies with the licence holder and then the curator, and that the Bonaire body granted a 250,000 USD contribution consistent with the Wet FinBES.
The OLB has in the meantime committed a contribution of 250,000 dollars.
Het OLB heeft inmiddels een bijdrage van 250.000 dollar toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht ‘Raad van State Rijkswet COHO strijdig met Statuut’

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether the COHO Kingdom Act was checked for legal compliance with the Statute, and about its consequences if the Council of State finds it conflicts with the Statute. The State Secretary answered that legal review took place, though under time pressure and only partially, that the Council of State did not find a conflict but has doubts on some parts, and that the consequences for the country packages and financial support are still being discussed with the Caribbean countries.
The department preparing the bill is primarily responsible for a proposal, and therefore also for its legal quality.
Het departement dat het wetsvoorstel voorbereidt is primair verantwoordelijk voor een voorstel, en dus ook voor de juridische kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Diertens over het delen van genetisch testmateriaal van Nederlanders met de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

Two MPs from D66 asked the health minister whether negotiations to send Dutch COVID test genetic material to laboratories in the United Arab Emirates complied with GDPR, whether it was anonymised, and whether misuse was a risk. The minister replied that the negotiations had been stopped, that all privacy risks were examined and a limited residual risk remained, and that other, more durable solutions for test capacity had been found.
There was a limited residual risk, and since other, more durable solutions had by then been found to increase test capacity, it was decided to stop the negotiations.

Er was sprake van een beperkt restrisico, en aangezien op dat moment ook al andere, meer duurzame oplossingen waren gevonden om de testcapaciteit te vergroten, is besloten de onderhandelingen stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de ontwikkelingen van de gezondheidssituatie op Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 hospitalisations, the call centre, vaccination capacity, reduced regular care and overload risk on Bonaire and Curaçao, and whether a negative PCR test should be required for travellers to the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered with figures, reports of resolved call-centre problems, cross-island patient transfers, and the designation of the islands as high-risk areas with testing obligations.
Talks are also being held about transferring patients to other countries in the region when local capacity proves insufficient despite joint efforts.
Ook worden gesprekken gevoerd over de overplaatsing van patiënten naar andere landen in de regio, wanneer de lokale capaciteit ondanks gezamenlijke inspanningen onvoldoende blijken te zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot en Diertens (beiden D66) over de berichten ‘Verzet tegen nieuwe vrachthaven Bonaire, aanleg zou ‘ecocide’ zijn’ en het bericht ‘conservebonaire.org opposes Hato port’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that a proposed new cargo port on Bonaire would harm the coral reef, its financing, environmental impact assessment, and transparency. The minister answered that no decision to build a port has been taken, that feasibility studies and an MER are still pending and will be shared later, and that the island council (Bestuurscollege) is responsible for the decision.
For now, there is no decision to build a new cargo port (location).
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van een besluit tot het bouwen van een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het terugtrekken van Nederlandse banken uit de BES-eilanden

Diertens (D66) asked whether ABN AMRO's plan to close euro accounts held by residents of the Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) affects access to banking, and whether residents have a right to a basic payment account. The minister confirmed the risk of higher costs, said residents have no EU basic-account right as overseas territories, and reported ongoing talks with banks and a planned regulatory change to ease euro account offerings.
I am therefore preparing an amendment to the Besluit financiële markten BES so that Dutch European banks may offer payment accounts in the Caribbean Netherlands without an additional licence.
Ik bereid daarom een wijziging van het Besluit financiële markten BES voor waardoor Europees Nederlandse banken betaalrekeningen in Caribisch Nederland mogen aanbieden zonder extra vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘BAM sloopt koraalrif en de Curaçaose overheid haalt de schouders op’

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about BAM's damage to a coral reef on Curaçao and whether BAM can be held accountable in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the matter is a Curaçao responsibility, that Curaçao has sued BAM for compensation, and that the Dutch government expects companies to follow OECD guidelines, while no concrete Dutch action was announced.
It is up to the Curaçao government to hold the construction company responsible for the damage it has caused.
Het is aan de Curaçaose overheid om het bouwbedrijf verantwoordelijk te stellen voor de schade die zij hebben aangericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Bergkamp en Diertens over aanwijzing ex artikel 34, eerste lid, Wet publieke gezondheid

MPs Groothuizen, Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister about designating the UMCG as a site for forced Covid-19 isolation, how often the emergency powers under the Public Health Act have been used, and how quarantine and legal protection would be handled. The minister answered that the designation was overdue, that only six isolation orders were issued by two regions with one court extension request refused, and that quarantine powers were not used, with further legislation on quarantine announced.
With this decision, the formal situation is finally arranged so that a hospital is designated at the moment a safety region chair imposes a mandatory isolation order.
Met dit besluit wordt alsnog de formele situatie geregeld dat er een ziekenhuis is aangewezen op het moment dat een voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio een verplichte isolatie beschikking oplegt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het bericht 'Ombudsman wil meer aandacht voor obstakels Caribische studenten'

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on obstacles faced by Caribbean students in Dutch higher education, including study results, healthcare, BSN numbers and loan repayment. The minister answered that the government is working on improvement measures, has commissioned research and a regional steering group, and promised further letters and investigations on several points.
I have pointed out the Ombudsman's report to my fellow education ministers in the Kingdom.
