Ik heb mijn collega-ministers van onderwijs in het Koninkrijk gewezen op het rapport van de Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over tekortkomingen bij het Instituut Sportrechtspraak

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortcomings at the Instituut Sportrechtspraak (ISR), including halted cases of former gymnasts, case duration, melder safety, capacity and alternatives for athletes. The minister answered that cases are not halted but under external review, promised extra funding and a kwartiermaker for professionalisation, and said the KNGU talks and aftercare will follow the April investigation outcomes.
The Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is an independent organisation.
Het Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak (ISR) is een onafhankelijke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over incorrecte cijfers van ziekenhuisopnames en de besluitvorming hieromtrent

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why COVID-19 hospital admission figures differed between data sources (OSIRIS, Stichting NICE, LCPS) and how this affected decisions on extra measures in September and October 2020. The minister answered in detail that the sources count admissions differently, that the dashboard was updated, that signal values and OMT advice guided decisions, and that the government would not commit to new action.
However, I have not managed to answer this before a next debate on the developments surrounding the coronavirus.
Het is mij echter niet gelukt om dit vóór een volgend debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over besmetting aan boord van vliegtuigen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about in-flight COVID-19 transmission on a Dubai to Auckland flight, the role of APUs and masks, and the status of the NLR/RIVM study. The minister acknowledged that some measures were not fully applied on the flight, explained APU use and mask exceptions, pointed to layered measures and new flight bans, and said the study report is expected around March.
The aviation committee debate of 4 February has been postponed.
Het AO Luchtvaart van 4 februari jl. is uitgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het bericht dat het reisadvies van Curaçao naar oranje is bijgesteld

Two D66 MPs asked why the travel advice for Curaçao was changed to orange only on 8 December 2020 despite a record number of infections, how many Dutch travellers had booked trips, and why returning travellers from Curaçao were not tested while Atlanta flights were. Minister De Jonge answered that the advice followed rising infections and that Curaçao is no longer a high-risk area since 8 January, so no PCR or antigen test is required, while giving partial figures on travel volumes and declining to address booking numbers directly.
Can you answer these questions within a week, given the start of the Christmas holiday next week?
Vraag 12 Kunt u, vanwege de start van de kerstvakantie volgende week, deze vragen binnen een week beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over reizen tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked ministers why travel advice for Curaçao and other Caribbean and Canary Island destinations seemed inconsistent with the Prime Minister's call not to travel abroad, and why airlines were promoting trips. The ministers answered that a worldwide orange travel advice now applies, that airlines and tour operators agreed to limit package holidays and add PCR and rapid testing requirements, and that testing of arriving travellers is being assessed for capacity.
On 15 December 2020 the travel advice was adjusted worldwide to orange.
Op 15 december 2020 is het reisadvies wereldwijd aangepast naar oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Onzekerheid over vaccinatiedatum BES en CAS'

An MP asked the state secretaries about preparations for COVID-19 vaccination on the Caribbean Dutch islands and Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten, including logistics, staffing, cold chain and undocumented residents. The government answered that plans and cold-chain equipment are in place, vaccination of healthcare staff and over-60s is intended from mid-February subject to RIVM approval, and it referred to earlier letters for quantities and timelines.
My intention is therefore to start vaccinating this group in mid-February.
Mijn voornemen is dan ook om half februari te starten met het vaccineren van deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland

MPs Jetten and Diertens (D66) asked the health minister about the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy, including why logistics for the BioNTech/Pfizer vaccine (ultra-cold storage, 975-dose packs) were not anticipated earlier, why care workers were prioritised over frail elderly, and why the start was late. The minister answered that preparations began before summer 2020, RIVM discussed packaging with Pfizer from October and repacking proved unfeasible, and the strategy was adjusted after Gezondheidsraad advice.
The RIVM was not surprised that the vaccine was packaged differently from vaccines normally used, for example against flu.
Het RIVM was niet verrast dat het vaccin anders verpakt was dan vaccins die regulier worden ingezet, bijvoorbeeld tegen de griep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over het bericht van NOS Sport op 21 december 2020, 'Sportrechtbank kraakt door machtsmisbruikzaken: dit is groter dan het turnen'

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked the minister, after a NOS report on the Sports Arbitration Institute (ISR) being overwhelmed by abuse-of-power complaints, about funding, volunteer judges, timelines for handling the gymnastics cases, and planned professionalisation. The minister answered that structural funding from 2021 and an extra 1 million euro from 2022 will enable Berenschot's recommendations, while giving timelines and capacity figures but no firm deadlines for the pending cases.
Yes, from 2021 there is structural financial support for the ISR.
Ja, vanaf 2021 is er sprake van een structurele financiële ondersteuning aan het ISR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Zeventien illegalen ontsnappen uit detentie op Curaçao'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the escape of 17 migrants from detention on Curaçao, Dutch involvement in the search, the number of Venezuelan detainees, access to legal aid, a repatriation flight, and arrests during the curfew. The government answered that Dutch authorities were not involved in the search, that 26 Venezuelans were held in detention on 12 December, and that asylum and return policy is a matter for Curaçao, with the Curaçao authorities reporting on legal aid and voluntary departures.
Asylum, reception and return policy, including providing legal aid to foreigners, is a matter for the country of Curaçao.
Asiel-, opvang- en terugkeerbeleid, waaronder ook het bieden van juridische bijstand aan vreemdelingen, is een aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het artikel 'Eerste besmetting met westnijlvirus in Nederland'

D66 MPs De Groot and Diertens asked the ministers about the first human West Nile virus infection in the Netherlands, expected case numbers, measures against mosquitoes, and a letter warning about the tiger mosquito. The minister said case forecasts are not possible, mosquito control for West Nile is still under study with a first advice expected in December, and the tiger mosquito is unrelated to West Nile transmission and is already being eradicated by the NVWA.
A first advice from the zoonoses response team is expected at the beginning of December.
Begin december wordt een eerste advies verwacht vanuit het responsteam zoönosen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over de relatie tussen besmetting met de parasiet Toxoplasma gondii en het risico op ongevallen en geestelijke aandoeningen

MPs Diertsen and De Groot asked whether Toxoplasma gondii infection is linked to traffic accidents and mental disorders, what is known about infection rates and prevention in the Netherlands, and whether prevention is proportionate. The minister answered that the associations are not causal, that the Dutch evidence finds no link to depression or anxiety, and that current prevention and consumer advice are the best feasible approach, with a committed cost-benefit review and a meat-safety project underway.
It therefore cannot be concluded that toxoplasmosis increases the chance of being involved in a traffic accident.
Er kan dus niet worden geconcludeerd dat toxoplasmose de kans vergroot om betrokken te raken bij een verkeersongeval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het plots sluiten van de teststraat op Schiphol

MPs Paternotte and Diertens (D66) asked the Health Minister why the Schiphol testing facility for travellers from high-risk areas was suddenly closed, whether it was a trial, and related questions on testing policy. The minister answered that the facility was a voluntary sample-based trial, closed because of pressure on lab capacity, and provided some figures but gave only partial answers on the trial design and did not commit to reopening.
The intention to close the test facility once the trial results came in is indeed something I did not mention.
Het voornemen om de teststraat weer te sluiten nadat de resultaten van de proef binnen zouden komen, heb ik inderdaad niet genoemd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over de kabinetsreactie op het 73e OMT COVID-19 advies en de berichten over het testbeleid van Duitsland en Frankrijk, respectievelijk het bericht over

MPs from D66 asked the health and infrastructure ministers about testing of travellers from high-risk countries, airport contact tracing, air cargo capacity and pricing for vaccine distribution, and EU vaccine negotiations. The ministers answered that testing and quarantine measures are being developed, that contact tracing follows RIVM guidance, and that logistics preparations and EU negotiations are ongoing, but declined to answer each question separately.
Unfortunately, this has not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over incorrecte cijfers van ziekenhuisopnames

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the Minister of Health why hospital admission figures on the coronavirus dashboard were wrong, when the ministry knew, whether Parliament was informed, and whether meeting records and advice of the BAO and OMT could be shared. The minister explained that the discrepancy came mainly from broader testing rather than delayed reporting, that the dashboard switched to NICE data on 13 October, and refused to release OMT and BAO minutes citing confidentiality and Article 68 of the Constitution while sharing some advice.
I do not have OMT minutes available and they are not public.
OMT-verslagen heb ik niet beschikbaar en zijn niet openbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over een onderzoek van de Raad voor de rechtshandhaving naar de bejegening van in bewaring gestelde vreemdelingen in Curaçao en het AIV-rapport ‘Veiligheid en recht

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about a Raad voor de rechtshandhaving inspection of detention conditions for migrants in Curaçao, the AIV advisory report on Caribbean security, the ombudsman's complaint that his recommendations are ignored, lack of legal aid and NGO access for Venezuelans, two minors reportedly detained, a Human Rights Institute recommendation, and a recent fire at the SDKK facility. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao decides whether to adopt inspection recommendations, though the Netherlands keeps pressing for improvements and Curaçao's project plan includes recommended measures, declined to intervene in the ombudsman matter, said legal aid is Curaçao's responsibility, denied that minors are currently held, and deferred the AIV-related questions to a later government response.
Under the Kingdom Act on the Council for Law Enforcement, it is up to the authorities of Curaçao to decide whether the recommendations in the inspection report are adopted.
Op basis van de Rijkswet Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving is het aan de autoriteiten van Curaçao om te bepalen of de aanbevelingen uit het betreffende inspectierapport worden overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over een verkeerde inschatting in de vraag naar griepvaccinaties

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the flu vaccine supply was insufficient and whether the government misjudged demand, plus related questions on procurement timing, correspondence and the priority group. The state secretary answered that vaccine ordering followed standard forecasting, that extra doses were bought when possible, that the minister acknowledged she would have wanted more, and that a priority rule was set for healthy 60-69 year olds, while refusing to send correspondence within the deadline.
I can share the correspondence with your House, but this cannot be done within the deadline you set for answering these questions.
Ik kan de correspondentie met uw Kamer delen, maar dit lukt niet binnen de door u gestelde termijn voor beantwoording van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht 'Olieplatform verbrijzelt koraalrif op Curaçao – en daarna werd het stil'

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a reported oil platform that damaged coral reef off Curaçao in 2017 and 2019, including whether Dutch assistance would be offered and what rules have changed. The State Secretary answered that the matter is the responsibility of the Curaçao government, that no assistance has been requested, that no safety rules have changed yet, and that the investigation is still ongoing.
No assistance has been requested from the Netherlands.
Er is geen assistentie gevraagd aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over het voldoen aan artikel 68 van de Grondwet

Two MPs from D66 asked the health minister whether the government complies with article 68 of the Constitution, which requires ministers to give parliament requested information unless state interests oppose it, concerning withheld OMT and BAO meeting records and the early handling of personal protective equipment in January and February 2020. The minister refused to release OMT minutes and BAO records, citing the confidentiality needed for expert advice and the constitutional limits of article 68, while giving a detailed chronology of PPE procurement and inventory steps.
The relevant OMT minutes are not provided for the reasons stated in the answer to question 4.
De desbetreffende OMT-notulen worden niet verstrekt om redenen vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het gemaakte onderscheid binnen de topsport

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why top-sport competitions other than the Eredivisie were halted, questioning infection figures, comparisons with other countries and possible discrimination. The minister defended the general halt as part of a package limiting social contacts and travel, noted that top-sport infections were under 100 versus nearly 195,000 nationally, and said reopening would be discussed with the sector.
I myself have no insight into the precise number of infections in top sport.
Ik heb zelf geen inzicht in het precieze aantal besmettingen in de topsport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Geen voetbalwedstrijden voor jonge asielzoekers door strenge FIFA-regels'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether FIFA's stricter transfer rules, which now apply to amateur football, exclude young asylum seekers from matches and whether this amounts to discrimination. The minister answered that exclusion is undesirable but that the rules serve to prevent trafficking, that the KNVB is working with FIFA on a limited minor exception, and that the Chamber will be kept informed.
I will keep your Chamber informed of the progress and results.
Ik zal uw Kamer op de hoogte houden van de voortgang en resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het anticiperen op de testcapaciteit in Nederland en het plotseling stoppen met testen van reizigers uit oranje gebieden op Schiphol

MPs Diertens and Paternotte (D66) asked the Health Minister about anticipating testing capacity and the sudden halt of testing travellers from orange-zone countries at Schiphol. The minister's answers describe RIVM capacity estimates, expansion steps, the Schiphol test-street pilot, and its temporary suspension due to lab capacity pressure.
The research on asymptomatic testing in the context of the Schiphol test street will soon be shared with the House.
Het onderzoek naar asymptomatisch testen in het kader van de teststraat op Schiphol wordt binnenkort gedeeld met Uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over drie studies over besmettingen aan boord van het vliegtuig

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked the minister about three studies on COVID-19 transmission aboard aircraft and whether they justify concern, pre-flight screening and whether RIVM's literature review will be shared. The minister replied that the cases date from before the sector's measures, that existing protocols and RIVM advice remain in place, that testing cannot be mandated under current law, and that a literature report will be shared around mid-October.
I will inform your House about this.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de besmettingen met COVID 19 in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 infections in the Caribbean Kingdom, including Sint Eustatius' quarantine exemptions for essential workers, Aruba's and Bonaire's healthcare capacity and testing, the use of Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman, and mandatory testing for visitors to Bonaire. The government answered that exemptions are limited to essential work under strict protocols, that support to Aruba and Bonaire has been provided, and that a legal basis for mandatory test certificates for Caribbean Netherlands is being considered.
I am currently considering whether it is desirable to provide, for the Caribbean Netherlands only, a legal basis for requiring visitors to the islands to present a test result.
Ik beraad mij nu over de wenselijkheid om alleen voor Caribisch Nederland te voorzien in een wettelijke basis voor het verplicht overleggen van een testresultaat aan bezoekers van de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het verbieden van een sekswinkel als hoofdsponsor bij een voetbalclub

An MP asked the minister why the KNVB barred a sex shop from appearing as main sponsor on FC Emmen's shirt, on what grounds, who decides, and whether clubs can appeal. The minister answered that the KNVB's board of professional football applies sponsorship rules on shirt advertising, that a temporary arrangement allows the ad this season, that a club can challenge such decisions in civil court, and that the wider question will go to the General Assembly.
A professional football club can challenge the board's decision not to approve an advertisement on match kit in the civil court.
Een BVO kan het besluit van het bestuur betaald voetbal om een reclame-uiting op wedstrijdkleding niet goed te keuren, aanvechten bij de burgerrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht 'Protestmars bij grens met Saint Martin'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Foreign Minister about French border controls between Sint Maarten and Saint Martin, including their reasons, the government's view, and efforts to coordinate COVID-19 policy. The minister answered that the French controls were introduced for COVID-19 reasons, that the Netherlands respects them but considers them undesirable long term, that they were lifted on 15 September, and that health-sector coordination with the island is ongoing.
The Netherlands respects the French decision to introduce these controls, but considers such a situation undesirable in the long term.
Nederland respecteert het Franse besluit tot invoering van deze controles, maar acht een dergelijke situatie op lange termijn niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Peters, Bergkamp en Diertens over het belang van ventilatie tegen de verspreiding van het coronavirus

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the health minister how seriously the government takes airborne transmission of COVID-19 and ventilation, and whether guidance and enforcement of building ventilation rules are adequate. The minister said the RIVM sees insufficient evidence for additional ventilation measures, pointed to existing guidance and to municipalities and building owners for enforcement, and noted that information has been published.
It is uncertain whether a specific ventilation (threshold) as an additional measure actually contributes to preventing or reducing SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
Het is onzeker of een bepaalde ventilatie(drempel) als aanvullende maatregel een daadwerkelijk bijdrage levert aan het voorkomen of verminderen van SARS-CoV-2-transmissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Diertens over het bericht ‘RIVM-site Infectieradar pas na zomer weer operationeel’

MPs Veldman and Diertens asked the Minister of Health about reports that the RIVM Infectieradar website would not be operational until after summer, including which software partner replaces Formdesk, contact with the Grote Griepmeting developers, funding, and when it will be reliable. The minister answered that development runs via the EU-funded EpiPose project with ISI-Foundation and Coneno, that talks with the Grote Griepmeting stalled over financial expectations, and that operation is targeted for September 2020 with security and privacy approvals.

The RIVM states its aim is to have the planned Infectieradar operational in September 2020, with all aspects (technical, information security, privacy) guaranteed and approved within the RIVM and VWS.

Het RIVM geeft aan als doel te hebben om in september 2020 de voorgenomen Infectieradar operationeel te hebben, waarbij alle aspecten (technisch, informatiebeveiliging, privacy) gewaarborgd en goedgekeurd zijn binnen het RIVM en VWS.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Kuiken  over voorwaarden van noodsteun en de brief aan de Kamercommissie KR (11 augustus 2020) over het ontwerp consensus rijkswet houdende regels omtrent de instelling van de

Two MPs (Diertens, Kuiken) asked the Dutch State Secretary for Kingdom Relations about the conditions attached to emergency liquidity aid for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the draft Rijkswet establishing the Caribbean Reform Entity (CHE), including its budget-law, autonomy and legitimacy implications. The answers were delivered by letter to the Chamber, referring to the state of affairs of the third aid tranche and the draft Rijkswet rather than answering each question individually.
Question 1: Have you taken note of reports of dissatisfaction over the emergency aid and the CHE?
Vraag 1 Heeft u kennisgenomen van berichten over de onvrede over de totstandkoming van de noodsteun en de CHE?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bron- en contactonderzoek, de opschaling van de GGD en de rol van de minister van VWS

An MP from D66 asked the health minister why the revised GGD contact-tracing scale-up plan was not published, why the assumed positive test rate was lowered from 8% to 5%, and why a warning memo from GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond did not reach the ministry through formal channels, with questions on communication lessons. The minister answered that the revised plan is a working document superseded by a later plan sent to parliament, that the 5% assumption was realistic given low positivity, and that the memo was shared informally and that signals should ideally travel through formal channels.
Will you send parliament a copy of this revised scale-up plan? If not, why not?
Kopie van dit aangepaste opschalingsplan de Kamer te doen toekomen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de adviezen van de Europese Commissie over de aanstaande griepgolf ten tijde van COVID-19

MP Diertens (D66) asked the health minister how the government will respond to European Commission advice on preparing for a flu season alongside a possible second COVID-19 wave, including widening vaccine eligibility, earlier vaccination, testing and protective equipment shortages, and lessons from the 2017/2018 flu epidemic. The state secretary answered that extra flu vaccines were purchased, earlier vaccination is not considered useful, the eligible group will be reviewed by the Health Council in 2021, testing and equipment supplies are being expanded, and vaccination-rate efforts continue.
For that reason I have purchased more than half a million additional flu vaccinations for the National Flu Prevention Programme.
Ik heb om die reden dan ook ruim een half miljoen extra griepvaccinaties ingekocht voor het Nationaal Programma Grieppreventie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de berichten 'Coronateststraat Schiphol voorlopig maar beperkt open voor hoog risicopassagiers' en 'Mandatory coronavirus testing at airports in Germany off to

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that the Schiphol testing facility was only partly open to high-risk arrivals and why not all travellers from risk areas are tested, unlike in Germany, asking about capacity, prioritisation, and missing entry controls. The minister's reply, sent by letter on testing and tracing, is referenced but the substantive answers are not reproduced in the text provided.
Questions from MPs Paternotte and Diertens (both D66) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the reports
Vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens (beiden D66) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de crash tussen wielrenners Fabio Jakobsen en Dylan Groenwegen op woensdag 5 augustus in de Ronde van Polen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the serious crash in the Tour of Poland sprint finish that injured cyclist Fabio Jakobsen, and whether cycling safety rules should be tightened. The minister said the UCI and national federations are responsible for race safety rules, while offering to discuss the KNWU's safety requirements.
It is up to the UCI (the international cycling federation) to set further rules, together with its members including the KNWU, on matters such as a safe finish area.
Het is aan de UCI (de internationale wielerfederatie) om daar samen met zijn leden, waaronder de KNWU, nadere regels te stellen aan onder andere een veilig finishgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het stijgend aantal besmettingen met COVID-19 i.r.t. terugkerende vluchten

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure about rising COVID-19 infections linked to returning flights, including how many infected travellers came from which regions, whether there is insight into flights' contribution, whether arriving travellers with symptoms are tested, whether fellow passengers are tested, and what measures would follow if infections keep rising. The government answered that flight-linked cases appear to be a limited share of total new infections, that testing and symptom checks at airports exist, that close contacts are traced, and that a quarantine obligation for travellers from high-risk areas is being prepared through a change to the Public Health Act.
The reason for the trip is not passed on to the GGD.
De reden van de reis wordt niet doorgegeven aan de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Diertens over berichten in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad over intimidatie en misbruik van jonge turnsters

MPs Westerveld and Diertens asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of abuse of young gymnasts, including whether an involved coach remains in the Olympic track, support for victims, complaint figures at the CVSN, handling by the ISR, and coach training. The minister answered that the KNGU suspended the Team NL women's programme pending an independent inquiry, outlined the victim support and reporting structures, gave complaint and case figures, and declined to make vertrouwenspersonen mandatory while pointing to federations for coach standards.
I am very reluctant to impose obligations on sports associations.
Ik ben zeer terughoudend met het opleggen van verplichtingen aan sportverenigingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de berichten: ‘Flu virus with 'pandemic potential' found in China’ en ‘Zorgen in China over nieuwe griep, die mogelijk kan uitgroeien tot pandemie’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports of a swine-origin H1N1 influenza virus with pandemic potential found in China and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister answered that existing zoonosis structures and hygiene protocols are adequate, the virus shows no sustained human-to-human transmission so far, and current vaccines do not work well against it, while WHO will assess whether a new vaccine is needed.
I informed your House about the COVID-19 lessons learned process in my letter of 15 June 2020.
Ik heb uw Kamer over het proces t.a.v. COVID-19: «lessons learned» geïnformeerd in mijn brief van 15 juni 2020
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kröger over niet-essentiële reizen naar risicogebieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Kröger asked why Dutch nationals may still travel for holidays to non-EU risk areas while residents of those countries cannot enter the Netherlands, and how the travel advice and quarantine recommendation are enforced. The minister answered that the entry ban was lifted for 15 countries from 1 July, that holiday travel is treated as non-essential but the decision is left to the traveller under the principle of own responsibility, and that enforcement relies on airlines and border checks while quarantine advice cannot be enforced.
Quarantine at home after visiting a risk area is indeed an urgent recommendation and in that sense cannot be enforced.
Thuisquarantaine na bezoek aan een risicogebied is inderdaad een dringend advies en is in die zin niet handhaafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over veiligheidsmaatregelen voor vliegtuigpassagiers en -personeel

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Bruins asked about aircraft transmission risks of COVID-19 (drawing on SARS-1 evidence), EASA/ECDC guidance, and whether the OMT should advise on flying. Minister De Jonge answered that protocols were drafted by the sector based on RIVM advice, measures are indefinite, evidence on in-flight transmission is limited, and the OMT has not been asked but RIVM has advised twice.
On the basis of existing literature, no sound comparison can be made between transmission of SARS-CoV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 on aircraft.
Er kan op basis van bestaande literatuur geen goed vergelijk worden gemaakt tussen overdracht van SARS-CoV-1 en SARS-CoV-2 in vliegtuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over ‘de waarschuwing van de Nationale Ombudsman het stroomstootwapen terughoudend te gebruiken’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he views the Ombudsman's warning to use Taser weapons restrainedly, including their use against an elderly dementia patient and a young man in psychosis, and about health risks, training and monitoring. The Minister says use is assessed afterwards on proportionality and subsidiarity, that the training was extended from two to three days, and that the wider rollout will be accompanied by medical research whose set-up will be reported later this year.
I will not go further into specific cases in which the Taser was used.
Ik ga verder niet in op specifieke casussen waarbij het stroomstootwapen is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bergkamp over de kwaliteit van mondkapjes in verpleeghuizen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether nursing homes still face shortages of protective equipment and whether the quality of masks bought outside the national LCH channel can be assured, and who is responsible for quality. The minister answered that shortages of face masks have eased, that the LCH has sufficient stock, and that manufacturers and care institutions are responsible for quality, with institutions able to have masks tested and to report quality concerns to the inspectorates.
The LCH indicates that there is sufficient stock to meet current demand for face masks, including for nursing homes.
Het LCH geeft aan dat er voldoende voorraad is om aan de huidige vraag naar mondmaskers te voldoen, ook voor verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen al vroeg wilden testen maar werden geweigerd

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Diertens asked the health minister whether nursing homes were refused permission to test staff early in the COVID-19 crisis, and how testing and protective equipment guidelines evolved. The minister answered that nursing staff became eligible for testing from 6 April 2020, that testing was rationed due to scarcity, and that no data exists on refusals or on links between early testing and infection spread.
I have no information on this and cannot make an estimate.
Hier heb ik geen informatie over en ik kan ook geen inschatting maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de onderzoeksresultaten van het Trimbos-instituut over psychische hulp tijdens coronacrisis

A D66 MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Trimbos survey finding that three-quarters of mental-health panel members had no face-to-face contact with a care provider during the coronavirus crisis, and about falling mental-health care use despite rising demand. The State Secretary answered that care was largely continued remotely or face-to-face where needed, that declaration data cannot show reduced treatment minutes, that the NZa monitor shows waiting times rising then slightly falling, and that a GP-referral factsheet and a crisis structure are being used to restore care.
On the basis of (declaration) data from health insurers it cannot be said whether individual patients have received fewer treatment minutes during the coronavirus crisis.
Het is op basis van (declaratie)data van zorgverzekeraars niet te zeggen of individuele patiënten tijdens de corona-crisis minder behandelminuten hebben gekregen/krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de sportsector

MPs Diertens and Westerveld asked about COVID-19 impacts on sports: whether clubs with payroll staff can use the NOW wage subsidy, whether clubs and event organisers get financial support, municipal compensation and SPUK extension, and how elite athletes without A-status can access aid. The minister answered that the €120 million package and NOW/TOGS/Tozo schemes apply under conditions, that municipalities receive €90 million compensation, that the SPUK will be evaluated before a decision, and that some athletes without KvK registration fall outside existing schemes.
As I have promised the House, the SPUK is currently being evaluated. Based on this, I will in due course take a decision on the continuation of the SPUK.
Zoals ik de Kamer heb toegezegd, wordt de SPUK momenteel geëvalueerd. Op basis hiervan zal ik te zijner tijd een besluit nemen over de voortzetting van de SPUK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Verhoeven over mondkapjes en het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked why the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH) scaled up existing suppliers rather than adding new ones, whether this disadvantages other suppliers, how rejected masks are handled, and how contact professionals and citizens are informed about face masks. The minister answered that the LCH uses both existing and new suppliers, applies quality criteria, provides test results on rejection, and that information on masks is available on rijksoverheid.nl, with the LCH having no logistics role for non-medical masks.
In the case of forged certificates, no details are released, so as not to facilitate future fraud.
In het geval dat sprake is van vervalsing van certificaten, worden geen details vrijgegeven, om toekomstige fraude niet in de hand te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Europees Parlement pleit voor een noodfonds voor overzeese gebieden’

An MP asked the ministers whether the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom have applied for, and how they would access, a possible EU emergency fund for overseas territories adopted in a European Parliament resolution. The government replied that no such fund exists yet since the Commission has not acted on the call, but that the Commission has redirected existing funds (about EUR 10 million via RESEMBID and access to the B-envelope), and that the Kingdom is working to facilitate access.
The European Commission has so far not acted on this call.
De Europese Commissie (de Commissie) heeft tot op heden geen gevolg gegeven aan deze oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het openhouden van vliegroutes van en naar Spanje ondanks snelle toename aantal besmettingen

D66 MPs asked why flight routes from Spain stayed open while infection numbers rose quickly, comparing this with the ban on flights from Italy and asking for a stricter flight ban and monitoring. The minister answered that multiple factors inform flight restrictions, pointed to EASA high-risk country measures and RIVM advice, and said monitoring continues without committing to a ban on Spain.
We are continuously monitoring and advising on whether additional measures for air traffic are needed.
Wij zijn continu bezig met het monitoren en advies of er aanvullende maatregelen voor het luchtverkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht ‘Wereldwijde toename huiselijk geweld door coronavirus’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports of rising domestic violence during the coronavirus crisis, including an Italian police app, the Fier chat function, a national 24/7 chat, BES islands provision, and safe shelter availability. The minister answered by reference to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277) rather than answering the questions in substance.

The written questions from MPs Bergkamp and Diertens (both D66) to Minister De Jonge (Health, Welfare and Sport) and State Secretary Blokhuis (Health, Welfare and Sport) (2020Z06384) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken' (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 277).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens (beiden D66) aan Minister De Jonge (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) en Staatssecretaris Blokhuis (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) ( 2020Z06384 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 277 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over homeopathische behandelingen van Covid-19 en het coronavirus

An MP asked the minister about claims that homeopathic prophylaxis protects against the coronavirus, asking what powers exist to act against such claims and the role of the IGJ. The minister agreed such claims are unacceptable, said unfounded medical claims are not permitted, noted the IGJ can investigate providers who are reported, and brought the matter to the IGJ's attention.
I have brought the matter to the attention of the IGJ.
Ik heb een en ander onder de aandacht van de IGJ gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de nazorg aan slachtoffers van misbruik in de sport

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about aftercare for victims of abuse in sport, including rising reports, support measures and a possible role for NOC*NSF. The minister said reports are rising, that existing aftercare through the Centrum Veilige Sport and referral partners is sufficient, and that he is discussing further investment with NOC*NSF and the sports tribunal, while rejecting a direct role for NOC*NSF.
I am in discussion with NOC*NSF, the Centrum Veilige Sport and the Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak about the investments needed to handle the growth in the number of reports, including in the future.

Ik ben met NOC*NSF voor het Centrum Veilige Sport en het Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak in overleg over de benodigde investeringen om de groei in het aantal meldingen, ook in de toekomst, aan te kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Diertens over de gevolgen van het coronavirus voor de culturele sector

Two D66 MPs asked how the government will cushion the coronavirus fallout for the cultural sector, given many freelancers and self-employed artists, and what support schemes exist. The minister answered that the sector can use general economic relief measures, that rent and subsidy leniency has been agreed with several bodies, that a new self-employed benefit scheme without means test is being set up, and that consultations with the sector are ongoing.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation calls for them.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen, zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over gedragsregels en communicatie bij het coronavirus, in het bijzonder in de grensregio’s

An MP from D66 asked the health minister how the government assesses reports that German politicians want the border closed unless Dutch and German corona rules are aligned, and whether differences in compliance and rules in the border region require coordination. The minister answered that the gap between Dutch and German measures has narrowed, that consultation with German states and Belgium is ongoing, that Dutch shops remain open unlike in Germany, and that the government will intensify public information on compliance.
Yes. Thus today the public campaign starts.
Ja. Zo start vandaag de publiekscampagne
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked the state secretary about a seller's campaign offering a free blender to mothers who refrain from vaccinating their children against whooping cough. The state secretary answered that the Advertising Code Commission rebuked the campaign, that no legal sanctions apply because no statutory rules were broken, that the IGJ contacted the company and the campaign was stopped, but that contacting parents directly is not possible under privacy law.
No, we do not have data for this and we (or the IGJ) cannot request it from the website owner because of privacy legislation.
Nee, we beschikken niet over gegevens hiervoor en wij (of de IGJ) kunnen die ook niet opvragen bij de eigenaar van de website vanwege de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: ‘Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expelled Venezuelans and about detention conditions in the immigration barracks on Curaçao, including whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for detention conditions, that Netherlands supports improvements, and that Kingdom intervention is a last resort, while promising continued monitoring and not committing to an independent visit.
Intervention by the Kingdom under the Charter is a last resort.
Ingrijpen door het Koninkrijk op grond van het Statuut is een laatste redmiddel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over ontwikkelingen coronavirus naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Two Beijing hospitals quarantined amid fears coronavirus infections will spike in the capital'

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising COVID-19 cases in Beijing, Chinese airlines still flying to Amsterdam, and KLM selling tickets on those routes, and whether they would restrict or withdraw air transport permits. The government answered that the case numbers do not compare to Wuhan, that airline restrictions are not currently at issue on WHO advice, that airlines are responsible for their schedules, and that it will reconsider only if WHO advice changes.
I have not currently taken any decisions that lead to restrictions on aviation.
Ik heb op dit moment geen besluiten genomen die leiden tot restricties voor de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de berichten Italië neemt drastische stappen na grote uitbraak coronavirus en Uitbraak coronavirus in Noord-Italië geen extra maatregelen in Nederland

The MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about reports of a coronavirus outbreak in northern Italy, including the epidemiological link, preventive testing, incubation period, hospital preparedness, supplies of masks and intensive care beds, medicine shortages, vaccine progress and international support. The Minister answers each question in turn, stating that current capacity and supplies are adequate, that the situation is monitored, and that certain steps such as a European procurement procedure are being explored.
I am also exploring whether the Netherlands can order a limited stock of additional protective equipment through a European tender procedure.
Ik verken daarnaast of Nederland via een Europese offerteprocedure een beperkte voorraad extra beschermingsmiddelen kan bestellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de betrokkenheid van Aruba Airlines bij het uitzetten van Cubaanse mensenrechtenverdedigers, journalisten en andere activisten

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Aruba Airlines was involved in deporting Cuban activists, whether this will be investigated, and what support or compensation the Kingdom can offer. The minister said aviation is an Aruban matter, that Aruba's government and the airline deny knowing participation, and that the embassy raised the issue with Cuba, which denies the allegations.
Aviation is, under the Charter for the Kingdom of the Netherlands, a matter for the constituent country and not a matter for the Kingdom.
Luchtvaart is op grond van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden een landsaangelegenheid en geen aangelegenheid van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Ploumen over de actie van een verkoper van blenders waarbij moeders worden opgeroepen hun kind niet te vaccineren

MPs Diertens and Ploumen asked whether the state secretary knew of a blender seller's campaign urging mothers not to vaccinate their children, and what could be done against commercial parties exploiting parental fears. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care had been notified, contacted the blog owner, and mentioned strengthening citizens' media literacy.
The Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care (IGJ) received a report from the RIVM.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft een melding van het RIVM gekregen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het bericht ‘Vreemdelingenadvocaten: 'Curaçao zet Venezolanen collectief uit’

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked about reports that Curaçao collectively expels Venezuelan migrants without individual assessment, detention conditions, minors, oversight by the Kingdom, and Dutch military assistance. The minister answers that individual screening is procedurally required, that Curaçao's judiciary must review compliance, that 95 of 97 intercepted persons were returned after individual assessment, and that Dutch military support was provided under Curaçao's authority with some improvements to detention facilities pending.
It is not for the Dutch government but for the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, where relevant cases arise, to what extent irregularities occur in an expulsion.

Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland, maar aan de rechterlijke macht in Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre er zich onregelmatigheden voordoen bij een uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Diertens en Paternotte over het racisme tijdens de voetbalwedstrijd FC Den Bosch – Excelsior

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about racist abuse of Excelsior player Ahmad Mendes Moreira at the FC Den Bosch match, the club's initial reaction, the extent of racism in sport, existing policy, sanction powers of the KNVB and clubs, and related matters. Minister Bruins answered that the abuse was unacceptable, described the monitoring figures and existing programmes, and promised to report on a joint action plan after 31 January.
At the end of January I will come together with my colleagues of J&V and SZW and the KNVB with an action plan to better combat racism and discrimination in sport.
Eind januari kom ik samen met mijn ambtsgenoten van J&V en SZW en de KNVB met een aanvalsplan om racisme en discriminatie in de sport nog beter te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Familiedrama in Winschoten: ze belde 113 maar dat nummer bestaat helemaal niet’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Winschoten family tragedy in which a caller dialled 113, a suicide-prevention number that does not exist as a usable number, and about whether the 113 Zelfmoordpreventie line should be given 1-1-3. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, said the number usage is not tracked, explained that the number is reserved in the numbering plan under the responsibility of the EZK Secretary and the ACM, and said that he and the Justice Minister will examine options and conditions for making 1-1-3 available.
Together with the Minister of Justice and Security we will examine the possibilities, risks and suitable conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico’s en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma en Diertens over de situatie op Curaçao

MPs Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma and Diertens asked about the situation on Curaçao, including the Article 3 ECHR protection procedure, detention conditions for Venezuelan migrants, border and drug and arms smuggling controls, and funding. The government answered that the procedure was revised and adopted, that detention upgrades are being funded, and that border controls and support measures are being strengthened, while stressing that law enforcement is Curaçao's autonomous responsibility.
It is primarily up to the country of Curaçao to ensure that the procedure is properly implemented and to ensure that effective legal remedies and the necessary capacity exist.

Het is primair aan het land Curaçao om erop toe te zien dat op goede wijze invulling wordt gegeven aan de procedure en zorg te dragen voor het bestaan van effectieve rechtsmiddelen en de daarbij benodigde capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Kabinet laat Caribische ouderen achter in ‘mensonwaardig bestaan’

An MP from D66 asked several ministers about reports that elderly residents of the Caribbean Netherlands live in poverty and that government support is inadequate. The state secretaries acknowledged the difficult situation, pointed to measures and shared responsibility with island authorities, but gave limited concrete timelines and said the Ombudsman's criticisms are addressed through ongoing monitoring.
The cabinet understands the wish of the National Ombudsman for more clarity on the timeline of the announced measures.
Het kabinet begrijpt de wens van de Nationale ombudsman om meer houvast voor wat betreft het tijdpad van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht ‘Bonaire overspoeld met Sargassum zeewier’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the recurring sargassum seaweed influx on Bonaire, its ecological and economic damage, causes, responsibilities, clean-up means, and circular use. The minister answered that the Openbaar Lichaam (island authority) is responsible for prevention and clean-up, that the Rijk has financially supported some equipment, and that it is willing to consult the island government and STINAPA and to address sargassum in the upcoming nature policy plan.
The actions taken to bring the problem under control fall under the responsibility of the Openbaar Lichaam.
De acties die ondernomen worden om de problematiek onder controle te krijgen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sneller over berichten dat Sint Maarten niet optreedt tegen witwassen

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary and Finance Minister about reports that Sint Maarten is not acting against money laundering, including the economic consequences of FATF non-compliance, EU and Kingdom implications, casino transaction reporting, and the Integrity Chamber. The government answered that Sint Maarten is responsible for implementing FATF recommendations, outlined possible CFATF countermeasures and grey-list risks, noted Dutch and World Bank technical support, and described the Integrity Chamber's powers, while stating that money laundering prosecution falls outside that chamber.
Foremost, anchoring the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) recommendations in legislation is a responsibility of the country of Sint Maarten.
Voorop staat dat de verankering van de aanbevelingen van de Financial Action Task Force (FATF) in wetgeving een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land Sint Maarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het steeds ouder worden van mensen met een drugsverslaving en het toerusten van zorginstellingen hierop

Two D66 MPs asked the Health Minister about rising drug addiction among older people and whether municipalities, Wlz care institutions and prevention are adequately equipped. The minister gave prevalence figures showing rises among older users, said municipalities are responsible for quality, found no signals of insufficient expertise in elderly care, argued late-life prevention is largely ineffective, and offered to send an overview of research but saw no reason for special action.
We are willing to do so. At present, however, we see no reason to take special action on this.
Daartoe zijn wij bereid. Op dit moment zien wij echter geen aanleiding hierop bijzondere actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en De Groot over het bericht dat alleen een radicaal ander dieet in 2050 alle monden kan voeden

D66 MPs asked whether the EAT-Lancet report on a radically different diet for 2050 warrants changes to health and food policy, how it compares with the Preventieakkoord and the Schijf van Vijf, and how it fits agriculture and climate goals. The government replies that the report supports current healthy-eating policy, that the Schijf van Vijf broadly matches EAT-Lancet, and that it will rely on existing climate and circular-agriculture plans without new binding measures.
No, this report supports the policy on healthy nutrition, and the impetus indicated together with the National Prevention Agreement.
Nee, dit rapport ondersteunt het beleid op het gebied van gezonde voeding, en de impuls die daar mede met het Nationaal Preventieakkoord aangegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Meldingen seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in sport vorig jaar verdubbeld’

An MP asked whether the doubling of reported sexual misconduct in sport reflects more abuse or greater awareness, what steps are needed, how sports bodies, police and prosecutors share information, and progress on the De Vries commission recommendations. The minister says rising reports mainly reflect greater attention, outlines a mandatory reporting duty for sports club leaders due by 2020, a convenant and work document with police and prosecutors, and annual progress reports to parliament.
In addition, the Minister of Medical Care and Sport will inform you annually, prior to the WGO sport, about the progress of implementing the De Vries commission recommendations.
Daarnaast zal de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport u jaarlijks, voorafgaand aan het WGO sport, informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van de aanbevelingen Commissie de Vries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Diertens en Bouali over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden kunnen grotere toestroom Venezolanen verwachten'

MPs Groothuizen, Diertens and Bouali asked whether UNHCR projections of a rising Venezuelan refugee flow to the Caribbean reflect a real threat, and about funding, detention, asylum procedures and rights on Aruba and Curaçao. The government answered that the UNHCR figures cover the wider Caribbean, that interceptions fell in 2018, that Curaçao has requested assistance on detention and the asylum procedure, and that asylum applications are assessed individually.

The Ministry of Justice and Security asks the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a country report when a high number of asylum applications from nationals of a given country is lodged in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid vraagt het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken om een ambtsbericht als er in Nederland een hoog aantal asielaanvragen wordt ingediend van personen uit een bepaald land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht 'Voetbal is voor iedereen!'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about an open letter from LGBT+ supporters calling for more acceptance in football, and what the government will do to promote inclusion and tackle discriminatory chants. The minister agreed more action is needed, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the Sportakkoord, and said the KNVB shares the ambition, while committing only to ongoing consultation with supporters.
Yes. Question 3: In what way are you currently promoting inclusion and acceptance of LGBT+ people in sport and especially in football?
Ja. Vraag 3 Op welke manier stimuleert u op dit moment inclusie en acceptatie van LHBT+ in de sport en bij het voetbal in het bijzonder?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Diertens over het rapport 'Opgesloten en uitgezet' van Amnesty International

MPs Groothuizen and Diertens asked the State Secretaries about the Amnesty report on detention and expulsion of Venezuelans in the Caribbean Kingdom islands, covering numbers, UNHCR registration, asylum procedures, detention conditions, and independent investigation. The government answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own asylum and detention matters, confirmed it will not commission independent investigations there, and offered only support for optimising Curaçao's Article 3 ECHR procedure.
The constitutional relations within the Kingdom do not allow me to unilaterally commission research into matters that concern an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.

De staatkundige verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk staan mij niet toe om eenzijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar zaken die betrekking hebben op een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport 'Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland'

Two D66 MPs asked whether geothermal exploration permits on Saba, granted by the island council to Teranova rather than via EZK and the Staatscourant, comply with the Mijnwet BES, and what the legal consequence would be. The minister answered that the Mijnwet BES contains no geothermal rules, so responsibility lies with Saba's public body, and promised to consider amending the law and consult the public bodies concerned.
I will examine how the granting of geothermal permits for the BES islands can be anchored and whether an amendment of the Mijnwet BES is desirable.
Ik zal bezien hoe de vergunningverlening rond geothermie voor de BES eilanden verankerd kan worden en of daarbij een aanpassing van de Mijnwet BES gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maak vaccineren verplicht’

MPs asked whether mandatory childhood vaccination should apply in daycare centres, how other EU countries handle it, and whether parents can learn daycare vaccination rates. The government opposes mandatory vaccination in daycare (limited effect, constitutional objections) and says a rate-disclosure obligation has little benefit and lacks support, promising a plan of action in autumn.
I am not in favour of making vaccination mandatory for children at daycare centres.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het verplicht stellen van vaccinatie voor kinderen op kinderdagverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van den Berg over kinderrechten in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van den Berg asked whether funding exists to support families with children in Caribbean Netherlands, how child poverty will be tackled there, and how the social minimum and the 1 July 2018 deadline will be met. The government replied that the claim of no funding is premature, that a benchmark study on subsistence security is pending with a reaction to follow, and that BZK is involved through its coordinating role.
A study into a benchmark for subsistence security in Caribbean Netherlands has been promised to both chambers of the States General.
Aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is een onderzoek naar een ijkpunt voor de bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Dodelijke bacterie rukt op in Nederland’

MPs Diertens and Pia Dijkstra asked about the meningococcal vaccine shortage after the national programme was changed, the later vaccination of 14-year-olds, and why scarce vaccines were kept for travellers. The state secretary explained the tender shortfall, said the risk remains very small, and that free-market travel vaccines are outside government control.
Therefore, from 1 May 2018 children aged 14 months will be vaccinated, and teenagers born between 1 May 2004 and 31 December 2004 from 1 October 2018.
Daarom worden vanaf 1 mei 2018 kinderen van 14 maanden gevaccineerd en tieners geboren tussen 1 mei 2004 en 31 december 2004 vanaf 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport ‘Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about results, targets, timelines and affordability of renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands following a report. The minister replied island by island (Saba, Sint Eustatius, Bonaire), noting new solar and wind capacity, prioritising reliability and affordability on Bonaire, and stating that small consumers have an affordable tariff though not a cheap one.
A sustainable energy supply is of great importance in the Caribbean Netherlands, as are safety, security of supply and affordability.
Een duurzame energievoorziening is van groot belang in Caribisch Nederland, evenals veiligheid, leveringszekerheid en betaalbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de stijging van water- en elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

MPs Jetten and Diertens asked the ministers about rising water and electricity tariffs on Bonaire and whether low-consumption households are unfairly burdened. The government answered that it has provided subsidies, is preparing a short-term amendment to the Wet elektriciteit en drinkwater BES to restore a discount for small consumers, and will examine tariff options, while stating that the subsidy does not imply dependence on the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bruins Slot over het gebruik van levensgevaarlijke doping door amateursporters

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the dangerous slimming agent DNP used by amateur athletes, including prevalence, government warnings, a planned doping action plan and customs and enforcement findings. The minister said prevalence of DNP use is unknown, described existing warnings and education programmes, noted a RIVM study showing 0.5% of adults used performance-enhancing substances in the past year, and reported that the NVWA investigation into seized DNP shipments is complete with prosecutions ongoing.
Figures on the use of DNP in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over het gebruik van DNP in Nederland zijn niet bekend.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht dat ministeries niet open zijn over de contacten met de tabaksindustrie

An MP asked the state secretary whether ministries are withholding their contacts with the tobacco industry from the transparency register and when disclosure will happen. The government acknowledged some contacts were not yet published, said the relevant documents have now been published or will be within a month, and committed to reminding local governments and ministries of their publication obligation.
I acknowledge that some of the contacts between ministries and the tobacco industry had not yet been disclosed.
Ik erken dat een deel van de contacten tussen ministeries en de tabaksindustrie nog niet was geopenbaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Diertens over het bericht ‘Kwetsbare gezinnen op Bonaire dupe van bezuinigingen’

MPs Van den Berg and Diertens asked whether Bonaire's planned 13% cut to housing foundation FCB's subsidy would hit vulnerable tenants and jeopardise plans for 500 social rental homes. The State Secretary confirmed the cut would raise rents for the lowest-income tenants, said it is a Bonaire island responsibility, and promised continued talks with the parties involved.
Housing market policy is an island-level task.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het tegengaan van matchfixing

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about match-fixing rules in sports, including whether suspected match-fixing must be reported to sports disciplinary committees and whether a formal disciplinary procedure should be a condition for state subsidies. The minister replied that sports federations adopted disciplinary rules in 2014-2016, that the 2014 Anema case predates the reporting duty and was therefore not reported, and that athletes bound by these rules lose state subsidies if sanctioned.
No, in the Anema case no report was made to a disciplinary committee.
Nee, in het geval van de zaak Anema is geen melding gedaan bij een tuchtcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het monopolie van sportbonden

D66 MPs asked whether the European Commission's ruling against the ISU's eligibility rules for skaters racing outside federation structures affects Dutch athletes, whether pro football clubs could play outside the Dutch pyramid, whether other federations sanction athletes similarly, and whether Dutch law should change. The minister replied that the ruling concerns the ISU alone, that FIFA rules allow pro clubs to play outside the calendar with federation permission, that no comparable federation sanctions are known, and that no change to Dutch law is needed.
In light of the above, I see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
In het licht van bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht “Experts luiden noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Agriculture about expert warnings that the approach to the tiger mosquito is failing, and whether the NVWA can monitor and control invasive exotic mosquitoes and their introduction via products such as used tyres and Lucky Bamboo. The minister says the NVWA monitors risk locations and businesses with traps, that the ministries fund monitoring and control, and that existing preventive measures are sufficient, while acknowledging that the imported products cannot be checked directly at borders given free movement in the EU.
I consider the monitoring of and supervision over businesses and the monitoring at risk locations (see also the answer to question 2) sufficient.
Ik acht de monitoring van en het toezicht op bedrijven en de monitoring op de risicolocaties (zie ook het antwoord op vraag 2) voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het onderzoek “Economische’ daklozen vallen tussen wal en schip; Zelfredzaam zonder dak’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about a report on 'self-reliant' homeless people who fall between care systems, including how many exist and how the coalition agreement's call for better-aligned care applies. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said such people are not counted, attributed implementation problems to professionals' limited discretion, and promised a multi-year agenda and an update before summer 2018.
It is up to municipalities to provide shelter to all residents of the Netherlands who need it, regardless of the specific problems involved.
Het is aan gemeenten om aan alle ingezetenen van Nederland opvang te verlenen indien zij dat nodig hebben, ongeacht de specifieke problematiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Diertens en Voortman over de inzet van de politie in instellingen voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ), in het bijzonder het gebruik van het stroomstootwapen in GGZ-instellin

MPs Van Dam, Diertens and Voortman asked the Justice Minister about police use of stun guns inside GGZ mental health institutions, including whether the stun mode is effective given manufacturer warnings and how this was handled in the pilot. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the taser was used 15 times in care institutions (11 in GGZ settings, one in stun mode), that the stun mode has limited effect on persons unresponsive to pain, that an extra training and a final evaluation will follow, and that Parliament will be consulted before any decision on standard issue.
As promised in my letter, I will first give your House the opportunity to discuss this before a definitive decision is taken.
Zoals in mijn reeds genoemde brief is toegezegd zal ik uw Kamer eerst in de gelegenheid stellen hier over te spreken voordat een definitief besluit wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sjoerdsma over homofobie in de voetbalwereld

MPs Diertens and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about a news report on homophobia in football, whether homosexuality remains a taboo among professional players, and how acceptance of LHBTI athletes in sport will be promoted. The minister condemned intolerance, cited a 2014 survey of players, and pointed to KNVB workshops, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the sports agreement as measures.
To further promote diversity in sport and the acceptance of LHBTI athletes, I will include this theme as a focus area in future sports policy.
Om diversiteit in de sport en de acceptatie van LHBTI-sporters verder te bevorderen, zal ik dit thema meenemen als aandachtsgebied in het toekomstig sportbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Diertens over het onderzoek “Geweld tegen hulpverleners in de psychiatrie”

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a study on violence against psychiatric care workers, including whether existing agreements give enough clarity on filing police reports, how the medical confidentiality rules relate to reporting, what prevention measures exist, and whether the government will engage with researchers on barriers victims face. The state secretary agreed safety is important, pointed to GGZ Nederland's initiative to consult police and prosecutors, and committed to asking GGZ Nederland to publicize the existing handreiking on reporting and confidentiality, while describing ongoing prevention efforts mostly as existing sector practice.
I will ask GGZ Nederland to give more publicity among its members to the O&O fund's handreiking.
Ik zal GGZ Nederland vragen onder haar leden meer bekendheid te geven aan de handreiking van het O&O fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Eijs over schade door rubberkorrels kunstgras

MPs Diertens and Van Eijs asked about reports that water boards did not study rubber granulate contamination near artificial turf pitches and whether standards should be reviewed. The State Secretary disputed the claim of dozens of seriously contaminated fields, said heavy metals and PAHs may be present, ordered a RIVM study and promised to raise the concern with the water boards.
I have instructed the RIVM to map the environmental effects of the spread of rubber granulate into the surroundings.
Ik heb het RIVM opdracht gegeven de milieueffecten van de verspreiding van rubbergranulaat naar de omgeving in beeld te brengen.

MPs Kooiman and Diertens asked the health minister whether patients are being coerced into filling in ROM questionnaires and whether insurers' budget cuts for under-delivery of ROM data should be banned. The minister answered that ROM is voluntary, insurers and providers must settle delivery targets between themselves, she has no signals of coercion, and the Data Protection Authority is still investigating.
As I indicated in the answers to your earlier parliamentary questions on ROM, I have no signals of coercion to complete ROM.
Antwoord 9 Zoals ik aangaf in de antwoorden op uw eerdere Kamervragen over ROM 5 heb ik geen signalen over dwang tot het invullen van ROM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘SCP: Nederlandse topsport dreigt internationaal weg te zakken’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about a SCP report warning that Dutch top sport risks declining internationally, including whether budgets for sport at local and regional level are falling. The minister acknowledged the study, said she recognises the perspectives but leaves policy conclusions to her successor, and stated municipal sport spending has been stable at around 1.1 billion euro per year.
Which policy conclusions are linked to these insights I leave to my successor.
Welke beleidsconclusies verbonden worden aan deze inzichten laat ik aan mijn ambtsopvolger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de gebrekkige beschikbaarheid van uitzendingen van NPO in het buitenland en op de BES-eilanden

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked why NPO programmes are often unavailable abroad and on the Caribbean Netherlands islands, and whether residents there can watch NPO websites. The State Secretary answered that availability depends on broadcast rights, that geo-blocking has been relaxed for the BES islands where rights and technology allow, and that distribution agreements were made with providers there.
Geo-blocking of NPO websites based on the user's location is no longer applied to the BES islands, insofar as broadcast rights allow and it is technically possible.

Het blokkeren van toegang tot websites van de NPO op basis van de geografische locatie van de gebruiker wordt, voor zover uitzendrechten dat toestaan en het technisch mogelijk is, niet meer toegepast voor de BES-eilanden.

MPs Diertens and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Health about a clinic fining patients who did not complete ROM questionnaires, whether ROM data use for benchmarking is appropriate, and whether patients are pressured into sharing sensitive data. The Minister said patients must be able to refuse, financial pressure is unacceptable, the practice has stopped, and no further signals of pressure are known so no further inquiry is planned.
In doing so, a patient must always have the option to refuse to participate in ROM or to withhold consent for passing personal data on to Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).
Daarbij moet een patiënt wel altijd de mogelijkheid hebben te weigeren om mee te werken aan ROM of geen toestemming te geven voor doorlevering van persoonsgegevens aan Stichting Benchmark GGZ (SBG).

Omdat ik het niet eens ben met het oordeel van de rechtbank dat betrokkene slechts een verdiepingscursus moet volgen, heb ik tegen deze uitspraak hoger beroep ingesteld.

Omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de Isla-raffinaderij bij het land Curaçao berust, zijn de vragen niet afzonderlijk beantwoord.

Member Diertens (D66) asked whether current law is sufficient to combat matchfixing, following KNVB calls for stricter rules, and what has been done with the 2013 report's recommendations. The minister replies that existing legislation offers enough prosecution options, refers to earlier answers for the report's recommendations, which led to a national matchfixing platform and sports-side prevention measures, and defers on the international approach.
In my answer to earlier parliamentary questions on matchfixing I indicated that the current legislation offers sufficient possibilities for prosecution.

D66 MPs asked whether generic PrEP imported from abroad because it is not available in the Netherlands is undesirable, what the medical risks of unsupervised use are, and when PrEP can be made available. The Minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility of the Curaçao Minister of Justice, that the Kingdom countries share a legal duty for police education under common quality standards, and that the Progress Committee did not cover the choice of training institution and has now ended its work.
