Permit granting and construction work on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten are matters for the countries themselves.
Vergunningverlening en bouwwerkzaamheden op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten zijn landsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg asked why the new financial assessment framework (nFTK) was not applied to the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, what the effects of its introduction would be, and about pension cuts, the court case with the State, income effects and flanking policy. requests the government, before implementing that tightening, first to demonstrate through extensive argumentation and/or research that the current burden of proof for the asylum seeker is too light
verzoekt de regering alvorens die verzwaring door te voeren, eerst door middel van uitgebreide argumentatie en/of onderzoek, aan te tonen dat de huidige bewijslast voor de asielzoeker te licht is
Motie Gesthuizen c.s. over alternatieven voor vreemdelingenbewaring
Asks the government to investigate alternatives to immigration detention for non-criminal, non-nuisance migrants and to inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to investigate alternatives to immigration detention and to inform the House about this before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering alternatieven voor vreemdelingenbewaring te onderzoeken en de Kamer hierover voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Motie Voordewind c.s. over een vertrouwenspersoon voor asielzoekers
Asks the government to create a separate confidential trusted person through whom asylum seekers can first report threats and violence in reception centres.
that at a first low-threshold opportunity to report violence and threats in an asylum centre, confidentiality and secrecy must be the starting point
dat bij een eerste laagdrempelige mogelijkheid tot melding van geweld en bedreiging in een asielzoekerscentrum vertrouwelijkheid en geheimhouding het uitgangspunt moeten zijn
Motie Spekman c.s. over niet strafbaar stellen van hulp aan illegalen
Motion asking the government not to criminalise aid to illegal residents and to guarantee schooling for children and medical care for everyone.
requests the government not to make aid to illegal residents, such as social shelter and church asylum, punishable
verzoekt de regering hulp aan illegalen, zoals maatschappelijke opvang en kerkasiel, niet strafbaar te stellen
Motie Spekman c.s. over het toezenden van het kostprijsonderzoek COA aan de Kamer
Motion asking the government to send the complete COA cost-price study to the Tweede Kamer immediately.
requests the government to send the complete COA cost-price study to the House of Representatives immediately
verzoekt de regering het complete kostprijsonderzoek COA onmiddellijk naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over dezelfde voorwaarden voor tot het christendom bekeerde Iraanse moslims als Iraanse christenasielzoekers
Asks the government to give converted Iranian Muslims who became Christians the same asylum conditions as Iranian Christian asylum seekers.
requests the government to let Iranian Muslims converted to Christianity qualify for an asylum permit under the same conditions as Iranian Christian asylum seekers
verzoekt de regering in Nederland tot het christendom bekeerde Iraanse moslims onder dezelfde voorwaarden als Iraanse christenasielzoekers in aanmerking te laten komen voor een asielvergunning
Motie Voordewind c.s. over tijdig ter kennis brengen van cruciale informatie van internationale gerechten aan de Nederlandse rechtspraktijk
Asks the government to examine how crucial information from international courts can be brought timely to the Dutch legal practice and to report progress to the House.
requests the government to examine how crucial information from international courts can be timely brought to the Dutch legal practice
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke wijze cruciale informatie afkomstig van internationale gerechten tijdig ter kennis van de Nederlandse rechtspraktijk kan worden gebracht
Motie Dibi c.s. over een zelfstandige verblijfsvergunning voor huwelijks- en gezinsmigranten die slachtoffer zijn van mishandeling

Asks the government to let marriage and family migrants who are victims of abuse by their sponsor qualify for an independent residence permit regardless of how long they have lived in the Netherlands.

requests the government to let marriage and family migrants who are victims of humiliation, abuse or maltreatment by the sponsor qualify for an independent residence permit regardless of the duration of residence

verzoekt de regering huwelijks- en gezinsmigranten die slachtoffer zijn van vernedering, misbruik of mishandeling gepleegd door de referent in aanmerking te laten komen voor een zelfstandige verblijfsvergunning ongeacht de verblijfsduur
Motie Spekman c.s. over niet op straat zetten van uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen tijdens een koudweerregeling
Asks the government not to remove rejected asylum seekers onto the street during cold-weather arrangements from December to February.
not to put foreigners on the street when a cold-weather arrangement is in force in the region
geen vreemdelingen op straat te zetten als in de betreffende regio een «koudweerregeling» van kracht is
Motie Spekman c.s. over een evenwichtiger immigratiebeleid
Asks the government to pursue a more balanced immigration policy that gives more attention to abuses and vulnerable groups than the coalition agreement.
requests the government to pursue a more balanced immigration policy than the coalition agreement shows
verzoekt de regering een evenwichtiger immigratiebeleid te voeren dan uit het regeerakkoord blijkt
Motie Spekman c.s. over verbeteren van de situatie van asielzoekers in Griekenland
Asks the government to push for an EU action plan to substantially improve asylum procedures and reception conditions in Greece and to contribute financially.
requests the government to initiate at very short notice in Europe that EU member states jointly put an urgent practical action plan into effect
verzoekt de regering op zeer korte termijn in Europa te initiëren dat de EU-lidstaten gezamenlijk een acuut praktisch actieplan in werking stellen
Motie Schouw over een bestuursakkoord met de decentrale overheden
Motion asking the government to inform the House on its view of a governance agreement with subnational governments and to actually conclude one promptly.
requests the government to inform the House of its view on a governance agreement with the subnational governments
verzoekt de regering om de Kamer te informeren over haar visie op een bestuursakkoord met de decentrale overheden
Motie Schouw over een infrastructuurautoriteit in de Randstad
Asks the government to present a further analysis on the need for and design of an infrastructure authority in the Randstad, noting unclear democratic control and financing.
considering that there is unclarity about the democratic control of this authority
overwegende, dat er onduidelijkheid bestaat over de democratische controle op deze autoriteit
Motie Schouw over verschuiven van het rijksbelastinggebied naar het gemeentelijke belastinggebied
Asks the government to present a plan, in consultation with municipalities, to shift part of the national tax base to the municipal tax base.
requests the government to come up quickly, in consultation with municipalities, with a plan to shift part of the national tax area to the municipal tax area
verzoekt de regering op korte termijn, in overleg met de gemeenten, met een plan te komen om een deel van het rijksbelastinggebied te verschuiven naar het gemeentelijke belastinggebied
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over onnodige verhuizingen van asielkinderen

MPs Voordewind, Schouw and Voortman asked whether the planned conversion of the Almelo family location into an asylum centre, forcing about 120 residents including children to move, could be postponed, and how the government weighs the harm of repeated relocations to children. The State Secretary confirmed the conversion, said COA is consulting the municipality and residents and tries to limit the impact, but that high intake makes avoiding moves impossible.
COA is in discussion with both the municipality and the residents.
Het COA is in gesprek met zowel de gemeente als de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rapport ‘Gezinnen in de knel’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the Defence for Children report 'Gezinnen in de knel', which claims Dutch family migration policy breaches children's rights, and about registration, the best-interests-of-the-child principle, ECHR Article 8 review and the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary rejected the claim of breach, said the best interests of the child are already adequately weighed, declined to codify them separately, and refused to change the transposition of Directive articles.
I committed to the Chamber on 4 June to consider how the best interests of the child could be incorporated more explicitly in the work instruction for applying Article 8 ECHR.
Ik heb de Kamer op 4 juni jl. toegezegd te bezien op welke wijze het belang van het kind meer expliciet in de werkinstructie voor de toepassing van artikel 8 EVRM kan worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de nationale politie proeven houdt met privacy schendende chips in kentekenplaten

D66 MPs asked whether the national police is testing privacy-invasive RFID chips in number plates that could track all drivers' movements, and how this relates to the pending ANPR bill. The minister denied police involvement, said a private developers' field test at a defence training centre is underway, and said a privacy assessment and CBP advice would follow only if the government later decides to introduce the chip.
Once the results of the test are known, the cabinet will consider whether it is desirable to introduce the RFID chip.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van de proef bekend zijn, zal het kabinet bezien of het wenselijk is om de RFID-chip in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het vervolgen van een activist voor het beledigen van de koning en de koningin

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the prosecution of an activist for insulting the King and Queen (lese majesty), questioning whether arresting him was justified and whether these articles should still be enforced. The Minister of Security and Justice answered that the OM decides on prosecution, the case was dropped after the objection, and that lese majesty provisions remain in force, to be applied prudently and only when necessary, while providing prosecution figures for recent years.
The OM has since informed the suspect and his counsel that the case has been dismissed.
Het OM heeft inmiddels aan de verdachte en diens raadsman laten weten dat de zaak is geseponeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het afkopen van een bestuurder voor negen ton door een openbaar lichaam van waterschappen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a severance payment of nine million (about €905,000 provisioned) to a director of the Hefpunt joint regulation of water boards was consistent with the WNT pay-cap law, how the general board was involved, and why such payments can stay secret for a year. The minister answered that the payment was a provision with components under sectoral rules, that a WNT enforcement unit is investigating its legal basis, that disclosure is required annually, and that the Raad voor het openbaar bestuur is advising on democratic legitimacy of joint regulations.

I am having the WNT supervision unit of my ministry further examine whether all these components were rightly and on the correct basis granted, and will inform the House once this examination is completed.

Ik laat momenteel door de met het toezicht op de naleving van de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) belaste Eenheid toezicht WNT van mijn ministerie nader onderzoeken of al deze componenten terecht en op de juiste grondslag zijn toegekend en zal de Kamer informeren zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Schouw over een rapport van het Duitse Milieu Agentschap (UBA) inzake de belasting op het milieu door conventionele landbouw

An MP asked the government about a German Federal Environment Agency report on environmental pressures from conventional agriculture and whether its findings apply to the Netherlands. The state secretaries answered that the Dutch situation shares nutrient surplus and ammonia issues covered by existing rules, declined further PBL research as unnecessary, and said the report's knowledge would feed into existing policy tracks.
I am of the opinion that additional research by the PBL is not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra onderzoek door het PBL niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de noodkreet van Artikel 1 Overijssel

An MP asked ministers whether anti-discrimination services (ADVs) in other municipalities are at risk due to budget cuts, whether all 393 municipalities ensure their ADV has adequate resources, and why municipal ADVs are hard to find on websites. The minister acknowledged some municipalities receive less funding and said a 2015 study will examine ADV functioning, while stating that the day-to-day execution is a municipal responsibility and declining to set new binding national rules now.
I do not yet have a more recent inventory of the municipal implementation of the Wga.
Ik beschik nog niet over een recentere inventarisatie van de gemeentelijke uitvoering van de Wga.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Schouw over het bericht dat veel mensen in de problemen komen na zinloze gijzeling vanwege verkeersboetes

MPs Kooiman and Schouw asked the State Secretary about reports that people face serious problems after pointless imprisonment for traffic fines, including the legal basis for payment arrangements and for coercive detention. The State Secretary answered that a legal basis is needed for instalment payments, that an interim measure is planned from 1 July 2015, that a new model for detention requests is in use, and gave 2013 and 2014 figures on detention requests and orders.
The starting point is that a detention request is only submitted if there is no indication that the person concerned cannot pay the sanction.
Het uitgangspunt is dat alleen een vordering gijzeling wordt ingediend indien er geen indicatie is dat de betrokken persoon de sanctie niet kan betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Hachchi en Bergkamp over de waarschuwing voor digitale dementie bij decentrale overheden

MPs Schouw, Hachchi and Bergkamp asked the ministers about warnings from local and regional officials that digital records risk being poorly preserved, and whether archive law and powers are sufficient. The government says existing archive law shows no gaps, points to a Ictu baseline study and to strategic information consultation (SIO) as the remedy, and declines to accelerate the AIDO project for lack of resources.
There are indeed no indications that the legal frameworks in archive regulations lead to shortcomings.
Er zijn inderdaad geen indicaties dat de wettelijke kaders in de Archiefregelgeving tot tekortkomingen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over een verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary why he is awaiting a ruling on vrijheidsbeperkende locaties (VBL) rather than the pending cases on municipal bed-bad-brood shelters, and whether the expected Council of State ruling was about VBL adequacy. The State Secretary answered that he is not waiting for a ruling, that the existing system complies with treaty obligations, that the Council of State cases were withdrawn on 11 May 2015 so no ruling will follow in them, and that other related cases are pending.
First of all, I consider it important to note that I am not waiting for a court ruling.
Allereerst acht ik van belang op te merken dat ik niet wacht op een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Wel begraven maar nog niet overleden, hoe kan dat?’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch citizens who die abroad can be registered as deceased in the municipal personal records when no death certificate is available, and how this is handled. The minister answered that registration follows a hierarchy of source documents, that a lesser document can suffice with no doubt about death, that the case was an incident, and that he will raise the issue with the responsible officials.
As stated in the answer to question 3, I regard the event that prompted these questions as an incident.
Zoals vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik de gebeurtenis die aanleiding was voor het stellen van deze vragen als een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de oorzaak en consequenties van het neerstorten van een ScanEagle

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about the cause of a 2013 ScanEagle drone crash, the adequacy of operator training, the Military Aviation Authority's review, why the investigation was not sent to parliament, and the use of the drone over populated areas and by police. The minister said a faulty sensor coating caused the crash, training has been adjusted, the report was withheld for confidentiality reasons, and the drone has not yet been deployed over the Netherlands for civil support.
Investigation reports on such incidents are as a rule not sent to the House of Representatives.
Onderzoeksrapporten van dergelijke incidenten worden in de regel niet naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Defensie een zwarte lijst voor journalisten aanhoudt

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether Defence keeps a blacklist of journalists, as reported by EenVandaag, and what measures would prevent one. The Minister answered that no such list exists, that the report rested on a single internal email expressing a staff member's personal frustration, and that press freedom is an important good to be protected.
As I reported to your House in my letter of 17 April (Kamerstuk 29 692, no. 20) following EenVandaag's coverage, there is no blacklist or similar list for journalists at Defence.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 17 april jl. (Kamerstuk 29 692, nr. 20 ) naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving van EenVandaag aan uw Kamer heb gemeld, is er bij Defensie geen sprake van een zwarte of soortgelijke lijst voor journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir ,Van Gerven en Schouw over een einde aan de kraambox voor zeugen en enige andere samenhangende vragen

MPs Bashir, Van Gerven and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ending farrowing crates for sows, the Pro Dromi alternative, funding for its research, nesting material and inspections, and the EU welfare guidelines, covering 16 questions. The State Secretary answered that Pro Dromi is promising but needs further optimisation before wider rollout, declined to make it mandatory to preserve innovation, pointed to existing funding routes, and said nesting material is largely exempt due to manure systems.
I will discuss with the Dutch pig producers' organisation (POV) and the entrepreneurs involved which bottlenecks exist in practical implementation.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de Producentenorganisatie Varkenshouderij (POV) en de betrokken ondernemers om na te gaan welke knelpunten er zijn bij de praktijkimplementatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges are refusing committal (gijzeling) requests for unpaid fines, which the courts say the Public Prosecution Service files automatically with thin justifications. The minister acknowledges the need for better motivation of such requests, points to planned measures such as instalment payments from 1 July, and says the Public Prosecution Service and CJIB will improve reasoning for the new-style requests.
I am of the view that these requests must be submitted to judges with such motivation that they are enabled to test the lawfulness of the request on that basis.
Ik ben van mening dat deze vorderingen zodanig gemotiveerd moeten worden voorgelegd aan rechters dat zij in staat worden gesteld de rechtmatigheid van de vordering hierop te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Opnieuw kinderen zonder belangenafweging in bewaring’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to respond to a report that children were again detained without a documented balancing of their interests, contrary to earlier court rulings and commitments. The State Secretary denied acting against court rulings, said detention was lawful and the appeal was rejected, and promised renewed attention to written balancing of children's interests.
I have explicitly asked these parties to pay attention to a recognisable balancing of interests, especially for families with minor children.
Ik heb bij deze partijen expliciet aandacht gevraagd voor een kenbare belangenafweging in het bijzonder bij gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het aantal instromende discriminatiezaken bij het OM op het laagst gemeten aantal is

Two D66 MPs asked why reported discrimination cases reaching the Public Prosecution Service fell to a record low despite thousands of police reports, and whether police and prosecutors are adequately resourced. The minister explains the gap through registration differences and lack of perpetrator indicators, says capacity is sufficient, and promises a broader report from 2016 while declining to publish the current figures report now.
No. The discrimination figures of the Public Prosecution Service have already been made public with the sending of the progress letter on discrimination.
Nee. De discriminatiecijfers van het OM zijn reeds bekend gemaakt met de toezending van de Voortgangsbrief discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht “VN roepen op tot reddingsplan”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the EU should expand the Triton operation's mandate and resources to save more migrant lives in the Mediterranean, and whether the issue would be raised at the JBZ Council. The State Secretary answered that Triton is a border-control mission whose mandate should not be broadened, that rescue duties rest with states, and that the Netherlands favours an integrated EU approach.
In view of the above, I am not in favour of broadening the mandate of operation Triton.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik geen voorstander van een mandaatverruiming voor operatie Triton.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten “Varkensschuur in Putten in de as gelegd” en “40.000 kippen omgekomen bij brand in Veendam”

An MP asked the government whether two barn fires (a pig barn in Putten and a poultry barn in Veendam) met fire-safety rules, how existing barns are being adapted under the Stalbranden action plan, and for a progress overview. The government answered that both barns complied with the rules in force, that new fire-safety requirements apply to new or rebuilt barns since April 2014, and that a progress report will be sent to parliament this autumn.
A progress report on the action plan is planned for this autumn. I will send this report to your House.
Een voortgangsrapportage van het actieplan is voorzien voor dit najaar. Ik zal uw Kamer deze rapportage toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht in de Boerderij “Fout bij 1 op 12 EU-subsidies”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responded to a European Court of Auditors finding of an 8.2 percent error rate in rural development subsidies, whether Dutch error rates and costs are known, and whether she will act on the finding that farmers are not incentivised to comply and controls and sanctions are too weak. The State Secretary answered that the error rate reflects procedural documentation gaps rather than proven fraud, that Dutch error rates are not comparable and no cost overview exists, that she does not recognise the claim about farmer incentives, and that she will pursue simpler rules and collective agri-environment management from 2016.
I do not have an overview available of the costs incurred by these errors in paying out rural development funds.
Ik heb geen overzicht beschikbaar van de kosten die gemaakt zijn door deze fouten bij het uitkeren van plattelandsontwikkelingsgelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de stijging van waterschapslasten ten gevolge van het hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked whether rising water board levies caused by shifting flood-protection costs to water boards breach the minister's earlier pledge that citizens would not bear these costs. The minister answered that the Water Governance Agreement targets efficiency gains offsetting cost increases, that monitoring shows the agreement on track, and that no individual-level commitments were made.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het beleid ten aanzien van haatpredikers en de handhaving daarvan

An MP asked the government about its policy toward hate preachers, including whether any were expelled or refused entry and how it judged speakers at a March 2015 event. The minister replied that no preachers had been expelled or refused entry in advance, that three speakers' visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, and that free speech is protected except where it incites hatred, violence or threatens public order.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn in the interest of public order, against the background of social unrest.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de tot nu toe verstrekte informatie over de omvang en aard van (legale) identiteitswisselingen en mogelijke fraude met reisdocumenten

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Gesthuizen, Schouw) asked the Dutch State Secretary and Minister about the scope and nature of legal identity changes and possible passport/identity fraud, including why Parliament was not informed earlier of NVIK/police signals from 2011 and 2013 and of the April 2014 meetings. The government answered that the signals were operational, not quantified, that duplicate registrations were largely legal name changes or data-entry errors, and that several measures and studies are underway.
It is not customary to inform the Chamber while an investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om lopende een onderzoek de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de ARGOS-uitzending ‘Ik keer terug!’

An MP asked the government about problems Dutch nationals face returning from abroad with a foreign partner, loss of nationality, and the lack of a one-stop-shop for emigrants. The state secretary acknowledged some IND cases on the income-sustainability requirement, promised to report on talks with expats, refused to drop loss of nationality on voluntary acquisition of another nationality, and said no one-stop-shop exists but pointed to existing web information.
As I promised in the General Consultation with your House on 14 January, I will inform the House of the outcomes of the talks I intend to have with expats
Zoals ik in het Algemeen Overleg met uw Kamer op 14 januari jl. heb toegezegd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het gesprek dat ik voornemens ben te hebben met expats
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over onderscheppen correspondentie van journalisten door GCHQ

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dutch journalists' communications could be intercepted by the UK's GCHQ and whether Dutch services intercept journalists' communications. The minister said journalists' source protection is a basic condition for press freedom, that Dutch services may use special powers against journalists only under strict conditions, and that a law amendment requiring prior judicial authorisation is pending following an ECtHR ruling; he would not rule out that Dutch journalists' emails were intercepted abroad.
No one is excluded from the possible application of special powers.
Van de mogelijke toepassing van bijzondere bevoegdheden is niemand uitgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over extra maatregelen tegen terreur

The MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (D66) asked the ministers about France's terrorism funding, Dutch security measures after the Paris attacks, intelligence staffing at the AIVD, and cooperation with neighbouring countries. The government answered by referring to its letter to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288) on additional counter-terrorism measures, rather than answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (both D66), question number 2015Z01185, have been answered by letter 'additional counter-terrorism measures and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Parliamentary paper 29 754, no. 288).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2015Z01185 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Schouw, Van Tongeren en Gesthuizen over de onwettigheid van de bewaarplicht van telecomgegevens van burgers

Four MPs asked whether the Dutch data retention law, which the Court of Justice had found incompatible with EU rights, should be suspended, and whether providers could claim damages or be shielded from client claims. The minister replied that the Dutch regime is more detailed than the annulled directive and is compliant, that there is no reason to suspend it, that providers may face damages claims left to the courts, and that no reliable investment estimate exists.
I see no reason to freeze the implementation of the current law until parliament has dealt with the proposed amendment.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de uitvoering van de huidige wet te bevriezen totdat het parlement de voorgestelde wetswijziging heeft behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat gemeentelijk dualisme in Vianen doorbroken wordt

An MP asked whether it is undesirable under dualism for a councillor to attend municipal executive (college) meetings in Vianen, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister agreed it is inherent in the dualist system that councillors do not attend college meetings, noted no other municipalities use this, and said the mayor is seeking a solution in dialogue with the council, province and ministry.

Under the letter of the law a councillor could perhaps participate, but it is inherent in the dualist system, which is based on a separation of functions and powers, that councillors do not take part in college meetings.

Naar de letter van de wet zou wellicht een raadslid kunnen deelnemen, maar het is inherent aan het dualistisch stelsel, dat uitgaat van een scheiding van functies en bevoegdheden, dat raadsleden niet deelnemen aan de vergaderingen van het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de gerechtelijke uitspraak dat de staatssecretaris zelf in opvang voor uitgeprocedeerden moet voorzien

An MP asked the State Secretary how the government will respond to a court ruling that the state must provide shelter, food and clothing to rejected asylum seekers under Article 8 ECHR, and whether it will act on the European Committee of Social Rights' position. The State Secretary answers that he will appeal the ruling, meanwhile offering affected persons places in Ter Apel without restrictive measures, and sees no reason to attach policy consequences yet.
I see reason to lodge an appeal against these rulings of the court.
Ik zie aanleiding om tegen deze uitspraken van de rechtbank hoger beroep in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de erkenning van gerechtelijke uitspraken in andere Unie-lidstaten

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how Dutch child custody rulings, such as a contact ban on a father, are recognised in other EU member states, including whether foreign courts can penalise a mother for not presenting the children, and how this relates to the Hague Convention and Brussels IIbis. The State Secretary answered that recognition depends on the rules of Brussels IIbis and the concrete case, that courts must assess jurisdiction and prior rulings themselves, and that the Dutch Central Authority and a liaison judge network can assist citizens.
It is for the judge to decide whether a particular ruling is recognised. This depends on the concrete circumstances of the case.
Het is aan de rechter of een bepaalde uitspraak wordt erkend. Dit is afhankelijk van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Mensen met schulden zijn een melkkoe’

MPs Schouw and Van Nispen asked whether bailiff tariffs contain excess profit, whether the government exerts price pressure on bailiffs, and how the CAK tender requiring bailiffs to pay for contracts was handled. Minister Teeven answered that tariffs are cost-based and indexed annually, that the CAK withdrew the tender after being told it violated bailiff independence rules, and that a sample review of tariffs will be explored.

The bill also provides that where there is a serious suspicion of complaint-worthy conduct, the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, the Royal Professional Organisation of Bailiffs, or the Minister of Security and Justice can ask the disciplinary court to suspend the bailiff immediately.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet er tevens in dat bij een ernstig vermoeden van klachtwaardig handelen, het Bureau Financieel Toezicht, of de Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders of de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, de tuchtrechter kan vragen de betrokken gerechtsdeurwaarder direct te schorsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Schouw over Brandpunt uitzending "De lange arm van Kagame"

MPs Sjoerdsma and Schouw asked the government to respond to a Brandpunt broadcast alleging that a Rwandan whistleblower's asylum-related reports were manipulated and questioning Rwandan fair-trial guarantees. The government rejected the claims, said the matter was handled through the proper channel with the court, declined further investigation, and described Rwanda's judicial standards.
Because his statements concern individual asylum cases, the cabinet is bound by confidentiality and cannot go into concrete details.
Omdat zijn uitspraken individuele asielzaken betreffen is het kabinet gebonden aan vertrouwelijkheid en kan niet ingaan op concrete details.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de geheime malware die aangetroffen is binnen de systemen van de Europese Unie en bedrijven in Europese lidstaten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the ministers whether the government knew of the Regin malware reportedly found in EU and Belgian systems, whether Dutch systems are safe and whether the US or UK were involved. Minister Plasterk said the AIVD found no direct Dutch targeting in 2013, gave no guarantees against foreign malware, declined to confirm details publicly, and pointed to general cyber security initiatives and EU cooperation.
No public statements can be made about that.
Daarover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Oosenbrug over de uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens van miljoenen Nederlanders door de Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en Justitie

MPs Schouw and Oosenbrug asked why the Tax Administration's data exchange with AIVD, police and prosecution was only disclosed after a convenant was concluded, and questioned the shared ANPR camera use and retention periods. The ministers answered that a legal basis in art. 67 AWR and the Uitvoeringsregeling applies, that the Tax Administration keeps only fiscally relevant plate data, and pointed to existing privacy supervision and legal remedies, without committing to new measures.
There was therefore no reason to send these convenants to your House.
Er bestond dus geen aanleiding deze convenanten aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de controle op Europese subsidies

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the burden of controls on EU subsidies, the risk of double enforcement, reclaiming of EU funds, and the trust principle. Minister Kamp answered that the Commission's rules differ from Dutch principles, that the government is working to balance controls and promote risk-based audits, and that it will prepare a new bill replacing the state-aid recovery bill.
To safeguard the lawfulness of expenditure, I am of the view that there must be a good balance between the control efforts of national and European control bodies and their efficiency.

Om de rechtmatigheid van de uitgaven te borgen ben ik van mening dat er sprake moet zijn van een goede balans tussen de controle-inspanningen door de nationale en Europese controle-instanties en de doelmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over uitzettingen naar landen waar ebola heerst

Three MPs asked the State Secretary whether Belgium's suspension of forced returns to Ebola-affected countries (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was justified given the travel advice, and whether returns endanger migrants' health care access. The State Secretary answered that forced returns are temporarily suspended for staff safety, that individual risk assessments under Article 3 ECHR continue, and that returns of migrants needing medical care will be handled cautiously and case by case.

However worrying the situation in the affected countries is, I am of the view that at this moment not all foreigners who must return to the affected countries are automatically at risk of violating Article 3 ECHR.

Hoe zorgwekkend de situatie in de getroffen landen ook is, ben ik van oordeel dat op dit moment niet bij voorbaat alle vreemdelingen die naar de getroffen landen moeten terugkeren, risico op schending van artikel 3 EVRM lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Schouw over de opvang van Nederlandse kinderen in gezinsopvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Schouw asked why two Dutch children and their Guinean mother were held for twenty months in a restrictive family locations despite having Dutch nationality, and whether more such cases exist. The State Secretary acknowledged the children's Dutch nationality was insufficiently recognised, said about ten Dutch children currently stay in such locations on a voluntary basis, and committed to finding alternative accommodation.
In the case referred to in question 1, the court ruled that this measure was therefore wrongly imposed on the two children.
In de casus waarover het bericht van vraag 1 gaat, heeft de rechter bepaald dat deze maatregel derhalve ten onrechte aan de twee kinderen is opgelegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het terugtrekken van de Nationale Ombudsman uit het systeem ter preventie van de vernederende en onmenselijke behandeling van burgers die onder staatstoezicht van hun vrijheid z

An MP asked why the National Ombudsman withdrew from the National Preventive Mechanism against torture and ill-treatment, and whether the mechanism is functioning and sufficiently independent of the inspectorates and the minister. The state secretary regretted the withdrawal, argued the network functions adequately, and rejected concerns about ministerial influence over inspection priorities.
I therefore do not share the concerns of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de zorgen van de Nationale ombudsman dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht ‘Sociale Zaken overtrad mogelijk de privacywetgeving’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouw (D66) asked Minister Asscher whether SZW linked and analysed databases without a legal basis in its 'Black Box' fraud-detection programme, whether unlawfully obtained evidence was used, and how the CBP supervised it. The minister answered that the linking rested on the Wbp, WWB and SUWI, that the Black Box had been adjusted after CBP findings, and that individuals are not personally informed about the processing.
The number of fraud cases detected with this is not available in aggregated form.
Het aantal fraudegevallen dat hiermee is opgespoord is niet in geaggregeerde vorm beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Schouw over de financiële problemen van scholen in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs die te maken hebben met een grote toestroom aan asielkinderen

D66 MPs asked whether schools receiving large numbers of asylum-seeker children face financing problems linked to the funding system's limited enrolment measurement dates, and what action will be taken. The State Secretary says existing facilities are sufficient, will amend an application deadline for procedure-reception locations, is examining specific bottlenecks with the PO-raad, and is discussing intensified support with schools.
To make it possible for schools to use these facilities directly even after 1 July, I will amend this scheme so that schools can also submit an application at a later point in time.

Om het voor scholen mogelijk te maken ook na 1 juli direct van deze faciliteiten gebruik te kunnen maken, zal ik deze regeling aanpassen, zodat scholen ook op een later moment een aanvraag kunnen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat er onderzoek gedaan wordt naar een tweet

MP Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the NCTV is investigating a jihadist tweet about three Dutch jihadists killed in Syria, on what legal basis, and whether a notice-and-take-down procedure was considered. The Minister confirmed the NCTV is assessing the tweet's content as a threat analysis, not a criminal investigation, that no take-down was considered, and that analyses draw on intelligence and police input under each service's legal framework.
It does not concern a criminal investigation or an investigation of the kind carried out by the intelligence and security services, but only an interpretation of the content of the tweet.
Het betreft geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek of onderzoek zoals de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten dat uitvoeren, maar slechts de duiding van de inhoud van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Schouw over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

MPs Van Veldhoven and Schouw asked whether a Nature study linking neonicotinoid pesticides such as imidacloprid to declining farmland bird populations requires action under EU pesticide law and the Birds Directive, whether EFSA should assess it, and whether precautionary measures should be taken quickly. The Secretary of State referred the answers to a separate letter on the Nature publication, indicating no substantive answer is given in this document.
For the answers to questions 1 to 3 I refer you to the letter to the House titled 'Nature publication imidacloprid and decline of bird populations' of 27 October 2014.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 3 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief «Nature publicatie imidacloprid en afname van vogelpopulaties» van 27 oktober 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over de plannen om rechtbanken in Noord-Nederland te sluiten waardoor de provincie Friesland zonder rechtspraak komt te zitten

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about plans to merge the Leeuwarden and Assen courts into a super court in Groningen, which could leave Friesland without local court sittings, and about whether this conflicts with the judicial map and access principles. The Minister answered that no decision to centralise the court's office function has been taken, that court sittings will remain in all 32 designated locations including Assen and Leeuwarden, and that the Council for the Judiciary has been informed and will monitor access, with evaluations promised later.

There is no question that justice will continue to be administered in the 32 sitting locations designated by general administrative order with a statutory pre-consultation procedure, including Assen and Leeuwarden.

Niet ter discussie staat dat er blijvend recht zal worden gesproken in de 32 bij algemene maatregel van bestuur met wettelijke voorhangprocedure aangewezen zittingsplaatsen, waaronder ook in Assen en Leeuwarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Weyenberg over het hoge ziekteverzuim bij de Rijksoverheid

MPs Schouw and Van Weyenberg asked why sick leave in the central government (5.2% in 2013) is above the national average and the highest of all sectors, whether a target exists, what it costs, and how re-integration and wage sanctions by the UWV can be improved. Minister Blok confirmed the figures, argued that the comparison with the national average is misleading because of age and job-type differences, declined a separate study, set no single sector target, and promised further re-integration measures and a review of sick-pay agreements.
In 2013, a wage sanction was imposed in 23% of WIA applications submitted by employees in the central government, police and judiciary sector.
Bij 23% van de WIA-aanvragen die zijn ingediend door werknemers in de sector «rijksoverheid, politie en rechterlijke macht», is in 2013 een loonsanctie opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het reisregisterplan dat onlangs door de Kamer is afgewezen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the travel data register plan rejected by parliament, whether it is abandoned, what existing data will be used, the legal basis for prosecutors' access, and the EU funding. The minister confirmed the plan is no longer on the agenda, described a technical facility giving prosecutors automated, targeted access to existing KMar and Customs travel data, and said parliament will be informed of implementation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het beleid inzake gratieverzoeken en het negeren van gerechtelijke adviezen

Parliamentary questions from MP Schouw (D66) ask the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the pclemency policy for life-sentenced prisoners, including a court ruling that refused unaccompanied leave was an improper balancing, the weight given to victims and relatives, the role of judicial advice (Art. 122 Constitution) and the Vinter case law. The State Secretary Teeven answers that he respects the court ruling, will consider its consequences for clemency policy, has started resocialisation activities for the prisoner, and that judicial advice is in principle leading but he may deviate from it.
In light of the ruling, I am examining whether and what consequences this ruling has for the enforcement of life imprisonment and the clemency policy.
In het licht van de uitspraak bestudeer ik of en zo ja welke consequenties deze uitspraak voor de tenuitvoerlegging van de levenslange gevangenisstraf en het gratiebeleid heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66) over het bericht dat de Nederlandse zorgautoriteit (NZa) jarenlang medische gegevens, onbeveiligd en in strijd met privacy regels, heeft bewaard

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked how the NZa could keep sensitive patient records and bank card copies unsecured and unchecked for years, what safeguards exist for supervisors' data handling, whether the Dutch data protection authority will be involved, and when the Chamber will be informed. The government's answer is a referral to an earlier written consultation letter on the NZa, without substantive answers to the five questions.

The written questions from MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (both D66), question number 2014Z06807, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2014Z06807 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012» (Kamerstuk 25 268, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Q-koorts: Staat aansprakelijk’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the state is liable for the Q-fever epidemic, including delayed source tracing, withheld information, the role of manure, the Stichting Q-support evaluation, its budget, and individual compensation. The minister acknowledges that government action could have been better, points to measures taken and the first report on Q-support, and declines individual financial compensation in favour of support through the foundation.
The cabinet has acknowledged that the government's action could have been better.
Het kabinet heeft erkend dat het overheidsoptreden beter had gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten van mogelijke fraude bij de Staatsloterij

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries of Justice and Security and of Finance about reports of possible fraud at the Staatsloterij, including when indications arose, whether the draw should be suspended, and the government's responsibility as sole shareholder and over the Kansspelautoriteit. The state secretaries answered that the Kansspelautoriteit is conducting its own investigation into compliance with licence conditions, that the ministries were only informed afterwards, that the Kansspelautoriteit has not seen grounds for measures, and that it is for the regulator to conclude the investigation and set its timeline.
The Kansspelautoriteit does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken doet de Kansspelautoriteit geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over de zelfmoord van een 17-jarige Afghaanse jongen op de campus voor alleenstaande minderjarigen in Oude Pekela

MPs asked the State Secretary about the suicide of a 17-year-old Afghan boy at the Oude Pekela campus for unaccompanied minors, including his psychological care, his residence permit, the delay in finding him, communication with relatives, and prevention measures. The State Secretary declined to address individual aspects of the case, said suicide is not always preventable, and reported that the Inspectorate for Youth Care received notification and decided not to start a further investigation.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over een foutief uitzetbericht van de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary why a deportation notice for a man was wrongly sent, how the error occurred and how recurrence will be prevented. The State Secretary answered that a human error from an incomplete holiday handover caused a mistaken flight booking, that the flight was cancelled, and that safeguards exist, but said he cannot guarantee such errors will not recur.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to provide information from individual files.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht informatie te verstrekken uit individuele dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Discussie illegalen op scherp’

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether he would immediately ensure that rejected asylum seekers have access to bed, bath and bread after two such people died or were seriously injured in Amsterdam. The state secretary expressed regret but rejected any link to national policy, arguing that the reception system covers vulnerable groups and that those who fulfil their departure obligation need not be without shelter.
Providing shelter to people without prospect or conditions, without requiring work towards departure, would not only undermine the credibility and sustainability of the Dutch migration system.

Het zonder perspectief of voorwaarden bieden van onderdak aan personen zonder te verlangen dat wordt gewerkt aan vertrek, zou niet enkel afbreuk doen aan de geloofwaardigheid en houdbaarheid van het Nederlandse migratiestelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht dat haatimams moeten worden aangepakt

Two D66 MPs asked how the government intends to stop hate preachers (haatimams), whether criminal law or a conversation with mayors is the right tool, how often such cases occurred and whether visas or residence permits were refused, and why the focus is on imams rather than other radicalising channels. The ministers answered that visa refusal, administrative measures and criminal law (art. 137d) apply, that no imam-related residence permits were refused on national security grounds in 2012-2014, and that a broader multi-year programme with mosques and local government on radicalisation is planned.
Criminal law applies (article 137d of the Criminal Code) to public statements that incite hatred against people because of their race, religion or belief.
Het strafrecht is van toepassing (artikel 137d Wetboek van Strafrecht) op openbare uitspraken die aanzetten tot haat tegen mensen wegens hun ras, godsdienst of levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht “Grensdetentie is niet langer houdbaar”

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a report calling border detention of asylum seekers, including children, incompatible with human rights norms and EU law. The State Secretary answered that detention and refusal of entry are applied under EU and national rules with individual assessment, that about 77% of asylum seekers detained at the border in 2013 eventually gained access, and that new policy for families with minor children and an IND work instruction would be introduced.
Furthermore, refusing entry and imposing border detention must take place with care.
Voorts geldt dat het weigeren van toegang en het opleggen van grensdetentie zorgvuldig moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de rapportage Vreemdelingenketen 2013

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about the 2013 Vreemdelingenketen report, including the number of children and families in asylum reception, how often families moved during the procedure, and exit figures from family locations. The State Secretary answered with the requested counts and tables, but declined to count all relocations during the asylum procedure because such moves are not registered separately.
No. As previously reported to your House, relocations that form part of the asylum procedure are not recorded separately.
Nee. Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld, worden verplaatsingen die onderdeel zijn van de asielprocedure niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Congolese getuigen van het Strafhof ondanks zorgen toch uitgezet zijn

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would act on reports that Congolese detainee witnesses for the International Criminal Court were returned to the DRC despite concerns about torture, unfair trial and the death penalty, and whether Netherlands would monitor them or contact Congolese authorities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Council of State and the ECHR found no obstacle to return, that the ICC bears responsibility for witness protection and monitoring under its own agreements with the DRC, and that Netherlands will not monitor individuals after return.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de trage beantwoording van digitaal verstuurde vragen en klachten door gemeenten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Interior about slow responses by municipalities to emails and contact-form questions, as reported by the Consumentenbond. The Minister says he relies on ombudsman signals, points to service standards and the VNG quality charter, and states that digital-only service is a goal under the Digitaal 2017 programme, while the National Commissioner for Digital Government will not cover email responses.
I interpret the signals as an incentive to further develop and fill in the Digitaal 2017 programme with extra energy and attention to quality.
Ik vat de signalen op als een aansporing om met extra energie en aandacht voor kwaliteit het programma Digitaal 2017 verder uit te werken en in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat Van der G. zijn leven niet zeker

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked whether serious threats had been made against Van der G., whether a former AIVD agent's warnings were included in the security analysis, and whether the minister would inform the House in closed session. The minister said he was unaware of the former agent's role, that threat assessments are current and not disclosed publicly for security reasons, and that he saw no reason for a closed briefing.
No statements are made in public about the extent and nature of the threat and risk, or about security measures.
Over de mate en aard van dreiging en risico en over beveiligingsmaatregelen worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a motion calling for an animal-keeping ban as a standalone sanction had not yet been implemented and whether a bill would be sent before summer 2014. The minister replied that the ban as a special condition was extended in 2012, that the evaluation will be brought forward to 2015 and a framework for a standalone measure is being sought, while stating that OM data on such bans cannot be generated and that seizure of new animals is only possible if they were also mistreated.
I am willing to bring forward the planned evaluation of the aforementioned law of 30 August 2012 to 2015.
Ik ben bereid de voorgenomen evaluatie van de eerder genoemde wet van 30 augustus 2012 ... te vervroegen naar 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat ‘de marechaussee niet wilde dat Brenno de Winter over NSS-top schreef’

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that military police wanted to stop journalist Brenno de Winter from writing about the NSS summit, including why journalists are observed and registered in public space and whether this restricts press freedom. The minister denied any policy of observing or registering journalists, said registration rests on the Politiewet 2012 and Wet Politiegegevens, and said no measures were taken to restrict investigative journalism.
It is therefore not police policy to observe and register journalists in public space.
Het is dan ook geen beleid bij de politie om journalisten in de publieke ruimte te observeren en te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de verwarring omtrent het publiceren van namen door gemeenten

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities may publish citizens' names and addresses in objection submissions, and whether privacy is adequately protected. The minister answered that municipalities must weigh privacy against publicity case by case, that the Groningen case involved only a list sent to parties rather than internet publication, and that an ombudsman investigation is ongoing.
The aforementioned investigation by the municipal ombudsman is partly aimed at establishing whether in this case the personal privacy of the submitters of objections was adequately safeguarded.
Het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van de gemeentelijke ombudsman is er mede op gericht vast te stellen of in dit geval de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de indieners van de zienswijzen goed is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de betekenis van de uitspraak van het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten (ECSR)

MPs asked the State Secretary how his refusal to take immediate measures after a European Committee of Social Rights ruling squares with a Amsterdam court ruling recognising a right to a dignified existence, and whether he will provide bed, bath and bread to rejected asylum seekers living on the street. The State Secretary replied that the court case concerned municipal welfare obligations rather than the ECSR letter, that the individual still had ongoing procedures, and that he sees no reason to change his position, judging the Dutch system balanced.
The ruling of the Amsterdam court therefore gives me no reason to revisit my position following the ECSR letter.
De uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam vormt voor mij dan ook geen aanleiding om terug te komen op mijn standpunt naar aanleiding van de brief van het ECSR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Van Hijum, Voordewind en Voortman over het onderzoeksrapport naar de medische behandeling van een uitgezette minderjarige asielzoekster

MPs asked whether the health and justice inspectorates were refusing to release an unredacted report on the medical care of a deported six-year-old asylum seeker, and whether the family's consent should change that. The government replied that the report was withheld to protect medical confidentiality, that the family had not consented to an unredacted version, and that a redacted version was sent to parliament on 27 May 2014.
It is undesirable for reports of an investigative committee to be made public if they contain privacy-sensitive and medical information traceable to a person.
Het is ongewenst dat verslagen van een onderzoekscommissie openbaar worden gemaakt indien daarin privacygevoelige en medische informatie die tot een persoon te herleiden is, is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de oproep dat strikte waarborgen voor gebruik drones in Europa

An MP asked the ministers whether they share the European Commission's call for strict safeguards on civil drones, given fragmented national rules and privacy concerns. The state secretary answered that safeguards exist in Dutch law, a WODC study is under way, and no restriction on drone use is warranted for now.
There is therefore no reason to restrict the deployment of such drones now.
Er bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding om nu het inzetten van dergelijke drones aan banden te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht ‘Google gaat gebruikers volgen naar de echte winkel’

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about reports that Google would link online browsing to offline store purchases, including whether it happens in the Netherlands, how it fits Dutch cookie and data protection law, and whether extra safeguards are needed. The minister answered that the test is only in the United States, that cookies require informed consent under the Telecommunications Act and the Data Protection Act, and that a broader big-data letter and the forthcoming EU regulation will address the issue.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to assess whether this representation of events is correct.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie om te beoordelen of deze voorstelling van zaken correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over namaakvoedsel

An MP asked the ministers whether the NVWA's plan of action addresses trade in counterfeit food and whether organised crime is involved. The government answered that the issue concerns mislabelled food, that the NVWA has enforcement tools and is strengthening fraud detection, and that it would inform the House by summer 2014.
At the General Consultation on Food of 18 December 2013 I committed to informing the House before summer 2014 about my approach to misleading labelling.
In het Algemeen Overleg Voedsel van 18 december 2013 heb ik toegezegd voor de zomer 2014 de Kamer te informeren over mijn aanpak voor wat betreft misleidende etikettering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het bericht dat landbouwgeld nog steeds naar sportclubs, kerken en golfbanen gaat

MPs Pechtold and Schouw asked whether EU agricultural subsidies still reach sports clubs, churches and golf courses, and whether the government will ensure spending is limited to farmers. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the 2014-2020 rural development programme aims at farmers, while LEADER and some cooperation measures may reach non-farmers, and that the Netherlands will not oppose member states choosing to fund non-farmers within EU rules.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw, Voortman en Gesthuizen over de uitzending van Zembla van 30 april jl. en de schriftelijke verklaring van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie aangaande het uitzett

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Zembla broadcast and ministry statement on deporting people to Guinea, including whether Dutch authorities are responsible for checking the validity of travel documents issued by Guinean officials and whether deportations should be halted. The State Secretary answered that Guinea is responsible for the validity of its documents, that no concerns have been raised by the Guinean government, that monitoring deportees is not appropriate, and that the Commission Integraal Toezicht Terugkeer is reviewing the matter.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements on whether certain (replacement) travel documents for return are valid or not.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid uitspraken te doen over of bepaalde (vervangende) reisdocumenten ten behoeve van terugkeer al dan niet rechtsgeldig zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten dat de overheid op Brenno de Winter jaagde

An MP asked whether a police alert flagging activist Brenno de Winter was still active after a correction letter, and why a prior request was ignored. The minister answered that the alert was removed on 10 March 2014, all police units were told to delete any such flags, and a national protocol on disclosure of data is being developed.
Within the force, all police units were instructed, as a precaution, to remove and destroy any alerts concerning him.
Binnen het korps is volledigheidshalve aan alle politie-eenheden opgedragen om eventuele aandachtsvestigingen hem aangaande te verwijderen en te vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het aanleggen van een database met reisgegevens

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Justice Minister why a letter promised before Christmas 2013 on a passenger travel-data database (PIU) had not arrived, whether Nederland accepted EU funding for it, what EU obligations exist, and what data would be collected, retained and accessed. The minister apologised for the delay, said Nederland accepted about 5.7 million euro in EU funds conditional on parliamentary approval, that no binding obligation yet exists, that no construction has started, and that details (data subjects, retention, rights, access, EDPS advice) would follow in a forthcoming letter.
Once this has been met, I will send the letter to your House.
Zodra hieraan is voldaan zal ik de brief naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Schouw over de lastenstijging bij provincies

MPs Koolmees and Schouw asked the State Secretary of Finance about a reported rise in provincial tax revenue from opcenten on motor vehicle tax, how much of it stems from national policy, when provinces were informed of the change, and whether provinces should be compensated through a rate cut. The State Secretary said the volume effect is not solely due to national policy, that provinces were informed on Prinsjesdag with prior consultation, and rejected a compensation arrangement since provinces set their own rates within statutory maxima.
That effect is also determined by how provinces estimate the development of the vehicle fleet in their own province (number, type and weight).
Dat effect wordt ook bepaald door hoe provincies de ontwikkeling van het wagenpark in de eigen provincie inschatten (aantal, soort en gewicht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over de conclusie van de Europese Rekenkamer dat de door de lidstaten verrichte verificaties van de EU-landbouwuitgaven niet betrouwbaar zijn

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' finding that member states' verification of EU agricultural spending is unreliable, and whether the Commission's error rates given to Parliament are flawed. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said the verification gap has been legally remedied from 2015, and stated the Netherlands relies mainly on the Court's own figures rather than Commission statistics.
I am therefore pleased that the European Court of Auditors has devoted a specific audit to this subject regarding the Common Agricultural Policy.
Ik ben daarom verheugd dat de Europese Rekenkamer voor wat betreft het Gemeenschappelijke Landbouwbeleid een specifiek onderzoek heeft gewijd aan dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen vann de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de voorwaarden voor het laten overkomen van gezinnen naar Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the criteria for exempting nationalities from the provisional residence permit requirement, and about the availability and telephone-based administration of the Dutch language test abroad. The government answered that exemptions rest on old agreements (South Korea added for economic reasons in 2007), that the test is available at more locations than claimed, that it will not be offered at all posts, and that candidates get a free retake if the phone connection fails.
With the exception of South Korea, this exemption is based on agreements or treaties concluded with these countries in the (distant) past.
Met uitzondering van Zuid-Korea is deze vrijstelling gebaseerd op afspraken of overeenkomsten die in het (verre) verleden met deze landen zijn gemaakt of afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Schouw en Voortman over schade die kinderen oplopen tijdens het verblijf in asielzoekerscentra

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether children suffer developmental harm while living in asylum reception centres, citing a court ruling, and asked about oversight, relocation of children and the state's duty under the Convention on the Rights of the Child. The State Secretary rejected the claim that children face harm merely from reception centre stay, pointed to existing oversight by the COA Supervisory Board and inspectorates, and committed to no new independent oversight body or relocation study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht “ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag”

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked the government about reports that ING wanted to commercialise customers' payment data, and whether this is lawful under the Dutch data protection act and the sector code. The State Secretary answered that such use for third-party marketing is not explicitly covered by the code, that consent must be free, specific and informed, and that the Cbp and supervisors are critical, while leaving the question of ING's plans to ING and the supervisors.
A careless approach and poor communication could damage consumer trust in the banking sector.
Een onzorgvuldige aanpak en slechte communicatie kan het vertrouwen van de consument in de bancaire sector schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Raak over het bericht dat staatsraden nevenfuncties hebben bij loterijen

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked whether two Council of State councillors holding side positions at lottery organisations, and councillors with close ties to lottery bodies in the advising section, create a conflict of interest and undermine the Council's advisory authority. Minister Plasterk answered that the side positions are public, no councillors with lottery ties sit in the section handling the online gambling bill, and that appointments are vetted under the Council of State Act and recusal rules.
In the section of the Advisory Division currently handling the bill amending the Betting and Gaming Act, there are no councillors with side positions at lottery organisations.

In de sectie van de Afdeling advisering die momenteel het voorstel van wet tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen ... in behandeling heeft, zitten geen staatsraden met nevenfuncties in loterijorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over gezichtsherkenning door de Scan Eagle

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Scan Eagle drone, used to track seals, is designed for facial recognition and whether its use for justice purposes could include such recognition. The government answered that the Scan Eagle's Defence cameras cannot identify people at operational altitude, but it does not rule out future low-altitude flights or facial-recognition cameras, pointing to a WODC privacy study.

Because I cannot foresee all future purposes for which a Raven or Scan Eagle will be deployed, I do not wish to rule out in advance that they will ever fly at low altitude or ever be fitted with cameras enabling facial recognition.

Omdat ik niet alle toekomstige doeleinden waarvoor een Raven of Scan Eagle zal worden ingezet kan voorzien, wil ik niet bij voorbaat uitsluiten dat deze ooit op lage hoogte zullen vliegen of dat zij ooit zullen worden voorzien van camera's waarmee gezichtsherkenning mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw inzake wildlife crime

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about EU-level action against wildlife crime, including enforcement rules, penalties and prosecutorial capacity. The government said it will send a written reply to the Commission, that existing EU rules suffice and enforcement is national, and that maximum penalties are rarely imposed though courts have handed down substantial sentences.
In the BNC fiche sent to your House on 14 March, it is announced that a written response will be sent to the Commission regarding the Communication.
In het BNC fiche dat op 14 maart jl. aan uw Kamer is gezonden, wordt aangekondigd dat een schriftelijke reactie aan de Commissie zal worden verstuurd naar aanleiding van de Mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules. The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.
