I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over het bericht dat een ernstig zieke vader is uitgezet naar Guinee

Four MPs (SP, ChristenUnie, D66, GroenLinks) asked State Secretary Teeven why a seriously ill Guinean father was deported despite pending Article 8 ECHR proceedings, medical concerns, questions about travel documents, and Utrecht's offer of care. The State Secretary defended the deportation as the outcome of careful individual assessments, said medication was confirmed available in Guinea, and declined to discuss the individual case beyond what was necessary.
It is known to your House that I do not consider it desirable to enter into individual cases in public debate.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het niet wenselijk acht in het publieke debat in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten dat de overheid jaagde op Brenno de Winter

An MP asked whether the government tracked and warned about journalist Brenno de Winter, and whether sharing his personal data was lawful. The minister confirmed internal security warnings were sent, admitted that personal data including his address was shared improperly, and said a protocol on sharing personal information within the state security domain will be drafted and sent to parliament.
To prevent this in the future, a protocol will be drawn up on sharing personal information within the state security domain.
Om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen zal een protocol worden opgesteld over deling van persoonsinformatie binnen het beveiligingsdomein van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het verschuiven van de waterschapsbelasting van boeren naar burgers

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked about a TV report claiming water board levies shifted from farmers to citizens, and whether reserved seats on water boards misrepresent interests. The minister says the figures cover the whole 'Ongebouwd' category, not just farmland, are not directly comparable over time, and that the reserved seats are a deliberate balance of interests, with evaluation planned alongside the 2015 elections.

As I promised in debate with your House on the bill amending the water board elections, the system of reserved seats will be included in an evaluation of the upcoming provincial elections combined with the water board elections in 2015.

Antwoord 7 Zoals ik heb toegezegd in debat met uw Kamer over het wetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing waterschapsverkiezingen ( Tweede Kamer, 2013–2014, 33719 ), wordt het systeem met geborgde zetels betrokken in een evaluatie van de komende statenverkiezingen gecombineerd met waterschapsverkiezingen in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Schouw over diens uitspraken tijdens het debat van de Volkskrant over het asielbeleid op zondag 9 februari 2014

MPs Voordewind and Schouw asked State Secretary Teeven to explain his remarks at a Volkskrant debate comparing the child pardon (sour) with criminalising illegal residence (sweet), and whether these remarks fit a humane asylum policy. Teeven said he was describing coalition party positions, did not regret implementing the child pardon, intended no signal to children granted status, and did not mean to depart from humane asylum policy.
I did not want to give a signal.
Ik heb geen signaal willen geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat bij de Olympische Spelen grootschalig gegevensopslag plaatsvindt van aanwezige sporters en andere geaccrediteerden

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government whether Dutch Olympic visitors' communications data stored by Russia (three-year retention, accessible to the FSB and other unnamed agencies) could reach Dutch intelligence services and what was being done to inform and protect Dutch citizens. The government answered that Dutch intelligence services have no access to the database, that Dutch visitors are covered by a travel advisory and the Oranje Boekje, and that it cannot exclude storage of delegation members' data for security reasons.
Dutch intelligence and security services have no access to the said database.
Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen toegang tot de genoemde database.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat medische problemen dreigen voor illegale vreemdelingen

An MP asked the government whether a new €5 co-payment per prescription line for uninsured foreigners would block access to medical care, and why a means test was not used instead. The health minister replied that the rule reflects the principle that uninsured foreigners pay their own care costs, that weekly dispensing is exempt, and that means-testing is impractical.
In view of this, I am of the opinion that an amount of (at least) €5 does not impede access to medically necessary care.
Gelet hierop ben ik van mening dat een bedrag van (minimaal) € 5 de toegankelijkheid tot medisch noodzakelijke zorg niet belemmert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over inzet door Justitie van de nieuwe Defensie drone

An MP asked whether the Justice Ministry plans to use Defence's Scan Eagle drone, whether it will test its suitability and whether it should be grounded pending a motion on drone privacy. The minister answered that there are no concrete plans for Justice to request Scan Eagle support, that existing legal frameworks (proportionality and subsidiarity tests via the MLA and ILT) can cover its use, and that a study of privacy frameworks for drone cameras will be carried out in 2014.
Because the UAVs and the cameras mounted on them are still under development, the cabinet announced in its note on freedom and security in the digital society that a study will be carried out in 2014

Omdat de UAV’s en daarop gemonteerde camera’s nog steeds in ontwikkeling zijn, heeft het kabinet in de notitie Vrijheid en veiligheid in de digitale samenleving aangekondigd dat in 2014 een onderzoek zal worden uitgevoerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat slechts negen procent van de door Defensie goedgekeurde dronevluchten van te voren bekend gemaakt is

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked why only nine percent of approved Defence drone flights were announced in advance and whether this is proportionate and privacy-respecting. The minister denied the figure as framed, explained that the 2012 change in procedure means fewer flights are published in the Staatscourant, described retention rules for drone footage, and declined to commit to publishing all flights in advance, citing investigation confidentiality.
In view of the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights before their deployment.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk vluchten voor de inzet aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat de presentatie van het door de Kamer verzochte CTIVD-onderzoek wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether reports of a delayed CTIVD intelligence oversight report were accurate and why parliament was not informed, and asked for the report to be sent immediately. The minister denied the delay, said the CTIVD chair will hand over the report on 7 February, and committed to sending it to parliament within four weeks of receipt.
My aim is to do this within four weeks of receiving the adopted investigation report.
Mijn streven is om dit binnen vier weken na ontvangst van het vastgestelde onderzoeksrapport te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat het waterschap Aa en Maas aan Heineken subsidie verstrekt

An MP asks whether a water board's confidential handling of an anti-disconnection subsidy to Heineken, and the limited public information on such schemes, undermines voters' ability to be informed. The minister replies that the scheme is an approved, publicly documented mechanism, that the decision was taken in public session with the criteria available, and that no action is needed.
No current data are available on the number of companies per water board receiving subsidies under the scheme.
Over het aantal bedrijven per waterschap dat op grond van de regeling subsidie ontvangt zijn geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van persoonsgegevens uit de Gemeentelijke Basis Administratie (GBA) aan de Stichting Interkerkelijke Ledenadministratie (SILA)

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the systematic supply of GBA population-register data to the SILA church membership foundation is lawful, given a Council of State advice that the historical justification was insufficient. The Minister said the justification was supplemented after that advice, declined to predict court outcomes, and saw no reason to end the data supply.
In the supplementary report of 25 November 2013, following the Division's advice, the justification for the data supply to SILA was supplemented in the explanatory note to the draft decree.

In het nader rapport van 25 november 2013 is, naar aanleiding van het advies van de Afdeling de motivering van de gegevensverstrekking aan de SILA in de nota van toelichting van het ontwerpbesluit aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over bacteriën zonder vijand

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the ministers about carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) in the food chain, monitoring, zero-tolerance policy, the role of intensive livestock farming and incentives for new antibiotics. The minister answered that food monitoring since 2011 found no CRE, that RIVM was asked for an integrated advice within three months, and that pull incentives such as patent extension will be explored with the European Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Bureau Buitenland over foute regimes die Interpol misbruiken

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government about a Bureau Buitenland broadcast alleging that Interpol notices are misused to arrest recognised refugees and human rights activists in Europe, and how Dutch checks on such notices work. Minister Opstelten answered that Interpol itself makes no arrests, that Dutch notices are screened against refugee status and persecution grounds before any extradition, that data on arrests from notices cannot be retrieved from police systems, and that Interpol removes notices that breach its constitution.
It cannot be derived from police systems how many or which arrests have taken place following an Interpol notice.
Uit de systemen van de politie kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel of welke aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden naar aanleiding van een Interpolsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rondetafelgesprek van het NJCM van 29 november 2013 inzake Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA)

MP Schouw asks the State Secretary about the NJCM roundtable criticism of the Bureau Medische Advisering (BMA), including doctors' independence under IND protocols, perceived partiality as an IND body, anonymous consulting doctors abroad, and treatment of sick asylum seekers after removal. The State Secretary rejects the independence critique, refers to earlier letters, explains the medical emergency rules and DT&V support for three months of treatment, and declines to publish the report on recommendation 4.
No, in the aforementioned letter I explain why not (page 5).
Nee, in voornoemde brief leg ik uit waarom niet (pagina 5).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over tegenstrijdige uitspraken van de minister betreffende het NSA afluisterschandaal

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior to reconcile three of his earlier statements on the NSA wiretapping affair, including that data collected by the NSA should not have been collected or used and that he could not technically rule out intelligence based on NSA-derived information. The minister confirmed the statements, denied they contradict each other, explaining that the Wiv 2002 forbids untargeted bulk collection of cable metadata and that inter-service tips share only specific information without disclosing sources, so a tip could in theory have partly derived from such collection.
No, those statements do not contradict each other.
Nee, die uitspraken spreken elkaar niet tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over berichten dat het makkelijker wordt om fraude te plegen als de Registratie niet-Ingezetenen ingevoerd wordt

An MP asks whether the Registratie Niet-Ingezetenen makes it easy for short-stay EU citizens to obtain a BSN and claim benefit allowances, and how the government handles fraud risk, municipal concerns and fraud prevention. The minister says a BSN confers no entitlement to benefits, that municipalities were consulted and a pilot is being developed, and that a new fraud-prevention bill lets the tax authority withhold allowance advances where fraud risk is high.
The citizen service number gives no right to benefits or subsidies.
Het burgerservicenummer geeft geen recht op uitkeringen of subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de activiteiten en het toezicht op de Europese geheime dienst IntCen

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how the EU intelligence body IntCen receives and shares intelligence, its legal basis and status, and what oversight applies, including whether it processes personal data. Minister Plasterk answered that IntCen only produces strategic analyses from voluntary member-state contributions, now sits within the EEAS under the same legal controls as other EU institutions (Ombudsman, Court of Justice, data protection supervisor), and that Dutch oversight of its AIVD input rests with the CTIVD.

Given that SitCen produces only strategic analyses, processes no personal data, acquires no intelligence of its own and receives information from member states only on a voluntary basis, the Council considered that no special legal basis was required to establish SitCen.

Gelet op het feit dat SitCen uitsluitend strategische analyses opstelt, geen persoonsgegevens verwerkt, geen eigen inlichtingen verwerft en dat informatie uit de lidstaten slechts op basis van vrijwilligheid wordt verstrekt, was de Raad van mening dat voor de oprichting van SitCen geen bijzonder rechtsbasis was vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het tekort aan cyberspecialisten bij het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service lacks cybercrime specialists, what staffing was planned and realised for 2012-2014, and what measures would be taken. Minister Opstelten answered that existing specialist teams are sufficient, that no additional measures are planned, and that the High Tech Crime unit's results are not lagging its targets.
Since these staff also handle other types of crime to a greater or lesser extent, I cannot give concrete FTE numbers in this context.
Aangezien deze medewerkers zich naast cybercrime ook in meer of mindere mate bezighouden met de aanpak van andere soorten strafbare feiten, kan ik in dit verband geen concrete aantallen fte's noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over een politie-inval naar aanleiding van een WhatsApp-bericht

MP Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police raided a home after a misread WhatsApp message, and how WhatsApp interception and its authorisation and accountability work. The minister confirmed awareness, said the police acted on an anonymous tip about a possible bomb, and explained that internet taps require prior authorisation by the investigating judge and are accounted for via official records and notification duties.
Recording of communications takes place solely on the order of the public prosecutor with prior authorisation from the investigating judge.
Het opnemen van communicatie gebeurt uitsluitend op bevel van de officier van justitie met een voorafgaande machtiging van de rechter-commissaris.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over het Nederlandse asielbeleid voor Russische LHBT-ers

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman and Schouw asked whether Russia's anti-gay propaganda law endangers LGBT people, what the Netherlands is doing about it, whether visa liberalisation should be suspended, and whether Russian LGBT asylum claims will be processed faster. The minister replied that the Netherlands raises LGBT rights through dialogue with Russia, the EU and the Council of Europe, that visa liberalisation is only at an exploratory stage with human rights weighed in future steps, and that LGBT asylum claims are assessed case by case under existing criteria without priority processing.

The Netherlands continues to focus primarily, both bilaterally and multilaterally, on broad international attention and dialogue on the human rights situation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia, rather than hardening positions.

Nederland blijft zowel op het bilaterale als multilaterale spoor primair inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de mensenrechtensituatie en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland, in plaats van het verharden van standpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de staatsrechtelijke problemen met betrekking tot het kort na elkaar houden van Provinciale Statenverkiezingen in Noord-Holland, Utrecht en Flevoland

An MP asks whether the Constitution requires new Eerste Kamer elections within three months of Provincial States elections, and whether postponing or splitting the provincial term extensions creates constitutional problems. The Minister replies that Articles 52 and 55 do not require the Eerste Kamer term to change when only some provinces are merged, citing commentators, and that postponing all provincial elections is undesirable because of time pressure.

By settled interpretation, the composition of the Eerste Kamer, except in case of dissolution, is meant to be determined by the newly elected states in all provinces and not partly by newly formed states and partly by states in their old composition.

Naar vaste uitleg is het de bedoeling dat de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer, behoudens in geval van ontbinding, wordt bepaald door de nieuw gekozen staten in alle provincies en niet deels door nieuw gevormde staten en deels door staten in oude samenstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de kosten uitzetting Guineese hongerstakers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the costs of deporting two Guinean hunger strikers, including the breakdown of flight and delegation costs, frequency of special deportation flights, joint EU flights with Frontex support, and the status of the CITT investigation into Guinea taskforces. The state secretary answered in detail on costs and frequency, said future flight costs cannot be predicted, and said he awaits the CITT's findings in its 2013 annual report without suspending the taskforces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat voedingsfabrikanten niet gestraft worden voor het plaatsen van misleidende informatie op etiketten

An MP asked the health and economics ministers why food manufacturers face few penalties for misleading labels, how enforcement capacity was increased, who is liable in the chain, and why the NVWA issued only 45 fines from 143 violations. The minister acknowledged that labels cannot be guaranteed fully accurate, described enforcement reprioritisation and planned higher fine ceilings and publication of inspection data.
In addition, I intend to double the fines for violations under the Commodities Act.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens de boetes voor overtredingen in het kader van de Warenwet te verdubbelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de politie op grote schaal misbruik maakt van internet- en telefoongegevens

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police misuse telecom and internet data via the CIOT system, including unlawful requests, shared access codes, repeated audit findings and the number of requests. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate's 2012 recommendations are being implemented on schedule, that the request volume reflects multiple queries per investigation, and that no services have been cut off from CIOT access so far.
I hereby inform you about the status of the various measures I have taken to give effect to these recommendations.
Bij deze informeer ik u over de stand van zaken van de verschillende maatregelen die ik heb getroffen om hieraan gestalte te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de signalen dat de Amerikaanse NSA ook topmensen uit het bedrijfsleven afluistert

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether the US NSA also spies on Dutch business leaders and Dutch companies for economic purposes, and what the risks and government response would be. Minister Plasterk answered that intercepting metadata for counterterrorism is acceptable within legal limits, that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss its methods or examples of corporate espionage, and that the government will send a signal to the US, referring to a letter of 28 October 2013.
No public statements can be made about the working methods and knowledge level of the AIVD, including examples of corporate espionage.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van AIVD, inclusief voorbeelden van bedrijfsspionage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat er teveel landbouwgif op groente en fruit zit

An MP asked the ministers whether the legal pesticide residue limits (MRLs) on fruit and vegetables are unsafe, as reported by Milieudefensie, Foodwatch and TROS Radar, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledges that some MRLs permit intake above the acute reference dose, says Nederland is pushing for revision in Brussels, and argues the share of unsafe MRLs is well below 10% with the actual health risk very small.
I consider the existence of such MRLs undesirable.
Ik vind het bestaan van dergelijke MRL's onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over een dreigende ernstige verslechtering van de positie van Iraanse lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele en transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra asked whether the abolition of the national c-ground in the asylum bill would worsen protection for Iranian LGBT asylum seekers, given continuing severe persecution, and whether the government would keep the protection level promised by a previous minister. The state secretary answered that a current country report on Iran will be assessed before the new law takes effect to decide whether equivalent protection under the a- or b-ground is needed, and that the group's protection is not automatically worsened.

However, this means that before the bill takes effect, based on current information on the situation of LGBT persons in Iran, it will be assessed whether there is reason to offer them a comparable level of protection under the a- or b-ground.

Wel brengt dit mee dat, voorafgaand aan de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel, op basis van de actuele informatie over de situatie van LHBT's in Iran, zal worden beoordeeld of er aanleiding bestaat om hen een vergelijkbaar beschermingsniveau te bieden in het kader van de a- of de b-grond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het kopiëren van identiteitsbewijzen door telecombedrijven

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister whether telecom companies copy customers' identity documents when signing up, whether this breaches the CBP privacy guidelines, and whether the government will act. The minister answered that partly masked scans are standard practice to prevent fraud, that enforcement is for the independent privacy regulator CBP, and that the government will not itself pressure telecom providers.
It is not for me to call telecom providers to account for the way they implement privacy legislation.
Het is niet aan mij om de telecomaanbieders aan te spreken op de manier waarop uitvoering wordt gegeven aan de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Franse wijnen vol gif zitten

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers whether a Belgian report that French wines contain pesticide residues poses health risks in the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister answered that NVWA testing shows no health risk, that existing EU residue limits for grapes apply to wine, and that no further action is planned.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat financiële data-analyse nauwelijks terreur voorkomt

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice minister about a report that financial data analysis rarely prevents terrorism, covering SWIFT data, AML/CFT rules, bank costs, retention and possible suspension of the EU-US TFTP agreement. The minister partly agreed with the report, said results are hard to quantify and often confidential, gave no case counts or false-positive figures, and saw no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement or change the EU AML directive position.
Given the highly confidential nature of this type of matter, I cannot rule out that the results will also have to remain partly confidential.
Gezien de zeer vertrouwelijke aard van dit type zaken, kan ik overigens niet uitsluiten dat de resultaten eveneens deels vertrouwelijk zullen moeten blijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat onbestuurbare drones uit de lucht kunnen vallen bij regen of wind

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether Raven drones can fall from the sky in rain or wind and how many crashed, and who bears liability for damage. The Defence minister denied that nine Ravens crashed, described the Rijkerswoerdse Plassen emergency landing and other flights, and said the aircraft is not certified for icing or heavy rain, with operations stopped before limits are exceeded.
There is no question of nine Ravens having crashed.
Er is geen sprake van het neerstorten van negen Ravens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat de servers van de Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) mogelijk zijn afgetapt door de NSA

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked ministers whether the NSA tapped SWIFT servers, including any server in the Netherlands, and what the government would do about it, including the EU-US TFTP programme. The government said it cannot confirm the report, SWIFT found no evidence of unauthorised access, the Commission has asked US authorities for clarification, and it sees no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement for now.
However, I cannot confirm the accuracy of that report.
Ik kan de juistheid van dat bericht echter niet bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat gemeenten de volle mep betalen voor het onderzoek naar de decentralisaties

MPs Schouw and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities in practice fully pay for the CPB multi-year research agenda on decentralisation, via the Gemeentefonds. The minister answers that the Rijk pays its half from the Rijksbudget (administratively placed in the Gemeentefonds), so the cost is shared equally, and that the €2 million also funds the Schouw motion research.
Given the distribution of costs, there is no question of the research agenda being fully financed by the municipalities.
Gelet op de verdeling van de kosten geldt dat er geen sprake is van een volledige financiering van de onderzoeksagenda door de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA) via telecomaanbieders het internationaal telefoonverkeer afluistert

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the government about reports that the US NSA was intercepting international telephone traffic via Belgian provider Belgacom, and whether Dutch telecom providers had been similarly breached or approached. The minister said there is no indication of a comparable breach in the Netherlands, that providers are responsible for their own security under the Telecommunicatiewet, that the government does not know whether foreign services approached Dutch providers, and that EU-US expert group work and the JBZ-Raad addressed the issue.
No public statements are made about contacts between the Dutch intelligence and security services and foreign services.
Over contacten tussen de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en buitenlandse diensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rapport van de UNHCR en Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland “Pas nu weet ik: vrijheid is het hoogste goed”

Mr Schouw (D66) asked the state secretary whether the closed extended asylum procedure lacks legal legitimacy, whether Dublin claimants are detained without substantive asylum review, and what alternatives to detention were examined. The state secretary rejected the claim of insufficient legal basis, pointing to independent judicial review of each detention, and said the Dublin procedure will be reviewed when the revised Dublin Regulation is implemented; he committed to informing the House on alternatives to detention.
Every placement in the closed extended asylum procedure can be brought by the asylum seeker, including the Dublin claimant, before the (independent) judge.
Elke plaatsing in de gesloten verlengde asielprocedure kan door de asielzoeker, ook de Dublinclaimant, worden voorgelegd aan de (onafhankelijke) rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de medische opvang van twee uitgezette hongerstakers

An MP asks the state secretary about the medical care of two hunger strikers deported to Guinea in August 2013, including whether promised treatment was actually arranged and why a delegation was sent. The government says the clinic was ready to treat them, that they left against medical advice, and that it will not cover the costs of the alternative clinic.
Both before the deportation and afterwards, the Dutch government did everything possible to fulfil the commitments regarding the medical transfer and support of the individuals concerned.

Zowel voorafgaand aan de uitzetting als daarna, is door de Nederlandse overheid al het mogelijke gedaan om de toezeggingen ten aanzien van de medische overdracht en begeleiding van betrokkenen na te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de Big Brother Awards

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Big Brother Awards, including the Tax Authority's expert prize and the Justice Minister's public prize for privacy-infringing policy. The minister answered that no jury report exists, defended the Tax Authority's use of police camera data and bulk requests to parking authorities as proportionate, rejected the suggestion that he ignores privacy, and promised a general letter on privacy and security later that autumn.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I will send your House a more general letter on the balance between privacy and security later this autumn.
De staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik zullen uw Kamer nog dit najaar een meer algemene brief sturen over de balans tussen privacy en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Schouw, Gesthuizen, Ouwehand en Voordewind over de voorgenomen ontruiming van de vluchtflat

MPs asked the state secretary what happens to residents of the Amsterdam 'vluchtflat' without residence prospects after its planned eviction, whether immigration detention is appropriate for them, who bears responsibility for their welfare and medical care, and whether alternative shelter will be provided before eviction. The state secretary replied that residents may choose to work on return and then get shelter in a freedom-restricting location with DT&V facilitation, that detention is a last resort applied case by case, that residents remain responsible for their own choices while retaining right to necessary medical care, and that he shares the ambition to prevent residents ending up on the street.
Since the residents of the Vluchtflat show no willingness to return and hardly want to talk to the DT&V, I do not rule out that in individual cases immigration detention may be the last resort.

Nu de bewoners van de Vluchtflat niet getuigen van terugkeerbereidheid en nauwelijks willen praten met de DT&V, sluit ik niet uit dat in individuele gevallen vreemdelingenbewaring het uiterste middel kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische asielzoekers door Bulgarije

MPs Maij, Gesthuizen and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reception conditions for Syrian asylum seekers in Bulgaria, including access to procedures, shelter, child provisions, EU minimum standards and other affected countries. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria faces overcrowded centres and UNHCR criticism, that an EU/Frontex/EASO mission was planned, that the Commission monitors EU law compliance, and that Greece and Cyprus would also be visited.
It is not for me, but precisely for the European Commission, to monitor the correct application of EU law.
Het is niet aan mij, maar juist de taak van de Europese Commissie om over correcte toepassing van het EU-recht te waken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Schouw over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Angolese asielzoeker

MPs from ChristenUnie, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government would reconsider the age cutoff of the Kinderpardon scheme, which excludes a 22-year-old Angolan asylum seeker who arrived at age ten, and whether he could await his objection procedure in the Netherlands and why he remains in detention. The State Secretary refused to revisit the upper age limit, allowed the man to await his objection procedure in the Netherlands, and defended detention given his earlier evasion of lighter measures.
I have now decided that the person concerned may await his objection procedure in the Netherlands.
Inmiddels heb ik besloten dat betrokkene zijn bezwaarprocedure in Nederland mag afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat de politie ongeoorloofd stealth sms’jes naar mobiele telefoons stuurt om verdachten te kunnen volgen

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice about reports that police covertly send 'silent SMS' to track suspects without proper authorisation, and about court criticism of this method. The minister confirmed the method is used, defended its legality and said police and prosecutors will tighten procedures, but declined to disclose how often it is used or how often it contributed to convictions.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service have informed me that they will take these critical points to heart and tighten the procedure for the use of the silent SMS.
Politie en OM hebben mij laten weten deze kritische punten ter harte te nemen en de procedure voor de inzet van de stille sms te zullen aanscherpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het plaatsen van hongerstakers in een isoleercel

MP Schouw (D66) asked the state secretary whether hunger strikers are still placed in bare isolation cells at Schiphol detention centre, whether the ombudsman was promised an end to this, and about camera monitoring and policy implications following a complaints committee ruling. The state secretary answered that the ombudsman's recommendation on facilities for hunger strikers is being implemented, that isolation is used sparingly, and that cells at Schiphol were upgraded by May 2013 without committing to new measures.

The National Ombudsman recommended in a 2010 report that directors of justice institutions be told that when hunger strikers are placed in an observation cell, as many facilities as possible must be provided there, as in a regular cell.

De Nationale ombudsman heeft in 2010 in een rapport de aanbeveling gedaan om bij de directeuren van de justitiële inrichtingen onder de aandacht te brengen dat wanneer hongerstakers in een observatiecel worden geplaatst, in deze cel zoveel mogelijk faciliteiten moeten worden geboden
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de effecten van de wijziging van het landgebonden asielbeleid Somalië

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how returns of Somalis were established, whether readmission agreements guarantee acceptance, why answers differ from court submissions, and whether detention and expulsions to South-Central Somalia remain justified amid Artsen zonder Grenzen's withdrawal and ECHR interim measures. The State Secretary defends the policy, says detention lacks no prospect of removal, cites an upcoming Council of State ruling, and refers to earlier answers on interim measures.
Of course I will follow this ruling if the Division concludes that there is insufficient prospect of removal to Somalia.
Uiteraard zal ik gevolg geven aan deze uitspraak indien de Afdeling oordeelt dat er onvoldoende zicht is op uitzetting naar Somalië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Justitie “superdrones” mag lenen van Defensie

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Justice Ministry may borrow Defence's new ScanEagle drones, and about privacy, airspace safety, incident history and transparency. The ministers answered that the ScanEagle may in principle be deployed in support of civil authorities once personnel are qualified, that existing legal frameworks suffice, and that they will not ban flights or publish evaluations, citing ongoing investigations.
It is not standard procedure for the police to conclude every deployment of a Defence Raven with an evaluation.
Het is niet een standaardprocedure voor de politie om iedere inzet van een Raven van Defensie met een evaluatie af te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de effecten van de wijziging van het landgebonden asielbeleid Somalië

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about the effects of the revised Somalia asylum policy on forced returns, voluntary returns, detention, cooperation arrangements and European Court interim measures. The State Secretary answered each question, noting that few forced returns had occurred, that interim measures do not change policy, and that he rejects Amnesty International's view that returns to south and central Somalia breach international law.
The government is not informed when a complainant asks the Court for an interim measure and the request is rejected, so I cannot provide figures on rejected requests.
De regering wordt niet op de hoogte gesteld als een klager het Hof heeft verzocht om oplegging van een voorlopige maatregel, maar dit verzoek is afgewezen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de uitzetting van een zieke asielzoeker

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the deportation of a seriously ill six-year-old asylum seeker, her medical treatment timeline, and what the government meant by the 'human scale' in policy. The State Secretary referred to earlier answers, said he cannot discuss the substance of medical care due to medical confidentiality and pending inspection investigations, and clarified the 'human scale' concept without changing restrictive policy.

Due to the medical confidentiality that applies to medical records and the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and Inspectorate for Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot currently make statements about the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medisch beroepsgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over klachten over het regime in vreemdelingendetentie (ingezonden 21 juni 2013).

MP Schouw asked the State Secretary about a TV report on complaints in immigration detention, how detainees can file complaints, and how many were filed and upheld over five years. The State Secretary explained the two-step complaint procedure (Commission of Supervision monthly commissioner, then complaints committee with appeal to the Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing) and reported falling complaint numbers and upheld complaints, while saying the new law will address complaints procedures.
Against the ruling of the complaints committee, the detainee who complains under the Pbw can lodge an appeal with the Council for Criminal Justice and Juvenile Protection.
Tegen de uitspraak van de beklagcommissie kan de ingeslotene die klaagt op grond van de Pbw beroep instellen bij de Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing en Jeugdbescherming.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vraag waarom rechters geen grondig feitenonderzoek zouden mogen plegen in asielzaken (ingezonden 11 juni 2013).

An MP asked the state secretary whether courts should be allowed to conduct a thorough fact review of asylum refusals, citing a doctoral study that marginal judicial review of asylum credibility conflicts with international and European law. The state secretary answered that credibility assessment rightly lies with the executive, that the courts' legality review is adequate, that no legislative change is currently needed, and that the implications of the new Procedures Directive will be examined later.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over afgeluisterde EU-diplomaten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the government would raise with the US the reported NSA surveillance of EU diplomats in Washington, Brussels and New York. The government said it had raised the matter at high level, that European and American experts will examine intelligence gathering and data protection together, and that next steps will follow from their findings.
European and American experts will jointly examine the issues of intelligence gathering and data protection.
Europese en Amerikaanse experts zullen zich gezamenlijk buigen over de problematiek van inlichtingenvergaring en dataprotectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het Gelderse paard

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the current status of the Gelderse paard breed, the implementation of a 2008 motion, what concrete measures are planned, and whether abolishing the Gelders-blood requirement is undesirable. The state secretary replied that research was funded and talks held with breeders, that next steps are up to the parties themselves, and that breed selection and breeding goals are a private matter for the stud book.
Determining the selection criteria and breeding objectives is a private matter for the stud books, in this case the KWPN.
Het bepalen van de selectiecriteria en fokdoelen is een private aangelegenheid van de stamboeken, in dit geval het KWPN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over schending van de gezinsherenigingsrichtlijnen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether he met Commissioner Reding in May 2013 about the EU family reunification directive, whether correspondence on a possible infringement procedure can be shared, and whether implementation will be revised after Commission and Children's Ombudsman criticism. The government confirms the meeting as routine preparation, denies discussing the directive, agrees to confidential access to the correspondence, and defers the substantive policy response to a separate letter.
Yes. As long as the correspondence does not enter the public domain, the Commission has no objection to (confidential) inspection.
Ja. Zolang de correspondentie niet in het publieke domein komt heeft de Commissie geen bezwaar tegen (vertrouwelijke) inzage.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht ‘Banken verkopen pingedrag klanten’

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked the state secretary about reports that banks and Equens planned to sell customers' PIN-transaction data, and whether this violates the Dutch data protection act (Wbp). The government answered that Equens has suspended the plans, that whether the data are personal data and whether the Wbp is breached is for the independent data protection authority (CBP) to judge, and that the CBP sees no reason to open an investigation for now.
It is not for us to pronounce on whether the data concern personal data and whether this is compatible with the Wbp.
Het past ons niet een uitspraak te doen over de vragen of de gegevens persoonsgegevens betreffen en of sprake is van verenigbaarheid met de Wbp.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over  ‘de additionele dekking van 69 miljoen bedoeld om wijzigingen in het masterplan Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen mee op te vangen’

An MP (D66) asked the State Secretary how the 69 million euro structural cover for revisions to the DJI masterplan is built from unpaid wage and price adjustments, which budget items are affected, and whether prisons will close. The State Secretary explained the wage/price adjustment mechanism, the reallocation schedule rising to 69 million by 2018, and that fewer prison closures and lower real-estate costs are expected, while stating that other items must absorb cost increases through efficiency measures.
Yes. X Footnote 1 DJI 2013–2018, Parliamentary paper 24 587, no. 490
Ja. X Noot 1 DJI 2013–2018, Kamerstuk 24 587, nr. 490
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over intimidatie en beïnvloedingspraktijken van buitenlandse overheden bij asielzoekers en migranten

An MP asked whether the AIVD has signs that Russia, like Iran and China, intimidates migrants and asylum seekers in the Netherlands, how the immigration chain handles such reports, whether asylum centres are approached by foreign intelligence services, whether staff are screened, how many people are intimidated and how their safety is ensured, and whether the Dolmatov case was investigated. The minister answered that there are no such signs at present, described the referral procedure to the AIVD and MIVD, said there are no concrete indications of foreign services approaching asylum centre residents, explained screening via VOG and security investigations, declined to give numbers publicly, and said the Dolmatov case was examined without leading to measures, while refusing further detail on current knowledge.
I cannot make any public statements about numbers.
Over aantallen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de ontwikkelingen rondom het thema lage loonschalen

An MP asks the minister for Housing and Civil Service why government is re-internalising low-paid facility work it had outsourced, whether it is cost-effective, and how many people are involved. The minister answers that business cases on insourcing security, post, printing, cleaning and catering are still being prepared, with no numbers or timelines yet.
To check this, I am now having business cases drawn up that calculate the financial consequences of insourcing work currently done by lower-scale staff.
Om dit na te gaan laat ik nu business cases opstellen waarin de financiële gevolgen worden berekend
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Schouw over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the state secretary whether Guinean laissez-passers for deportations were issued despite the Guinean ambassador's claim that he signed none, and why Guinea did not take part in taskforces. The state secretary answered that about 20 laissez-passers were obtained in 2013 from the Brussels mission, signed by the consul, that two deportations have taken place, and that there is no reason to suspend deportations to Guinea.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how acquitted ICC suspect Ngudjolo could be released on Dutch soil, whether the ICC met its host-state duties, and how witnesses or acquitted suspects excluded from asylum under Article 1F would be handled. The government answered that the ICC must arrange transfer after acquittal, Dutch authorities facilitate it, structural arrangements with the ICC registry are being developed, and detained witnesses' cases are discussed in that context without individual details.
Regarding the status of the procedure, I maintain the principle that I do not comment on individual cases.
Wat betreft de stand van de procedure hanteer ik het uitgangspunt dat ik niet inga op individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over de veiligheid van homoseksuele asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the State Secretary about safety of LGBT asylum seekers in reception centres, incidents, discrimination reports, the Deloitte and COC reports, and the COC's recommendations. The State Secretary replied that COA, IND and DT&V have taken measures, about 90 possible discrimination cases were recorded in 2012 at reception locations, the IND reported no incidents, and he committed to continued dialogue with the COC while rejecting some COC demands such as blanket asylum for LGBT nationals of countries criminalising homosexuality.
Without further information, such as file numbers, it is not feasible to establish what exactly happened in these cases.
Het is, zonder nadere informatie, zoals bijvoorbeeld dossiernummers, niet haalbaar om na te gaan wat er in deze zaken exact gespeeld heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over de inzet van onbemande vliegtuigjes (‘drones’) zonder toestemming van de gemeente door de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de politie in Soesterberg

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Royal Marechaussee and police used Raven drones for traffic checks in Soesterberg without informing the local authority, and how that fits with the military assistance procedure. The government admits the assistance procedure was not followed, that the local authority was not asked, that it has instructed all involved to follow the procedure in future, and that a police-wide drone policy is being developed.
Because the assistance procedure was not followed, the authority never got to the question of subsidiarity and proportionality.
Doordat de bijstandprocedure niet is gevolgd, is het gezag niet toegekomen aan de subsidiariteit- en proportionaliteitsvraag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Schouw en Voordewind over uitzettingen van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked about cooperation between the Guinean embassy in Brussels and the Guinean taskforce in the Netherlands on deportations, why a May 2013 taskforce was postponed, and whether there is a dispute between them. The state secretary answered that presentations are coordinated with both channels, that the postponement was due to unspecified Guinean reasons, that he knows of no dispute, and that about 100 travel documents were issued in 2012 with roughly a third of those returned, with no reason to suspend deportations.
I am not aware of any disagreement between the Guinean taskforce and the Guinean government.
Van onenigheid tussen de Guineese taskforce en de Guineese overheid is mij niets bekend.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de arrestatie van enkele protestanten op de Dam tijdens de inhuldiging van de koning

MPs Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest of protesters on the Dam during the 30 April 2013 inauguration, including police instructions, consistency with earlier ministerial letters on the right to demonstrate, the 'mistaken identity' explanation, and the role of plainclothes officers and the DKDB. The minister's further reply refers the House to earlier answers on the same events and to a supplementary letter from the Amsterdam mayor, and states that no reason is seen to change those answers.
I see no reason to change the answers to the above written questions.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de beantwoording van bovenstaande schriftelijke vragen te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Schouw van Uw Kamer over de medische behandeling van vreemdelingen

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Schouw asked the state secretary about the medical treatment of a hunger-striking asylum seeker at a Rotterdam detention centre, including allegations of mistreatment by a physician and restricted access for the trusted doctor. The state secretary defended the use of force by an internal assistance team, said the detainee refused a medical examination, referred the assault complaint to a police investigation, and stated that access and care procedures were followed.
If the outcomes give reason to do so, I will inform your House confidentially about this individual case.
Indien de uitkomsten daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik uw Kamer vertrouwelijk over deze individuele casus informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de paardenvleesaffaire

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about the horsemeat scandal, including the Selten firm's denial of fraud, the NVWA's sampling and figures, and the legal basis for the recall. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, maintained that the untraceable meat must be withdrawn under the General Food Law, and said there was no discrepancy in its letters and no reason to revise its decisions.
Meat that is unfit for human consumption may not be placed on the market.
Vlees dat ongeschikt is voor humane consumptie mag niet op de markt worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Russische spionnen erg actief zijn in Nederland

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russian and Chinese espionage in the Netherlands, including targeting of military-technological knowledge, is adequately understood and countered. The minister answered that intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD) investigate, disrupt operations, advise on security and screen defence contractors, while acknowledging that not all operations can be detected and no further public details can be given.
No further information on this can be provided publicly.
In het openbaar kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven over het herbestemmen van Rijksvastgoed

D66 MPs asked whether empty Rijksgebouw parking garages could be opened to the public in evenings and weekends to ease city parking problems, and what security obstacles exist. The minister answered that parking is a municipal responsibility, that five Hague garages are already partly public, and listed conditions for opening garages, plus a list of locations with more than 25 spaces.
Parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Het parkeerbeleid is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacyvoorwaarden bij apps en ander mobiel telefoongebruik

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about app privacy terms, Apple's user terms, and whether mobile location data can be traced to individuals. Minister Kamp answered that privacy law requires clear, readable terms and informed consent, that the matter of specific producer-consumer relations is not for him to judge, and that consumers can complain to the Autoriteit Consument & Markt and the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens.
It is not for me to pass judgment on how that relationship is shaped.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de invulling van die relatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Gesthuizen over een humaan asielbeleid

MPs Schouw (D66) and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about a more humane asylum policy, covering the wider policy direction, the return policy and the ground-for-no-fault criterion, criminalisation of illegal stay and aid to illegal migrants, the illegals quota for police, and conditions and numbers in immigration detention. The state secretary answered that the current policy leaves room for humane treatment, pointed to planned reviews, the forthcoming bill on criminalising illegal stay, and reduced detention capacity plans, while declining to discuss an illegals quota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het vastzetten van ‘gevaarlijke eenlingen’ in verband met de troonswisseling

An MP asked how many 'dangerous loners' were detained or monitored around the 30 April 2013 coronation, how police and prosecutors handle them, and what legal remedies they have. The minister said about twenty potentially violent loners were identified and monitored, with 11 ordered to leave the area, and that people can only be arrested on suspicion of a criminal offence, not preventively.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de zorgelijke toename van het aantal herhaalde asielaanvragen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why repeat asylum applications have risen sharply, whether the eight-day procedure is to blame, which policy changes cause them, what share end in approval, and whether the rise will be studied. The State Secretary attributes repeat applications to varied motives and policy developments, says the approval share cannot be given due to the IND system transition, and states that the rise will be addressed through existing measures and the PIVA evaluation later in 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat onderzoeken naar de gevaren van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor bijen in Nederland niet openbaar gemaakt worden

Parliamentary questions from MP Schouw (D66) asked why studies on the harm of Bayer's insecticide to bees are not published in the Netherlands while available in England, and whether the Ctgb's disclosure assessment should change. The state secretary answered that the matter is before the court, which forbade publication of part of the studies pending a ruling, and that the Ctgb judged the studies on sublethal effects to be publishable while referring further to a letter to parliament.
This matter is before the court, which has forbidden the Ctgb from making it public before a ruling is given in the substantive proceedings.
Deze zaak is onder de rechter en die heeft het Ctgb verboden om tot openbaarmaking over te gaan voordat er in de bodemprocedure uitspraak is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een ernstig zieke vreemdeling

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why a seriously ill Togolese former unaccompanied minor, resident over eleven years, faces deportation, why the state appealed a court ruling in his favour, and whether the discretionary power should be used. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, restated the medical-stay procedure and the general policy framework, and said rootedness is not an objective criterion.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, vind ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat onbemande militaire vliegtuigen (“drones”) steeds vaker in Nederland worden ingezet als opsporingsmiddel van de politie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the police use Defence's unmanned Raven aircraft for investigations and public order, and about legal basis, costs, liability, privacy, oversight and public information. The minister answered that 14 requests were granted in 2012 (81 flights), that the legal basis is the assistance regime of the Politiewet 2012, that data are kept only if relevant to criminal cases, and that civilian drone use is governed by Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport permits.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het ontbreken van Nederlandse immigratie- en asielgegevens in de rapportages van Eurostat

An MP asked why Dutch asylum and immigration data are missing from Eurostat overviews and whether they can be supplied, and about return figures. The State Secretary answered that data for 2012 could not be delivered due to the conversion from INDIS to INDiGO, to be supplied retroactively after completion, and that no return figures from countries of origin are held.
Once the conversion of the active 2012 files is completed, the data will be made available retroactively.
Nadat de conversie van de actieve dossiers 2012 is voltooid, zullen de gegevens met terugwerkende kracht beschikbaar worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de marktverstorende overheid en herintredende overheidsdiensten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked why the government takes back in-house activities it had outsourced, whether this distorts markets under the Wet markt en overheid, and how it squares with the compact civil service goal. The minister answered that the state may freely choose between outsourcing and in-house work, that in-house activities fall outside the market-conduct law, and that employment considerations will be presented in May.
I consider it desirable that government service providers assess per activity whether it is sensible to put an assignment on the market or to carry out the activity themselves.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat overheidsdiensten per activiteit beoordelen of het verstandig is om een opdracht in de markt te zetten of om de betreffende activiteit zelf uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verdwijnen van de plofkip uit de Nederlandse winkelschappen

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about supermarket and poultry-sector agreements to phase out fast-growing 'plofkip' chicken, covering who does what, enforcement, environmental impact, animal welfare and labelling. The state secretary welcomed the agreements as a first step, pointed to private quality systems for enforcement, and said welfare improvements would continue stepwise.
I welcome the initiative of the supermarkets and the poultry meat chain to produce a new market segment of fresh poultry meat for Dutch supermarkets.
Ik ben verheugd met het initiatief van de supermarkten en de pluimveevleesketen om een nieuw marktsegment voor vers pluimveevlees te gaan produceren voor de Nederlandse supermarkten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de toename van het aantal vluchtelingen vanuit Syrië

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked about the rising number of Syrian refugees, EU strategy, family reunification and visa policy for Syrians. The state secretary replied that the EU has seen asylum applications from Syrians rise sharply, that EASO and emergency funds exist for member states, that the Temporary Protection Directive is not yet triggered, that Netherlands issues no visas on protection grounds, and that EU and member states have committed substantial humanitarian funding.
The Netherlands does not issue visas for reasons of international protection.
Nederland verstrekt geen visa om redenen van internationale bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over het bericht dat circa 100 huizen van Pakistaanse christenen zijn verbrand vanwege vermeende belediging van Mohammed

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether the Pakistani government adequately protects Christian minorities after about 100 homes were burned over an alleged blasphemy case, and why Christians are not classed as a risk group for asylum purposes. The state secretary answered that Pakistani authorities often fail to protect and prosecute perpetrators, that no reliable data on 2012 incidents exists, and that after considering the Lahore incident he still does not consider Pakistani Christians a risk group.
No, there is no reliable information available on this.
Nee, er is hierover geen betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over leges

An MP asks the state secretary whether leges for residence permits must be reduced following the CJEU and Raad van State rulings, whether the cost-recovery principle still applies, and why leges for replacing a foreigner's document are much higher than for Dutch or EU identity documents. The state secretary answers that leges for study and research were lowered, medical-ground permits are unaffected since they are national, cost recovery remains the principle subject to EU law, and higher fees for foreigners' documents reflect the extra checks the IND must perform.
I therefore see no reason to adjust these fees downward.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding om deze leges naar beneden bij te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw betreffende de gevolgen van de door de medeoverheden verstrekte hypothecaire leningen voor de schuldpositie

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the Chamber should be informed about the effects on debt positions of mortgage loans that municipalities, provinces, water boards and ZBOs gave to their staff, and whether an inventory should be made. The minister replied that such loans are an autonomous matter with no specific reporting duty, that existing budget and supervision mechanisms suffice, and that he sees no realistic chance of an information request.
Providing mortgage loans to one's own staff is an autonomous matter for which there is no specific reporting obligation.
Het verstrekken van hypothecaire leningen aan eigen personeel is een autonome aangelegenheid waarover geen specifieke rapportageplicht bestaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten nog meer mogelijkheden heeft om in clouddata graaien

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked whether US law (the FISAA, extended on 30 December 2012) lets US authorities access personal data stored in the EU by US-based cloud providers, and what the consequences and remedies are. The state secretary answered that the Act grants no new powers, that no concrete cases of such demands for EU-stored data are known (US authorities say requests go via mutual legal assistance), and that the government will raise the issue in the EU data protection regulation negotiations.
Negotiations are under way in Brussels on a General Data Protection Regulation.
Er wordt in Brussel onderhandeld over een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de grondverliezen van gemeenten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal land-exploitation losses and the limited provincial supervision threaten municipal capacity, and whether new rules are needed. The minister answered that losses are being absorbed by municipalities under existing norms, that provincial supervision is not marginal, and that no new accountant instructions are currently needed.
The intention exists to carry out a follow-up study again this year, in consultation with the provincial supervisors.
Het voornemen bestaat om ook dit jaar en in overleg met de provinciale toezichthouders, weer een vervolgonderzoek te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en Hachchi over de situatie van ezels op Sint Eustatius

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reportedly poor conditions for dozens of donkeys on Sint Eustatius and whether local authorities had promised to end the situation. The State Secretary answered that the public body had rounded up most loose donkeys, that a drought-related food shortage has since been resolved, that an action list was agreed with Greenfound Foundation, and that the ministry would mediate if local authorities asked.
If the local authorities request it, I am willing to engage in mediation where possible.
Indien de plaatselijke autoriteiten daartoe verzoeken ben ik bereid om mij waar mogelijk in te zetten voor bemiddeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

D66 MPs asked the State Secretary about a Congolese person acquitted by the International Criminal Court who was detained by Dutch authorities for removal, questioning whether this ignored the court's ruling and whether the ICC assessed his safety. The State Secretary answered that acquittal does not confer a right to remain, that the host state must facilitate transfer to a third state under the seat agreement, that his asylum/protection request is pending, and that structural arrangements with the ICC are being discussed.
The Netherlands deprived the person of his liberty within the framework of the aforementioned immigration law procedure.
Nederland heeft betrokkene zijn vrijheid ontnomen in het kader van genoemde vreemdelingrechtelijke procedure.
Antwoord vragen Schouw naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Europese landbouwsubsidies naar kerken en sjoelclubs'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why EU agricultural subsidies under the rural development programme were going to churches and card clubs, and whether this matched the rules. The State Secretary answered that these non-agricultural projects fall under rural-development axis 3 and LEADER within the POP2 framework, gave budget figures and publication details, and said future spending would focus on agriculture and innovation.
The examples cited in the article fall under axis 3.
De voorbeelden aangehaald in het artikel vallen onder as 3.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Schouw over het bericht dat rechtszaken te duur worden voor lage inkomens door bezuinigingen op de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

MPs De Wit and Schouw asked the State Secretary whether budget cuts to subsidised legal aid, including a draft decree on contributions and lawyer fees, make court access nearly impossible for low-income citizens, and whether a full study of the effects would be done. The State Secretary said access for low-income groups remains guaranteed, that a quick scan was completed but a deeper study of cumulative effects is not feasible in the short term, and that the decree's effects will be reported in spring 2013.
I aim to inform the House in spring 2013 about how the renewal of the system will be further developed.
Ik streef ernaar in het voorjaar van 2013 uw Kamer te informeren over de wijze waarop de stelselvernieuwing verder wordt uitgewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat zijn ‘fusiebonus’ om gemeentelijke herindelingen te stimuleren, in strijd is met de wet

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that his proposed financial 'fusion bonus' to encourage municipal mergers conflicts with the Financial Relations Act, and about claims that no negative incentive against mergers exists. The Minister acknowledged a negative incentive from losing the fixed amount, said he is researching a positive incentive system and would propose legislation if needed, and rejected the claim that the fixed amount is unimportant.
At present I am researching the desired system of financial incentives. Should the outcome mean that a legislative amendment is necessary, you will of course receive a proposal to that effect.

Op dit moment doe ik onderzoek naar het gewenste systeem van financiële prikkels. Mocht de uitkomst hiervan betekenen dat wetswijziging noodzakelijk is, dan zult u vanzelfsprekend een daartoe strekkend voorstel ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het uitschrijven van mensen uit de GBA wanneer zij langer dan zes maanden elders verblijven

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether people who spend more than six months a year elsewhere can stay registered in the municipal population register, what the consequences of deregistration are, how many people are deregistered for this reason, and whether an investigation into keeping such people registered at home is planned. The minister explained the two-thirds-abroad criterion for deregistration and its importance for residence-linked obligations, said central figures are not available, and stated that the rules will carry over into the proposed Wet basisregistratie personen.
The number of persons per year who are deregistered ex officio for this reason cannot be determined at central level.
Het aantal personen dat per jaar om deze reden ambtshalve wordt uitgeschreven, is op centraal niveau niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van hypothecaire leningen aan medewerkers door de overheid

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior about municipalities and other public bodies providing mortgage loans to their staff, including amounts involved, effects on debt, and whether such loans should end. The Minister agreed it is not a government task, noted that since 2009 the Wet FIDO bars public bodies from such contracts, but said he does not know the total outstanding loans and that decentralised governments need not report them.
I am not aware of the total of ongoing mortgage loans that were entered into before 2009.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van het totaal aan lopende hypothecaire leningen die voor 2009 zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over aantallen kinderen die niet onder de regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen vallen

MP Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how many children fall outside the long-term resident children scheme, including by contra-indication, by absence of an asylum application, and whether families who evaded state supervision but stayed known to municipalities are excluded. The State Secretary said no reliable estimate can be given, excluded children who evaded supervision, and promised to assess cases reported by the VNG under the scheme's conditions.
It is not possible to give an estimate of the number of children who fall outside the scheme because of a contra-indication or for not submitting an asylum application.
Het is niet mogelijk om een schatting te geven van het aantal kinderen dat niet onder de regeling valt vanwege een contra-indicatie of het niet indienen van een asielverzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over stijgende lokale lasten

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister about sharp rises in local property tax (OZB) and waterschap charges, including whether the 2013 macronorm would be exceeded and how the motion on capping water board charges is being implemented. The minister answered that tariff-setting is an autonomous municipal and water board competence within the macronorm framework, that definitive figures await the uniform monitor due in March, and that any overshoot would be raised in the Bofv consultation where sanctions could be considered.
If the actual macronorm is exceeded, the central government will raise this in the regular Bofv consultation with subnational governments in spring.

Als er sprake is van een overschrijding van de feitelijke macronorm dan zal dit door het Rijk aan de orde worden gesteld in het reguliere Bestuurlijke overleg financiële verhoudingen (Bofv) met medeoverheden in het voorjaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland overweegt haar steun aan de EU-privacyvoorstellen in te trekken

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would withdraw support for EU data privacy proposals by joining a blocking minority, and which points and member states might form one. The minister denied concrete indications of any blocking minority, said the Netherlands takes positions like all member states and will keep the Chamber informed, and agreed to answer before the JBZ Council debate.
I have no concrete indications of the existence or form of a blocking minority in the negotiations on the proposals mentioned.
Ik heb geen concrete aanwijzingen van het bestaan of vormen van een blokkerende minderheid bij de onderhandelingen over de genoemde voorstellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat gezochte criminelen makkelijk aan een paspoort kunnen komen
