MP Schouw asked why wanted offenders can obtain passports, given that only 217 of 1566 fugitive convicts are flagged and only 16 passports withdrawn, and how the passport-alert register can be made more complete. The Secretary of State explained the strict legal conditions for listing (Dutch nationality plus a well-founded suspicion of flight abroad), pointed to OM procedures, and said the Paspoortwet will be amended to widen passport alerts.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and I have agreed to amend the Passport Act as soon as possible regarding the conditions for passport alerts.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en ik zijn overeengekomen de Paspoortwet op zo kort mogelijke termijn aan te passen wat betreft de voorwaarden voor paspoortsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over vervolgingen en veroordelingen wegens majesteitsschennis

D66 MPs Pechtold and Schouw asked the Justice Minister about prosecutions and convictions for lèse-majesté after a press report claimed they were rising. The minister replied with yearly OM figures showing no clear increase, said the offence is not a priority for prosecution, and refused to draft a bill equalising insult penalties.
Enforcement of the criminal provisions on insult and lèse-majesté is not a priority.
De handhaving van strafbaarstellingen van belediging en majesteitsschennis heeft geen prioriteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Schouw over het bericht dat er nauwelijks controle is op het rookverbod in de horeca

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality is too thin, given roughly 3,154 targeted checks by the NVWA in 2012, uneven regional coverage and reported fine figures. The state secretary answered that enforcement is as optimal as current capacity allows, that the problem is concentrated in cafés and discotheques, that about 4,000 targeted checks are planned for 2013, and that he is examining options to expand enforcement capacity.
I am currently examining the options to increase enforcement capacity.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment de mogelijkheden om de handhavingscapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked whether US authorities could access biometric data held by Morpho in the Netherlands under the Patriot Act, and whether the agreed solution with Morpho prevents this. The minister answered that the US law remains in force and has extraterritorial reach, but that Morpho reports no data requests and the agreements are a proportionate safeguard, while refusing to guarantee that foreign authorities will never use extraterritorial powers to access personal data.
I cannot make any statements about requests from US authorities to other companies.
Over vragen van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten bij andere bedrijven kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de toenemende onrust binnen de rechterlijke macht

An MP asked the Justice Minister about growing unrest among judges and a manifesto against the erosion of the judiciary, asking whether the minister would talk with judges and commit to protecting quality against production demands. The minister said the Judiciary Council will hold the dialogue first, that he will follow it and engage if needed, and will inform parliament after the consultation rounds conclude.
I consider it primarily a task for the Judiciary Council to engage in dialogue with the judges and councillors who have expressed their concerns.
Ik acht het in de eerste plaats een taak voor de Raad voor de rechtspraak om het gesprek aan te gaan met de rechters en raadsheren die hun zorgen hebben geuit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouw over het terugtrekken van de overheid uit het Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouw asked whether the government's cooperation agreement on the Platform Verduurzaming Voedsel ends on 1 January 2013 and whether the state withdraws, and how that fits a parliamentary motion requiring active continuation. The state secretary confirmed the agreement expires, says the government stays involved via a regiegroep and topsector policy, and promises a 3-year overview and an evaluation around summer 2013.
The government remains directly involved in the sustainability process of the food chain through the Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens.
De overheid blijft via de Regiegroep Duurzame Veehouderij en Agroketens direct betrokken bij het verduurzamingsproces van de voedselketen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Tongeren, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about reports that Somali asylum seekers whose applications were rejected were put back on the street after leaving a tent camp in Amsterdam, and whether this could have been avoided under the earlier motion and the Bestuursakkoord; they also asked how this squares with a Raad van State ruling on detention and how many Somalis had returned voluntarily. The state secretary answered that about 50 were sent away, that only a shelter conditional on cooperating with return was offered and not taken up, that conditional shelter remains policy, and that about 25 Somalis returned voluntarily since 2010, with forced return to all of Somalia now possible again.
I am willing to offer shelter to these foreigners, on condition that they cooperate with return.
Ik ben bereid om onderdak te bieden aan deze vreemdelingen, onder de voorwaarde dat wordt meegewerkt aan terugkeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de toegang tot de schuldhulpverlening en de schuldsanering

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether stricter selection criteria for debt rescheduling and debt relief have reduced access, and about differences between municipalities. The government replied that municipalities now carry debt assistance responsibility, that no national data on excluded people exist, that Wsnp applications rose from 16,643 to 21,114 between 2010 and 2011, and that debt assistance tends to pay for itself.
The national government does not keep records of the number of people with problematic debts who do not qualify for debt assistance.
Door het Rijk worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over het aantal mensen met problematische schulden dat niet in aanmerking komt voor schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Schouw en Krol over het bericht dat uitgeprocedeerde Somalische asielzoekers weer op straat zijn gezet

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks, D66 and 50PLUS asked whether most residents of the former Amsterdam tent camp were put on the street on 30 November, whether this is responsible in winter, and whether it could have been prevented under the Gesthuizen motion and the 2007 agreement with the VNG. The State Secretary answered that most were sent away after arrest, that the alternative shelter required cooperation with return, and that he sees no need for structural emergency shelter by municipalities.
It is true that the majority of the foreigners were sent away after their arrest.
Het klopt dat het merendeel van de vreemdelingen na hun aanhouding is heengezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacy van internetters

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether personal data of a 16-year-old was handed to the state by Skype without a valid request, and how many such cases occur per year. The minister explains that police may not request voluntary data disclosure, that spontaneous third-party disclosures are permitted with a proces-verbaal, and that no statistics on such cases are kept.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep statistics on the number of cases in which personal data was spontaneously provided to investigators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt geen statistieken bij over het aantal gevallen waarin spontaan persoonsgegevens aan de opsporing zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het niet door de Kroon vernietigen van de programmabegroting 2012 van de gemeente Haaksbergen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the 2012 budget of Haaksbergen municipality should be annulled by the Crown, given it may not comply with the BBV budget rules and may be unrealistic. The minister agreed the budget does not fully meet BBV requirements but deferred to the provincial supervisor (Gedeputeerde Staten of Overijssel), which judged the budget materially balanced and agreed improvement commitments for 2013, declining to intervene himself.
I see no reason to take the place of the province.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op de stoel van de provincie te gaan zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Jan Vos en Schouw over geweld in de Braziliaanse sojateelt

MPs Van Gerven, Jan Vos and Schouw asked the government about violence against indigenous peoples and smallholders linked to Brazilian soy farming, and what Dutch action, embassy contact, bank financing and investigation follow-up exists. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy raises indigenous rights with Brazil and supports CIMI, that the Dutch soy sustainability initiatives are supported, that the embassy has no knowledge of a river-dredging study, and that one Dutch bank has a code of conduct and it will report on prosecutor investigations involving Dutch financiers.
Yes, insofar as this concerns Dutch banks and financiers.
Ja, voor zover dit Nederlandse banken en financiers betreft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Karalabut over het bestemmen van de resterende middelen ten behoeve van Sinti en Roma

MPs Schouw and Karabulut asked how remaining funds for Sinti and Roma redress would be managed after the NISR liquidation and SARSR dissolution, including oversight, conflict-of-interest concerns and future representation. The state secretary answered that about EUR 4.39 million remains in a treasury account, the foundation's mandate continues past 1 January 2013 pending a new approach, she supervises the body, and she acknowledges the appearance of conflict of interest.
Ik houd toezicht op het zbo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, en Schouw over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration whether deportations of rejected asylum seekers to Guinea rely on corrupt authorities, how travel-document delegations and payments work, and whether a specific mother and children case and related investigations will be addressed. The minister answered that cooperation is necessary but structured via MoUs and delegations from Guinean ministries, that payments follow standard return practice, and that deportations will not be suspended, with the family case to be reported by end 2012.
Your House will be informed further about the family concerned before the end of 2012.
Uw Kamer wordt over het betreffende gezin voor het eind van 2012 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de onnodige eisen voor goed ingeburgerde buitenlanders die Nederlander willen worden

An MP asked why well-integrated foreigners such as a German-born specialist GP married to a Dutch citizen must still take the naturalisation integration exam, and whether the IND can be instructed to waive it. The minister answered that the GP's specialist training qualifies for exemption, that no instruction is needed as the case is now settled, and that municipal integration exemptions are not carried into naturalisation policy to ensure national uniformity.
Meanwhile, regarding the physician the question refers to, it has been established that he is not required to pass the naturalisation test. An instruction is not necessary.
Inmiddels is met betrekking tot de arts waarop de vraag doelt, vastgesteld dat deze niet verplicht is de naturalisatietoets te halen. Een instructie is niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over besmette zalm

An MP asked the government about salmonella-contaminated Greek salmon sold via a Harderwijk supplier, covering distribution, NVWA inspection frequency, consumer awareness, bacteria stickers, pre-export inspection and EU food-safety cooperation. The minister answered that the contaminated salmon reached various retail and food outlets, that the NVWA's sampling found no salmonella, and that EU rules and FVO oversight apply, offering no new oversight measures.
All samples examined for Salmonella were negative.
Alle op Salmonella onderzochte monsters waren daarbij negatief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het recht op onderwijs voor asielzoekers van achttien jaar en ouder

An MP asked the ministers whether adult asylum seekers aged 18 and over, who have little access to education, can be denied meaningful schooling, and whether the Robin Hood College initiatives and ISK classes could be expanded. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same formal rights as residents, that compulsory education ends at 18, that it sees no discrimination, and that it will examine practical barriers and report to parliament later.
We intend to investigate the scale of the problem and consider which solution can be found.
Wij zijn voornemens te onderzoeken wat de omvang van het probleem is en te bezien welke oplossing kan worden gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Facebook de activiteiten van zijn gebruikers scant op mogelijke criminele activiteiten

An MP asked the Dutch ministers of Security and Justice whether they knew of reports that Facebook scans user activity for possible criminal activity, how this fits EU and Dutch data protection law, whether detection of criminals should be solely a government task, whether other firms do this, and whether Dutch authorities systematically use such information. The minister answered that he lacks details, that privacy supervisors (Ireland and the Article 29 group) are examining the matter, that Article 22 of the Dutch data protection act allows private parties to process criminal data in their own interest under conditions, that crime detection is a government task, and that Dutch authorities do not systematically use such information.

The Dutch Data Protection Authority informed me that the Irish privacy supervisor, where Facebook's European office is located, is investigating Facebook on behalf of the privacy supervisors of the other 26 EU member states.

Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft mij in dit verband meegedeeld dat de privacytoezichthouder in Ierland, waar het Europese kantoor van Facebook is gevestigd, mede namens de privacytoezichthouders van de 26 overige EU-lidstaten onderzoek doet naar Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de vervanging van volksvertegenwoordigers die door een ongeval in coma zijn geraakt

An MP asked whether a legal mechanism can be created to temporarily replace a municipal councillor who is in a coma after an accident, as in Schouwen-Duiveland. The minister explained the existing leave rules, said a scheme modelled on the one for aldermen could be considered but has limits, and declined to commit to a bill because a permanent solution would require a constitutional amendment.
For a scheme, article X 10 of the Kieswet would have to be amended.
Voor een regeling zou artikel X 10 van de Kieswet moeten worden aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Schouw en Dijksma over een (voorlopige) stop op uitzetting vreemdelingen met een 1F-status

MPs Dibi, Schouw and Dijksma asked the minister whether the 1F asylum policy (excluding persons with serious crime or war crime suspicions) should be suspended pending European Court rulings and a new cabinet, and whether the families concerned would be informed. The minister replied that there is no reason to change the policy, that Court interim measures are individual and do not imply policy change, and that he will not suspend departures, citing the need for clarity.
I therefore see no reason to adjust the policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland moet terughacken

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked the Justice minister about reports that the Netherlands should 'hack back' against foreign servers spreading viruses, including what actions the government takes and the risks and legal safeguards of such measures. The minister replied that cyber security is primarily the responsibility of individuals and providers, the government protects its own infrastructure and informs the public via NCSC, that hack-back is not an official government term and would be addressed in a forthcoming legislative proposal on cybercrime, and that an international treaty comparable to the law of the sea is interesting but premature.
However, I note that in the rapidly changing digital world, legislation and international agreements have fallen behind.
Wel constateer ik dat in de snel veranderende digitale wereld de wetgeving en internationale afspraken zijn achter gebleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat in de gemeente Opmeer (Noord-Holland) burgers/vrijwilligers geen stembureaus meer mogen bemannen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the municipality of Opmeer's decision to staff polling stations only with officials and councillors, excluding volunteers, was justified and whether it is common, and what is being done about counting errors. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for appointing polling station members, that the decision was based on evaluations of counting differences, that the government values volunteers but respects the municipality's choice, and that the municipality will evaluate the upcoming election.
Appointing polling station members is the responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
Het benoemen van stembureauleden is de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het vrouwenstandpunt van de SGP

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the ECHR ruling on the SGP's exclusion of women from passive voting rights, and what measures would end it before upcoming elections. The minister said the SGP is being asked to consult on consequences, the government is considering measures if the SGP does not act, and that candidate lists for the coming Tweede Kamer elections are already final.
I will inform the House of Representatives by letter of further decision-making on this matter.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer middels een brief op de hoogte stellen van nadere besluitvorming hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de ontbinding van het Nederlands Instituut Sinti en Roma (NISR) en het bestemmen van de middelen ten behoeve van Sinti en Roma

MPs Schouw and Karabulut asked why the Nederlands Instituut Sinti en Roma (NISR) was being liquidated after about 1.5 years, despite earlier approval of its 2012 plan and a planned five-year evaluation, and how funds and expertise would be protected. The state secretary answered that the NISR board decided to liquidate on the basis of its own quick scan, that SARSR approved the 2012 budget, that liquidation aims to be short and is following statutory procedures, and that SARSR will fund liquidation costs and inventory NISR's activities for a possible new approach.
I have no insight into the internal communications of the NISR foundation.
Ik heb geen zicht op de interne communicatie van de stichting NISR.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi, Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Thieme, Schouw over het bericht 'Syrische asielzoekers eisen duidelijkheid'

Six MPs asked the minister about a report that Syrian asylum seekers demanded clarity on their status, including whether group-wide protection under the Qualification Directive applies and how hunger strikes could be prevented. The minister replied that a 3 August letter sets out the policy, that individual assessment remains the starting point, and that Syrians not shown to be active supporters of the regime may receive temporary asylum residence permits under the Aliens Act.
On 3 August I informed your House about how I have shaped the country-based asylum policy regarding Syria.
Op 3 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Syrië heb vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de veiligheid van paspoortgegevens

An MP asked the State Secretary about the security of passport data, including the spread of requests for passport copies, CBP guidance, and the possibility of a fining power for the privacy regulator. The State Secretary said the CBP is independent and enforces the ban on copying identity documents, that the website was updated in consultation with the CBP, and that the fining power motion would be answered separately.
The CBP is independent and sets its own supervisory, enforcement and information priorities, and is accountable for them.
Het CBP is onafhankelijk en stelt zelf zijn toezichts-, handhavings- en voorlichtingsprioriteiten vast, en legt daarover verantwoording af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het niet naleven van het SWIFT-akkoord over de doorgifte van bankgegevens

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the EU-US SWIFT agreement on bank data transfers is being implemented, including Europol's secret report, public access rights, and the Commission's delayed filtering system. The minister answered that the implementation is in line with the TFTP agreement, that the report is classified and access is governed by EU rules, and that the Commission has not failed its obligations.
The report is classified as 'Secret' and is therefore a sensitive document within the meaning of Article 9 of this regulation.
Het rapport is geclassificeerd als «Secret», en is daarmee een gevoelig document in de zin van artikel 9 van deze verordening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Schouw over controles op EK-voetbalpoules in café's en kroegen

MPs Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit will actively check cafés and pubs running EK football pools, whether fines can reach 780,000 euro, and what criteria distinguish open from closed pools. The State Secretary answered that the regulator sets its own priorities, will focus on large-scale commercial gambling rather than small café pools, may impose fines up to 780,000 euro or 10% of turnover, and will consider whether a venue is open to the public.
In principle the gambling authority itself decides how it carries out those tasks and which priorities it sets.
In beginsel bepaalt de kansspelautoriteit zelf hoe zij die taken uitvoert en welke prioriteiten zij daarbij stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Interior whether biometric data for Dutch travel documents, held by Morpho in Haarlem, could be accessed by US authorities under the Patriot Act given its US affiliates. The minister confirmed the outsourcing and said US jurisdiction cannot be excluded, but that any US request would be tested against reciprocity, sovereignty and Dutch and European data protection rules, and that no US requests had been received.
Furthermore, Morpho is willing to investigate whether further measures can be taken to prevent this.
Voorts is Morpho bereid te onderzoeken of er verdergaande maatregelen genomen kunnen worden dat te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Dijksma, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Oproep: stop uitzetten kinderen’

MPs from four parties asked the immigration minister whether he knew of the Children's Ombudsman's call to halt deportations of children, how many child-involved deportations were planned, when he would respond to the report, and whether he would suspend planned removals until the Samsom/Voordewind bill is debated. The minister refused a deportation stop, arguing it would not serve the children's interests, create legal inequality and undermine return procedures, and said he could not give a count of planned deportations because the information changes daily.
It is not possible to indicate how many deportations involving minor children are planned for the coming months.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel uitzettingen, waarbij minderjarige kinderen zijn betrokken, er voor de komende maanden gepland zijn.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Dijksma, Voordewind, Dibi en Schouw over de ontstane situatie in Ter Apel

Five MPs asked the minister whether a clearance of the tent camp of rejected asylum seekers in Ter Apel had begun, and about its course, the pending summary proceedings, and the medical condition of residents. The minister replied that residents were offered temporary shelter with a freedom-restriction measure, that the Iraqi group left voluntarily, and that the mayor issued an emergency order to end the action on safety grounds.
In line with my commitment made in the emergency debate of 15 May 2012, I will inform you fully in writing as soon as possible once the action has ended.
Conform mijn toezegging gedaan in het spoeddebat van 15 mei 2012, zal ik u schriftelijk zo spoedig mogelijk volledig informeren zodra de actie is afgelopen.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Schouw over vermeende uitspraken van de Albanese staatssecretaris van Defensie

Two D66 MPs asked whether an Albanian deputy defence minister really called for the Dutch ambassador to be declared persona non grata over LGBT advocacy, and what the government would do. The minister confirmed the statements, said they do not reflect the Albanian government's position, and said the EU and Dutch embassy have condemned them and will continue supporting LGBT emancipation.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to ask the Albanian authorities for clarification on these specific statements.
Ik acht het derhalve niet nodig om de Albanese autoriteiten over deze specifieke uitspraken om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam, Gesthuizen, Dibi, Schouw en Voordewind over het stopzetten van zestien hoger beroepprocedures en het niet uitzetten van zestien Somaliërs

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister why he withdrew appeals in sixteen Somali asylum cases and stopped detention and removals, given the security situation in Mogadishu. The minister replied that return to North Somalia remains possible via Mogadishu airport, that the appeals were withdrawn because forced return could not be organised in a way he considered responsible at present, that detention was lifted, and that returnees without state-funded shelter are not entitled to accommodation.
That is why the appeals were withdrawn.
Daarom zijn de hoger beroepen ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Berndsen over het afschaffen van de verplichting van het ‘gratis’ huwelijk

MPs Schouw and Berndsen asked whether the legal obligation for municipalities to offer free weddings should be abolished, given the claimed cost and misuse. Minister Spies replied that she sees no need to change the rule, that municipalities report no problems, and that no data on usage or lost revenue is available.
These figures are not known to me.
Deze cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het doorgeven van van Europese data aan de Verenigde Staten

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked about the Netherlands joining a US-G5 government-to-government approach to FATCA, its data-protection implications for EU data sent to US authorities, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the joint statement is a non-binding intention, that the Commission is studying the data-protection issues, that no Dutch cases of forced US data disclosure are known, and that the matter is for the Commission and member states to resolve.
The Netherlands has declared its willingness to join the statement of intent for this government-to-government approach.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard om aan te sluiten bij de intentieverklaring voor deze »government to government approach».
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over het opslaan van adresbestanden door Twitter

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether Twitter's storage of users' full address books breaches privacy and the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the assessment and any enforcement belong to the independent CBP and OPTA, which do not comment on ongoing investigations, and the government itself takes no action.
The judgement on whether there is a breach of the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens in this case, and any enforcement measures, is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Het oordeel of er in casu sprake is van een schending van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, en het eventueel inzetten van handhavende maatregelen, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland de Roma niet goed behandelt

MP Schouw asked the minister about a Council of Europe commissioner's report saying no government, including the Dutch, safeguards Roma rights, and about the Dutch input to the EU Roma integration framework. The minister rejected the claim that Roma rights are not guaranteed in the Netherlands, pointed to anti-discrimination and naturalisation rules, defended generic rather than group-specific policy, and said the government stays in contact with local authorities and Roma on these issues.
The cabinet does not share the human rights commissioner's conclusion that the human rights of Roma are also not guaranteed in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet deelt niet de conclusie van de mensenrechtencommissaris dat ook in Nederland de mensenrechten van Roma niet worden gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over de geschiktheid van Nederlandse wetgeving voor het gebruik van spyware

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the KLPD's use of spyware, the Big Brother Award it received, and whether Dutch law, including article 126l of the Code of Criminal Procedure, is adequate for such tools. The minister acknowledged the award and the KLPD's use of spyware, and referred back to an earlier answer rather than stating a new position on whether specific legislation is needed.
I refer to my answer to question 2 from Member Recourt of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Schouw over het bericht dat gruwelijke wraakacties worden uitgevoerd op Irakese homoseksuelen

Deputy Schouw (D66) asked the ministers of Immigration and Foreign Affairs about reports of violent reprisals against Iraqi homosexuals, whether this contradicts the 'social taboo' characterisation in the country report, and whether a moratorium or upgraded protection for Iraqi LGBT asylum seekers would follow. Minister Leers answered that the attacks also target 'Emo' youth, that the policy for Iraqi homosexuals has been changed to treat them as a vulnerable group, that a new country report is due around August 2012, and that he sees no need for a separate report or moratorium.
I have asked my colleague at Foreign Affairs to keep me informed if significant developments occur in the meantime.
Ik heb mijn ambtgenoot van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd mij op de hoogte te houden als zich in de tussentijd belangwekkende ontwikkelingen voordoen.
Antwoord vragen Hachi en Schouw over de risico’s van software voor het op afstand besturen van industriële processen

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about security risks of SCADA systems controlling industrial processes, including whether attacks require exceptionally advanced software, what security requirements and oversight apply, the risks of USB sticks and internet connections, and European activity. The minister answered that operators are themselves responsible, sectoral supervisors oversee SCADA safety, the NCSC advises, and that European initiatives exist.
Organisations within government and the commercial sector are themselves responsible for their SCADA systems.
Organisaties binnen de overheid en de commerciële sector zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun SCADA-systemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Samsom, Dibi en Voordewind over de uitzetting van een Georgisch gezin



G.B.M. Leers

Five MPs asked the minister about the planned deportation of a 17-year-old Georgian girl after ten years in the Netherlands, including her mother's disability, the duration of asylum procedures, the father's alleged risks in Georgia, and whether she should be spared removal pending answers. The minister's reply was sent only for confidential inspection, citing privacy sensitivity, so the substantive answers are not public.

Given the privacy-sensitive aspects, I request that the answers be made available solely for confidential inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives of the States General.
Gelet op de privacygevoelige aspecten verzoek ik u de antwoorden enkel ter vertrouwelijke inzage bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Schouw over gebruik van andermans naam op sociale media

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of other people's names on social media, such as Twitter, and whether current law is adequate, including whether criminal prosecution should be possible and when it amounts to identity fraud. The minister confirmed awareness of the incidents and referred the MPs to earlier answers given to other MPs on the same subject.
I refer to my answer to the questions from member Kooiman of your House
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kooiman van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over soevereiniteitsoverdracht

An MP asked whether the Fiscal Compact transfers no sovereignty and how that fits earlier government statements and parliamentary motions, asking eight questions in total. The Secretary of State answered that the treaty mainly strengthens enforcement of existing SGP rules, adds only organisational eurozone governance, and that the government therefore sees no transfer of national competences, while stating that the earlier 'Europact' statements referred to a different political agreement.
In view of the above, the cabinet is of the opinion that this treaty transfers no national competences to the EU, because the EU is already competent in the areas concerned.
Gezien het bovenstaande is het kabinet van mening dat er met dit Verdrag geen nationale bevoegdheden worden overgedragen aan de EU, omdat de EU reeds bevoegd is op de genoemde terreinen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over het behoud van het dubbele paspoort

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Interior Minister about retaining dual nationality in light of international trends and press articles on the issue. Minister Spies replied that each state sets its own rules, that the bill will remove exceptions so that acquiring another nationality ends Dutch nationality, that no one is forced to renounce it, and that the bill is expected in March.
The fact that there are countries that expand the possibilities for multiple nationality does not lead this cabinet to a different assessment.
Het feit dat er landen zijn die de mogelijkheden voor meervoudige nationaliteit vergroten, leidt niet tot een andere afweging van dit kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over veel te dure verblijfsvergunningen

MP Schouw (D66) asked whether the Advocate-General's view that Dutch residence permit fees are too high, and the risk that fees deter poorer applicants, were accepted, and when the cost breakdown promised by earlier motions would be sent. Minister Leers rejected the Advocate-General's view, said fees are meant to cover about 65% of costs and are not deterrent given income requirements and exemptions, and pointed to a letter already sent on 31 January 2012.
I am awaiting the ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Union.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie af.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over de gang van zaken tussen het ministerie en het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers

An MP asks the minister to explain his statements on COA director Albayrak's pay, the discrepancies with the court ruling, his contacts on her salary, and why he suspended rather than dismissed her. The minister answers only that the questions concern matters under the ongoing COA investigation and proposes to revisit them after that report.
The uninterrupted progress of the work of the COA Investigation Committee takes priority.
De ongestoorde voortgang van de werkzaamheden van de Commissie van onderzoek COA staat voorop.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het toezicht van persoonsgegevens in het Visa Waiver Programma (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Netherlands meets the Visa Waiver Programme requirements, how data exchange with the US under the PCSC and related agreements works, whether US authorities have direct access, whether transfers are judicially reviewed and who supervises them. The Minister answers that automated queries are limited to serious crime and non-personal reference data, that personal data transfers remain subject to Dutch law and supervision by the College bescherming persoonsgegevens, and that judicial review of each transfer is not provided for outside extradition procedures.
Insofar as personal data is exchanged, Dutch national law remains applicable, and therefore also the national system of supervision and legal protection.
Voor zover er sprake is van uitwisseling van persoonsgerelateerde gegevens, blijft het nationale recht van toepassing, bijgevolg ook het nationale stelsel van toezicht en rechtsbescherming.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat alle provincies hun rekeningen te laat betalen (ingezonden 7 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a report showing that provinces pay their invoices late, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged the lateness, said the associations had been urged to shorten payment terms to 30 days, and pointed to forthcoming legislation imposing a 30-day payment obligation and interest on all public bodies.
I expect to see improvement in the payment behaviour of decentralised governments if there is an obligation to pay invoices within 30 days.
Ik verwacht verbetering in het betalingsgedrag van decentrale overheden te zien als er de verplichting is om facturen binnen 30 dagen te voldoen.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de grote bijdrage van Poolse arbeidsmigranten aan de Nederlandse economie (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs minister whether Polish labour migrants' economic contribution fits government policy of faster returns and reduced social security access, and whether Bulgarian and Romanian workers should be expected to contribute similarly. The minister acknowledged migrant contributions but stressed problems with labour migration and said the government keeps administrative barriers for Bulgarians and Romanians and will send the Commission a notification on grounds of labour market disturbance without first submitting it to parliament.
For that reason I did not find it necessary to first submit the notification letter to the House.
Om die reden heb ik het niet nodig gevonden om de notificatiebrief eerst aan de Kamer voor te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de staat van het vennootschapsrecht (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the state of Dutch company law, including the withdrawal of two bills on partnerships and the modernisation of the legal framework for personal partnerships. The minister confirmed the withdrawal for lack of support and said he would first identify practical problems and begin work on modernising NV law in 2012.
I have concluded that the primary objective of the legislation – facilitating entrepreneurs – is insufficiently realised in both bills.
Ik ben tot de conclusie gekomen dat de primaire doelstelling van de wetgeving – het faciliteren van ondernemers – in beide wetsvoorstellen onvoldoende tot zijn recht komt.
Vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van spysoftware (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

MPs Schouw and Berndsen asked the Justice Minister whether the Dutch government holds covert computer-spying software, who developed or bought it, whether source code is available, whether it has been used under judicial authorisation, and what safeguards exist. The minister confirmed the KLPD's Unit Landelijke Interceptie holds such software, limited by law to recording confidential communications under art. 126l Sv with authorisation, refused to disclose product or supplier details for operational reasons, and said it has been used in very few cases within legal limits.
Providing information on which specific software investigative services possess poses an unacceptable risk to the usability of those means.
Het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software opsporingsdiensten beschikken vormt een onaanvaardbaar risico voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rechtsgrondslag van het gebruik PNR gegevens in Nederland (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the legal basis for Dutch customs' use of airline passenger name record (PNR) data, the scope of data access, the selection of risk flights, and passenger notification. The minister replies that customs relies on articles 13, 14 and 58 of the Community Customs Code and the General Customs Act, accesses PNR data only for preselected risk flights, retains it briefly, and that passengers are informed via airline terms, while noting the increase in prosecution requests reflects more investigations rather than a sharp rise per case.
Customs' power to consult PNR data is based on the Community Customs Code (Regulation 2913/92), in particular articles 13, 14 and 58.
De bevoegdheid van de Douane tot het raadplegen van PNR-gegevens is gebaseerd op het Communautair douanewetboek (CDW), Verordening 2913/92, in het bijzonder de artikelen 13 en 14 en 58.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over expat-Nederlanders (ingezonden 10 november 2011).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about Dutch expats holding two passports, including how many have dual nationality, their motives, and the effects of the Nationality Act's loss rule. The minister answered that dual nationality is not registered, cited general research on motives, described the current loss provision and comparative rules, and said the amendment bill would be sent before the Christmas recess.
I expect to send your House the proposal to amend the Netherlands Nationality Act before the Christmas recess.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor het kerstreces het voorstel tot Wijziging van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap toe te sturen.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wijze waarop Nederland invulling geeft aan de levenslange gevangenisstraf (ingezond

An MP (D66) asked the Justice ministers about the life sentence in the Netherlands, including the Forum Levenslang proposal for conditional release after twenty years with judicial review. The state secretary replied that the 32 life-sentenced prisoners remain eligible for pardon, that the Forum proposal does not change policy, and that a periodic risk-assessment procedure is considered unnecessary.
I share the Forum's view that life-sentenced prisoners should not be denied every prospect of release.
Ik deel de mening van het Forum dat levenslanggestraften niet ieder perspectief op vrijlating mag worden ontnomen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden

Vragen van de leden Heijnen (PvdA), Koopmans (CDA), Van Raak (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bemoeienis van het college van B e

MPs asked whether the Roermond municipal executive improperly interfered in the sale of a former prison and court complex, and whether the state lost money when a developer with a lower bid obtained it. The state secretary replied that the highest bidder won after a second round, the state suffered no financial loss, the municipality cancelled the planned meeting with bidders after objections, and the evaluation report by the RijksAuditdienst was attached.

Although I distance myself from the wording he chose in the article, a meeting at the time could have led to unclarity about the State's position as seller of the complex and the transparency of the sales process.

Hoewel ik afstand neem van diens gekozen bewoording in het artikel, had destijds een gesprek kunnen leiden tot onduidelijkheid over de positie van de Staat als verkoper van het complex en de transparantie van het verkoopproces.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het onderzoek op basis waarvan een project voor ex-ama’s is

Five MPs asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government's claim that the project for former unaccompanied minor asylum seekers performed worse than the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek was a misreading of the CVO research, and whether a scientifically sound comparison would be made. The minister answered that a sound comparison was not feasible for research reasons, that the CVO findings were correctly interpreted, and that the conclusion that the project was not performing stands.
No, there is no question of an incorrect interpretation of the CVO research.
Nee, van een onjuiste interpretatie van het onderzoek van CVO is geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «PVV verzamelt privégegevens journalisten» (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asked whether the PVV collected citizens' BSN numbers at the request of the Dutch royal protection service before admitting visitors to party events and press conferences, and whether this breached the data protection law. The state secretary confirmed the screening for Wilders' security, argued the Wbp does not apply to police duties, and said BSN collection via the PVV will stop, with a more transparent procedure to follow.
I have now decided that Burgerservicenummers will no longer be requested via the PVV, and I will work with the DKDB to set up a more transparent procedure.
Inmiddels heb ik er voor gekozen dat er voortaan geen Burgerservicenummers meer via de PVV worden opgevraagd, maar zal ik samen met de DKDB een meer transparante werkwijze opstellen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het toekennen van de eretitel Minister van Staat (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011)

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Minister of the Interior whether the honorary title of Minister van Staat has criteria and how arbitrariness is prevented, after reports that Van Agt wanted the title. Prime Minister Rutte answered that there are no formal criteria beyond exceptional merits comparable to earlier recipients, and declined to disclose the Queen's role in the nomination.
There are no criteria other than exceptional merits comparable to the exceptional merits of those to whom this title was previously granted.
Er zijn geen criteria anders dan bijzondere verdiensten die vergelijkbaar zijn met de bijzondere verdiensten van degenen aan wie deze titel eerder is verleend.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie op straat vingerafdrukken afneemt en controleert (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

An MP asked the government whether police may take fingerprints on the street and check them online, under what conditions, on what legal basis, and how this fits with the Interior Minister's statement on fingerprint storage. The ministers answered that pilot projects ('leertuinen') for on-street identity checks are being prepared, cite Vreemdelingenwet and Eurodac/VIS rules for aliens, and maintain that the storage decision concerns Dutch travel documents and is separate from the pilots.

No. The Minister for Immigration and Asylum and the Minister of Security and Justice have approved several pilot projects to enable officers to carry out their work more efficiently and quickly within the limits of the law.
Nee. De minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie hebben goedkeuring gegeven aan enkele proefprojecten
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over bedrijven die de privacy schenden (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the state secretary about reports that companies ignore data access (inzage) requests under privacy law, and what the government and the CBP will do about it, including fines and mediation powers. The state secretary said he could not confirm widespread non-compliance, that the CBP chooses its enforcement priorities independently, and that the cabinet intends to give the CBP administrative fining powers.

Vragen het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Nederlandse veto tegen de toetreding van Roemenië en Bulgarije tot Schengen (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

An MP asks the ministers why the Netherlands opposes Romania and Bulgaria joining Schengen, whether the position is final, and what the economic and diplomatic consequences would be. The government answers that rule-of-law and anti-corruption reforms are insufficient so far, that partial accession is not an option now, and that trade relations are expected to remain unaffected.

The Netherlands wants both countries to carry out the necessary reforms in the field of an effective and efficiently functioning judicial system and the fight against corruption and organised crime, and to implement these reforms.

Nederland wil dat beide landen de noodzakelijke hervormingen doorvoeren op het terrein van een effectief en efficiënt functionerend justitieel stelsel en de bestrijding van corruptie en georganiseerde criminaliteit en dat ze deze hervormingen ook implementeren.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Spekman (PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het lid Wilders (PVV) dat een immigratiedaling van 50 procent

Four MPs asked the immigration minister whether he was aware of PVV leader Wilders' claim that immigration of non-Western migrants would fall by 50 percent, and how the government would prevent such statements from damaging the Netherlands' image. The minister replied that the government's package of measures is expected to cut inflows substantially over the longer term, that there are no target percentages, that the PVV is responsible for its own statements, and that 2010 and early 2011 figures do not yet show a decline.
As the cabinet has stated several times, there are no target percentages.
Zoals het kabinet verschillende keren heeft aangegeven 2 is er geen sprake van streefpercentages.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Schouw en Verhoeven (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over barrières bij het inhuren van kennismigranten (ingezonden 1 september

Three D66 MPs asked why employer groups complain that importing skilled workers is too hard, and about the market-rate salary test for the highly skilled migrant scheme introduced in June 2011, its basis, past abuse, refusals, and the income thresholds. The minister defended the test as a safety valve used only on suspicion of misuse, said no refusals had yet occurred, explained the income criteria, and agreed to talk with the employer organisations.
This measure was partly introduced because your House, including through a motion by MP Ulenbelt et al., expressed concern about possible misuse of the highly skilled migrant scheme.
Deze maatregel is onder meer tot stand gekomen omdat uw Kamer, onder andere bij motie van het lid Ulenbelt c.s. zijn zorgen heeft geuit over mogelijk misbruik van de kennismigrantenregeling
Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de strafbaarstelling van illegaliteit (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Dibi and Schouw asked the immigration minister whether the EU Return Directive, as interpreted in the El-Dridi ruling, precludes criminalising illegal stay, what would happen if a fine imposed on an illegal migrant is not paid, and why the Directive is still not fully implemented. The minister referred to a letter sent the same day for the first set of questions and explained the legislative history of the implementing bill, which is still awaiting plenary debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter of today to your House.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik hier naar mijn brief van heden aan uw Kamer.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een transparante benoeming van de vice-president van de Raad van State (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior how the vacancy for vice-president of the Raad van State would be advertised and selected, including who runs the selection and whether the Crown is involved. The minister replied that the vacancy would be published within weeks in the Staatscourant only, that no candidates had yet been approached, that candidate names would not be disclosed, and that the procedure follows the Wet op de Raad van State with the Raad heard and the Crown signing the appointment.
Will it be made public who applies for the post of vice-president? No.
Vraag 4 Wordt openbaar gemaakt wie zich kandidaat stellen voor de functie van vice-president?
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat in Rotterdam een gezichtsscanner is geïnstalleerd bij een juwelier (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about a facial scanner installed at a Rotterdam jeweller, including who can access the data, privacy safeguards, and evidentiary use. The minister supports the pilot, says its effectiveness, feasibility and privacy aspects are being studied until early 2012, and will await the results before judging.
Although I have high hopes for the instrument, I would prefer to await the outcomes of the pilot before passing judgment on it.
Hoewel ik hoopvolle verwachtingen heb van het instrument, wacht ik graag de uitkomsten van de pilot af alvorens hierover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Vraag van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht «Onrust bij organisatie asielopvang» (ingezonden 19 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum to inform parliament within a week about internal problems at the COA asylum reception agency after media reports. The minister replied that the supervisory board had commissioned an independent investigation into a possible culture of fear and that parliament would be informed of the outcome.
I will inform your house further about the outcomes of the investigation.
Ik zal uw kamer nader informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van de rechter dat het mobiel grenstoezicht in strijd is met de Schengengrenscode (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how he would respond to rulings that mobile border checks by the Royal Marechaussee amount to border controls contrary to the Schengen Borders Code, how many irregular migrants were apprehended and their composition, and how much the checks contribute to combating drugs and terrorism. The minister disagreed with the rulings, said the amended rules meet earlier Council of State guidance and that he has appealed, gave the number of 224 apprehensions without a breakdown by nationality (not centrally registered), and explained the checks' aims as combating illegal residence, cross-border crime and document fraud.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebrekkige openbare register voor nevenfuncties van rechters (ingezonden 12 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about judges failing to report side positions in the public register, after newspaper investigations and pressure from the judges' association. The minister acknowledged the importance of an accurate register, pointed to the duty under the Judicial Officers Act and a pending bill allowing dismissal for repeat violations, and said the Council for the Judiciary has asked court presidents to ensure registrations are complete and current.
To strengthen the openness of judges' side positions and thereby increase trust in the impartiality and integrity of the judiciary, a bill amending the Judicial Officers Act has been submitted.

Om de openbaarheid van nevenbetrekkingen van rechters te versterken en daarmee het vertrouwen in de onpartijdigheid en integriteit van de rechterlijke macht te vergroten, is een wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wet rechtspositie rechterlijke ambtenaren ingediend
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Eindrapportage Spelregels Interbestuurlijke Informatie (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Interior Affairs for an exhaustive list of the controls that the Interbestuurlijke Informatie guidelines would reduce or make less frequent. The minister answered that the guidelines are too recent to measure their effect, but expects reduced burden and better information for ministerial accountability, based on a pre-implementation test and examples such as ICT streamlining and accrual accounting for specific grants.
This recent introduction currently makes it impossible to measure the precise effect of the guidelines.
Deze recente invoering maakt het op dit moment niet mogelijk het precieze effect van de spelregels te meten.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht inzake de negatieve gevolgen van het verhogen van de m

MPs Schouw and Van der Ham (D66) asked why residence fees for non-EU students rose on 1 July 2011, whether this harms access and was properly communicated, and whether the effects will be reported. The minister confirmed the increase (e.g. EUR 433 to 600 for an MVV application), said it is meant to raise cost recovery and will not deter students, offered coulance for applications already paid, and agreed to report instroomcijfers alongside fee levels, while noting a causal link is hard to establish.
Of course I am willing to inform the House.
Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid om de Kamer te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het voorstel van de Europese Commissie inzake EU PNR (ingezonden 1 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the European Commission's EU PNR proposal, including how Dutch authorities collect and use passenger data, whether a DPA review occurred, whether the government is anticipating EU rules, and whether API data transfers are mandatory. The minister answers in detail, describing limited current use by the Marechaussee, Customs and AIVD, the legal bases, retention periods, and that the data flows are case-by-case rather than systematic.
At present, the Netherlands makes (limited) use of PNR data through the Royal Marechaussee, Customs and the AIVD.
Op dit moment wordt in Nederland (beperkt) gebruik gemaakt van PNR-gegevens door de Koninklijke Marechaussee, de Douane en de AIVD.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Amerika graait in Europese clouddata» (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether US authorities use the Patriot Act to access personal data stored in the EU by US-headquartered companies, and whether this bypasses EU data protection law. The minister acknowledges US law may compel such disclosure regardless of data location, says no such cases are known to the ministry, notes the CBP sets its own research agenda, and says the matter is a conflict of laws for the European Commission to resolve.
However, it goes too far to claim that the entire European system for the protection of personal data is thereby switched off.
Het gaat echter te ver om te stellen dat het hele Europese stelsel voor de bescherming van persoonsgegevens hierdoor wordt uitgeschakeld.
Vragen van de leden Berndsen en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de termijn voor een beslissing van het Openbaar Ministerie (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

MPs Berndsen and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the nine-month time the Public Prosecution Service took to decide on prosecuting officers involved in a 2010 Hellevoetsluis death was acceptable, and what measures would speed up such decisions. The minister acknowledged the delay was caused by a miscommunication in sending forensic orders, regretted it, and said the prosecution office had been reminded to supervise such transmissions more closely, with no further measures deemed necessary.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it is aware that it was important for both the officers involved and the next of kin to obtain clarity about the case as quickly as possible, and that it regrets the delay that arose.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat het zich ervan bewust is dat het zowel voor de betrokken agenten als de nabestaanden van belang was om zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te krijgen over de zaak en dat het de ontstane vertraging betreurt.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Spekman (PvdA), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de berichten dat er geen sprake zou zijn geweest van gedwong

MPs from five parties asked the immigration minister whether an Iranian asylum seeker who took his own life was told that forced removal was not possible, whether detention without realistic prospects of removal is acceptable, and whether courts are misled by claims of 'prospect of removal'. The minister confirmed the matter was discussed in a 2009 departure interview, stated that forced return to Iran is not impossible in all cases if the person cooperates, and denied that courts are misled.
The conversation report can be found in the annex for confidential inspection.
Het gespreksverslag vindt u in de bijlage ter vertrouwelijke inzage.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat een Brits advertentiebedrijf een da

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven (D66) asked about reports that a British advertising firm holds profiles of nearly all Dutch internet users, including risks of concentrating such data, compliance with Dutch data protection law, retention periods, and the effect of the cookie law. The minister replied that supervision of these companies lies with competent supervisory authorities abroad or in the Netherlands, that no statutory retention limits exist, and that the cookie provision will require consent for storing or reading data on users' devices.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat ouders hun kinderen bespioneren (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that parents can spy on their children via phones and computers, and whether the state will act against unwanted privacy intrusions by parents. The minister answered that parents have a duty to protect children, that the state should balance privacy and safety and only intervene when parents fail, and that children can resolve disputes within the family or via a special guardian appointed by the court rather than the Children's Ombudsman.
The government is only legitimised to intervene in a concrete situation when parents do not (or no longer) properly fulfil their responsibility.
De overheid is slechts gelegitimeerd om in te grijpen in een concrete situatie wanneer ouders hun verantwoordelijkheid niet (meer) naar behoren vervullen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van de opslag van vingerafdrukken (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister why fingerprint storage in decentralised passport databases had not yet been stopped despite the government's own statements that it should be, and about the timetable and possible exemptions for conscientious objectors. The minister replied that shortened retention rules and updated software took effect on 23-24 June 2011, that rollout to all issuing bodies was planned by end July, that full removal of stored traces would be clarified by September, and that the EU rules leave no exemption for conscientious objectors.
I will then inform the House about the planning.
Ik zal dan de Kamer over de planning informeren.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat provincies d

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Interior and of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how they respond to a report finding provinces involve citizens in landscape policy only at informing, consulting and advising levels, and what they will do to broaden participation as landscape tasks are decentralised. The government disputes the reading, says provinces use many participation instruments, says involving active citizens is difficult, and points to existing programmes and a forthcoming agenda on civic participation, while leaving the choice of participation methods to provinces and municipalities.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over homoseksuele asielzoekers uit Oeganda (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the minister for Immigration and Asylum whether a possible anti-homosexuality law in Uganda would affect asylum claims by gay asylum seekers, whether a country report would be commissioned, and whether deportations of rejected gay Ugandan asylum seekers would be suspended. The minister answered that no Uganda-specific country report is planned, that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that the number of rejected gay Ugandan asylum seekers is not recorded, and that deportations will not be suspended for now.
There is currently no reason for me to suspend any deportations, because each asylum application is individually assessed to determine whether protection should be granted.
Er is thans voor mij geen aanleiding om eventuele uitzettingen op te schorten, omdat bij elk asielverzoek individueel getoetst wordt of er aanleiding is om bescherming te bieden of niet.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht van dat stateloze Roma met kinderen naar Ter Apel worden gestuurd zonder dat zij

An MP asked the ministers whether stateless Roma children are being moved to the Ter Apel facility without being removable, and about nationality acquisition, EU citizenship and the 12-week detention period. The government defended nationality rules and the use of the restricted-freedom location as a means to keep migrants in reach for return, and refused to exempt children from transfer.
Are you prepared, in situations where the expected preparation time for departure exceeds the usual twelve weeks, to refrain from moving children to Ter Apel? No.
Vraag 6 Bent u bereid in situaties waarin de voorziene voorbereidingstijd voor vertrek de gebruikelijke twaalf weken overschrijdt, af te zien van het verplaatsen van kinderen naar Ter Apel?

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya, Van der Ham en Schouw (allen D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de belemmeringen voor het lop

MPs from D66 asked why youths awaiting a residence permit cannot do internships during regular education, and whether the government will drop the work permit requirement and suspend fines for employers. The government answered that such internships count as work under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen, that it will not change the law or suspend fines, and only urges schools to issue school statements.
The cabinet will therefore not change the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen on this point.
Dit kabinet zal de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen op dit punt dan ook niet wijzigen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie waarin in een

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum how the government will respond to a CJEU ruling that imprisoning an irregular migrant for illegal stay conflicts with the Return Directive, and whether the planned criminalisation of illegal stay and breach of entry bans is therefore incompatible with EU law. The Minister declined to pre-judge the pending bill and the Raad van State advice, said the ruling concerned Italian law, and stated the government will respect EU law while seeking to change EU rules.
It does not seem appropriate to anticipate the handling of this bill now.
Het lijkt mij niet opportuun nu reeds op de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vooruit te lopen.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Economische Zaken Landbouw en Innovatie over de verkoop van persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Economic Affairs about police use of speed profiles derived from TomTom location data, including payment, privacy, consumer disclosure and whether similar data sales occur. The State Secretary answered that the data is anonymised, that the Cbp is the competent body to judge re-identification, that consumer information duties lie with producers under existing law, and that police navigation systems are not synchronised so no location data is shared.
The Cbp is independent and itself determines in which cases it conducts an investigation.
Het Cbp is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf in welke gevallen het een onderzoek instelt.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over lastenverzwaring via sluiproute (ingezonden 28 ap

D66 MPs asked whether shifting dike and dune investment costs to water boards (reaching EUR 200 million by 2015) would raise local water-board taxes, and whether such cost increases are acceptable. The state secretary answered that the costs will be funded partly through water-board levies, that efficiency savings are intended to keep increases moderate, and that the costs will be monitored and reported under the Bestuursakkoord Water.
The Bestuursakkoord Water further agrees to closely monitor and report on local charges and the savings achieved.
In het Bestuursakkoord Water is verder afgesproken om de lokale lasten en de behaalde besparingen nauwgezet te monitoren en te rapporteren.

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66), Heijnen (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP), Dibi (GroenLinks) Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een grote hoeveelheid gegevens ov

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how telecom companies store and link citizens' mobile phone data, who may access it, how long it is kept, and how citizens can object or inspect it, after a German press report on location tracking. The state secretary answered that location and traffic data are necessary for network operation, that Dutch rules are comparable to German ones, that the retention obligation requires one year of storage for criminal investigation, and that the Agentschap Telecom and the College bescherming persoonsgegevens supervise these data.
Telecom companies are obliged to make their customers' data available to the government when requested in the context of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences.
Telecombedrijven zijn verplicht om gegevens van hun klanten beschikbaar te stellen aan de overheid bij bevragingen in het kader van de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitzetting van acht Iraakse gezinnen naar Irak (ingezond

MPs from several parties asked the minister about the forced deportation of eight Iraqi families, including thirteen minors, their detention in Rotterdam, and alleged rough treatment by police. The minister confirmed six families were deported, said families were informed of legal remedies, defended detention periods as within policy, denied reported mistreatment, and described the escort arrangements.
