All aliens were explicitly informed, through information leaflets and my letter to the House of 30 November 2010 and the answers to earlier parliamentary questions, of the possibility to pursue legal remedies against the planned deportation and to contact their lawyer.

Alle vreemdelingen zijn door middel van informatiebladen en mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 30 november 2010 over de uitvoering van de motie Voordewind en door uitreiking van de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) van 25 november 2010 expliciet gewezen op de mogelijkheid rechtsmiddelen aan te wenden tegen de voorgenomen uitzetting en op de mogelijkheid om contact op te nemen met hun advocaat.
Vragen van Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over geld bieden aan illegalen om Nederland te verlaten (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

Schouw (D66) asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek (DT&V) offers money to illegal migrants to leave the Netherlands, asking about numbers, amounts, budget, oversight, effectiveness and the link to the planned criminalisation of illegal stay. Minister Leers confirms that in a limited number of individual cases a financial contribution is given (about 140 people in 2010, average about 840 euro), states that no specific working guidelines or oversight rules exist beyond the DT&V's case-by-case assessment, and says the illegal-stay approach will be presented to parliament later.
No. Under article 6.1 of the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, the minister is authorised to take all necessary measures when exercising his power of expulsion under article 63(2) of the Aliens Act.

Nee. Op grond van artikel 6.1 Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000 (Vb2000) is de minister bevoegd om, bij uitoefening van zijn bevoegdheid tot uitzetting als bedoeld in artikel 63, tweede lid, Vreemdelingenwet, alle daartoe benodigde handelingen te verrichten.

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

MPs Schouw, Janssen, Voordewind and Spekman asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether criminalising illegal residence, as foreseen in a second amendment to the Aliens Act implementing the Return Directive, is compatible with the Directive and with the European Commission's answers to Parliament's questions. The Minister answered that the bill sanctions only stay in breach of an entry ban, not illegal residence as such, that the Commission's position is noted and will be respected, and that no further Council of State advice is needed.
I want to emphasise that the bill as it lies before the House does not contain criminalisation of illegal residence.
Ik wil benadrukken dat het wetvoorstel zoals dat in uw Kamer voorligt, geen strafbaarstelling van illegaal verblijf inhoudt.
Vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe flitspaal (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the EU-funded ASSET 3D speed camera, its legal basis, privacy implications and relation to ANPR. The minister answered that the project is research-stage, that any Dutch deployment would be notified to parliament, and that privacy would be safeguarded under data protection law, though many details were left open.
Should there in future be cause to deploy this or similar techniques on Dutch roads, it goes without saying that the House will be informed of this.
Mocht er in de toekomst aanleiding zijn om deze of soortgelijke technieken in te zetten op Nederlandse wegen, dan spreekt het voor zich dat de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd wordt.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de onduidelijkheid rondom de inning van provinciale opcenten (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked whether citizens can clearly tell which government layer receives motor vehicle tax and provincial opcenten, and how to make this more transparent. Minister Donner answered that the tax is sufficiently transparent because the assessment notice states that opcenten are levied for the province, and no changes are planned.
On the motor vehicle tax assessment it is clearly stated that besides motor vehicle tax, opcenten are also levied for the province where one lives.
Op de aanslag motorrijtuigenbelasting is duidelijk aangegeven dat er naast motorrijtuigenbelasting ook opcenten worden geheven ten behoeve van de provincie waar men woonachtig is

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het aantal lang verblijvende, verwesterde Afghaanse meisjes

Opposition MPs asked the immigration minister how many long-resident Afghan girls resembling Sahar Hbrahimgel face removal, and whether her case and her family's circumstances should weigh in residence decisions. The minister answered that the family will receive a residence permit, that a few dozen to about a hundred girls may qualify under new policy, and that he cannot say how many of the 110 pending cases involve fathers subject to Article 1F, citing limits of the IND information system.
It is not possible to provide figures, because asylum seekers and their family members do not always arrive at the same time.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers te geven, omdat asielzoekers en hun gezinsleden niet altijd gelijktijdig inreizen
Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een ongelijk speelveld op de incassomarkt (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Schouw and Van der Steur ask whether the bailiff monopoly and the Verordening Onafhankelijkheid give bailiffs an unfair advantage in the debt-collection market, as the NMa suggests, and whether the government will curb bailiffs' commercial collection work. The minister denies an uneven playing field, defends the approval of the regulation as necessary for bailiffs' independence, and rules out banning bailiffs from non-official collection work.
I am not considering any measures to prohibit bailiffs from performing, alongside their official duties, non-official work such as debt collection.
Ik overweeg geen maatregelen om gerechtsdeurwaarders te verbieden naast de aan hen toebedeelde ambtelijke werkzaamheden ook niet-ambtelijke werkzaamheden, zoals incasso, te verrichten.

Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Schouw (D66), Dibi (GroenLinks), Voordewind (CU) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over uitspraken van de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel in

Six MPs asked the immigration minister whether his media remarks linking the Hbrahimgel family's repeated asylum procedures to delay were accurate, and whether the family's prolonged stay and their children's interests were fairly weighed. The minister said the remarks were about future procedural policy, that the case was reassessed under new policy on westernised girls to Afghanistan, and that because a residence permit will be granted, his appeal will be withdrawn.
Since the Hbrahimgel family will be granted a residence permit, the appeal will be withdrawn.
Aangezien aan het gezin Hbrahimgel een vergunning zal worden verleend, wordt het hoger beroep ingetrokken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Schouw (D66), Dibi (Groenlinks), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Somal

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about the planned deportation of a Somali former Muslim convert to Christianity to Somaliland, citing Somaliland's constitution and sharia, and whether the IND's position on Christians being able to practise faith quietly holds. The minister answered that the courts found no risk of persecution or Article 3 ECHR violation, that such cases are assessed individually, and saw no reason to change deportation policy or the decision.
In view of the above, I do not share your view that the person concerned fears for his life upon return to Somaliland.
Gezien het bovenstaande deel ik uw mening dat betrokkene te vrezen heeft voor zijn leven bij terugkeer naar Somaliland niet.

Vragen van de leden Koolmees en Schouw (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de doorgifte van financiële data van Europese burgers aan de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 22 maart 201

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Justice whether bilateral transfer of financial data to the United States is still possible under the EU-US TFTP Agreement, and whether any such transfer has occurred since the agreement took effect. The minister answered that bilateral SWIFT data transfer is not possible under the agreement and that no bilateral transfer has taken place between the Netherlands and the United States.
No bilateral transfer of SWIFT data has taken place between the Netherlands and the United States.
Er heeft geen bilaterale doorgifte van SWIFT-data plaatsgevonden tussen Nederland en de Verenigde Staten.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie inzake Zambrano (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP from D66 asks the immigration minister about the implications of the ECJ Zambrano ruling for parents of Dutch children and other third-country family members, and how it relates to the coalition plan to abolish the 'Europa route'. The minister refers to a separate letter on the ruling, says the affected situation is exceptional, and states the Europa route concerns a directive the Court found inapplicable in this case.
I refer you to my letter to the House today, in which I address the ruling, its consequences for Dutch immigration policy and the situation in other EU member states.
Graag verwijs ik naar mijn brief aan uw Kamer van heden waarin ik inga op het arrest, de gevolgen van het arrest voor het Nederlandse vreemdelingenbeleid en de stand van zaken in andere EU-lidstaten.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebrek aan informatie over de interpretatie en toepassing van het EU-US TFTP Agreement (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Joint Supervisory Body's report on Europol's compliance with the EU-US TFTP agreement, the classification of that report, and calls for full access to documents and an EU-based bank data filter system. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report but declined substantive comment since only the public version was available, pointed to a published six-month review, deferred declassification to Europol and the EU Parliament, and committed to supporting a Commission feasibility study on an EU TFTP.
Therefore I cannot respond to this on substance.
Daardoor kan ik hierop niet inhoudelijk reageren.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat het afschaffen van stadsdelen miljoenen gaat kosten (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Interior whether abolishing Amsterdam's and Rotterdam's city districts would cost at least 100 million euros per year as an advisory report claimed, and about related decentralisation risks. The minister rejected the cost estimate, citing structural savings on political office-holders' pay and support, and said the abolition is still planned without compensation.
Abolishing the political layer need not have consequences for the organisation of the civil service departments.
Het afschaffen van de politieke laag hoeft geen gevolgen te hebben voor de ophanging en organisatie van de ambtelijke diensten.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebrek aan informatie over de interpretatie en toepassing van het EU-US TFTP Agreement (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the lack of information on interpretation and application of the EU-US TFTP (SWIFT) agreement, including reported top-secret classification and who is competent to interpret it. The minister answered that the matter is an EU responsibility, supports maximum transparency and access for evaluators while accepting some operational and commercial confidentiality, and declined to press for a binding interpretation before an expert meeting on 14 March.
The government is not aware whether all documents and information related to the implementation of the TFTP agreement are indeed classified as 'top secret'.
Het is de regering niet bekend of daadwerkelijk alle aan de tenuitvoerlegging van de TFTP-overeenkomst gerelateerde documenten en informatie als «top secret» zijn geclassificeerd.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over onvoldoende capaciteit bij ambassades voor het afleggen van de toets inburgering buitenland (i

An MP from D66 asked the Interior and Foreign Affairs ministers about rising demand for the civic integration test abroad, whether embassies have enough capacity, and how candidates were informed of the stricter requirements from 1 April 2011. The minister answered that embassy capacity is adequate, that a short inventory found a few posts scheduling exams after 1 April and that these were instructed to fix this, and that candidates were informed through several channels.
The consular departments of the relevant diplomatic posts currently have sufficient capacity to process requests to take the test.
De consulaire afdelingen van betreffende diplomatieke posten hebben op dit moment voldoende capaciteit om verzoeken tot het afleggen van de toets af te handelen.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minster van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onafhankelijke benoeming van de voorzitter van de Onderzoeksraad (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the appointment of the Safety Board chair was politically influenced, including the profile, selection committee, and the claimed agreement that the Board would propose future appointments. The Minister answers that the procedure was careful and in line with the law, denies a binding new agreement on proposals, and rejects parliamentary appointment, while promising to review the procedure's possible shortcomings.
The Rijkswet guarantees the full independence of the Board.
De Rijkswet waarborgt volledige onafhankelijkheid van de Raad.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het kiesrecht voor de Eilandsraad van niet-Nederlanders (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the Minister of Interior about how the Caribbean islands were informed of the Santana court ruling extending active voting rights to non-Dutch residents for the Bonaire island council elections, how eligible voters are identified, the role of the IND, the short timeframe for candidacy, language of information, and differences in election organisation. The minister answered in detail, describing notifications, IND support, and that the Kieswet now applies integrally, with evaluation promised.
The Ministry of Interior, in light of the Court's ruling, arranged for three public bodies to receive an update to the PIVA elections module so they could correctly select eligible voters.

Het ministerie van BZK heeft, gelet op de uitspraak van het Hof, geregeld dat drie openbare lichamen de beschikking hebben gekregen over een update in de module verkiezingen van de PIVA om de juiste selectie van de kiesgerechtigden te kunnen maken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat de uitgangspunten voor het beleid om scholen geen geld te geven voor het wegwerken van

MPs Van der Ham and Schouw (D66) asked the education minister whether a study showing ethnic origin still matters for early school disadvantage undermines the policy of not using ethnicity in the school weighting scheme. The minister replied that the findings were not new, that ethnicity was deliberately not used in favour of parental education, income and benefit dependency via the impulse regime, and that no further research was needed.
At the time it was decided, with very broad support from the House, that apart from parental education level, ethnicity would not be used as a second criterion, but another criterion instead.
Destijds is besloten met zeer brede steun van de Kamer dat naast opleidingsniveau van de ouders niet de etniciteit als tweede criterium gebruikt zou worden, maar een ander criterium.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over opslag biometrische gegevens (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of reports on a possible EU inquiry into Dutch passport data storage, whether the Commission had approached the Netherlands, and whether they would drop a central biometric database if the Commission judged it contrary to EU data protection rules. The minister replied that he was aware of the reports, had not yet been approached by the Commission, and would await the outcome of any inquiry without prejudging it.
I am waiting to see what the Commission plans to investigate. I will not anticipate the outcome of that.
Ik wacht af wat de Commissie van plan is te onderzoeken. Op de uitkomsten hiervan loop ik niet vooruit.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de weigering inlichtingen te verschaffen over zakelijke belangen van bewindspersonen (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Schouw (D66) asks the Prime Minister whether ministers' financial and business interests, even when managed at a distance, must be open to parliamentary scrutiny, and why some ministers refused to disclose such information under article 68 of the Constitution, proposing criteria and a conflict-of-interest rule like the UK Ministerial Code. The answer by Minister Donner (on behalf of the Prime Minister) responds to these questions in writing, with the government's reply summarised in the document only in part.

Are you willing to promote that the ministers of your cabinet provide the information requested on 7 December 2010, which they initially refused to provide, in light of article 68 of the Constitution?

Vraag 4 Bent u bereid te bevorderen, dat de bewindslieden van uw kabinet de inlichtingen, gevraagd op 7 december 2010 2 , die zij in eerste instantie hebben geweigerd te verstrekken, alsnog verstrekken, gelet op artikel 68 van de Grondwet?

Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de registratie van een tweede nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke Basisadministratie (GBA) (in

MPs Schouw and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether Dutch treaty obligations require automatic GBA registration of a second nationality and how this compares with Belgium, France and Germany, and what the effects of non-registration would be for public tasks, citizens, denaturalisation and foreign authorities. The minister answered that no treaty obliges registration, that registration is declaratory, that the government sees no reason to change the current law, and that non-registration would hamper statutory tasks and burden citizens.
The purpose of the GBA is to provide unambiguous information that is necessary for applying the law.
Doel van de GBA is om eenduidige informatie te verstrekken welke nodig is met het oog op de toepassing van de wet.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Nederland onverminderd de mensenrechten van illegale vreemdelingen blijft sc

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum and the State Secretary for Security and Justice how they respond to reports (Amnesty International, NJCM, the ISt inspectorate, CPT) that immigration detention in the Netherlands violates human rights, including detention duration, medical care, handcuffing of a pregnant woman, complaints handling, detention of vulnerable people, and conditions akin to prison. The minister largely rejects the critiques, citing improvements, the ISt findings, the ultimum remedium principle, the EU Return Directive, and an upcoming policy letter on alternatives to detention.
However, I am of the opinion that in recent years both the policy on immigration detention and its implementation have changed and improved considerably.
Ik ben echter van mening dat de afgelopen jaren zowel op het terrein van het beleid inzake vreemdelingenbewaring als de tenuitvoerlegging daarvan, het nodige is veranderd en verbeterd.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de constatering dat asielzoekers slechter behandeld worden dan criminelen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An MP asks the minister for Immigration and Asylum how the government responds to an inspectorate report finding that asylum detainees are treated worse than criminals, that earlier promises to improve detention conditions were not kept, that detainees' rights are insufficiently guaranteed, and about thirteen specific concerns. The minister answers that the inspectorate did not conclude that national and international rules conflict, refers to a letter of 27 October 2010 for the remaining questions and to a 2010 letter on the reorientation of detention.
For the answer to this question I refer to my earlier letter to your House of 27 October 2010.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn eerdergenoemde brief aan uw Kamer van 27 oktober 2010

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Schouw (D66) en Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de bedreiging van ex-moslims in asielzoekerscentra (ingezonden 26 nove

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum about threats and violence against ex-Muslim and LGBT asylum seekers in reception centres, questioning the low number of registered incidents, whether a confidential reporting system and a trusted contact person should be created, and whether perpetrators should be moved to immigration detention. The minister said incidents are registered only when reported, that COA already has a low-threshold reporting system, that he sees no need for a trusted-person role, and that he will consult interest groups and inform the House, but did not answer all questions before the budget debate.
In my earlier answer to the questions I already indicated that I take the signals seriously and that COA has already put low-threshold facilities in place for reporting incidents.

In de eerdere beantwoording van de kamervragen 1 heb ik al aangegeven de signalen serieus te nemen en ook dat het COA reeds laagdrempelige voorzieningen om incidenten te kunnen melden heeft getroffen.
Vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen (beiden D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het ten onrechte opslaan van kentekengegevens van burgers (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

MPs Schouw and Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about storing citizens' licence plate data collected via ANPR, including accuracy, planned scope, data leak risks, the breach notification duty and the WODC study. Minister Opstelten answered that a bill will allow temporary retention of ANPR plate data for crime detection with safeguards, that error risk is minimal, that the bill will go to consultation in January 2011, and that a breach notification duty will be pursued.

A bill is currently being prepared that will make it possible to retain licence plate data obtained through Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) for a limited period for the purpose of detecting criminal offences.

Er wordt momenteel een wetsvoorstel voorbereid dat het mogelijk maakt om ten behoeve van de opsporing van strafbare feiten gedurende een beperkte periode kentekengegevens te bewaren die zijn verkregen door gebruik van Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR).
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de situatie van stateloze Roma in Nederland (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

MPs Schouw and Koşer Kaya asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU Regulation 883/2004 prevents cross-border workers who become fully unemployed from claiming unemployment benefit from their last employment state under the Miethe ruling, and whether the Commission's view that Miethe still applies is accepted. The minister answered that under Regulation 883/2004 only the state of residence pays benefits, that the Miethe ruling no longer applies (as Germany and Belgium also hold), and that no Dutch change is planned.
The Netherlands therefore no longer sees any need to also grant a Dutch unemployment benefit.

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister why the government plans a yearly conversation between adolescents and a doctor, questioning whether it is needed given most teens have no problems and whether parents, not doctors, should handle this. The minister defended the extra youth contact moment as part of a healthy-lifestyle investment under the 2013 budget agreement, answered most questions on substance, and refused to drop the plan.
I am not willing to stop this action plan.
Ik ben niet bereid om dit actieplan te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dille over het bericht ‘LSG-Rentray betaalt tonnen voor ontslagen’

An MP asks the health minister about reports that former LSG-Rentray board member Lodewijks received a severance payment of 157,013 euro and was then re-engaged as a freelancer, asking whether he should repay it. The minister replies that she does not oversee individual institutions' personnel policy, that accountability lies with the supervisory board and courts, and refers to the institution's own statement.
I do not oversee the personnel policy and personnel expenditure of individual care institutions, because the relevant Supervisory Board and Board of Directors are responsible for those.
Ik ga niet over het personeelsbeleid en de personeelsuitgaven van individuele zorginstellingen, want daar gaan de desbetreffende Raad van Toezicht en de Raad van Bestuur over.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dille over het bericht dat ADHD onterecht als neurobiologische hersenziekte wordt gekwalificeerd

An MP from the PVV asked whether ADHD is wrongly classified as a neurobiological brain disease, citing pharmaceutical industry financial interests, the risk of medicalisation, and the prescribing of ADHD medication to children. The minister acknowledged financial stakes in ADHD medication, stated that industry cooperation must serve public health, and said the government will discuss possible over-prescribing with the relevant professional groups and report back to parliament.
I will, together with the State Secretary (within the youth demedicalisation process), discuss the matter with the relevant professional groups.
Ik zal samen met de Staatssecretaris (in het kader van het traject demedicaliseren jeugd) in gesprek gaan met de betrokken beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord vragen Dille over het niet vergoeden van een hernia-operatie

Dille (PVV) asked the health minister about the non-reimbursement of a PTED hernia operation, citing a Radar broadcast and a claim that the technique allows faster recovery, and asked whether the CVZ's stance should be revised and how innovative treatments can be made accessible. Minister Schippers answered that the CVZ and professional groups will update the evidence and standpoint, that microdiscectomy remains the reimbursed gold standard, and that a conditional-admission pilot exists.
To this end, the overview of the medical-scientific literature on endoscopic techniques will be updated.
Daartoe wordt het overzicht van de medisch wetenschappelijke literatuur over endoscopische technieken geactualiseerd.
Antwoord vragen Dille over het bericht ‘Gehandicaptenzorg is nog te ‘wit’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary for health whether it is shameful that immigrants demand culturally specific care in disability institutions, and whether halal food preparation is permissible. The state secretary answers that residents may have culturally based preferences, that some institutions cater to religious or cultural backgrounds, and that dietary wishes are taken into account.
Everyone residing in a Dutch care institution has the right to care that takes their preferences, including cultural background, into account as well as possible.
Eenieder die in een Nederlandse zorginstelling verblijft, heeft recht op verzorging die zo goed mogelijk rekening houdt met zijn of haar voorkeuren, waaronder culturele achtergrond.

MP Dille asks the state secretary about a news report that crying babies are being treated with potentially lethal alternative therapies, asking whether such therapies should be banned for children and whether data on treated babies and child deaths exist. The minister answers that the Wet BIG leaves alternative treatments largely free, that treatment data are not known, and that she will ask the inspectorate (IGZ) to investigate.
I will ask the IGZ to investigate this and to examine whether dangerous, health-threatening acts are being performed.
Ik zal de IGZ vragen hiernaar onderzoek te doen en te bezien of hier gevaarlijke, gezondheidsbedreigende handelingen worden verricht.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezond, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er in 2011 meer dan 1 miljoen ADHD-voorschriften zijn (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the rise in ADHD prescriptions and whether children are diagnosed and medicated too quickly, and asks whether an investigation into diagnosis practices will be launched. The secretary expresses concern, says professional groups will be asked for their views, and commits to starting a discussion with them on diagnosis and medication, including by letter.
For that reason I will shortly ask the professional groups involved for their view on this rising use.
Daarom zal ik op korte termijn de betrokken beroepsgroepen naar hun visie ten aanzien van dit stijgende gebruik vragen.
Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het succes van de Opvoedpoli (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport why the private youth-care provider Opvoedpoli appears more efficient and cheaper than traditional institutions, and whether such providers complement or replace them. The state secretary welcomed new entrants as innovation, said Opvoedpoli fills a gap for simpler problems but cannot cover residential care, and said municipalities will decide how to pay providers by performance, with the ministry still exploring guidance.
As part of the system reform, I am examining what guidance can be provided for this.
In het kader van de stelselwijziging onderzoek ik welke handreikingen daarvoor kunnen worden geboden.

Vragen van de leden Dille, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voorstel om besnijdenis van meisjes te legaliseren (ingezonden

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Health whether they agree that female genital cutting is barbaric, whether legalising it would advance Islamisation, and whether they will guarantee it stays criminal. The minister confirmed it is criminal mutilation under the Criminal Code, said changing those articles is not planned, and did not give the requested guarantee in absolute terms.
Girls' circumcision is punishable in the Netherlands.

MPs Van Klaveren and Dille asked why the Amsterdam and Tilburg GGD refused to investigate child abuse in mosques and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that a misunderstanding arose: the refused study concerned mosque education by Verwey-Jonker Instituut, which was halted because mosque boards would not agree to research, while the GGD Nederland study covers the social environment and selected other municipalities.
Apparently a misunderstanding arose because two studies were confused with each other.
Er is kennelijk een misverstand ontstaan doordat er twee onderzoeken door elkaar zijn gehaald.

Antwoord van staatssecretaris Veldhuijzen van Zanten-Hyllner (Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport) (ontvangen 22 augustus 2011) Zie ook Aanhangsels Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2010–2011, nrs. 470, 1831 en 3064.

MPs asked the state secretary about a reported sexual assault by residents of a Cordaan care institution on a girl, whether supervision failed, how those involved would be approached, and how recurrence could be prevented. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate is handling the matter after a police investigation, that internal and external supervision was adequate, and that 100% safety cannot be guaranteed.
Given the complexity of the incident and the possible criminal implications for the suspects, including two Cordaan clients, priority was given to unhindered execution of the police investigation.

Gelet op de complexiteit van het incident en de mogelijke strafrechtelijke implicaties voor de verdachten, waaronder twee cliënten van Cordaan, is voorrang gegeven aan een ongehinderde uitvoering van het politie-onderzoek.
Vragen van de leden Dille en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat gehandicapten zijn bekogeld en bespuugd (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether disabled people are being spat at and pelted with stones in their neighbourhood, whether this is structural, and what will be done to protect them. The minister confirmed awareness, agreed that vulnerable people should not be victims, saw no sign of a structural problem, said police are investigating a small group of youths, and noted agreements with the care institution's security coordinator for quick response.
The police are working on tracing the perpetrators.
De politie is bezig met het opsporen van de daders.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ondertoezichtstelling (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why a three-year-old was placed with a family where the mother's partner had prior violent convictions, why the court refused a supervision order against Bureau Jeugdzorg's advice, and what would prevent such cases. The answer declined to comment on the judge's decision, pointed to an ongoing Inspectorate and prosecution investigation, and gave the number of pending supervision requests (about 3000 covering about 5300 children).
I do not comment on the judgment of a children's judge.
Ik treed niet in het oordeel van een kinderrechter.

Vragen van het lid Dille en De Mos (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderzoek van FNV Bondgenoten over de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer voor ouderen en gehandicapten(ingezonden

The state secretary rejected the causal claim, said the union survey is not representative and not comparable to the government's own baseline measurement, and stated that cost is not the only criterion in tenders but gave no commitment to new legal quality requirements.
I do not recognise the picture the question suggests. This general conclusion cannot be drawn (on the basis of this research).
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de vraag oproept. Deze algemene conclusie kan men (op basis van dit onderzoek) niet trekken.

Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de artikelen «25 baby’s dood door schudden» en «Gewelddadig schudden na onbedaarlijk huilen» (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about press reports on deaths and brain injury from shaken baby syndrome, and whether doctors and well-baby clinics are doing enough to prevent and recognise it. National figures on abuse of babies/infants for the year 2009 are not available.
Landelijke cijfers over mishandeling van baby’s/zuigelingen over het jaar 2009 zijn niet beschikbaar.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending van de Ombudsman waaruit is gebleken dat passagiers vervoer geweigerd wordt, vanwege hun handicap

The state secretary denied refusal on grounds of disability, said mobility aids are carried within safety and capacity limits with case-by-case solutions, committed to raising safe securing of aids with Connexxion, and rejected changing the rules.
Passengers are never refused because of their disability.
Passagiers worden nooit geweigerd vanwege hun handicap.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebruik van Ritalin (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about a study showing non-prescribed Ritalin use, claimed addiction rates, the risks of easy prescribing, and whether stricter criteria or an investigation will follow. The minister acknowledges the study but says its sample cannot support the 15% addiction claim, states the CBG judges the risk-benefit balance positive with monitoring underway, and commits to asking the profession about prescribing behaviour with the IGZ and to an investigation if warranted.
I will, in consultation with the Health Care Inspectorate, ask the professional group about prescribing behaviour and have an investigation carried out if there is reason to do so.
Ik zal in overleg met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg de beroepsgroep vragen naar het voorschrijfgedrag en indien hiertoe aanleiding bestaat een onderzoek laten doen.
Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Uit naam van Anna» (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

I see no reason for this.
Vragen van de leden Graus en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de toegankelijkheid van treinen en perrons voor rolstoelgebruikers (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about poor accessibility of trains and platforms for wheelchair users, including reports of being seated next to a smelly toilet and missing ramps. qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de overstap van de Belastingdienst naar Microsoft

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked why the Tax Administration is moving its office IT and email to Microsoft 365, given dependence on the US, the motion requiring an independent justification and in-house email, and the exit strategy. Minister Heinen answers that dependence on the US increases but is comparable to alternatives, that the risk analysis and exit strategy are confidential, and that the primary tax processes stay in Dutch data centres while office automation moves to Microsoft.
The risk analysis will be made available to your House on a confidential basis.
De risico-analyse wordt vertrouwelijk ter inzage aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de uitspraken van minister van Justitie en Veiligheid over de afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice minister to explain remarks about Dutch dependence on US tech giants, whether this requires reducing that dependence quickly, and what the government's digital autonomy position is. The government answers that the European cloud market is concentrated, that a sovereign government cloud and a revised cloud policy are being explored, and that the Justice ministry will contribute to the revised cloud policy and digital sovereignty vision.
Reducing dependencies is currently being considered in the revision of the government-wide cloud policy.
Het afbouwen van afhankelijkheden nemen wij momenteel mee in de herziening van het Rijksbreed cloudbeleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Six Dijkstra over het (structureel) gebruik van het controversiële Amerikaanse softwaresysteem Parlantir

MPs Van Vroonhoven and Six Dijkstra asked about the use of Palantir software by Dutch public bodies, including police, data handling, procurement, EU/NATO indirect use and oversight. The government answered that only the police use Palantir in the analysis environment 'de Raffinaderij' on police data, that the six safety regions' 2021 pilot ended, and that procurement and contract details are confidential or were covered earlier, while promising little concrete new action beyond referring to earlier answers.
The financial details regarding the contract concerned are confidential and cannot be made public.
De financiële details met betrekking tot het betrokken contract zijn vertrouwelijk en kunnen niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over de recente cyberaanvallen middels kwetsbaarheden in Sharepoint en Netscaler

MPs asked the government about the impact of recent cyberattacks exploiting SharePoint and Citrix Netscaler vulnerabilities, including the compromise of Public Prosecution Service systems, attribution policy and information sharing by the NCSC. The minister answered that the impact on government and society was limited, that compromises at some national organisations are under investigation, and that attribution decisions are taken by the cabinet after weighing many factors, while the Cybersecurity Act is expected to improve information sharing.
What the exact consequences of the compromise are is the subject of ongoing investigation.
Wat de exacte consequenties van de compromittatie zijn, is onderwerp van lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over hoe het demissionaire kabinet omgaat met de keuze voor mailcommunicatie in eigen beheer

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the caretaker cabinet how it handles the choice to keep government email and data in-house rather than in Microsoft's cloud, including the Exchange support deadline of 14 October 2025 and US sanctions risks. The State Secretary answered that departments decide on cloud use themselves, most ministries and agencies keep mail on-premise, the Belastingdienst is considering a Microsoft365 migration, and the government will sharpen its cloud and digital sovereignty policy without committing to a binding halt.
Departments are themselves responsible for deciding which considerations they make regarding cloud use.
Departementen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen welke afwegingen zij maken rondom cloudgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the ministers how government bodies, including RIVM and the NZa, depend on US cloud providers, what would happen if access were cut, and whether migrations would be halted. The government answered that some migrations were reconsidered or paused, that a revised Rijksbrede cloud policy is being prepared, and that continuity risks and concentration risks will be addressed, but gave no firm halt to US dependence.
Migrations have been reconsidered following, among other things, the Kathmann motion.
Er zijn migraties heroverwogen naar aanleiding van onder meer de motie Kathmann.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Six Dijkstra, Kathmann en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘In de strijd tegen deepfakes krijgen Denen copyright op eigen gezicht en stem’

MPs asked whether the government will act on deepfake abuse, including whether big tech platforms should be held responsible and whether Denmark's copyright-on-likeness approach should be adopted. The government answers that existing Dutch law (AVG, DSA, criminal law, portrait rights) is sufficient, that platforms can already be held liable, and that it sees no reason to introduce a copyright on appearance or voice.
The State Secretary for Justice and Security therefore sees no reason to proceed with amending legislation.
De Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om over te gaan tot aanpassing van wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether government bodies such as UWV and SVB will reconsider moving services to US cloud providers, given dependence on US tech giants and the CLOUD Act. The government answered that cloud policy is being revised to limit concentration risk and that some migrations were reconsidered, but it gave only general assurances on continuity, data confidentiality, and strategic autonomy.
In the revision of the government-wide cloud policy, attention is also being paid to further limiting dependence on a few suppliers.
In de herziening van het rijksbreed cloudbeleid wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan het verder beperken van afhankelijkheid van enkele leveranciers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked how dependent Dutch government organisations are on US cloud providers, whether migrations will be reconsidered, and what the consequences of losing access or of US surveillance laws would be. The state secretary answered that cloud policy is being revised, that some migrations have been reconsidered and that a sovereign government cloud is being pursued, but gave no full overview of planned migrations and largely described consequences only in general terms.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the government about dependence on US tech giants for public cloud services, including whether ministries, DJI, IND and CJIB will reconsider migrations and whether data could be exposed under US law. The state secretary answers that existing cloud policy requires weighing risks, that migrations are being reconsidered under a temporary cloud policy line, and that dependence on US providers will largely persist for now while the cloud policy is revised.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

Two MPs asked the government about growing dependence on US tech giants for cloud services, including whether DNB and other agencies will reconsider migrations, which data and processes are already in US clouds, and the risks from US laws such as the CLOUD Act. The government answered that existing cloud policy already weighs market concentration and continuity risks, that some migrations were reconsidered, that a sovereign government cloud is being explored, and that it cannot give a blanket commitment to halt dependence.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful deliberation on cloud migrations is of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.

The State Secretary answered that Logius does not use US cloud services, that the government is reviewing its cloud policy and exploring a sovereign government cloud, and that several planned migrations were reconsidered or halted.
The revision of the government-wide cloud policy also addresses further reducing dependence on a few suppliers, the so-called market concentration and continuity risks.

MPs asked the government about the rising number of people seeking treatment for gambling addiction (many young, mostly online), the lack of a ban on online gambling advertising, the minimum gambling age, drug addiction trends including cannabis and new substances, and the cost of cannabis-related addiction care. The minister acknowledged the trends as worrying, pointed to planned gambling law revision with consultation in 2026 and a planned raise of the minimum age to 21, and listed prevention measures while declining to ban gambling outright and giving no cost breakdown for cannabis treatment.
The aim is to put the relevant bill out for consultation in 2026.

MPs Hertzberger and Six-Dijkstra asked how a hack at the Clinical Diagnostics laboratory exposed medical data of about half a million Dutch citizens, when the government was informed, why the breach was not disclosed sooner, and what minimum data security standards apply. The state secretary answered that independent investigations by BVO NL, the AP and the IGJ are underway, gave a timeline of notifications, stated that the cooperation with the laboratory was suspended, and largely deferred the detailed questions on data minimisation, certification and other laboratories to those ongoing investigations.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) has launched an independent investigation into the exact scope and cause of this hack.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar de exacte omvang en de oorzaak van deze hack.

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would express interest in an EU AI gigafactory before the Friday deadline, whether EU cofinancing could draw on Nij Begun funds for a Groningen AI factory, and the status of that application due 30 June. Via a letter to the European Commission, the Ministry of Economic Affairs will then shortly support the importance of AI gigafactories and Dutch interest.
