Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Eritrese bijeenkomst afgeblazen, probleem niet opgelost’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that a Rijswijk mayor refused an Eritrean gathering over riot fears, asking how municipalities can be strengthened, which national body coordinates support, and whether the Eritrean regime's diaspora control threatens national security. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing powers and the Ondersteuningsnetwerk maatschappelijke onrust, and said NCTV found no concrete signs that the Eritrean government was driving the violence, while committing to continued monitoring.
To examine how experiences have gone so far, how the room for action can be deployed as effectively as possible and where it can still be strengthened, a consultation structure has been started.

Om te kijken hoe de ervaringen tot dusver zijn geweest, hoe het handelingsperspectief zo effectief mogelijk ingezet kan worden en waar dat mogelijk nog versterkt kan worden, is een overlegstructuur gestart
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra en Boswijk over berichten op de sociale media, die uit Nederland komen en oproepen tot haat, geweld en moord in Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra and Boswijk asked whether police and the public prosecution service have adequate oversight of, and capacity to prosecute, social media calls from the Netherlands for hatred and violence against groups in Syria, and asked for case figures. The minister said the systems cannot show how often such posts occur or how many cases are investigated, asserted priority and capacity for prosecuting hate speech, and did not answer within the requested two weeks.

From the systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) it unfortunately cannot be retrieved how often such statements and calls occur and how many reports, complaints or criminal investigations are carried out regarding such calls.

Uit de systemen van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kan helaas niet worden gehaald hoe vaak dergelijke uitingen en oproepen zich voordoen en hoeveel meldingen, aangiften of strafrechtelijke onderzoeken er worden gedaan naar dergelijke oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koops, Omtzigt en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gewijzigd beleid van het Openbaar Ministerie rondom strafbeschikkingen, waardoor bijvoorbeeld veelplegers en asielzoekers standaard een str

Three MPs asked the Justice and Asylum ministers about the Public Prosecution Service's expanded use of penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen), which could mean repeat offenders and asylum seekers receive fines or community service instead of prison and no longer go before a judge. The minister answers that the OM acts independently, that the expansion aims to shorten case times and cover offences up to six years, that cases can still be referred to court, and that the data requested is not registered or is forthcoming later.
The OM will clarify the passage in the instruction at the next amendment or following instruction on this point.
Het OM zal de passage in de instructie bij een eerstvolgende wijziging of volgende instructie op dit punt verhelderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het gebruik van Microsoft Exchange binnen de Rijksoverheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior about Microsoft Exchange servers in central government reaching end of support on 14 October 2025, including how many systems remain and what oversight exists. The State Secretary answered that central inventories are lacking because life-cycle management is a departmental responsibility, promised to ask the ministers for information and to monitor migrations, and stated that the move to Exchange SE need not mean a forced move to the cloud.
Due to the federal structure of government, no central overviews are currently available of the exact numbers and versions.
Door de federatieve opbouw van de overheid zijn er momenteel geen centrale overzichten beschikbaar over de exacte aantallen en versies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe werkplek van SSC-ICT

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether migrating 58,000 government digital workplaces to the public cloud is necessary, what it costs, whether US cloud laws and dependencies pose risks, and how data and metadata are handled. The State Secretary answered that migration is needed because Windows 10 and Ivanti components reach end of support, that most data stays in government data centres with only metadata held by US providers, and that risks are being managed and a revised cloud policy is coming in mid-2025.
I am still consulting on how we can share the advice of the intelligence and security services in outline, whether or not confidentially.
Ik ben nog in overleg hoe we op hoofdlijnen, al dan niet vertrouwelijk, de adviezen van de inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen delen.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsrea

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the government about the ADR report on security failures at the NCTV and police, including oversight, the BVA's role, and a leak. This follow-up letter answers question 5 by stating that a search found documents on the NCTV's security situation, that these are being assessed, and that some passages will be withheld for state and privacy reasons, with further documents to follow.
This has led to certain passages in the documents not being made public because they may harm the interests of the State.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid bepaalde passages uit de documenten niet openbaar te maken omdat deze de belangen van de Staat kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Six Dijkstra over het bericht 'De Vonk nodigt omstreden pro-Palestijnse activist Khatib uit voor politiek evenement’

MPs Eerdmans and Six Dijkstra asked whether the government could stop Mohammed Khatib, invited by party De Vonk, from speaking in person or online in the Netherlands. The minister answered that Khatib is flagged for refusal at entry, that online speech can be prosecuted or removed, and that the government will explore broader tools while noting limits set by free speech case law.
I want to explore in the coming period whether there are possibilities within the framework of national security to broaden the scope for action.
Ik wil de komende tijd verkennen of er in het kader van nationale veiligheid mogelijkheden zijn om het handelingsperspectief te verbreden.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Six-Dijkstra en Kathmann over de rechterlijke toegang tot burgerinformatie van de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police refuse a court order to give a court-appointed forensic expert access to police data systems, and how citizens can access their police data. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, stated that court rulings should be followed and that police are in talks with the expert, and cited the Wpg access rules and existing audit findings.
In principle, court rulings must be followed.
Aan rechterlijke uitspraken dient in beginsel gevolg te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Criminelen ontdekken een nieuwe oplichtingstruc: phishing via QR-codes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of phishing via QR codes, including how common it is, whether police and prosecutors face obstacles, and what prevention is planned. The minister answered that such cases are not separately registered, that the Fraudehelpdesk received about 20 related reports in 2024, and that prevention campaigns and awareness initiatives are ongoing.
The police do not keep separate records of the number of cases of phishing via QR codes.
De politie houdt geen aparte registraties bij van het aantal gevallen van phishing via QR-codes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Kathmann over het bericht ‘Controversial ‘chat control’ back on EU agenda this week’

MPs Six Dijkstra and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the EU 'chat control' proposal on scanning private messages, its timing in the Council, and its compatibility with Dutch constitutional privacy and telecommunications rights and EU/ECtHR case law. The Minister answered that the Netherlands will not support mandatory detection measures practically implementable only via client-side scanning, that the proposal is not yet ready, and that the answers to the questions were delayed beyond the deadline.

With the information now available, the cabinet will not support proposals on mandatory detection that in practice can only be carried out through client-side scanning, because of the consequences for digital resilience.

Met de informatie die nu voorhanden is, zal het kabinet geen voorstellen over verplichte detectie ondersteunen die in de praktijk uitsluitend kunnen worden uitgevoerd door middel van client-side scanning, vanwege de gevolgen voor de digitale weerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen en Six Dijkstra over het artikel inzake het plegen van hypotheekfraude door drugscriminelen

MPs Welzijn, Van Oostenbruggen and Six Dijkstra asked about reports that criminal networks, including drug criminals, commit large-scale mortgage fraud and whether police and prosecutors can detect and prosecute it. The government answered that the problem is recognised but not systematically registered, that data-sharing options with banks and the Tax Authority are being explored, and that police knowledge of new modus operandi will be shared with lenders.
Mortgage fraud is not registered separately by the police or the Public Prosecution Service, because it consists of the offences of forgery, fraud and/or money laundering.
Tot slot wordt hypotheekfraude niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd bij de politie of het OM, omdat hypotheekfraude bestaat uit de delicten valsheid in geschrifte, oplichting en/of witwassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Olger Van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minister van Defensie: Nederlandse wetten ongeschikt voor ‘grijze zone’ tussen oorlog en vrede’

MPs Van Dijk and Six-Dijkstra asked the government about Russian vessels mapping North Sea infrastructure, military transport routes, conscription and reservists, a single cyber contact point, and cybersecurity governance. The government answered that it does not pre-announce responses, outlines Defence's North Sea tasks and the Action Plan, says military route specifics are confidential, notes a voluntary enquiry and more reservists, and describes the NLCS and the planned Cyberweerbaarheidsnetwerk.
Specific information on military transport routes and corridors cannot be shared publicly due to the confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke informatie over militaire transportroutes en corridors kan i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet publiekelijk gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over een verklaring van nationale politiehoofden die betrekking heeft op end-to-end- encryptie

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice Minister about a European police chiefs' call to weaken end-to-end encryption and how it relates to rulings by the ECtHR, CJEU and EDPB. The minister answered that the government keeps its existing position supporting end-to-end encryption, that lawful access should be sought through European cooperation, and that the rulings are not inconsistent with that position.
That position is not up for discussion here.
3 Dit standpunt staat hier niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het Koninklijk Huis, de belastingvrijstelling en nevenfuncties

An MP asked the Prime Minister about tax treatment of royal family members, whether the constitutional exemption for functional assets is implemented, and whether the RVD asked journalists to avoid royal topics. The government answered that the functional assets are held in foundations and are not taxed, that all entitled royal members pay box 3 tax, and that no such RVD requests occurred.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het DNA-spoor op het wapen waarmee Pim Fortuyn is vermoord

An MP asked whether the Public Prosecution Service will re-run a DNA trace from the Fortuyn murder weapon through international databases, and whether further investigation is possible for truth-finding. The Minister confirmed the OM decided against it because any match would only show possession before 2002 of an offence that has since prescribed, and said the Minister will not interfere in that prosecutorial decision.
The decision on whether to have further investigation carried out into the DNA trace in question rests with the OM.
De beslissing om al dan niet nader onderzoek naar het betreffende DNA-spoor te laten verrichten is aan het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de conceptenrichtlijn

MPs Palmen and Six Dijkstra asked the Interior Minister whether earlier answers on draft documents under the Woo transparency law were correct, including a nota showing a ministry applied a blanket draft-exclusion policy. The minister acknowledges the 2022 Woo instruction was too strict, leading to routine refusal of drafts, that it was revised in July 2024, and that a study of Woo implementation costs will start, but denies the Chamber was deliberately misinformed.

As previously stated in the letter to the House of 12 February 2024, the Woo instruction appeared stricter than intended, so that in practice drafts were refused more often than they should have been.
Zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 12 februari 2024 oogde de Woo-instructie strakker dan bedoeld, waardoor in de praktijk concepten vaker werden geweigerd dan zou moeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de trend dat Nederlandse banken stoppen met de ondersteuning van contactloos betalen via eigen apps

MPs Six Dijkstra and Zeedijk asked the government about banks such as ING and the Volksbank dropping their own contactless payment apps in favour of Google Pay, and the consequences for privacy, digital sovereignty, and consumer choice. The Minister of Finance answered that banks set their own policy, that supervision of privacy falls under the AVG and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, that the DMA obliges Apple and Google to allow alternative payment apps, and that no general open contactless payment protocol is needed for now.
Banks conduct their own policy and decide for themselves whether they offer contactless payment via their own app or in another way.
Banken voeren hun eigen beleid en bepalen zelf of zij contactloos betalen aanbieden via een eigen app of op een andere manier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize, Six Dijkstra en Rajkowski over de kabinetsbrief Gemelde kwetsbaarheid Cisco Webex vergadervoorziening

MPs Valize, Six Dijkstra and Rajkowski asked about a Cisco Webex vulnerability that exposed metadata of government meetings, whether calls could be joined by phone, and which classification levels may be discussed on Webex. The State Secretary answered that Webex may be used up to Departementaal VERTROUWELIJK, that no Dutch cases of misuse are known, and that the Cisco vulnerability disclosure process will be discussed with Cisco.
However, no cases are known in the Netherlands in which unauthorised users attended confidential video meetings of the national government.
Binnen Nederland zijn echter geen gevallen bekend waarbij ongeautoriseerde gebruikers vertrouwelijke videovergaderingen van de Rijksoverheid hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over de personele bezetting bij de Commissie Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD)

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Interior Minister how oversight of the AIVD and MIVD will be ensured when the temporary law on cyber programmes and bulk datasets takes effect on 1 July, given the CTIVD's stated lack of capacity, and when the CTIVD will get the workspace needed to hire 10 promised FTE. The government replied that the CTIVD will be temporarily housed from 1 January 2025 and permanently from 1 July 2026 with enough space for the expansion, but that the CTIVD has said it cannot oversee the other provisions of the law until its move is complete, so those powers will only be used after that or earlier if agreed with the CTIVD.
The CTIVD has indicated it cannot oversee the other provisions of the Temporary Act because the cyber specialists needed for this are largely occupied with work on the housing problem.

De CTIVD heeft aangegeven geen toezicht te kunnen houden op de overige bepalingen uit de Tijdelijke wet, omdat de daarvoor benodigde cyberspecialisten voor een groot deel belast zijn met werkzaamheden voor de huisvestingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het bericht 'Advocaat vraagt om getuigenis van Dick Schoof in zaak van NCTV-medewerker'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a former NCTV analyst was allowed to store state-secret information on personal data carriers, who approved this, and what the consequences are for the reliability of NCTV analyses. The minister declined to give substance because criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations are ongoing, and stated that NCTV analyses follow a validation process and are not shared without the originator's consent.
As soon as the investigations allow it, I will share more information with you.
Zodra de onderzoeken dat toestaan, zal ik meer informatie met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Oud-NCTV-chef Schoof werd gewaarschuwd dat burgers online volgen via nepaccounts waarschijnlijk niet mocht'

MPs Six Dijkstra and Van Nispen asked whether the NCTV knowingly continued internet monitoring via fake accounts without a legal basis, and why documents were released only after a court order. The minister denies the NCTV acted unlawfully, says the legal view was long held to be defensible, admits the Woo deadline was overrun, and points to new supervision under the 2023 coordination act.
It is not good that the statutory period within which documents should be provided has been exceeded.
Het is niet goed dat de wettelijke termijn waarbinnen stukken behoren te worden verstrekt is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Daniëlle Jansen over de vacaturetekst “PhD-kandidaat: Vroegtijdig des- en misinformatie identificeren op sociale media” bij het RIVM

MPs Six Dijkstra and Daniëlle Jansen asked the Minister of Health whether a RIVM PhD vacancy on early detection of dis- and misinformation on social media, using AI, would involve unlawful tracking or processing of citizens' data and how the methods and algorithms would be made public. The minister answered that RIVM is independent, that implementation is outside the PhD scope, that legal bases and a DPIA would be considered if personal data are processed, and that results and methods will be published in open-access papers.
Any implementation of the method to be developed is not part of this PhD research.
Een eventuele implementatie van de te ontwikkelen methode is geen onderdeel van dit promotieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Six Dijkstra en Sneller over de verhuizing van het.nl domein

MPs Kathmann, Six Dijkstra and Sneller asked about SIDN's plan to move the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, raising sovereignty, US access, oversight and security concerns. The minister answers that no move has yet occurred, that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps, that the RDI and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will review risks via a DPIA/DTIA, and that a quickscan of Dutch and EU alternatives will be carried out with a further letter expected in Q2.
It has been agreed that SIDN will not take any irreversible steps at this time.
Afgesproken is dat SIDN op dit moment geen onomkeerbare stappen zal zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over het artikel 'Veiligheidsregio gebruikte jarenlang Chinese apparatuur ondanks spionagerisico’s'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch safety regions used Chinese network equipment despite espionage risks and whether they will map this. The minister said there is no complete overview, leaves risk assessment to the regions' boards, and promised to discuss the matter with the regions.
No. I do not have a complete picture of which network equipment is used by safety regions.
Nee. Ik heb geen volledig zicht op welke netwerkapparatuur wordt gebruikt door veiligheidsregio’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Postma en Six Dijkstra over de berichten 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? De Belastingdienst kijkt mee', 'Fiscus kijkt mee met verkoop op Vinted en Marktplaats: dit betekent he

MPs Idsinga, Postma and Six Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the Tax Authority will receive data on private online sellers on Vinted, Marktplaats and Bol under DAC7, raising concerns about tax burdens, unclear entrepreneur status, and privacy risks from collecting citizen service numbers. The State Secretary replied that DAC7 creates no new tax obligations, that the 30-transaction/2,000-euro threshold balances enforcement with feasibility, that personal data collection is necessary for proper taxation and protected under GDPR, and that the Tax Authority will expand public information rather than new rules, though several questions were answered only in part.
In addition, the Tax Authority is intensifying information provision to private individuals who sell, rent out or offer their services via online platforms.
Daarnaast intensiveert de Belastingdienst de voorlichting aan particulieren die verkopen, verhuren of hun diensten aanbieden via online platformen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de SGO-instructie dat conceptdocumenten categorisch niet verstrekt moeten worden

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether a secretaries-general meeting instruction categorically withholds draft documents from parliament and Woo requesters, and whether that is lawful under the Constitution and the Woo. The State Secretary denied categorical withholding, said drafts require a case-by-case assessment of relevant factual information, and promised to clarify the instructions.
Blanket refusal of drafts without this test is not permitted, and that is also not what was agreed in the SGO.
Integrale weigering van concepten zonder deze toets is niet toegestaan en dat is ook niet zo gewisseld in het SGO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Palmen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether political leadership was fully informed and gave green light before an Iranian sabotage operation reported by Volkskrant, and whether the legal powers exist for digital sabotage. The minister declined to discuss operations or the information given to the Prime Minister, citing secrecy, and pointed to parliamentary oversight via the CIVD and the CTIVD and to the legal basis for disruption measures.
Because of the mentioned duty of secrecy, the information provided to the Prime Minister cannot be addressed in public.
Vanwege de genoemde plicht tot geheimhouding kan in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op de informatievoorziening aan de Minister-President.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Six Dijkstra over het volgen van holocaustoverlevenden door de BVD

Six Dijkstra asked the Interior Minister how long the BVD has known it monitored Nationaal Auschwitz Comité members and survivors, whether the investigation was politically steered, whether it was justified, and whether the remaining files will be fully declassified. The minister answered that the investigations fell under ministerial responsibility, were framed by Cold War communism concerns and the historical legal context, and that the person files are partly restricted on privacy grounds but become fully public after 75 years.
This was done because the content of the personal files may affect the interests of living persons.
Dit is gedaan omdat de inhoud van de persoonsdossiers de belangen van nog levende personen kunnen raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Zeedijk over de Nederlandse deelname aan de IPCEI-regeling voor cloudtechnologie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Dutch participation in the IPCEI scheme for next-generation cloud technology, including the cloud value chain, market concentration, sovereignty, and governance of the EUR 70 million. The minister answered that the scheme serves European innovation and autonomy, that Dutch projects were selected through criteria and monitored by RVO, and that a purely Dutch sovereign cloud service is not the aim.
The cabinet informed parliament on 21 September 2021 about the planned Dutch participation in the IPCEI CIS and the decision to make EUR 70 million available for Dutch projects.

Het kabinet heeft op 21 september 2021 (Prinsjesdag) uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen Nederlandse deelname aan het Important Project of Common European Interest Next Generation Cloud Infrastructure and Services (IPCEI CIS) en de beslissing hiervoor 70 miljoen euro ten behoeve van Nederlandse projecten beschikbaar te stellen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koekkoek c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over middelen voor het programma Nationale Parken
Moves 23.7 million euro within the agriculture budget to nature to reverse the planned cut to the National Parks programme funding.
This amendment aims to redistribute the non-legal mandatory funds from art. 21 so that the cut to the National Parks Programme is reversed.
Dit amendement beoogt de niet-juridische verplichte middelen uit art. 21 zodanig te verdelen zodat de ombuiging op het Nationaal Programma Parken wordt teruggedraaid.
Motie van het lid Lahlah c.s. over uitspreken dat een minister van Rechtsbescherming met structurele begrotingsmiddelen onderdeel uit moet maken van een volgend kabinet
Calls for a Minister of Legal Protection with its own control over structural budget funds to be part of the next cabinet, to protect the rule of law and fundamental rights.
expresses that a Minister of Legal Protection with its own control over structural budget funds should be part of a next cabinet
spreekt uit dat een Minister van Rechtsbescherming met eigen zeggenschap over structurele begrotingsmiddelen onderdeel uit moet maken van een volgend kabinet
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Koekkoek c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over middelen voor het programma Nationale Parken
Shifts 23.7 million euro from agriculture to nature policy to reverse the cut to the National Parks programme.
In article 21 Agriculture and horticulture, the commitment amount and the expenditure amount are reduced by € 23,700 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 21 Land- en tuinbouw worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 23.700 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over een dekking voor extra steun voor Oekraïne
Moves 624 million euro reserved for border surveillance intensification to Ukraine support by cutting defence and infrastructure budget lines.
The budget statement is amended as follows: in article 3 Land Materiel the commitment and expenditure amounts are reduced by 30,450 (x 1,000) euro.
De begrotingsstaat wordt als volgt gewijzigd: I In artikel 3 Land Materieel worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 30.450 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over extra steun voor Oekraïne
Shifts 624 million euro of planned border-control funding through 2030 to direct financial support for Ukraine's defence industry, reducing the Marechaussee budget.
This amendment therefore aims to invest the 624 million euro reserved through 2030 in support for Ukraine against Russian aggression
Deze beoogt daarom middels dit amendement de tot en met 2030 gereserveerde 624 miljoen euro te investeren in de steun aan Oekraïne tegen de Russische agressie
Amendement van de leden Koekkoek en Dassen over middelen voor het programma Nationale Parken
Reallocates within the agriculture and nature budgets to reverse the planned cut of 18 million euro to the National Parks programme.
This amendment therefore restores the national contribution so that national parks can continue their public function
Dit amendement herstelt daarom de rijksbijdrage en zorgt ervoor dat de nationale parken hun publieke functie ook in de toekomst kunnen blijven vervullen.
Motie van het lid Chakor c.s. over voor taakmutaties in het Gemeentefonds en Provinciefonds weer gebruikmaken van de oude methode voor het verwerken ervan
Asks the cabinet to use the old method for processing task changes in the municipal and provincial funds until a implementation test shows the new calculation is error-free.
requests the cabinet to again use the old method for task changes in the Municipal Fund and Provincial Fund from the Spring Memorandum 2025
verzoekt het kabinet om voor taakmutaties in het Gemeentefonds en Provinciefonds vanaf de Voorjaarsnota 2025 weer gebruik te maken van de oude methode
Motie van het lid Chakor c.s. over structureel voldoende middelen beschikbaar stellen voor cruciale voorzieningen
Asks the government to agree with municipalities on structural funding so that cuts to sport, culture, housing and infrastructure are avoided.
requests the government, in consultation with municipalities, to structurally make sufficient funds available
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met gemeenten structureel voldoende middelen beschikbaar te stellen
Motie van het lid Chakor c.s. over overeenstemming bereiken over de tekorten op de jeugdzorg en de algemene korting op het Gemeentefonds
Asks the government to make every effort to reach agreement with local governments on youth care deficits and the general cut to the municipal fund before the next intergovernmental meeting.
requests the government to make maximum efforts so that agreement can be reached with decentralised governments at the next intergovernmental meeting on 14 April
verzoekt de regering om zich maximaal in te spannen zodat er tijdens het volgende overhedenoverleg op 14 april overeenstemming kan worden bereikt met de decentrale overheden
Motie van het lid Koekkoek over voor de Voorjaarsnota in kaart brengen welke regelingen kunnen worden overgeheveld naar het Rijk
Asks the cabinet to map before the Spring Memorandum which municipal schemes could be transferred to central government.
requests the cabinet to map before the Spring Memorandum which schemes could be transferred to central government
verzoekt het kabinet voor de Voorjaarsnota in kaart te brengen welke regelingen kunnen worden overgeheveld naar het Rijk
Motie van het lid Chakor c.s. over het gemiste accres over de ingetrokken opschalingskorting en extra korting op de jeugdhulp toevoegen aan het Gemeentefonds en Provinciefonds

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de ontwikkelingen omtrent opschorten van asielaanvragen, de inbreukprocedure en de belemmeringen van ngo’s in Griekenland

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about Greece's suspension of asylum applications, an EU infringement procedure on reception rules, NGO restrictions, and whether the Netherlands would press Greece and the Commission. The minister answered that enforcement is primarily for the Commission, that the ECHR interim measures say nothing about Greek law's legality, that Dutch bilateral support does not contribute to detention, and that the Commission's rule-of-law dialogue is the forum for NGO issues, with no concrete new commitments beyond informing parliament when warranted.
So far it is only known that the Commission sent a letter of formal notice to Greece on 26 January 2023.
Vooralsnog is enkel bekend dat de Commissie op 26 januari 2023 een aanmaningsbrief aan Griekenland heeft gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Kabinet stuurt vrouwen terug naar Taliban in Afghanistan'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government accepts that Taliban rules against women amount to persecution and how deportations of Afghan women fit with Netherlands' legal action against Afghanistan under CEDAW. The minister answered that individual assessment continues, that the Taliban rules can ground asylum under current policy, that forced return is currently not possible, and that the government will not comment further on the ongoing legal proceedings and will publish a new country report soon.
On this process [and questions related to this international legal procedure] the cabinet, in the interest of the liability claim, cannot make further statements.
Over dit proces [en vragen gerelateerd aan deze internationaal-juridische procedure] kan het kabinet, in het belang van de aansprakelijkstelling, geen verdere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de Israëlische aanval op de Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about reported drone attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, the treatment of Dutch participants, and whether to condemn Israel, press for EU/UN action, or seek sanctions. The Foreign Minister says the government abhors violence against peaceful activists, cannot confirm Dutch citizens were aboard the attacked ships, has asked Israel for a legal justification and is awaiting it, and has pressed for safe passage and humanitarian access without committing to sanctions or a formal condemnation.
The cabinet rejects any form of violence against peaceful activists.
Het kabinet keurt elke vorm van geweld tegen vreedzame actievoerders af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de beschietingen van humanitaire reddingsschepen door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about Libyan coast guard shootings at humanitarian rescue ships (Ocean Viking and Sea-Watch 5), Dutch involvement, EU funding of the Libyan coast guard, and Dutch steps on accountability, rules of engagement and NGO criminalisation. The minister answered that the government has no independent information, condemned the violence, urged Libyan authorities to investigate through the embassy and EU delegation, and said it would inform parliament on request.
The cabinet does not have independent information about this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ministerie ‘trekt steun in’ voor wereldwijd klimaatcentrum in Rotterdam’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch government is ending funding for the Global Centre on Adaptation in Rotterdam, and about the consequences of a possible departure. The state secretary replied that the project funding simply runs to its contracted end date of 31 May 2026, that the foundation is independent and may reapply, and that the government will not withdraw support or change its climate adaptation commitments.
The current project funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs runs in line with the signed contract and ends on 31 May 2026.
Het huidige project dat door het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wordt gefinancierd loopt in lijn met het gesloten contract op 31 mei 2026 af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht 'Als trans persoon gevlucht voor Trumps beleid, maar is dat genoeg voor asiel? ‘Het is niet veilig voor haar’'

An MP from Volt asks the Asylum and Migration Minister and colleagues whether transgender US asylum claims can succeed given the Trump administration's policies, whether the 2024 US country report should be revised, and whether transgender people should be designated a risk group. The government answers that US developments do not currently justify presuming a well-founded fear of persecution for transgender Americans, that each claim is judged individually on recent sources, that no general country report is planned, and that discretionary residence permits will be reviewed after a Council of State ruling.
By letter of 27 August I informed your House about the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Bij brief van 27 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Eigenrichting zoals bij de grens bij Ter Apel mag niet op begrip kunnen rekenen van politici’

An Volt MP asked the Justice Minister whether citizens carrying out their own border checks near Ter Apel break the law, whether authorities are failing to act, and what concrete steps will counter this vigilantism. The Minister said prosecution is for the OM and courts to judge, that border control is reserved for competent authorities such as the Marechaussee, that demonstrating is allowed within legal limits, and that police and Marechaussee are monitoring the situation with German counterparts.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have occurred.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Voortrekker Nederland blijkt fors achter te lopen met voorbereidingen Migratiepact’ en het daarin benoemde rapport van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Minister about press reports and a European Commission progress report suggesting the Netherlands lags in implementing the EU Migration Pact, and about reception capacity and the Asylum Emergency Measures and two-status bills. The government replied that the Netherlands is on schedule for June 2026, acknowledges reception-capacity concerns, pledges to reduce emergency reception locations, and says the implementation timeline continues, with periodic updates to parliament.
The Netherlands is on schedule to implement the Pact by June 2026.
Nederland ligt op schema om het Pact per juni 2026 te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Pentagon gaat duizenden transgender militairen ontslaan’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government how it views the US Pentagon's plan to discharge transgender military personnel, whether it will condemn this, and whether it will offer asylum or other protection. The minister answered that Dutch defence values diversity, expressed concern, declined to condemn the US decision citing sovereignty, and said there is no basis for a special asylum scheme for transgender Americans, with each asylum claim judged individually.
All countries enjoy sovereignty and make decisions based on their own specific national priorities.
Alle landen genieten soevereiniteit en zij nemen beslissingen op grond van hun eigen specifieke nationale prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Waakhond slaat alarm: ‘Als je nu niet in actie komt, zit jouw foto straks in AI-bot van Instagram’

MP Koekkoek asked whether Meta's plan to use Instagram and Facebook user data for AI training violates privacy rules, and what the Dutch government will do about it. The Secretary of State answered that assessing lawfulness under the GDPR is for the Irish lead regulator (DPC) and the Dutch AP, that the government sees no role for itself and will not take independent action, while noting the DPC's ongoing follow-up and the EDPB's views.
No, that would mean the Dutch government would be taking over the role of the supervisory authorities.
Nee, daarmee zou de Nederlandse overheid op de stoel van de toezichthouders gaan zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel `Organisatie meldt dat Israëlische marine zeilboot Greta Thunberg heeft geënterd’

Two Volt MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Israeli forces intercepted and boarded the Madleen, the sailboat carrying Greta Thunberg toward Gaza, asking whether this violates international law and what the government has done. The minister confirmed the interception, said consular assistance was given to the Dutch national aboard, declined to judge the incident definitively pending information from the flag state, the UK, and did not commit to summoning the Israeli ambassador.
Because of the privacy of the person concerned, the cabinet cannot currently go further into the substance of the matter.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkene kan het kabinet op dit moment niet verder ingaan op de inhoud van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Fransen willen Amerikanen 'wetenschappelijk asiel' verlenen'

Two Volt MPs asked the Dutch education minister about the French plan to grant US scientists 'scientific asylum' and what the Netherlands would do to attract American researchers. The minister declined to judge French policy, stressed academic freedom and pointed to EU and national measures such as a EUR 25 million NWO instrument, without giving figures on US researchers arriving.
I currently have no specific information on appointments of scientists broken down by where they come from or what their intentions are.
Ik heb op dit moment geen specifieke informatie over de aanstellingen van wetenschappers in combinatie met waar ze vandaan komen of wat hun voornemens zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de strategische partnerschappen tussen de Europese Unie en Jordanië, Libië, Polen en Griekenland

An MP asked the government about the EU strategic partnerships with Jordan, Libya, Poland and Greece, covering the Commissioner's role, border management funding, Frontex and Europol roles, human rights conditionality, Libyan mass graves, Schengen evaluation of Poland and pushbacks. The government answered at length, largely describing EU instruments and Dutch positions, declining to publish the EUBAM Libya strategic review, and deferring some matters to Frontex, the Commission or later reports.
This review will not be made public.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ´Pro-Russische hackers nemen Belgische overheidswebsites op de korrel´

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Belgian government websites, including whether Dutch government websites are vulnerable, who is responsible, and whether diplomatic steps follow. The government answered that DDoS attacks are generally limited in impact but must be taken seriously, that Dutch sites are equally vulnerable, that organisations bear primary responsibility and attribution is difficult, and that Russian cyber threats are rising and met with sanctions and support for Ukraine.
The NCSC does not engage in attribution in this context.
Het NCSC doet daarbij niet aan attributie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over digitale sloten in studentenwoningen

An MP asked the government about a housing corporation's plan to switch student housing in Enschede to digital locks, including privacy risks, registration of entries and exits, and the Finnish regulator's ruling on a similar practice. The minister replied that the government has no say over private organisations' technology use, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is responsible for GDPR enforcement, and that the government has no overview of such locks nationally.
However, it is not for the cabinet to investigate or, in individual cases, whether privacy legislation is being breached.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om onderzoek te doen of in voorkomende gevallen de privacywetgeving wordt geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel 'Hongarije neemt wet aan die Pride-mars verbiedt'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government shares concern about Hungary's law banning Pride marches, its fines and facial recognition, what message the Netherlands conveys to Hungary, and whether the minister will join the Budapest Pride. The government calls the Hungarian laws very worrying, says the Commission must assess EU law compliance and urges action, reports a BeNeLux statement at the Council of Europe and conveyed concerns to the ambassador, and says the minister will not attend Pride though participation is still being considered.
The Netherlands will call on the Commission to do this expeditiously and take action if it finds that Union law has been breached.
Nederland zal de Commissie oproepen om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over Chemours

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and Volt asked the State Secretary about Chemours, its recent leak and past accidents, its lobbying in Europe against the PFAS ban, and the scientific claims used by industry. The State Secretary answered that supervision of the Seveso site is shared with inspection partners, that the leak caused no soil, water or drinking water effects, and that the PFAS restriction is under assessment by ECHA, with the government saying it would take a position once the Commission proposal exists.
I am not responsible for that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de herkomst van budgetten voor maatwerkafspraken

The MP asks how much budget is reserved for maatwerkafspraken (tailored agreements with large emitters), whether NIKI and SDE++ funds and unallocated Klimaatfonds money will be used, and how a level playing field for other firms is ensured. The minister gives budget figures (about EUR 1,004 million plus EUR 66 million for implementation, EUR 222 million for waste incinerators), says NIKI and SDE++ are generic schemes with allocation by tender, and defers the unallocated funds decision to the spring budget process.
The House will be informed about this simultaneously with the Voorjaarsnota (spring budget memorandum).
De Kamer wordt hierover gelijktijdig met de Voorjaarsnota geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de invoering van interne grenscontroles in Nederland

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked the government about the reintroduction of internal border controls, including costs, justification under EU rules, personnel impact on the Royal Marechaussee, and whether controls will facilitate people smuggling. The minister answered that controls will be risk-based and non-systematic, that no significant extra costs are expected, that irregular migration and secondary flows justify the measure, and that controls are temporary and not expected to increase smuggling.
The cabinet is taking all possible measures to prevent further disruption of the migration system, because this could lead to distressing situations and a greater threat to public order.
Het kabinet neemt alle mogelijke maatregelen om verdere verstoring van het migratiesysteem te voorkomen, omdat dit kan leiden tot schrijnende situaties en een grotere dreiging voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over humanitaire consequenties detentie reddingsschip van Artsen zonder Grenzen Geo Barents door Italië

MP Koekkoek (Volt) asked the ministers about the humanitarian consequences of Italy's detention of the Geo Barents rescue ship and the Libyan coast guard's conduct. The government replied that Italy's detention is a domestic legal matter for Italian courts and the European Commission, that the EU supports the Libyan coast guard with monitoring and training, and that a complaint filed with the Commission in July 2023 is still pending.
This concerns an assessment by the Italian authorities based on Italian laws and regulations.
Het gaat hier om een afweging van de Italiaanse autoriteiten op basis van Italiaanse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het aankondigen van een optout bij de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why the government is announcing an opt-out from EU asylum and migration rules to the European Commission when treaty change is not on the table, and what signal this sends about compliance. The minister replied that the letter signals Dutch intent to make its own migration rules at future treaty change, that the government will comply with current EU asylum law while an opt-out is absent, and that enforcement is for the Commission to decide.
As long as the Netherlands has no opt-out, the European asylum and migration rules apply to the Netherlands, and the cabinet will implement and comply with them.
Zo lang Nederland geen opt-out heeft, is de Europese asiel- en migratieregelgeving op Nederland van toepassing, en zal het kabinet dit uitvoeren en naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Bekende stikstofexperts slaan uitnodiging Tweede Kamer af'

An MP asks the agriculture minister about nitrogen experts declining a Lower House invitation and whether scientists are being used to find loopholes; the minister denies this, says a peer review of a scientifically based calculation floor for nitrogen deposition will be completed by year end, and that the Council of State's advisory division will be asked to advise if the review supports a floor. Answers to questions on consultation, disclosure of expert advice, costs and timing are given, with the minister declining to share advice until the process is finished.
At this moment I cannot yet share these advices with the Chamber because I am still working on elaborating the follow-up steps.
Op dit moment kan ik deze adviezen nog niet delen met de Kamer omdat ik nog bezig ben met de uitwerking van de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de aanpak van institutioneel racisme

An MP asked the Minister of BZK how the government defines and tackles institutional racism, including in digital systems and algorithms, and what timeline applies. The minister answered that the CRM definition is used, outlined planned measures (discrimination test, Staatscommissie, Awgb review, algorithm framework, discrimination protocol) with timelines, but gave no concrete binding commitment beyond existing plans.
I expect to inform your House at the end of 2024 or in the first quarter of 2025 about the outcome of this study.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer eind 2024 of in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 te informeren over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel van de NRC 'Hoe PVV’er Barry Madlener in zijn eerste weken als minister van Infrastructuur de voorgenomen krimp van Schiphol terug liet draaien'

An MP asked how the Schiphol flight-cap increase to 475,000–485,000 movements was decided, who was consulted, and how civil servants' integrity and residents' trust are affected. The minister answered that an additional consultation ran in 2024, about ten meetings with sector parties and advisers were held, civil servants advised with noted risks, residents' concerns were acknowledged, and the decision notes were already shared with the Chamber.
The underlying relevant decision notes have, in line with the existing practice, already been shared with the Chamber on 4 September.
De onderliggende relevante beslisnota’s zijn conform de bestaande lijn reeds met de Kamer gedeeld op 4 september jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee en Koekkoek over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen, Hirsch, Van der Lee and Koekkoek asked the ministers about the export credit insurance for Total's LNG project in Mozambique, including the re-assessment process, independence of security information, Total's role, the Palma attacks, and compliance with the Thijssen motion. Minister Heinen answered that the re-assessment is not finished, that all Proximities report recommendations were implemented, that the government will not postpone the decision as the motion asked, and that delayed Woo requests led to penalty payments.
As long as the assessment process is ongoing, I cannot make statements about its content in order to ensure a careful process.
Zolang het beoordelingsproces loopt, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de inhoud daarvan om zo een zorgvuldig proces te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekkoek over het niet op orde hebben van het toezicht op de geheime diensten

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the CTIVD, which oversees the intelligence services, still lacks workspace and 10 additional staff, and whether the new Temporary Act can responsibly take effect without a fully equipped overseer. The government answers that housing is being sought with strict security requirements, a temporary solution is available from January 2025 and permanent housing by mid-2026, and that the Act's powers will be phased in as oversight capacity grows.

As stated in the letter of 26 June 2024 on the entry into force of the Temporary Act, the Act contains provisions that must become available as soon as possible but that create no additional work for the CTIVD.

Zoals in de brief van 26 juni 2024 over de inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet is aangegeven, bevat de Tijdelijke wet voorzieningen waarvan het van groot belang is dat deze zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen, maar waar geen extra werkzaamheden voor de CTIVD uit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het gebruik van dwangmiddelen bij begeleide terugkeer

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked about the use of restraints (body cuffs, tie wraps) and force during forced returns, including a May 2024 Dublin transfer to Bulgaria, medical incidents, oversight and whether an independent inquiry is needed. The minister answered that restraints were justified by a prior risk assessment, that oversight by the Public Prosecution Service and the Inspectorate exists, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service supervises the use of restraint aids for removal and the use of force.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt toezicht op de inzet van hulpmiddelen ten behoeve van uitzetting en op het gebruik van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het NOS artikel 'Vluchtelingen moeten vijf weken weg vanwege studentenfeest, mogen daarna weer terug'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the forced relocation of 120 asylum seekers from the Octoberhal in Leiden for a student party was considered, and whether their vulnerability and mental health were weighed. The minister answered that the location was a temporary emergency shelter, the municipality required it for student activities, no alternative site was available, and the residents were moved to other COA locations.
Naturally, alternative locations for the student associations were discussed, but in the various talks with the municipality this proved not feasible.
Vanzelfsprekend is gesproken over eventuele alternatieve locaties voor de studentenverenigingen, maar dat is in de verschillende gesprekken met de gemeente niet haalbaar gebleken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Lighthouse Reports rapport “Desert Dumps”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether EU and Dutch funding or operational involvement contributed to abuses of migrants dumped in the desert, as reported by Lighthouse Reports, and what steps would prevent recurrence. The government answered that the Commission and EEAS found no evidence of direct or indirect EU support, that the Netherlands has no indication of its funds contributing to abuses, and that it will press for monitoring and do-no-harm standards, while saying the Commission had not yet answered the Parliament's request for a review.
The Netherlands has asked the European Commission for clarification.
Nederland heeft bij de Europese Commissie om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de situatie in Republika Srpska

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about rising tensions in Republika Srpska, including Dodik's secessionist rhetoric, minority safety, EU sanctions and Russian influence. The minister answered that the government sees Dodik undermining Bosnian state structures and the Dayton Agreement, that EUFOR Althea is monitoring and ready to scale up, and that the EU lacks consensus for sanctions while Nederland opposes funding for RS authorities that violate the rule of law.
The government remains committed to ensuring the EU does not in any way support Dodik's secession agenda, including under the Hungarian presidency.
Het kabinet blijft zich ervoor inzetten dat de EU de afscheidingsagenda van Dodik op geen enkele wijze zal steunen, ook niet onder het Hongaars voorzitterschap.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Ouwehand, Teunissen en Tseggai over het bericht ' Yeşilgöz haalt uit naar Tim Hofman na X-bericht over ME'

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether her social media post questioning journalist Tim Hofman about police treatment of ME (riot police) demonstrators harmed press freedom and journalist safety, and whether she would retract it. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good, that her post was a counter-question about possible police incidents and did not limit press freedom, and that any alleged improper police conduct is investigated.

I also indicated in my post that if there were questions about, or if there were improper conduct by the police, an investigation is always conducted and appropriate measures are taken where necessary.

Ik heb in mijn bericht ook aangegeven dat wanneer er vragen zouden zijn over, of sprake zou zijn van onjuist handelen van de politie, daar altijd onderzoek naar wordt gedaan en waar nodig passende maatregelen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Rechtbanken wijzen voorlopige voorzieningen ‘derdelanders’ toe’

MPs Podt and Koekkoek asked why courts granted interim relief to third-country nationals with Ukrainian temporary protection and how the policy to end that protection was made and implemented. The Secretary of State defended ending the protection, said the status was frozen pending CJEU rulings, and described municipal and private-sector obligations and reception arrangements.
As a result, I have been obliged to again freeze the consequences of ending temporary protection for these third-country nationals until the CJEU answers the preliminary questions.

Als gevolg hiervan ben ik genoodzaakt geweest om opnieuw de gevolgen van de beëindiging van de tijdelijke bescherming voor deze derdelanders te bevriezen tot de beantwoording van de prejudiciële vragen door het HvJEU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Teunissen over het rapport 'Death, Despair and Destitution: The Human Costs of the EU’s Migration Policies' van Artsen zonder Grenzen

MPs Koekkoek and Teunissen asked the government to react to a Médecins Sans Frontières report on the human costs of EU migration policy, including externalisation, violence at borders, Libya and Tunisia cooperation, Malta and Italy sea rescue, and legal routes. The State Secretary answered at length, mostly by restating EU and Dutch frameworks, citing monitoring mechanisms, and declining to commit to suspending cooperation or launching new investigations.
On this subject, questions were asked on 21 February by MP Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). The cabinet refers to the answers to those questions for a comprehensive response on detention centres in Libya.

Over dit onderwerp zijn op 21 februari jl. vragen gesteld door het lid Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA). Graag verwijst het kabinet naar de beantwoording op deze vragen voor een uitgebreide reactie over detentiecentra in Libië.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen en Koekkoek over gestapelde gezinshereniging

MPs Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen and Koekkoek asked the Minister of Justice and Security why she claimed thousands of people were affected by chained family reunification (nareis-op-nareis), given IND's uncertainty and expert signals of a marginal phenomenon, and how this squares with the cabinet's fall. The Minister answered that her conclusion rested on general family reunification figures and IND's Stand van de uitvoering 2023, that the law leaves room for misuse, that a broad migration package could not be agreed and the change is left to a next cabinet.
I concluded, based on the general figures on family reunification plus the total inflow figures and the IND's Stand van de uitvoering, that chained family reunification is a problem.
Ik heb op basis van de algemene cijfers over nareis plus de totale instroom cijfers en de Stand van de uitvoering 5 van de IND geconcludeerd dat nareis op nareis een knelpunt is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de (toegang tot) zorg voor ongedocumenteerde personen op Aruba, Sint-Maarten en Curaçao

An MP asked the government which Caribbean organisations were consulted under the Simons motion on refugee assistance, how child and health protection for undocumented people is addressed, whether Curaçao's reports can be shared, and how civil society input and HIV medication access are handled. The government answered that migration and healthcare for undocumented people are the responsibility of the autonomous countries, withheld the reports until Curaçao publishes them, and pointed to ongoing working-group cooperation.

However, the fact remains that migration policy, including access to healthcare and protection of undocumented minors, is a matter for the countries, and the countries within the Kingdom are primarily responsible for it themselves.

Feit blijft echter dat migratiebeleid inclusief de toegang tot de gezondheidszorg en bescherming van minderjarige ongedocumenteerden een landsaangelegenheid is, en de Landen binnen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden hier zelf primair voor verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.

Antwoord op vragen van het leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Koekkoek over de berichten 'Steeds meer arbeidsmigranten op straat: 'De opvang moet humaner'', 'Een half miljoen arbeidsmigranten: uitbuiting en maatschappelij

MPs from CDA and Volt asked the ministers about media reports on homeless EU labour migrants, including causes, the BRP temporary address registration, the legal-entitlement tool for municipalities, language barriers and WW benefits, and measures against exploitation. The government answered that the numbers are uncertain and being monitored via a new census, that causes are varied and mostly personal, that a legal tool and a short-stay pilot are underway, and that existing measures such as the agency-licensing bill and the labour-market reform are the route forward.
The cabinet recognises the signals that the legal reality regarding the rights of EU citizens is complex.
Het kabinet herkent de signalen dat de juridische werkelijkheid ten aanzien van de rechten van EU-burgers complex is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
