The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Tjeerd de Groot, Kostić en Koekkoek over de controle op visfraude door de NVWA

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, PvdD and Volt asked the minister about the court ruling on NVWA fish-fraud controls, overfishing, the adequacy of staffing and EU compliance of the inspection system. The minister acknowledged ongoing EU infringement procedures and announced capacity expansion and a revised steekproefplan, while largely defending current staffing levels and declining to share confidential Commission advice.
These advice and remarks are confidential.
Deze adviezen en opmerkingen zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de NCP-analyse van de voorstellen voor de CSDDD en de Nederlandse inzet in de EU

Volt MP Koekkoek asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the NCP's analysis that the EU CSDDD deviates from the OECD Guidelines, and what the Dutch government is doing about it. The minister says the CSDDD remains largely based on the OECD Guidelines, that some points still need work in the trilogues, and that the government has shared the analysis with negotiators and will assess impacts.
The cabinet welcomes the NCP analysis, but does not share the NCP's concern about a "serious risk of damage" and "dilution of the OECD Guidelines".
Het kabinet verwelkomt de analyse van het NCP, maar deelt de zorg over «een ernstig afbreukrisico» en «verwatering van de OESO-richtlijnen» van het NCP niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen en Ceder over het onderzoek Oxfam “From Development to Deterrence”

MPs Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen and Ceder asked whether EU development aid (ODA) under NDICI is being used for migration deterrence, citing an Oxfam report on Libyan and Tunisian coast guard funding and weak EU transparency. The minister says the Commission must check ODA eligibility and that the Netherlands will press for better reporting and human rights risk analysis, but gives no firm new commitments and says there is no misuse so far.

In the context of the mid-term evaluation of NDICI, the Netherlands has asked the Commission for insight into the calculation of migration-related expenditure and access to the markers used to attribute spending to NDICI's migration objective.

In het kader van de mid-term evaluatie van NDICI heeft Nederland de Commissie gevraagd om inzicht in berekening van migratie gerelateerde uitgaven en inzage in de markers die worden gebruikt om uitgaven aan de migratiedoelstelling van NDICI toe te rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Tunesië weigert delegatie Europees Parlement toegang tot het land'

An MP asked the Prime Minister about Tunisia refusing a European Parliament delegation access, and how the Netherlands and EU should respond to Tunisia's president and whether Tunisia remains a reliable partner. The minister answered that the government finds the refusal regrettable and has raised concerns bilaterally and within the EU, but ruled out ending cooperation and emphasised continued dialogue.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that the European Parliament can do its work.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat het Europees Parlement zijn werk kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de gelekte migratiebrief

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security 29 questions about a leaked cabinet migration letter, covering planned policies, EU negotiations, asylum, border controls and detention. The government declined to address the substance, stating that political negotiation documents are not disclosed and that as a caretaker cabinet it exercises restraint, promising only to keep Parliament informed through usual channels.
The same applies to the information requested in this set of questions in relation to this document.
Dat geldt eveneens voor de informatie die, in het kader van dit document, in deze vragenset wordt opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands face uncertain future: report’ en het bericht Tijdelijke karakter opvang Oekraïners blijft knellen

MP Koekkoek asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports on the uncertain future and temporary status of Ukrainian refugees, including financing of housing, exploitation risks, healthcare and education, opvang standards, and EU-wide extension of temporary protection. The government answered each question, largely by describing existing measures, extending investment periods, and promising further reports, without committing to an EU-wide extension beyond pursuing one.
In the autumn I will inform you of the outcomes.
In het najaar zal ik u over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht «E.U. Border Agency Considers Pulling Out of Greece Over Migrant Abuses»

An MP from Volt asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security, on behalf of the Foreign Minister too, whether Frontex might withdraw from Greece over migrant rights abuses, what the Council and Netherlands would do, and what tools Frontex and the Commission have. The government answered that the decision to suspend or end Frontex operations lies with the Frontex executive director after consulting the fundamental rights officer, that Commission enforcement tools exist, and that it supports continued dialogue and the Commission's role without committing to a new Dutch initiative.
The decision to temporarily suspend or end Frontex activities in a Member State is reserved, under the European Border and Coast Guard Regulation, to the Frontex executive director.

Het besluit om activiteiten van Frontex in een lidstaat (tijdelijk) op te schorten of te beëindigen is op grond van de Europese Grens- en Kustwachtverordening (hierna: EGKW-Vo) voorbehouden aan de uitvoerend directeur van Frontex.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht «Bulgaria will invite Dutch and Austrian customs experts to help secure Schengen entry»

An MP asked whether the Netherlands joins the Bulgarian border-management pilot, what support it will give Bulgaria's border control with Turkey, what concrete conditions apply to Bulgaria's Schengen accession, and how it will prevent Dutch funds supporting rights-violating border control. The government answered that the Netherlands supports the pilots and provides Frontex staff via existing channels, that accession requires full compliance with the Schengen acquis, and that it will monitor that fundamental rights are respected.
The cabinet has also informed the House of the Netherlands' wish for an additional fact-finding mission to Bulgaria to ensure correct and current application of the Schengen acquis.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer ook ingelicht over de wens van Nederland voor een aanvullende fact finding -missie in Bulgarije die de correcte en actuele toepassing van het Schengenacquis moet verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Ook NS wil in 2025 met internationale treinen blijven rijden en doet aanvraag bij ACM’

Koekkoek (Volt) asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about NS and other operators applying to the ACM to run international train services from 2025 without a concession, and how this affects the HRN concession. The State Secretary welcomed the open-access applications as benefiting travellers, listed all notifications, confirmed that international services will be left out of the HRN concession, and committed to requesting economic-balance reviews for three initiatives.

Where the risks to domestic service are limited and lines are not decisive for the robustness of the integrated Dutch network, I choose to give the open-access initiatives room by not including train services in the HRN concession.

Daar waar de risico's voor de binnenlandse dienstverlening beperkt zijn en lijnen niet bepalend zijn voor de robuustheid van het integrale netwerk in Nederland, kies ik ervoor om de initiatieven in open toegang de ruimte te geven door treindiensten niet op te nemen in de HRN-concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel ‘Landbouwlobby liet maatregelen uit nieuw waterbeleid van het Rijk afzwakken’

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the agricultural lobby (LTO) influenced the new national water policy after a press report, and about the nature of its contacts with ministers. The government answered that the meetings were consultations tied to a policy letter rather than formal administrative consultation, that no minutes were kept, and that some suggestions were adopted while others were not.
No meeting report was made, but an appointment was made for a follow-up meeting.
Er is geen gespreksverslag gemaakt, wel een afspraak voor een vervolggesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Sylvana Simons over de geweldincidenten op HTL Hoogeveen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violent incidents at the HTL Hoogeveen asylum enforcement facility, including who decides on placement, whether courts are involved, use of force by staff, reporting of incidents to Nidos and the Inspectorate, and compliance with EU and UN child rights rules. The State Secretary answered that placement is an administrative measure open to judicial review, that minors can only be placed in exceptional cases with Nidos consent, that force is used only in exceptional situations and reported, and that the COA is working on an independent complaints procedure and updated policy, though the answers were often descriptive and deferred some steps.
So a judge is indeed involved here.
Hier komt dus wel een rechter aan te pas.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Ondanks ophef wijzen meer reformatorische scholen homohuwelijk af'

MPs Simons and Koekkoek asked the minister how reformed schools' identity statements rejecting homosexual or transgender lifestyles can be reconciled with a parliamentary motion to end such statements, and what will be done about indirect exclusion of LGBTIQA+ pupils. The minister says such statements are unacceptable, the inspectorate will intervene, and a fuller response on implementing the motions will follow later this year.
I am currently examining how I can implement the Gündoğan/Simons motion, as well as the Kwint et al. motion, which call for banning (certain forms of) identity statements in education.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik op welke manier ik uitvoering kan geven aan de motie-Gündoğan/Simons, net als aan de motie-Kwint c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Gif in de grond’

An MP from Volt asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports on the herbicide bentazon in groundwater, its effects on drinking water and whether a general ban is warranted. The minister replied that bentazon is authorised under EU rules and periodically reassessed, that use in groundwater protection areas was banned from 2023, and that a general national ban is not possible under the current EU system.
The Netherlands cannot simply ban an active substance in general.
Nederland kan een werkzame stof niet zomaar algemeen verbieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Europese Ministers vertragen en verzwakken bescherming drinkwaterbronnen tegen bestrijdingsmiddelen’ van de VEWIN, de vereniging van waterbedrijven in Nederlan

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about EU ministers delaying and weakening protection of drinking water sources against pesticides, and about the risks to meeting Water Framework Directive goals by 2027. The minister confirms awareness, says the Netherlands opposed the additional impact assessment but a majority supported it, and states the national approach to meet WFD goals will continue regardless of EU outcomes.
Regardless of further European handling of the proposed Regulation on sustainable use of plant protection products, the Netherlands will continue the approach to achieve the WFD goals.
Ongeacht de verdere Europese behandeling van de beoogde Verordening duurzaam gebruik gewasbeschermingsmiddelen zal Nederland de aanpak doorzetten om de KRW-doelen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Kröger, Sylvana Simons en Akerboom over ongedocumenteerde mensen in Nederland

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the size and composition of the undocumented population in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch policy could adopt German, Irish or city-level measures such as regularisation or city ID cards. The State Secretary answered that return remains the central policy, that existing support (LVV, minors' rights, medical care) suffices, and that he is reluctant to add broader facilities or a new education convention.
I am therefore, unlike the initiatives mentioned in question 3, reluctant to provide additional facilities such as a city pass.
Derhalve ben ik, in tegenstelling tot de in vraag 3 genoemde initiatieven, terughoudend in het faciliteren van aanvullende voorzieningen
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over afkeuring bouwvrijstelling en de gevolgen voor de herbeoordeling van milieuvergunningen voor bouwprojecten

MP Koekkoek asked the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning about the court ruling striking down the construction exemption from nitrogen permit requirements, its effect on permit reassessments, and municipal and regional environmental service capacity shortages. The minister answered that the ruling does not in principle require new environmental permits, that nitrogen permit impacts fall mainly on provinces, that no overview of backlogs or affected projects is available, and that capacity-building measures are being pursued through existing programmes.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de door Poetin aangekondigde gedeeltelijke mobilisatie en het Europees verbod op toeristenvisa voor Russen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Russian mobilisation, the Russian narrative of 'russophobia', and whether the EU should admit fleeing Russian men, plus security risks and a visa exemption. The government answered that member states control border entry under EU and international law, that it supports a coordinated EU approach, and that it will not seek an exemption from the visa suspension for men aged 18-55.
The cabinet supports the EU agreement to reach a joint approach that takes into account both international obligations and security aspects.
Het kabinet steunt de in de EU gemaakte afspraak om te komen tot een gezamenlijke aanpak, waarbij zowel de internationale verplichtingen als veiligheidsaspecten in acht worden genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verstrijken van de termijn om nieuwe informatie aan te leveren aan de GRECO (te weten 30 september 2022) naar aanleiding van de nog niet afgeronde behandeling van de GRECO

An MP asked about the former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's contacts with the government on energy compensation, the deadline for information to GRECO, and the definition of lobbyist in the lobby register proposal. The government answered that she did not take part in the energy price talks, that the GRECO deadline moved to December 2022, and that a definition of lobbyist requires research by Professor Braun first.
Question 2: Can you send an overview of all contacts (including phone calls) between Ms Van Nieuwenhuizen and Ministers and State Secretaries over the past six months?
Vraag 2 Kunt u een overzicht sturen van alle contacten (inclusief telefoongesprekken) tussen mevrouw Van Nieuwenhuizen en Ministers en Staatssecretarissen van de afgelopen zes maanden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de internationale campagne om de klimaatcrisis naar het Internationale Gerechtshof (ICJ) te brengen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Vanuatu's campaign to seek an ICJ advisory opinion on the climate crisis, Australian and New Zealand support, Kingdom SIDS representation at the UN General Assembly, and whether the government would back a UN resolution requesting such an opinion. The minister confirmed awareness, described Kingdom efforts on SIDS and climate at the UN, and said the Netherlands would decide after the legal question is formulated, in principle supporting advisory requests that are relevant to international law and not bilateral or essentially political.
The Netherlands is awaiting the formulation of the specific legal question before taking a position.
Nederland is in afwachting van de formulering van de specifieke rechtsvraag alvorens stelling ingenomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over vluchtende alleenreizende kinderen uit Oekraïne

MP Koekkoek asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether the registration of unaccompanied Ukrainian refugee children is adequate compared with other EU states, including whether age and gender are recorded and what action is taken. The State Secretary acknowledged early confusion over referral routes, described new procedures routing all unaccompanied minors to Nidos, reported growing registration numbers and EU coordination, but gave only partial answers on some points and largely restated existing procedures.
These arrangements at the time led to confusion, as a result of which registration and monitoring of this group did not always take place.
Deze afspraken hebben toentertijd tot verwarring geleid, waardoor registratie en monitoring van deze groep niet altijd plaatsvond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het rapport Death in Slow Motion: Women and girls under Taliban rule van Amnesty International van 27 juli 2022

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Amnesty International's report on women and girls under Taliban rule, including the lifting of the asylum decision and departure moratorium for Afghans, the treatment of Afghan women asylum seekers, and sanctions and humanitarian aid. The government said it is pursuing diplomatic and financial support focused on women's and girls' rights, will give the benefit of the doubt in individual asylum cases involving (imputed) Westernised women, and that the UN sanctions regime does not block health care or food supplies.
The Cabinet has great concerns about the increasing repressive measures against women and girls in Afghanistan.
Het Kabinet heeft grote zorgen over de toenemende repressieve maatregelen tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Afghanistan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verschijnen van de Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People covering events that occurred in Europe and Central Asi

An MP from Volt asked several ministers about the ILGA Europe 2021 review of LGBTI rights, including Dutch LGBTI conditions, asylum treatment of transgender applicants, violence, intersex surgery, transit leave and bi+ visibility. The government broadly recognises the report's account of the Netherlands, declines to assess other states' asylum procedures, and outlines ongoing measures and studies while promising letters on several items later.
The cabinet considers it too early to anticipate the outcomes of these processes.
Het kabinet vindt het te vroeg om op de uitkomsten van deze trajecten vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekoek en Van der Lee over noodvisa voor journalisten

MPs Koekkoek and Van der Lee asked the Foreign Minister how Dutch posts in Russia can continue supporting human rights defenders and journalists after the expulsion of diplomats, and why emergency visas for at-risk journalists are not more readily available given EU guidelines and a parliamentary motion. The minister answered that support continues in limited form, that humanitarian visas remain possible in exceptional cases, that a band-with-the-Netherlands criterion applies under the Visa Code, and that ministries are still studying how to implement the motion.
The Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Justice and Security are jointly examining the possibilities to implement the above-mentioned Dassen and Van der Lee motion.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid bekijken gezamenlijk de mogelijkheden om uitvoering te geven aan de bovengenoemde motie-Dassen en Van der Lee
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Koekkoek over het bericht ‘Grote woorden winnen in politiek Maastricht van sympathie’

MPs Palland and Koekkoek asked about a Maastricht council debate on a court ruling concerning the Tozo scheme for cross-border entrepreneurs, appeals, EU free-movement concerns and cross-border policy testing. The minister said the matter is for the municipality, that appeals were lodged and the ministry joins them, that the CRvB will rule, and that the Tozo's non-export rule follows the territoriality principle.
That is why it is good that the higher administrative court now assesses this case in an independent and impartial manner.
Daarom is het goed dat nu de hogere (bestuurs)rechter deze zaak op een onafhankelijke en onpartijdige wijze gaat beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de hint van premier Johnson dat hij uit het Europees mensenrechtenverdrag dreigt te stappen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about UK Prime Minister Johnson's hints at leaving the European Convention on Human Rights, the Rwanda deportation plan, and the Assange extradition case. The minister said the UK remains bound by the ECHR, the government is monitoring the UK's Bill of Rights and its compliance, and it would raise any breach of international law bilaterally and multilaterally.
The cabinet closely follows these developments during the parliamentary approval process.
Het kabinet volgt deze ontwikkelingen gedurende het parlementaire goedkeuringsproces nauwgezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van der Lee  en Arib over de berichten dat de Belastingdienst discriminerende criteria in de fraudesignalering voorziening (FSV) verzweeg en dat de Belastingdienst op onrechtmati

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority concealed discriminatory criteria in the fraud signalling facility (FSV) and unlawfully blocked access to blacklists. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, admitted the ministry knew of the discriminatory handbook since 2020, acknowledged the FSV processing was unlawful and will pay the fines, and said that FSV access requests are being handled and letters sent, while formal refusals of some access requests remain subject to a balancing of interests.
Yes, the manner in which personal data was processed in FSV was unlawful.
Ja, de wijze van verwerking van persoonsgegevens in FSV was onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de aanstaande uitlevering van Assange aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would oppose the extradition of Julian Assange to the United States, citing press freedom and the rule of law and the earlier government position on Britain's legal safeguards. The minister replied that the Netherlands trusts the independence of the British courts, that press freedom is not at stake given the protection of state secrets, and that any decision now rests with the British government, so the Netherlands will not intervene.
The Netherlands has full confidence in the British rule of law.
Nederland heeft het volste vertrouwen in de Britse rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over noodvisa voor journalisten door de situatie in Oekraïne

An MP asks the government whether Russian and Belarusian journalists fleeing to Ukraine can receive emergency visas or temporary protection, citing risks of arrest and Kosovo's precedent, and asks about EU border treatment and relocation. The minister answers that the EU Temporary Protection Directive covers certain third-country nationals, that Russian-speaking journalists are supported through Shelter City and a EUR 2 million fund, that specific cases are considered individually, and that the Netherlands will not commit to mandatory relocation or extra border staff.
Due to the safety of these persons, the cabinet cannot make further statements about this.
Vanwege de veiligheid van deze personen kan het kabinet hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'VVD-handelsminister hielp bedrijfslobby tegen aanpak kinderarbeid en milieuschade'

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether VNO-NCW took a different stance in the Netherlands than in Brussels on due diligence and CSR legislation, and whether the OECD guidelines will guide the Dutch position on the EU proposal, and which stakeholders were consulted. The minister says no concrete signs of a different VNO-NCW position were received, the OECD guidelines are supported, the Commission proposal is under study with a BNC-fiche to follow, and a stakeholder overview was previously shared, without detailing how input shaped the position.
The cabinet is currently studying the recently published Commission proposal on CSR.
Momenteel bestudeert het kabinet het recent gepubliceerde Commissievoorstel inzake IMVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Rapport 'de evacuatie uit Afghanistan' d.d. 12 december 2021 door Crisisplan

An MP asks the ministers of Defence, Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Crisisplan report on the Afghanistan evacuation, covering implementation of recommendations, the decision-making structure, the reduction of the evacuee list from 60 to 3, the role of the IND and the expanded definition of family members. The government answers that ministries have started implementing recommendations, that the reduction to 3 was an indicative order of magnitude, that all 58 extended family members were ultimately evacuated, and that it will report on implementation before summer.
Before the coming summer, the House will be informed about the implementation of the recommendations.
Voor de aankomende zomer zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de implementatie van de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Landbouwminister in de clinch met Brussel over teruggave fraudemiljoenen'

An MP from Volt asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why parliament was not informed in time about a disputed EU agricultural subsidy fraud case (FresQ, around 52 million euros), whether audits will be shared, and why the minister has not recovered the funds or acted earlier. The minister replies that the case is still in civil and criminal proceedings, that audits are shared with the national audit service and summarized in departmental reports, that a request has been made to charge the unrecovered amount to the EU fund after the company's bankruptcy, and that the Commission has yet to decide.
These audits by the European Commission are aimed at lawfulness errors and can be fairly detailed and technical in nature.
Deze audits van de Europese Commissie zijn gericht op rechtmatigheidsfouten en kunnen vrij gedetailleerd en technisch van aard zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Piri  en Kuzu over afwijzingen kort verblijf familieleden Syrische Nederlanders

MPs asked why Syrian visitors for family visits, even when they appear to meet the Visa Code conditions, are refused at a high rate (55% for Syrians overall, about 75% for family visits), and whether the Syrian war is treated as breaking ties to the home country. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that each application is assessed on its merits under the Visa Code, that refusals mostly reflect insufficient ties to the country of origin and doubts about timely return, and that Syrian nationals can only obtain a family visit visa if these concerns are resolved.
Every visa application is assessed on its own merits in accordance with the provisions of the Visa Code.
Alle visumaanvragen worden echter op hun eigen merites beoordeeld overeenkomstig de bepalingen van de Visumcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de interactie tussen organisaties inzake de situatie Afghanistan en het asiel- en migratiebeleid

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked how the IND was involved in deciding who could be evacuated or relocated from Afghanistan before and after 15 August 2021, and asked for internal advice, criteria and working instructions. The government answered that the IND was involved through questionnaires, document checks, social media checks and visa approval, that the IND's internal advice will be included in the pending Wob requests without a fixed date, and that the criteria were set via the existing tolkenregeling and later adjusted under the Belhaj motion amid extreme time pressure.
In handling the Wob requests, all relevant documents will be considered, including those of IND/DSUA.
Bij de behandeling van de WOB-verzoeken zullen alle relevante stukken worden betrokken, dus ook die van IND/DSUA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekoek over de Kamerbrief 'Update Nederlandse vaccindonaties'

MP Koekkoek asked the ministers why the 22.55 million vaccine doses committed to COVAX differ from the 27 million donation target, and about delivery delays, infrastructure, mutation risks and licensing. The ministers answered that 26.78 million doses were donated in total, that 14.2 million had been delivered, and that the bilateral donation was delayed by the booster campaign, while declining to commit to compulsory licensing.
The Netherlands will fulfil this commitment as soon as this is possible.
Nederland zal deze toezegging nakomen zodra dit mogelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Koekkoek, Jasper van Dijk, Kröger, Piri en Ceder over het Fiche 'Voorstel voor een Raadsbesluit betreffende voorlopige noodmaatregelen ten behoeve van Letland, Litouwen en Polen'

Six MPs from D66, Volt, SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether emergency measures for Latvia, Lithuania and Poland under Article 78(3) TFEU are still necessary, legally grounded, time-limited and consistent with asylum and human rights safeguards, including the risk of pushbacks. The government answered that the Commission's assessment of an unprecedented influx from Belarus justifies the measures, that the measures are time-limited to six months, that they largely codify existing derogations, and that it will press these states on lawful border management while not withholding support for the proposal.
The government closely follows the situation at the borders with Belarus and considers the European Commission's assessment of the situation of great importance.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie aan de grenzen met Belarus nauwlettend en acht daarbij het oordeel van de Europese Commissie ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de situatie van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over interactie asiel- en migratiebeleid en evacuaties Afghanistan

Volt MPs asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuations, including whether correspondence between ministries and the IND would be shared, the IND's role in evacuation lists, and how asylum policy relates to crisis situations. The state secretary answered that correspondence will be released via pending FOI requests with no firm timeline, that the IND had a limited support role without staff in Kabul, and that the asylum policy framework accommodates crisis situations.
Your House will therefore receive an overview of the information disclosed in this context at or immediately after its publication.
Uw Kamer zal dan ook een overzicht van de in dit kader geopenbaarde informatie ontvangen bij of onmiddellijk na de openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de uitkomst van de JBZ-Raad.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a joint letter from twelve member states calling for EU funds to be used for barriers at external borders, and about the Dutch position on such barriers. The government answered that it shares concern about instrumentalised migration via Belarus, sees EU funds (BMVI) as supporting integrated border management, sees no concrete proposal to fund physical barriers, and that the Netherlands will judge any proposal on its merits.
At the same time, the cabinet notes that there is currently no concrete proposal to use this fund, or other EU funds, specifically for financing such barriers at the EU external borders.

Tegelijkertijd merkt het kabinet op dat er op dit moment geen concreet voorstel ligt om dit fonds, dan wel andere EU-fondsen, specifiek aan te wenden voor de financiering van dergelijke barrières aan de EU-buitengrenzen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over het rapport 'Transcript from the margins' over de behandeling van trans personen uit Latijns-Amerika en de Cariben in Nederlandse asielprocedures

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked about a report on the treatment of trans asylum seekers from Latin America and the Caribbean in Dutch asylum procedures, including recommendations for trans-specific approaches, misgendering, and police violence. The State Secretary replied that the IND already uses LHBTI coordinators and training, that trans applicants are assessed individually, that Venezuela's trans population was recently classed as a risk group, and that no further structural changes are planned beyond ongoing contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland.
The IND's approach is always to address the asylum seeker according to their own wishes, regardless of the information in the passport.
De insteek van de IND is om de asielzoeker altijd naar wens van de asielzoeker aan te spreken, ongeacht de informatie in het paspoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekoek over juristen van de NCTV die oordeelden dat de eigen dienst onrechtmatig handelde bij het verzamelen van privacygevoelige gegevens over burgers

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why he did not act on signals from NCTV lawyers that the agency unlawfully collected and analysed privacy-sensitive data on citizens, and about the legal basis for that monitoring. The minister answered that internal legal discussion existed but a general legal basis was assumed, that the NCTV concluded the basis was legally vulnerable, that certain activities were suspended, and that a bill creating a specific statutory basis is forthcoming.
There is no list kept of that.
Daar is geen lijst van bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de te verwachten asielstroom uit Afghanistan en Litouwen en het huidige structurele tekort aan faciliteiten in de opvang

The MP asks how the government will address shortages of asylum reception capacity in light of expected inflows from Afghanistan and Lithuania, including whether budget cuts and COVID have eroded reception capacity and whether EU-level coordination will be pursued. The State Secretary answers that talks with COA, municipalities and provinces are ongoing, temporary locations have opened, budget adequacy is under review at regular budget moments, and the government is pressing for a coordinated EU approach while noting Lithuania did not request redistribution.
In the course of October I will inform your House, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, about progress.
In de loop van oktober zal ik uw Kamer, samen met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over het falen van het EU-migratiebeleid en de gelekte Raadsnotitie voor vrijwillige terugkeer

An MP asked about the European Court of Auditors report finding weak EU returns cooperation with third countries, and about a leaked Council note on voluntary return and reintegration. The Secretary of State largely agreed with the report, described Dutch positions on EU-level coordination and a new legal framework for return, and offered mainly general measures without concrete commitments.
I share the European Court of Auditors' finding that effective return policy is necessary for an effective EU asylum and migration policy.
Ik deel de bevinding van de Europese Rekenkamer dat een effectief, werkend terugkeerbeleid noodzakelijk is voor een effectief EU asiel- en migratiebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de Conferentie over de Toekomst van Europa

Two Volt MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Conference on the Future of Europe is organised in the Netherlands, covering citizen representativeness, the choice of external contractor, themes, youth dialogues, coordination with provinces and municipalities, and how results will be used. The minister answered in detail, describing representative survey panels, online and in-person dialogues, a communication campaign, reports to the Conference and a planned timeline, without declining to provide requested information.
The cabinet will convey the outcomes of the national citizen consultations to the Conference and ensure they are taken into account in the Conference's final report.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten van de nationale burgerconsultaties overbrengen in de Conferentie, en er zorg voor dragen dat deze worden meegenomen in het eindverslag van de Conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de effecten op klimaat, milieu en inkomenspositie van boeren

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a WUR scenario study on the national CAP strategic plan, its public draft, the required environmental assessment and the researchers' call for a more ambitious plan. The minister answered that the report was sent to parliament on 15 September, that the public June draft was only a high-level version for national debate and must meet EU requirements by 31 December 2021, that the environmental assessment is not yet made and will be shared once done, and that no statements on ambition can be made yet.
Once the environmental assessment is ready, it will be shared with your House.
Zodra de m.e.r. gereed is, zal hij met uw Kamer gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over pulsvergunningen

An MP asked the minister how future incompatibilities between parliamentary wishes and EU rules on pulse fishing licences could be brought to parliament's attention, and what the effects were of extra licences on the level playing field and on relations with France. The minister acknowledged that warnings were ignored and that incompatibility with EU law should be flagged, but rejected a separate reporting paragraph, and argued that the pulse gear gave Dutch fishers an advantage without distorting competition.
Given the political and societal pressure, these signals were not acted upon at the time. That is not good and lessons must be learned from it.
Gezien de politieke en maatschappelijke druk zijn deze signalen destijds niet opgepakt. Dat is niet goed en daar moet van geleerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over privacy schending door het COA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the IND shares full asylum decisions and intended rejections with the COA, and whether this enabled a COA employee to leak information about an asylum seeker online. The State Secretary confirmed the sharing, said internal investigation found no sign of a COA employee leaking the information, and stated the IND will stop sharing full decisions with the COA while alternatives are examined.
In practice it has become apparent that the COA needs certain information to carry out its statutory task, but not all the information in the decisions.
In de praktijk is gebleken dat het COA bepaalde informatie nodig heeft voor het uitvoeren van de wettelijke taak, maar niet alle informatie uit de beschikkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Ellemeet over het monitorrapport 'Leefomstandigheden van kinderen in de asielopvang'

MPs Koekkoek and Ellemeet asked about a monitoring report on children's living conditions in asylum reception centres, including feelings of insecurity, frequent relocations and the role of COA child contact persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said some improvements have been made and that recommendations are being studied, but did not commit to adopting all of them and gave only general commitments on relocations and contact persons.
I am grateful to the members of the Werkgroep Kind in azc and the involved organisations for the research and the monitoring report.
Ik ben de leden van de Werkgroep Kind in azc en de betrokken organisaties erkentelijk voor het onderzoek en het monitorrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Koekkoek over de dreigende uitzetting van Davit en Nunë

MPs Ceder and Koekkoek asked the State Secretary about the threatened deportation of two Groningen-born children to Armenia, citing developmental risks, the child-rights convention, social networks, and the IND's handling of the children's stay and missed-whereabouts rules. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, maintained that the best interests of the child are weighed under Article 8 ECHR, and refused to change the criteria or commission new research.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Simons over de veiligheidssituatie in azc’s voor lhbti-asielzoekers

MPs Koekkoek and Simons asked the State Secretary about safety for LGBTI asylum seekers in reception centres, citing LGBT Asylum Support reports of frequent, unanswered incident reports and weekend gaps in follow-up. The State Secretary replied that Bureau Veiligheid forwards reports to locations without substantive feedback for privacy reasons, that after-hours incidents are handled on site, that the COA now registers suspected discrimination, and that separate LGBTI units are rejected in favour of tailored placement.
Bureau Veiligheid does not give substantive feedback, only a brief email to LGBT Asylum Support confirming the signal was received and passed on.
Bureau Veiligheid geeft geen inhoudelijke terugkoppeling, maar een korte reactie aan LGBT Asylum Support per e-mail dat het signaal is ontvangen en doorgegeven.

m: Motie van het lid Moorman over een nieuwe wet voor de vestiging van scholen
Asks the government to send its policy response on the school establishment law early and draft a new law that tackles its harmful effects and gives municipalities an explicit advisory right.
an advisory right for municipalities is explicitly included
expliciet een adviesrecht voor gemeenten wordt opgenomen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over elke tien jaar evalueren of de kerndoelen moeten worden herzien

Requires the minister to send Parliament a report every ten years on whether core objectives must be revised, taking into account advice from the Onderwijsraad, and gives the Onderwijsraad an advisory task on the curriculum.
Every ten years the Minister sends the States General a report on the need to revise the core objectives
Onze Minister zendt iedere tien jaar aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de noodzaak tot herziening van de krachtens het tweede lid vastgestelde kerndoelen
Motie van het lid Boomsma c.s. over voldoende tijd voor leraren voor het nakijken van schrijfopdrachten
Asks the government to examine and ensure teachers have enough time to mark writing assignments and that this is reflected in tests and exams.

Amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over elke acht jaar evalueren of de kerndoelen moeten worden herzien
Requires the minister to report to parliament every eight years on whether the core objectives (kerndoelen) for education need revision, drawing on the Education Council's advice.
Every eight years the Minister sends the States General a report on the need to revise the core objectives.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vliegenthart en Moorman over het bericht ‘Reclame Code Commissie geeft pro life-organisatie ‘stevige tik op de vingers’ vanwege misleidende abortusfolder'

MPs Vliegenthart and Moorman asked about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that an anti-abortion organisation's folder was misleading, and what the government would do about misinformation on abortion care in GP waiting rooms. The State Secretary said the government is funding research and strategies against misinformation, that the choice of materials is up to GP practices, and that the RCC is the appropriate body to act, not the ministry.
I have not contacted Kies Leven following the ruling. The Advertising Code Committee is an independent body that oversees compliance with the advertising code.
Ik heb geen contact opgenomen met Kies Leven naar aanleiding van de uitspraak. De Reclame Code Commissie is een onafhankelijk orgaan dat toeziet op naleving van de reclamecode.
